title: Greta Sees Ghosts!
description: Greta Sees Ghosts! is a lovingly crafted cozy adventure filled with quirky ghosts, witty dialogue, and clever shape-based puzzles. Explore remote islands, help the dead move on, and uncover Greta’s quietly touching story — one odd encounter at a time.

title: Memoria Wake
description: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

title: Farmbotic
description: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmatic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

title: Rollo Pollo
description: The evil robots want to eat all the baby chickens! Plan your strategy by placing the arrows and blocks on the correct tiles and solve the puzzles. Move your chicken around the map and save all the chicks in each of the 100 levels.

title: Inauthentic Hummus
description: in 'Inauthentic Hummus' you play as a refugee running a food truck, serving "almost" authentic ethnic dishes. Upgrade your tools, ingredients, and truck to serve customers quickly. Earn your citizenship and buy passports for your family within 30 days.

title: Land of Idyllic Beauty
description: Welcome to "Land Of Idyllic Beauty" a simulation management game that combines farming, store management, supply chain management, and romance elements. Experience the beauty of the idyllic life, starting from a small plot of farmland, gradually building your agricultural and commercial empire!

title: Orion Defense
description: Orion Defense is a space-themed shooting game with a tower defense element. You will build turrets or manually control turrets to repel incoming enemy attacks in a space fortress. You will also pilot fighters to stop enemy fleeing and capture enemy commanders in the asteroid belt.

title: Desert Angels
description: A story-driven exploration game set in a desert scrapyard. Search for memories in the trash, speak to its ghosts, and blast new paths with the weapons you find. Seek the generator to save your oasis village, and make your choices: What gets to be remembered, and what gets to be forgotten?

title: Fay Keeper
description: Battle, catch, and morph hundreds of Fays in this new turn-based creature collector RPG! Traverse the vast realm of The Faylands, filled with bustling cities, challenging dungeons and arenas, hidden routes and unpredictable weather. Ascend ranks to become the ultimate Fay Keeper!

title: Diving Focus
description: “Diving Focus” is a scuba diving simulator in which you have to explore the underwater world by diving into the water and looking for objects that will help you in the further progression of the game!

title: Take Stock
description: Take Stock! is the ultimate wacky stock trading simulation strategy game! You take your time getting information about stocks in order to make the most profit buying and selling shares. Featuring a colorful monochromatic art style!

title: Meat Fest
description: A Single-player Story Shooter of the old school. Dynamics, Strategy, Secrets, Upgrades. The familiar appearance of the planet is a thing of the past, in its fragments lie the answers to the question: why did the Earth become unsuitable for human life?

title: Hunters of Idlearth
description: Manage a team of three hunters, improve their attributes as you progress through different stages and complete missions. All of this happens in the corner of your screen, allowing you to continue your daily tasks on the computer while the game progresses.

title: Escape Everlit
description: A narrative-driven sci-fi mystery featuring four playable protagonists trapped in an island mansion. Switch between characters to explore, investigate, and piece together their mysterious past while uncovering the truth behind their predicament.

title: Dungeon Legend Party
description: This is a dungeon style roguelike adventure game, Choose your dungeon hero to participate in this adventure.

title: Euclid Valley
description: Euclid Valley is a fast-paced, arcade game with some rougelike elements in which you fight for survival against all manner of shapes in a variety of small, difficult levels. Strive to achieve the highest score possible by staying alive and killing the hoards of enemies.

title: Ellixir's Dream
description: Ellixir's Dream is a single-player otome adventure where players, as an alchemist’s daughter, uncover their origins through choices and shape their fate with multiple endings.

title: Maxima: Keepers of the 2nd Law
description: Unleash devastating power in this surreal third-person shooter. Charge orbs of raw energy in your hands to obliterate enemies in explosive bursts of particles. Bring down floating monoliths threatening the universe, and battle through a visually stunning sci-fi hellscape with supernatural abilities.

title: SoulForge
description: Harness the power of a corrupted blade as you navigate forgotten ruins, kill monsters, and balance your soul between power and corruption in this dark, atmospheric dungeon souls-like game!

title: The Maimed God's Saga
description:
The Maimed God's Saga is a fan-made campaign for Neverwinter Nights 2.

You play as a cleric of Tyr, the god of justice, on assignment to investigate attacks by a mysterious beast. Joined in your adventure by a friendly ranger, you solve various problems in a Town with a Dark Secret, a secret that eventually brings you into conflict with corruption at the very heart of the Church of Tyr itself.

title: Galactic Pawns
description: Galactic Pawns is an action-packed roguelite bullet hell, where you eliminate high-profile targets across war-torn planets. Master a vast arsenal, upgrade your abilities, and adapt to ever-changing battlefields in a fight for galactic order.

title: Meat Grinder: First Cut
description: “First Cut” is a short, standalone prologue to Meat Grinder, introducing the world, tone, and atmosphere of a story where every slice has consequences.

title: Stillness
description:
The mountain is quite and you are not alone...
A short sci-fi survival horror game about a failed recon mission. After the helicopter crash leaves two pilots stranded, one must fight to survive the cold, search for shelter, and uncover an unknown presence hidden beneath the snow.

title: This World Is Over
description: Explore, collect, craft, build, hunt, eat, drink, fight or run away in order to survive another day. You have an entire world to make your own history, but remember... This World Is Over...

title: Mushroam
description: A 2D puzzle-platformer where you use your powers to place bubbles that launch you through the air to avoid hazards and reach new depths. You play a mushroom bubblemancer, on a journey through dangerous caves and ruins to save your village, in this punchy and kinetic platformer.

title: My Camp of Memories
description: A visual novel in the romance and adventure genre. Awaken in the Honeycombs, a camp where memory is erased and secrets hum in the night. Forge bonds, defy the Union, and uncover your past. Will you be a pawn or ignite freedom as war looms?

title: Forgotten Signal: Portal
description: Grandfather contacted aliens, a portal opened, and he was taken! Solve puzzles, go through the portal to space, and save him. Survive with 3 skills: see enemies, turn invisible, stop time to freeze foes. Fight aliens, defeat the giant boss!

title: Digital Market Simulator
description: Run a marketplace where you can sell games and everything related, take care of customers and shape it however you want.

title: Realm
description: Defend the last bastion of humanity with magic and strategy in this intense tower defense game.

title: Soul Chained
description: A co-op souls-lite adventure awaits in Soul Chained. Face brutal enemies, overcome complex platforming challenges, and learn to work together within the constraints of the Soul Chain. You will be chained to your co-op partner so remember to communicate!

title: Farmer’s Market Simulator
description: Escape the corporate grind and embrace farm life in Farmer’s Market Simulator! Grow crops, raise animals, and run your own market. Manage resources, upgrade your farm, and sell fresh produce to build a thriving business. Can you turn your dream into reality?

title: Dice Battle: 3d Board Game
description: Dice Battle brings the thrill of friendly competition as you roll the dice, strategize your moves, and enjoy moments of triumph and tension. It's a fun, lighthearted experience that keeps you engaged and eager for the next turn.

title: Yanloveless Simulator
description:
YanLoveLess Simulator is a fangame of Yandere Simulator, developed by @jxstleslie for Windows, Android, and iOS. The game features custom characters in a dramatic high school setting.

Ana Mijlović is a young girl who recently transferred to a prestigious high school. Although seemingly calm and reserved, Ana hides a difficult past and deep emotional wounds. Marked by a tragic event at her old school, she develops a troubled view of love and attachment. Behind her melancholic gaze lies a fierce desire to never lose those she loves again, even if it means resorting to extreme behavior.

In YanLoveLess Simulator, Ana isn't just a rival or an ally: she's a character whose evolution depends on the player's choices. Can she be saved from her obsession? Or will she be consumed by her uncontrollable feelings?

title: Baccarat
description: Baccarat keeps you on the edge of your seat with every turn of the cards! Feel the thrill of high-stakes decisions, the rush of a perfect hand, and the sweet satisfaction of a big win. Will luck be on your side, or will the suspense keep you coming back for more?

title: Passenger: Gone
description: Based on the mechanics of trading card games and roguelike elements, we have incorporated charming heroines from different worlds along with a variety of relics and equipment. Players can freely choose between battling or gathering resources in a cyclical world where each loop consists of 30 steps.

title: The Eternal Hunt
description: Endgame-first ARPG: Conquer infinite dungeons, master deep loot, and dominate leaderboards. Built for grinders.

title: Polyglock
description: POLYGLOCK combines flash-cards with FPS aiming mechanics to create ridiculously fun, satisfying and productive gameplay. Create and share your own decks, or play through the curated content to learn anything you like.

title: Isekai Adventurer Guild
description: One day, countless Isekai adventurers were suddenly summoned, and at the same time, numerous monsters appeared. As the master of the Adventurers Guild, you will train adventurers to solve the anomalies. Experience the fun of SRPG alongside various adventurers!

title: Saloonery
description: Grab your trusty revolver and blast away outlaws in this fast-paced shooter. You'll need to use the wide arsenal of weapons, your razor-sharp reflexes, and an itchy trigger finger to bring order to the lawless western frontier. It's Saloonery time!

title: For the Forge
description: Build the ultimate PvP slot machine and battle rival dwarves for control of the last great dwarven forge!

title: Merchants of the Stars
description: A "Space Traffic Control" game where you control cargo ships by clicking and dragging them, attempting to guide them to docks where they can unload. Be careful, if things get too chaotic and ships collide or run into other obstacles, such as pirates or asteroids, then you lose.

title: Evel Knievel
description: Ride and jump your way to glory on a motorcycle and a prayer!

title: Dancing Bones
description: Wild West, ancient magic, non-linear plot, puzzles and colorful characters are all waiting for you in “The Dancing Bones”! Deep drama and humor intertwine in a unique world where every choice you make changes the story. Are you ready to uncover secrets, break curses, and change your destiny?

title: Funny Cargo Simulator
description: From a small shop to a cargo empire! Deliver packages, earn money, buy vehicles and hire staff to grow your business. Fast delivery, big success!

title: IndianOps
description: Hey Folks :- IndianOps is Free to play Cross-Platform Tactical Shooter .

title: Re-Fracture: The Prophet’s Awakening
description: Re – Fracture: The Prophet’s Awakening follows the journey of Shaiden Wreath as he searches for his brother displaced by the tragic series of destructive events that led to the collapse of their world.

title: Delfini
description: Delfini is a gentle and delicate two-player cooperative ocean exploration game, it is about a moving journey where two dolphins bravely save the polluted coral reef island.

title: Planet IX
description: You and up to 2 friends will upkeep the facility by doing tasks. Most tasks are easy like cleaning rubbish, but some tasks can be the death of you. Complete all 4 shifts in order to receive your paycheck.

title: Boss of FCs
description: Boss Of FCs is a text-based game that includes strategy, simulation and football/soccer. You will start on this path with a certain budget and move towards success and wealth by making the right moves. Make the best deals and the best transfers, buy and sell clubs and move towards the top...

title: Mination
description: Mination is an arcade twin-stick shooter/survivor with roguelite and story elements. Take control of Minerva as she mines ores, avoids or fight pirates and aims for a high score! Earn space-dollars to upgrade your ship, progress the story to unlock rewards and head back to get on that leaderboard!

title: God Trials
description: You will play as an ordinary person who has been chosen by the main god and can fulfill a wish by completing a trial assigned by the main god, with four different characters to choose from, each with their own unique abilities, and up to four players can play together.

title: From By
description: From by is a simple third person action adventure game where players need to transform into various animals, evade danger and improve their skills in an environment full of mechanisms, and ultimately complete the competition to win.

title: Beware of Space Dragons
description: Beware of Space Dragons is a short, incremental journey about upgrading a space dragon from a small creature to the king of the cosmos. Eat asteroids, collect resources, get upgrades and become the most powerful being in space!

title: Deskeroes
description: Deskeroes is a desktop idle game allows you to build and dispatch heroes to battle monsters, farm resources, mine, manage stores, and engage in other interesting activities within a fantasy world.

title: Find Cats 5
description: This is a game where players search for the souls of many lost cats in a 3D world. The protagonist is an angel cat responsible for retrieving the souls of lost cats. Players need to play as the angel cat and explore and discover in different 3D worlds!

title: Camp Keepalive: Endless Summer
description: Camp Keepalive: Endless Summer is a turn-based strategy game set in a camp straight out of an 80's horror movie. Save the helpless and dull-witted campers from an onslaught of monsters with a team of counselors, each with their own unique abilities.

title: Hero Slayers
description: Hero Slayers is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. You must shape the fate of Lucy, who finds herself trapped in a crisis from which there's no easy escape due to a single misstep. Even if you fail, make different choices next time—so that you may reach a better ending.

title: The Lighthouse Secrets
description: On a remote and forgotten island, a century-old lighthouse that once guided ships across the seven seas has ceased to function. Its disappearance has sparked countless theories and speculations. To solve the mystery, the protagonist, is hired to investigate The Lighthouse Secrets.

title: Whispering Stacks
description: A Cozy Wizardly Rogue-Lite Zap-em-Up

title: Pogs: Power of Golden Slammer
description: A sandbox simulation featuring skateboarding, 90s toys and fashion, authentic turn based pogs battles, mini quests and fun wearable items.

title: Animesports: Party Basketball!
description: AnimeSports: Party Basketball! is a multiplayer eSports basketball video game. Team up with your friends or play against them in a variety of basketball games. Showing the world who has the best shot won't be easy because, as real basketball, you really need good hands to let the ball go in.

title: Speed Dates: Summer Edition
description: Summer's here and hearts are heating up! Meet five different beauties, hang out, flirt a little... and maybe even find your summer romance. Your choices matter — and the story's all yours.

title: Math Match Three
description: Math Match Three is a Match Three game with math elements,Connect numbers with the same factors into three to pass the level.Continuously improve your mathematical skills during the clearance process!

title: Hiss & Hunt
description: Dive into fast-paced 2D snake battles! Boost through chaos, outsmart rivals, and grow to dominate the arena. Instant respawns keep the action non-stop. Easy to learn, hard to master. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: VenusBlood Ragnarok International
description: VenusBlood Ragnarok is a direct sequel to the world-famous VenusBlood FRONTIER! Enjoy the combination of deep tactical gameplay with a rich narrative set around Norse mythology!

title: Jurassic Gym
description: Run your own dinosaur gym on the bottom of your screen while you stay productive! Hatch new buddies, train them up, send them to competitions, and spend your winnings upgrading and customizing your Jurassic Gym.

title: Strength in Numbers
description: Take back control of the galaxy and defeat the evil AI in this fast-paced, node-based strategy game. The humanoid races need all the help they can get. We're counting on you, Commander!

title: Cursor Blast
description: Cursor Blast is a space shooter in the style of old school SHMUPs with spaceships, heavily inspired by those from the Nintendo and Super Nintendo.

title: Jawless Fishtank
description: Explore raising your very own Sacabambaspis in the casual fish tank idler. Save coins and feed fish various foods, sparking a various set of reactions. Name your Sacabambaspis and watch them grow before your eyes.

title: Puzzle Company
description: You don’t solve puzzles — you help build them, test them, and handle all the weird stuff that comes with the job. Missions come to you, you head out, get it done, earn cash, unlock gear. It’s a job. Sort of.

title: Modular
description: MODULAR is a 2D sci-fi adventure where you build your "MODULAR" from modules. Explore, survive, and adapt as you uncover new tech, battle threats, and shape your journey through a dynamic environment.Your MODULAR. Your strategy. Your story.

title: Ideabookroom
description: The IdeaBookRoom is a writing and reading software that goes beyond plain text by incorporating multimedia and interactive components such as "Narrator," "Image", "ShowText", "Words Before", and "Words At End" significantly enhancing readers' experience.

title: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
description: You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil. Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night. Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?

title: Pirate Go: Bravo
description: A turn-based strategy game where classic board game mechanics meet high-seas adventure. Roll the dice, conquer islands, collect treasure, and outwit rivals in your quest to become the ultimate pirate tycoon.

title: The Death Forest
description: The Death Forest is a psychological horror game set in a cursed forest where hallucinations blur reality. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying visions, and uncover the truth behind the legend—before you lose your

title: Gone Fishing
description: GONE Fishing is a co-op multiplayer survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

title: The Tumor
description: Hardcore stealth survival-horror in retro style with realistic physics. The creature is faster, hears, and feels you perfectly. Escape is impossible. Craft, set traps, strategize. Hide, deceive, and fight to uncover the truth.

title: My Shelter
description: This is a placement game located at the bottom of the screen that won't interfere with your daily study and work. Research technologies, grow crops, automate tasks, explore maps, utilize various machines to craft items, and defend against monsters. With just you and a dog, conquer the apocalypse!

title: Legend of Hiraq
description: Traverse a blazing desert and brave ancient ruins teeming with deadly traps, enigmatic djinn, and hidden lore. Experience heart-pounding action and thrilling mysteries in this epic adventure.

title: My Tiny Room
description: A zen puzzle game about placing furniture in a small, cozy space. Keep it clutter-free and create a peaceful retreat.

title: Laserade: Sugar Rush
description: Evade lasers and other hazards in this first-person action platformer while chugging as many Suga soft energy drinks as you can, boosting your speed while feeding your insatiable sugar addiction.

title: Another Level
description: Another level is a game that might be a different level from the existing normal game levels and not have been ever experienced before with multiple unique gameplay that can be played by 1–4 players.

title: Arcadia: Cloudbound
description: 3D Find Different A visual and auditory feast of the Ninth Art

title: GigaSlave
description: GigaSlave is a horizontal-scrolling multiplayer online shooting game developed as a tribute to Metal Slug. It inherits the scrolling level-clearing gameplay of Metal Slug and, in a masterful touch, adds a PVP mode. In the game, the trading and social systems stand out as its most striking features.

title: Traffic Rivals: 1v1 Duels
description: Traffic Rivals: 1v1 Duels is an action-packed street racing game where you skillfully weave through heavy traffic in intense 1v1 duels. Outsmart rivals with strategy and skill, customize your car, and become a street legend solo or with friends in co-op mode!

title: Becoming a King
description: Take control of your destiny in "Becoming a King", an exciting time management romance game!

title: Flipto
description: A rogue-like slot-machine builder about cryptocurrency and capitalism. Score lines and set off chain reactions to generate a fortune. Invest that fortune in upgrades (or back into coins) to amass an even bigger one! All the fun of casinos and day-trading without the risk of financial ruin!

title: CivRise
description: Forge your civilization in this strategic idle game. Develop knowledge, build wonders, command armies, and recruit historical figures as you evolve from primitive beginnings to a mighty empire. The Heritage system lets your achievements persist, making each new civilization stronger than the last.

title: Sunset Sprout
description: Sunset Sprout is a cozy farming simulation game where you rebuild a ruined island and grow it into a thriving paradise. Relax, plant crops, raise animals, craft, and connect with your new community in this charming life sim inspired by the classic farming games of the past.

title: Dead by Backrooms Anomaly
description: A story-driven psychological horror game filled with puzzles and comedic moments. Follow the thrilling, love-filled adventure of a woman as she navigates a mysterious and captivating atmosphere.

title: Mystery of the Malign
description: Investigate. Interrogate. Descend into a world of intrigue to untangle the Mystery of the Malign.

title: Island Supermarket Simulator
description: Island Market Simulator is a relaxing shop management game where you run your own store on a beautiful island. Expand your business by buying making sure all your products are in stock, purchasing more shelves and storage, and purchasing more space to increase the size of your shop!

title: Hollow Jump
description: Jump and dash that’s your whole life. In a world of dystopia, fantasy, and steampunk, you run to find truth. Meet people, dodge monsters, and leap between buildings. Simple controls hide a test of patience and purpose. HollowJump — an addictive vertical adventure where philosophy follows every jump

title: Jumpscare Slayer
description: A horror game with surprises and puzzles

title: Videonauts
description: Videonauts is a pixel art adventure game where you must escape from a mysterious mansion full of deadly traps and terrors. You and your fellow trapped companions want to escape alive... but how you converse and solve exploration-based puzzles can change everyone's fate!

title: MPPP: Multidimensional Paper Plane Project
description: Fly a paper plane that transforms as you travel across dimensions. Each dimension changes how the game plays—test your reflexes, adapt on the fly, and see how long you can last in this fast-paced arcade challenge.

title: Santa Elena
description: The only path left is forward. Take the reins of Elena's revolution, conjure powerful incantations with the forgotten echoes of history, and deliver the final blow to the Duchy of Monte Branco in this short (2-3h) linear turn-based RPG with plenty of room for tactical creativity.

title: The Island of Doctor Morose
description: A horror adventure game inspired by the art of Theodor Geisel and the works of HP Lovecraft, featuring a mixture of point and click and survival horror elements.

title: Raccoon Cocoon
description: Raccoon Cocoon is a charming pixel art puzzle game where you join Grandma Raccoon and help her organize the little details of life in a relaxing way. From everyday clutter to the small messes nature brings, everything is waiting to be tidied up with calm and care!

title: InkBrush: The Demon Wars
description: "Inkbrush: The Demon Wars"is a 2D turn-based strategy game where you lead a team of an inkbrush boy and his companions. Explore a scroll-like world inspired by traditional Chinese ink art, triggering battles and events as you uncover hidden secrets through strategic decisions.

title: Hold.for.Humans
description: Hold the line so that humanity may live another day. Defend the evacuation lanes from the relentless spawns of a rogue AI in this rhythm/roguelite-infused hack n’ slash/tower defense game. Upgrade the last friendly robot on Earth, armed with a unwavering program and purpose: HOLD.FOR.HUMANS.

title: Hyperspace Striker
description: Alone in the vast expanse of space, you are the Hyperspace Striker. Choose a unique class of spaceship and survive the onslaught of factions defending their territory.

title: Thalia
description: Thalia is a fast paced roguelike action game. You as Thalia has been summoned to this ancient place where death is not the end, it is only the beginning. Fight hoards of enemies, giant bosses and improve in an infinite mechanic where death only makes you stronger!

title: Novems
description: Cut open your destiny with 9 cards! Master strategy in a turn-based roguelike auto-battler. Collect cards and survive battles by utilizing 'placement' and 'linking' mechanics.

title: Shake It Co!
description: Grow your orchard by shaking trees! Literally shake your mouse! Join Co, a friendly adventurer with a can-do spirit, and plant unique saplings for bountiful fruit. Collect coins, invest in upgrades, and harvest in a charming 2D style!

title: The Lake Lady
description: After his girlfriend died in a flood, the surgeon Salvio, in search of the truth behind his missing daughter, enters the "Ward No. 9" of Hongqiang Hospital, shrouded in the legend of the LakeLady.

title: Infinity Nikki: Playful Season
description:
Golden sunlight floods the land, and laughter echoes through Stoneville, welcoming the Playful Season!

Children gather in cheerful groups, bursting with giggles.
Meanwhile, adults roll up their sleeves to prepare delightful games.

A magical day that belongs to the young at heart is about to begin!

title: Aroma Love Ready!
description:
You run your own perfume store as the owner of a perfume store. A sudden accident has involved you in the investigation of your own resurrection from the dead.
The truth gradually emerges with three employees - a love affair about perfume. Harvest the memories of your own heartbeat in the game!

title: The Giving Well
description: After wandering into a forgotten town you overhear the townsfolk wishing by the town's well. Having traveled across the ancient forest you embark on quests to retrieve the lost items. Jump, Grapple, and Push your way through the forest to help those in need. While adventuring, you just might run into the spirits of the forest.

title: Neither Cross Nor Crown
description: A colorful souls-like late medieval power fantasy. Duel knights and strange creatures in a world loosely based on the Peasants' War of 1525. Collect unique weapons and armor and visit striking, atmospheric places!

title: Dead Station Files
description: Hardcore tactical roguelike puzzle about survival during a perfect storm of disasters aboard the space station. Explore, adapt, and plan your escape to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe. Or die.

title: Cursemark
description: Cursemark is an action-exploration roguelike where you forge unique equipment to pierce the depths of the Unknown Lands. Unlock hundreds of items and spells, then discover powerful rune synergies every run in this place beyond the edges of the world.

title: Little Chef
description: Little Chef is a fun and cute 2D physics-based cooking game with a focus on experimentation and discovery.

title: Tactical Annihilation
description: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

title: Raft Days
description: RAFT Days is a Sokoban-like puzzle + simple trading game. You travel across the sea from port to port, loading goods and tools onto your ship. You can save money by trading, expand your raft, hire sailors to help you, and enrich your journey. The waves and winds make this game relaxing to play.

title: Life Below
description: Life Below is a refreshing twist on the city-building genre, set beneath the waves. Shape thriving coral reefs, revive collapsing ecosystems, and grow a living seascape in a heartfelt narrative by Rhianna Pratchett. You are the ocean's final hope.

title: Bum: Revenge
description: First-person homeless crime sandbox. Steal, drink, hallucinate and crush rival bums in chaotic online co-op.

title: The Hatchling
description: Locked in a dystopian lab, a strange egg stirs. Control its environment, and ensure it hatches—before the system deems you unfit. The Hatchling is a chilling low-bit horror experience where every second counts. The Overseer is watching… will you succeed, or be discarded?

title: Colony 13: Into the Void
description: Explore this post apocalyptic semi-open world and the aftermath of an alien encounter. Play as simulated subject "G".Upgrade your weapons, find your way through the enemies, find the way to the main ship and save the crew. Humankind must leave the solar system! Something big is coming!

title: Fading Serenades
description: Hike, jump, and climb to traverse the treacherous terrain of the island to help villagers deliver parcels and complete their tasks and requests. Experience a story of vanishing traditions, a missing scientist, and an unfolding mystery. Serenading a quieter life, the island calls!

title: Oh? Me
description: "OH?ME" is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. Play as a ghost exploring the fragments of your past, uncovering hidden clues to different endings. Will you move forward, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in time?

title: GeTrix
description: Stack, swipe, and wave your way through a fast-paced puzzle challenge powered by intuitive hand-tracking controls.

title: FailFactory
description: Genre: 2D Side-scrolling Platformer Platform: PC Player Mode: Single Player Target Audience: Fans of fast-paced platformers with challenging mechanics!

title: Ancient Altar
description:
Hey!

You there!

Burned to death by the dragonfly again?

Got devoured by the hounds too many times?

Need better gear than your old log suit and 1% spear?

Then you need the ANCIENT ALTAR mod!

With the ANCIENT ALTAR you can craft thulecite fragments, the (broken) Ancient Pseudoscience Station and all the recipes that come with it!

Jump with joy as you use THE LAZY FORAGER to grab the items your teammates leave lying around (If they say you're stealing, blame the amulet!).

Become the fanciest person (or robot (or monster)) around with the THULECITE CROWN! Not only it reduces your damage taken, but it gives you an almighty shield once in a while. It also make you automatically the KING of the camp!

People disagree with your position as king? Grab the powerful THULECITE CLUB and SHOW EM WHO'S BOSS!

title: Mandatory Fun
description: You play as a young man conscripted into the Finnish military. Your actions shape how things turn out — for you, and for those around you. This is a story-rich experience with elements of drama, comedy, and romance… if you can call it that.

title: Shipwrecked Hamlet
description:
The Tropical Experience mod adds content from every DLC ever released on Don't Starve to Don't Starve Together, as well as adding event content and creating your own content. The screenshots below try to summarize what the mod would be like in a standard generation world. When the world is created you start on the Together continent, and you can sail across the ocean in search of new continents, including Lunar Island, Pig City, Tropical Islands, Frozen Island and more.

but the new content doesn't only affect the surface of the game, the mod also adds new zones inside the caves, like the frozen cave that can be accessed by an entrance on the frozen island, adds the Hamlet caves that can be accessed by any entrance on the island where the cities of the pigs are located, there is also the interior of the volcano, which has a portal that takes you to the forge arena, and in addition to these additions, all the contents of the don't starve together are kept.

title: Brainrot's Hamster Game
description: a silly free endless runner depicting the 1:1 experience of a hamster

title: Oldish Stuff
description: Travel through portals, tear your enemies apart, loot their gear, and sell it back to them in your pawnshop. An action-packed, darkly humorous game of looting and trading.

title: Pogo Stadium
description: POGO Stadium is a rhythm-based territory control battle game inspired by Go. Players bounce across futuristic arenas using pogo sticks, strategically placing blocks to capture territory in real time. The game features solo challenges and local multiplayer for up to four players, with customizable characters, gear, and dynamic music-synced visuals.

title: Heartlodged
description: In 6 hours, 28 minutes, and 11 seconds, an avalanche will crush the lodge. Is the cat in the box alive or dead?

title: Not Easy
description: Get ready for the ultimate challenge with Not Easy, a hardcore platformer that tests your skills and patience. Navigate relentless obstacles, gather keys, and unlock doors across 60 intense levels. Each level is designed to push your reflexes and determination to the limit. Can you conquer Not Easy?

title: Rollin' Along
description: Rollin' Along is an endless marble shooter game about an armadillo's journey! Play as Arma the Armadillo on her quest to save her cactus friends. See how far you can last through multiple in-game nights while using different power-ups and strategies!

title: Finger Fury Showdown
description: Prepare your fingers for the addictive Finger Fury Showdown, a skill-based 2D fighter with kung fu action. Every punch is significant! This is a martial arts tale, not just a fighting game!

title: Starless Umbra
description: Starless Umbra is a couch co-op action RPG. Join Amalia as she searches for her friend in a land afflicted by a noxious fog. The deeper she ventures, the further she unravels a force that threatens far more than just one life.

title: Price of Knowledge
description: Start your journey to meet your fears and new knowledge. You are forced to become an adult and learn the truth.

title: Terra Forma: Tower Combat
description: Terra Forma is a pixelated 2D tower defense, inspired by Flash-age classics. Build a dozen unique towers and create even more fusions by combining shock, ice, fire, and iron. Prove your command prowess one final time, and defend mankind's final hope.

title: Crayon Legend
description: Cursed nobles turned into Magic Doors watch their possessions eaten by an insatiable Mimic. Transported to this time-locked island, you must Jump, Lift, Search, and Feed to restore the kingdom. A family-friendly, 3D platformer with hand-coded physics, Unlock the doors to find your way home.

title: Iron Psycho: Retro
description: Iron Psycho: RETRO is a retro First-Person shooter in which the player must eliminate all threats aboard the ship and collect keys to reach the end of each level. Some levels contain secrets.

title: Alex: An Adventure Between the Ages
description: Dive into a dark, but quite funny story about a schoolboy who fell into another world and now cannot get out of there. Help Alex to pass through all the trials that will come his way. Solve puzzles, escape from monsters, and try to find out what's going on.

title: Deckmancers
description: Deckmancers, an action melee roguelite, blends deckbuilding with spell-slinging & sword-swinging chaos. Build arcane decks, play cards to cast powerful spells & cut through hordes of fantastic beasts. Journey through shattered realms, solo or in co-op, to conquer the arcane tournament.

title: Blaster Boy
description: Blaster Boy 2d shooter boss gauntlet. Players will Blast their way through a variety of bosses while completing challenges to unlock new playable characters, more game modes and other in-game content.

title: Gold Ryoushi
description: Follow VTUBER Omaimaimaii and pick up the fishing rod! Hook up the gold bars! Defend against the shameless marine creatures

title: Celler
description: Design your own single-celled organism and dive into a vast microscopic world. Eat, fight, and unlock upgrades to survive the dangerous microcosm.

title: Mafioso's Dice
description: A high-stakes mafia-themed dice and risk game. Four players roll dice to climb toward victory, then face off in deadly rounds of Russian roulette. Strategy, bluffing, and hidden cards determine who walks away alive.

title: Denovo
description: Become the ultimate Guild Master in a pixel art world! Manage your guild, craft epic gear, uncover a vast bestiary, and recruiting a diverse team of adventurers and workers. Prepare your heroes for battle and unravel the mystery surrounding your missing king!

title: Lords and Legions
description: Lords and Legions is a medieval fantasy battle game where you create epic clashes in a sandbox mode or play through the Campaign Mode to build your army step by step and take on all other factions. Take control of your Hero un in third-person combat, unleash powerful abilities, and turn the tide of war. Command, fight, and forge your legend!

title: Double It
description: Join the multiplayer online experience by spinning the fortune wheel in this deadly arena. Take your seat at a table with up to 6 players and earn money with every spin. Remember, deception can double your cash or be your downfall! Are you ready for an unforgettable night?

title: Blood Country
description: Blood Country is a roguelike shooter set in the Wild West. Kill outlaws with your guns, knife, and dynamite. Defeat the gang's leader, and free the country from outlaws, bandits, and scoundrels.

title: Void Wave: Drift
description: Customize your Ionblade and race through gravity-defying tracks in Void Wave Drift, a sleek anti-gravity combat racer. Use powerups, destroy the track to forge shortcuts, and master the Drift in a high-speed fight for glory across the galaxy.

title: Strip Miner
description: A roguelike mining game where you descend through shells of rock. Collect, Deposit, Upgrade and Profit.

title: Bug Off
description: Squash bugs with your feet, unwind, and earn points in this fun and satisfying game.

title: Bside
description: Create your Biibit with unique personalities and watch them evolve independently in a multi-character life sim. Build custom life-sim spaces where Biibits autonomously live and interact. Experience real companionship as your Biibit connects you with their social life and becomes your desktop buddy!

title: Lucky Zombie Survival
description: You knew in advance before the zombie crisis breake out, go to the supermarket to buy everything you need! Then stay at home and play your mobile phone in order to survive in this madness!

title: Psychological Challenge
description: An unsettling little game that can increase blood pressure and effectively treat low blood pressure.

title: Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune
description: Hire companions, master trade routes, and navigate a shifting landscape of war, weather, and wealth in Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune - a colourful, character-driven trading sim set along the legendary Silk Roads.

title: I See Me
description: Overcome the trials by relying on your partner's sights! A 3D co-op game that goes beyond common sense. Enjoy unique gameplay based on sights in I See Me.

title: Mystic Jumper
description: A clumsy wizard miscasts a spell, turning himself into random objects! Now stuck at the bottom of his own tower, he must triple-jump his way to the top to fix his mistake. Master precise platforming, avoid traps, and use unique object physics in this retro pixel-art adventure!

title: Soul Cauldron
description: Create a Coven of Witches in this Min-Maxing dungeon runner, where you meticulously redesign your characters for every new dungeon with over 500 unique spells in 6 spheres of magic. Get ready for hours of stat comparing, synergy building and running side quests for that set item you're missing.

title: 40D40M
description: 40 Doors 40 Mistakes is an anomaly-spotting game for up to 4 players. Walk through 40 unsettling rooms. Spot what’s wrong, capture it, and keep going—unless you miss one.

title: Lost Liminal
description: Lost Liminal is a quirky first-person exploration and deconstruction game based on the BackRoom urban legend! Players will take on the role of a wanderer lost in the backroom hierarchy, determining the ultimate outcome based on your choices!

title: ShopFront
description: ShopFront is a fast paced top down twin stick action arcade-like game set in a fantasy world full of heroes. Play as Keeper, an elderly shop keeper with a poor temper fed up with all the heroes destroying his pottery and decides to take matters into his own hands.

title: Soul Nexus
description: Soul Nexus is a text-based adventure game where you explore strange environments and interact with even stranger individuals. Will you wander the spaces forever or will you eventually fulfil your goal of being free?

title: A Game About Cards
description: The pure card game, craft weapon cards, slay monster cards, create insane combos with cards. everything is cards. i love cards. the deckbuilder for card lovers

title: Blackroot: Medieval Survival
description: Survive in a dark medieval world plagued by the undead. Gather resources, build shelter, and face the horrors of Blackroot.

title: Unboxing: 1-Bit Paradox
description: UNBOXING is a puzzle-platformer where death is your key. Die, revive, and solve tricky puzzles using your companion box to return back to life. Will you find the cause of this endless cycle? Will you break free?

title: Idle Frontier
description: This idle game blends card-based building, resource management, and relaxed gameplay. Expand your village, master sect skills, explore realms, and enjoy offline rewards. Effortless fun awaits—start your journey to immortality!

title: Dyson Era Idle
description: In Dyson Era Idle, harness stellar power to build cosmic megastructures. Research technologies, select unique stars, and construct increasingly efficient Dyson Spheres. Transform theoretical astrophysics into a captivating idle experience of galactic engineering.

title: Cult Leader Simulator
description: Strategize, discover new cards, control risk, gather followers and increase your power. You are the leader of your own cult!

title: Blocky's Short Quest
description: Play as Blocky with super high jumping height in this 2D adventure platformer. Discover new worlds where Blocky's abilities change.

title: Command Deck
description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where you explore the galaxy, face hostile aliens, and upgrade your starship. It will take adaptability and strategic thinking to survive and uncover the secret your enemies want to keep hidden.

title: Feeding the Velociraptors
description: Feeding the Velociraptors is a point-and-click interactive escape game where you wander corridors, trying to escape both the blame for your past actions—and the scientifically realistic raptors who cast no blame upon you for said past actions, but will still eat you regardless.

title: Uncanny Tales: 1992
description: Autumn, 1992. Anton, a 14-year-old boy, moves with his parents to a small town and is left alone in his grandmother's apartment. Meanwhile, children are disappearing across the town — the police are powerless, and no one knows who's behind it…

title: Small Bird Poem
description: Fly from hideout to hideout, dodge gentle dangers, and watch your poem change with each choice. small bird poem is a short, interactive journey through natural and urban bird habitats. Play it with your youngest — or alone, for a quiet evening or bedtime moment.

title: One King Is Enough
description: High-speed territory control battle! Build structures, earn money, and grow your army to expand your territory. One King Is Enough is a strategy roguelike deck-building game where you compete against players worldwide in asynchronous battles. Outsmart your rivals with your own powerful builds.

title: Limb Driver
description: While tasked with disposing of bodies for the mafia, you carry a mutilated corpse without question. However, as time passes, the secrets of the body you carry slowly begin to surface.

title: Bandido Rush
description: Trapped deep in a collapsing gold mine, a fearless Mexican bandido needs your help to escape. Use his trusty six-shooter to master airborne movement, navigate treacherous worlds with unique mechanics, and conquer hardcore platforming levels. Can you save him before the mine caves in?

title: Museum Magnate
description: Museum Magnate is a 3D museum tycoon game which gives you all the freedom you would expect from a tycoon game. Show your skills as a manager and builder and watch your museum grow and prosper.

title: Bitbird
description: Bitbird is a 2D platformer where players manipulate gravity to overcome challenging levels. The game starts with monochrome pixel-art and evolves through 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit styles inspired by different gaming eras.

title: Aetherfall
description: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.

title: Lost World Survivor
description: In this lost world, fight against thousands of monsters, learn new skills and enhance one's own abilities from dozens of techniques, and strive to survive. Step by step unlock new abilities and ultimately challenge the Hell Dragon.

title: Awrak
description: Build combos with your characters and cards to reach MASSIVE numbers! Choose from unique characters, stack powerful synergies, and unleash a storm of projectiles in this roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Aether Delight
description:
Aether Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that adds compatibility with The Aether (and addons: Deep Aether, Redux, Lost Content)
It's recommended to play with JEI and Appleskin to view recipes and food stats in-game.

title: Deadly Deals
description: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

title: The Seven Enchantments
description: Play as Józef of Místov a conman exorcist. Discover the unique story through clues about what dark mysteries fell upon the denizens of a remote village of Pradonin, all while trying to survive the Horrors along the way.

title: Mechaconda
description: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while collecting cards that add unique ability upgrades to the body of a small snake Mechaconda.

title: Cultural Delights
description: A Farmer's Delight addon that adds food systems from around the world.

title: Light Up the Town
description: Light Up The Town is a cozy, casual holiday game for all ages. Play as Bean, a precocious young ferret, and explore the town of Bellflower, Colorado as you hang up festive string lights around to spread holiday cheer. Click to throw a light or decoration; the only limit is your imagination.

title: Miner's Delight +
description:
Miner's delight is an addon for Farmer's Delight that adds culinary content focused on Caves, including a new and mysterious meat-flavored crop that grows in caves!

Experiment with new and unique ingredients to prepare delicious or unusual meals to share with your friends!!

This Addon Mod for Farmer's Delight focuses on making gastronomic content more accessible to mining!!!

title: Gobber Delight
description:
Gobber Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that adds compatibility with Gobber.
It's recommended to play with JEI and Appleskin to view recipes and food stats in-game.

Main Features
Whole new food tier for the End in style of Gobber Mod.
Expanded Gobber and Nether Gobber food tiers.
New knives for all three sets of items.
New cutting board recipes for more efficient processing of gooey meat.
Additional alternative recipes for gooey beewstew.
Lightweight and compatible with most mods via forge tags.

title: Large Meals
description:
A Farmer's Delight addon that adds new and creative recipes to the game.
This mod currently adds 5 types of food: Soup, Plated food, Feast, Sweets and Pie.
Forge support.

title: Ocean's Delight
description:
Ocean's Delight is an addon mod for Farmer's Delight based around adding culinary content to the ocean!

Using your culinary skills, you can prepare a myriad of hearty meals made with creatures of the ocean!

This Addon Mod for Farmer's Delight focuses on giving more content to the Ocean to satisfy our desire to eat those creatures from the depths!!!

title: Slime Delight
description:
Slime Delight is a lightweight add-on mod for Farmer's Delight, that adds a handful of food items made using Slimeball or Magma Cream, and - a large bowl of lava. You can drink this bowl of lava directly.

Most Slimeball food give jump boost effect, and most Magma Cream food give Fire Resistance effect.

title: Spanish Delight
description:
Spanish Delight is a mod that expands upon the cooking system from Farmer's Delight introducing spanish cuisine's traditional plates such as Spanish Tortilla, Gazpacho and more.

Find new ingredients spawned in the world and cook delicious new meals!

⚙️ Dependencies:

You will need Farmers Delight and Forge to run this mod, and optionally but highly recommended JEI !

title: Vintage Delight
description:
Vintage Delight is a culinary-focused mod that enriches your farming and cooking experience in the game. As an addon to the Farmer's Delight mod, it introduces a variety of new crops, foods, and crafting processes mainly centered around the new block, the Fermenting Jar.

Fermenting Jar: The centerpiece of Vintage Delight. Use this innovative block to pickle various foods and experiment with fermentation. Displaying the items inside, it can be used also as a decorative block

title: Naturalist Delight
description:
This mod creates compatibility between Farmer's Delight and Naturalist

Currently adds 9 food items in game. It also adds tags and recipes for the other meats and drops from naturalist so that they can be used in standard Farmer's Delight recipes.

title: Nether's Delight
description:
Nether's Delight is an addon mod for Farmer's Delight based around adding culinary content to the nether!

Using advanced hunting techniques and culinary skills, you can manage to prepare a myriad of disgusting meals and moss-covered snacks, and even survive a little longer in the Nether!

This Addon Mod for Farmer's Delight focuses on giving more content to the Nether to satisfy our desire to eat the infernal creatures!!!

title: Veggies Delight
description:
Veggies Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that introduces a variety of new vegetables and dishes to the game.

Adds 4 new vegetables: Bell Peppers 🫑, Cauliflowers 🥦, Garlic 🧄, and Sweet Potatoes .
Adds Dandelion Leaf (Foraging food).
Seed Pouches : a convenient new way to store your seeds (basically like crates).
Adds Depot Houses to village: a new structure where it serves as a storage area for various goods.
The mod is also fully compatible with Botany, Create, CreateAdditions, Diet, and Serene Seasons (and a lot of other mods)

Use JEI and Appleskin for a better experience.

title: More Delight
description:
Embark on an expanded culinary journey with More Delight, a mod for Farmer's Delight designed to improve your cooking experience!

Expand your menu with new meals and ingredients.
Craft sandwiches effortlessly using bread slices.
Enjoy crispy toasts made from bread slices.
Equip yourself with wooden and stone knives for culinary precision.

title: Domino Galaxy
description: Domino Galaxy is a minimalist puzzle that uses domino pieces combined with a galaxy theme. Arrange the dominoes to connect like numbers and form a complete sequence, while basking at the dazzling stars of the universe.

title: Rouletum
description: Roulette-based rogue-like with a bit of supernatural. Place your bets, use under-the-table chips and mystical sigils to claim your prize. Using your wits, a TON of luck and some help from strange places you can rise to the top of the Rouletum Casino!

title: Void Stalkers
description: As the pilot of a Void Rig, it's your job to transport dangerous creatures to various research facilities across the system. Use your ship's security cameras, drone, and other systems to solve problems and stay alive as you travel through The Void.

title: Cotard
description: A 4-part psychological horror adventure that will plunge you into the dark delusions of Cotard Syndrome. Shape your fate through crucial choices and unlock 7 different endings. Each playthrough unveils new secrets and chilling confrontations.

title: Wisp Gunner
description: "Wisp Gunner" is an immersive first-person shooter that combines core gameplay elements of stealth, tactical shooting, and resource management.

title: Ghost In The Grid
description: A short cyberpunk story about a security technician investigating a system outage in a city sector cut off from the network. The deeper he ventures into the digital underworld, the darker the truths he uncovers...

title: Death Row Escape
description: What started as a routine repair job becomes a fight for survival. Trapped in an abandoned prison controlled by a powerful AI, mercenaries, and deadly experiments, you must solve puzzles, break time loops, and escape!

title: Qume: Echoes of Sand
description: The world has been buried in dust. For those left behind, the sand is quieter than death. Become one of the survivors in Qume and uncover the secrets hidden behind the silence.

title: Dungeons of Uhr
description: "Dungeons of Uhr" – A gripping first-person RPG where you explore treacherous dungeons filled with ancient secrets, deadly creatures, and hidden treasures. Craft gear, master survival skills, and uncover the dark mystery buried deep within the labyrinthine depths.

title: Backrooms Bodycam
description: These are still the same yellow corridors and rooms inhabited by dangerous entities, but now you can fight them back!

title: Backrooms Bodycam 2
description: Enter the Mysterious World of the Backrooms! Find weapons left behind by other wanderers, fight off dangerous entities, and make your way to the exit!

title: Trigger of Time
description: A vanished expedition. A forgotten underground city. Explore the echoes of a lost civilization in this short first-person adventure, and bend time to solve intricate puzzles woven into the ruins.

title: BrainRooms: Brainrot Backrooms
description: BRAINROOMS is a grotesque horror born from a twisted internet: rotten memes, entities laughing at you, rooms that feel all wrong. A trashy, surreal nightmare where you scream, laugh, and lose your mind. Survive… if you can even grasp what's happening.

title: MoonMiners
description: MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator of miners in space, in an alternative dystopian future. You take on the role of space miners working for an evil corporation far from home, and it will be much easier for you to die than to do your job.

title: Discreet Mission
description: Game of infiltration and action. You have to complete the assigned mission.

title: No Customers Left
description: Andy, a night shift security guard at a game console store, expected a quiet shift in the nearly empty mall. But as the hours passed, an unsettling presence made itself known. Flickering lights, and distant echoes—something was watching. Little did he know, the night was just beginning.

title: Dawn Break
description: In 2039, tsunamis of varying degrees occurred all over the world, and multiple small black holes inexplicably appeared in the sky, ruthlessly devouring the world. At first, scientists believed that this phenomenon was a common natural disaster, until one day, a test report shocked the world.

title: Console Shop Simulator
description: Run your own game store business. Design your shelves with consoles and games, set prices, manage communication with companies, handle customer support, and grow your brand. Online sales, rival companies, marketing strategies, and tech upgrades are coming soon.

title: Toey Weedz Forreal
description: "Toey Weedz Forreal" Is a challenging, sleek and compact action game. A Comediac retro inspired Side Scrolling Shooter with a 3D Twist. Become Toey Weedz once again and raise your flag forreal!

title: Doki Doki Relapse
description: What if you knew about something horrible and had the power to prevent it from happening? Doki Doki Relapse is a story filled with humor and emotion, following a semi-sentient protagonist as he attempts to prevent a horrible event from occuring. All the while, he is faced and impeded with numerous other situations involving everybody's favorite literature club! Romance, comedy, and bitter elements all serve to make Relapse's lengthy story a rollercoaster of an experience.

title: Carefully Stamped
description: Craft and sell charming postcards to your customers in a relaxing sandbox full of color and creativity. Carefully Stamped is a cozy job simulator where you are a postcard designer. Take on new orders, craft the cutest mail, write a wholesome note and collect stamps to send your postcards ️

title: Adventure of Samsara
description: A hero resurrected. A new Adventure. With stunning, 2D pixel art, Adventure of Samsara combines classic gameplay, a deeply connected world, and a heady, twisting narrative of death, rebirth and memory. Become the Solar Champion and restore balance to the multiverse.

title: Dogwalk
description: Play as a big adorable dog and explore a hand-crafted winter forest with a little kid in tow. A short, free, open source project brought to you by Blender Studio.

title: Star Razer
description: Star Razer is a shooter game inspired by the Vectrex game Asteroids, with a hint of Geometry Wars. You must face successive waves of enemies and achieve the highest score (online). The game is exclusively played with mouse and keyboard (for now).

title: Sync or Sink
description: Trapped in a sinking submarine, two players must communicate through walkie-talkies to solve puzzles, complete tasks, navigate the depths, and escape before time runs out.

title: Vector Horizon
description: Take flight in Vector Horizon where you guide a thruster-powered car through wild obstacle courses built for timing, precision, and control. Vector Horizon is all about the joy of movement and the thrill of pulling it off.

title: Puffer Bounce
description: Puffer bounces is an old style arcade game. The pufferfish doesn't stop and there's always a bounce on the ground. Help him move on safely with your reaction speed and proper controls.

title: Otters and Stones
description: Build up thriving habitats in this otter kind of clicker.

title: Don't Turn Back
description: Don't Turn Back is a first-person, single-player psychological horror game. You play Bethany, A young woman who has just inherited her grandfather's mansion. Get immersed in the deeply emotional story of Bethany's family, and experience everything there is inside this home...good and evil.

title: My Sleeping Girlfriend
description: Your girlfriend’s sleepwalking is getting worse each night. Find her and bring her back to bed safely.

title: Under the Ruin
description: Lead a squad deep into the ruins of the city. Scavenge for resources atop the remnants of the old civilization, and use the ruins to fend off the Swarm. In this unique salvage-and-defend strategy game, you will gradually uncover the source of the Calamity and rebuild human civilization.

title: Demonbyte
description: fast-paced, retro-inspired boomer shooter where you blast through hordes of cyber-demons using outrageous weapons — including a husky puppy handgun. Inspired by classics from the 90's, every level drips with pixelated carnage, over-the-top firepower, and secrets to uncover.

title: Seen Before
description: Seen Before is a psychological horror game where you are trapped in a looping environment, trying to detect inconsistencies and escape the cycle.

title: Whispering Fog
description: Whispering Fog is a first person psychological horror game set in an ever-changing forest shrouded in fog. A quiet getaway becomes a sinister nightmare as the illusion of safety and solitude slowly crumbles around you.

title: Iona's Island
description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

title: ESA Shield
description: Join the European Space Agency's S.H.I.E.L.D. mission and discover why aliens aren't the biggest threat to us! In this science-based Earth defense simulator, you fight real cosmic hazards. Build, Monitor, Protect! Become Earth's Last Defense.

title: Dragon Riddler
description: A turn-based puzzle adventure with a simple concept: Find dragon's lair → defeat dragon → grab treasure → upgrade → next. But with words.

title: Beyond the Space Wall
description: Beyond The Space Wall is a story-driven brick-breaking action game, enriched with RPG elements and other original features. In addition to the usual brickbreaking, you’ll face plenty of choices and side quests that directly influence the direction of the main story. Can you find the path to victory?

title: The Anomaly Protocol
description: The Anomaly Protocol - Something is wrong with the building. Floors repeat, reality shifts, and you've been assigned to investigate. Use your checklist to track anomalies—but the deeper you go, the more the truth slips away.

title: Miner Crysis
description: Miner Crysis is a 2D sci-fi mining adventure where you pilot a drill-ship to explore a collapsing moon held together by a mysterious crystal machine. Mine resources, battle alien threats, find secret rooms, defeat bosses, and buy powerful upgrades to grow stronger and progress.

title: The Grafted Gear
description: 《The Grafted Gear》is an auto chess game that focuses on engine building. In each game, you will get a large number of equipment with unique entries and designs, facing enemies with unique designs. In the rest between each battle, you will build your equipment, and build a unique equipment engine.

title: Numina: Construct
description: Dodge, defend, and destroy! Engage in a frenetic shoot 'em up, facing relentless bullet streams that test your reflexes. Experience dynamic shifts between vertical and horizontal views as you fend off endless enemy waves. Use polarity shields for defense and strike back fiercely. Conquer the chaos!

title: Beebo & Luna
description: Start a healing journey with Beebo and Luna on your desktop! When you are with Beebo and Luna, the melody of time turns into the light of stars. Change outfits for Beebo and Luna, decorate the warm Dream Oracle House, meet mysterious travelers and start an incredible adventure.

title: Gaslighters
description: A mysterious fog has fallen over Rock Valley. Strangers speak half-truth over the radio. Expose the lies, or remain silent forever.

title: RoboSoul: Chariot
description: 《RoboSoul: Chariot》 Retro pixel co-op adventure! Control Blue & Red piloting a transforming chariot (driver + 4 gunner seats) with slick morphing animations. Battle the Resistron Army - just don't fling your teammate off!

title: Ender Chariot
description: Ender Chariot is a relic-building roguelite game. You will choose one of four heroes to start a new adventure. Gather resources in battles, purchase relics, summon members, and form your unique chariot team. Charge through randomly areas with three different styles until victory.

title: Night Shift at the Museum
description: Watch the cameras. Catch the anomalies. Report every irregularity. Repair the malfunctioning systems. While trying to meet your hourly reporting quota, various incidents may force you to move around the museum. When your reflection starts moving on its own, it's no longer just another night shift.

title: Apokerlypse
description: Apokerlypse is a strategic deckbuilding Roguelike where classic poker game gets a demonic twist. Step into a post-apocalyptic tavern as a skilled cardsharp. Wield demonic chips to bend the rules of play, outwit players across the globe, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate master of the deck!

title: Shadow Cocoon
description: "shadowcocoon": A Chinese horror puzzle game. As cop Chen Han, enter a surreal reality-nightmare world. Hunt clues in decaying settings, solve puzzles to uncover secrets. Choices shape the truth. Uncover the chilling truth?

title: Parking Together!
description: "Parking Together!" is a chaotic two-player "parking" game. Players must cooperate to park a car that will explode on the slightest impact. Grab a friend and challenge yourselves with this intense and hilarious gameplay now!

title: Trials of the Forest Kingdom
description: “Trials of the Forest Kingdom” is a cross - border RPG integrating creature collection, turn - based strategy and exploration. Players can enjoy solo adventures, form teams, and explore the kingdom tactically.

title: Pact Warden
description: A roaming Marchwarden, you travel along roads to defend strange travelers and pious pilgrims. They'll say you're altruistic, but in truth you seek something personal. A place to call home. The waystation Gheimgarth, tucked beneath the Threshold of the Gheim, might just be the place.

title: Under the Disco Lights: 80's Bar Simulator
description: Step into a neon-lit 1980s disco! Under the Disco Lights lets you manage the bar, serve drinks, read customers, and uncover secrets - all in first-person. Featuring stylized visuals, reactive characters, and a fully original 1980s-inspired soundtrack that keeps the night alive.

title: Palmora
description: From street scavenger to production tycoon, collect, craft, and trade your way to the top in the bustling city of Palmora. Build your empire with workshops, vehicles, licenses, and more.

title: Tale of Excalibun
description: Wield the Excalibun and found a kingdom for the rabbit kind by rescuing bunnies of different specializations from different environments and worlds.

title: Quaso Studio: The Liven Collection
description: Quaso Studio: The Liven Collection is a compilation of two horror games: The To-Do List: Complete tasks, face the killer, escape. Rouge Carmin: Explore the depths of your subconscious, confront your regrets, and find a way out.

title: Hidden Bananas
description: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all? ️

title: Lick Roll
description: A casual game blending light racing and puzzle-solving adventure. Its warm art style takes you back to a sweet, candy-colored childhood.

title: Reposition Defense
description: A tactical Tower Defense with the ability to reposition your troops! Deploy your available warriors to hold back the forces of darkness engulfing the kingdom.

title: Purr-suit of Happiness
description: Hoomanity’s last hope, delivered by cats. One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As the Cat Courier, it’s your job to navigate a charming little town, drop off packages to humans and collect parts for the ultimate Escape Crate. And spread smiles along the way.

title: Car Dealership Simulator 2
description: Take charge of the car trade with Car Dealership Simulator 2! Buy, modify, and grow your dealership with strategic sales. Every opportunity will take you closer to the top of the automotive market!

title: Continuum Keeper
description: Monitor unstable realities through surveillance cameras, spot and report Fractures—distortions in space, time, and logic—and prevent the collapse of the multiverse in this psychological horror puzzle game.

title: Roofgrown Life
description: Roofgrown Life is a cozy idle farming game. You can collect fruits in various regions, plant and harvest them, complete customer orders, upgrade your vehicles and house, and explore to unlock new points of interest on the map.

title: Doctor Viscera
description: Trapped in an abandoned asylum with the sinister Doctor Viscera, who will stop at nothing to keep you there as his test subject for cruel experiments. Explore the old GrimmHaus Asylum in this PSX-style survival horror game.

title: City Supermarket Simulator
description: Buy in bulk, set prices, and sell to customers. Hire staff, manage inventory, and keep your customers happy. Expand your store and increase profits. Can you become the city’s top merchant and build a business empire? What are you waiting for?

title: Neko Neko Love
description: Have you ever wanted to be a cat? To eat, sleep and play without a care in the world? Well, wish granted! There's just a tiny catch - you have to get adopted before a deadly Magic Storm.. Fortunately, you're the cutest. Unfortunately... you're also the meanest.

title: The Archaic: Unauthorized
description: A story-driven 3D action platformer set in a post-immortal future, where the last organic human awakens. Explore levels with metroidvania progression, momentum-based traversal, and tactical combat. Uncover the ruins of a world that chose immortality over humanity.

title: Escape the Desert
description: So you're stuck in a middle of a desert with a single flask of water... how do you escape? Do you stare at the sun long enough for it to stare at you back? Well, that might not be the worst idea. Try it out in Escape the Desert, a strand-type roguelike strategy game!

title: Yollen
description: Before Megaloot, there was Yollen - a brutally minimalist game by solo dev axilirate. Your peaceful life is gone. Now it’s all about the grind. Climb every skill tree, master every craft, and turn the grind into pure payback.

title: Hell's 8th Avenue: Miori's Mysterious Notebook
description: In this adventure game, play as Miori, a young detective tasked with finding a missing person and purifying the ominous 'Illusory 8th Street.' Challenge your dexterity with fun Quick Time Events and push forward... or get punished for being too slow.

title: Gutfarm
description: Gutfarm is a top-down 2D pixel art game that blends farming, tower defense, and survival elements. On this alien island, you will expand and grow your farm by planting crops, unlocking genetically mutated varieties, defending against waves of monster attacks, collecting relics, and more!

title: Chasing Her Light
description: Chasing Her Light is a survival-adventure game about a grieving man who ventures into a snowy forest to find his missing dog, battling the cold and chopping through obstacles with his axe.

title: Mara
description: The modern world is awash with materialism, vanity and the overwhelming impulse to excessively consume. You are a boy monk traversing through the world filled with urban dangers trying to find himself.

title: Bloodface
description: Unable to endure the ruthless tyranny of the Lord, the people rise in rebellion, plunging the entire country into civil war. As the Lord and his family abandon the throne and flee, a bloody battle erupts across the lands.

title: Italian Brainrot: Arena
description: Italian Brainrot: Arena is a multiplayer shooter in Unreal Engine 5 based on popular meme characters. Battle across multiple game modes with unique heroes and their special abilities. Customize loadouts and engage in fast-paced combat on various maps.

title: Idlequarium
description: Idlequarium is a casual simulation game where you raise adorable little fish to earn coins, purchase decorations, and build a fully customized aquarium.The game sits anywhere on your desktop, letting you interact with your live aquarium during work or study breaks.

title: Sky Fields: Goober Gardens
description: Sky Fields Goober Gardens is a Voxel, Creature Collector, Idler. Raise, trade, breed Goobers and watch them grow! Don’t forget to pet your Goobers! Use your Goobers to turn your Island into a luscious haven, building an environment for them to flourish.

title: Subjugation
description: Nobody knows where it came from. But it's here. And you can't let it escape. In Subjugation you're put in charge of a containment chamber for one hour, housing a horror unknown to mankind. Maintain it's oxygen, hunger, and anger, to keep it calm and complacent. Escape means the end.

title: Lumara
description: Descend into a corrupted abyss as a lone anglerfish in this atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Solve physics-based puzzles, uncover forgotten knowledge, face mutated creatures, and use your light to push back shadows and restore what was lost.

title: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
description: Walnut the Walrus sets out to save his friends, and all of Northern Bear, from the dreaded Emperor Penguin. Luckily, his chilly Walrus Wind is ice cold. Now let's freeze some penguins!

title: Loot of Baal
description: "Loot of Baal" is an idle game nestled right on your screen's sidebar. Multitask your way to glory by sending your hireling crew out to explore, fight demons, and collect loot while you focus on other things! With hundreds of uniquely skilled hirelings, over 1000 distinct items, and a wealth of randomized battle stages, there’s always something to discover. Craft items and upgrade them to Immortal levels, and trade items online with other players to create the perfect team of heroes.

title: Keytamine
description: Keytamine is a satisfying action game where you click unique keycap enemies in a fast-paced, rhythmic battle! It supports both engaging survivor-like and relaxed modes. Basically a video game ASMR !

title: Mr. Billion
description: Mr. Billion is an idle life and economic simulator where you'll rise from a homeless nobody to a wealthy tycoon! Make smart choices, climb the career ladder, and build your luxury life. Tap your way to billions and live like a true money king!

title: Astronook
description: An astronomy game where you can explore space from your cozy office. Map out constellations, photograph planets and discover the hidden wonders of space.

title: Fishing the Sky
description: "Launch the hook to the sky! Capture the unknown!"Use a specially designed anti-gravity fishing rod to fish for strange flying creatures in the mutated clouds, establish a new era of Earth's ecological atlas, and explore the oddities of civilization in the joy of picking up trash.

title: Chroma Blasters
description: Blast your way through 120+ dynamic music-driven levels in this twin-stick arcade shooter. Defend against waves of color-coded enemies that spawn to the beat and use tight reflexes and precision color-matching to score big against the chaotic audio-fueled spirals.

title: Dem Tanks
description: Blast your way to victory in this fast-paced top-down shooter party game! Pilot futuristic hover tanks, unleash incredible turrets and get ready to wreak havoc in chaotic destructible local multiplayer arenas. But most importantly - destroy DEM TANKS!

title: Anomaly Protocol
description: Anomaly Exit Together is a cooperative horror and exploration game where you explore unknown anomalies together with your friends online, with each game offering different scenarios.

title: Arcane Seekers
description: The game cleverly blends Minesweeper mechanics with RPG progression. Call a team of unique adventurers, each with powerful abilities, and collect magical energy across the field. As characters level up, you'll draw random skills, unlocking endless tactics and strategies in every playthrough.

title: Train Your Fingers: Lab
description: Unleash your speed, cast powerful spells! Master both spells and keyboard skills in a story-driven game where every word brings you closer to magical mastery.

title: Bloxiti
description: Bloxiti is a photorealistic builder where you snap and stack blocks to craft cozy cabins, massive megastructures, or peaceful dioramas.

title: Quadra Break Tetris
description: Take a break with Quadra Break, a Tetris-like game that reimagines a classic with exciting new modes. Whether you prefer competitive or cooperative gameplay, get ready for the ultimate brain massage!

title: Overpower RPG - Capítulo 1: A Saga de Bulgar
description:
Overpower is a Brazilian game developed on RPG Maker 2000, originally released in 2002 and developed by E.F.N. Most of its assets come from the Runtime Package (RTP), and its sense of humour is typical of the early 2000s Brazilian internet. Despite that, the game had high narrative and gameplay ambitions.

You start the game by choosing one out of four characters. Each character has its own narrative line, and their stories eventually cross each other. The game also has an alignment system that, although simple, can have surprising consequences. For example, depending on the circumstances of your death, instead of a game over your party can be sent to either heaven or hell, where there's an opportunity to be brought back to life, for a price. The game also features an extensive magic system, with 11 different Schools of Magic.
