description: Recruit Heroes, gear up and face the threats of the Pixel Frontier! This engine-building, dice-rolling, turn-based strategy game has 36 Hero classes to choose from - each with their own sets of abilities, upgrades, synergies and strategies for near endless possibilities.

title: The Last Squad
description: A team-based third-person shooter where up to four players battle waves of evolving zombies using class-based tactics, upgrades, and survival skills.

title: The Novice: Animal Kingdom
description: Survive relentless waves of agitated wild beasts and rise through the ranks of the adventurer’s guild in this intense roguelite action RPG. Collect gems and complete quests to buy powerful upgrades. Increase your rank to unlock new map and quests. Your goal: find the cause of the chaos!

title: Minesweeper 3D
description: Classic Minesweeper across four true 3D fields: a cube, cylinder, hexagonal prism, and tetrahedron.

title: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

title: Aleato
description: Aleato is a dynamic roguelike dice game where you aim to surpass each level's score by strategically experimenting with a diverse array of unique builds each game.

title: Blue Mansion
description: We integrate decryption into Roguelike cards to create a single player card adventure full of deadly suspense. Everytime you step into the mansion, you will face deadly opponents, randomly triggered mechanical rampage events, and various mysterious relics hidden behind the frame.

title: Orbs of Duality
description: Master puzzles by wielding fire and water! Push, combine, and transform the elements with mind-teasing puzzles inspired by Sokoban and Minesweeper.

title: Mushroom Jump! Miracle
description: Wabi-Sabi Step into a world of bouncing mushrooms—a space embodying the essence of Zen. What are these melancholic yet endearing mushrooms trying to tell us? Their determined struggles will inspire courage in the hearts of all who witness them.

title: Vampiress: Eternal Duet
description: Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a noir-style 3D side-scrolling action game. You play as Miss Vampire who switches between vampire/human form and uses blood to fight in high-speed battles. To find your sister in this conflicted world, bloodshed is the last thing to worry about...

title: Double Date: Yuri Visual Novel
description: Alice is a disaster when it comes to asking women out. But when she adopts a dog from the shelter, she wasn't expecting to be knocked over by an absolutely cute lady, Sophie, who makes her want to try. With their dogs being the best wingdogs, can Alice and Sophie get together?!

title: Throne of Ages
description: "Throne of ages" blends roguelike progression with grand-scale RTS gameplay, letting players command multiple legions across vast battlefields. Command your troops in real-time across dynamically generated battlefields where every campaign offers unique randomized upgrades and unit evolution.

title: Outlying Islands
description: A story about discovering anomalies, finding strange energy sources, and the intertwining of peculiar spaces. Get ready to uncover hidden stories, delve into a horrifying narrative and unveil the most fundamental truth!

title: Fields of Malice
description: Fields of Malice is a turn-based strategy rogue-like deckbuilder with elements from auto battlers! Buy your cards from a shop and upgrade them by getting multiple of the same level. Use these cards to summon units and affect the board and fight off the Malice!

title: Solitaire of Stygian Shadows
description: Battle through countless arrangements of evil cards and bring order to our world! Solitaire of Stygian Shadows is a randomly generated card game where each playthrough is completely unique!

title: GTL Schedule
description: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

title: 1! 2! 3! Battle Card!
description: A simple and interesting new poker game that supports 2-4 players online battles. The key to winning is to balance risks and benefits, perform operations to maximize benefits, participate in ranking and bidding competitions, and see who is the real "head-breaking" king!

title: VeilWood
description: Protect your farm from twisted creatures as you cultivate the land and put an end to the Azure Haze in this first person real time strategy dark farming sim.

title: Hermit
description: Hermit is a Third-Person Open-World Fantasy RPG featuring deep lore, magic, crafting, and exploration. Navigate dark dungeons, create powerful spells and potions, hunt monsters, and traverse a vast dangerous open world as you try to uncover the secrets of the Order of Hermits.

title: Frontier Governor
description: Frontier Governor is a city-building game set in 15th-century Korean history. You have been appointed as the local governor, in the historical background of the northern pioneering. Overcome the rough north and lead the frontier through various resources, buildings, technologies, policies, and more.

title: Ravenhille: Awakened
description: Hunt down the mythical beast, created in desperation during the final days of World War II. A failed Nazi project known as “Wolfsklinge” unleashed an ancient creature from the depths of hell. Now, it’s your task to lift the curse that haunts the village and the forest. It won’t be easy.

title: Rob Your Friends or Die
description: Rob your friends or die is a 4-player co-op game. Force your friends to take the "cursed" scroll, avoid the evil spirit and be the last one standing to win.

title: Ashen Reverie
description: You've ignored the hallucinations for years. But after visiting a shrine in search of answers, a stranger claims she sees them too. Ashen Reverie is a supernatural thriller visual novel about the consequences of chasing a myth too far.

title: Hyperdrive
description: HYPERDRIVE is a fast paced Sci-fi action flight sim, combining the infinitely looping gameplay of a roguelike, along with the combat and controls of classic spaceship combat. Avoid obstacles, and take down enemy ships in high speed space combat, all while making as many deliveries as possible!

title: Lia: Hacking Destiny
description: Be the resistance in a world ruled by machines: fight, hack, and reignite hope. Craft powerful builds in this fast-paced roguelite with lethal weapons and power-ups. Free kittens from the algorithm’s chains and smash the robots’ scheme. Resist spam and prove that no one codes your destiny!

title: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
description: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

title: Please Claim Your Social Security Card
description: This text-based adventure simulates window service work.As consultant to heroine Xiao Qiao, players assist her social security card distribution tasks:Master card issuance proceduresExperience diverse human interactionsGuide Xiao Qiao in finding her life purpose

title: Melodraw
description: Pick a coloring book. Draw a melody. An audiovisual experiment that lets you paint and make music at the same time. Let your brush strokes create sounds based on stroke speed, location, or even your drawing tablet pen pressure. Export a video, picture or sound file to share with others.

title: Keine's Terakoya: A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo
description: Play as Keine Kamishirasawa, the half-beast teacher of Gensokyo! Teach humans and yokai, grow their minds, hearts, and bodies, and guide them to graduation. Balance tradition and change, expand your influence, and build your ideal school. Write your legend on the education frontlines!

title: Fireside Friends
description: Fireside Friends is a cozy multiplayer sandbox where players explore a vast world, catch fish, play instruments, and uncover secrets with friends or on their own. Complete a rich compendium filled with animals, vehicles, fish, and locations to discover. It's a kid's game for adults!

title: Wandering Souls
description: "Wandering Souls" is a visual novel game set in modern China. It tells a touching story about love, sacrifice, and repentance. Through delicate narrative and profound character creation, it brings players an immersive audio-visual experience.

title: Moon Corona
description: open your eyes from the ancient temple and embark on this adventure! Embark on an RPG adventure in a dark-themed sandbox world. Explore vast lands, collect all kinds of cards, craft diverse combinations, and make pivotal choices—seeking lost truths and redemption in the chaos and danger.

title: The End of Paradise
description: A dark, despair-filled RPG + survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Play as a mercenary survivor in the last paradise. Befriend or kill 6 companions, explore the black mist, face the Old Gods, and choose to save humanity—or end the world.

title: Dustless
description: Dustless is a side-scrolling action-adventure game set in a wuxia world, featuring a richly layered combat system.

title: Goblin vs. Princess
description: The goblin is determined to challenge the princesses! Reborn and reincarnated in an endless labyrinth, all to redeem his past shame. So, what kind of adventure awaits the goblin? Will it be absurdly comical or fraught with hardships? The answers await your discovery!

title: Fiendish Quest
description: To save her petrified mother, the heroine embarks on a journey to find the legendary orbs that can grant any wish.

title: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
description: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

title: Run Chicken, Run!
description: Run away like a chicken as fast as you can!

title: Game Centre Simulator
description: Manage your very own Japanese Game Centre in this business management sim. Buy and fill claw machines, capsule toy machines and more. Will you run an honest business, or rig your machines?

title: A Flame in the Dark
description: Navigate the darkest of dungeons equipped with only a torch. Explore, solve puzzles, and find a path forward to help the next adventurer before your only light source burns out in this unique roguelite!

title: Julio's Adventure 3
description: Survive in Tamixa School in this horror adventure. Explore the school without attracting the attention of the mysterious creatures until they leave the area. Use the school cameras, your flaslight and your stealth skills to avoid getting caught before it's too late...

title: Long Knives
description: An oriental narrative mystery. The story branches upon your choices. The dice lies.

title: Once a Pawn a King
description: Once a Pawn a King is a roguelike, turn-based strategy game with party-building mechanics, where chess meets chaos. Venture into the ever-shifting castle of the evil White King on a quest to rescue the beloved Black King, who was recently taken by the tyrant.

title: Liege of the Labyrinth
description: Can you guide your party through all 20 floors of The Labyrinth and defeat its Liege in this turn-based roguelike RPG? As their Guardian, the party will be counting on your to plan ahead and work around unexpected encounters.

title: Momo Crash
description: This game is a rhythm action game in which the player purifies souls by pinching them with girls' thighs! The player controls the thighs and pinches the flowing souls in rhythm. Let's purify souls by pinching them with thighs in rhythm! Let's Paradise!

title: Moshi Online
description: Moshi Online is an independent and non-profit game that is not affiliated with Moshi Monsters, Mind Candy, or the Mind Candy brand. The game's content and assets are responsibly sourced from publicly available archives, including Flashpoint and the Wayback Machine, with a commitment to preserving and providing access to historical web content.

title: My Favorite Coworker
description: A virtual pet device in the corner of your screen! Feed and play with your pet while you work or play for dopamine boosts that makes even mundane tasks a little more fun!

title: Widget Warriors
description: A warrior living on your desktop? Yes! Defeat enemies, collect coins, unlock skills, and face off against bosses— all within a portable widget that lives right on your desktop.

title: Ravenridge
description: You are being watched. Tested. In RAVENRIDGE, uncover the truth behind a forgotten prison as detective Ethan Ward. What begins as an investigation soon leads deep into your own mind. Are you in control, or just another subject?

title: Kungfu Card
description: Special Moves! Great Kung Fu! "Kung Fu Cards" is a tactical card battler inspired by traditional Chinese martial arts. This innovative game combines elements of poker and mahjong with Chinese kung fu philosophy, striking the perfect balance between strategy and chance.

title: The Light Charmer
description: This is a rogue-like tower defense game where players control Light Wisps. Players use Light Wisps to build defense towers and obtain Light Shards, which can be combined to create various Light Wisp attack patterns! Use these to defeat enemies and escort Princess Liana to save the world.

title: Hurry Chef
description: Roguelite restaurant sim with 4-player co-op! Manage ingredients, cooking, hygiene & customers. Make strategic choices - build properly or cut corners? 30+ recipes, 15+ roguelite cards and various upgrades. Will you thrive or get shut down?

title: Greensome
description: Greensome is a cute and cozy hand-painted style game where you can decorate and manage your very own greenhouse. You’ll be able to add your very own personal touch as you plant, decorate and expand your greenhouse.

title: Ridiculous Gungame
description: A fast-paced FPS. Kill with Piano's, Jelly, a Spectral Train, and some kind of Sword/Bow hybrid. It's kill or die laughing in this instagib gun game.

title: The Conquest
description: The Conquest is spiritual successor to The Invasion 2.

title: Downmouse
description: An arcade game where you fight and mine your way down a procedurally generated cave as a mouse. Compete against your friends and people around the world on who can reach the furthest point. A simple game, perfect for when you got some free time but don't want to commit to anything.

title: Dungeon Picnic
description: Dungeon Picnic is a game that combines RPG and Roguelike. Build your own strongest party by using the synergy of various characters and skills. Become an explorer, gather companions, and conquer the dungeon in other dimensions!

title: Sanjuro: Subject One
description: Japan is shaken up as Sanjuro, a mysterious ronin working for the government, seems to have become bloodthirsty. Jace, a nearby onlooker, investigates what’s really going on.

title: Pulmo
description: PULMO is a casual puzzle game where you control a lone character in a world full of faceless crowds.

title: Spacefighter Rukia 2
description: A blend between Shoot'em ups and Looter Shooters. Take on the story or randomly generated missions to level up your pilot and collect loot to build your ships up to take on bigger challenges.

title: Terra Fighters
description: The world is your weapon in this earth-slinging platform fighter where champions defend their continents from collapse!

title: Grim-chan's Soul Fight
description: When the grim reaper isn’t just a skeleton, but a super cute girl! Enter a dark fantasy world as Grimchan, who must collect souls to fight against terrifying demons, battling through the minions of the dangerous Demon King for peace."

title: Super Cricket Fighter Turbo
description: Super Cricket Fighter Turbo is Pong on steroids.

title: Quantum Dogfight
description: Quantum Dogfight is a 2-player guessing strategy game where players must correctly locate all of their opponent's planes on a hexagonal grid. Inspired by the principles of quantum mechanics, Quantum Dogfght is a fun and interactive way to learn about superposition and measurement collapse.

title: Hellmaster: The Legend of Dante
description: Hellmaster is a competitive, role-based strategy card game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy. Players descend into the underworld, choosing and evolving mythological heroes to build powerful decks and utilize tactical gameplay to outsmart their opponents. Prove your skills and claim epic rewards as you conquer Dante's nine circles of Hell, striving to become the ultimate Hellmaster.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Legacy
description: Turn back the clock. Operation: Legacy revives the iconic Halo 3 multiplayer experience with a retro Delta Arena playlist, iconic maps, fueled-up Grifball modes, and hallmark helmets from the glory days of 2007.

title: SCP: Yet Another Day
description: SCP: Yet Another Day is an action RPG and a satirical look at the SCP foundation, When a load of morons are put in charge of a powerful organization tasked with containing supernatural dangers- it doesn't take long before everything crumbles and a great evil is unleashed which threatens their lives.

title: The Sling and The Stone
description: The Sling and The Stone is an action-adventure game where players craft powerful stones and use a sling to fight demons, rising from zero to hero in a thrilling journey of revenge and rescue, culminating in a surprising meeting with a greater force.

title: Eternal Circus: Dancing with Missiles
description: Become a nimble mech and defeat bosses while dodging a barrage of missiles in this top-down 3D dodge'm-up inspired by mecha anime and Itano Circus!

title: Prima Materia XXV
description: Prima Materia is an experimental 3D fighting game created as part of the Fashion Week 2025 Tobias Equipment showcase. A stylistically uncompromising brawler with a unique aesthetic — reminiscent of classic fighters like Mortal Kombat, but reimagined through the lens of fashion and alchemy.

title: Flowloop&
description: flowloop& is a minimalistic anti-gravity racer where you try and stay on the track for as long as you can. Every day you can play on three new procedurally generated levels where you race around in 3D-space.

title: Plantastic
description: Over 30 plant species Unlockable hats & accessories to customize. Idle game for desktop - runs in the background Regular drops, items & collecting fun Proceeds go towards real tree planting projects. Perfect for work, study & relaxing sessions

title: Markus's Miasma
description: Explore a fog-choked, twisted version of UCSC in this 2D puzzle horror game, where cryptic clues and buried memories reveal the disturbing truth behind one man's obsession...

title: InspoQuest
description: InspoQuest is a two-button rhythm platformer with music tracks by Trust This Mechanism. Jump, roll, glide, and more as you make your way through three levels inspired by the city of Vancouver, Canada.

title: 17 Ways To Not Die (Or Not, IDK): Interactive Movie
description: 17 Ways Not to Die is a movie, first and foremost. A movie in which you can influence what happens on the screen. There are 17 endings, or not endings, or not 17, I don't know. I don't care.

title: Pepper Odyssey
description: Pepper Odyssey is an RPG about surviving a shipwreck in an unruly outlandish island. Survive the lawless island: fight, trade and explore. Gather scrap to trade, improve your shelter and build yourself the means to escape; or meddle in the affairs of the island and realize a vision for its future.

title: Fighting Fantasy Classics: Eye of the Dragon
description: In a tavern in Fang, a stranger offers you the chance to find the legendary Golden Dragon—hidden in a deadly labyrinth beneath Darkwood Forest. Face brutal traps, savage beasts, and dark magic in a quest that begins with a life-risking potion.

title: Neon Highways
description: Welcome to a retro-futuristic '80s world of supercars, neon-lit cities, and synthwave beats. Neon Highways is an arcade racer where you cruise through vibrant cityscapes and endless highways, all set to an iconic synthwave soundtrack.

title: Neon Knives
description: Two of you do not belong. Neon Knives is an award-winning couch multiplayer game of stealth and deception. Blend into the crowd, hunt down your opponent, and take them out—all while being hunted yourself. Trust no one.

title: Sunfluffs
description: Exist in the world as a queer little animal. Toss berries at grumpy critters to cheer them up, and try your best to help out the mysterious Lightbearer!

title: Fox XII
description: Switch between top-down and third-person while engaging in intense dungeon combat packed with deadly foes and loot. Return to base camp to craft new upgrades and progress the storyline. Each run delivers unpredictable challenges and endless roguelike excitement.

title: Neon Colony
description: Neon Colony is an isometric tower defense game where you build your own road to access and harvest the resources of an alien planet. Deal with the resistance of the local population and fulfill this noble mission for your generous corporate benefactors.

title: Neon Warfield
description: A casual-style tower battle game with eight unique forces, each with distinct combat mechanics. To defeat different enemy forces, you'll need to adapt your strategy and pay attention to the moment you activate skills. Defeating enemys in battle allows you to unlock new forces.

title: Pinball Neon
description: This is Pinball Arcade Simulator game with modern graphics. You can use Keybord, mouse, touchscreen or Gamapad(XBox or Dualshock) Use “Tilt”, but do not use often, this is can brake the table. You can use GOLDEN BALL from inventory.

title: Rumble Crumble
description: Dig, zoom, crush, blast, burn and CRUMBLE your way to the top in this cute arcade digger. Build your score to unlock new items and power-ups, discover new depths and expand Rumble’s journey to the surface. With charming graphics, classic arcade-style gameplay and a delightful soundtrack.

title: Survivor Story: The Apocalypse
description: Your goal in this text-based choice game is to help the protagonist survive until he uncovers the mysteries surrounding the city in order to reunite with his daughter, Susan.

title: Lazarus: Side Story of Comrade Force
description: "LAZARUS" is a BOUKEN action RPG where you freely explore the world while mowing down countless monsters. Strengthen your character with skills and equipment, and aim to defeat the demon king Lazarus! Various dungeons, summoned beasts with mysterious powers, and relics await players in the world.

title: Skyline Urban Story
description: Starting from a small village and growing into a megacity with a million population, this is a city-simulation game that integrates systems such as demand, plot price, wealth, and special zones. It has a high degree of manageability and is suitable for urban-construction and management enthusiasts.

title: Ridiculous Space Battles
description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

title: Solar Wave
description: A large-scale 4X strategy game with indirect control and a focus on simulating a space empire. Capture systems, develop your economy and logistics, call up hundreds of powerful fleets and watch them incinerate enemies of the Solar Empire.

title: Dark Investigation: Experiment
description: Play as a private detective sent on the trail of a missing person. What seemed like a simple case quickly turns into a nightmare. Will you be the one to solve the case... or just another victim of this mystery?

title: Nethermage
description: Brave the depths of the Nether, confronting relentless hordes of monstrous foes and the madness of ancient elder gods, in this thrilling survival roguelite!

title: Checkout Midnight
description: Checkout Midnight is an atmospheric horror game where you work the night shift as a cashier. What begins as a simple job scanning groceries in an almost empty supermarket slowly turns into a true nightmare.

title: The Adventure Ball
description:
The Adventure Ball is a puzzle game in that the player needs to complete all 20 levels.

Some levels are easy and some levels are more challenging, you can always go to the level you want and pass it too :)

title: StormCore
description: A TPS with roguelike elements. Choose your loadout, gather powerful upgrades, and fight your way through hordes of alien insects. You only have 3 days, so make them count.

title: Glyphora
description: GLYPHORA is a roguelike typeracer-style game where words and letters can be upgraded. In this unique typing-focused experience, you choose from several runes and progress through increasingly difficult levels, shop for upgrades, select powerful (or risky) glyphs.

title: Superhero Simulator
description: Superhero Simulator is an open-world superhero game where you fight villains and save lives! But being a hero isn’t free! You’ll need to work, pay rent, and survive. Can you handle both sides of the superhero life?

title: Black Souls
description: Black Souls is the censored release of a dark fantasy, souls-like RPG game inspired by Dark Souls and various fairy tales, where you are an unnamed undead who has awakened imprisoned within the Lost Empire. Freed by the brave Holy Knight Jeanne D'Arc, your freedom is short-lived as a fearsome dragon claims both your lives. Now you have one goal - to infiltrate the Lost Empire and defeat Cinderella, who spreads the fog that drains souls and drives everyone to insanity, but to get there, you will need to defeat or enter into a covenant with the Demonic Princesses.

title: Ultimate Fishing Simulator 3
description: Fish across five open-world maps, from the Mississippi River to the Yangtze River. Use float, feeder, spinning, and casting to catch over 70 species with lifelike behavior. Switch perspectives, upgrade gear, track fish with sonar, and build your career solo or in multiplayer fishing clubs.

title: Backrooms: The Scream
description: Backrooms: The Scream is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players, where you can play as a single player, but what could be better than hearing your friend scream in the game? This is an unforgettable experience you will get with your friends!

title: Backrooms: Forgotten Floors
description: Backrooms: Forgotten Floors is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Descend into levels no one remembers, through spaces that shouldn't exist. You're here now — and the only thing worse than being lost is being noticed.

title: Backrooms: Recode
description: Backrooms: Recode is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. The rules don't stay the same. Neither do the walls, the halls, or your thoughts. If there's a pattern, it's not meant for you to understand.

title: Backrooms: Flicker
description: Backrooms: Flicker is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Navigate a fractured reality with no clear form or end. Whatever's keeping you here doesn't speak — it simply waits. Don't flicker, or you won't find yourself!

title: Backrooms: Noise
description: Backrooms: Noise is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. Explore a dimension where even silence doesn't sound right. The world doesn't explain itself - and the more you try to understand it, the further you feel from the answers.

title: Backrooms: Final Exam Part II
description: Backrooms: Final Exam Part II is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Together or alone, you'll return to a place you were never meant to leave. The deeper you go, the more uncertain it becomes whether there was ever a way out.

title: Ship Explorer
description: You know their stories. Now it's time to step aboard! Board iconic ocean liner and warships from history like SS United States, Morro Castle and more as you explore and learn about the secrets that made them into legends.

title: Zortch 2
description: After her daring escape from the planet of the Brainsuckers our heroine Zortch immediately crashlands on a desert planet and once again finds herself in the middle of it: caught in a conflict between the human colony, the waspy natives and a bizarre cybernetic cult that worships mites!

title: Pineapple
description: Pineapple is a clicker game delivering mystery pineapple drops every two hours and an exclusive Rare‑or‑higher drop every twelve hours. Join the fun, collect rare varieties, and watch your collection grow!

title: Aure
description: Aure is an open world exploration RPG where you take a role of an adventurer in a large and living fantasy world.

title: RimWorld: Odyssey
description: Explore exotic biomes, expand your mobile colony, and launch into space. Scavenge ancient tech on asteroids, abandoned space stations, and satellites. Find and defeat the mechanoid lair.

title: Bereshipsis
description: Can you feel the clocks stop? Take control of the Existentials, the first inhabitants of Earth, beings capable of altering creation itself, and master destiny in an unforgettable tactical RPG

title: Planet Keeper Program
description: You were chosen for the Planet Keeper Program. Defend the planet in this retro-inspired incremental game. Upgrade our defenses, destroy our enemies, ensure our future.

title: Goblita’s Delivery Service
description: Goblita’s Delivery Service is a chaotic co-op horror game where up to four goblin girls battle tight deadlines, creepy back alleys, cursed kitchens, and an ever-stalking monster... all in the name of hot, fresh pizza.

title: Peach Tangle
description: A boy and a girl, alone together in a mysterious forest. A short and sweet romance visual novel where you get to know the cute, always positive tomboy Mira! Fully animated sexual content, great music and a short, focused story, with award-winning visuals and animation!

title: Love Confessions on the Adventure
description: I arrived, full of spirit, only to find the dungeon already conquered?! While searching for clues to a new one, I ended up helping a village in crisis—gathering materials for every shop! How did I start getting close to all these unique and charming women?! What will become of my adventurer life?!

title: Monster Ops 12
description: Wraith and Tide's whole worlds are destroyed in an instant, and all they have now are each other. Loaded with twists, multiple endings, CG art, and even animations--season one of Monster Ops is going out with a bang!

title: Villain's Legacy 2
description: After bringing his greatest invention to life, our superhero finds himself involved in an out-of-the-ordinary affair, so he will have to juggle fragile alliances and deadly threats. Between one adventure and another, of course, there will be a large dose of out-of-the-ordinary sex scenes!

title: Pixie Pleasures
description: How could pixies possibly be bored? Yet poor Aisling finds herself exactly that – until she spies Dink the naughty Fae getting busy next door! What is that thick tool between Dink’s legs? And if Aisling asks nicely enough, maybe Dink will let her touch it – maybe even more!

title: The Last Pussy: Survival Lesson
description: The Last Pussy: Survival Lesson is an adult visual novel with point & click elements in a post-apocalyptic bunker setting.

title: Dating of the Future
description: Rise to fame as an adult star in the world of the post-post-apocalypse. Make friends, help your fellow machines discover their inner freedom, and make, um, “industry connections”.

title: Wet Slits
description: Wet Slits is an exciting animated game with many different sexual scenarios. You need to control the sex toys or the girls to help them achieve orgasm and squirt. A game with beautiful graphics can be very addictive!

title: Harventure
description: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Turkey
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 999 Hidden Cats: Brazil Together
description: 999 hidden cats and 444 adorable objects are waiting for you on large hand-drawn maps. Explore animated scenes and test your attention in detail-filled worlds. Enjoy a cozy, relaxing experience alone or with a friend.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Italy
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Russia
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Thailand
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in China
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in South Africa
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 4Story: The Original
description: 4STORY : The Original is a steam global relaunch of a Free To Play classic MMORPG developed by Zemi Interactive, a private game development company from South Korea, the game features 6 different classes... warrior, archer, summoner, wizard, priest, assassin, including 3 races, human, fairy, werebeast.

title: Match Shot Chimera
description: Match Shot Chimera is a roguelite shoot 'em up where you match-3 to blow things up and level up. Battle giant bosses, make explosive matches, upgrade your chimera, and dodge many, many bullets.

title: Pick me! Visual Novel
description:
"Pick Me!" is an atmospheric visual novel where every choice you make matters.
You decide whether to play as a boy or a girl, and create your character's name to fully immerse yourself in the story.

The plot begins on a dark forest road, where you and your friend face a tough decision — help a dying deer or walk away. From this moment, a chain of events unfolds that will lead you to either a good or a bad ending.

The game combines comedy, light horror, and romance. Expect unexpected twists, mystical scenes, moral dilemmas, and of course, friendship and love.

title: Kingdom Hearts Rebirth
description: A French Kingdom Hearts fangame set after Dream Drop Distance.

title: Tree of Savior: Neo
description: Mobile MMORPG game based on the PC game Tree of Savior. Has a PC client.

title: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive
description:
The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

title: Mistwilds
description: Mistwilds is a vibrant online adventure where you collect, evolve, and battle magical creatures. Explore a vast world, unlock new zones, and join forces with friends to tame wild beasts, take on quests, trade rare loot, and conquer challenging dungeons.

title: Veilwalkers
description: Veilwalkers is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card you play builds momentum. Strategically manage your deck, master turn-based combat, and battle through cursed forests filled with twisted enemies and eldritch secrets.

title: Mole Digging
description: Mole Digging is a puzzle game where you guide a mole to dig through all tiles in a single stroke. Start at the flag, pass through flags 1 and 2 in order, and cover every tile without missing any. Simple yet deep, it was popular on mobile and now arrives on Steam with enhanced graphics.

title: Elegant Sleuth: Mystic Family
description: Agent Allison received an unexpected dinner invitation from the head of the Johnson dynasty, controllers of a sprawling business empire. What required her presence? The story's curtain began lifting...

title: StellarFish
description: Action and science fiction game in pixel art, where you must block shots instead of dodging them. Survive waves of enemies and unlock new skills and powers in a campaign with 20 levels, all for you and your teammates to cross the dangerous galaxy.

title: Jason Maxx
description: A man has fallen to his death in Metro City. Mysterious circumstances. Luckily, edgy 90’s detective Jason Maxx is on the case. The city is dark, the suspects are zany, and the graphics are Y2K-crusty. Explore, interrogate. Can Jason solve the mystery, even when absurdity takes over?

title: Vanquish Evil
description: Vanquish Evil is an Action RPG Roguelite! Fast-paced action! A Randomized Upgrade System to choose your own path, and every run is unique! Explosive spell-based and melee upgrades! Stack upgrades for synergy! Features stylized pixel art!

title: BackSlap
description: A must-have idle rhythm game for slacking off at work! Single-key tapping for ultimate stress relief, 90+ addictive tracks, 9 quirky themes, instantly hide with mouse middle click, supports osu beatmap import, AFK level-up while vibing to music! Certified by Bathhouse Cat Master with gold medal!

title: Little Kingdom RTS
description: Little Kingdom RTS is an indie real-time strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Gather resources, build settlements, raise walls, and grow your small kingdom. Command an army of knights, archers, and mages to fight off rival kingdoms, orcs, and undead.

title: Egnima
description: Egnima is a solo puzzle game where you explore diverse biomes and their unique challenges.

title: No Logic Inc.
description: Tired of serious life? Good. You're now a super-agent, certified in top-level absurdity. No logic. No sanity. Just nonsense — and you're built for it

title: Jaws of Hell
description: A psychological boomer shooter set before The Hive Pandemic. Play as Clark—ex-farmer, husband, and future bounty hunter—who escapes to Mars after losing everything. But when alien tech surfaces and visions of your ex-wife Angela pull you into the Hive, reality begins to fracture.

title: Edge of Extinction
description: Edge of Extinction is a sci-fi real-time strategy game where you command one of five alien factions in a war for survival. Position your armies, deploy formations, and adapt as the battlefield shifts beneath you. Outthink your rivals—or face extinction.

title: Honest Helper
description: Honest Helper is a top-down strategy game where you use time manipulation to defeat all enemies without any casualties. This cute and charming game will challenge your tactical and decision making skills for hours on end.

title: Fruit Mart Simulator
description: Run your own fruit store! Restock fresh fruits, design your store layout, and manage daily sales. Keep customers happy and grow your business into the most popular produce shop in town!

title: Little Laps
description: Race through minimalist tracks designed for precision and flow. Master the one-button controls, beat your best times, and experience racing distilled to its purest form. Can you perfect your little laps?

title: Tales of Klodan
description: Prince Fescillia's mission in Klodan was meant to bring peace, but the cold hides something far more sinister. Alongside his friend Leonar, he becomes entangled in shadows of the past and meet a mysterious warrior in a beastly mask. Five paths, one fateful choice… Will the prince find the right one?

title: Chopcremental
description: Short incremental game about man conquering nature. Log and Load.

title: Dimension Ranger
description: This is a single-player roguelike card game. You play as Sun Wukong, a legendary figure from Chinese mythology, traveling through multiple parallel universes to save your master. Defeat enemies from parallel universes and gain card powers from these worlds.

title: Linear S
description: LINEAR S is an arcade racing experience where rhythm follows the line. Built for flow. Choose. Race. Repeat. No detours.

title: Ogantto
description: oGANTTo is a deck-building strategy game set on a gantt chart. Manage employees and techniques to optimize your supply chain and maximize revenue.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Red Fens
description: Something fishy is happening in the swamp: devious creatures from the depths of the sea have come; bringing piles of valuable pearls, evil traps, and a deadly plan that is out of this world. Delve beneath the fens to uncover the creature’s sinister secrets before the flood gates open and doom is unleashed.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh Hops for Honey
description: Uh oh. Winnie-the-Pooh ate all of the honey that Christopher Robin set aside for the annual Honey Festival! It's up to Winnie to set things right and prove that his heart is bigger than his stomach by adventuring into the Hundred Acre Wood to collect enough honey to save the festival!

title: The Symbiant II
description: The Symbiant II is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

title: Crafty Crasher
description: Craft and trigger contraptions to perfection or glorious chaos! Smash cars, rescue heroes, and create hilarious scenes with your own interactive systems! From giant hammers to epic chain reactions, anything is possible!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Necropolis, Part 4
description:
As the gates of death open, the Black Abbot beckons Stormreach’s finest to witness the birth of a god. The hour of ascension is upon us! Can Eberron’s newest deity be defeated?

This adventure collection includes several dungeons, a large wilderness area and a raid. It is some of the most challenging content in the game and requires great teamwork.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Dreaming Dark
description: For thousands of years the Dreaming Dark have watched and waited in our dreams. Now at long last they strike. Horrific creatures from the Plane of Nightmares threaten to overrun Xen’drik and it’s up to you to defeat them. Explore five new dungeons that will send you back in time, explain ancient mysteries of the Giants, and take you to the Plane of Nightmares itself.

title: Pinball Arcade: Star Trek - The Next Generation
Pinball Arcade: No Fear - Dangerous Sports
Pinball Arcade: The Getaway - High Speed II
Greed's Grub
description: Greed's Grub is a first-person horror game where you must craft burgers for nightmarish and goofy customers in a hellish diner, facing terrifying challenges for five days in order to survive. Made by a solo dev in 3-4 months, and is still actively being updated.

title: Bombun
description: High above the clouds, Bombun, a bomb-throwing rabbit, defends her floating fortress from her former friend turned foe, Robombun.

title: Average Human Ball Game
description: A Fighting game and a sports game merged together to create a high energy point based fighting game

title: Moor Rail
description: 《Moor Rail》 is a strategic lateral scroll shooting action game set in diesel funk. As you strengthen your train, you can increase your load, speed up, and install vehicles that assist or attack your battles.

title: Dungeons & Desserts
description: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.

title: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest
description: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings.

title: Above the Snow
description: Join the shelter crew, and let’s create the best Alpine resort around! Enjoy rich character stories, customize your shelter, attract and rescue alpinists, dive into hotel management, and map out trails! Grab your map, zip up your jacket, fill your thermos, and brace for the worst winter of the ’60s!

title: Indies' Lies: Desires Flowing
description: This content requires the base game Indies' Lies on Steam in order to play. A new class, new mechanics, new challenges, and more replayability!

title: Yoyo Punk
description: Swing, Fight & Crush your opponents in intense PvP combat arenas in this unique, fast-paced rope-physics fighter.

title: Kaido Genkai
description: Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics and RPG elements, set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside. Come explore the open world and see who you meet along the way!

title: Emirati Tales
description: Dive into Emirati Tales, a family-friendly 3D platformer where players explore the rich folklore of the UAE while learning essential life lessons. Journey through diverse levels, face unique challenges and mythical creatures, and enjoy adaptive difficulty that suits all play styles and ages.

title: Fangtopia
description: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

title: Attrax
description: Opposites attract and likes repel. Enter the mysterious world of Attrax in this captivating single-player experience. Solve logic puzzles based on attraction and repulsion, and uncover the origins of the institute. Enjoy hours of gameplay that will redefine your understanding of physics and logic.

title: Haut
description: Haut is an adventure puzzle climbing game where you journey to find your brother. Traverse ancient landmarks, uncover treasures, and experience breathtaking landscapes.

title: Choppy Cuts
description: Welcome to Choppy Cuts! In this light-hearted multiplayer co-op game, you'll become hair salon employees, working together to meet the diverse needs of various customers. Through teamwork, you'll complete a series of hairdressing tasks, earn bonuses, and challenge your skills.

title: Paratopic: Overdub
description: Paratopic: Overdub revives the award-winning 2018 liminal horror classic: a twisting 3-in-1 remaster, remix, and sequel to the original.

title: Resurrection of Santiago
description: Hunt for the notorious and unrelenting outlaw Santiago known for his reign over the dystopian city of Dorai. Endure the dangerous desert pushing your way through GDI officers and marauders as you fight for Caloria’s survival.

title: Gladiato Potato
description: Play as a brave potato in this challenging roguelike, facing off against enemies. Ready to be the hero of your own adventure?

title: Dyebreaker
description: Score goals to paint the arena in the "air hockey platformer" inspired by screen print poster art! Slam and sling dye-soaked pucks in fast-paced arcade competition, drive your color to victory and print a poster unique to your team. First art wins!

title: Seedborne Soldiers
description: An auto battler roguelike made by obsessive fans of both genres. Draft fighters with matching Traits to power up your team. A massive content pool enables a large variety of builds. Weigh risk vs. reward every round as you carve a path toward each boss.

title: Toy Voyage
description: Begin an adventure in the world of humans! This is the story of you, a toy bear, escaping from your room and begin an adventure to find your new owner. Climb on chairs, cross over beds, run through the human world, and overcome various obstacles to reach your destination.

title: Radium Lux
description: Radium Lux is a physics-based skill game with puzzle elements. The sphere that the player must navigate to the target is attracted by two tractor beams and gravity. Using these three forces from different directions enables the player to maneuver the sphere very organically through the level.

title: Black Paradox Reloaded
description: Experience chaos in this remastered, hyper-stylized roguelite. As bounty hunter Black Paradox, travel through space to defeat the Hellraisers – now with enhanced pixel art, rebalanced gameplay, new synthwave tracks, and an intense boss rush mode.

title: The Shame of a Daydreamer
description: Shame & choices = possible apocalypse. You need to figure out what’s causing the apocalypse to happen, so that you can prevent it. 2 playable characters with different relations to shame → 2 unique perspectives of the same story. Complicated families, branching choices and unforgiving consequences.

title: Ant Guardians
description: It’s a defense game where you create your own strategy, grow your units, and defend against enemies.

title: PowerCharge
description: Take to the stars in PowerCharge, a revolutionary new card game. Assemble your crew of over 100 possible cards. Position your workers strategically on the board to combo with beacons you place. Increase your power and deal massive damage to your enemy all at once. Will your crew rule the galaxy?

title: Glyphscape
description: A retro turn-based RPG with souls-like and metroidvania elements. Craft spells by combining magical glyphs, dispatch enemies through turn-based combat, discover the secrets and rich history in a deeply interconnected open world!

title: EggGarden
description: Control adorable animals and start running a bustling café! As you manage the ever-increasing number of customers, your café will expand and new menus will keep appearing! Get ready to enjoy a new kind of 3D action game featuring cooking mini-games and serving challenges!

title: LightRay
description: LightRay is a top down logic puzzle game in a peaceful setting, that features a plenty of Puzzles that utilize Lasers, the behavior of light and it's colors to create problems to be solved by you.

title: Satisfrustration
description: Satisfrustration is a trippy first-person puzzle game with directional gravity. Complete satisfying and disorientating puzzles made by The Taskmaster that become more frustratingly difficult to find solutions.

title: Sculplings
description: Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion! Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games!

title: Lonesome Road
description: "Lonesome Road" is a vanilla compatible set of 8 levels for Doom 2 Created by Tourniquet,

title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
description: Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you can battle unpredictable, dynamic mega-fires solo or in co-op, using ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support and more.

title: Ctesiphon
description: A retrowave/mecha-inspired sci-fi first-person shooter featuring fast-paced combat in old-school style open-plan levels packed with pickups, keys, and secrets.

title: Minos Dungeon
description: Help Ferdinando find treasures in a labyrinth full of puzzles!

title: Baseball Card Shop Simulator
description: Collect, trade, dominate the market and outsmart the competition.

title: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
description:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

title: Perimbó
description:
Jaime was just playing in the forest when, attracted by a beautiful red bird, he ended up falling into a deep and mysterious cave. Now, he must find a way to escape and, at the same time, unravel the forgotten secrets of this ancient place. In an underground world full of dangers and lost stories, you embark on an exciting adventure, solving puzzles, exploring secret passages and helping spirits that need to be freed.

This cave was once home to a tribe that worshipped the god Guaracy, creator of light and protector of nature. They lived in harmony until foreigners invaded and destroyed the sacred tree that brought sunlight into the caves. The magical Ybá fruit, the last reminder of this ancient power, now shines in the depths, waiting to be collected. Use the power of the sacred necklace given by the bird to create blocks of light and climb impossible heights, revealing hidden paths and overcoming obstacles.

At every turn, you’ll uncover pieces of this ancient puzzle. Help them, solve complex challenges, and recover lost tools like Jaime’s hoe to clear a path through the corrupted roots that block your progress. Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative that weaves legend, mystery, and resilience as you uncover the truth about the tribe’s fate and fight to escape back to the surface.

With an immersive atmosphere, unique soundtrack, and creative exploration mechanics, this game promises an unforgettable adventure. Explore, solve, collect, and climb as you guide Jaime on his journey back home and help restore peace to the souls trapped in the depths. Are you ready to unravel the mysteries of the cave and free your people?

title: Postal 2 Redux
description: A ground‑up overhaul of 2003’s infamous open‑world shooter. Part modernization, part love‑letter, POSTAL 2 Redux will hoist every original asset out of the creaking Unreal 1.5 engine and slam it into today’s Unity—delivering the same familiar week in the POSTAL Dude’s life with a merciless glow‑up and a bucket of new toys.

title: Neko Ningen Eugene
description:
The year is 2020, and it is off the coast of the Sea of ​​Okhotsk.

A "portal" suddenly appears on the bottom of the sea, leading to a different space-time.
The unknown wilderness beyond it is called the "Demon World."

title: Tears of the Maker
description: Tears of the Maker is a roguelike deck builder in which tears flow to the chambers to determine who attacks. Use your cards to manipulate the game and change your fate. Collect cards and build your stats in story mode or go for a more hardcore endless mode where you risk it all to go farther.

title: Fight-Quest
description: The first-person melee roguelite. Fight-Quest is a brutally satisfying deckbuilder where you fight thousands of fantasy foes, discover game-changing enchantments, and extract with your hard-earned gold.

title: Kathana
description:
Embark on an epic journey in Kathana and immerse yourself in a world brimming with adventure!

Join forces with friends and connect with adventurers from around the globe in this captivating classic MMO. Set out on shared quests, overcome formidable challenges, and experience everything Kathana has to offer.

title: Hellsprint
description: A hyper-focused, first-person speedrunner with a focus on pure adrenaline, frame-perfect execution, and the very pinnacle of competitive grinding.

title: DepthLess
description: A surreal first-person platformer horror game where you descend into nightmarish architecture, solve spatial puzzles, and survive grotesque creatures.

title: Altruistic
description: This is a pixel-style casual puzzle game set against a fresh backdrop of snowy mountains and pine forests, creating a playful winter atmosphere filled with childlike wonder.

title: Emotitron
description: Guide twin spinning orbs through lethal neon mazes in a precision arcade speedrunner with instant restarts and global leaderboards.

title: Unhinged Pet Store Simulator
description: Run your own crazy pet store! Buy wares, stock shelves, raise crabs, defend the store from the local thieving animals, hire workers and try to keep your store tidy while taking payment from impatient customers.

title: Kasama: The Awakening
description: Dive into this magical journey and join Orion The Orange in the adventure of a lifetime through dreams and nightmares. Uncover the secrets, face your fears, and restore the balance in the land of Kasamas! Will you dare to dream and face the night with them?

title: Beast Unleashed
description: Drawn breaks and the hunt begins... Beast Unleashed is a turn-based, one-vs-many multiplayer game of deadly hide-and-seek, where every move counts.

title: Humblets
description: Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. No pressure, just peaceful exploration and fireside stories!

title: Pathogenic
description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

title: Noroi no Kegareuta: Narumi Tatsuya no Kaikiroku
description: You have lost your memory and wake up in an unpopular Japanese house. Strange phenomena occur. Eerie singing voices coming from inside the house. Uncover the mystery of the cursed house with your partner.

title: Ascendora
description: A first person horror game where you play as Harper, the child of an infamous scientist. You must explore his abandoned laboratory to find the answers you have been looking for. Unravel the secrets of your parents, but be aware, you might not be alone...

title: Artis Impact: Meiji Spa
description: Soak in hot springs, explore a snowy town, uncover secrets, and maybe even... save the world?! This pixel JRPG blends humor and adventure. Meet fun characters, enjoy relaxed turn-based combat, and defend the resort from mysterious AI threats. A journey full of surprises awaits!

title: Girl Frame
description: Girl Frame: A sci-fi meat-and-pigeon survival shooting game, control mechas to fight against the mutant tide of Crusus, manage your own space base, cultivate beautiful girl pilots, fast-paced mowing × dynamic strategic choices, and experience interstellar survival under the collapse of san value.

title: Whimsy Bake ＆ Craft
description: Whimsy Bake ＆ Craft is a relaxing and therapeutic idle game where you can craft adorable desserts while freely designing your home’s aesthetics. Embark on this sweet dual-healing journey to enjoy the perfect blend of creativity and cozy charm!

title: Kalma
description:
You're a mythical Finnish warrior, descending to the depths of the crypts to show Kalman Väki who's the boss. Swing that axe at the ghosts of Kalma.

You advance to next level when you have cleaned the dungeon from all enemies.

5 levels of dungeon crawling sweetness!

title: Cute Star Heroes
description: "Cute Star Heroes" is a game inspired by the Klonoa series and 8-bit games on the NES. Play as one of the two titular "Cute Star Heroes" -Pami, a brave blue-loving rabbit, or Lumi, a girly pink-loving cat. Travel through eight different worlds and stop Lord Hades from taking control of the universe.

title: Fish 'n Ships
description: Take to the seas on your little boat and catch some fish in this 2D cozy fishing experience! Explore the drizzly coastline, upgrade your boat, and bring home the big one! How many fish can you catch?

title: Countryballs: Power Protocol
description: Incarne un Countryball et conquiers le monde – par la force, les accords ou les ruses. Développe ton économie, construis ton armée, fais-toi des alliés ou des ennemis, et règne sur les 195 pays. Une domination mondiale, plus ronde et plus drôle.

title: A Regular Pinball Game
description: You know Pinball, that's it... kinda.

title: Farm Chicken
description: Simulate a chicken on a farm recklessly destroying and exploring, or fulfilling someone else's wish to feel the warmth and healing of the farm.

title: Hidden Portals: Eternal Balance - Collector's Edition
description: As time unravels, Alice Lofton must journey into the mystical realm of Luminaria to confront her father's dangerous mission and prevent the collapse of reality. Will she be able to stop him before it's too late?

title: FloofCorp.
description: A single-player idle sticker game where white-collar workers escape to stress-free farms, collect ancient resources, process magical goods, and build personalized, ever-expanding dreamlands.

title: Castle Rodok
description: Castle Rodok is an action-RPG game with heavy emphasis on adventure and PSX style retro graphics. In Castle Rodok, you create your own character from five different races, and try to survive at least 8 levels of it's procedurally generated dungeons. There are three levels which the dungeons can occur in: Wintery forest, castle dungeons and the castle itself. After the 8 levels, you have a chance to find the final bossfight...

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X
description: Rainbow Six Siege X is the reference in tactical team shooters, where elite strategy and execution triumph. Enjoy free access to Quick Match, Unranked and Dual Front game modes with a selection of operators.

title: Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Syng, Leg Og Lær
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Hønsefødder Og Gulerødder
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Der Bor En Bager
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Mæh, Siger Det Lille Monster
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Kan Du Alfabetet?
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Kan Du Klokken?
Portal for TIC-80
description: Demake of Portal for the Tiny Computer game engine

title: Nebs' Island Adventure
description:
Nebs' Island Adventure is a 3D platformer where you play as a leopard gecko girl Nebs. Her goal is to reach the top of a mountain in a small island to find the golden cricket and prove leopard geckos are great climbers too.

While exploring the island Nebs can also collect normal crickets. Can she find them all?

title: Monster and Snakes 1.1
description: "Monster and Snakes 1.1" is a captivating story about a brave monster who encounters a series of snakes in a mysterious jungle. The monster, initially scared, quickly learns to face its fears and discovers that some snakes are friendly and helpful, while others are dangerous. Through a series of adventures, the monster navigates the jungle, making new friends and overcoming obstacles, ultimately understanding the importance of courage, wisdom, and kindness in overcoming fears and challenges.

title: Away Team
description: Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included adventure. Take control of a Duplicant and harness a new world where every tile is simulated.

title: Ffff You Machine
description: Time-stressed arena FPS. Everybody wants to FFFF you - FFFF them instead, gain time and feed the FFFF Machine until the world ends. Or time.

title: Memory Of Psycho
description: A game to relive the memories of a young man.

title: BouleMan
description: BouleMan is a fun, family‑friendly game for all ages! With up to 5 save slots, each family member can follow their own adventure and resume where they left off. Simple, charming, and customisable—perfect for both young and old players.

title: Crabs
description:
Key Features
Care for Your Crab – It’s simple. Get a crab, bring it home, and keep its food and water topped up for a few days. Take it out for a backyard adventure. When you are done spending time with your crab you can ALT-F4. The Crab will survive will the game is off as long as it has food and water. Make sure to check in before it runs out and refill as needed. Keep your crab alive as long as possible. Train it to improve its skills and discover new abilities along the way.

Real-Time Gameplay – The game continues even when you are not playing, so there is no need to keep it open between visits.

Backyard Adventure – Take control of your crab and explore the backyard. Discover secrets, face threats, and solve puzzles to discover new traits and abilities for your crabs!

Tank Variety and Customization – Unlock larger tank designs and customize them with decorations to create the perfect environment for your crab. (Coming soon)

Perfect for anyone looking for a low-pressure gameplay experience, Crabs captures the simple joy of caring for a hermit crab. Whether you are a longtime hermit crab enthusiast or just curious about these fascinating creatures, this game invites you to slow down and enjoy life’s tiny wonders.

Crabs is in early access and does not represent the final product. I will do my best at regular updates to improve the experience and add new features. Some content is still a work in progress. Please visit the Discord to report any bugs and share your feedback.

title: Grey Wake
description: In an intimate narrative-driven exploration game, wake up on a forgotten island between life and death equipped with only a compass, a telescope, and a weathered sailboat. Chart the haunted archipelago, relive faded memories, and uncover the truth about what, and who, you came here to find.

title: Beyond the Pitch
description: Dig beneath the pitch and uncover secrets no one was meant to find.

title: Born as a Pirate
description: Born as a Pirate - Multiplayer PVP game where you explore and fight!

title: Skaldsong
description: A free-to-play, singleplayer/multiplayer RPG reminiscent of TTRPGs mixed with MUD games but with content generated by an AI Game Master.

title: Biofall: Survival
description: Open-world survival horror game based in 2030, two years after the "cure". Build, survive, and find the truth of the horrors unknown.

title: Become Barista!
description: Become Barista is a charming café life-sim game. Run a café by stocking your shelves, preparing fresh ingredients, welcoming customers, expertly crafting coffee☕ and bread, upgrading your equipment and shop. Buy and decorate your dream house.

title: Lovebyte.exe
description: A parasocial VTuber dating chatsim where you join a friendly degen discord group to chat about your oshis together, but is your kamioshi actually one of your new friends? Chat, uncover irl identities, & romance a fellow fan - or maybe a VTuber. Inspired by Mystic Messenger, online communities, and internet spam

title: Dust Walkers
description: Recruit DUST WALKERS to go on dangerous expeditions to extract Dust, the most valuable resource in the galaxy! Collect resources, build defenses, acquire weapons, and choose upgrades to collect and deploy the most powerful Dust Walkers you can.

title: Still Wakes the Deep: Siren's Rest
description: 1986. Over a decade has passed since the Beira D incident. A specialist dive team journeys to the North Sea to uncover the truth.

title: Peak
description: hit bag..crank lever..upgrade moves..Hit Bag...Crank Lever...Upgrade Moves...HIT BAG....CRANK LEVER....UPGRADE MOVES....THIS... IS...PEAK... GAMEPLAY !

title: Emma's Umbrella
description: Emma's Umbrella is a challenging 2D precision platformer where you guide Emma through dangerous obstacles. Use her umbrella to create platforms, master precise movements, run, float, and wall-jump. Overcome tricky levels and help Emma find her way home!

title: Really Fast Rat
description: Really Fast Rat is a cute 2D platformer where you play as a Really Fast Rat! Dash into several unique levels and collect some adorable hats!

title: Irbet Tong
description: In this pixel adventure, Ürgel walks through a village crumbling with byllars, guided by the cosmology of the Sakha people and the memory of his ancestors, the Öbüge. As the permafrost collapses and the Earth warms, he searches for meaning on a quiet journey for jam.

title: Crimson Horn
description: Forge an unstoppable army in this thrilling auto battler experience! Strategically recruit and command diverse warriors, each with unique abilities, to form the ultimate force. Customize your squad with powerful weapons, crafted gear, and inspiring banners to turn the tide of battle!

title: Simultree
description: Simultree is an incremental game about running a life simulation. Unlock new entity, items, food and upgrade inside a big tech tree. Compete in an online leaderboard.

title: You Were Just Selling Lemonade
description: You Were Just Selling Lemonade is a strategy simulation game about selling lemonade in a capitalist society and the consequences that your actions may bring.

title: Choose
description:
A puzzle game where you collect offerings in a world where heaven and earth are connected to each other.
Stepping on clouds high in the sky, you look up at the earth you've been walking on.
In the mysterious world of Mobius, you can only rely on your inspiration.

title: Evergreen Tavern
description: A Medieval Tavern and Farming Simulator with Dungeon Crawling.

title: Koarabyss
description: This is a one-button action game where you slide down the wall while being subjected to two forces: wind and gravity.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Harbinger of Madness
description: Mysterious disappearances have the entire city on edge. Investigate the fates of the missing, dare to face hidden horrors that have broken the sanity of so many others, and destroy the monstrous perpetrator before it consumes your mind. Contains 4 hand-crafted adventures in the streets of Stormreach.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Mines of Tethyamar
description: The Dwarves have returned to the Mines of Tethyamar to seek fabulous treasure, only to find the Drow of the Underdark are after it as well. This DLC contains five adventures with an appearance by one of the Forgotten Realms' most intriguing villains.

title: Norm: A Serial Killer RPG
description:
It is not a story about love. It is a story about survival. It is a story about what is considered "normal" - and the actual truths of the universe that send people screaming from their beds in the night. It is a story about the lies we are told. It is a story about the lies we tell ourselves. It is a story about murder, debauchery, cannibalism, fraud, extortion, torture, Stockholm Syndrome, drugs, war, heresy and black magic. It is a story about tedium... it is a story about entropy... and there will be no happy endings.

But there will be plenty of macaroni and cheese...

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Haunted Halls of Eveningstar
description: Rumors say treasures still await those brave enough to delve into the depths of the Haunted Halls. A classic D&D module brought to life narrated by Forgotten Realms creator Ed Greenwood. This is an enormous dungeon with dozens of side objectives. It can be replayed in an extended mode with new content and developer commentary.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Devils of Shavarath
description: The time has come to battle the devil armies of Shavarath on their own ground. Journey to Shavarath to end once and for all the invasion of Xen'drik! Avoid the lethal traps set for you along the way, wage war against the devil army, and thwart the strategies of their most powerful commanders. Contains several challenging quest dungeons, an adventure area and a raid.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X: Elite Edition
description:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X is the undisputed reference in tactical team shooters, where elite strategy and execution triumph.

Siege X marks the biggest evolution in its history and deepens the game’s tactical core.

The Elite Edition grants access to all game modes including Ranked playlists and the Siege Cup, and 16 additional operators.

title: Cats Visiting Wild West
description: Explore charming Wild West scenes and find hidden cats hiding in saloons, canyons, and steam trains. Relax, search, and collect them all!

title: Tekken 8: Anna Williams
description:
Lightning Scarlet: The breathtakingly beautiful and deadly ex-assassin Anna Williams is joining the fight!

Fueled once again by the thirst for vengeance, Anna is armed with not only a new secret weapon, but also a new fighting style so she can finally take Nina down.

title: Bee Flowers: Save the Garden
description:
n the third chapter of the Bee Flowers series, you’ll guide bees through stunning environments while solving logic puzzles on a hexagonal grid. The goal is simple: connect paths to deliver pollen to the flowers. The gameplay is accessible, but the challenges increase as you progress.

With 30 carefully designed levels, the game features three distinct biomes:
Green Fields: A peaceful green field, perfect for learning the mechanics and getting used to the game’s rhythm.

Autumn Grove: An autumn scene with leaves covering the paths and winds affecting the bees' movement.
Winter Hollow: A cold, serene environment where puzzles require more planning and attention.

Bee Flowers: Save the Garden combines minimalist visuals, a relaxing soundtrack, and thoughtful mechanics to offer an engaging experience, perfect for puzzle lovers with a touch of personality.

Time to save the garden — one path at a time.

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Digital Deluxe Edition
Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Super Digital Deluxe Edition
D.S. al Fine
description:
A mysterious parcel. An absent friend. When did you buy a radio?

An experimental game inspired by the audio-drama Malevolent and is based on its pre-show events, but knowledge of it is not required to play (no spoilers past season 2 if you are familiar.)

title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
With the SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition, you can play the game three days early and receive the Ghost Outfit, Medic Lite Amulet, in-game currency, digital artbook and soundtrack, and the SEGA Villains Stage, featuring bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.

It includes:
• Base Game
• Play the game 3 days early
• Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o Starter Pack: the Ghost Outfit, the Medic Lite Amulet, and In-Game Currency
o SEGA Villains Stage (Coming Early 2026)
o Digital Art Book + Soundtrack

The iconic SHINOBI returns in an all-new 2D action platformer with a unique hand-drawn look created by the team behind the hit brawler Streets of Rage 4.

title: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree: Deluxe Edition
description:
Pre-order to receive the Guardians' Vestments Costume Set, which grants additional costumes for Towa and all 8 Guardians.

Content includes:
- Towa Outfit: Blacksmith's Clothes
- Rekka Outfit: Lady Towa's Personal Guard
- Shigin Outfit: Traditional Attire of Jinkai
- Akazu Outfit: Researcher's Uniform
- Origami Outfit: Traditional Attire of Musuhi
- Nishiki Outfit: Chargrilled Nishiki
- Mutsumi Outfit: Sakura Kimono
- Korou Outfit: Village Hero Regalia
- Banpuku Outfit: Black & Beige Fur

*The Guardians' Vestments Costume Set can be changed by visiting the Residence which unlocks after completing the tutorial.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

In this Roguelite adventure set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Special Equipment Set
description: Dive into the world of Daemon X Machina with this collection of special equipment!

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Special SFX Weapon Set
description: Spice up your battles with these special weapons with original sound effects!

title: Venue
description: The world is in pieces... this is your responsibility now. The process will be excruciating, beautiful, and you will tolerate it entirely without question.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Magic of Myth Drannor
Fixer Park-er
description:
You've been thinking about your childhood park a lot recently: it was closed some years ago after the original contributor paying for it's maintenance died and it has since been left to fall into disrepair, now overgrown and abandoned. You've been trying to find a way to help out the old neighborhood for a while now and this might be a 2 for 1 opportunity.

Time to get to work and restore the park to it's former glory.

Take your time exploring the park, using tools to break open new pathways and finding items to fix up broken structures and machines. All on the back of the charity of others gained by selling lemonade to the locals!

title: Common Grounds
description:
In this heartfelt barista simulator, you'll serve not just drinks, but warmth, comfort, and inspiration!

Listen to your customers' stories, serve their drink just the way they like, and hand-decorate each cup with stickers, drawings and personal messages to uplift not just their day, but life! We hope you enjoy!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Eladrin
description: Unleash the Eladrin’s seasonal magic with this character race. Master versatile combat styles and elemental spells that shift with the seasons, bringing the Feywild's power to your fingertips.

title: Bytecollector
description: Bytecollector is a short, incremental game where you draw loops to collect bytes. Spend them on a skill tree with over 40 upgrades to unlock new mechanics.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Eladrin Chaosmancer
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Epic Destiny - Machrotechnic
description:
This is an arcane epic destiny that can be purchased in the in-game store, or included with some editions of the Vecna Unleashed expansion.

The Machrotechnic wields the devastating power of both the lightning strike and the destructive sonic boom that follows. With mastery over arcane and mechanical devices, the Machrotechnic can wield a variety of devices to enhance themselves and their allies against harm or interfere with their foes.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Tabaxi Trailblazer
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Inquisitive
description:
Inquisitives are investigators who specialize in solving mysteries and shedding light on the darkest secrets. They gain skills that focus on Diplomacy, Law/Chaos damage, finding hidden things, and a new Dual-Crossbow combat style.

Any Light or Heavy (non-repeating) Crossbow you equip splits into two smaller hand-crossbows in your hands, each firing a shot every time you attack. Both of these shots use the stats of your single (equipped) Crossbow. Get ready to hit the streets of Sharn and solve some mysteries!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Tiefling Scoundrel
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Horizon Walker
description:
