description: Get saucy with the official Rhythm Rift for "World Wide Noise" by ClascyJitto. This track is part of the Pizza Tower Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "MikuFiesta"
description: Dance and leave all your sorrows behind with the official Rhythm Rift for MikuFiesta feat. Hatsune Miku by AlexTrip Sands! This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "M@gical Cure! Love Shot!"
description: Keep on fighting with the official Rhythm Rift for M@gical Cure! Love Shot! feat. Hatsune Miku by SAWTOWNE! This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "Radiant Revival"
description: Feel your heart beat with the official Rhythm Rift for Radiant Revival feat. Hatsune Miku by Jamie Paige! This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "Just 1dB Louder"
description: Pump up the volume with the official Rhythm Rift for Just 1dB Louder feat. Hatsune Miku by IOSYS TRAX! This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "Intergalactic Bound"
description: Fly high with the official Rhythm Rift for Intergalactic Bound feat. Hatsune Miku by Yunosuke & CircusP! This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: hololive - "Bibbidiba"
description: Experience your own fairy tale with the official Rhythm Rift for "BIBBIDIBA" by Hoshimachi Suisei!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: hololive - "Carbonated Love"
description: Feel the rush with the official Rhythm Rift for "Carbonated Love" by IRyS!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hololive - "Reflect"
description: As a bonus, celebrate the graduated icon with the free Rhythm Rift, available now for everyone:""reflect"" by Gawr GuraThank you, legendary shark!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: hololive - "Ahoy!! Warera Takara Kane Kaizoku-dan☆"
description: Raise your voice with the official Rhythm Rift for "Ahoy!! 我ら宝鐘海賊団☆" by Houshou Marine!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: hololive - "Play Dice!"
description: Follow your heart with the official Rhythm Rift for "Play Dice!" by Hakos Baelz!

title: RWSD
description: RVSD is an FPV drone simulator with a campaign. Control scout, kamikaze, spotter, bomber, and interceptor drones. Customize your loadout, avoid air defenses and jamming, and hit ground and naval targets.

title: To the Kingdom
description: Build your kingdom in this strategic multiplayer board game. Plan your cities and villages carefully, manage resources and cards wisely, and outsmart your rivals. Master the game's rules and sharpen your tactics as you march To the Kingdom. Only the most cunning will claim victory!

title: Revenant: Through the Veil
description: When love defies death, the gods take notice. Armed with the Book of the Dead, archaeologist Hossam Sharawi must face ancient gods, survive cursed tombs, and journey through the Egyptian afterlife to bring back the one he lost.

title: Hardly Workin'
description: Balance your work and fun in this goofy and chaotic office simulator! Avoid falling asleep on the job by slacking off in the goofiest ways possible. Just don't get caught by your boss Karen!

title: Fractured Balance
description: A fast-paced action-platformer where your health is tied to the world's stability. Defend energy cores from waves of magical skulls, repair damage, and stop reality from decaying—because if the world dies, you die with it.

title: Infinite Einstein Tiles
description: Infinite Einstein Tiles is a casual puzzle game themed around an aperiodic monotile discovered by David Smith in 2022. Once you've solved all the puzzles, you might understand how aperiodic tiling with a single tile is achieved.

title: Square & Circles
description: Play as the cute, surviving square, and destroy the dictatorship of the circles. Shoot, run, explode - do everything but defeat the circles and stay alive. Can you save your friends and your beloved? It all depends on you!

title: Pathless Maze TD
description: A tower defense game that blends strategic depth with labyrinthine design. Construct mazes to block enemy advances, fuse advanced towers to obliterate monsters, and adapt your tactics to counter unique foes.

title: Sweet Girls Collection
description: In the world of Sweetaria, where girls known as “Sweets” live under divine blessings, the protagonist "Pâtissier" chooses a heroine to pursue—each leading to a unique ending. A sweet and bittersweet multi-ending visual novel awaits you!

title: SpaceCorp: 2025-2300AD
description: Lead mankind's exploration into outer space! Build bases on the Moon and Mars, survey the rings of Saturn, and send generational Colony ships to Alpha Centauri and beyond. SpaceCorp: 2025-2300 AD is a fast-playing, turn-based, sci-fi strategy game, playable in 60 minutes or less.

title: Terminal Toilet Simulator
description: Buy an old, dirty public toilet, clean it, decorate it, and run it! Deal with customers, level up, and move on to new toilets. An absurd toilet simulation filled with everything from perverts and police to thieves and people who wet themselves!

title: Quacolé Tennis
description: Face the most unexpected opponents in completely crazy tennis matches. Win tournaments, overcome obstacles, and defeat giant monsters using the power of your racket! Embark on a solo adventure or invite a friend to explore the world of Quacolé Tennis in doubles matches.

title: Leafko
description: Leafko is a turn-based RPG set in a magical forest. Meet a new character in each chapter and explore dungeons overtaken over by nature.

title: Nekogumi
description:
Join Bruce, a tuxie who loves to cosplay and roam around town. Spruce up the cat café and buy all sorts of wardrobe items you want. Gather your brigade and let your curiosity guide you, you get a free pass as a cat boss~

Nekogumi is a single player, third person cafe-adventure game. It is a cozy game where you’d find companions among silly and funny animals and work together to protect and bring prosper to the neighbourhood.

title: Vibe Clicker
description: An idle clicker game following the journey from job-seeking graduate to Vibe Lord. Click your way through career phases while automating tasks with increasingly "helpful" AI tools. Balance money, reputation, and processing power in this satirical exploration of AI's role in modern work.

title: Puzzlestuck
description: A Puzzle and Dragons inspired Homestuck fan game

title: The Knight in Pajamas
description: The Knight was yanked out of bed and hurled into the craziest beat 'em up adventure! Help him complete his quest and get back home. Slash through hordes of enemies, defeat bosses, and take their unique weapons with special effects.

title: Highway Bus Rush
description: Highway Bus Rush is a fast-paced endless racing game with mission-based gameplay. Drive a highway bus, complete 50 levels, collect fuel, dodge traffic, and race through Sunny, Night, and Rainy modes at top speed.

title: Longmen
description: "Longmen" is a roguelike turn-based card game set in Chinese mythology, where you can freely embody three legendary figures from the myths—Sun Wukong, Nezha, and Erlang Shen—challenging the lofty deities and their minions.

title: Knighventure
description: The eternal darkness of the dungeons dragged the brave knight in golden armor into an endless maze of dangers

title: Evil Twin
description: A female scientist of Py King Corporation made a huge mistake when she directly tested cell tissue programming technology on the human body, causing suffering to millions of people. She was trapped in her own uncertain maze after jumping off a building to commit suicide,

title: Lingering Shadows
description: A short, story-driven 3D RPG adventure with horror elements. Explore, fight, and make choices in a surreal world inspired by a nightmare, where your actions lead to multiple endings.

title: The Last Hearth Defense
description: Your mission in this game is to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast the enemy waves using smart tactics and powerful upgrades.

title: Kabuki Fire
description: Every year, the world's best shooters gather on an tropical island, to participate in a lethal competition!

title: All You Have to Do Is Click the Button
description: We are hiring! Gumthrow Industries needs you, and all you have to do is click the button! That's it. Click the button, and don't get distracted.

title: Let's Paint Toast
description: Paint slices of toast using red, yellow, and blue—then deliver them to the matching colored blocks. Mix colors to create green, purple, and orange toast as the difficulty ramps, demanding sharp hand-eye coordination and strategic decision-making as you aim for the leaderboard.

title: HAL Protocol
description: Your shift aboard the HIS 01 Echo is finally over. The return shuttle awaits you in Compartment 9. All that's left is to walk there. But the corridor to Compartment 9 loops endlessly. Each time, something shifts. Uncover the mystery. Escape the impossible.

title: The Secret Fake Ring
description: You have lost your job and your home, and you are reunited with two childhood friends. Then, one of them suddenly proposes “marriage” in order to help you... A true love begins from a fake marriage!

title: Mega Man Battle Network 4: Blue Moon
Mega Man Battle Network 4: Red Sun
Mega Man Battle Network 5: Team Colonel
Mega Man Battle Network 5: Team Protoman
description:
The exciting fifth entry in the series!
Dr. Regal, the leader of the Dark Chip Syndicate Nebula, is back.
What dangers await Lan on his quest to rescue his kidnapped father...?
Control allied Navis in team battles!
Liberate the internet from Nebula's clutches!

title: Mega Man Battle Network 6: Cybeast Falzar
description: The sixth entry, and the conclusion to the series! Wield the power of the Cybeasts and bring the fight with WWW to its definitive end! Thanks to Lan the ambitions of Dr. Regal, leader of the Dark Chip Syndicate Nebula, are crushed and peace is returned to the world. Getting back to his normal life, Lan prepares to move away from his friends, to a place where a new adventure awaits.

title: Mega Man Battle Network 6: Cybeast Gregar
description: The sixth entry, and the conclusion to the series! Wield the power of the Cybeasts and bring the fight with WWW to its definitive end! Thanks to Lan the ambitions of Dr. Regal, leader of the Dark Chip Syndicate Nebula, are crushed and peace is returned to the world. Getting back to his normal life, Lan prepares to move away from his friends, to a place where a new adventure awaits.

title: SCP-015
description: SCP-015 is an horror game that takes place in the SCP-015, an ever expanding mass of pipes, vents, boilers and other various plumbing apparatus.

title: My Little Foundation: Containment is Magic
description: A mod for SCP Containment Breach that replaces SCP and setting with a darker version of My Little Pony : Friendship is Magic

title: Island Off Outer Darkness
description: A narrative delivery simulator following the Postman, a Postal Worker new to a small fishing village off the coast of a volcano. As they do their doldrum job delivering mail to residents day-by-day, they begin to experience space-warping aberrations.

title: Birdoo
description: Birdoo is an indie action game were you take control of a bird on his quest for revenge against the humans that mistreated him. For too long have you been called a flying rat and shooed away. It's time to take revenge!

title: Farmtastic
description: Step into a colorful world! In this fun farm game with cartoon-style graphics, plant and harvest fields, take care of animals, build structures, and complete villagers' tasks to write your own farm story and pay off your debt. Wander around the fun world or build a giant barn - it's your choice!

title: Dude Called Barry
description: Run across short fast paced levels, comboing movement abilities to try and get to the finish line as quickly as possible

title: Monster Hunter
description: This is the PC version of an early Y2K indie game called Monster Hunter, (not to be confused with the popular Capcom action rpg series). It is an arcade-style dungeon maze game. A Game Boy Advance version was planned, but it was cancelled.

title: Inhabited Island: Prisoner of Power
description:
Inhabited Island: Prisoner of Power is a linear, mission‑based first‑person shooter adapted from the Strugatsky brothers’ novel. Players control Maxim Kammerer through prison‑camp episodes and resistance missions on the planet Saraksh, using a multifunctional weapon with selectable fire modes to tackle human foes, hazards, and stationary electronic defenses.
Levels mix outdoor areas, environmental dangers (mines, radioactive water), and occasional vehicle sections and stealthy diversions; between missions you can buy weapon mods, ammo, and healing items to prepare for the next operation.

title: Cozy Catch
description: An idle fishing game with pixel art charm and a spooky-cozy twist. Cast your line, reel in strange and rare fish, upgrade your gear, and explore eerie biomes beyond the peaceful forest where you begin. Simple mechanics, relaxing vibes, and plenty of hidden treasures await.

title: Beat Vortex
description: Discover a new way to experience your music in Beat Vortex, a rhythm game where your favorite songs shape the world. Fly through twisting tunnels that pulse, bend, and react to every beat. You’ll dodge, roll, and flow in sync with the rhythm—chasing high scores or just vibing to the music you love.

title: Forest Asylum 2
description: Forest Asylum 2 - An Indie Psychological Horror Game and the sequel to the well-received first part. Embark on a Therapy that will change your life!

title: Frontline Protocol
description:
Frontline Protocol is an RTS with deckbuilding and auto battler elements, entirely focused on cooperative PvE. It features a tactically rich card system: you draw from three customizable decks at once, rewarding specialization, deck planning, and player experience, allowing you to control each frontline with precision.

Whether solo or in online co-op with up to three players, each battle brings new challenges. You share resources, spawners, and eco buildings. Your deck composition lets you focus on specific roles - such as economy, defense, support, or aggressive frontline control using light infantry. Communication and timing are crucial, as whatever one player builds benefits the whole team.

Throughout the game, you earn booster credits that can be spent on new card packs. These packs include new cards, temporary bonuses, and resources to further develop your decks. Some cards can also be upgraded, permanently lowering their deployment cost—offering long-term depth over short-term optimization.

With each level-up, you gain a skill point to invest in passive bonuses—such as higher starting resources, larger hand size, or better resource rates. This adds a growing meta-progression system that deepens your playstyle alongside your deck choices.

Experienced players can take on missions, randomly generated mini-campaigns with special challenges. Completing them earns mission coins used to unlock special booster packs. These contain unique deployment plans, booster items, and additional rewards that can be strategically used to optimize your loot.

With over 300 cards for units, buildings, towers, and special actions, you'll find the playstyle that suits you best.

title: Advent/Archive
description: Advent/Archive is a short fan-game, made in RPG Maker MV, featuring Shiori Novella, and guest starring other talents from Hololive. You play as Shiori, navigating an underground dungeon in search of the Archive. You will have to fight through tough monsters and discover treasure to make it all the way through.

title: Raiders Rise
description: Raiders Rise is a multiplayer action-strategy game where two teams must cooperate and compete to collect crystals. Survive alien threats, outmaneuver rivals, and choose help or betray? In this chaotic battleground, teamwork is key… until it isn’t.

title: Putrika 2nd.Cut: For the Exquisite Attire
description: Is cutting down a young girl a sin, or a salvation? In the Haku-a Church where pure love and jealousy collide, a young gem-craftsman is forced to choose—to let her live, or to end her life.

title: Duelyst: Blitz
description: Build your deck, command units in lightning-fast turn-based duels. With beautifully animated pixel art, Blitz brings the soul of Duelyst into a more intense experience.

title: Toyland Tussle
description: A classic cartoon inspired boss fight platformer, with shoot em' up game mechanics. Run, jump, and shoot with four unique bullet types and two difficulty modes. Try to get a gold rank in this hand-drawn, traditionally animated boss fight.

title: Bon Appecheese
description: Colette the mouse runs her own fromagerie after working years as an affineur for other restaurants. But it's a big world for a small mouse, and she's got to make a name for herself. She wants to curate the best cheese in the world. Will her cheese be CHEDDAR than the rest? Or will it BRIE no GOUDA?

title: Megaplex Madness 2: Summer Blockbuster
description: After much success refurbishing Movieville's cinemas, you've decided to build the town a movie megaplex with 5 uniquely-themed theaters. Use your fast fingers to serve movie goers and make cash to buy upgrades. Hit Expert level to earn tokens for arcade mini-games and hit Master level to choose theater decorations, like a rocket for your sci-fi theater.

title: Witch War I
description: Wage a war...with witches! Take control of islands one battlefield at a time in this team-based action roguelite. Play alone or with friends and become the last witch army standing!

title: Tralalero Tralala: Survive the Night
description: An asymmetric horror game where four survivors try to escape an Italian monster-maniac by solving puzzles and completing tasks. Repair the Bombardiro Crocodilo and run!

title: Terrible Life Expectancy
description: Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite top-down shooter with Survivors elements. Fight absurd hordes of mutants for the amusement of an unseen bloodthirsty audience and only inherit all your upgrades as long as someone in your family is still breathing... or at least twitching.

title: Motel Snooze: Suite Dreams
description: Check in to a cocktail of surreal worlds, find out what makes other guests tick in order to take their Sweetest Dreams. They are, after all, the only way to get rid of your nightmares.

title: Mirealle
description: A world has split into thousands of floating islands. A forgotten history is hidden in ruins. Mirealle is a touching puzzle adventure set in a cozy universe. It is about the search for hope where a lost part of the world… and of oneself… are hidden in every detail.

title: The Pixotron 49
description: The Pixotron 49 is a retro-inspired puzzle game where you craft pixel art by wiring together visual logic nodes. Interact with eclectic characters, solve creative challenges, and bring their requests to life - hopefully not one pixel at a time.

title: Wicked Cabins
description: Wicked Cabins is a tiny relaxing builder where you design cozy dioramas set in the most uncozy places. Create eerie little sanctuaries in a game with a horror twist, where you're not escaping the darkness - you’re making it feel like home.

title: Push to Win
description: Get ready to compete in this fun 8-player party game full of puzzles and tricky obstacles! Each player must both cooperate and compete to outsmart the others. Jump, solve, push, and win—but watch out, rivals may try to sabotage you every round!

title: Synth Riders: Toto - "Africa"
description: Add Toto - "Africa" to your library! Welcome back to the 1980s, Players! You knew a “Side B” was coming to our Mixtape and this time we're delivering seven huge hits from the era when the only thing bigger than the music was the hair!

title: Synth Riders: Blur - "Song 2"
description: Add Blur - "Song 2" to your library!Music that rips you out of your seat — that's Rock from the 1990s! The hard driving riffs and high energy lyrics that defined a decade are now attacking the rails in Synth Riders.

title: Synth Riders: Soundgarden - "Black Hole Sun"
description: Add Soundgarden - "Black Hole Sun" to your library!Music that rips you out of your seat — that's Rock from the 1990s! The hard driving riffs and high energy lyrics that defined a decade are now attacking the rails in Synth Riders.

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice
description: SMASH through My Hero Academia’s final story arc and triumph over your foes in spectacular 3v3 battles! Follow the trials of Deku and other characters in the Final War between Heroes and Villains!

title: Cascade
description: CASCADE is a stylish first-person roguelite with a focus on blazingly fast movement. Slide from surface to surface, unlock and upgrade abilities and face otherworldly enemies and bosses, all while exploring a corrupted digital space. But don't forget: Always keep on moving!

title: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons
description:
Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons is an action-adventure game inspired by the true story of the 1900-1902 polar expedition. It tells the story of brave explorers who decide to prove the legend of the phantom island in the Arctic Ocean.

Switch between characters, use your grappling hook to explore a phantom island, home to mammoths. Face threats from hunters and choose to play stealthily or confront the dangers head-on. Inspired by real events.

title: Tekken 8: Fahkumram
description:
Thunderous Roar Garuda
The undefeated Muay Thai champion is joining the fight!

While his wife and daughter are held hostage, Fahkumram remains under the control of the Thai military. With the belief that he will one day reclaim his sole purpose for living, Fahkumram has been sent to the battlefield in a military breaching vehicle.

title: Futa Runner: Big Dick Edition
description: Get ready to dive into the brutal and hardcore futanari underground world!

title: Sloppy Fields
description: After his disappearance, you've inherited your father's old farm and a huge debt. The farm is located in the Sloppy Fields: legendary lands where nature grows strong and where monster girls are proliferous. Will you be able to conquer these lands once again and pay your debt?

title: Born to Breed
description: A futanari visual novel set in a world of goblins, centaurs, and more. Features Live2D animation and full voice acting.

title: Scryer's Shadow
description:
Winner of the 2025 Ukie Student Game Jam!
You stray too far from your village and stumble upon something very sinister...

Stay out of sight of the piercing eye by jumping from shadow to shadow in this intense platformer!

title: Gym Buddies
description:
Mark is a young guy who decides to go to the gym after binge-scrolling too many TikTok motivational shorts. Here he meets many gorgeous personal trainers who can't wait to fuck train him.
Will Mark focus on his gains or succumb to temptation? The choice is yours in this sweaty, steamy adventure!

title: Sci-Futa
description: A futa x female NSFW visual novel. Follow a very pent-up futanari after a bad breakup as she goes to a space brothel and relieves her stress.

title: SeaCret 1
description: Sail into the 17th-century Caribbean in SeaCret 1, a riotous mix of strategy, humor, and adventure! Trade, fight, or govern your way to fame in this sandbox escapade, where every choice brings riches or ridiculousness.

title: Elliot's Great Symphony
description: Join Elliot Taylor in a musical roguelike adventure to master a legendary 20-minute symphony and awaken his inspiration.

title: Snail Race
description: Race to learn in Snail Race!  Answer fun questions to boost your snail’s speed — the more you know, the faster you go! A colorful and silly educational game for kids, combining learning with fast-paced fun.

title: Starfield Battlegrounds
description: On the occasion of the invasion of alien races, in order to defend our homeland on Earth, you will play the role of one of humanity's ace pilots, piloting aircraft provided by various countries, galloping in the universe, and fighting against alien fleets.

title: The Judge
description: Take down multiple criminals case by case as you judge each and every one of them. Will you be naughty or nice? The final verdict is up to you!

title: Line Goes Up
description: Line Goes UP is an idle game where you watch a line go up. Even though it starts simple enough, soon you will unlock new lines, tools and challenges to complete, that will allow you to reach unmatched heights. Will you uncover all the misteries of the grid?

title: Teamcrafter
description: Cozy roguelite where you gather resources and craft gear for adventurers fighting dangerous monsters. Gather, craft, watch them win!

title: The Serpent and the Crow
description: The Serpent and the Crow is an unforgiving roguelite-survivor game. Rip through countless hordes of enemies to unlock gear, skills, origins, and ascensions and create your perfect broken build. You will need to survive to discover the mysteries of this long forgotten tavern.

title: The Last Captain
description: Experience nail-biting space combat which mixes tactics, physics, and precision in this top-down, sci-fi RPG. Explore the Pyre Sector and fight, trade, and befriend the local factions while seeking vengeance against an enigmatic threat. Take on the campaign with friends, or take part in PvP online.

title: AirBoost Airship Knight
description: the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, during a battle in the ruins, accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl, Agate. This also draws the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles. The game offers rich levels and exciting battles, with many companions who will fight alongside you!

title: Börd Killer
description: This game is an arena shooter where you have a gun, and you must fend off hordes of börds.

title: Bertha
description: a short (2.7k words) visual novel for the queer vampire jam.

title: AstraPuffs
description: Astrapuffs is an agentic NPC multiplayer that is set to revolutionize the cozy gaming genre. Our advanced AI-driven NPCs create dynamic, responsive, and immersive stories that adapt to the player interactions in real-time.

title: Night Jackal: Blood Debt
description: A masked vigilante seeks revenge, unravels a conspiracy, and teeters on the edge of sanity in this retro-inspired boomer shooter.

title: Patapon Replay
description: PATAPON released in 2007 is back as a remastered!

title: Patapon 2 Replay
description: PATAPON 2 released in 2008 is back as a remastered!

title: 100 Cats World
description: Find hundreds of Cats hidden in around the world! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Lost in Poland Find & Color
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 100 hidden cats across a beautifully hand-drawn map. Play solo or invite a friend to join online, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette — all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Canada Find & Color
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 100 hidden cats across a beautifully hand-drawn map. Play solo or invite a friend to join online, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette — all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Usa Find & Color
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 100 hidden cats across a beautifully hand-drawn map. Play solo or invite a friend to join online, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette — all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost In World 2 Find & Color
description: Discover 900+ hidden cats across 9 unique hand-drawn country maps. Relax with guided color-by-numbers or free pastel coloring. Play solo or online co-op, while Meow FM sets the mood.

title: 100 Cats Lost in England
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 100 hidden cats across a beautifully hand-drawn map. Play solo or invite a friend to join online, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette — all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Space Find & Color
description: Explore 10+ space-themed maps and find 1,000+ hidden cats in 100 Cats Lost In Space: Find & Color! Enjoy guided color-by-numbers or free coloring modes. Play solo or local co-op in a relaxing cosmic adventure.

title: Einherjar's Ascent
description: Battle through the Nine Realms in this Norse-themed survivor roguelite. Slay hordes, collect runes, upgrade abilities, and ascend as Odin’s chosen champion.

title: Dice Tower
description: 2D strategy platformer with elements of controlled risk and time management

title: University Speedrun Simulator
description: Under the blessing of your talents, speedrun university in as few turns as possible! Multiple endings await your discovery!

title: Solaris: Good Harvest
description: A humble farmer sets out to rescue his chicken from monstrous abductors. Punch, slash, and parkour your way through elemental-infused chaos in this fast-paced 2D action-platformer!

title: Boogie Cruise
description: Boogie Cruise is a fast-paced indie racing game with a wild twist! Blaze through epic tracks, then dive into a mysterious dungeon packed with action-adventure thrills. Face an unforgettable boss battle and prove your skills in this one-of-a-kind racing adventure!

title: Fatebound Cards: Sundering Cities
description: In this unique turn-based strategy game, assemble your heroes, choose your cards, and assault the enemy castle. Draw cards to fortify your defenses, organize your heroes' attacks—and leave the rest to fate~

title: In Arrears
description: A survival horror game for anyone who's ever wept into an Excel sheet. Welcome to your new job! You’re underpaid, overworked, and haunted by rent. Literally. In In Arrears, time is money — and you’re chronically broke. The coffee's cold. HR is missing. And the tax men? Avoid them.

title: Hello Penguin 2
description: after a year of waiting the reckoning is finally here! join us on an important journey, that will make you a better person. Peng is back, and we all can't wait for you to say hello.

title: What do You Call a Group of Skeletons?
description: What do you call a group of skeletons is a short comedy adventure where you will experience peak narrative, absolute gameplay, and hats! ...There will also be plenty of organ theft...

title: Hello Penguin 3D
description: Penguin is here. Here in the void, I have found it. After ten years pouring over my two tomes, I have found Penguin. There is something present here, something wrong with the air. It is heavy with joy, misty with rage, and arid with fear. Penguin is here. I am shaking. Penguin seems intent but I do not know on what. It surveys the lands, not as if searching, but as if scouring every possibility at once. I can not comprehend what is happening. Penguin is here?

title: Medieval Life
description: Medieval Life is a text-based simulator RPG that tactically forces you to plan your time to survive in the harsh world of the Middle Ages.

title: Crazy Islands
description: Welcome to "Crazy Islands", a 3D survival game for 1-4 players that takes you into a world full of mystery and challenges. On this isolated archipelago, you will face ancient gods, cruel natural environment and unknown dangers. Only wisdom and courage can help you survive in this unknown land.

title: Kill Your Darlings
description: The kingdom has imprisoned you in the dungeon! Manage your day-to-day life, date your fellow inmates (who are monsters) and fight by their side to escape in this innovative time-management dating-sim RPG where every choice matters and every playthrough is different.

title: Ultakia
description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

title: Land of Glarefall
description: An action-adventure survival game where every night could be your last. Explore a vast, dangerous world where survival depends on smart resource management, tactical combat, and what you choose to do before night falls.

title: Hypnosis: Quiet Nights
description: A psychological exploration game combining dialogue and side-scrolling action. Guide a sleepless girl through a journey of dreams, medication, and fragile emotions. Enter her dreams, battle adorable yet dangerous creatures, and gently change the course of her fate.

title: DoppelTest
description: Kagari, a withdrawn child, and Kagami, the robot living in society as their stand-in— Only one will be recognized as the real Kagari. Your role is to gently observe their choices and decisions.

title: Bounce Cat
description: Bounce Cat is a vertical platformer where every jump matters and every fall hurts. Join Kat, a determined cat on a mission to rescue her companion Mat, as she climbs through a challenging vertical world. There are no traditional checkpoints—just pure skill, precise bounces, and the occasional break… by meowing a little tune.

title: Reaper Actual
description: Reaper Actual is an open-world persistent shooter where hundreds of players engage in FPS combat against each other and 5 NPC factions on the massive war-torn island of Marova. Level your Reapers, maintain a home base, and complete missions to earn gear and reshape the world.

title: Nightmare Invasion
description: Nightmare has set its sights on this world, and as the will of the world, you will rely on cards, tower defenses, and urban construction to destroy Nightmare's invasion in the dream

title: Wretch: Divine Ascent
description: A dark fantasy 1v1 auto battler game with 3D action elements inspired by Backpack Battle You have a complete backpack that allows you to purchase various items (equipment, accessories, skills, etc.), creating a powerful build unique to you.

title: Voyage Router
description: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

title: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
description: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

title: Your Very Last Words
description: Live the last ten minutes in the life of Juan Fuentes, who has been given the chance to choose his very last words before death. Captured by Victoriano Huerta's army after the Ten Tragic Days, Juan will have a brief while to think about his life, death, family, relationships, fights and existence.

title: Memory Collectors
description: Navigate a broken-down space station in search of some of the last mementos left behind by human beings before a black hole swallows them whole.

title: Space #2: The Gallery of Unfulfilled Dreams
description: Welcome to The Gallery of Unfulfilled Dreams, the place where artist's unaccomplished dreams end up in. Navigate the gallery's halls and learn the story behind each one of the 17 pieces that make up this temporary exhibition.

title: Extreme Forklifting 3
description: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination!

title: The Wandering
description: The Wandering is a narrative-driven single-player first-person experience set in a labyrinth with no exit in sight. Trapped with five other people, you can use any dialogue you want from any conversation you like to answer the game's questions and escape!

title: 4Dead
description:
The only way to live is to eat!

Control the strongest invincible creature, "No. 42," who dies in 4 seconds, defeat the alien invaders, and survive!

title: Colorful Mines =Slide=
description:
"COLORFUL MINES =SLIDE=" is a puzzle game that combines minesweeper and slide puzzle into 3D.

Click "＜" "＞" to slide the colored panels, and clear the stage if all the numbers match the colors and numbers of the surrounding panels.

title: Stick A Round
description: Relive the joy of your childhood in Stick A Round! Find uniquely generated sticks that transform into weapons based on their real-world shapes. Battle friends in combat, play action packed or relaxing minigames, and explore a changing world where your imagination sets the rules.

title: Shift at Midnight
description: An online co-op horror for 1–3 players. Be wary: some of your customers are only pretending to be human. Question them. Check their paperwork. Don’t let them trick you; make one mistake, and you’d better board up, set traps, and hide.

title: Raptor
description: The protagonist, a reporter, receives information that a laboratory is conducting experiments that defy the law. He visits the laboratory to find out what the experiment is, but regrets his decision to come... A 3D escape horror in which he explores while being chased by a tracker using only lights!

title: Real Estate Simulator 2
description: Real Estate 2 is a continuation of the business simulator, where you completely manage the real estate business, but wider and with more opportunities. Find the best deals, repair, organize transportation and sell with maximum profit. It's time to build your empire!

title: Between Two Worlds
description:
What will you do when the boundary between fantasy and reality collapses?

You and your friends are playing a simple tabletop game, adventuring in the fantasy world of Euchora. But strange things start happening to you. An unknown woman is visiting you in the night. Your friends have started to behave in strange, unusual ways. What is going on?

title: Curtain Drop
description:
This game is played by using the player's hands to create “shadow pictures” on the screen.

Instead of using common input devices such as a controller or mouse, the player actually creates shadow pictures on the screen in real space, and all operations are performed by the shadow pictures. The created shadowgraphs are captured in the game world through the camera and begin to move as characters. Different movement patterns and characteristics are automatically set for each character, and based on their performance, they engage in auto-battles with enemy characters. Character performance is determined based on the shape and size of the base shadowgraph, so the key to the game is how creative you can be in order to create powerful characters.

title: Tales of The Nightmares: Episode One
description: Tales Of The Nightmares is a series of games focused on an indie cinematic experience with an immersive narrative of cosmic and psychological horror, featuring a retro visual style inspired by classic PS1-PS2 titles.

title: Yes, And So Our Hollow Hearts Called For Love
description:
What does it mean to suffer in heaven? Eve knows the answer and Leben is going to find out. After all what's love without a little bit of pain involved?

A 20,000 word visual novel made for the Menhera VN Jam. Love, eternity, death and time await.

title: Just Keep Looting
description: In Just Keep Looting, play as one of three classes in this 3D turn-based RPG. Fight monsters as you progress deeper and deeper into the dungeon in search of more powerful loot! Designed to play windowed in downtime during other games. Delve into the dungeon and Just Keep Looting!

title: Sonic Frontiers: Holiday Cheer Suit
description:
Bring some holiday spirit to the Starfall Islands with the Holiday Cheer Suit!

The Holiday Cheer Suit can be equipped by accessing the Title Menu and then selecting the EXTRA CONTENT submenu.

title: Scarlet Wolf
description: If you're ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek, then come on in and make yourself at home. Behind the door, endless oppressive corridors, filthy walls, deadly traps, and a ravenous creature eagerly waiting to get up close and personal with you await.

title: Earth Atlantis 2
description: Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by monstrous machine sea creatures. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through intense Bullet Hell battles, harnessing innovative drone systems to conquer over 20 colossal bosses. Explore stunning underwater ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and battle to save humanity. With a vibrant new pixel art style, expansive Metroidvania-style stages, and fresh gameplay mechanics, the game delivers intense SHMUP action, epic sea monster showdowns, breathtaking visuals, and unforgettable undersea journey.

title: Slasher
description: Welcome to an epic adventure like no other. Slasher - a game that promises non-stop action, adventure and excitement! In this game, you play as a fierce and powerful female character, ready to take on the world and all its challenges.

title: Something a Little Super
description:
An interactive novel by Barbara Truelove.

Raising a kid ain't easy. Throw super powers into the mix and well... that's where the real fun begins.

Something a Little Super is a 20,000 word interactive story about adopting and raising a child with super powers. Your choices will shape them into the person they'll become (hero, villain, or something else...)

title: Mine From Here
description: Avoid mine and find route to develop this new land of opportunity! MINE FROM HERE is a 2D rouge-like puzzle game inspired by minesweeper. Scan the map, find the mine, get item and drive your rover to escape from mindfield!

title: Quantum of Hope
description: Quantum of Hope is an action-packed Twin-Stick shooter game set on Earth overrun by aliens. Use your Fabricator and different weapons to shoot your way through alien swarms to rescue mysterious Princess in distress.

title: Crusader Kings III: Wandering Nobles
description: Learn more about the world and put this knowledge to productive use in Wandering Nobles, a new event pack for Crusader Kings III. Develop your character through a new Wandering Lifestyle option, designed for less sedentary people. New events will happen to characters as they travel, opening new story-telling possibilities.

title: Crusader Kings III: Crowns of the World
description: Step into history’s spotlight with a collection of new crowns, hairstyles and beards in Crowns of the World. What will your royal image be like?

title: Crusader Kings III: All Under Heaven
description: With All Under Heaven, the vast and dynamic history of Asia comes to life. Claim the Mandate, unite your people, and shape the future of empires in this monumental expansion for Crusader Kings III.

title: Crusader Kings III: Chapter IV
description: From the crowning glory of Crowns of the World to the sweeping narratives of Khans of the Steppe, Coronations and All Under Heaven, Chapter IV offers a comprehensive journey through the diverse and dynamic world of Crusader Kings III.

title: Crusader Kings III: Coronations
description: Mark your ascension to power with Coronations by hosting grand ceremonies that inspire awe and respect in your subjects and neighbors. How will your crowning moment define your reign?

title: Nothing Strange Here
description:
Nothing Strange Here is a single-player open-world adventure game with mystery and slice-of-life elements. Set in the small town of Larcenest Gap, players take on the role of a reporter exploring the community, documenting strange events, and interacting with townsfolk.

The game combines narrative discovery with photography and journaling mechanics. Players can photograph scenes, collect evidence, and publish their findings in a customizable in-game journal. NPCs follow daily routines, and the world changes based on the player's actions and the time of day. Additional features include hidden collectibles, such as stickers and gnomes, and dynamic events that encourage exploration and investigation.

title: Christa & Tonyo
description: A married couple have to deal with an unexpected financial struggle caused by the husband's workplace accident. The wife desperately searches for a "sugar daddy" to fix their financial problems. What could go wrong?!

title: AlterLife
description:
Get up in the morning, go to work, cook your meals, play with your friends - just live! AlterLife is a powerful virtual life simulator where you can make your biggest dreams come true!

Create your avatar from scratch, matching every element of its appearance and personality, and then start your new life in AlterLife. Choose from hundreds of different hairstyles, shapes of nose, mouth, eyes and other physical features. The most comprehensive character editor on the market will even let you recreate yourself and your friends in a virtual environment. Then use the money you've given on start, to buy an apartment or a house in the suburbs and lead your life the way you've always dreamed of it!

In AlterLife you are only limited by your own imagination. If you want, you can lead a peaceful life, getting up in the morning, going to work, and meeting with friends after hours. Maybe you will even find the love of your life here? But nothing stands in the way of becoming a fashion, rock or movie star - you can choose from dozens of different career paths to see how your life could have turned out if you made completely different choices in the past!

AlterLife also offers an extensive interior editor! Enlarge your apartment or house for yourself or because your family is getting bigger. Buy new furniture, household appliances, wallpapers, panelling, floors and many more. You have tens of thousands of items at your disposal, which will allow you to build
an apartment of your dreams. All you have to do is make money to afford them! After all, AlterLife
is a real life simulation game, so not everything comes easy and you have to earn some luxuries.

title: Wret
description:
Five Days of Dread
A tightly paced horror experience that escalates each day.

No Dialogue. No Escape.
The story unfolds purely through visuals, sound, and space — no text, no voice, no guidance.

PSX-Inspired Visuals
Low-resolution textures and unsettling retro environments amplify the unease.

Atmospheric Psychological Horror
No chases. No combat. Just presence, tension, and the terror of being watched.

title: Farming Simulator 25: New Holland CR11 Gold Edition
description: Get the unique New Holland CR 11 Gold Edition and operate one of the flagship combine harvesters of the renowned machine manufacturer.

title: Scratchers
description: Scratchers is an incremental game where you scratch cards to earn cash, unlock upgrades, and hire little scratchers to do the scratching for you. Discover rare cards, and optimize your earnings as you climb to scratcher supremacy!

title: Farming Simulator 25: Highlands Fishing Expansion
description:
This Farm is Your Farm!

Build a farm along winding rivers and historic grain elevators in North America, surrounded by ponds in Central Europe, or in a lush East Asian landscape filled with rice paddies near a neon-lit port city. Grow crops, tend to animals, practice forestry, and manage an empire of business ventures with farm shops, productions, and constructions!

title: The Goblin Tavern
description: You are a fallen hero. Beneath your feet lies a shattered world, cursed by a grieving wizard. Alone in this god-forsaken land, you will find refuge in a tavern, to rebuild, gather outcasts, and plot your path through the darkness. Will you face your fate with courage, or repeat the sins of the past?

title: Farming Simulator 25: Highlands Fishing Edition
description: Console Edition bundle including Farming Simulator 25, MacDon pack, and Highlands Fishing Expansion

title: Snapto
description: SNAPto is a challenging Sokoban-Style puzzle exploration game centred around a single snapping mechanic. Players are given a series of dense and deceptively simple puzzles with increasing difficulty. Each puzzle is unique in introducing a principle of the game's core mechanics and acts as a bridge to lead the Player to new places. The player is asked to discover the rules and history of this world, but is never certain of what is true.

title: Ikebana
description: A logic puzzle game about arranging flowers and observing their locations.

title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

title: Factories in Factories in Factories
description: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

title: Slivercall
description: Silvercall​​ – A retro action-platformer RPG. Play as an amnesiac adventurer, battling through perilous terrain and collecting Memory Crystals to uncover your past and your lover's dark transformation into the "Saintess".

title: BloomKeeper
description: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.

title: Spores of Fortune
description: Learn about REAL mushrooms and how to identify them, in this cozy mushroom picking Sim! Also manage your shop and sell them to the local folk.

title: Luigi's Mansion: First-Person Optimized
description: A simple modification aimed to optimize the game-play of Luigi’s Mansion to accommodate a first-person perspective, made possible using an Action Replay code by Laser Crusader. This novelty hack makes the game fully playable through the eyes of Luigi, transforming the GameCube classic into an unusual sort of FPS; one focused on hunting ghosts in a spooky mansion, presented as a lighthearted adventure with some eerie undertones.

title: Domini
description: DOMiNi is a roguelike puzzle game that combines strategic placement of dominoes with a minimalist dungeon crawler experience. Connect dominoes to build paths, collect loot, and avoid deadly monsters as you progress through an increasingly challenging dungeon.

title: The Lust Voyage
description: Sir Richard and his wife flee Ertonbury from the citizens that they angered, aboard a sketchy fishing vessel with a suspicious captain... Will they make it to safety the same?

title: Arcane Dice Wars: Gacha Date
description: "Arcane Dice Wars: Gacha Date!" is a fluffy spinoff game where you get a second chance at love with some of the series' most popular characters!

title: Pinball Arcade: Phantom of the Opera
Pinball Arcade: Tales of the Arabian Nights
Pinball Arcade: Ripley’s Believe It or Not!
Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.1 - The Impending Crash of Waves
description:
Version 2.1 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Yuzuha and Alice
• New Main Story Quest: The Impending Crash of Waves
• New outfits
• New summer events
• ...and more!

title: Lone Labyrinth
description: A fantasy turn-based strategy game where your choices shape your party dynamic and morality

title: ShellMobile: Titan Rampart
description: On the cosmic frontier, humanity has fought alien species for a century. As traditional defenses fall to new-gen alien mechs, tech giant ShellMobile—human-centered at its core—kindles new hope via breakthroughs in extraterrestrial titanium ore research.

title: Axel Quest
description: A 2D action-adventure game with Metroidvania elements. Explore, fight monsters, collect equipment, unlock new paths, and challenge bosses in a handcrafted pixel-art world inspired by retro classics.

title: Synth Riders: Red Hot Chili Peppers - "Give It Away"
description: Add Red Hot Chili Peppers - "Give It Away" to your library!Music that rips you out of your seat — that's Rock from the 1990s! The hard driving riffs and high energy lyrics that defined a decade are now attacking the rails in Synth Riders.

title: Synth Riders: Radiohead - "Creep"
description: Add Radiohead - "Creep" to your library!Music that rips you out of your seat — that's Rock from the 1990s! The hard driving riffs and high energy lyrics that defined a decade are now attacking the rails in Synth Riders.

title: Lumber Valley
description: Lumber Valley is a logging simulation game where you build and grow a logging business. Cut wood, process materials, and complete contracts to expand your operations. Unlock upgrades, automate production, and explore a quarry to uncover valuable resources while overcoming various challenges.

title: Tradewake
description: Captain a 1920s cargo boat, trading goods between diverse ports, from the arctic to tropical islands. Buy low, sell high, upgrade your vessel, and navigate a vast ocean. Explore new routes, and grow your trade network to build a fortune or lose it to the ocean floor.

title: Pinball Arcade: Creature from the Black Lagoon
Pinball Arcade: Red & Ted's Road Show
Pinball Arcade: Big Buck Hunter Pro
Pinball Arcade: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons
Pinball Arcade: Al’s Garage Band Goes on a World Tour
Assault on Hardblood Hotel
description:
Three assassins from an underground syndicate raise hell inside the Hartblood Hotel. Their mission: To huntdown the owner. Follow orders as given. Do not question authority.

A timer has been set for you to die over and over. Every 10 seconds, a new curse to bear. Don’t get sloppy now; it’s bad for the skin.

Kill everyone as fast as you can and avoid the burden of The Seal.

And may God have mercy on their souls.

title: Pinball Arcade: Star Trek Vengeance Premium
Adorable Adventures
description: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

title: Low_Signal
description: In this mysterious first-person adventure, explore an abandoned 90's Asian slum with the help of various abilities, collect documents and objects to uncover the fate of its former inhabitants and interact with a strange Altar to unveil the story of this unique place.

title: OlliOlli World: Close Encounter Skate Deck
description: OlliOlli World is a bold new skateboarding action-platformer that’s bursting with personality. Flip and flow through the vivid and vibrant world of Radlandia, meeting colorful characters as you grind, trick, and air your way to discover the mystical skate gods on your quest for Gnarvana.

title: Garden of Butterflies
description: The game Garden of Butterflies follows Rafaela on a journey of personal growth as she helps nature and her friends. Shrinking down and exploring her garden from a tiny perspective, she embarks on a unique visual and narrative experience, showing that everyone has the potential for great change.

title: Anomaly Observer
description: Anomaly Observer is a horror observation game where you become CCTV operator watching paranormal footage. Watch your surroundings closely and report any suspicious activity! Nobody knows what awaits you in your next shift!

title: Infinity Nikki: Blue Tears Season
description:
Blue Tears, Blue Tears, secrets kept, in guarded years.

Upstream I drift, soft and light,
to yesterday's fading plight...

Version 1.7 of Infinity Nikki "Blue Tears Season" launches on July 7!

Get ready for new events, a new dungeon... and so much more! Stylists, don't miss out on the excitement—dive in and explore!

title: Mommy-Goddess of Unconditional Love ~Wow, You Sure Gave It Your All Out There!~
description: "...A-Are you a... goddess...?" The words just slip out from me. "I'm the Goddess of Healing. I have come to this world to lift you from despair."

title: Rocket Wrestling Entertainment
description: Throw it down in the newest sport league of 2073: Rocket Wrestling Entertainment. Pelt your foes with a barrage of rockets and powerful takedowns to stand on top!

title: Wicked Little Witch
description: A city witch lost in the woods, face enemies both familiar and strange. In this Action Roguelite, unlock new characters, collect spells, and build your own playstyle and uncover the truth.

title: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite
description: Lead a platoon of WWII tanks in this immersive TPP and FPP game. Engage in realistic, tactical combat across historic battlefields. Play through campaign or challenge yourself in skirmish mode as either German or US forces.

title: Totto's Magic Soup
description: An item-mixing RPG filled with furry creatures

title: Tired of Being the Hero
description: As a retired hero, lead and train your villagers to stand against relentless monster attacks. Assign roles, motivate your team, upgrade townsfolk, unlock powerful abilities, and adapt your strategy to outlast the next assault. TBH is a first-person fantasy action RPG with a strategy twist.

title: Stabjack
description: A combination of Roguelike Deckbuilder and comic noir tragedy. Stabjack plunges you into a dark, gritty, demon-infested world, with gameplay that builds on the familiar concepts of Blackjack. Can a talking knife help you solve your wife’s murder, or is this just the beginning of your descent into madness?

title: 7 Days to Die: The Desert Armor Set
description:
A hot weather outfit for hot players, grab this Desert Armor Set to sweat in style.
This armor set’s look can be applied to both male and female characters.
This item changes the appearance of your character. It does not affect stats or abilities.
This cosmetic armor set can be applied in the "Cosmetic" screen to override your equipped armor's appearance.

title: 7 Days to Die: The Marauder Armor Set
description:
Be the battle hardened tank no one dares to challenge in this awesome Marauder Armor Set.
This armor set’s look can be applied to both male and female characters.
This item changes the appearance of your character. It does not affect stats or abilities.
This cosmetic armor set can be applied in the "Cosmetic" screen to override your equipped armor's appearance.

title: 7 Days to Die: The Hoarder Armor Set
description:
Become the ultimate pack rat with this new in-game Hoarder Armor Set.
This armor set’s look can be applied to both male and female characters.
This item changes the appearance of your character. It does not affect stats or abilities.
This cosmetic armor set can be applied in the "Cosmetic" screen to override your equipped armor's appearance.

title: Eden's Inferno
description: Descend through Heaven and Hell in search of the one person who made you feel.

title: Batalla de Arquitectos
description: Compete to create a better circuit than your opponent's and thus be able to reach the goal earlier.

title: Warframe: Gunblade Battlekit
description:
Let no enemy stand against you with the Redeemer Gunblade while you add the radiant Opula Customizations to your Arsenal for a limited time.

Gunblade Battlekit features:
- Redeemer
- Pyra Opula Syandana
- Pyra Opula Sugatra
- High Noon Stance Mod
- 3-Day Affinity Booster

title: Is this a Game yet?
description: Is this a Game yet? is a blank slate that players cooperatively design. Starting with just a button, you compete every week for 5 spots on a global leaderboard to have your idea implemented in the next update live on stream.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDM Airport
description: Munich Airport, located 28.5 km northeast of Munich, is Germany's second busiest and a major hub for Lufthansa. It features two main terminals, extensive cargo and maintenance facilities, and handles wide-body aircraft like the Airbus A380.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KBOS Airport
description: IATA: BOS, ICAO: KBOS, FAA LID: BOS - main international airport serving the city of Boston. KBOS has six runways and four terminals (A, B, C and E). On average Boston experiences 950 aircraft movements each day, keeping you pretty busy in your controller seat!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KBNA Airport
description: Control the sky on KBNA Nashville airport - Tower! Simulator 3. Detailed custom buildings with highly detailed texturesAirport taxi signsGround markingsDynamic lighting, light sources individually placed, for a spectacular night view experience.

title: 44 Hidden Naomis
description: Embark on an enchanting journey to discover hidden Naomis scattered throughout meticulously crafted scenes. Can you find them all? This cozy hidden objects game challenges your attention to detail and perceptiveness. Capture the simple fun!

title: Pengicitis The Game
description: Pengicitis The Game is the officially licensed game about a day in the life of world famous influencer Pengicitis and his journey throughout the meaning of life.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: LSZH Airport
description: Zürich Airport (IATA: ZRH, ICAO: LSZH) FeelThere brings you the first European airport add-on for Tower! Simulator 3. Nicely detailed remake of the bustling international airport in Switzerland.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KAUS Airport
description: Austin airport is the third busiest in Texas, and the 28th busiest in the US. As of 2023, total of 18741 flights passed through Austin airport.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDF Airport
description: IATA: FRA ; ICAO: EDDF - A major international airport located in Frankfurt, the fifth-largest city of Germany, main hub for Lufthansa. FRA is the busiest airport by passenger traffic in Germany as well as the 4th busiest in Europe, so be prepared to control some busy days here!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KSFO Airport
description: KSFO - A major international airport and gateway to a lot of international destinations. This airport is the second busiest in CA after Los Angeles Airport and among the top 10 busiest airports in the U.S. Beautifully modelled and very unique tower building and surroundings, terminals.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KATL Airport
description: The busiest airport in the world, ATL shuttles people and goods across the nation and around the globe, on average, there are 2,700 arrivals and departures daily on five parallel runways. This airport has the tallest air traffic control tower in North America and is the fourth tallest in the world.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EHAM Airport
description: Amsterdam airport appears in the top 5 airports in Europe in terms of passenger volume and number of flights. Check out the main airport in the Netherlands with Tower! Simulator 3 and challenge yourself with its 6 runways.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KSLC Airport
description: SLC for Tower! Sim 3 is a joint military/public airport, the 21st busiest airport in the United States with four runways, three air carrier runways and one general aviation runway. The airport complex is made up of one terminal, two concourses and 63 gates.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: Miyo
description: MIYO transforms your Tower! Simulator 3 sessions by giving you unprecedented control over visuals and weather alike. Tweak the lighting for stunning sunrise ops, or push your controlling skills with heavy rain and lower vis. With MIYO, the sky is no longer the limit—it’s whatever you want it to be.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KTUS Airport
description: Tucson International Airport ICAO: KTUS, FAA LID: TUS is a large civil-military airport in Arizona, United States. With 2 runways, 3 concourses and endless controlling!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: CYYZ Airport
description: Canada's busiest airport is a fine addition toy our Tower! catalog. By size it is one of the biggest also, five main runways and 30 taxiways will give you some challenge too.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KRIC Airport
description: [KRIC] airport is the busiest one in central Virginia and also one of the most modern. The "Open V" runway configuration can be keeping you in a steadily busy gameplay. The best little big airport you'll ever have.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KDEN Airport
description: Denver International airport arrives to Tower! Simulator 3 air traffic control DLC catalog, as one of the largest in the Western United States with its magnificent views of the Rocky Mountains, award-winning architecture. Set your schedules and enjoy controlling the second biggest airport on earth.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KJFK Airport
description: Main international airport serving New York City [KJFK] for Tower! Simulator 3 air traffic control game is the busiest international gateway into North America with four runways located on the southwestern shore of Long Island.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KPHL Airport
description: ICAO: KPHL | Philadelphia Airport is the sixth busiest airport in Pennsylvania. There are four separate runways at PHL, making this a busy airport to control and practice on like JFK.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KSEA Airport
description: IATA: SEA, ICAO: KSEA | Seattle-Tacoma International Airport is the primary airport serving Seattle and Tacoma, Washington, one of the fastest growing large hub airports in the U.S. KSEA has 115 gates over four concourses and has two satellite terminals.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KCLE Airport
description: Cleveland Hopkins International Airport (KCLE) is a significant commercial airport, being the largest and busiest airport in the state, developed by FeelThere for Tower! Simulator 3.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KPVD Airport
description: PVD airport for Tower! Simulator 3 is a mid-sized airport in Rhode Island, United States, located six miles south of Providence. With 22 gates and 2 runways, enough traffic to keep you busy, yet still relaxed controlling this airport.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KSAN Airport
description: Flying into San Diego Airport for Tower! Simulator 3, the busiest single-runway airport. Originally known as Gibbs Field, opened in 1937. A state-of-the-art terminal inspired by the people and places to love about San Diego.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KIAD Airport
description: IAD, ICAO: KIAD, FAA LID: IAD - It is the largest and busiest airport in the Washington area. Each year, over 23 million passengers use Dulles. More than 60,000 people fly out of Dulles daily to over 125 places around the world.

title: Wolf and The Warren
description: Sam Bane is travelling cross country to start her new job. But, disaster! Her car broke down and she's been stranded in the woods. As luck would have it, Sam's stumbled across the forest's best kept secret...A quaint little hotel called ‘The Warren’ and it's owner Kylie.

title: The Island of Crossed Destinies
description: A Pentiment-like set in 19th-century Malaysia, featuring pirates, East Indiamen, headhunters, a locked-room murder mystery, a blade of meteoric ore, a tarot deck, a mountain of light, and a tiger. It’s time to put your thinking cap on; as for those voices in your head – probably best to ignore them.

title: Overdrive Warfare: Premium Edition
description:
Overdrive Warfare just got even better. Purchase the Premium Edition to unlock the following exclusive in-game content:
- 2 6v6 maps (Trench & Goal)
- 4 weapon camos (Poly, Envy, Spirit & Abstract)
- Ranked Play

title: Climbing Gym Simulator
description: Run your own climbing gym in this first-person management game. Build walls, order holds, set routes, and expand your facility - all while keeping your climbers happy and preferably alive. Developed by a solo developer and passionate climber, this game lets you unleash your creativity and establish the ultimate climbing empire.

title: Shelltered
description: Shelltered is a short and Difficult Precision Platformer, inspired by Dream-Exploration games and a world depicted through the eyes of two young birds who's about to leave the comfort of their shelter.

title: Dilemma: The Game
description: In this 2D, Point and Click, choose-your-own-adventure experience. You will pick a way to respond to dilemmas .Answer non-sensical thought questions and unearth what happens from your choices.

title: Death and Tactics
description: A post-apocalyptic turn-based strategy game where death is permanent and every decision counts. Experience unique events based on how you play, sell the organs of party members you don't like, transform your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

title: Solitaire Battle
description: Slay your enemies by playing solitaire, synergize your card-powered attacks and abilities, then break the game and become the best to ever Solitaire Battle in this roguelike deckbuilding autobattler!

title: Walthros
description:
Everyone's lived the old RPG standard of gathering crystals and fighting mysterious monsters, but have you ever done it... as a fish? Bob Surlaw and a whole host of mutants embark on a quest to save the world. Features 9+ hours of gameplay.

First released on DOS in 2002 and made with the OHRRPGCE engine, Walthros is back for a whole new generation of players! Featuring its original 8bit-styled graphics and storyline, Walthros has been enhanced with higher quality music and touched up dialogue.

Walthros is an alien planet inhabited by lifeforms that resemble animals from Earth. At some distant point in the planet's history, there was a great conflict that ended when a legendary hero unleashed a power that destroyed most of the known world. Thousands of years later, life has largely recovered. Unfortunately, old conflicts have been reborn, and war continues to rage. Players take the role of Bob Surlaw, a Walthrosian Fish who makes a living as an explorer of ancient ruins. His journey begins when he leaves his home one morning to explore a nearby shrine that has long been sealed. Inside, he finds an angry spirit and a piece of an ancient relic.

title: Beggar to Emperor
description: Beggar to Emperor is a strategic simulation RPG set in the fictional medieval continent of Legia, where you begin as a penniless beggar and shape your own destiny through countless choices and experiences.

title: System Shock: Rewired
description: System Shock: Rewired is the very first full fan made singleplayer campaign for the original System Shock in over 24 years! 3 brand new levels with branching paths, 4 new cyberspace sections, new puzzles, brand new soundtrack by SpeedySPCFan, new fully voiced audiologs, new on-screen text and so much more awaits in the now dark corridors of the hospital ship UNN Bismarck. Playable with all existing versions of System Shock (Enhanced Edition recommended). What are you waiting for? SHODAN waits for your return! And she is eager to end your - in her opinion - useless existence.

title: Evolized
description: Evolve from a single cell into the ultimate lifeform in this Adventure ARPG on the planet Eiegôr. Choose among three biological kingdoms, consume for genetic material, and unlock mutations to transform your abilities and appearance. Adapt biomes and become the apex creature of an evolving world.

title: 75 Demons
description: A roguelike demonic combat game with deck-building where you must predict your enemy's moves to land your blows. Fast-paced combat, numerous items and weapons to unleash powerful attacks, and unique effects that will turn the battle in your favor.

title: Dai Datsugoku! Hell chama Prison no Yabou
Pintern
description: Pintern is a pinball-based deckbuilding roguelike game. Launch the ball to collect coins, combine various bumpers and tokens to create synergies, and submit your performance to avoid getting fired and aim for full-time employment!

title: Stories of Somnia
description: Unravel a story-rich adventure blending a turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics. Use spells to grapple across gaps, uncover hidden routes, and combine abilities with powerful Dreamkin companions to overcome a world consumed by Gloam.

title: Dreamrealm's Tower of Despair
description:
Dreamrealm's Tower of Despair is a first person RPG whose action happens inside a haunted tower where dungeon-crawler mechanics meet a light but disturbing horror ambience. The story revolves around a knight of light that embarks onto a quest to fight an evil vampire that deceives his followers into blood rituals and sacrifices for his own gain.

Throughout the tower, you'll have to gather more and more clues and lore pieces to build evidence against this hellish envoy. Moreso, important heirlooms of your creed will be found at some point to give you advantage against Malgrym's acolytes, and even against himself.

At times, you'll get hints about what's happening from the victims themselves, even more their riddles or level puzzles will take you further in progression. Using your Journal and the ability to search for hidden clues will be your utmost aid throughout this tower.

The light horror ambience is combined with combat scenes to immerse you in this parallel world from within the Dreamrealm Universe where the Light takes its toll against the corrupted nightmares affecting the veil of sleep.

title: The Deathmind
description: The Deathmind is a psychological horror game set in a forgotten village shrouded in mystery and silence. Trapped within his own fractured mind, Ethan searches for his missing wife, Clara, by solving environmental puzzles and following haunting memories.

title: Inside the Crow's Nest
description: Inside the Crow's Nest is a game inspired by classic survival horror. Explore an ancient monastery, face the terrors hidden within its corridors, and search for a way to escape. Will you survive... or be hunted?

title: Baldi's Basics: Encounter Doors
description: Baldi's Basics: Encounter Doors is a tense crossover game that blends the fear-inducing world of Baldi's Basics with the puzzle-filled challenge of Doors. Explore 100 procedurally generated rooms, each with unique puzzles and obstacles, while trying to avoid Baldi and his relentless friends. Solve the challenges, unlock new doors, and escape before they catch you!

title: Biggest Piano
description: A short comedic horror adventure where you investigate the mystery of a piano that won’t stop growing.

title: Serpent at the Vernissage
description: An open-world adventure set in an abandoned island paradise, where nothing is quite what it seems. Explore forgotten villas, sentient art pieces and sunken opera houses. And find your way back home before the archipelago swallows you whole.

title: Hazard Versus
description: Hazard Versus is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter. Play with your friends! Play with your enemies! Play with anyone!

title: Grow a Girlfriend
description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or… don't ;)

title: PyramidValley: Reborn
description: ​Immerse yourself in the captivating world of ancient Egypt with PyramidValley: Reborn, a compelling management game that invites you to build and develop your own pharaonic city. Play as iconic figures such as Cleopatra, and construct legendary monuments like majestic pyramids, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, and the Great Sphinx.​

title: Narco Express
description:
Narco Express is a co-op smuggling simulator set in the skies over Mexico.
Players take on the role of low-level couriers flying unstable, heavily modified aircraft to transport illegal cargo across dangerous territories. Designed for solo or up to four-player online co-op, the game features physics-based flight mechanics, aircraft customization, patrol avoidance and a variety of high-risk delivery missions. With an emphasis on coordination, improvisation, and environmental hazards.

title: American Truck Simulator: Volvo Construction Equipment
description:
The Volvo Construction Equipment DLC includes 5 different branded construction machinery from Volvo CE's line-up for drivers to haul and deliver across the USA.
This DLC includes:
A25G (Articulated Hauler)
SD160B (Soil Compactor)
EC220E (Crawler Excavator)
EW240E Material Handler (Excavator)
L250H (Wheel Loader)
Rock Bucket Volvo SPN P T SEG
Wheels with Volvo Rims

title: American Truck Simulator: Mack Pinnacle
description: The Mack Pinnacle combines power and reliability with modern technology and a classic design. A legendary workhorse, ready to take on any job. Pinnacle’s lightweight-yet-strong frame is built for heavy loads, steep grades, and long hauls.

title: American Truck Simulator: Freightliner Cascadia (The Fifth Generation)
description: The Fifth Generation Cascadia is the most advanced on-highway truck Freightliner has ever offered, featuring a cutting edge aerodynamic package with chassis fairings, skirts, cabin extenders, roof fairings, front wheel closeouts and a new aerodynamic hood.

title: We are the Literature Club
description: This story was created to continue on the story of the Literature Club, and to give the girls the ending that they deserved, as well as the closure that the player thought they would never get.Set in an alternate canon, where the meddlings of the class president never took place, We are the Literature Club carries on the story by laying a new foundation in storytelling, eventually culminating in the revival of the Literature Club for a new era.With a small cast of new characters, and familiar ones, We are the Literature Club sets the stage for an enjoyable "re-write" of the world of Doki Doki Literature Club, with a slight twist in an alternate timeline.After all that happened; are you really willing to let it end there?"

title: Logic Bombs
description: Logic Bombs is a logic puzzle game where you use deductive reasoning to tackle 160 puzzles about bombs. The same core rules apply to every puzzle so prepare to delve deeper into a realm of pure logic where your understanding will be put to the test.

description: A fun rage platform game where you ascend a farm as a golf ball!

description:
Fujita Anju, an average college student, finds herself trapped in an unfamiliar location with several other people. As their memory loss as well as the ominous situation indicates that something's going wrong, a weird cubic creature named Dokuroku appears with the intention to hack into their Prisms, a daily-use microship implanted in the body at birth, and enroll them in a thrilling,
deadly adventure.

Beautiful autumn pictures

Puzzles of monkeys & apes!
