description:
Submission is originally one of twelve games that made up the third Dread X Collection.

You basically wander around a farm and help Potato the Donkey collect apples, meet some of his friends, and that's really pretty much it.

title: The Esoteric Archive
description: Those with a thirst for knowledge, and an understanding of the weavings, may find themselves in a library like no other. A deep perseverance and an amount of aimless wandering is required to find this place, but should you find it, you would surely find all the answers you seek. For this Esoteric Archive is vast, possibly endless, and filled with knowledge not meant for mankind. However, you have need of such knowledge, don’t you. Otherwise, why would you have come to such a place?

title: I Wanna Start a Party
description: A fan-game of I Wanna Be The Guy based on the Mario Party series, with minigames and characters based on both games, plus IWBTG's various fan-games and community -in-jokes. Play alone or with friends with fully functional 4 player online, with boards based on various video games, from popular to obscure.

title: Crash Bandicoot: Respun
description: A new Crash Bandicoot fangame has been released by ‪RS Project‬. It’s called Crash Bandiocot: Respun and it plays like the original PS1 games.

title: .G
description: Avoid meteorites and survive until the end.

title: Eggconsole Zanac EX MSX2
description: The Zanac battle, which was supposed to have ended, was not over. To suppress the reactivated organic intelligence, Zanac takes flight once again!

title: House Fighters: Total Mess
description: House Fighters: Total Mess is a PvE aerial arcade shooter where toy planes battle in everyday spaces. Engage in fast-paced dogfights in this nostalgia-filled world, take on clever foes, and fight to save your fellow toy friends!

title: Make it! Choco Banana
description:
It's time for a cute choco banana-making challenge!
Make as many as you can, and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Mystery Hotel: Hidden Objects
description: Solve the riddle of the mysterious murder at the Hotel Noir

title: Idle Life: An Idle Game
description: A brutally efficient idle game where every resource counts. Build, unlock, and optimize in a game made for grinders, min-maxers, and resource maniacs.

title: Capsule Hero
description: This is a minimalist challenge game based on a physics engine. Players control a capsule-shaped character, keep balance on a narrow wooden board, and rely on skills and patience to gradually walk out of the dark room. Every step is a challenge, and every failure will bring great frustration.

title: The Last Mullu
description: The Last Mullu combines the strategy of tower building with the replayability and intensity of roguelikes. Pick a companion and fight for survival in this mountainous and coastal 2D pixel art world.

title: Full Contact
description: Full Contact is a competitive, fast-paced, sumo slam-fest that always draws a crowd. Pick up and play in a one-on-one battle against your friends! Hype up the audience, use your stylish special moves, and knock your buddies out of the ring to be crowned champion.

title: Ancient Archer
description: Defend the essence of the universe from a horde of monsters using the power of the witch's magic and the accuracy of a brave archer. All in a psychedelic, original audiovisual setting inspired by heroic fantasy and more...

title: Fear Below Zero
description: Survive an isolated Antarctic research station as you hide from an ancient creature, scavenge for parts, and repair communications to call for rescue.

title: Seven Squad
description: Roguelike... but this time, with a squad of heroes. In 7 Squad, you’re not the lone hero anymore. You begin with one cheerful champion and gradually assemble a squad of up to seven charming, weird, and wildly different heroes—each with unique powers and personality.

title: Death Frame
description: Explore a haunted mansion, uncover a killers madness, and enter surreal paintings to relive the twisted mind of a killer. Danger and mystery are lurking behind the screaming walls of this fascinating and frightening horror adventure.

title: Zero Pixel Dawn
description: Scavenge, craft, and fight to survive in a post-pixel apocalypse. Explore dangerous biomes, wield guns and magic, and uncover a hidden truth buried in chaos. Every choice matters. Will you survive?

title: Album Corvus
description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler/roguelike. Fight one-on-one in turn-based combat. Find gear that improves or completely changes your tactics. Delve procedurally generated dungeons where choices matter. Die, upgrade your characters, unlock new skills and experiment with perks to find the best build.

title: Parlor Mall
description: Collect the Proof beneath the Devil's tropical parlor in this Experimental Military Action RPG Horror!

title: Memories Off Sousou: Break Out of My Shell
description: Memories Off Sousou's fandisc.

title: Janitori
description: You are a janitor working on a night shift at the museum. Your task is to clean and restore its exhibits and dusty rooms. Janitori blends satisfying simulation with chilling horror and puzzle-solving mechanics, as you unfold a dark mystery and try not to disturb what lurks in the shadows.

title: Basilica
description: Explore an enchanted cathedral that calls to you. Grow stronger and wiser as you traverse through the ethereal. Collect and create items to navigate its ever-changing floors. Uncover its hidden secrets, and use the ancient wisdom of divinity to guide your way. Lose yourself, or find yourself.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Legacy of Solaris
description: Sonic the Hedgehog: Legacy of Solaris isn't an official game, but rather a major fan-made mod for the infamous "Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)" game, often called "Sonic 06." Its primary goal is to enhance and correct the myriad of issues and bugs that plagued the original title, transforming it into a more playable and definitive version. This extensive community-driven project seeks to redeem the unfulfilled potential of "Sonic 06" by meticulously addressing its notorious flaws. The mod dramatically improves the game's core mechanics, rectifying common glitches, camera problems, collision issues, and character physics, resulting in a much smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. Beyond mere fixes, "Legacy of Solaris" also expands the base game with new missions, levels, and even playable story segments for characters who had limited screen time in the original (such as Blaze, Omega, Knuckles, and Rouge), offering a more comprehensive perspective on the universe and events of "Sonic 06." Furthermore, the mod reintroduces beta elements and concepts that were cut from the final release, providing fans with a glimpse into what the game could have been. While a fan-made endeavor, it also strives to optimize the game for more stable performance, reducing frame drops and, in some cases, delivering visual enhancements. In essence, "Sonic the Hedgehog: Legacy of Solaris" takes the foundational story of "Sonic 06" – involving time travel, Princess Elise, the villain Mephiles, and the entity Solaris – and meticulously refines it into something genuinely complete and fun.

title: Project Nortubel
description:
This is a game about 6 friends lost in strange places and you play as the older ones, who must help guide their younger siblings.

The game is full of different places, characters and stuff to go through while you help our protagonists find their way home.

title: Unholy Souls
description:
You are Josephine Garland, a Knight of the Inquisition. It is your duty to cleanse the land of the blasphemous arcane wielding heretics in the name of the Silent God.

Your work has you hunt down those who would defy the Silent God's will... and mete out bloody justice with a swift stroke of your sword.

Now, the tables have turned. All that you knew is gone in a bizarre twist. You turn from hunter to prey and flee as a curse put upon you sees fabric turn to flesh and bay lustily for your blood.

Is this a test from the Silent God? A curse formed from your own bloodstained hands? Will you ever escape this theatre of nightmares?

title: Pulsebreaker
description: Pulsebreaker is a classic survival horror game. Explore environments, collect resources, and fight zombies. Manage your inventory, solve light puzzles, and survive with limited supplies. Includes melee and ranged combat. Single-player only.

title: DeckTerra
description: A Medieval 4X Deckbuilder. Lead a kingdom as you build your deck to conquer the map and expand your rule. Develop your technology through the middle ages to improve your army of knights and keep your peasants happy. Develop your trade, religion, science, and military to conquer the continent.

title: Stock Fighter
description: Wall Street meets street fighting! Engage in arcade-style trade duels where you buy low, sell high to drive your opponent into bankruptcy.

title: Touhou Kouzougi: Flickerframe Shutter Festival
description: A fan-made celebration of Touhou's creative spirit! When a suspicious festival erupts, Aya must photograph spellcards, unlock skills, and uncover hidden truths. Packed with loving references to fanworks both old and new, from all around the world!

title: The Best Eroge Ever
description:
A 5 minute eroge parody that covers everything from Jun Maeda to Hyakugojyuuichi. It's the best eroge ever.

* Note that this game is not actually an eroge. It does contain offensive language and content, but nothing 18+

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Tangleroot Gorge
description: Home to many fierce hobgoblin and bugbear tribes, Tangleroot Gorge also contains the infamous Hobgoblin fortress of Splinterskull. This quest pack contains a small explorer area and a short series of dungeons for low level adventurers.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Catacombs
description: The Church of the Silver Flame maintains a Sanctuary for the insane within the boundaries of Stormreach's Market ward. Stormreach denizens refer to it as "The Catacombs". This quest pack contains a short series of undead-themed dungeons for low level and epic adventurers.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Fall of the Night Brigade
description: Help a group of wererats to bring down the Night Brigade, a ruthless gang that's killed and pillaged its way into power. Transform into a rat to explore hidden nooks and crannies and bring the leaders of the Night Brigade to justice in four hand-crafted quests set inside Wheloon Prison.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Necropolis, Part 1
description: A quest pack for low level adventurers with a short series of undead-themed dungeons.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Sorrowdusk Isle
description: An island further to the west of Three-Barrel Cove, Sorrowdusk Isle is shrouded in mystery. Rumors occasionally trickle back to Stormreach of powerful troll and ogre clans, and of cults who worship the Dark Six. But while rumors trickle back to Stormreach, adventurers who leave for Sorrowdusk seem to never return. This quest pack contains an explorer area and a series of short dungeons for low level players.

title: Planetary Sim
description: Minimalistic simulation game, where you are in charge of a growing planet, the population will take shape over time, evolving and learning new ways to explore, grow and communicate.

title: Dream Fallen
description: Dream fallen is a remake of a game launched 13 years ago, beside of the remake it also bring a continuation for the plot changing few aspects of the game like gameplay and puzzles. The game pass in a well know village and the goal is to solve all the tasks and stay alive to tell it.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Hunter and Hunted
description: You've received an invitation from the Master of the Hunt to partake in a series of deadly challenges. This quest pack contains two dungeons for low level characters and an endgame raid for legendary characters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Sentinels of Stormreach
description: Join the Sentinels in swashbuckling adventures as they seek to defeat the pirate scourge. But don’t think you’re safe once the seas are clear: the skies themselves will rain scurvy death—and scurvy undead. Because when this pillaging pirate captain runs short of troops, he just brings back the ones you’ve already disposed of. This quest pack contains a short series of dungeons for low level characters.

title: Fowl Legacy
description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to Hell! It's time for revenge. Explore different landscapes, jump, run and dash past deadly obstacles, search every corner... and defeat the ultimate evil keeping you from returning to your world!

title: Whispers from the Star
description: An interactive story about connection in isolation… where your words are the lifeline of a stranded companion in space. In Whispers from the Star, there are no dialogue trees, just open-ended conversations powered by AI chat, as you stay connected across light years.

title: Raspberry Flavoured
description: A modpack focused on exploring, farming & taking things easy... but not too easy!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Necropolis, Part 2
description: A quest pack with a series of shadow-themed dungeons for mid level adventurers.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Ruins of Threnal
description: House Deneith and House Kundarak have temporarily joined forces to explore and excavate the Abandoned Keep, a settlement deep in the heart of Xen’drik that has lain abandoned for hundreds of years. But the evil that destroyed the settlement 500 years ago still awaits those foolish enough to dig deep enough below the Abandoned Keep.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Dragonblood Prophecy
description: A dragon-themed quest pack featuring two medium level dungeons and two endgame raids. Creatures and beasts of all kinds have rallied to help the Dragons who are wreaking havoc through-out Stormreach. Kor-Kaza has taken control of an ancient giant site with immense power, enough to wash Stormreach into the sea. Breach the site of the ancient people, stop the raging storm, and smite the dragon where it stands.

title: Monarch
description: Play as Monarch, the masked duelist! Aid him on his quest to seek out the strongest fighters of the realm!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Restless Isles
description: The fires of the Twilight Forge glow hot and fierce as plans are made for war across Eberron. This is a small quest pack featuring a maze-like adventure zone, two dungeons, and a raid for mid-level characters.

title: Dokkalfar: The Ballads of Vivi the Dark Elf
description: Step into the boots of Vivi the Dark Elf in this thrilling Action-Adventure RPG, where you will explore mesmerizing worlds, battle fierce monsters using both strength and sorcery, complete quests, uncover secrets, and vanquish true evil!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Path of Inspiration
description: The Inspired rebuilt Stormreach's Old Harbor, but are the Inspired a dream come true or a nightmare? Dare to explore and be taken beneath the Harbor, to a savage island, and into your own mind as you discover the Inspired's terrible secret. A quest pack with several short dungeons for high level adventurers.

title: Frogs Kitchen
description: Embark on a culinary journey like no other in "Frog Kitchen Tycoon: Idle Venture"! Dive into the whimsical world of frogs and kitchens as you traverse through various exotic locations on a planet teeming with flavor and fun.

title: Parallel Convergence
description: A time travel project. A group of students. A cat that eats too much. Can you rewrite fate without losing what matters most?

title: Sunrider Legends Tactics
description: The Sunrider series returns in a new fantasy universe! Both new and returning players can embark on this adventure on the high seas. Become a naval captain in the age of sail and command your fleet in tactical turn-based battles.

title: Pinball Arcade: The Machine - Bride of Pin-Bot️
Pinball Arcade: Elvira and the Party Monsters
Pinball Arcade: Dr. Dude and His Excellent Ray
Dungeons & Dragons Online: The High Road of Shadows
description: Oriphanun Huntsilver's journal, containing a fabled Nether Scroll, has vanished and the Harpers are in need of your help to retrieve it. This is a small quest pack for high level characters with an adventure area and five short quests.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Heart of Madness
description: The insane lords of Xoriat return to Eberron. Tour the Palace of Stone, experience the latest in Mind Flayer fashion, and return to the Sleeping Spell Inn for the ultimate excursion into madness in Terminal Delirium. This is a small quest pack for high level characters with 3 dungeons.

title: Pinball Arcade: El Dorado - City Of Gold
Daniel Linssen's Typing Challenge
description: Learn to type quickly under pressure

title: Celeste: Into The Jungle
description:
Celeste: Into The Jungle is a fan-made collaboration with a campaign-style structure.
It is made with accessibility in mind, aiming to be a solid introduction to what mods can do.
The difficulty should play as a direct step-up from base game 7A.

Contains:
- New mechanics coded and sprited from scratch
- Platforming that will offer a challenge for both beginner and skilled players alike
- Diverse visuals to keep things looking fresh and unique throughout
- Berries and more…
- Fully custom soundtrack (along with some remixes)
- Trees. Lots of them.

title: Pinball Arcade: Frank Thomas' Big Hurt
Score the Fear
description:
"Score the Fear" is a 3D adventure game in which you explore rooms and find hidden ghosts.

The little ghost that appeared before your eyes seems to want to become a proper evil spirit.

He'll scare you in a variety of ways, so rate him on whether he was scary or not.

The story will last up to three days and unfold depending on the results of the scoring.

Can you make this child's wish come true?

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Druid's Deep
description: Fight a strange corruption of nature that has come out of the King's Forest to threaten Eveningstar. Unravel the mystery of its cause in a tale that introduces new allies, new enemies, and troubling riddles that can only be answered down in the very heart of Druid's Deep. This is a quest pack that contains four short dungeons for high level characters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Reaver's Reach
description: This is a quest pack for high level characters with four small explorer areas and four challenging dungeons.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Devil's Gambit
description: Defend Stormreach from demonic invaders! The Devils have come to the city of Stormreach - and they have strange new powers. This quest pack has four adventures: meet a Green Slaad, befriend a bear, battle in the streets of House Cannith and protect Stormreach's most unusual tavern.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Soul Splitter
description: This adventure pack contains six dungeons for high level characters. Explore previously unseen parts of Sharn as you search for an old acquaintance. Uncover a vile conspiracy that seeks to enslave the city’s Warforged, visit Sharn's most luxurious private clubs, and discover the shocking surprise lurking in a mad wizard’s hidden base.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Necropolis, Part 3
description: A quest pack featuring five undead-themed adventures. This collection includes the "Tomb of the Tormented", which requires players to very patiently guide rats through a trap-filled maze.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Peril of the Planar Eyes
description: Help scholars from Morgrave University as they search Xen'drik for the Planar Eyes, mysterious artifacts tied to the power of Eberron's planes. But be careful - the Eyes are also sought by a new and mysterious cult known as the Hidden Hand! This quest pack contains 4 dungeons for medium level and legendary characters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Slice of Life
description: Daily life in Sharn isnt quite as ordinary as some would believe. Take part in a cooking competition, renovate a home, and go on an educational date in this "totally ordinary" series of quests. This adventure pack contains 3 dungeons for high level and legendary characters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Tavern Tales
description: This quest pack contains three dungeons for very low level and legendary characters. Strange things are happening in The King's Forest! Villagers blame a local hag, but it's up to you to discover the far more sinister truth. City workers have discovered a previously unexplored section in the Sunken Sewers. Things are getting tense in the Stormreach Fish Market as local Sahuagin struggle with the Kobold Union for control. Bring order to the chaos in an adventure with multiple possible endings.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Reign of Madness
description: When a mad lord of Xoriat roams free, no one can remain sane. Visit an asylum where sanity is the disease, explore the depths of madness in a visit to Xoriat, turn the great Xorian lords against each other, and free the Tower of the Twelve from the grip of insanity. This adventure pack contains 4 dungeons for high level players.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Grip of the Hidden Hand
description: Collect the rest of the Planar Eyes for Morgrave University for a wealthy benefactor before the Cult of the Hidden Hand meddles in your plans. This adventure pack contains 5 quest dungeons for high level and legendary characters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Trials of the Archons
description: Forge an alliance with the celestial Archons. Battle a Demon swarm, prove your worth to the Archons, learn the secrets of the Devils' leader, and battle an Erinyes. This adventure pack contains 3 dungeons for medium level and legendary characters, and also an endgame raid.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Disciples of Rage
description: The magic that has long protected Stormreach is failing, and a strange plague is sweeping through the city. This adventure pack contains 5 quests for medium level and legendary characters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Dhampir
description: Dhampir are characters with innate connections to death and undeath. Many are half-Vampires one way or another, and have a life-draining bite.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Dhampir Dark Bargainer
description: Dark Bargainers are Dhampir who have made bargains with the Dark Powers. They have connections to the Mists (regardless of their origins) and can manipulate them to their advantage. Dark Bargainer characters have a modified unique racial skill tree. They start with a level in the Warlock class.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Falconry
description:
The Falconry Universal Enhancement Tree gives players the ability to use a Hunting Bird to make coordinated attacks on targets, and hones the character's ability to make pinpoint attacks.

This extra skill tree can be purchased in the in-game store. Falconry can also be obtained for free per character after completing almost every Free Agents quest at the highest difficulty levels, which is incredibly difficult and time consuming.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Harper Agent
description:
This elusive organization of bards, mages and other adventurers are famed for their devotion to the arts, the preservation of history, and maintaining the balance of civilization and nature. Their often-secretive agents know one another by a silver harp pin.

This extra skill tree can be purchased in the in-game store. The Harper universal tree can also be obtained for free per server after completing most Harper Agent patron quests at the highest difficulty levels. These quests are in premium adventure packs and the Shadowfell Conspiracy expansion.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Archetype - Dragon Lord
description:
An add-on available for purchase in the store. You can make a new character that plays as a variant of the fighter class.

Dragon Lords model their tactics after the ferocity of dragons to demoralize and subdue their enemies. They excel in crowd control, defense, and Draconic power.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Archetype - Dragon Disciple
description:
An add-on available for purchase in the store. You can make a new character that plays as a variant of the monk class.

Dragon Disciples are Monks who have devoted themselves to the Way of the Mighty Dragon. While Centered, they can tap into Draconic magic. They gain limited Wisdom-based spellcasting.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Deep Gnome
description:
An arcane illusionist with affinity for the fathomless darks of the earth. Deep Gnome characters have a modified unique racial skill tree. They start with a level in the Wizard class.

Svirfneblin are said to dwell in great cities deep underground. A svirfneblin has wiry, rock-colored skin usually medium brown to brownish gray.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Sun Elf (Morninglord)
description:
A battle-ready Cleric of the great sun-god who wields holy light against the dark in all its wicked forms. Morninglord characters have a modified unique racial skill tree. They start with a level in the Cleric class.

This was originally included with some Shadowfell Conspiracy expansion bundles, but now has to be purchased in the in-game store.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Bladeforged
description:
"You were built for war. With a greatsword in hand, you mercilessly smite your foes and leave behind only a wake of destruction."

Bladeforged characters have a modified unique racial skill tree. They start with a level in the Paladin class. This was originally included with some Shadowfell Conspiracy expansion bundles, but now has to be purchased in the in-game store.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Purple Dragon Knight
description:
A stalwart Fighter, cut loose from active service, who can lead the charge with rallying battle-cry.

Purple Dragon Knight characters have a modified unique racial skill tree. They start with a level in the Fighter class. This was originally included with some Shadowfell Conspiracy expansion bundles, but now has to be purchased in the in-game store.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Shadar-kai
description:
A lethal Rogue who has thrown off the Netherese yoke and draws on innate powers of the Shadowfell to hide and to kill.

Shadar-kai characters have a unique racial skill tree. They start with a level in the Rogue class. This was originally included with some Shadowfell Conspiracy expansion bundles, but now has to be purchased in the in-game store.

title: Majjam
description: Pick your hero and team up with other players to fight back the creeping evil in Majjam, a poetic multiplayer adventure where music is magic. Explore a dynamic environment responding to melody, defeat evil with your magical instrument, and jam in real time with friends to restore what was lost.

title: Tesera
description: Explore cosmic worlds, build unique bases, and battle for resources in this browser-based sandbox game. Interact with players from around the globe

title: Egg Baby
description:
One day, everyone discovers strange eggs, containing a new kind of baby that can adapt and change to its enviroment and how it's raised.

What will your baby grow into?

title: Let Her Go
description: This story-based escape room game guides you through different rooms and realities.All quests form part of one big puzzle to solve for the main character James, creating a growing sense of tension.You'll find his thoughts and feelings illustrated in design and dialogs to fully dive into James' inner

title: Awurda First Wave
description: Awurda First Wave is an action adventure game. The last remaining human is caught in the middle of a war to save the world from evil creatures. Defeat your enemies with fast and exciting fighting mechanics. Overcome various obstacles and defeat difficult enemies to advance to the next levels.

title: Hack Back
description: Breach networks, plant malware, steal secrets, and outsmart digital defenses in a real-time strategy campaign that teaches cybersecurity through immersive, hands-on gameplay—no experience or skills needed!

title: Redact
description: A short free game, where you're listening or not affects your path of a single press of a button.

title: Harmonic Convergence
description: Master the rhythm of combat in this roguelite where attacks must hit on beat! Match inputs to music as you battle through conspiracy hotspots like Government Bases, Bimini Road, and alien worlds. Uncover artifacts, craft game-breaking builds, and uncover the truth behind Harmonic Convergence.

title: 5 Minutes Until Self-Destruction
description: The self-destruction sequence has been activated. You have 5 minutes to solve your way out of a high-stakes, escape room-style disaster.

title: StacKit
description: Stackit is a turn-based puzzle of pure strategy. Load your gun in a precise order before you fight—this is your 'Stack'. Once in combat, your firing sequence is locked. Use Fire to strip armor, then hit with Corrosion to weaken foes and boost all other damage.

title: Burdock 2
description: Burdock 2 is a single-player action-horror game. Explore a lost place in a post-apocalyptic future, and help the main character's friends, or leave everyone behind and embark on the path of darkness. Find all the clues and open the way to the passage. Solve puzzles and do not lose your composure.

title: Ghost Infinite Labyrinth
description: You have wandered into a Japanese labyrinth where ghosts lurk. Escape from this strange space while running away from the ghosts.

title: Infected Mushroom Pinball
description: Wether you´re a music lover, a hardcore pinball fan or just curious about pushing boundaries of virtual experiences, Infected Mushroom Pinball is your gateway to next-level audiovisual immersion, where the line between real and virtual blurs.

title: Chess Mess
description: The chess pieces you know, but with an addictive, puzzle game twist! Get the highest score possible while staying ready to capture the King. Featuring daily challenges, rogue-like elements, and more!

title: Warehouse Job
description: A short horror game where you sort shipping containers in a warehouse.

title: Light Night Street
description: A new type of bullet hell action game is born! Bounce back the barrage of shouts with your shield and witness the moment bullet hell games go from "difficult" to "exciting"!

title: Clean Your Room
description: Clean Your Room is a first-person memory puzzle game. There are several levels (denoted as hours) that you must complete. Each hour is more difficult than the last, taxing your memory more and more. Return all items to their designated location before time runs out!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Fun-A-Licious
description:
Ready to make your rides sweeter, more colourful, and full of joy?

The "FUN-A-LICIOUS" combo brings a lot of sweetness and energy to make your experiences even more fun.

With this add-on extra pack, you can choose the super cute Candy Bear as your companion, ride with the fabulous Fun-A-Licious Cart, and make accurate shots with the Splatter Blaster.

This DLC includes:
- One companion.
- One roller coaster cart.
- One weapon.

title: Guy Who Sells Jars
description: Step into the shoes of a brand-new jar shop owner! Create and sell jars to over 200+ unique customers! Be careful though, some jar shop owners don't take lightly to new competitors...

title: Guns of Gaia
description: Take back your planet from alien invaders! Guns of Gaia is a game that blends survival and base-building elements. Use biotechnology to alter the landscapes, build defenses, set traps, and deploy bait. Nurture creatures, unlock equipment and weapons. Defeat your enemies and conquer your planet!

title: Soul Slasher
description: Soul Slasher is a top down, 1v1 PvP focused close combat game. The arena's randomized obstacles, buffs, and traps make every match different. Slash your opponent's soul and claim your freedom.

title: Backrooms: The Next Level
description: Backrooms: The Next Level is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were

title: Quiverless
description: Quiverless is a fast-paced pixel-art dungeon crawler made to challenge your precision and strategy. Armed with only a single arrow, you must skillfully retrieve and reuse it to defeat relentless monsters lurking in dark and treacherous dungeons.

title: Flanker: Call of the Ghost
description: A vertical scroll shooter sci-fi space combat game where you pilot your spaceship through 25 challenging levels, engaging in intense battles against 75 unique enemy types. Master precise shooting mechanics, dodge incoming fire, collect power-ups to enhance your ship, and face epic boss battles.

title: Midnight Crane
description: A psychological horror game where you spend a night in the shoes of an arcade worker named Marcus. Win prizes on the crane machine and shoot some hoops. Just make sure to keep the doors locked.

title: Block Beast
description: Build the strongest Beast and claim your title as "King Of The Jungle!" With thousands of possible combinations, which Beast will reign supreme in this fast paced Auto-Battler

title: A Tale of Dirty Whiskers
description: A Tale of Dirty Whiskers is a murder mystery visual novel about seven siblings and their mother, who died in suspicious circumstances. Now it's up to you, Detective, to search through their nine lives and solve the mystery surrounding the death of Princesa Whiskers.

title: Meteor Raiders
description: Space Miner is a shmup with roguelike elements and weapon customization. Destroy asteroids, collect different minerals to improve your ship, and discover new places on the galaxy!

title: Crow Style
description: When fashion sets the rules, boldness decides who wins! In this Stealth game, control an arrogant crow obsessed with status, sabotage the rivals to win the city's biggest contest. Sneak into designers homes, alter their creations and escape without getting caught!

title: Royal Jest
description: A story-driven theatrical experience about family, world-domination, and capitalism.

title: Purrates
description: Purrates is a point & click adventure about cat pirates solving a great mystery. Embrace the pirate's duties with captain Clawdius Whiskers & reassemble the ship's crew scattered across the island. Craft items to solve various puzzles & win back the favor of your fellow purrates!

title: Ironseed 2: Consensus
description: Sequel to a sci-fi exploration game Ironseed written in 1994, the story continues in Ironseed 2: Consensus!

title: Black OX
description: Black OX is a roguelike deckbuilder where Blackjack meets Tic-Tac-Toe in a wild, tactical clash of cunning combos. Stack cards, twist values, and unleash powerful Oxchips to outsmart your opponent—and flip the game on its head. This isn’t just Blackjack. This is Black OX.

title: Stack to Ascension
description: The beasts have ravaged your ancestral sect, leaving you as the sole survivor. With your cultivation regressed to Qi Condensation stage, you must start anew. Rebuild strength, recruit disciples, and uncover the dark truth behind the disaster.

title: The Razorform
description: Infiltrate a classified research facility and unleash the Razorform, a time-warping entity from a dimension of nightmares and chaos. Spray gunfire, uncover military secrets, and slice through enemies with electrified blades. The Razorform is a single player atmospheric sci-fi action game.

title: JunkRats
description:
JunkRats is a story-driven action shooter set in a ruined world where humanity survives beneath the remains of collapsed cities. Years after a deadly mutation known as the Forsaken virus spread across the planet, the surface has become a hostile wasteland filled with infected creatures and decaying infrastructure. Survivors built a settlement beneath the ruins inside a massive crater, forming a controlled society known as the Underground.

Combat is tactical and grounded, yet fast-paced, encouraging players to use positioning, the environment, and situational awareness to survive encounters with both human enemies and mutated creatures. Weapons feature an active reload system that rewards precise timing with faster reloads and temporary combat advantages.

title: Arcadice
description: Handcuffed to a deadly arcade machine, fight for your life in its top-down shooter. Load weapons by inserting dice into the machine. Six failures and the sentry gun fires.

title: Great Harvester
description: A farming sim… with a body count. Your husband murdered... You... locked away. But now the Devil has a deal: and it looks like soul harvesting season has just begun. Farm by day, kill by night, and don't get caught!!! Congratulations, you’re now the town serial killer.

title: Stupid Horse Channel
description: Bet on stupid horses, win stupid money! A single/multiplayer horse race betting game with insane synergistic skills!

title: Pinball Crush
description: Pinball Crush is a pinball dating sim, great for casual gaming and fans of classic pinball alike. Impress your crush and unlock over 300 unique character events on your way to a high score. Pick your favorite date and explore Pinball Crush's bonus stages, each with new mechanics!

title: Magical Girl Fist Fight
description: Can't a Magical Girl retire in peace? You may have lost your powers, but you can still throw a punch!

title: Fighting Fantasy Classics: The Port of Peril
description: Are YOU brave enough to face the savage demons of the underworld...? Embark on an epic quest from Moonstone Hills, to the shadowy streets of Port Blacksand, to the depths of Darkwood Forest, and ultimately face your worst nightmare...

title: Mad Television Tycoon
description: In Mad Television Tycoon, you take control of a TV station. Accept the challenge and lead your network to success. Your task is to create a diverse schedule, maximize advertising revenue, and outshine the competition.

title: WW Furnishing
description: Wisteria Whiskers Furnishing is a mod that adds a large portion of furnishing goods, from sofas to kitchen cabinets, we have all kinds of objects and trinkets to make your builds feel more homey, meaning the direction of the mod focuses on home decoration aspects. Sometimes we will add a fun thing here and there that might not be furniture but the purpose usually will still be leaning on the aesthetic or fun aspect rather than practical for gameplay.

title: Serpico
description: After a royal expedition sent to investigate disappearing trade ships is destroyed, Serpico Albrecht is left the lone survivor among an uncharted island. Explore ancient ruins, cursed enemies, and uncover what doomed the expedition. Serpico is a dark-fantasy dungeon crawler with brutal combat.

title: Jeremy the Health Inspector
description: In this game, you play as Jeremy, the health inspector in space. Your goal is to bring back taco ingredients from an abandoned starship and find out what happened to the crew.

title: Nova Patria
description: Nova Patria is a Roman Steampunk Colony Sim. In this alternate history, the empire never fell and lived on to discover the New World and steam power. Manage intricate supply chains, expanding cities, and innovations in a hopeful, procedurally generated, isometric simulation of industrial antiquity.

title: Fragile Hero and the Immortal Frog
description: This is a 2D action game where a high-powered but fragile protagonist teams up with an invincible frog who follows behind.

title: I Am a Dorm Resident (but Cat)
description: This is the corridor of a student dormitory with a hundred-year history… and you find yourself sleeping in it. You awaken as a cat, your memories lost. Paws in place of hands, fur covering your face — the only thing you remember is that you were once a resident here. But fortunately, the one you’ve transformed into is ‘Bon’, the dorm cat loved by everyone. Stroll through the corridors, chat with the dorm residents, receive treats, run errands, and when you’re tired, curl up for a nap under the kotatsu. While enjoying this carefree moratorium that only a cat can enjoy, search for the secrets hidden within the dorm and the memories you’ve lost.f

title: EA Sports FC 26
description: EA Sports FC 26 is a football simulation game and the third entry in the EA Sports FC series, following the franchise's rebranding from FIFA. The game features various modes including career mode with narrative-driven Manager Live Challenges, and introduces Archetypes, a system that defines player playstyles based on real footballers. It is the successor to EA Sports FC 25.

title: Empires of Steel
description: Empires of Steel is a turn-based wargame. Form alliances, capture and trade resources, research new technologies, and form huge invasion fleets to conquer your opponents. Single or multiplayer, voicechat, customizable maps, scenarios, and rules.

title: Where the Chips Fall
description: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with you abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

title: Princess of the Tomb
description: A dark romance visual novel inspired by Yin and Yang, where your choices determine the path of light (Yang) or darkness (Yin). Explore a fantasy world inspired by Vietnamese horror folklore as a princess, entrusting your fate to 5+ love interests, each with their own dangerous ambitions.

title: Lost Sword
description: Lost Sword is a 2D anime RPG published by Wemade Connect. Gather and lead a roster of unique and appealing characters in an epic fantasy world.

title: Bookworm Adventures Deluxe
description:
Bookworm Adventures Deluxe is an enhanced edition of Bookworm Adventures, combining word puzzle gameplay with turn-based RPG combat. Players form words from a grid of letters to attack enemies, unlocking power-ups, gems, and potions to help Lex the Bookworm on his journey.

The Deluxe version includes:

Improved graphics and visual effects.

A “Hall of Fame” ranking system for tracking high scores.

All original content, including three story books, mini-games, and side modes.

The core gameplay and storyline are the same as the standard version, but the Deluxe release refines the presentation and adds competitive replayability.

title: Blueberry Weather
description: A melancholic, dialogue-driven game with themes of depression, dreams and loss. You visit your childhood friend, that has been in a coma for a long time, battling a rare illness.

title: WeirdParisGame
description: a very short game I made for my university, they didn't like it that much

title: Soulforge: Lost Path
description: In Soulforge: Lost Path (Survivors-like), become a legendary hunter slaughtering endless Corrupted Souls. Scavenge Sacred Remains to forge Exorcist Artefacts, manage limited inventory strategically, and uncover the world's festering corruption truth.

title: CastleOn
description: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in this turn-based strategy!

title: Aeoliada
description: 3D Action RPG set in a mix of Ancient Greece and 80s Synthwave about a demigoddess queen cancelling her enemies with high kicks, a katana and a greatsword.

title: SuperWeird
description: Automate highly unstable and unreliable robots using microprograms installed along their paths. Design an automated system that is prepared to handle the challenges of a super weird environment, full of automated hazards left here long before your arrival.

title: El Coco
description: El Coco is a 3D action roguelike game that immerses you in a world of dreams, broken memories and nightmares incarnate. Descend into the Uncertain, a place as strange as it is dangerous, and fight to recover what you lost... if you can trust your guide.

title: Little Corners
description: Peel, place, and arrange stickers across tiny windows into different worlds. Relax and unwind to lofi beats, collect unique stickers and share your cozy creations with the world.

title: Smol Adventure
description: A short 3D exploration role-playing game with a click-to-move movement system.

title: Summoner's Gambit
description: Summoner's Gambit is an innovative duel game that blends strategy rouguelike with auto-battler positioning. As a powerful summoner, you'll forge a dominant formation and clash against other players on the ever-shifting battlefield, where wit and luck collide.

title: Nelli the Seer
description: Nelli The Seer is a third-person platformer and memory game. Jump, glide and see the future to collect the treasures present in the Templo Mayor. Collect the fragments of the obsidian mirror to show the future to your people.

title: Cinco Noches en Casa Rosada 2
description: The sequel to the original 'Cinco Noches en Casa Rosada' a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame where you play as a night guard in Argentina's government house, Casa Rosada (pink house). This game features better graphics, more mechanics and more politicians.

title: NBA 2K26
description: Bragging rights are on the line in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, The W, and Play Now. Showcase your bag of moves with hyper realism, Powered by ProPLAY, and challenge your friends, or rivals, in NBA 2K26’s competitive modes—and leave no doubt that you wear the crown.

title: Melt Abyss
description: A fan action game for Meaqua. An ominous vortex "Abyss" appears above the city, and the city's order is collapsing. Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua, who have lost their memories, receive a call from the city. In order to solve the mystery of themselves, they embark on the road to return home.

title: Not Guilty!
description: You are the judge, the executioner, and the warden — all in one. Investigate absurd cases, make questionable decisions, expand your prison, and keep the budget balanced. Bend your morals, play with verdicts, and build your own empire of justice.

title: Castle Bloodstone
description: Castle Bloodstone is a labyrinthine puzzle adventure set in a big castle of stone, dirt, and blood. The two maps are primarily inspired by Barbuta from UFO 50, while also makes plenty use of vanilla mapping tricks and expl﻿oits.

title: Germ Blasters
description: Help clear the the germs with meds using different directions.

title: Storm Settlers
description: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

title: Aura Kingdom: Impact
description: Aura Kingdom: Impact is an anime-style fantasy MMORPG. Explore a vast world, fight with dynamic skills, and switch classes freely. Summon Eidolons to aid in battle.

title: The Train Can't Escape Without XXX!?
description:
"The two are trapped in a strange train. How will they get out...?"
An official Saihate Station fan-game.

title: Hyper Chess
description: There are NO TURNS in this wild version of Chess! Pieces move across the board in real-time, so you'll need to think fast to protect your King!

title: Tatsunami, let's clean up!
description:
"Let's do some deep cleaning while exploring their rooms!"
An official Saihate Station fan-game.

title: Bras
description: Get ready to defend a school in a different Turrent Defense, where you defend and attack! Choose between 4 heroes and fight against bandits and corrupt politicians. Improve your defenses and get ready for lots of shooting, in this third-person action game!

title: Crazy Crab
description: The first of the classic SpongeBob horror adventure series. Mr. Krabs' money was stolen, and he has gone crazy! You will go on a dangerous path to escape that crazy crab and his lust for blood.

title: Broken Sword: The Angel of Death
description: When a mysterious and beautiful woman rushes into George Stobbart’s office, pleading for help, he cannot know that he will be inextricably drawn into terrifying conspiracy, and a desperate search for a nefarious artifact of great and terrible power. For George, it looks like the world needs saving. Again.

title: Wail of Despair
description: "Wail of Despair" follows a non-binary shut-in, trying to recover from their isolation and face the world once again. Facing a horrific, overstimulating, colorful and judgmental world Confronted with their past scars and mistakes, taunted with everything they've lost by a strange shadow that won't leave them alone and always follows. Can they readapt and learn to return to being something resembling okay? Or will they be swept away by the vibrant pulsating horror that threatens them back into the darkness?

title: Stellations
description: Stellations is a manic arcade game about careening around mind maps. Pilot yourself through vibrating circuits where each input is tactile, twitchy, delightful. Chase, be chased, escape.

title: Garbage Take Out Day
description: Today is garbage take out day. You need to throw all the trash in the trash container. But be careful, there are a lot of strangers around.

title: Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero - Randomizer
description:
Rediscover Sub-Zero’s journey like never before!

This mod completely shuffles the item distribution in Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero, delivering a fresh and challenging experience for both veterans and newcomers. Power-ups, keys, and essential items are now placed at random, putting your knowledge and adaptability to the ultimate test.

In addition, the randomizer grants immediate access to all levels from the start, allowing for a non-linear playthrough. The experience requirements to complete the game have also been adjusted, making progression more flexible and suited to the randomized structure.

title: Bastion of Valor
description: Bastion of Valor is a strategy game where you build and develop your village, grow its population, and defend against raids. You can construct your village as you wish and assign tasks to your villagers. Your strategies will shape your village's future.

title: F.E.A.S.T
description: F.E.A.S.T is a farming factory automation game focusing on cooking. You are a new recruit in a secret organization tasked with a critical mission: feed the gods before they destroy the world with their hunger. Farm ingredients, run food factories, and prepare gourmet-level offerings tailored to each divine being’s impossible appetite.

title: Lunaris
description: Lunaris is a fast-paced sci-fi top-down roguelite shooter: survive escalating enemy waves, stack powerful passive and active abilities, craft wild build synergies, and turn the arena into a neon storm of lasers and explosions. Every run feels fresh and intense.

title: Bastion Frontier
description: Bastion Frontier is a dark fantasy tower defense game where your mission is to defend the last Crystal Hearts — the only source of light left in a dying world.

title: Bigfoot Hunting
description: Hunt the legend and survive the untamed wilderness.

title: Infernitos: Fiery Dishes
description: Welcome back to the hottest kitchen in the underworld!

title: Frame Cat
description:
In this retro-style platformer, play as Catherine, a witch and tomb raider caught in a cursed dimension after stealing a forbidden artifact.

Blast enemies with magic fireballs, solve puzzles, and escape the clutches of the Cat Demon across 15 pixel-perfect levels inspired by ‘90s classics.

title: Hextalia
description: Hextalia is a strategic tower defense where you craft powerful items and attach them to your towers. Shape enemy paths with walls, craft the desired items, defend corrupted crystals, and unlock new powers as you grow your collection. Build, defend, and adapt.

title: Casey Noir and Carved Pumpkin's Latte
description: What's this? A Point and Click, "Who Done It?", Murder Mystery Visual Novel, set in a Gothic Hotel on top of a lonely hill, during the Night of Halloween?

title: Subway Invasion
description: Defend a NYC subway train from relentless alien waves as a lone security guard. Scavenge scarce ammo, upgrade your pistol with attachments and sub-weapons, fortify chokepoints, and survive increasingly deadly assaults in this tactical wave-based shooter.

title: Overpowered 1: Mars Infestation
description: Exterminate hordes of menacing creatures in twin-stick shoot’em up style so your fellow humans can settle on a new planet!

title: Maw
description: Play as a wolf detective, who is exploring his queer identity while working for a totalitarian regime. Solve cases using animal abilities. Sniff for clues. Listen to the wind. Lick everything. Fight your instincts or become an animal.

title: Maja and Benny
description: The story of a little girl named Maja, who meets a talking cat named Benny. The two heroes end up in a mysterious town. It turns out that... the trees there can talk, as well as a teddy bear and a paper lion. The people they meet have strange dreams, and not everything seems to be what it should be.

title: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void
description: Take command of a freight ship traveling through deep space. Every jump brings danger, every decision matters. Manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade, fight, and survive in a hostile galaxy where resources are scarce and every day could be your last.

title: Ocean City Killer
description: Ocean City Killer is an open-world corporate dungeon crawler. You play as Rick Atlanta, a private eye investigating the death of a former colleague. What starts out as a routine case pulls you into the dark labyrinth of a seedy megacorp. Hop in your muscle car to explore the city!

title: Gluttony
description: In the 2D action roguelike Gluttony, devour endless waves of Food Devils! Swallow enemies whole to steal their powers, then explode when your belly is full. Constantly decide where to move, who to eat, and which powers to upgrade. Without razor-sharp judgment, survival is impossible.

title: Copter Cove
description: It’s 1982. You’ve just inherited your uncle’s helicopter and hangar on distant Cove Island. Help the locals rebuild after the great storm—and uncover what really happened that eerie night, five years ago.

title: QUByte Classics: Beat 'Em Up Collection
description: A collection of seven retro beat 'em ups with enhanced features like rewind, cheats, screen filters, and more!

title: Griffin
description:
The Griffin, battle tank has been developed as countermeasure against powerful neighbor countries. However, its designer was captured by the enemy country…

Now, his granddaughter got into the Griffin and take on her solo mission to rescue her grandfather!

title: The Rock and the Rose
description: A short demo that won second place in the Indie Game Maker Contest 2017

title: Once Upon a Spirit
description: Its soul is lost! Clung to the crow! Find it! Find it in the realm of spirits!

title: Long Live My Lady!
description: A lone gnome, a sleeping princess and a sea of beer. Take care of your mistress by becoming the manager of the only tavern in the entire Dungeon!

title: Voice of the Ocean
description: Voice of the Ocean is a single-player adventure about a lost world, and the echoes of a forgotten past. Use your voice to sing ancient melodies and explore a world lost beneath the waves. Dive into the depths to uncover the power within your song and learn why you may be the last of your kind.

title: The Odd Squad Adventure in Oddbodia
description:
Published in 1997 by Glow Zone Pty Ltd, The Odd Squad Adventure in Oddbodia was an above-average math / logic title in its time.
You play as Dylan, an average kid who gets suck through his computer into the land of Oddbodia. Myron Megabrain needs your help to rescue Doc Fever from the evil clutches of Draculard. To help you on your quest, Myron gives you a Superhero makeover (to disguise the fact you’re a human). Playing as the Mystery Kid, you team up with Nerdy Neville and Mimi Screami.

title: Goobs
description: Goobs is a top‑down puzzle‑action game for Windows developed by Redclaw Software. You control adorable yellow creatures stranded on floating platforms in space, guiding them to exits while collecting energy orbs and overcoming obstacles. Featuring 55 handcrafted levels, a powerful built‑in level editor, and a custom level browser, Goobs offers creative challenges with multiple solutions and robust replay value. Originally shareware, it later became freeware, celebrated by fans for its clever puzzles, charming presentation, and community‑driven content.

title: Funko Fusion: Frankenstein
description: It’s alive! IT’S ALIVE! Celebrate spooky season in Funko Fusion with the arrival of Universal Monsters Frankenstein.

title: Catacomb Chess
description:
The city of Chessfield is being menaced by bloodthirsty monsters crawling out of the ancient catacombs. Together King, Queen, bishops, knights, rooks, and pawns embark to end the evil menace deep down below.

The lawful chess pieces follow the chess rules, HOWEVER THE CHAOTIC MONSTERS FIGHT WITHOUT HONOR.

title: JDG & le RPG
description:
JDG & le RPG is a fan game that honors the world of Joueur du Grenier (and more generally to the French-speaking YouTube community) and comes after the third episode about RPGs.
It is a narrative game accompanied by a few classic turn-based battles, the real interest of the game is the references and jokes scattered throughout the story.

title: Crazy Crab 2
description: After Mr. Krabs's money was stolen, his desire to kill everyone he can think of has only grown with time. What will happen next in the treacherous journey of these frightened Bikini Bottomites?

title: Hello World: a developer story
description: The developer narrates. The world evolves. The fourth wall breaks. Welcome to Hello World, a charming Narrative Physical Adventure where you play a game as it's being created live.

title: Supra Mayro 64 FM
description: This game is a comedic parody game made by Gusvenga in which you are Mayro who is tasked to save princes Pesh from booser There is minigames, easter eggs and 15 levels in the story mode. There is also a sand box mode where you can spawn stuff.

title: Late Stops
description: Late Stops is a short indie horror experience where you play as Derek Adams, a man on a long, late-night road trip across the country. Somewhere along a quiet highway, his car runs out of gas. With just enough momentum, he rolls into a small convenience store that seems oddly untouched by time.

title: My Wife Threw Out My Card Collection (So I Bought a Dump to Find Them All)
description: One trash run — and it was all gone. Now it’s just you, a cart, and a thousand tons of garbage. But you’ll keep digging through every pile, searching for rare cards and nostalgic treasure. In this cozy trash-cleaning simulator.

title: Quarion
description: A short 2D pixel-style metroidvania where you explore, fight bosses, aquire items and abilities and find secrets. Heavily inspired by games such as You Have to Win the Game and VVVVVV.

title: Identity V: Closing Night

title: Bear Defence Situation
description: A hybrid card game and tower defence where the hands you play become the towers you build. Defeat the enemies approaching the bear's den and find modifiers that support the elements of your defensive strategy.

title: Chrono Commander

description: "Phantom Necro" is a strategic RPG about a necromancer who commands phantoms. Collect souls by defeating monsters and summon powerful creatures to fight by your side. Build your own faction in a world ruled by mighty powers and lead it to victory in an epic battle for supremacy.

title: Majogami
description: The sword fighter Shiroha cleaves through a twisted world with her high-speed Setsuna, facing off against the powerful witches in her way, in 2D paper craft character action. Paper craft character action! Majogami - the story of one girl who cuts gods like paper.

title: Astro Miners
description: Astro Miners is a thrilling space action game: blast meteors to harvest resources, battle rival factions in their airspace, and survive anomalies and black holes. Exchange fragments for Credits to upgrade dual-weapon ships and unlock powerful modules. Purchase now and conquer the void!

title: Xociety
description:
XOCIETY is a third-person POP Shooter with an Extraction-based gameplay RPG core. Set in a deep Sci-Fi world. Starting with a core shooter experience XOCIETY will evolve into an engagement-first player experience. Featuring PvP and PvE gameplay combined with RPG mechanics.

Shoot, Earn, Pioneer: Now We Live in XOCIETY.
Welcome to XOCIETY.

XOCIETY aims to redefine gaming experiences with a strong emphasis on player engagement. It gives TPS players economic control, allowing them to take on the role of key economic agents within XOCIETY. In traditional TPS games, players' actions have little impact on the environment and market economy.

However, in XOCIETY, every decision you make creates diverse effects on gameplay, the environment, and the overall market economy.
Gain voting power, build wealth, and pioneer a new world.
That’s why we live in XOCIETY.

We invite you to join us on XOCIETY's Early Access journey. Participate now and experience the new world XOCIETY seeks to create. Your feedback will be invaluable to the game's development. Let us know what excites you and what could be improved. Together, we’ll shape the future of XOCIETY.

Take the challenge now! We’ll be waiting for you in XOCIETY.

title: Shark Dentist
description: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.

title: Funko Fusion: SpecialEffect's Streamer Bear
description: Take on iconic worlds and your favourite franchises with SpecialEffect's Streamer Bear! With your purchase, you'll be supporting the UK charity, SpecialEffect, and helping to level the playing field for people with physical disabilities.

title: Exofactory
description: Awaken as a forgotten AI on an alien world, your every choice reshapes your technology, environment, and identity. Automate deeply transformative factories in a chill open world, where the story evolves uniquely around you.

title: Mato Fragments
description: You are a photo shop owner moonlighting as an informant in the vibrant, but dangerous streets of Neo City. After harboring a strange fugitive, your skills as an informant are put to the test, as the fate of the entire city rests in your hands.

title: Descentarium
description: Play as Kero, a determined frog trapped in a strange, enclosed world with no clear way out. This 2D roguelike platformer takes you deep into dark, shifting caves filled with hidden dangers, valuable resources, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

title: Blood Vow: Survive the Night
description: Defend the people of Sodermark from the hordes of darkness. Fight as an army of one, or online with up to four-player PvE multiplayer in this wave-based, action-survival game.

title: A Tragedy in Elvish
description: Once an elven kingdom, Karmabüttel shuns its founders in favor of men. Mari, scorned for her pointed ears and fine features, finds friendship in Uno, a dying human boy. When she learns of a rare cure, she sets off on a quest not for revenge, but to save the one who truly saw her.

title: My Farm Is Running!
description: Experience farm life like never before – where the crops are the ones doing the harvesting... of their freedom! Chase down your escaping produce in a madcap, silly dash to save your livelihood.

title: Russian Parkour Simulator
description: A game where you need to find memes, clear apartment and other activities.

title: 7 Days to Escape

title: Dragon Conqueror

title: Chaos the Devil

title: Wanderstate

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 3 - The Abyss Awakens
description:
In the wake of the Timestream Entanglement, Knull stirs deep within Klyntar’s core, stretching his shadowed hands across the cosmos. Power promised by the dark symbiote god beckons the awakening of a new queen. The Phoenix arrives from across the stars to erase Klyntar before the darkness can rise again! However, she'll require unlikely aid from a warrior of two worlds who lives to fight against the tide of night.

As the god of the symbiotes and the Phoenix Force collide, will you burn with the light of creation or embrace the darkness?

title: Abyss Veil
description: Abyss Veil is a narrative FPS where you play as Ivy and Mel. One seeks her brother, the other revenge. Meet strange folks, fight like hell, unravel strange mysteries, and most importantly, enjoy your stay!

title: Towst: The One Who Sees Things

title: Contractors Showdown: ExfilZone
description:
Enter ExfilZone, the immersive extraction-based game mode in Contractors Showdown, where every decision could mean life or death. ExfilZone introduces a deep progression system intertwined with dynamic missions, challenging you to survive, complete objectives, and extract with your hard-earned loot.

Craft your ultimate loadout with the one and only VR Gunsmith System, featuring over 50 weapons and thousands of combinations. Customize attachments, tweak components, and design unique color schemes to dominate with style.

Take on missions from unique vendors, ranging from elimination contracts and reconnaissance tasks to planting trackers and resource gathering. Completing these missions builds loyalty with vendors, unlocking new weapons, gear, and upgrades to expand your arsenal.

In this RPG, you play as Hikari as she protects Mikamai Town from the evil forces of Cynthia.

title: Advent: Dawn
description: A research trip turns deadly when seven strangers are trapped in a vast cave beneath a remote island. 『Advent: Dawn』 is a sci-fi mystery visual novel where you must escape through fear, fractured trust, and whispers from the deep. Will you unravel the mystery before the cave unravels you?

title: Illusive Domain
description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

title: Poolcore: Submersion
description: Immerse yourself in poolcore-inspired vibes as you explore a vast complex of mind-bending liminal architecture straight out of your dreams. Navigate through a facility filled with obstacles and puzzles, venturing into depths that descend far below the rippling, chlorinated waters.

title: Hellcam
description: HELLCAM is a hyper-realistic psychological horror exploration game focusing on navigating liminal spaces. Follow the story of a stranded backrooms researcher through a VHS camera, uncovering the harrowing reality of the backrooms.

title: Our Bad Ending
description: A girl’s dark, romantic desire for her best friend and the spiral of pursuing a doomed love.

title: Frutiger Aero
description: Welcome to Frutigo Aero, a cozy 2-player puzzle adventure set in the nostalgic future we were promised but never got. Explore dreamy zones of bubbly glass, glowing gradients, and soft retro UI. Solve puzzles, unlock cosmetics, and vibe solo or with a friend in a world made to ease your mind.

title: College Kings 2: Episode 2 "The Pool Party" Reworked
description: Tensions on the campus are high, the college is clamping down on the frats, and a mysterious social media page has students paranoid and on edge. Join the Social Planning Committee and work to bring the campus back together. Your first job? Organize the ultimate blow-out Pool Party! We’re going to need inflatables, beach balls and bikinis.

title: College Kings 2: Episode 3 "Back To Basics"
description:
With the second most important fighting tournament of the year on the horizon, the frats will struggle for survival as a newly appointed auditor is looking to end the violence once and for all.

Meanwhile, Nora throws a schoolwide sleepover hoping to unite the students against this new threat.

title: Grow Home & Grow Up
description: This bundle includes the two platformer titles developed by Ubisoft Reflections.

title: Dungeon Market Simulator
description: A strategic medieval market simulation game. Equip your dungeon with traps. Hunt down outcast warriors and earn mysterious chests. Upgrade the items you obtain and increase their value. Bargain with customers and earn promotions.

title: The Lone Keeper
description: A psychological horror game where nothing is as it seems. Maintain a remote lighthouse, perform daily tasks while descending into isolation, hallucinations, and distorted reality.

title: Natsuki And Chill
description: After telling her that you're interested in her, Natsuki wants to come to your place! Spend a chill evening with her... And maybe get a little more intimate...

title: Possession Game
description:
Possession
Team up. Uncover the unknown. Survive the haunting.

Possession is a 1v4 co-op horror game where one player takes on the role of a malevolent ghost, while a team of four investigators must work together to uncover its identity—and banish it before time runs out.

title: Tempaux
description: Tempaux is a four-directional rhythm game inspired by both the gameplay of cornerstone arcade rhythm games from around the world, and the customization and appearance of classic operating systems. Blast incoming notes with your ship, develop your skills, and compete to become the best player.

title: Associate
description: Associate is a short horror adventure game made with RPG Maker. It's a game about [...] as you deal with [...]. You wake up in an unknown room, unware of what happened, having lost any memories besides your name. Little do you know, the truth is actually [...].

title: Infinite Lives
description: Explore infinite possibilities with INFINITE LIVES - where superhumans and subhumans fight for control of the ultimate shared universe! Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, in a vicious cycle that never ends...

title: Fantasy Burger
description: A chill fantasy cooking game. Serve meals to knights, mages, and mythical creatures. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!

title: Encounter: The Lost Cards
description: The unhinged roguelike for the tactically obsessed. Forget maps—your journey is a deck of Tarot cards you build on the fly. Manage a tight inventory, chain questionable combos, and watch your gear shatter. Got unlucky? The virtuous can resurrect; the sinful, however...

title: Dreadcore: Locked Unit
description: A first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and environmental storytelling. Discover the tragic story of Unit 199, where a fragmented consciousness still haunts the place.

title: Holy Deadline
description: Holy Deadline is a surreal, story-rich visual novel where you play as a demigod lawyer. You have one week to investigate the divine divorce of Adam and Eve! Flirt, drink, raise your stats and make bold choices in minigames and Heaven's drama.

title: Train Sim World 5: Frankfurt S-Bahn: S1, S8 & S9 Route Add-On
description: Sprawling rails, stations galore & services in all directions – welcome to the S-Bahn Rhein-Main in Train Sim World 5! From the complex Frankfurt Hbf, depart westbound for Wiesbaden along 3 distinct lines and keep the city moving with the DB BR 430.

title: Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends Visit the West Somerset Railway
description: Embark on a special journey as Thomas the Tank Engine makes his debut in Train Sim World 5! Drive with Thomas as he makes his way to the West Somerset Railway, Diesel’s tagging along for the ride as well, what mischief will he get up to?

title: Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends 80th Anniversary Expansion
description: Continue the story of Thomas’ visit to the West Somerset Railway with the Thomas & Friends 80th Anniversary Expansion! Sir Topham Hatt and Diesel are preparing to throw a surprise birthday celebration for Thomas, who has been given a special coat of paint!

title: Train Sim World 5: Spoorlijn Zwolle - Groningen Route Add-On
description: Embark on an all-new journey in Train Sim World 5 with Spoorlijn Zwolle - Groningen. Run express services with the iconic ICMm Koploper and dash between commuter towns with the modern SNG Sprinter. New challenges await with our first Dutch route!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Wien - St. Pölten Route Add-On
description: Travel from Wien (Vienna) to St. Pölten with this scenic Austrian route from RSSLO.

title: Sterile
description: Follow five kids in their quest to not die!

title: Paranoir
description:
Paranoir is a comical visual novel that makes you play as an annoyed grandchild, trying their best to help their grandpa remember the day of his first detective case.

Age is taking a toll on him, and so the flashback might contain some inaccuracies. It's up to you to figure out what is real and what isn't, as you help him remember forgotten words.

Paranoir was developed in the span of 4 months by a small team of part-time developers.

title: Earth Invasion 99
description:
Earth is being invaded, cities are being torn down by those aggressive aliens. They do not come in peace and they do not negotiate.

Our only option is to fight back and defend our planet, but the situation is grim. Only one trooper is capable of putting up a fight anymore. The likelihood of complete human extinction is 99%.

Earth Invasion 99 is a fast paced shooter inspired by EDF franchise. Shoot and power up yourself to victory.

title: Pokémon Villain Jam
description: An entirely different playthrough everytime! Since the tournament is randomized every time, and each character has a wide variety of Pokémon to choose from, everyone's playthrough will be different!

title: Open Starbound
description: OpenStarbound is a mod of the latest version of Starbound, 1.4.4. It fixes many bugs, adds many new features and improves performance.

title: ZacJumper
description: A little game in which you have to jump to get a better score while avoiding monsters.

title: Touhou Farming: Minoriko's Homestead Harvest
description: The unofficial Touhou farm sim! Play as harvest god Minoriko Aki and grow your popularity with your home-grown produce and specialty sweet potatoes. Mingle with other gods and youkai in newly-constructed Yasaka Resort Town, explore Youkai Mountain, and maybe get into a fight or two!

title: Pirates: The Spectacular Treasure Trail
description:
In this PC game, children aged 6 and over can embark on an exciting treasure hunt. Who will find the treasure in the end with a compass and map? The trail of a mysterious treasure map leads to a teeming pirate island in this CD-ROM adventure! Who has enough courage and pirate cunning to take on the legacy of an old pirate captain?

The future pirates are first given a detailed description of the person or flag they are looking for and also learn about piracy. With their compass, they use the cardinal points and the squares on the map to guide their search! With eagle eyes, they have to find all the secret hiding places and track down legendary sailors, because only then will the pirates get all the puzzle pieces of the treasure map they need to set off in search of the treasure with their own ship and crew.

If the treasure chambers are empty, the pirates must use their skill to steal the loot from other pirates. There are also pirate-themed games, information and extras to print out in the old captain's cabin!

This adventurous pirate game requires geographical skills, a sense of direction, eagle eyes and concentration in order to shine as a proud pirate captain with a full treasure chest at the end.

Players can continue their treasure hunt at any time from where they left off. The game is automatically saved under the respective name.

The totally crazy treasure map is a fun and varied computer game for primary school children that teaches knowledge about the popular pirate theme in a playful way and, in particular, promotes concentration and the first use of the computer.

title: Project Code M
description: A mystery adventure where the protagonists are a pair of crime scene cleaners! You clean up dead bodies—and there’s also a “killer’s perspective” where you do all sorts of shady stuff, like scam phone calls.

title: Duke Nukem 64
description:
2018 Build Engine PC port of Duke Nukem 64 packaged in the "rednukem" release.

Created by the EDuke32 Team!

title: Cubescape
description: CubeScape is a philosophical game of self-discovery. You enter a gallery called "Tesseract," but soon everything vanishes. Now you wander through bizarre cubic worlds, trying to understand what truly lies within you.

title: The Shadows Over Lighthouse
description: Investigate your grandfather’s mysterious disappearance in Shadows Over Lighthouse, a Lovecraftian survival horror adventure. Explore eerie 1912 America, solve puzzles, and face horrors as reality twists around you. Can you uncover the truth, or will you lose yourself to madness?

title: Galduen of the Void
description: A fantasy space agency management game! Manage your team, design your space ship and research new technology! Reach moons, planets and the void beyond. Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void?

title: Climb The Backrooms
description: Ascend through the twisted levels of the Backrooms using physics-based object manipulation to overcome obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets.

title: Hordeguard: Winds of the North
description: Gather resources, fortify your village, recruit your warband, and defend against waves of monsters. With the clock ticking, every decision counts – strategize quickly and act swiftly to ensure the survival of your village. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode.

title: The Retrospection of Tomorrow
description: In this non-linear, time-travel romance visual novel, you'll date four captivating love interests just like in any ordinary otome game… until they die before your eyes(!). Trapped between memories and delusions, fighting fate itself—can you rewrite their endings? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

title: The Saturnians
description: Saturnians are moth wizards. For many generations, they have passed down techniques for making "light weaving" wands. They yearn to explore the unknown and meet new species. Saturnian villages are usually built on floating islands. When Saturnians ally with each other they typically connect these cities together into a larger network. Most Saturnians are from the largest network of cities, the country Solalei.

title: Scyphojel, Space Jellyfish!
description: Scyphojel are space jellyfish. They hover above ground with some type of levitation, and can produce electricity at the ends of their tentacles. They're genderless and reproduce through strobilation. They also like to eat metal.

title: No World Dreamers: Sticky Zeitgeist
description: No World Dreamers: Sticky Zeitgeist is an episodic game-comic about a town plagued by space waste, and the girls working to clean it.
