description: A puzzle action platformer where shifting your perspective lets you cross dimensions! Use the “Eyes that See the World” to uncover hidden truths.

title: Module:Berserk
description: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

title: Staffer Retro : A Supernatural Mystery Quest
description: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

title: The Automaton of Second London
description:
A Victorian Fantasy Halloween Robo-Otome.

Arabella Harlow is a governess seeking new employment in the city of Second London one Halloween season. Her paths cross with an eccentric alchemist-inventor, who introduces her to his myriad of creations. One particular automaton is Jack, a humanoid construct with ruby-red eyes and intellect on par with a human's. But Jack cannot speak - not verbally. So Arabella is hired on to teach him how to communicate through alternate methods.

As they grow in their relationship - are they colleagues? are they comrades? are they confidantes? Arabella herself is not quite sure. - a series of tragic, dramatic events culminate in a murder. Secrets lurk in the city of Second London...secrets that may put Arabella's life in danger...

title: [ Content Deleted ]
description: A sinister digital presence has invaded characters computer. Explore the depths of your PC's hidden files and confront the unsettling horror that now resides on your desktop. The more you uncover, the closer the terror gets to your reality.

title: Lewd Mod
description: A game where you play as a content moderator for a virtual social network, tagging which user images adhere to the guidelines and which do not and should be removed.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Reclaimer
description:
Operation: Reclaimer has come. Let claimants to the Mantle sing a requiem for the resolute warriors of Halo 4 multiplayer!

Enter the fray July 8 through August 5 to test your might in S&D Extraction, brave new Action Sack modes, and immortalize your triumphs with a library of returning armor sets from Halo 4.

title: Trainwatch
description: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

title: Lakeside Has No Lake!!
description: A spooky horror game where a femboy has to save his girlfriend from the town of Lakeside!

title: Boomer Brawler
description: A 2D fighting game where you play as old people! Compete to get your wish granted!!! 6 playable characters! 6 wishes to be granted! Simple button mashing controls!

title: My Pet Femboy
description: My Pet Femboy is a simple pet simulator UwU

title: Zombies Ate My Femboy
description: A Run-and-Gun indie shooter! Avoid various monster and save big booba women! 9 playable levels with 7 different enemies!

title: Perfect Victim
description: Unravel the web of relationships between four girls trapped in a room deep underground, with one DOOR and no way out. Constructed for the Toxic Yuri VN Jam.

title: Prop Sumo
description: Prop Sumo is a physics-driven fighting game that pits ordinary props together in extraordinary battles!

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Mysteries of Skull Rock
description: The 17th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley solves the mystery of Skull Rock, adds Peter Pan as a character, brings Friendship mechanics to The Forgotten and animal companions and starts The Adventures in Neverland Star Path.

title: Merge Coin: Mai
description:
It can be described as a turn-based puzzle roguelike.

In this game, you defeat enemies emerging from dimensional rifts using coins and gravestones, merge dropped coins to strengthen them, or offer them to altars to create barriers and empower gravestones — all in pursuit of higher scores by defeating even stronger enemies.

title: Endless Space 2: Lost Symphony
description: Endless Space 2: Lost Symphony enriches the game with 7 exclusive new tracks, and marks the return of a fan favorite Minor Faction: the Harmony.

title: Endless Space 2: Harmonic Memories
description: More than 6 years have passed since the release of the first Endless Space... FlybyNo, by pure madness, decided to delve into the archives and remaster 9 of his favorite songs from the game that made what Amplitude Studios is today! This add-on also features the arrival of a new Harmony Hero FES2 Reflects.

title: Wuthering Waves: Unfading Melody of Life
description:
Version 2.5 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Phrolova
• New area: Fabricatorium of the Deep
• New story quests
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Gun Dealer Simulator
description: Run your own store from the ground up! Stock shelves, set prices, pay bills, and maintain a clean environment to boost your reputation. Buy goods from local suppliers across town. Bet your earnings and become the go-to destination for firepower.

title: Genshin Impact: Sunspray Summer Resort
description:
Version 5.8 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Ineffa
• New main story quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Prelude, "The Journey Home"
• New outfits for Yelan and Bennett
• New main event: Sunspray Summer Resort
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Strike Mission
description: Strike Mission is a top-down aerial action game where you play as pilot Jake Walker on a mission to stop a global terrorist threat. Face intense battles, daring rescues, and strategic sabotage missions.

title: Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity
description:
Tyria’s leaders are anxious about rumors of covert Inquest voyages launched in search of the island of Castora, an island so remote that it’s long been thought to be inaccessible—or even nonexistent. The risks involved prevent all but the most tenacious (and perhaps foolhardy) of pursuers from investigating the Inquest’s plan. Your race to discover the Inquest’s plot will lead you across two new open world regions at launch, each filled with magical energies and strange creatures. Two additional maps will open as the story continues over the course of a year.

During your travels, you’ll unlock three new Mastery tracks, including one for your Skimmer mount that will unlock new and updated abilities. The new region also brings new adventures, collections, and thematic rewards. Players who own both Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity and Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds will be able to unlock a new Castoran Homestead map.

A new elite specialization for each profession will unlock new traits, profession mechanics, and healing, utility, and elite skills. Further augment your build by acquiring new relics themed to your adventures in Castora. And work towards six legendary rewards: three new legendary weapons, plus a ring, accessory, and aquabreather.

The magically infused landscape of Castora is home to all manner of strange, warped wildlife. Two of the three major updates coming in 2026 will pit players against the most powerful of the island’s denizens in Raid Encounters (including Challenge Modes and a Legendary Mode) and a new Convergence. Along with the first of the new Raid Encounters, new system updates will make raids easier to access. A Fractal with an accompanying Challenge Mode will also release with the last of the major expansion updates.

New emotes, armors, weapons, recipes, and other unique rewards await those who brave the dangers of Castora, and seasonal Wizard’s Vault refreshes throughout the expansion will bring additional options for unique aesthetic rewards.

To support the addition of a new Homestead map, we’re introducing two additional features. The first, the ability to freely swap between the Janthiri and Castoran maps, is helped by the second feature, Layouts. Layouts create a file you can use to save, load, share, and edit arrangements of decorations. We’ll share more about these and other features as we get nearer to the launch of Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity.

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball Volume 9
description: Contains the classic pinball tables PIN·BOT, TAXI and WHO dunnit.

title: I Looked Out
description: Debut game from Kit Le Bihan released as part of the O2A2: One of Every Asset game jam 2025. Short visual novel featuring a conversation with an unnamed narrator in a cable car.

title: Swiftrace Canyon
description: Find the fastest path to collect all flags and outpace the competition in this non-linear racing platformer. Master your skills on the hoverbike and become the champion of the Meerkat tribe. Drive the unique force mechanic to perfection to climb the leaderboards and prove that there can only be one fastest meerkat in the canyon.

title: Boom Ascent
description: Use bombs to move around and reach the top of a world full of obstacles and find help to regain your human form. Watch out for falls! Are you ready to take on this challenge?

title: Favela Kick: The Final Goal
description: From favela streets to global superstardom! Live a young Brazilian's dream of football glory. Rise through leagues, face challenges, & chase ultimate victory. Will your final kick define a generation? Your legend starts now!

title: American Journey Solitaire
description: Wyatt, a small-town lumberjack, is swept into a spontaneous road trip to Hawaii by his thrill-seeking best friend. As their journey unfolds, play through 300 solitaire levels, overcome obstacles, and unlock bonuses, all while enjoying a lighthearted story filled with unforgettable stops.

title: ZagrajMy
description: ZagrajMy is a browser-based quiz game for viewers and streamers. Perfect for streams and fun chat games.

title: Toytles
description: The leaf raking business simulation game puts you in the role of a budding entrepreneur looking to earn enough money to buy yourself the Ultimate Item(tm)!

title: A Happy Summer of Loving You
description: This is a summer love comedy about two new lovers who are a little bashful, but have a lot of fun.

title: Tamer Town
description: Collect Mokitons in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town. Design neighborhoods, unlock stories and grow a feel-good world where every connection matters.

title: Play Dead! #3
description: A story about a band, and their strange life on the road, accompanied by a surprisingly lively dead dog.

title: Ripley Remembered
description: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again. Pixel graphics, bullet hells, puzzles, and dialog.

title: Golf With Your Friends: Headbangers Hat
description: Ever wished your Golf Ball looked like a Pigeon? Well now it can! Become the Master Headbanger with this special animated Hat from the game Headbangers: Rhythm Royale by Glee-Cheese Studio.

title: The Struggle to Survive the Dragon Siege
description: The Struggle to Survive the Dragon Siege is a Tower Defense game inspired by Plants vs Zombies modernizing the formula to make this a unique experience. Different strategies to tackle the waves of enemies and be able to emerge victorious.

title: Springuins
description: Take on the role of Flare and Breeze, far from their home, as they try to make their way through the blooming spring in this puzzle game adventure. Control a single penguin to collect cherry blossoms that sync their movements to reunite the pair across challenging, cleverly designed levels.

title: Retro Basketball Manager
description: Take control of a basketball team. Choose tactics, sign players and help them develop. Guide your team to victory!

title: Tekkout2: Balls Of Rust
description: Play through challenging levels in eight atmospheric worlds in this rusty and technically demanding Breakout remake. Collect and craft crystals to upgrade your equipment and find your own way through the level jungle.

title: Ajedrez
description: It is a chess game with the possibility of playing two players or playing against the computer. Castling, exchanging a pawn for another piece at the end of the board, drawing, recording and loading the game can be performed.

title: Sor.Op: Dark Shades
description: SOR.OP: Dark Shades is a realistic first-person shooter from SNRC Studios with beautiful graphics, precise controls, and over 40 maps. Play in 7 modes, including Team Deathmatch, Free For All, Domination, and Zombie Mode. Tactics, skill, and teamwork are the key to victory.

title: The Vending Machine
description: The Vending Machine is a survival stealth horror where you must sneak, run, and escape from an anomalous vending machine.

title: Life in Jasskia: a Coffee Shop
description: A political-economic shop survival game. In a world nearing its end, the national and global agenda in crisis-stricken Jasskia shifts every day. In the middle of it all, build your business, meet people, witness unsettling truths, find ways to make money, and prepare for the coming end.

title: TicTacBlow
description: TicTacBlow is a modern take on classic tic-tac-toe with new gameplay mechanics that create fresh opportunities for clever strategies and extended play. Attack settlements, lay mines, play cards with powerful effects, and construct the ultimate weapon to defeat your enemy.

title: The Dream's Exit
description: A ripple stirs across the calm digital ocean, transforming into a human form. Is this entering a dream ? Following the traces left by the guide, feel everything around, and complete the final journey.

title: Fallowind
description: A retro psychological horror game that mixes the 3rd person camera of classic horror games and the immersive first person camera used in modern horror games. Elliot comes into contact via walkie-talkie with a mysterious woman, he must search an abandoned coal mining distribution site to find her.

title: The Showdown: Gorilla vs 100
description: A physics-based roguelike brawler where you play as a gorilla smashing your way through 100 men. Punch, throw, and ragdoll your enemies in chaotic, ever-changing game. Easy to pick up, wild to watch, and built to settle the internet’s dumbest debate.

title: Aniverse
description: Chop trees, cook meals, build your home and play music to control the wild! Explore a procedurally generated world and survive your way through art.

title: Packet Loss
description: Pilot cargo across an assigned sector. Master near-realistic flight, use ground effect for fuel, and perfectly balance your cargo or lose it to gravity. Precision is key in this aerial ballet of flight and cargo!

title: Awakeroots
description: Awakeroots is a passion project—crafted by two brothers who combine creativity with a deep love for Slavic culture and storytelling. It’s not just a game—it’s a journey into a world that could have been… and now awakens again.

title: W3dge
description: W3DGE is a fast-paced, minimalist arcade game about swallowing wedges before they can stab into you. The walls are closing in and the wedges are lined up endlessly in every direction. How long can you survive?

title: Phantom Feline
description: Play with light and shadow in this Game Boy–inspired puzzle game!

title: Le3ch
description: LE3CH is a psychological horror game set in 1994. You take a shady office job and soon find your PC hijacked by a stalker’s RAT. As files corrupt and reality distorts, uncover a disturbing conspiracy through eerie desktop tasks before you lose control completely.

title: Lumina's Brew
description: Explore enchanted biomes, gather rare ingredients, and brew potions to sell in this cozy 2D metroidvania. Discover secrets, meet curious creatures, and master the art of potion-making as a young witch on a mystical journey.

title: Elven Rivers 3: Sky Realm - Collector's Edition
description: Traverse the clouds, explore a fantastical realm populated by winged beasts, and defeat your adversaries with brilliance!

title: Minefield Fractalis
description: A Minesweeper-inspired puzzle game with a recursive twist. Each "mine" is a gateway to a new battlefield, each with its own cryptic logic to decipher. Navigate these nested systems and solve the chaos from the inside out.

title: Cadence Point
description: Welcome to Cadence Point- Our Marketplace, Your Time. There's something on offer for every shopper with our array of vendors and store fronts, with modern facilities to take the stress out of shopping with included food court and welcome centre should you need a helping hand...

title: Deck of Anubis
description: Descend into the Egyptian underworld in this roguelike deck-builder. Guided by Anubis, draw sacred blessings from the Book of the Dead and forge divine synergies. Face ancient trials and forgotten spirits as you journey through the Duat toward judgment, balance, and rebirth.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden
description: Discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in a hand-crafted landscape.

title: Table for None
description: "Table for None" is a pixelated, bite-sized open world, food truck cooking adventure game. Explore diverse regions, discover new recipes, and prepare meals to manage your food truck!

title: Aira & Van's Last Journey
description: Embark on an emotional journey of loss, acceptance, and moving forward. Discover precious moments through point & click cozy puzzles, feel the comfort of a beautiful pixel world brought to life by original soundtracks, and find peace as you travel with Aira in her grandmother’s nostalgic camper van.

title: Gabby's Dollhouse: Ready to Party
description: Throw a party with Gabby and the Gabby Cats. Explore magical worlds – enjoy fun activities, minigames and rewards playing solo or with a friend.

title: Trolling Football
description: In this wacky puzzle game, you’ll be thrown into a series of brain-teasing challenges that will test your logic, creativity, and sense of humor.

title: Barabizna
description:
BARABIZNA is a atmospheric horror game set in a creepy old house. Find and collect all the hidden items before it's too late. But beware... you're not alone.

In this game, you become one of those people looking to profit from someone else’s misfortune by selling a few intriguing items that are said to be hidden inside the house.

title: Bulletploop
description: BULLETPLOOP is a 2D platformer, roguelike shmup game. Where you shoot your way through a series of monsters, who are determined to kill you. Although, some odd forces will not let you truly die.

title: Mikoto and the Succubus Island
description: Reunite with your childhood friend to conquer dungeons and get rid of all the succubi plaguing your island! In this first-person dungeon-crawling RPG, you'll have to carefully explore every floor to find your way to the depths of each dungeon and defeat its boss succubus.

title: Subarashii
description: Subarashii is the second entry in the SUGOI series, a series of collaborative level packs created by community members under the supervision of TehRealSalt. It contains 48 levels created over the course of December 2016 and features work by more than 60 different contributors. In addition to regular levels, this edition of Sugoi also asked mappers to create their own Special Stages. As a result, Subarashii includes seven Special Stages, each of which utilizes Lua scripts to create its own unique playstyle. The level pack was initially released on July 27th, 2017.

title: Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey
description: Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey is a 1994 video game released on the Windows and Macintosh systems. It is the sixth game in the Reader Rabbit franchise. Designed for ages 4 till 7, the game introduces the new main characters Mat the Mouse and Sam the Lion who accompany Reader.

title: Sakura no Uta Re:Graphic - 10th Anniversary Edition
description:
A remaster of Sakura no Uta made for the 10th anniversary of the game.

Contains redrawn sprites/CGs in the style of Sakura no Toki in higher resolution (1080p), new opening movie, 10 new BGM tracks & new ending song.

title: Sakura no Uta Re:Graphic - Append Disc
description: A fandisc included in the Sakura no Uta 10th Anniversary edition featuring after stories for Rin, Rina & Yuumi connected to the sequel Sakura no Toki and other unreleased works in the Sakura no series.

title: Merkava: The Sacred Armour of Meirav
description: Cute Shmup video game with some ARPG mechanics

title: Actual Roommates!
description: An Adult Visual Novel about a young lesbian, her horny roommates and an overcomplicated corporate conspiracy.

title: Kuukiyomi: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.
description: Introducing the New Title: “KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World”! This time, the stage is Thailand! Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios, packed with cultural quirks and “That’s so true!” moments.

title: Sakura no Uta: Sakura no Mori no Ue wo Mau - 10th Anniversary Edition
description: An anniversary collection for Sakura no Uta: Sakura no Mori no Ue wo Mau, which includes Sakura no Uta Re:Graphic, a brand-new remaster of the original game; Sakura no Uta Append, a fan-disc featuring the after-stories for Rin, Rina, and Yuumi; the soundtrack on a CD, a voice drama CD about the story of Saki and Kenichiro, which was not told in the main story; and a 10th anniversary special booklet.

title: Fiction Paradox
description: Year 2045. Everything is moving too fast, and it’s becoming increasingly difficult to imagine the future. In a modern city built in record time thanks to technological progress, millions of people from different nations live isolated from the great global conflicts. Feeling trapped in a world that never made sense, you decide to embark on a journey to find the purpose of your existence.

title: Fantasketch
description: "Fantasketch" is a new kind of puzzle action game where the characters you draw come to life and move! Control your character and aim for the goal!

title: Candylands Journey
description: There is a trouble at the Magic University. The heart of magic has been stolen by Pastry Witches. Adventure across on a journey through a beautiful world drawn in pixel art style, buy magic wands, collect jewels and fight monsters to return the Magic Crystal.

title: Otterly Lost
description: Play as Otto, a curious sea otter swept far from home. In this story-rich adventure, explore wild forests, dive underwater, glide over rocky canyons, and climb your way back. Meet friendly animals, complete heartfelt quests, and enjoy soft challenges, at your own pace!

title: Darkway: Murder of King Mere
description: The King Mere is dead. Once the leader of diplomacy in the Dog Empyre, now a bloodstain on snow. You are the Apprentice, sent by the Master Detective to the City of Ink, to uncover who really murdered the King at the edge of the world.

title: C.U.T.S
description: It's an indie horror game in which a man named Ethan, passionate about collecting VHS tapes, receives a box full of them from a friend. But as he begins to watch them, he realizes he's witnessing something deeply disturbing and unsettling.

title: Xonix32
description: Xonix32 is a remake of the DOS game Xonix for the Windows platform. The gameplay is the same: the player controls a marker and has to cut off pieces of the playfield, creating a big safe area, while avoiding to be hit by the enemies.

title: After the End Fan Fork
description: Play anywhere in North America, the Caribbean, or the northern coast of South America in the year 2666, centuries after a cataclysmic Event knocked human civilization back to the medieval era. Featuring over a thousand provinces, 47 different religions (most of which are unique to AtE), and 31 different culture groups. (Not individual cultures - culture groups.)

title: New Era Old World
description: This mod is set in the post-apocalyptic Old World, in the year 2555. Play in North Africa, Europe and as far east as Japan or Darwin Australia, trying to build an Empire in these unfamiliar times. New music from Derek and Brandon Fietcher.

title: Ante Bellum
description: Ante Bellum is an alternative history mod currently centered around Europe, East Asia and parts of the Middle East. The design philosophy of the mod is to preserve the base game gameplay without flooding the game with any new mechanics and interactions, while also offering new and fresh gameplay experience, provided by the addition of new countries, mission trees, events, reforms, formables and such.

title: Post Finem
description: Post Finem is an alternate history modification for Europa Universalis IV that overhauls many things, including the entirety of Europe, western Asia from the Urals to Persia and Arabia, as well as north Africa. This mod explores a scenario in which Carthage was victorious in the Punic Wars against the Roman Republic, dismantling it after the third conflict, and pursuing economic hegemony in the western Mediterranean.

title: AnotherEidos Of Dragon Vein R
description:
A Borderless Love Story where you can do anyone!
Send a maximum of 12 units to attack!
Level the battlefield!

title: Buddy Garden
description: Buddy Garden is a cozy pixel-art sokoban puzzle game where you play as Buddy, a cheerful husky with a mission: tidy up the garden by pushing seed sacks into the right spots. Solve relaxing puzzles across charming farm environments that bloom as you progress, one sack, one season at a time.

title: A Game of Thrones
description: CK3AGOT is a total conversion mod set in the world of George R. R. Martin’s A Song of Ice and Fire, where lords great and small vie for control over Westeros. The mod takes its name from the first book in the series, synonymous with the contest of plots and politics the ambitious and hopeful play in their struggles for supremacy.

title: Godherja: The Dying World
description: Godherja: The Dying World is a total fantasy conversion mod that is set in an original dark fantasy world poised on the edge of the end times. After killing their Creator in a time long-forgotten, humanity has once again shaken the fabrics of reality through the use of world-shattering magics. Now, an endless Fog spews forth across the land swallowing all. Strange monsters and men turned wild now roam these lands, and the peoples who once called it home flee for the Shattered Coast. The world is dying. As the tribes migrate to the last safe lands and ancient empires crumble, reality itself hangs in the balance. Will you save the world, or end it?

title: Build-A-Putt
description: Build and play your own mini-golf courses with up to 8 players. Save courses for later or build them as you go.

title: Neon Hyperdrive
description: A rhythm racer like you've never seen before: drift corners, surf waves, and fly through neon skies to the rhythm of the music.

title: Graviscape
description: A reflective, physics-based puzzle game about piloting a ship through gravitational fields in deep space.

title: YaeiJinja
description: Yaei Shrine is a game where you must sense disturbances and guide the girl safely to the shrine.

title: FlippUp
description: You've activated an old Pinball machine—but with a twist. No points to score, just a mysterious mission to reach the top. We recommend you to try the demo before buying to avoid quick refunds- FlippTechINC.

title: ToneTrek
description: A colorful logic puzzle game where each step changes tile colors in a looping sequence. Plan your moves, recreate target patterns, and solve handcrafted levels across multiple game modes with minimalist style and relaxing flow.

title: Geodyssey
description: Geodyssey is a mind-bending first-person adventure game that challenges your perception with confusing environments. Explore spaces that defy logic and experience a reality that cannot exist. Immerse in a Non-Euclidean world that you cannot wrap your head around.

title: Bilson
description: Bilson is an open-world detective game where players will take on the role of the great detective Bilson, solving various bizarre cases in an open world. The game not only features a main storyline for players to solve, but also offers a wealth of additional content for players to explore.

title: Alebound
description: Alebound is a fast-paced, wave-based action brawler where you play as a battle-hardened dwarf, wielding fists of fury and drunken might. Unleash devastating melee combos and harness ale-fueled power-ups to crush relentless waves of orcs and skeletons. Survive as long as possible!

title: Heggo
description: A strategy roguelike shooting game. Play as Egg Kid, helping the demon Egg Overlord defeat monsters. Allocate monsters each round, with stronger monsters offering better rewards. Defeat them in time, then use the leftover time to craft equipment and upgrade your stats to reach the goal.

title: Lunavoid
description: There seems to be something wrong with the moon, and the world is under global lockdown. Will you figure out what's happening, or will you remain isolated, never finding out?

title: Epilogue
description: In this choice-driven game, you play as Gokturk, the last member of a team investigating a planetary anomaly. A capricious being who claims to possess ultimate power, the Anomaly manipulates the minds of its victims, trapping them in mind-bending dimensions. Your decisions lead to multiple endings.

title: The Manor
description: Another day in the office. Exorcising Demons!

title: Shogunate
description: This mod focuses on the medieval age in Japan, especially the Sengoku period around the 16th century. It includes a lot of historical feudal lords, aka Sengoku Daimyo, with their family trees.

title: The Fallen Eagle
description: The Fallen Eagle is a total conversion mod that brings Late Antiquity and the Early Medieval Era (361 – 867) to Crusader Kings III.

title: Warcraft: Guardians of Azeroth 2
description: Guardians of Azeroth 2 is a total conversion mod for Crusader Kings 3 set in the Warcraft universe by Blizzard Entertainment which harnesses the latent potential of storytelling through exploring the societal and interpersonal dynamics of the world like never before. Relive the harrowing years of strife first told in the beloved strategy games and the early years of World of Warcraft as you chart a new saga for Azeroth and cement a legacy to last the ages.

title: Princes of Darkness
description: Dark Ages just got a whole lot darker. Play Crusader Kings III as a vampire, hunter, werewolf, changeling, mummy or demon! You are the Prince of the city! Inspired by the World of Darkness, Dark Ages: Vampire, Vampire: the Masquerade...

title: Legacy of Valyria
description: Legacy of Valyria is an ambitious submod for the CK3: AGOT mod, dedicated to reviving the majesty, power, and mystery of ancient Valyria and the vast lands of Essos. Rediscover a world of dragonlords, forbidden magic, and epic conquests as you shape the legacy of one of history's greatest civilizations.

title: Battle for Agatharia
description: A single-developer Crusader Kings III Total Conversion mod that brings to life a land of piety, ambition and unyielding conflict. Set amidst a fictional hard-fantasy world inspired by the early medieval period, players must navigate political intrigue, scathing rivalries, and the ever-present threat of conquest.

title: Cloud Keeper: Shrine of Dal
description: Summon an army of clouds in this auto-battler survivors-like bullet heaven inspired by Korean folklore! Recruit cloud companions, collect relics, befriend shrine visitors, and survive against the monster hordes!

title: Touhou Rinrinki: Crafts of the Lucky Beast
description: Touhou Rinrinki ~ Crafts of the Luck Beast is a Touhou Doujin Card-Strategy Game. Using cards across different seasons, join forces with duelists of unique abilities, face various opponents from all over Gensoukyo, and uncover the truth behind the Card Duel Incident!

title: Space Supermarket Simulator
description: Run your own supermarket in outer space. Keep shelves stocked and nicely organized. Supply your store with drone delivery.

title: The Coffin of Andrew and Renee
description: The Coffin of Andrew and Renee is a mod for The Coffin of Andy and Leyley. The Alternate Universe we are developing centers around the question: "What would happen to the timeline of events from the original game, if one aspect of their childhood was changed?". And thus, The Coffin of Andrew and Renee was born.

title: Junkyard Space Agency
description: Build ships from scrap and fly them in a gritty, realistic space sim. Venture solo or team up. Hunt for parts, haul vital resources, and keep your space agency afloat.

title: Terraspace
description: The game "Terraspace" offers you a unique experience of planet settlement and terraforming — creating conditions for life on unsuitable planets. This will require you to build the necessary structures to populate the planet.

title: Spacesheep
description: You are a brave sheep who was sent to space by the USSR to test a new spaceship, but it veered off course and crashed on an alien planet! You must travel across strange worlds and fend off enemies to make it back to Earth safely.

title: Space Diner Simulator
description: After buying a rundown diner, you need to repair it and bring it to its full glory. Manage, renovate and upgrade the diner to attract more customers, and meet their demands. Bring a piece of home to the edges of space with Earths best recipes.

title: Super Space Frogs
description: Design, deploy, and fly awesome rockets. Unlock new technology to build bigger and better ships. Explore the solar system and discover the mysteries it holds.

title: Spaceum
description: You're stranded on SPACEUM, a sprawling space base with a deadly alien parasite hiding in the shadows. To escape, you’ll need every ounce of energy you can find.

title: SwordBorn
description: A pixel art action role-playing game where you fight, craft, and explore elemental lands to stop monsters spilling from ancient portals. Shape your path with skills, pets, farming, and puzzles.

title: Sword of Mejor
description: A unique rpg experience where you follow the path of a sword, rather than 1 set character! Follow the Sword of Mejor as it travels the lands swapping hands through battles, trades, gifts and more! With more paths and endings to count, every playthrough is different!

title: Stomp and the Sword of Miracles
description: Embark on a mission to save the world from the god of chaos in this exploration-focused metroidvania! Explore a world full of lost secrets, make new friends, and use strange creatures to your advantage to reach new heights!

title: Marvel Adventures
description: This mod for Freedom Force v The Third Reich features a massive roster of both heroes and villains, including most characters you can imagine that were around by the end of the Bronze Age. This mod has everyone from the most famous, like Spider-Man, to the deservedly obscure, like Stilt-Man. It also features multiple universe-spanning adventures, full campaigns that you can play with different teams of heroes.

title: Décapita
description:
An ordinary evening interrupted by a discovery that could change the course of humanity.

Do you believe in free will?

A short visual novel with one choice created for the Stop Killing Games JAM 2025.

title: Kalterkrieg
description: An alternate history mod for Hearts of Iron IV by Paradox Interactive that asks the question: "What if Germany had won the First and Second World War?"

title: Novum Vexillum
description: This mod spans the modern era from 2000 to 2032, built on the 2018 Millennium Dawn files. It serves as an enhanced version with modernized features while preserving the streamlined, vanilla-inspired feel of the original and most popular Modern Day mod. It also includes full DLC compatibility, including support for the Man the Guns ship designer.

title: StarCraft II: Campaign Collection
description:
The fate of your people rests in your hands, commander. Lead your forces to ultimate victory across the far-flung battlefields of the future, or reap defeat and devastation at the hands of terrifying, alien foes.

StarCraft II is the pinnacle of real-time strategy gaming. Challenge your cunning, tactical thinking, and unbreakable will as you command three unique armies in intense conflicts across the stars.

● Master the art of war as the ever-adaptable Terrans, who rely on mechanized infantry and rugged, versatile tech to take on whatever the universe throws at them.
● Devour your enemies as the unstoppable Zerg swarm, whose ravenous hunger to consume, evolve, and dominate makes them a terrifying threat.
● Wield power overwhelming as the enigmatic Protoss, an elder race of psionic warriors with a frightful edge thanks to their advanced technology and alien mysticism.

The Campaign Collection includes the complete story of StarCraft II, an epic space opera spanning three massive campaigns that will put your leadership skills to the test and task you with growing your forces as the plot unfolds.

title: Red Dusk
description: Red Dusk is a Game Mod for Hearts of Iron IV that imagines a world where the August Coup succeeded and kept the Soviet Union surviving past its historical dissolution. Limping past the 90s, the Soviet Union deals with factionalism and the risk of economic collapse, while the United States experiences internal strife from the sudden rise of the Reform Party and the indecisive of President Quayle.

title: War of the Ring
description: An Imperator: Rome mod that tailors its mechanics to work with the Middle-earth world. Units, portraits, races, graphics, missions, and events have all been overhauled.

title: Imperator: Invictus
description: Imperator: Invictus is a collaborative effort by the Imperator modding community. The primary aim of this mod is to enhance the flavour of the game adding content and balance challenges to enrich the immersive experience.

title: Frontier Mech: Ash Walkers
description: Frontier Mech: Ash Walkers combines TPS combat with tower defense in a post-apocalyptic world. Pilot powerful mechs, build and upgrade defenses, and fend off insectoid invaders. Collect resources, enhance your mechs, and tackle challenging missions in this action-packed strategy game.

title: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG
description: Travel through over 10 different biomes, catching over 90 different kinds of fish. Collect different rods, level up, and try to fill your Fish Encyclopedia. Experience a story-rich narrative filled with a fun and unique cast while exploring a Lovecraftian-ridden sea.

title: Derpy Fish
description: Derpy Fish is a casual puzzle/adventure game where you guide a small school of fish with different abilities.

title: Touhou: Fearless Frogslayer
description: Follow Cirno in this RPG adventure as she travels across Misty Lake and beyond, fighting fierce amphibious opponents, all to fulfill her contractual obligations to a certain disguised figure...

title: Ellie's Farm 5: Long Journey - Collector's Edition
description: Visit the great Australian outback, where you must use your expert time management skills to help Ellie restore a farm ravaged by droughts, floods, and local bullies. Care for wildlife, rebuild the land, and embrace high-tech upgrades to secure a brighter future.

title: Ellie's Farm 3: Flood Proofing - Collector's Edition
description: Join Ellie as she works to rebuild a region ravaged by powerful floods and power outages caused by malicious sabotage. Help her navigate treacherous terrain and uncover the mysteries behind the destruction.

title: Ellie's Farm 4: Guardians of the Wild - Collector's Edition
description: This time management game challenges you to save a nature reserve under siege. As rare animals disappear and poachers take over, Ellie must confront corrupt forces to protect the wildlife.

title: Ellie's Farm: Forest Fires - Collector's Edition
description: The Northern Woods are the perfect place for a writer, Ellie, to get inspiration and start a new life. But, the woods have been devastated by frequent fires, sick wildlife, and a declining local economy. Help Ellie manage resources, save the woods from danger and build the home of her dreams.

title: Ellie's Farm 2: African Adventures - Collector's Edition
description: Ellie is called upon to help a forest ranger struggling with poachers. But, she soon realizes that this is not the only challenge to overcome. With forests burning and endangered animals at risk, Ellie needs your help more than ever.

title: Channel Surfing
description: You’ve always been watching, but what happens when the screen watches back? Channel Surfing is a mysterious desktop idle game disguised as a retro TV. Click, spin, pop, and discover unique gameplay on each channel as you progress.

title: Vita: The Ember Oracle
description: Dive into Vita: The Ember Oracle, where the city of Pando is torn by zealous dogma and a terrifying prophecy. Follow Sin-Nul's story of self-discovery and understanding of beliefs, as he fights to unravel a conspiracy threatening to destroy the Ever Flame.

title: Crown of the Empire: Timeloop - Collector's Edition
description: Crown of the Empire: fun adventures await! The queen needs your help!

title: Knight in Time
description: In this bullet hell odyssey, Claymore, the time travelling knight, must save the world with his limited understanding of how guns work. He must uncover the mystery of the future. You will uncover the truth of it all. We eagerly await your response.

title: Hexed Time
description: Play as a witch living in secret among villagers in this hand-drawn narrative puzzle adventure. An attempt to change fate traps her in a time loop. Help the witch and her cat escape without getting caught by the inquisition. Your choices shape the outcome.

title: Warframe: The Old Peace
description: Those glory days, long since reduced to ashes, are now preserved in the purest of resins. This exhibit commemorates our glorious landing on Tau: that deep and wonderful coast, that grand orokin project, now obscured by the vile sabotage of its solar rail.

title: Rescue Simulator 2014
description: Manage vehicles, personnel and your ambulance station in this simulation game. Experience realistic operational scenarios and keep track of your team with the detailed city map. Every second counts!

title: Royal Envoy: Campaign for the Crown - Collector's Edition
description: Someone wearing a black cloak broke into the royal palace. The stranger was fearful and grim, and challenged the King's right to the throne. He accused the King of being unable to manage the kingdom, and demanded to be elected King himself! Help the King win the elections in this time management game.

title: Monument Builders: Statue of Liberty
description: Discover the New York of yesteryear and take part in the building of the iconic Statue of Liberty. Produce the metal and wood required to keep the building site functioning. Improve the roads to quickly transport materials to the job site and watch the statue evolve in real time as you progress through the game.

title: Aquascapes: Collector's Edition
description:
Explore the seek-and-find underwater world of Aquascapes. Take care of your finned friends and play with them, watching as they interact with each other and you. Engage in hidden object gameplay as you earn money to customize your tank and make your pets happy.

The collector's edition includes additional levels, wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art and decorations.

title: SpiritVale
description: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

title: Exit The Abyss
description: Exit the Abyss is a psychological horror game where you are trapped in an abandoned, haunted hospital. The game focuses on an oppressive atmosphere, exploration, and mysteries, with minimalist puzzle elements. Immerse yourself in a distorted reality, confront your fears, and find the way out!

title: A Recipe for Survival
description: Use two decks of cards to serve food to your customers during the day! Then fight them off when they turn to monsters at night in this fun and unique deckbuilding roguelike!

title: The Curse
description: "THE CURSE" is a horror mystery visual novel wearing the clothes of an MMORPG.

title: Scary Game
description: You open your eyes in a dark, unfamiliar room; each door drags you into a new chamber filled with absurd surprises and dark comedy. Will you manage to escape, or will you continue to star in this black comedy?

title: Blindfold
description: Blindfold is an asymmetric co-op game: one player is a blindfolded prisoner, the other a guide with a map and bodycam. Work together to escape, avoiding guards, traps, and creatures. Each level adds new hazards and dynamic weather. Communication is key.

title: Anno Domini 1259
description: Anno Domini 1259 is a total conversion mod meant to be enjoyed with Lemmy1916's Europe Campaign Map mod. The mod converts kingdoms, clans, nobles, settlements and troops to a 13th century Europe setting.

title: Yoshimi-kun wa Game Bakkari
description: A romance simulation game where you connect with a classmate you're interested in and build a relationship through online gaming. You can use your PC camera to video call Yoshimi-kun.

title: Banner Kings
description: Banner Kings is a suite of systems to deepen non-combat gameplay. It heavily revolves around settlement management and kingdom gameplay. Banner Kings draws ideas heavily from Paradox games, mainly Crusader Kings.

title: Eagle Rising
description: Eagle Rising mod for Bannerlord takes you to the ancient world with new weapons, armor, and unique combat mechanics.

title: Eastern Europe 1259
description: Set against the tumultuous backdrop of Eastern Europe in the mid-13th century, this mod plunges players into a period rife with conflict, cultural shifts, and significant historical events.

title: Empires of Europe 1100
description: Empires of Europe (EoE) 1100 is a historical overhaul set at the turn of the 12th century. The mod is centered around a large, custom built map that incorporates Europe, Eastern Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East.

title: Realm of Thrones
description: Total conversion mod for Mount & Blade 2 Bannerlord, which will change Calradia into Westeros and Essos from the HBO series, Game of Thrones. Hundreds of characters added, along with over twenty kingdoms from the Free Folk, north of the wall, to the Dothraki of the Great Grass Sea.

title: Realms Forgotten
description: Realms Forgotten is an overhaul mod that brings the World of Aeurth at the brink of dramatic events. Aeurth is a unique blend of culture styles and fantasy concepts and brings a campaign setting at the brink of dramatic events.

title: The Old Realms
description: The Old Realms is a fan made mod project for the game Mount & Blade: Bannerlord. We aim to capture the grim dark nature of the Warhammer Fantasy world with the intention of delivering the best possible experience for the player. The Old World will have the player meeting and fighting (Or WAAAAGHING!!) alongside legendary characters such as Karl Franz and Grimgor Ironhide, as well as exploring well known locations such as Karaz-A-Karak and Castle Drakenhof.

title: Shokuho
description: Shokuho is a complete overhaul mod set in feudal Japan. Every aspect of the game has been redone and overhauled completely to fit within the setting. Many new features have been added such as naval battles, enlisting with lords as a troop, promoting your troops to companions, looting the remains of a battle, dueling, and more!

title: Empires of Europe 1700
description: Empires of Europe 1700 is a Total Overhaul of Bannerlord, transforming the game into a historical conquest of Europe and the Middle East during the 18th century. Most vanilla items are gone, and replaced with muskets, sabres, and even field artillery! This mod is currently the only one of its kind, providing both a grand strategy campaign and first person 18th century warfare.

title: Burning Empires
description: Burning Empires is a full conversion mod, bringing you to the late roman era, at 374 AD, the start of the hunnic conquest of Europe. It features an expansive world map, encompassing the known world from Britannia to the frontiers of Asia.

title: American Civil War Mod: Revived
description: The American Civil War Mod: Revived is a complete overhaul for Mount & Blade: Warband, built on top of an old mod that ceased development, called "A House Divided".

title: Hispania 1200
description: It's year 1200 AD, war and peace are at stake in Spain. Both Muslims and Christians coexist, often fighting, always distrusting each other.

title: Struggle for the Iliac Bay
description: Struggle for the Iliac Bay is TES inspired fantasy mod for M&B Warband. Set after King Lysandus death but before the start of Daggerfall, this mod is centered around the Iliac Bay, allowing you to visit Hammerfell, High Rock and parts of Cyrodiil and Skyrim, where you can either help a kingdom to aquire hegemony or to carve your own domain in the province.

title: The Last Days of the Third Age
description: The Last Days of the Third Age is a full conversion mod for Mount and Blade Warband that brings the player into the world of Middle Earth. In this mod you must select a faction that you fight for and defeat all your enemies to win the war. There are some interesting side quests you can get from listening to rumours or from various commanders but the main goal is still to crush all your enemies and attain victory!

title: Wildseed
description: A relaxing game where you grow plants and attract creatures as you build your garden. Keep your creatures happy and your plants healthy, find rare variants, and discover the ancient secrets your garden holds - one seed at a time.

title: Muse Dash: Muse Plus
description: Purchasing the Muse Plus expansion allows you play all the currently available music packs (now including about 500 songs). It also unlocks most characters, elfins, title screens, and illustrations in the game. Muse Plus and music packs are not cross-platform purchases.

title: Muse Dash: Just as Planned
description: This now-delisted expansion unlocked all music and other content in Muse Dash. "Just as Planned" was replaced by "Muse Plus" when premium collaboration music packs like Hatsune Miku were released.

title: Touhou: Fading Illusion - Underworld Chapter
description: This chapter is narrated by Rin Kaenbyou, Satori Komeiji and Seija Kijin. Join them on a journey full of medical examinations, epidemiological investigations and revolutionary slogans.

title: Agefield High: Rock the School
description: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s and you have three months left at school. So REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school!

title: Dreamscapes: The Sandman - Collector's Edition
description: Save Laura from her nightmares and help her wake up in this hidden object puzzle adventure. Collector’s Edition extras include 15 additional locations, concept art, wallpapers, screensavers and original soundtrack.

title: World of Vasnar
description: World of Vasnar is a dark fantasy mod with a mixed 18th century gothic ashtetic inspired by the artworks and lore from settings such as Innistrad, Bloodborne, Greedfall and classic gothic tales.

title: Warsword Conquest
description: Warsword Conquest is a fan-made fantasy complete-overhaul modification for TaleWorld Entertainment's Mount and Blade: Warband based on Game Workshop's Warhammer Fantasy. It features many factions, legendary lords and heroes, magic and endless war for your delight.

title: A World of Ice and Fire
description: Be prepared to create your own house and challenge the Seven Kingdoms in this adaptation of Game of Thrones. A gritty world awaits you full of treachery and traitorous kings, lords and knights. Will you survive the slaughter and take the Iron throne, or will you succumb to the traitorous ways that goes forth in Westeros and Essos.

title: Little Amazon
description: Join Lily as she flees the cursed lair of the horrible demon Grûûl. Use the exceptional agility and extraordinary abilities of an amazon to run as far as possible! Jump from hill to hill, go around the creatures of the forest and destroy them using your destructive powers.

title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Vocaloid Songs Collection
description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo.

Vocaloid Songs Collection contains 9 songs: "Good-bye Declaration", "Lagtrain", "Luka Luka★Night Fever", "Lower one's eyes", "DARLING DANCE", "Yoidore Shirazu", "ASUNO YOZORA SHOKAIHAN", "Venom (feat. flower)" and "A Tale of Six Trillion Years and a Night".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.

title: Star Wars: Conquest
description:
Star Wars: Conquest is a Mount&Blade; module which transforms a medieval world into the far, far away galaxy... With the same premises than the original game, this module offers an open sandbox where the player can do anything he wants.
Based on a Galactic map and hundreds of planets.

title: The Swarm 2
description: Destroy bosses one after another in this fast-paced and dynamic abyssal bullet hell.

title: Wiffleball Legends
description: Swing for the fences and become a backyard hero! Throw insane curve balls and other crazy wiffleball pitches in this 4v4 wiffleball game! Build your dream team to win a championship in season mode, crush home runs in a home run derby mode and lead your team to the national championship in Story Mode

title: Perisno
description: Perisno is a total conversion light fantasy mod based in the fictional land of Perisno. Encounter unique factions, races, unexpected events, and discover unique opportunities!

title: Faceball Captain
description: This game is a sports management roguelike deckbuilder. Craft a team of players, power them up, and try to keep them match-fit. Hire staff to bend the rules of the game in your favor, and discover overpowered combos to rise to the top of the Faceball pyramid.

title: Paintball Madness
description: Paintball Madness is a super fun, fast game where you play paintball with friends. Pick a mode-play all by yourself (Free-for-All) try to grab the other team’s flag (Capture the Flag) or team up to win battles (Team Deathmatch). The faster you move, the more you win, have fun and no place to hide.

title: Polariball
description: Prepare to master magnetism! Polariball is an arcade action game where you must wield the power of polarity to smash targets, grab power-ups, and keep time at bay. Keep an eye out for those pesky sawblades!

title: Crazy Robot Ball
description: Step into the thrilling world of Crazy Robot Ball, the ultimate turn-based football showdown. Take command of a team of high-tech robots, each with unique attributes designed to give you the edge in the battle for robotic football supremacy.

title: Anno Domini 1257
description: This mod attempts to reflect the reality of 13th century Europe. The starting point of the journey is year 1257 AD and attempts to be as historically accurate as possible. From this point on the player and NPC lords shape this land and fight for supremacy and control of the continent.

title: Dodgeball Blast
description: A lighthearted, action-packed boss rush game where you dodge, catch, and throw your way through epic battles. Take on challenging bosses, each with unique abilities, as you aim to become the ultimate Dodgeball Master.

title: Barrel Baller
description: A 3D platformer where you take control of v806 autonomous hauler unit across different planets. Your goal is to deliver cargo to hard-to-reach locations.

title: Conan Chronicles 1
description: This Campaign is set in the Hyborian World of Conan and consists of a three-part adventure, \"The Legions of the Dead\", \"The Scythian Pits\" and \"The Thing in the Crypt\" and includes custom races, feats, deities, monsters, music and items to fit a Hyborian setting. Play as Conan or as your own Hyborian hero starting their first adventure.

title: Conan Chronicles 2
description: These are the second chronicles set in RE Howard's world of Conan and they are suitable for one or more PCs of around 15-17th level, either pre-existing PCs who completed Conan Chronicles 1 or new PCs who can be autoleveled at the start of the game.

title: Little Folk of Faery
description: Discover a small village of fairy creatures and embark on a fascinating adventure. What is behind the mysterious, omnipresent mist? What secret lies behind the wistful spirits who are now roaming the place? With the help of fairies, solve these mysteries though numerous quests and restore your shop’s splendor.

title: Harp & Chrysanthemum
description: Harp and Chrysanthemum is a fan-made module for Neverwinter Nights 2, created by Maerduin, that stands out for its emotional storytelling, cinematic flair, and exceptional area design.

title: Edain Mod
description: The Edain Mod is an total conversion mod for the Rise of the Witch-King that expands greatly on every aspect of the game using the lore and that uses the Battle for Middle-Earth 1 fixed plots building system.

title: Chemical Combat
description: A chemistry-themed roguelike in which you fight your way through procedurally generated dungeons, splashing enemies with highly reactive potions.

title: Legacy of the Dragonborn
description: “Legacy of the Dragonborn” creates a sizeable addition to your Skyrim game by providing a fully featured museum in Solitude, and with the help of the curator Auryen Morellus, you can store, display and utilize your entire collection as you see fit, all the while being aided and guided by Auryen in between your adventures. Auryen acts as a quest hub for the numerous stages of the “Shattered Legacy” questline, and also offers a variety of rewards for filling the museum displays. There are several more quests linked to the museum that, upon completion, will provide even more items for display. Patrons will also tour your collection and provide donations on a regular basis which you can collect.

title: Medieval Kingdoms Total War: 1212 AD
description: Medieval Kingdoms 1212 AD is a comprehensive mod for the Total War: Attila game, transforming it into a medieval setting focused on the year 1212. It offers a highly detailed and immersive experience with numerous playable factions, unique units, and historically accurate features. The mod is popular among Total War fans as a potential vision of what a Medieval 3 title could be.

title: Evolver
description: Explore the mysteries of evolution in Evolver. By helping the adorable little creatures evolve, you will find yourself at the center of evolution in three different worlds. Match up three or more creatures to create and unlock new species. Each one even crazier than their ancestors!

title: Age of Anthemius
description: Set in 471 AD, the mod portrays the twilight of the Roman Empire amidst rising barbarian kingdoms and internal decay. You play through a custom campaign featuring political strife, epic military clashes, and power struggles across the Roman world—from Italy and Gaul to Britannia and the East.

title: Spooky's Jumpscare Mansion Plus
description:
Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion PLUS is finally out!

This is only an Endless Mode Beta, but it still adds an insane amount of features, specimens, rooms, bug fixes, modes, Easter eggs, and more!

title: Divide and Conquer
description: Divide and Conquer (DaC) is a extensive mod for Medieval II: Total War, set in the world of Tolkien's Lord of the Rings. It builds upon the Third Age: Total War mod, expanding and refining various aspects of the gameplay, including factions, units, and campaign mechanics.

title: Finn and Jake's Epic Quest
description: Team up as Finn and Jake in a 3D adventure of epic proportions! The Land of Ooo has been transformed into a giant video game, and BMO has been kidnapped. Brawl your way through the Witch's garden, Ice Kingdom, Fire Kingdom, and even the Land of the Dead itself to rescue BMO and uncover the evil mastermind!

title: Third Age: Total War
description: Third Age: Total War is a total conversion modification for the PC-game Medieval II: Total War by Sega that brings the world of Middle-earth. It changes the map of Europe, North Africa and the Middle East to an extensive historically accurate map of Middle-earth as it was in the Third Age, while retaining the turn-based strategic gameplay and real-time battles of the original.

title: Westeros: Total War
description: Westeros: Total War is a total conversion mod for the game Medieval II: Total War. It transforms the game into a Game of Thrones-themed experience, allowing players to control various factions from the series and battle for control of Westeros.

title: Hispania in the Middle Ages
description: This mod is about the Middle Ages in the Iberian peninsula. It includes a total of 24 factions and four campaigns on different periods.

title: Insularis Draco
description: INSULARIS DRACO is an overhaul of 2014’s Invasio Barbarorum II: Conquestu Britanniae. The setting of our main campaign: North-Western Europe, 452 AD. From Pictland in the North to the Alps in the South, from Ireland in the West to Jutland in the East.

title: Lucium Total War
description: Lucium Total War is a mod for Medieval II: Total War that transforms the game into a 18th-century experience. It features two campaigns: one set in Europe and another in South America. The mod aims to immerse players in the pike and shot era with the emergence of line infantry, offering a wealth of historical context and unique gameplay mechanics.

title: Stainless Steel
description: A combination of bug fixes, many small mods, better AI and AI armies, more provinces, graphical improvements and many other campaign and battle map changes. The whole game offers now a much greater challenge!

title: The Dawnless Days
description: The Dawnless Days is a total overhaul mod for Total War: Attila based on the Tolkien Legendarium. The project brings to life the peoples, places and events of Tolkien's world loved and cherished by fans all around the world, and is set in the time of the great wars of the final years of the main books.

title: Broken Crescent
description: Broken Crescent is a M2TW total conversion modification centered on the Middle East starting from 1174 and concluding in 1300. Featuring a gorgeous new campaign map spanning from Anatolia to India, Broken Crescent allows you to take control of over 18 brand new factions all complete with over 300 new artistically crafted warriors ready to do you bidding!

title: Tsardoms: Total War
description: Tsardoms: Total War is a total modification for M2TW Kingdoms set in late middle ages, featuring a campaign centered on Italy, Balkans and Asia Minor. The reason we decided to make a mod like this is, firstly because we are familiar with the history of the region, and secondly (and most importantly) because this part of the world has pretty much been ignored by TW games and mods and we thought it would be fun to play and learn from it.

title: Thera: Legacy of Great Torment
description: Thera gives M2TW players a breath of fresh air by providing them with a whole new strat map portraying a whole Other world which has it's own mysteries buried in the shadows of time. Thera contains a tempting package of 21 new factions never seen or heard before which includes factions like Romano, Mythical, Chivalric, Post renaissance factions. In addition it gives new battle models and strat models to characters and agents in the game which are graphically supreme and better suited to the world of Thera.

title: Last Alliance: Total War
description: Last Alliance: TW is overhaul mod to Shogun 2. This mod base on stories from Tolkien's books, concretely on wars Dúnedain and Elves against Sauron at the end of the Second Age.

title: Dei Agminum
description: Dei Agminum (Armies of God) is an ambitious mod project aimed at becoming the premiere Medieval II Total War Crusades mod. Its origins can be traced back to the Broken Crescent Submod "Jersualem Rising". It will use the Crusades campaign from Kingdoms as a base but will in time morph into its own distinct entity. For now I will concentrate on revamping the Crusades campaign through this mod. This will include renaming existing units, settlements and factions with their historical names, introducing historically accurate buildings and new units and completely remaking unit art/UI (models, textures, banners, screens and etc.) and introducing other assets.

title: Rinne Tenshou
description:
Bullet Hell Doujin about magical kawaii girls
It features a stoic system in which there are no bombs and bullets must be avoided by memorizing their patterns.
The characters are based on the manga "Kurukururinne" by Iwaoka Meme (unpublished in book format), which was serialized in the magazine "Shogaku Ichinensei" between 2002 and 2003.

title: Divide et Impera
description: Divide et Impera (DeI) is a comprehensive overhaul mod for Total War: Rome II, aiming to create a more challenging, historically authentic, and immersive experience. It significantly expands the game with thousands of new units, intricate campaign mechanics, and revamped battle systems.

title: Penny for Your Potion
description: Welcome to Penny for Your Potion! Customize your shop, manage your garden and brew potions for your customers to discover new ingredients, recipes and secrets in this medieval management game. Build the store of your dreams, grow your reputation and become the greatest alchemist in history!

title: Total War: New World
description: Total War: New World is a massive overhaul mod for Rome 2, along the lines of DeI and Radious. Instead of being focused on historical events, it takes place in an alternate reality of the ancient world. With various new cultures, factions, effects, buildings, units, technologies, UI visuals, and major overhauls to the campaign and battle AI, this’ll be a new experience for even the most hardcore Total War players!

title: The Fourth Age: Total War
description: The Fourth Age: Total War is a modification for 'Rome: Total War - Barbarian Invasion' (v1.6). Our aim with FA:TW was to accurately portray the lands and peoples of Middle-earth as we think they existed approximately three-and-a-half centuries into the Fourth Age. It is based on the works of Tolkien, and especially on his unfinished and abandoned sequel to 'The Lord of the Rings', entitled 'The New Shadow'. With an aim to staying true to the works and spirit of J.R.R. Tolkien's world of Middle-earth, whilst also aspiring to original creative excellence, 'The Fourth Age: Total War' is a must-have for anyone who loves the setting and peoples of Tolkien's mythic world.

title: The Lord of the Rings: Total War
description: The Lord of the Rings: Total War is a Total Conversion for Alexander TW based on The Lord of the Rings trilogy, focused to recreate the epic battles seen in the movies. It has a complete Middle Earth map, fully customised cities like Minas Tirith and Helm's Deep on Battle and Campaign map, a set of Historical Battles where you can play all the major and minor battles that take place in the trilogy, and a quest line for the Free-People's campaign where, if the player succeeds, will take the Ring-Bearer from Hobbiton to the wasteland of Mordor in an attempt to save the world from its doom.

title: Basileia Romaion 1736
description: Set over a century before the familiar age of industry, this is an era of awakening: of steam and scripture, of conquest and reform, of fading traditions and revolutionary fire. It is a time when legacies are reforged, when borders shift and faiths evolve, and where the clash of ideals defines the course of civilization. Inspired by Roman glory, medieval splendor, and Renaissance ambition, Basileía Romaíon invites you to reshape a living, breathing world. Depth, balance, and historical imagination lie at its core.

title: Cold War Era
description: The Cold War Era mod (CWE) brings Victoria 3 into the Cold War era and beyond. This mod contains a slew of special features such as nuclear war systems, dynamic international organisations and decolonisation chains to accurately simulate the Cold War and Post-Cold War world. Politics and the economy have also been completely overhauled to allow the game engine to represent the modern era.

title: Iwakutsugi
description: This is the third horror adventure game from TEAM SHINZA. Players progress through the game by writing comments while watching videos of [problem properties] being investigated.

title: Divergences
description: The Divergences mod for Victoria 3 significantly alters the game's starting conditions and history by introducing numerous points of divergence from the historical timeline. It features a revamped world map with new nations, cultures, events, and decisions, offering a fresh and alternative historical experience.

title: Pax Hispanica
description: Pax Hispanica is an alternate history mod where the War of Spanish Succession never occurred. As a result, you can play in a scenario where the Spanish Empire still exists as a hegemonic power and experience what might have happened if the Hispanic modernity of the Salamanca School had prevailed as an alternative to liberal modernity.

title: Realms of Exether
description: Realms of Exether is a total conversion mod aiming to bring a D&D inspired fantasy world to Victoria 3. This includes myriad custom races such as elves, dwarves, dragons, naga and gnolls with unique racial mechanics. The ability to pursue magical-steampunk technology or the arcane arts and a plethora of new mechanics.

title: The New Order Victoria 3
description: This mod, inspired by its original Hearts of Iron IV counterpart, represents an exploration of an alternate Cold War scenario. We firmly denounce all hateful ideologies. This mod is not, under any circumstances, intended to idealize, promote or trivialize the ideologies or regimes that brought untold suffering to millions. We categorically reject any interpretation of this mod that serves as a platform for glorifying or fantasizing about such entities and their actions.

title: Cat Gunner
description: Claw your way through 5 action-packed worlds in this fast-paced 2D platformer-shooter! Upgrade your feline hero, battle bosses, and unlock minigames like Coconut Catch and Ice Climb. Master every level and top the leaderboards!

title: Saveseeker
description:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

title: Cloudwalkers
description: Cloudwalkers is a hilarious third-person shooter-platformer where you defend the cloud world from quirky alien invaders.

title: The Hamburger Isles
description: Join Mario (or anybody else other than peach for some reason) into a small tiny adventure full of 10 "Vanilla" Levels! Wart is up to no good again!

title: Super Mario and the Space Base
description: Bowser instead of capture Peach, he decides install a base in Space, preparing his next attack, not losing time, Mario was send to stop Bowser before he finish his plan.

title: Mycubium
description: Mycubium is a first-person 3D puzzle platformer where you grow bridges using mushrooms in a minimalist cubic world. Explore and solve spatial puzzles across shifting landscapes filled with secrets, platforming challenges, and evolving mechanics. Build your path as the day fades to night.

title: DarkShine
description: DarkShine is an open-world game with a classic graphical style, where you as a former soldier have to save the inhabitants of your village from the white queen and her army, going a long way from nobody to the savior of the world.

title: Ødeborg
description: Alone in a dark castle, you must find a way to escape. You will have to explore the castle grounds, find keys, solve puzzles, ans if worst comes to shove, you will have to use your gun. Be careful however. Your gun only fires one bullet at a time.

title: Sproutmart: Grocery Store Simulator
description: Run your own grocery store. Stock shelves, scan items at the checkout, and keep the store moving — solo or with friends. Farm, process, and fish for goods to expand what you can sell.

title: Yaoyoro Zoo
description:
Remote-control bats, toolbox hippos, clock owls... familiar items have transformed into adorable yet strange animals called ""Fanimals,"" living freely and happily!

Your mission as a caretaker is to deliver food to these Fanimals.

Navigate through 2D stages created within rooms, solve puzzles, and reach the food box.

title: Oh! Robot: Legendary Mechanic
description: A top-down shooting game where you board a robot and fight against runaway robots. We invite you to the shooting chaos! Robot boarding complete! Let's go!

title: Way of Robot
description: Way of Robot is a Turn-Based RPG. Join three robot companions on a journey to find life in a destroyed world. 14 Job Classes, 100 abilities. The map changes with every playthrough, new treasures, events, and enemies await, fully customize your party to survive.

title: Amy Hates Robots
description: AI has possessed everything. Toasters, telephones, and trash cans have come alive and want you dead. Fight back with a bizarre array of weapons, from bouncy balls to banana guns. Battle through deadly arenas and make strange allies in this action roguelike, as you uncover an apocalyptic conspiracy.

title: Robot Beekeeper
description: A sci-fi game where you help restore collapsed ecosystems on an alien planet. Raise and breed bees, grow native plants from bee produce and automate production as you stabilise the planet's ecosystems.

title: Dark Hunter: Ge Youma no Mori
description:
This game is the sequel to Dark Hunter (Jou) Ijigen Gakuen. In the game you can select one of the three main characters (Mariko Kayano, Ran Mashimo & Cher Mulligan). The PSX game is fully voice acted. 2 language interaction (Japanese or English), perfect speech dubbing free conversation. It's possible to select speech choice.
The game is an interactive comic adventure, since to advance in the adventure part the player just have to select one answers of the possible ones. There are some action levels made using 3D graphics.

title: This is Just the Beginning
description: “This is just the beginning” is an arcade-style minigame roguelike where you navigate a gauntlet of fast-paced challenges — each inspired by some of the most iconic video game intros.

title: The TimeBuilders: Caveman's Prophecy
description: Explore a forgotten time when dinosaurs ruled the earth in this time management game. Guide your tribe out of their cave and into the world. Discover new lands filled with dinosaurs, carnivorous plants, and mischievous saber-toothed kittens. Use all your skills to manage your people, build houses, and gather resources while creating awesome inventions to help your people.

title: Silmarils Collection
description: This is a collection of sixteen games presented by DotEmu.

title: World's Greatest Temples Mahjong
description: Learn about the great temples of the world as you play mahjong. This game features seven different game modes and multiple levels.

title: Spatial Dip
description: Scale into ever-smaller nested worlds. Shrink into your spaceship's mechanisms. Uncover the fractal worlds within and meet the zany goobers who call them home. Track down the root of the system errors, whether by replacing old gears or getting Grandma Beetle's bakery back in business.

title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Pops Collection
description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo.

The Pops Collection is a large music pack with 14 songs. It contains "Star mine", "TT", "OTONABLUE", "Kawaikute Gomen", "Haru wo Tsugeru", "Dance Hall", "PLASTIC LOVE", "MAYONAKANO DOA-STAY WITH ME", "S’il vous President", "phony", "Habit", "Odo", "bad guy" and "Usseewa".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.

title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Anime Songs Collection
description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo.

The Anime Songs Collection contains 9 songs: "Aozora No RHAPSODY", "Monster", "I'm invincible", "GO!!!", "God knows...", "New Genesis", "Dai Zero Kan", "Chu, Tayousei" and "RPG".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.

title: The Silent Jungle
description: The Silent Jungle is a classic survival horror game set deep within the haunting jungles of Vietnam. After a brutal ambush, a lost American soldier must survive in a cursed jungle filled with lethal traps and haunting illusions. To escape, he must uncover its dark secrets and break the curse.

title: Delta 78
description: A crew member wakes up alone on a silent ship. Something is wrong. Something is watching. Delta 78: The Passenger is a dark sci-fi experience with interactive storytelling and stealth gameplay.

title: XOL: Space Mech Wars
description: Mech FPS game in Space Fight in all directions of space, follow the story and contribute to the space wars of your homeland! Survive as an up-and-coming soldier with the toughest warriors around!

title: Auto-Land: Mechanical Horror
description: Welcome to AUTO‑Land, an autonomous amusement center abandoned and transformed into a horrific death trap filled with robotic abominations. Armed with an arsenal of unorthodox weapons and gadgets, you must fight your way through this survival‑horror experience and escape AUTO‑Land in one piece.

title: Mechxis War: The Rise of AI
description: Emma: "Humanity stands on the edge of extinction. As the commander of AlphaRobo, Earth’s ultimate war machine, you’re our final defense. The rogue AI is back, stronger than ever. Upgrade your mech, unlock powerful abilities, and lead the charge to save us all. We are waiting for you, Commander."

title: Mechs and Muskets
description: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

title: Mech Log Zero
