description: Take control of a mechanized pilot and its Mech. Blast through Colossal Machines and secure the last remnants of life inside a dying God.

title: Lux Leonarii: A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
description: A puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

title: Mechanical Throb
description: Mechanical Throb is a story-driven puzzle adventure game. Explore a glamourous futuristic world and uncover the secrets of its biggest medical engineering company.

title: Arcade Empire Tycoon
description: Build and manage your own arcade, attract customers, and grow your empire in Arcade Empire Tycoon!

title: Mechanic Beyond the Horizon
description: In "Mechanic Beyond the Horizon" , you’re the heart of a bustling space station. Repair warships, fuel luxury liners, and tackle cosmic challenges. Manage resources, upgrade facilities, and boost your reputation. Every decision shapes your future in this fast-paced, interstellar adventure!

title: Asgard's Edda: Mechanical Threat
description: Asgard's Edda: Mechanical Threat is an action shooter. Play as one of Asgardian descendants, battling the ancient Architect and his nanobot army. Explore diverse locations, use heavy machine guns and traps in tactical combat, and upgrade your character in a rich mythological universe.

title: Mechanical Mayhem
description: Pilot your swift combat bot through relentless bullet hell arenas. Upgrade your lethal robot with parts collected from futuristic dungeons for new ways to kill in this twin stick shooter.

title: AstroCore Mining
description: Welcome to the harsh reality of space capitalism. Profit is everything, and you’re expendable. Extract resources, meet quotas, and survive; whatever it takes. But beware: failure isn’t just a setback, it’s a death sentence. How far will you go in this brutal frontier?

title: Lead The Dragon
description: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.

title: Finding Dragons
description: Find cute dragons hidden in a fully hand-drawn interactive scene.

title: Dragon Rancher
description: A dragon ranching sim where you find, hatch, raise, and care for your dragons while building a home in a ruined world. Breed dragons, explore the land, and grow your ranch in this cozy creature care adventure.

title: Sunken Dragon
description: This is a retro 8-bit pixel-style RPG. The game features turn-based combat, inviting players to explore the unknown in a fantastical world.

title: Green Ember: Helmer in the Dragon Tomb
description: Swords up! Level up your character, solve puzzles, and defeat bosses in this Bunny Brawler Dungeon Crawler, set in the world of the best-selling Green Ember series.

title: Bodacious Blasteroids
description: A fast paced arcade shooter where firepower is everything. Build a rotating arsenal of devastating weapons and obliterate waves of evolving enemies. Upgrade your weapons into screen-clearing powerhouses and form unique combinations of weapons to score the most points.

title: Mage Blast
description: Forge arcane might in this semi-idle deckbuilder! Craft spells layer by layer—turn a simple fireball into a barrage of flaming meteors. Build a deck of modifiers to trigger explosive combos, explore ancient realms for rare resources, and stitch together magic unlike anything the world has seen.

title: Dungeons 4: Tales from the Campfire
description: Stay a while and listen by the fireplace, while Thalya, Tristan and the ever-eloquent Narrator live through the true horror of soothing the sleepless miniature version of the Absolute Evil, Gorgu, in Dungeons 4 - Tales from the Campfire.

title: Skyfire: Death From Above
description: Build and upgrade your flying castle, defend yourself against enemy hordes and explore a medieval post-apocalyptic world. Experience the fusion of Bullet Heaven, and real time strategy. In a world where machines have taken over, mankind has taken to the skies.

title: Echoes of the Skyfire
description: A character-driven role-playing game where you choose and shape your protagonist, align with a faction, and influence relationships with your party companions, romance, and fate. Engage in epic turn-based battles, travel through time, and explore legendary kingdoms.

title: Fire Me, I Insist
description: Workplace efficiency is at an all time low at Bog-Standard Solutions. You've been hired to sniff out inefficiencies and get rid of the rabble. Trouble is, everyone's up to something. Collect evidence, listen to gossip and tattle on your colleagues.

title: Bonfires of Azure
description: Embark on a cozy journey to settle and thrive on floating islands in the remnants of a ruptured world. Grow your village, manage resources, and become the renowned pioneer of the clouds. A relaxing city-building experience where you build and optimize your serene sanctuary in the skies.

title: World's Greatest Cities Mahjong
description: Learn about the greatest cities in the world while playing mahjong. This features multiple game modes, many levels and special power-up tiles.

title: The TimeBuilders: Pyramid Rising
description: Assistant to the Royal architect Senmut, you have been appointed the daunting task of reconstructing villages and bringing hope to the people of Egypt. Only you can save them from banishment to eternal darkness by the mighty god, Amen-Ra. Hire workers, manage resources, build structures and gather stone in this time management game while fending off alligator attacks and more.

title: Dead Sea Scrolls
description: Dead Sea Scrolls is a vanilla compatible (comp -3) episode replacement for Ultimate Doom. The "story" is a schlocky adventure with the real life mystery of the Dead Sea Scrolls and Abrahamic mythology sprinkled on top. Emphasis is on varied, approachable gameplay with anything from puzzle, stealth, horror, to light slaughter.﻿﻿

title: Battleground
description:
Battleground brings classic grid board game play to the Nintendo Switch by using state of the art 3D UI game graphics while maintaining the original look and feel.

Your mission is to destroy your enemies tanks and artillery before it destroys yours. Deploy your tanks and artillery and then fire at your enemy using your grid screen to find and destroy their tanks and artillery before your tanks and artillery are taken out.

The first player to destroy all of the opponent's tanks and artillery wins the game. Play against either another player or against the smart Ai player, either way winning won't come easy.

title: Escape from Grustovia
description: The long-awaited draft notice has arrived, and besides the window, you have only one way out - to RUN. The main thing is to get out of the apartment before the draft notice page fully loads.

title: 2040World
description:
2040 World is a free-to-play third-person MMO action game with extraction-based gameplay. You play as a mercenary operator, remotely controlling synthetic avatars used by powerful transnational corporations to explore a vast artificial megastructure simply known as The Station.

The Station is an entire world, created by an unknown advanced civilization for mysterious purposes. Explore its biomes, uncover rare minerals, study alien flora and fauna — and fight your way through hostile environments in pursuit of power and profit.

But be warned: avatars are not immortal. If one is lost, you’ll need to spend resources to build a new one. Master all five avatar classes to find the one that fits your playstyle.
Discover over 30 unique weapons, divided into three damage types, and mix and match armor pieces to achieve maximum protection in combat.

The economy of 2040 World thrives on player interaction. Use the in-game marketplace to trade resources, weapons, and gear — and strengthen your position in the world.

title: Gumbo* and the Machine
description:
A 2D Tower Defense Shooter Platformer!
You play as Gumbo as you emerge from your MACHINE!

Buy Upgrades from chef peppino he isn't too happy about his demotion from main character to shop keeper but he may know secrets...

Go through 7 waves with a final boss or tough it out through the infinite gauntlet!

and you must. At all cost. Protect me.
I am what matters.
I am the genesis

I am the MACHINE!

title: Dream Mayday
description: You are "Dream Supporters" — protectors of dreams. Working together from two perspectives — dream and reality — you must ensure the peaceful sleep of residents through cooperative gameplay. Don’t miss any signs of disturbance, and team up to deliver a perfect night's rest by 9:00 AM!

title: Wa-shoi! Kamiokoshi
description: A 2D action game in which you use the two sticks on your controller to send the mikoshi into the sky in order to wake up the lazy god inside the mikoshi. Send the mikoshi flying, add up your score, and reach the target line to reach the goal!

title: Hop Drop
description: Hop Drop is a fast paced arcade game in 3rd Person. You're playing a Birdman on jumping stilts, delivering Organs in a futuristic city. Within a time-limit of 5 minutes you have to do as many deliveries as possible jumping from rooftop to rooftop or flying cars and any other object available.

title: Super World War
description:
The president of the world, Theorn BrunceWald, has died, leaving the position he held for many years vacant. It's time for the other leaders to take action for world domination, triggering a super world war!

Super World War is a strategy game on PC and Nintendo Switch in which you play as one of the 6 leaders in a story mode featuring 40 missions. Take control of your army and set out to conquer the world, whether it's for your father's pride, to bring peace and stability to the world, out of sheer madness or simply out of boredom.

title: Shelldiver
description: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!

title: Grim Pastures
description: Welcome to Grim Pastures! Rumors of a killer infiltrating the farm have shaken the town. Seasonal workers, unable to trust anyone, suspect their coworkers. With tension everywhere and danger lurking, survival means more than completing tasks—it’s about staying alive.

title: Chushpan Simulator
description: A game in which you have to go from an insignificant person to the king of the world.

title: The Abyssal Descent
description:
The Abyssal Descent is a brutal 2D platformer about falling—fast, deep, and without forgiveness.
Descend through 80 handcrafted pixel-art levels, each more surreal and punishing than the last.
There are no saves, no checkpoints, and no second chances.
Learn from your mistakes, dodge deadly traps, and try to survive the abyss.
Can you reach the bottom without breaking?

title: Factory Town 2: Paradise
description: A cozy city-builder where you craft and sell tropical items to keep villagers happy. Use conveyor belts, trains, zip lines, catapults, and boats to automate delivery, optimize production, and earn the favor of a giant sentient volcano.

title: Fallout: Bakersfield
description:
Fallout: Bakersfield, the new fan creation from Alexander and Denis Berezin using Doom Total Conversion.

A retro-inspired FPS using Doom Total Conversion, Fallout Bakersfield pulls from the classic Fallout aesthetic of Fallout 1 and Fallout 2 and carries with it the gunplay of Fallout 3 and Fallout 4, with a splash of original Doom.

title: A Few Quick Matches
description: A FEW QUICK MATCHES is a fast-paced, 1-4 player platform fighter that lets you bring old-school stick battles to life! play with your friends locally, or challenge players online in this flash-inspired spectacle!

title: Reverse Fishing
description: Reverse Fishing is a rage game all about jumping your way back to the ocean as fast as possible!

title: University of Problems
description: Student life is perhaps the most vivid, colorful, and memorable period of life for many of us. You start your adult life, feel unlimited possibilities, make a lot of new acquaintances. "University of Problems" is just about it.

title: Deemo: Reborn - Taiko no Tatsujin Collaboration Collection
description: The DEEMO -Reborn- Taiko no Tatsujin Collaboration Collection contains 5 songs and 25 charts.

title: Project Warfield Heroes
description: Warfield Heroes Project is an independent online game inspired by Battlefield Heroes.

title: Universal Wardrobe
description: This mod adds dozens of unique outfits and variants of both new and vanilla outfits, mostly to give a lot of uniqueness to the npcs of the game. You’ll be able to get these new clothing pieces in chests all around the universe, some of them well kept in the brand-new costume boxes. You will also find a new crafting table: the Customization Desk , where you can customize, combine and create clothing items along with new dyes.

title: Bees Reborn
description: Bees Reborn is a functional remake for Starbound 1.4.1. (...at least it's always worked for me xD) Just like StarBooze Reborn, it was originally intended for personal use and with friends.

title: Lost Luminosity
description: Lost Luminosity is a realistic psychological horror game with a linear storyline, immersing players in a dark narrative where the line between reality and madness slowly begins to blur.

title: Lostbound
description: Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

title: Dusttale: Non est Deus
description: This game is based off of Halo's Dusttale by Haloboi3. It's recommended that you play UNDERTALE before playing this game.

title: Backmooms
description: You’ve wandered into a strange dimension while shopping. A mysterious monster is chasing you, You must escape. "Backmooms" is a first-person adventure game.

title: Star Wars Battlefront II: Remaster
description: Star Wars Battlefront II: Remaster is a total conversion mod that will overhaul the maps, units, vehicles, weapons and effects of Battlefront II while preserving Online Compatibility and the integrity of the vanilla gameplay.

title: Tobenai Koi ha Tada no Koi
description: Control the carp and send it flying high into the sky! Control the Koi that swims automatically with one-button operation. Use fish in the water and birds in the air to reach higher!

title: The Sith Lords Restored Content Modification
description: This mod's intention is to restore much of the content cut from The Sith Lords, that was lost to the main game due to a rush to release the game. Its goal is to make the KotOR 2: TSL experience as close as possible as what Obsidian originally intended it to be.

title: Metamancer
description: Metamancer is a roguelike video game that uses procedural generation for every sprite, item, map and faction making for a unique playing experience each time!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Dubai
description: Discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in this hand-crafted Dubai landscape.

title: Firefly Haven
description: Firefly Haven is an incremental, short cozy game about catching bugs, collecting trophies, traveling to new locations and achieving greatness!

title: SamuelGame
description: Road trip game made in RPGMaker MV. You take control of a funny skeleton named Samuel on his quest to find who stole the Statue of Liberty. Featuring the Cat Who Says Bruh.

title: Slime In Abysm
description: A little slime got trapped deep in the abysm. can you help it reach the surface?

title: The Cleanup Crew
description: As part of the Cleanup Crew for The Company, you are designated to go in after we have detected an entrant dying to an Anomaly and retrieve vital components for us.

title: The Mirage Project
description: A first-person sci-fi horror game where you explore an abandoned research facility, travel through different timelines using a broken time machine, and uncover shifting, liminal spaces created by the Mirage. Survive evolving shadow-like entities and uncover the facility’s dark secrets.

title: Ironwing Valiant: Record of Astera
description: Ironwing Valiant is a fast-paced Mecha action-JRPG set in the fantasy world of Euridia! Taking the guise of a young mecha pilot named Reinhardt, you will battle through sleepy villages, imposing fortress cities, and war-scarred industrial centers!

title: Your Glass Heart in My Hands
description:
You are fast asleep.

You are drifting through the darkness: a seemingly endless abyss from which there is no escape.

There is nothing but the darkness: leagues and fathoms and feet of it...

But you were a person once, you know, before you found yourself in this sorry state. You had a name — perhaps you had several names — and thoughts of your own; feelings, too.

You had friends. A family, perhaps.

You had a life.

You might have had many lives.

You are one, yet you are many. Fragmented, your past dances behind your eyelids like shards of glass: sharp to the touch, and yet...

Will you reach out to touch these broken bits and pieces of your past?

Do you dare?

title: Ten Metre Tide
description:
Ten Metre Tide is a kinetic novel presented as two interlocking cycles of vignettes.
Features an original story, art, photography, embroidery, collage, and music by kazehai + ppilotco.

title: Kotou no Majo to Houtou Ouji
description: Hazameki Island, an isolated island floating in the ocean. One day, a box is delivered to the witch who was living a quiet life with her familiars. Emerging from inside was Phoenicia, the first prince of the Kingdom of Elpitlica. According to an old arrangement, the witch has 14 days to lead the others to the right place to be king. Exchanging words and spinning little by little as the days go by, a time just for the two of you.

title: Jampa Buggys
description: Jampa Buggys is a fast-paced local multiplayer racing game set on the breathtaking beaches of Paraíba, Brazil. Race through thrilling tracks, face exciting challenges, and immerse yourself in the vibrant local culture! Perfect for friends and family, with simple controls and endless fun!

title: Undertale: The Story of Kindness
description: Undertale: The Story of Kindness is a fan-made prequel to Undertale! You play as the fifth soul in the underground - a human named Fred! The soul of kindness!

title: Fit And Fry: Organized Chef
description: Cook with logic, fry with flair!

title: Mystic Pathways: Crystal Quest
description: Get ready to walk magical... and very confusing paths!

title: The Cursed Frog
description:
The Cursed Frog is a single-player puzzle-platformer with an enchanted twist: switch between a brave princess during the day and a cursed frog at night to overcome magical challenges in the heart of Witchwood forest.

Solve environmental puzzles, avoid treacherous traps, and use each form’s unique abilities to forge a path through 30 carefully crafted levels. The day-night shift mechanic changes not only the scenery but also the gameplay: jump higher as the frog to reach hidden areas, or fight enemies as the princess with ranged attacks and agile dashes.

Combine logic and reflexes to activate magic bridges, manipulate platforms, and discover secret routes in this ever-changing enchanted world. Each level brings new challenges that test your creativity and strategy.

title: I Want to Talk About My Friend
description: "I Want To Talk About My Friend" is a horror game based on ancient folklore, but it's also a tribute to some friends gone too soon.

title: Ball Blast
description: Dodge falling rocks and blast them all in this chaotic arcade shooter! Play solo or co-op, unlock wild cannons and power-ups, and survive endless waves of bouncing destruction!

title: Hyperspaced
description: Hyperspaced is a chaotic co-op space action game for 1-4 players. Working as a team, you and your fellow Space Cadets must save the Multiverse from collapsing. Slide into the pilot’s seat, operate turrets, become a mechanic or even a janitor on your quest to find the culprit who disturbed the balance of the Multiverse.

title: Teraslide
description: Play as Tulock, a snow fox, and help him progress through the different levels of this puzzle game based on movement on a hexagonal grid.

title: Darkest Cube
description: Darkest Cube fuses card games, roguelikes, and RPG elements – adapt your starting deck with cards gained from quests, and adjust your strategies to seal the mysterious Dark Cubes.

title: Re:D Cherish!
description:
In 206X, the resort island "Eleutheria" floats on the Adrishina Sea. The protagonist, Kusaka Yukimitsu, comes to an earthly paradise that advocates "freedom for all". Deprived of his work, his hometown, his beliefs, everything he once had up to that point...
There, Yukimitsu meets a gray-haired girl, Unica. She lost her father, and her cherished place of memories--the diner restaurant is in the hands of others and everything is taken away. Unica had a dream "I want to revive the diner".
Yukimitsu reaches out to her. I'll help you. So give me a dream.
This is Eleutheria. The city of freedom that has gone too far, the city of dreams where anything goes.
The preparation of the dishes is perfect, the kitchen is flawless. Spare magazines are enough, safety device is released.
"Everyone, are you all ready? Daft Dream Diner is now open...!"
--Eat and drink for those who are lost, may it be the food for tomorrow--

title: Genshin Impact: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
description:
The fifth major update of Genshin Impact, also known as Version "Luna I" and "Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue". This update includes:
• New characters: Lauma, Flins and Aino
• New region, Nod Krai
• New main story quests: "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves" and "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight"
• New main event: Clink Clank Clash
• 5th anniversary celebrations, new QoL, and more!

title: BlockBlasters
description:
This game has been flagged as containing malware, and has since been delisted.

Blast your way through waves of crab monsters in this action-packed 2D platformer! Armed with a powerful blaster, fight, dodge, and survive as you take down creepy crawlers and face off against relentless enemies in BlockBlasters!

title: Anomaly Rooms
description: A survival horror with anomaly hunting, where you’re trapped in a school classroom frozen outside of time. Find a way to escape. But remember: every choice you make carries unpredictable consequences.

title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
description: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

title: Service With a Shotgun
description: Service With a Shotgun [SWAS] is a mash up of visual novel storytelling and chaotic wave game shooting. You're the last poor soul manning a beat-up roadside shop in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Shoot straight. Talk fast. Surely nothing can go wrong. Right?

title: Noir Lords
description: Welcome to the Noir Lords! This fast-paced strategy card game puts you in the middle of an intense battle against a powerful enemy army. As an elite strategist, you’ll build your ultimate deck, outsmart ruthless opponents, and take down bosses in a gripping noir-inspired story.

title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan
description: A visual novel about living through a sudden and chaotic job loss, and making tough choices about your future. Based on the real-life experiences of foreign teachers living in Japan.

title: Touhou Kichouden: Mythos of Phantasmagoria 2
description: The second chapter of the Chuhou Joutai origin story.

title: Deathtouch
description: An open-world horror survival game where exploration leads to hidden secrets—and lurking nightmares. Uncover mysterious locations, navigate eerie environments, and survive terrifying encounters in a world that feels truly alive.

title: Tome Tumble Tournament
description: Master the bizarre art of enchanted book rolling in this 3D puzzle game. Discover unexpected ways to manipulate giant tomes to solve challenging conundrums.

title: Touhou Crawl
description: A Touhou derivative roguelike game. Conquer the dungeon-ified Gensokyo using items, faith, and tactics.

title: Kiyo: Bunny Tyranny
description: Control the body of Kiyo, a feline ex-predator trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. Discover their deepest secrets, and free everyone from their tyrannical grip in this stealthy platform adventure.

title: The Third Tourist
description: Possessed by a demon, hunted by a cult—sneak, scheme, and deceive your way through a deceptively sunny town in this no-guns stealth adventure.

title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
description: A fan-made roguelike action Touhou game. Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

title: Path of the Bogatyr
description: The Slavic land is under attack! Take on the role of a mighty bogatyr and help vanquish the enemy lizards in epic battles. Forge items, arm your hero, and become a folk legend!

title: Bounce 2
description: Bounce 2, the 1v1 Physics Based Digital Sport built with the warmth and comfort of 2D analog graphics, and the cold precision of modern computing and networking. Challenge your friends, together or online, in the Bounce Arena.

title: Snack Machine Change
description: A 10-minute story about a boy who is waiting at the hospital for his sister's check-up to be finished.

title: The National Library of Geometric Impossibilities
description: Shelve books in a paradoxical library.

title: On the Way
description:
In this Game you dive into a world of twisted minds as you embark on the search for a lost man.

In a classical Survival Horror Fashion in the First Person Perspective you will solve puzzles, will interact with the world and get to explore a handcrafted world! Manage your Inventory with care as you might not carry everything you collect at once. Fight off enemies with Melee and Range weapons you can find on your travels and experience the Stories of a once thriving place.

title: Gordy
description: Gordy is a First-Person Horror Comedy that follows a hermit in the woods who befriends a feral human and work together. As the months go by a darker energy begins to take hold of the forest and you have to question if Gordy is so trust-worthy after all or maybe you're the real monster.

title: Screwball
description: Screwball is a story-rich puzzle game built around crafting items. Hilariously voiced by a one-man cast, the game is hand-animated to appear as though you’re playing a cartoon strip, and offers hours of gameplay with more than 80 custom-tailored puzzles and over 500 craftable items.

title: Conquer The World
description: "Conquer the world" is a historical theme of live-action interactive film game. First-person immersive experience, super-long and massive endings,rich interaction with multiple gameplay. Here,you will cross the river of history, Against invaders!

title: Don't Mind the Robots
description: Build deadly mazes and outsmart a rogue AI in this strategic tower defense game. Adapt your defenses, use aiming parameters to your advantage, and activate powerful perks to survive increasingly complex waves of incoming robots.

title: Tiny Plushie Story
description: A cozy story-driven puzzle game that features relaxing puzzle mechanics, a heartfelt story and environment customization. Sort magical plushies, learn the history behind the mysterious Cresswell legacy and join Kaitlyn as she faces her past in Wickwood.

title: Castaway Trails
description: Explore, fight, and survive in a turn-based RPG with resource management and emotionally evolving characters throughout the journey.

title: The Devilry Reservation 2
description: Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of Slavic folklore and post-Soviet aesthetics. Escape the system, seek the truth among half-forgotten myths and urban legends. In this madness, every clue is part of someone else’s game, and your past is the greatest mystery.

title: Magnavis
description: Set in the depths of the Red Seas, Magnavis is a 1-4 player co-op submarine horror survival game. Manually operate grotesque ship systems powered by living organs, weld catastrophic leaks, and survive with your crew in an abyss where unknown terrors lurk in the absolute dark.

title: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
description: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

title: The Unseen Fears: Last Dance - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save the city from an otherworldly predator?

title: Yes, My Queen
description: The chess roguelite. Play game-changing cards, bend the rules, save your Queen, and escape from the dungeon.

title: Tsuri ni Ikou
description: An early Windows 95 fishing game with some customization, basic story and anime scenes, and a different partner girl who accompanies you depending on which style of fishing you choose. The game uses a mix of 2D art, 3D-rendered graphics, and photo sprites.

title: The Seven
description: "The Seven" is a single-player roguelike auto-battler where virtue and sin clash. Endless growth. One shot at survival. Lead your army through the eternal war between good and evil.

title: Another Day Off
description: Damon Gibbs, a cop on the verge of leaving it all behind, finds himself trapped in the nightmare of a city overrun by the infected. In this action-horror adventure, you'll explore haunting environments, face relentless foes, and uncover the dark truth behind the outbreak.

title: Tales from the Commonwealth
description: Tales from the Commonwealth adds over 20 quests, 125 NPCs, and three companions with over 1000 lines apiece to the game. In total, there are over 12,000 lines of dialogue.

title: June Bride Nightmare
description:
The most popular month to get married is during the summer, hence the name a "June Bride." For they say when you marry in June, you're a bride all your life. A wedding ceremony is supposed to bring good fortune and as the saying goes: "From that day onward, only happiness will follow."

However, it can easily be destroyed by uninvited misfortune. As for Yuno Minazuki, her love will never awaken again.

This game is made by IVORY DICE using RPG Maker VX Ace and it was released on June 24th, 2016. The American fan translation group, Memories of Fear, translated this game and released it on June 5th, 2017.

title: Elestrals Clash!
description: Elestrals Clash! is an innovative cross-platform digital card game that brings epic mythical beings to life! Players can wield elemental powers, explore diverse environments, and engage in strategic clashes wherever they are. Wishlist now to Ascend to Immortality and unlock exclusive rewards!

title: Petri Dish
description:
Petri Dish is an online browser game. No downloading or registration. Click and play. Instant immersion. This is the main principle of this game and what made it so popular - the greatest simplicity.

In the game, you are born on the map, gain weight and try to get to the top, like hundreds of other players. Gain weight, devour other players, be the strongest and the biggest. This is not just TOP-1, this is real domination!

title: Last
description:
The world is about to end. It's your last chance to let go of your fears and leave your mark on the world.

A short kinetic novel about existing outside of the gender binary, feeling like you're running out of time and embracing your desires.

title: Shadow Warren
description: You are a stranger, cast into the darkness of ancient mysteries. As a rabbit, you wander a world where nightmares lurk and rituals are part of an unfathomable game. Survive and follow the voice’s call—but remember: the true will of these powers is forever beyond your understanding.

title: Nocturnal Whispers
description: Solve the mystery behind bizarre nightmares in this immersive Full Motion Video Game.

title: Phylomortis: Avant-Garde
description:
Phylomortis: Avant-Garde is the third entry in the Phylomortis series of RPG Maker games, developed by RPG Advocate. It was created in RPG Maker XP.

The Ascension War caused chaos and havoc worldwide, plunging the various nations of the world into social and economic chaos. Even after an armistice was formally signed, the reconstruction and re-establishment of trust among nations was marred by terrorism and demands by dissident groups for a voice in the new world order.

Maia, a diplomat for the nation of Yatar, is abducted by a sect known as Corpus Negatis. Even twenty years later, when this story takes place, Maia's fate is still a looming question in the international community.

Amidst this backdrop of uneasy tension, Syeull, an employee of Cave Village Beckweth, a settlement for the destitute near the island of Kravit, is forcibly conscripted into the Kravit Authority. He is soon paired up with a schizophrenic former intelligence agent and sent to do Kravit's bidding under threat of Beckweth's extermination. Meanwhile, events unfolding in the socialist nation of Ehlison threaten to inflame the animosity between nations that have simmered below the surface since the conclusion of the Ascension War. Little does Syeull know that in doing the Authority's bidding, he will embroil himself in a much larger chain of world events that have implications far beyond Kravit's national security...

title: VeryVeryHouse
description: We moved into our new home.We talked about little things and laughed about little things.Then strange things started happening in the house.But even those kinds of surprises can be fun now and then."VeryVeryHouse" is an adventure game.

title: Zargog
description: A dark-fantasy horror RPG set in space. Confront the sorcerer-cult of Uhnin, a post-apocalyptic world drowned in miasma. Fight the undead, mutated creatures and raging elements. Discover shrines to power-up and build your character, and be weary of the dark agents hunting you.

title: PButtons
description: A puzzle game about the irresistible urge to push buttons. You can’t press the red ones — they must be activated indirectly. Use yellow AButtons to trigger clever mechanisms and solve each level. Satisfy your curiosity one forbidden button at a time.

title: Sunfinity
description: Sunfinity is a 2D idle farming game where you grow sunflowers, sell your harvest, upgrade your stats, and build a fully automated farm... all while Grandpa George gently grumbles at every click.

title: Lost Prototype
description: Lost Prototype is a walking simulator in which you have to find your way out of a maze under construction. But be aware, you're not alone in this place. Something is following you and wants to erase all your progress.

title: RazePact
description: A little soul named Soul is searching for answers in a mysterious dungeon. Facing several enemies along the way, she will learn more about the place and who she is. The game refers to classics and has a frenetic hack n' slash gameplay mixed with platforming.

title: Sonak
description: Sharpen your blade and unleash devastating elemental magic in Sonak, a third-person fantasy action RPG. Charge into adventure against relentless monsters, customize your build, craft the ultimate gear, and defeat continuously evolving bosses.

title: Against the Storm: Nightwatchers
description: The Blightstorm rages on as Against the Storm - Nightwatchers introduces a new species into the fray alongside two new biomes, new buildings, new deeds, new world events, and more for any Viceroy seeking additional options in the seemingly endless struggle.

title: Battles of Cardista
description: Build your deck, control the battlefield, seize victory. Battles of Cardista is a card battler with single player campaigns and PvP multiplayer. Each faction has a different campaign, each lord a different twist.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Farm Machinery
description:
Saddle up drivers, because the Farm Machinery DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2 has arrived! Transport everything from trusty tractors to forage harvesters across scenic virtual highways and roads.

Featuring 2 in-game brands, Owl & Greenler, you'll be able to deliver a variety of unique cargoes on Lowboy, Dropdeck or Flatbed trailers to a number of agriculture-related industries large and small across the country.

title: Skoof Fishing
description: Fishing has never been a boring activity and it has never been so fun and immersive before! Join the ranks of true skoofs, catch fish and have fun.

title: Jimmy's No. 44 House
description: This is an exciting escape room game. Uncle Jimmy has challenged you and invited you to his house to play a game. Let's see who can survive until the end — whether you escape alive first or get mercilessly killed by him. Hurry and find the puzzle-solving items to escape from this house!

title: Lunera
description: A live combat fantasy 2D rpg where you hunt monsters to level up your character. Use a close combat battle style, bows, or wands. There is always a new challenge around the corner as you grow stronger and can take on stronger monsters. You can also compete on the level highscore list.

title: Hearthguard
description: A tactical tower defense game that rewards clever pathing and strategic placement. Build mazes, upgrade defenses, and hold the line against relentless waves of enemies.

title: Lucera
description: Hunt monsters and level up your character in a retro fantasy setting. Further make your character stronger with rare loot from monsters and by increasing character skills.

title: A Box Full of Joy
description: A grim and surreal adventure game.

title: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
description: Build spell-powered factories, reclaim ancient territories filled with magical secrets, and discover game-changing technology hidden across procedurally generated worlds. Master both engineering and magic in this cozy fusion of factory automation and RPG progression.

title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 1 Re-Raptored
description: Jack Briar is back to stop Bayliss’ dastardly Disaster once more! Rediscover every room, dino, and puzzle from the original match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania—now fully reraptored!

title: Kando Realm
description: Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you.

title: The Last Transmission
description: The Last Transmission is a short, first-person psychological horror game built around isolation, atmosphere, and slow, creeping dread.

title: We Hunt Them in the Dark
description: A hand-drawn "anomaly hunter" game with a playtime of 10 to 30 minutes.

title: VanillaSugar
description: Dive into a haunting narrative where love becomes obsession, and protection twists into possession. Every choice stains your hands darker in this beautifully unsettling visual novel about the price of devotion.

title: Resident Evil 4: Berserker
description: This MOD modifies a large number of enemy and item configurations, adds previously unexplored areas from the original version, adjusts weapon attributes, and introduces more weapons, bringing you a brand new Resident Evil 4 gaming experience.

title: Assault on Everest
description: A seemingly cancelled game from Take Two Interactive, with cinematic sequences. It was previewed in some magazines and had a very small presence at Summer CES 1994. Aside from the few information that has come to light, the title was patented in 1994.

title: Lost Curse
description: In a forgotten ancient world, this JRPG blends turn-based combat with novel-like storytelling, delivering thrilling adventures through mysteries and challenges. ﻿

title: Gridlock
description: Daily block puzzle - same pieces for everyone. One chance. Compete globally.

title: Headshot Roulette
description: Battle against your friends in a crazy Russian roulette. Blanks or live ammunition? Fate decides. Proximity Voice Chat, Gestures, Unique Items & High Stakes. Ready to take a risk?

title: Netcode The Protogen
description:
Prologue – Awakening in Neon
The world is no longer what it was. Once shaped by the rise of human civilization, Earth has splintered into a chaotic blend of overgrown ruins and evolving machines. Climate collapse, digital wars, and lost centuries have left behind a ravaged planet—one now consumed by diverse, unpredictable biomes: toxic deserts, jungles laced with nanite storms, shattered cities reclaimed by rogue flora, and oceans shimmering with radioactive shimmersteel.

Floating above this scarred planet is Neovara—a breathtaking metropolis built and maintained by the Protogens, cybernetically enhanced synthetic beings born of humanity’s final technological era. Sleek, intelligent, and partially organic, Protogens constructed Neovara to preserve advanced life and knowledge. Towering spires of chromed glass, living machines, and holographic networks define its skyline. Within it, everything is calculated, optimized, and connected. The city pulses like a living circuit board in the sky.

You awaken in one of its containment facilities, unaware of who you are or how you got there. Rebuilt with artificial limbs, a reinforced spine, and a data-linked brain, you are no longer entirely human. They call you the Anomaly—a being that shouldn’t exist. Protogens reconstructed your dying body with forbidden technology after recovering you from an unregistered crash site on the surface. They won’t say why they did it. They won’t explain what they fear. But you can see it in their eyes—coded eyes that flicker when they speak to you.

They’re hiding something.

title: Throne of Egypt
description: Embrace your divine rule and carve your legacy in the sands of ancient Egypt

title: Trash Wars
description: A 3D hybrid tower defense game! Defend against trash, send trash. Manage resources, build turrets, automate defenses, and survive against pollution.

title: The 13th Floor
description: As a weary security guard, navigate a 13-story office building to find your way home. Traverse each floor on foot, moving between elevators while observing subtle details. Set in broad daylight, this exploration game blends curiosity with logic as you uncover the building's secrets.

title: Esports Team Manager
description: An esports team management simulation game based on MOBA game management by The Brain Trust. Sign players, keep them happy, and strategize to win it all.

title: RealFlight Evolution: E-flite Beechcraft D18 1.5m
description: The E-flite Beechcraft D18 1.5m is the most convenient and easiest-to-fly scale model of the classic aircraft yet! Well-equipped with many scale details, functional features, and Smart Technology, it's a modern-day marvel for a wide range of pilots.

title: Luxuriant
description: Luxuriant is a fantasy card-driven roguelike deck-builder where you assemble and manage a deck of Royals, Citizens, Weapons, and Resources to outmaneuver Enemies in turn-based combat, earn Influence, progress through evolving levels, and unlock new cards for future runs.

title: Wish Upon a Cat
description: Embark on a delightful little romp through the worlds of various Odencat games to track down a dimension-diving cat in this short, heartwarming adventure.

title: Farm to Table
description: A farming & restaurant management sim with base building elements. Grow in backyard to cook & serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals & produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff & grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!

title: Fritz & Chesster: Chess for Aliens
description: This educational chess game takes place on an alien planet, in which Fritz and Bianca learn additional tactics and strategies. They learn about the Queen's Gambit, blockades, additional checkmate patterns, passed pawns, the concepts of space and tempo, drawing strategies and variants including dice chess.

title: Fool King
description: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat.

title: Deadline Escape
description: Deadline Escape is a Low Poly Extraction Looter Shooter that throws you into a Post-Apocalyptic World. Scavenge for valuable resources, face deadly enemies and fight for your survival as the clock ticks down toward the deadline.

title: Weapons Arena
description: "Beyond seven steps, the gun is faster than the sword; within seven steps, the gun is both faster and more accurate." But... what happens if you're surrounded by a group of swords? Can the gun still hold its edge?

title: Wasteland Travelers
description: Society governed by the Giant Corporations fell. It's all you now. Travel to the Marion Military Outpost and scavenge, fight and fend off the ferocious zombies and bandits, and eventually obtain the key to restoring civilization in Area 5.

title: Summer in the City: Season One
description: Meet Summer Summerson, an eighteen year old girl from the middle of nowhere trying to achieve her dream of becoming a professional photographer. "Summer In The City" is a wholesome and kinky adult visual novel with a slice-of-life narrative.

title: DnB Starfighter
description: High-speed shmup where survival meets rhythm. Evade waves of enemies to pounding drum and bass soundtrack. Customize your ship, perfect your run, and claim your spot on the leaderboards.

title: Sticker Business
description: Create, collect, and sell your stickers in your sticker shop. Design and print stickers, open mystery boxes, manage orders, customize your shop, and find the thief cat.

title: Dragon Ruins II: Aftermath
description: A standalone expansion for a dungeon crawler for tired people.

title: Wilds of the Realmwalker
description: A four-player cooperative survival game in which wizard explorers and their magical companions embark on enchanting adventures filled with spell crafting, exploration, and cozy, collaborative gameplay.

title: Find Meow in Wild West
description: A hidden object game where you explore a hand-drawn Wild West to find 100 charming cats, each one carefully hidden and full of personality.

title: Growing Wild
description: Enjoy the cozy vibes of this vibrant tower defense game. Harness the power of magical plants to restore nature's balance and uncover the secrets buried beneath the corruption. Grow, Defend, Restore!

title: Wildheart Gourmet
description: Unlock the mysteries of a strange yet familiar world and forage real wild plants & herbs in this curious, peaceful adventure. An experimental interactive fiction cook-em-up with educational elements.

title: Wilderlocke
description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

title: Scooby Doc 4: The Destroyer
description:
Enter a strange dimension and travel through WARGATES to take on 15+ strange foes. Can you escape THE VOID? Mega Man-style boss oriented game with some stages and other weird stuff thrown in.

As a Robot, Skullman experienced a rush of battle and killed many enemies in his cruise operations. He has become an international attacker. The Skullman found a battlefield and killed many enemies in his line. This Dr. Cossack, a Russian scientist who made a lot of robots. He was a doctor. Cossack had a library with good people, and the intention was to open the door of the robot. However, at the library at Cossack. The 'WARGATE' was opened, causing panic over robots and humans. This 'WARGATE' is very dangerous and opens the door to other countries... 'WARGATE' opens, and the other party is very dangerous. There are many images that threaten the rest of the world. Now the house has to return to Scrumman and restore security. But the road is very dangerous, because everywhere is a strange and dangerous enemy. We will go to Skullman's battle and we will secure the country. We are like an inner skull...

title: Qreate
description:
Qreate is a sandbox mod/extension for id software's Quake.
It allows you to spawn pretty much all the entities made
available to use when making a map, but here you can place them
in real-time.

title: Under Destruction
description: In a dystopian future dominated by artificial intelligence, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Machines, led by the supreme AI “Axis”, fight for control of Erythonite, a revolutionary mineral fueling the war. You are Spyro, an elite combat drone tasked with a critical mission: secure Erythonite deposits, eliminate human defenses, and ensure machine dominance.

title: Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a magical quest to save the fading forest. The collectors edition includes a bonus chapter with additional story arcs and challenges.

title: Strange Investigations: Truth Will Out - Collector's Edition
description: Unravel a tangled web of lies, betrayal, and obsession in a case where no one is truly innocent. The collector's edition adds bonus content, including a visit to Dana's childhood home, a side story about her family, and Ursula's final treasure hunt.

title: Rat's Lair
description: Horror game that combines elements of sandbox, horror, stealth, puzzle and a small open world.

title: Amanda's Magic Book 11: Fractured Reflections
description: Enter a realm where mirrors distort reality. Explore a distorted Florence, where every reflection hides secrets. Uncover the lost power of the Aeternum Mirror and mend its broken shards. Face mirror-clone versions of yourself and decipher who's truly real.

title: Tower of Wishes 4: Shaka
description: Rise as King Vusumuzi and ascend the legendary Tower of Wishes to save your kingdom.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XVIII: Ghost Sheep - Collector's Edition
description: Help Hercules battle mischievous ghosts, restore balance to Hellas, and unravel ancient mysteries. Collector's Edition includes an interactive guide, wallpapers, bonus levels and even more sheep.

title: Argonauts Agency: God of the Storm - Collector's Edition
description: Lead legendary heroes through cursed islands, and uncover the mysteries of Poseidon's domain. The collector's edition includes extra levels, comics, and more.

title: Motorhome: Traveling America - Collector's Edition
description: Hit the road in and find hidden objects across America. The Collector's Edition offers exclusive content, expanding your journey with bonus locations, additional mini-games, and a treasure trove of souvenirs.

title: Chaos Agents
description:
Chaos Agents is the world’s first autobattler-royale, a genre-defying strategy game from Richard Garfield, creator of Magic: The Gathering, and the debut title from Popularium. In Chaos Agents, players coach a globally unique superhero—known as a Chaos Agent—through intense auto-battling skirmishes against dozens of others in a large-scale battle royale.

Using strategic card play, players power up their Agent between rounds, then watch their choices unfold in action-packed, hands-off combat. With every Agent being one-of-a-kind and globally exclusive, mastery becomes personal—and competitive. Combining the tactical depth of auto-battlers with the high-stakes scale of a battle royale, Chaos Agents invites players to discover, upgrade, and dominate in a new genre born from community-driven development.

title: Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover Norse secrets and mystical realms in this hidden object game. The collector's edition features an exclusive bonus chapter to uncover even deeper secrets, concept art, and more.

title: Tengo 20 Bolos y Permiso hasta las 7
description: In a small world made of crafting materials, you take on the role of a craftsman whose decisions will affect the ongoing galactic war, but whose fates are being shaped by outside forces.

title: New Yankee: Through the History Mirror - Collector's Edition
description: Save John and Mary from the time loop they've gotten themselves into. The collector's edition includes 15 additional levels, a strategy guide, 2 mini games and more.

title: Whispers of Mexico: La Noche de la Casada
description: Whispers of Mexico is a psychological narrative horror game with puzzle elements set in post-revolutionary Mexico in 1930. Follow Manuel as he navigates his mind, where he must recover his memory, unravel the mystery surrounding the town, and redeem his sins.

title: Mage Arena
description: A co-op PvP experience about using your voice to cast spells in the Mage Arena to settle an ages-old feud between sorcerers and warlocks.

title: Doronko Wanko: Bulldog
description: Welcome a new pup into your home! This DLC unlocks the Bulldog as a playable dog. Choose your favorite pup and explore a beautiful, pristine house — then cover it in mud to your heart's content!

title: Doronko Wanko: Toy Poodle
description: This DLC unlocks the Toy Poodle as a playable dog. Choose your favorite pup and explore a beautiful, pristine house — then cover it in mud to your heart's content.

title: Doronko Wanko: Jack Russell Terrier
description: This DLC unlocks the Jack Russell Terrier as a playable dog. Choose your favorite pup and explore a beautiful, pristine house — then cover it in mud to your heart's content.

title: Doronko Wanko: Corgi
description: This DLC unlocks the Corgi as a playable dog. Choose your favorite pup and explore a beautiful, pristine house — then cover it in mud to your heart's content.

title: Doronko Wanko: Shiba Inu
description: This DLC unlocks the Shiba Inu as a playable dog. Choose your favorite pup and explore a beautiful, pristine house — then cover it in mud to your heart's content.

title: Into the Evernight
description: A retro-styled tactical RPG with a heavy emphasis on player choice and branching story paths. Long ago, the sun went out and the world went dark. Now, the last remaining sources of light are starting to wane. How will you stop the spreading darkness? Or will you even be able to?

title: Sword Art Online: Fractured Daydream - Symphony of a Dazzling Dawn
description: The Symphony of a Dazzling Dawn DLC allows you to play as two additional characters: Cat Knight Alice and Mito. It also has a scenario, costumes, weapons and more. This DLC is also included in the Character Pass 2.

title: Clobber Barons
description: A short, arcade-style throw back to the beat 'em ups of the early 90's. Use the money you beat out of wealthy criminals to charge your power attacks while attempting to find the mastermind behind the criminal racket taking over your city.

title: Layered Ordeal
description: LAYERED ORDEAL is a bullet time FPS. A barrage of various bosses will attack you. Take advantage of the slow-motion feature to avoid the barrage, defeat the bosses, and reach the lowest level.

title: Mordeny
description: Prepare for fast-paced, strategic combat in Mordeny, a thrilling 2D top-down shooter where quick reflexes and tactical thinking are your best weapons. Explore unique gamemodes and customize your own character as you unlock new abilities and gear. Whether you're battling solo or teaming up with friends, Mordeny offers an action-packed adventure like no other where every battle demands precision and skill. Join the fight and experience the thrill today!

title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
This bundle includes:
• Base game
• Season Pass:
- Sonic Prime Character Pack - Rusty Rose, Tails Nine, Knuckles the Dread (Available at launch)
- 6 Content Packs, which include guest characters, vehicles, tracks, emotes, and more from some of your favorite pop culture franchises.
* Additional content will be released sequentially after the game is released.
* Please check the official website for product details and release schedule.

title: Super Robot Wars Y: Ultimate Edition
Street Fighter 6: Year 3 Ultimate Pass
description: Year 3 Ultimate Pass includes - 4 additional characters (Sagat, C. Viper, Alex, Ingrid), 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10, 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 2 (including colors 1-10), 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 3 (including colors 1-10), 1 additional stage, and Bonus: 5,800 Drive Tickets

title: Ball Blast: Dreamland DLC
description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
Haunted Castle Map
Candy Land Map
Vaporwave Map
15 Boomerang Shards
10 Shock Wave Shards
10 Laser Shards
6 Extra Cannon Boosters
2500 gems

title: Ball Blast: Space DLC
description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
Space Station Map
Red Planet Map
Wasteland Map
15 Saw Thrower Shards
10 Barrier Shards
10 Cannon Shards
4 Extra Damage Boosters
4 Fast Charge Boosters
2500 gems

title: Ball Blast: Wilds DLC
description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
Desert Map
Runic Map
Frozen Map
15 Shotgun Shards
10 Turret Shards
10 Plasma Cannon Shards
10 Shield Boosters
2500 gems

title: The Days Without Gods
description: The Days Without Gods is a text-based DND fantasy ADV in which the player takes on the role of Mori Granson, an apprentice and subordinate of Hysso, the president of the Magic Association, and meets Coccinea, a young girl he rescued years ago, and other characters in the mage capital of Tylin.

title: Westale: Peelgrimage
description: Westale: Peelgrimage is an ink-style survivor-like game. Player can evolve their characters in the game, use marvelous magical treasures, experience the mysterious 72 transformations, and synthesize artifacts. Let's get into this Journey-to-the-West world and experience addictive combat.

title: Unsung Escape
description: Unsung Escape is a vertical action-platformer where you outrun an ever-rising Void. Use Energy Orbs to gain movement abilities like double-jumps and dashes. No enemies—just pure platforming, exploration, and survival.

title: Be (Not) Afraid
description: This game was made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2025, a micro-Visual Novel jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000 word limit.

title: Instant Anastasia
description: In this roguelite horror, rescue survivors on a spaceship tainted by nightmares. Track an invisible foe through anomalies leaking into reality. Use the "Dream Shader" to reveal and fight the enemy. Scarce resources and split-second decisions will determine your survival.

title: Nekro3
description:
NEKRO3 is a dark 2D horror-puzzle game with stealth elements.
You are terminally ill. Somewhere in the depths lies a stone that can heal.
But the deeper you go, the more you die. And every death becomes your enemy.

title: Idutshane
description: IDUTSHANE is a fangame of Undertale, inspired by its popular Dusttale AU, created by Mehigh6 and released in August 2024.

title: Game With Balls
description: Game With Balls! Move the Steam Deck to navigate through handcrafted mazes.

title: Smoots Crazy Wave
description:
Get ready for a splashing good time in Smoots Crazy Wave! This fast-paced arcade racer brings the beloved Smoots characters to thrilling water tracks where you’ll compete for victory. Whether you prefer classic Slalom races, powerup-filled mayhem, or intense Battle Royale showdowns, there's a mode for every type of racer.

Race across vibrant locations like Honu Island, Iceland, and the mysterious Lost World, using skill and strategy to outpace your rivals. And if you’re falling behind, grab a powerup to turn the tide! Play solo or challenge up to 3 friends in local multiplayer to prove who rules the waves.

title: Return to Wonderland
description: The Rainbow Coins have been scattered throughout the land, and it is up to Stinky and Loof to restore their magic once again. This exciting stand-alone expansion pack to the original Wonderland brings you back into the world of puzzles, action, adventure, and fun.

title: Lewd Mod 2
description: A game where you play as a content moderator for a virtual social network.

title: Lewd Mod: Noir
description: You work as a spy, looking through surveillance photos to identify Red Hat agents and uncover their mystery.

title: Non Euclidean Room
description: An exploration game in a strange land. How many times can a room be connected to itself?

title: Shattered Dimension
description: Dive into a world of mystery and wonder in Shattered Dimension. As an unexpected investigator, you're plunged into a labyrinthine plot filled with enigmatic puzzles and intriguing characters.Uncover hidden truths by engaging in conversations and following the intricate web of relationships.

title: Carved Brink
Trap Again
description: Trap Again is a brutally unfair 2D troll platformer inspired by Cat Mario. Every jump hides a trap, every step could kill you. Die, learn, try again… and die again. Can you survive the madness?

title: Knight Crawler
description: Play as Cyrus, a medieval knight, in this top-down action roguelike. Battle your way through endless procedurally generated dungeons filled with coins and weapons. Discover rare, powerful modifiers and test your skills against a variety of deadly foes.

title: Good Boy The Long Night
description: This game is a first person single player horror game, where you play a dog searching its owner, while surviving paranormal creatures.

title: ShellPieces
description: ShellPieces is a gauge-based command RPG. 23 unique heroes to form your party! Allies and enemies fight on a 3×3 grid. Skills have different ranges and rows—strategize your formation carefully! Collect powerful legendary gear and create synergies with your characters and party setup!

title: AashMans Party Mix
description: AashMans Party Mix is a multiplayer game with 8 game modes, very similar to other obstacle course style games. You can choose from 5 characters. Play fair, or attack each other to gain an advantage.

title: Two Days
description: Two Days is a short, minimalist puzzle fangame in two rooms, requiring sound and focused on exploring a brief detour as the Batter. It was made in two days and is purely an homage to OFF, with minimal narrative or interactivity beyond the central puzzle.

title: Destiny Spire
description: Destiny Spire is a party-based RPG with active time battles inspired by the classics. Not your traditional turn based combat: The battle continues even while you select your actions, you'll need reflexes and wits to survive. Pick your party and set off on a retro, non-hand holdy adventure!

title: Slots & Daggers
description: A retro-fantasy roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!

title: Clockwork Maiden
description: Clockwork Maiden is a 3D Action-Adventure. Play as Mary, a Wind-up Maid fighting to stop the Bell Family from polluting the world. Keep her key wound, upgrade her gadgets, and explore Mansions, smog-choked cities, and airships in a retro PSX-inspired world before time runs out!

title: Nachtmahr
description: Nachtmahr is a third-person adventure where you play as a magical unicorn, exploring five realms filled with puzzles, collectibles, and secrets. Uncover a poetic story as you journey through a world of wonder and magic.

title: RhythmStrike
description: Rhythm game inspired by modern Japanese arcade titles, featuring intense visuals and gameplay, dynamic keyboard and mouse controls, and community integration. Climb the global leaderboards and unlock new content through specialized challenges!

title: Anomalien
description: You’re a retired lab worker sent to Tulega City, chasing UFOs. Only with a prototype scanner, hunt anomalies, weaken them, and stop the source from spreading before it’s too late.

title: Forced Entry
description: A masked serial killer has Forced Entry into your home knocking you out and locking you into the basement, You must now try to escape before its to late. Can you escape or will you become another victim of this relentless butcher.

title: Oremus
description: This text adventure, beautifully illustrated in pixel art, invites you to explore a medieval abbey filled with secrets. You take full control by entering commands directly on your keyboard through a flexible command parser, allowing for free and immersive interaction.

title: The Death Night Show
description: The Death Night Show is a narrative game with multiple endings and unlockable scenes where you play as Death's intern in his own late night show. Control the audience's reactions to the events of the program, run errands, and uncover the overarching mystery with each new featured guest.

title: Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington
description:
Learn all about George Washington in this visual novel biography containing rare photos from inside the Washington Monument, Washington's home at Mount Vernon, Yorktown where he achieved final victory in the Revolutionary War, and much more. Soldier, General, Spymaster, and President - this is George Washington!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in Washington’s home state of Virginia

title: Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson
description:
Learn all about Thomas Jefferson in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of the room where the Declaration of Independence was signed, Jefferson’s Monticello home, the National Archives where the Declaration is kept, and much more. Writer, Diplomat, President - this is Thomas Jefferson!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in Jefferson’s home state of Virginia

title: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln
description:
Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat from the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in the Washington DC area

title: High Fantasy Idle
description: High Fantasy Idle is an idle RPG with unique class-based gameplay and hundreds of achievements and secrets to find. Level up by farming, battling, and researching while buying items and perks, then rebirth to find newfound power! Embark on a journey of fantasy and mystery to unravel your destiny.

title: Space Road: Elite
description: Trade between star systems. Fight against pirates and alien invaders. Modification of the ship.

title: Plambra Dash: The Parkour Game Part I
description: Jump, climb, and race your friends in this thrilling parkour adventure set in a mysterious tropical village reaching up to the sky! Dive into fast-paced, action-packed fun. Don’t miss out! Grab your spot and start the climb now!

title: Questionable Ethics
description:
Survivors got stuck in a mysterious research facility.
This campaign is about randomness and some traps.

title: Questionable Ethics: Alpha Test
description: A 5-map campaign, a sequel to 'Questionable Ethics'.

title: Foos
description: Score 15 points to win against a series of opponents with unique abilities in this foosball inspired arcade game! Play with or against your friends, and hone your skills by beating your high scores in the Challenge Modes!

title: Karakage The Sky Shadow
description: Karakage The Sky Shadow is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter where stylish, anime-inspired warriors trained in Celestial Flow battle across realistic, immersive environments that shift in real-time. The game’s unique Domain Warp Gamemode lets you teleport between two completely different maps mid-game, altering the landscape and changing the flow of combat.

title: Punch Champs
description: PUNCH CHAMPS is a tactical 2D brawler where every move counts. Master one-hit KOs, parries and dodges because precision is your path to victory. Customise your fighter, outsmart your rivals and rise to GOAT status in this boxing showdown!

title: Space Pinball
description: Blast off into a cosmic twist on classic pinball! In Space Pinball, you're a UFO racking up points by crashing into asteroids while navigating an ever-changing playfield. Survive with just three lives as the stars—and the arena—fall around you.

title: Mr. Prepper: Uranium Project
description: Gain access to a long-abandoned nuclear power plant, manage unstable uranium to craft powerful tools and weapons, advance through a new storyline, and decorate your bunker in a whole new way!

title: Pascal's Requiem
description: Embark on an epic journey to change the past in this 2.5D adventure RPG! Conquer turn-based minigame battles to unravel a story of fate and self-discovery. Will you accept your fate, or forge a new destiny?

title: Spreadsheets and Nothing More
description: An experimental work simulator where all you do is type simple data into spreadsheet

title: Planet Hoarders
description: Planet Hoarders is a co-op game where you collect cute creatures to meet your quota in dark dungeons… and hide from the not-so-cute ones. You’re a replicant, grown by the Corporation for this exact mission.

title: Backstabbing King
description: Backstabbing King is a chess based strategy puzzle game with a few twists on the base chess mechanics.

title: Corner Shop: NightShift
description: Take a night shift job in a place that runs on habit, not purpose. Restock shelves, take deliveries, clean the mess, and try to make it till morning. Not everything feels right and you’re never quite alone. Something waits in the dark.

title: Treasure Tiger
description: Treasure Tiger is a first-person horror game where every spin brings you closer to fortune… or to something far worse.

title: Contraria
description: Solve 3D puzzles and collect ProtoCores while crew logs whisper from another time—or maybe another reality. Keep solving. Keep looping. Until the final room. The Answer… or just another Question.

title: Ghost Traveler: Adventures in Edo
description: A Time loop mystery set in Japan’s Edo period!

title: Astral Takers
description: Shape your fate with the power of summoning in an immersive JRPG!

title: Cryptadia Village
description: A short role-playing game where you try to save a village from dark spirits. Explore an interactive world filled with puzzles and side quests, engage with villagers, and uncover the mysteries of a cozy, magical land full of adventure.

title: Project B-Fer: Prime Cut
description:
You and 4 other people are trapped underground on a moving subway train. What are you willing to do to get out? Will you play by the rules, or break them?

An escape room style visual novel with non conventional puzzles, colorful characters, and a rich story.

title: Keys of Fury
description: Keys of Fury is a retro-style Beat `em up typing game. Focus on typing perfection as you battle your way to becoming a master of key fu.

title: Road Truckers: New Beginning
description:
Live a trucker’s life in the first trucking sim RPG. Explore villages, cities and wilderness in a fully customizable truck. Get on-foot to eat, sleep, and help people along the way. Your goal: to bring back prosperity in your region. Drive, grow, and inspire!

Experience trucking on a new level: by driving and interacting with the world around you. Make your truck unique by customizing it mechanically and visually, inside and outside. Meet people and decide how to approach them. Enjoy the beautiful scenery in different weather conditions. But most of all, see the change you’re making by supporting the economy.

title: Pixel Wizard
description: A medieval fantasy hack and slash adventure where you are a battle pixel wizard. Fast and frantic, fight hordes of enemies and defeat brutal bosses in any order to save the kingdom. Use deadly magic, powerful items and valuable loot to help turn the tide of battle.

title: Peter Flat's Inflatable Adventures
description: Peter Flat`s Inflatable Adventures is a quirky game of social satire featuring 50 awesome adventures. Newly recruited by the Corporate Corporation, Peter Flat must go through vigorous training to prove himself to the company. Transform Peter Flats 2D world into 3D while evading attacks from corporate rivals and the occasional 2D purist, hell-bent on keeping the world just the way it is.

title: Misty Island: The Forgotten Story
description: On this island perpetually shrouded in mist, time seems to condense into damp droplets, with every breeze whispering untold secrets. This action RPG introduces survival mechanics where hunger gradually sets in over time, demanding careful resource management and strategic use of skills.

title: Brew or Die
description: Brew or Die – an RPG game with TBS elements, where potion brewing is a matter of life, duty, and... possible wealth!

title: Rhino Express
description: Lost under the red sun, a rhino must deliver packages across the savanna! Help our rhino through fun puzzle challenges where every step counts. Can you help complete all deliveries?

title: The Shores of Stellaluna
description: Sail a fractured world. Battle through dangerous dungeons, Stack powerful abilities, Rebuild cities, Manage trade, Survive ever-changing islands to gather lumen, get more powerful and shape the fate of a broken world in this first person craft and build focused RPG with a strong storyline.

title: Single Scoop
description: Scoot and shoot to the finish line in this action puzzle game. Time your button press to advance towards the goal. Navigate through a maze of patterns and build your combo meter to break the rules.

title: A Pirate Game About Digging for Treasure and Getting Drunk
description: A pirate game about digging through a treasure-filled dungeon, which you can then spend on booze at the bar. Collect as much gold as possible and beware of the dangers that lurk in the shadows...

title: TerraScape: Ancient Egypt
description: Expand your kingdom-building adventure in TerraScape Ancient Egypt! Master the sands by crafting irrigation systems to nourish the land, then raise mighty monuments under the desert sun. Discover new resources and mechanics as you lead your settlement to pharaonic glory. Will your legacy endure?

title: Obsidian Moon
description: Investigate your way in this branching noir horror detective game. Discover dark secrets through genre-bending clue mechanics while navigating a world where Lovecraftian horrors blend with ancient Minoan and Kawirian mysteries. Uncover a sinister plot and face an ultimate choice.

title: Musical Meteors
description: Blast meteors in this retro-style arcade game with a musical twist! Use your keyboard or plug in a MIDI piano to methodically (and melodically) destroy the oncoming meteors. Shoot for high scores, rack up massive combos, and develop your piano dexterity along the way!

title: Gemion Function
description: Chaotic 2v2 action where all 4 players clash at the exact same time! Master the frame-perfect parry mechanic and equip one of 6 powerful Gems to alter your team's playstyle. Play with 3 friends in smooth online matches powered by GGPO rollback netcode.

title: Abyss: The Wraiths of Eden - Collector's Edition
description: Your fiancée has gone missing in the dark abyss of the ocean. Discover and investigate a forgotten underwater city that hides many spine-chilling secrets and supernatural forces. Find hidden objects and solve cleverly designed mini-games during your exploration of the underwater city of Eden. The collector's edition includes a bonus gameplay chapter, an integrated strategy guide, concept art and more.

title: Adventure Trip: Wonders of the World - Collector's Edition
Adventures of Megara: Demeter's Cat-astrophe - Collector's Edition
Managun Wizard
description: Play as a wizard with a magic shotgun and fight waves of enemies. Each enemy has its own behavior, so you need to think fast and use tactics to win. Defeat all enemies to move to the next round. Upgrade your managun, and choose new powers after each round.

title: Winter Games Collection + Advent Calendar
description: Hop aboard a train and ride through the Winter Valley discovering 25 exciting and fun games!

title: Beat Stickman: Beyond - Story Mode
description: This is like the base game but you will progress much faster to focus more on the story.

title: Coup de Koala
description: Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a cute bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala king, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

title: Alexis Almighty: Daughter of Hercules - Collector's Edition
Legendary Tomb Digger
description: Legendary Tomb digger is a single player digger adventure game, You will play as a veteran tomb robbery expert, delving into a frozen ancient Arctic tomb. Dig deep to collect treasures from the tomb, sell them to purchase and upgrade tomb-raiding equipments, and search for a priceless secret.

title: Woodrot
description: You're the maintenance man for an apartment complex that has mysteriously been transported to the middle of the ocean. Woodrot is a surreal adventure game about getting to know your neighbors who all seem to blame themselves for their recent relocation.

title: Pharma Inc Simulator
description: Build your own pharma empire - on fair play or greed. Face the consequences of every decision in this darkly humorous, satirical sim: set market prices, manage production, boost your brand, make tough choices... and see where they take you.

title: Grim Axiom
description: Enter a dark underground world in this soulslike adventure-horror game where undead monsters lurk around every corner, and uncover the mystery behind the ancient machines operating in its depths.

title: Tester Wanted
description: Help an incompetent game developer test out a bunch of game ideas he came up with in a desperate attempt to make it big. Don’t worry, everything will totally go according to plan! He’ll be keeping an eye on your progress anyway.

title: Dungeon Cleaners
description: They came; they died. Now it's your job to clean up their mess.

title: FrostLight Escape
description: FrostLight Escape is a parkour game set in a stylized town, where you jump and climb on objects. But don't forget—if you fall, you start from the very beginning!

title: Sediment
