description: A pixel-physics sandbox. Fifty materials, and every one of them is physics: sand finds its angle, water freezes, lava crusts into stone, gunpowder blows. Build your own materials and worlds, and share them in the Workshop.

title: Nakuma
description: Nakuma is a singleplayer RPG with focus on grinding for gear and experience points. Obtain a variety of magical spells, upgrade your gear and invest stat-points as you progress!

title: The Child Of Hagar
description: The Child of Hagar is a 2D/3D hybrid game where you feed the thing you gave birth to. Dig up graves, lie to the police, do what you have to: it is hungry.

title: Smoke Shop Simulator
description: Run your own smoke shop in this quirky life simulation game. Decorate, manage customers, level up, and become the neighborhood’s go-to dealer (of legal stuff, of course).

title: Re-body
description:
Re-body is a socio-experimental crawler/exploration game.

The Re-body project was created out of an interest to explore body perception, especially of queer experiences. 38 individuals were asked a simple question: how do you feel about your body? Participants were encouraged to think about their feelings in the past and present, and analyze how those feelings may have evolved or not.

This experience functions simultaneously as a game and anthology; players explore a desolate environment while searching for fragments—manifestations of thoughts and memories—which reveal confessions, writings provided by the surveyed individuals.

title: Under the Lighthouse
description: In the middle of a stormy night, Liv reunites with an old friend. A short linear visual novel.

title: Rotten Heart of Yours
description: What kind of cruel world forces a woman to contemplate which of two indescribable horrors would be more ideal? Mallory comes home to find her friend. A short linear visual novel, to play in 5-10 minutes.

title: Creepy Shift: Uncle Joe’s Motel
description: Unknown actress takes a job at Uncle’s Motel to make ends meet. She’s running from trouble — but peace is the last thing she’ll find here. A surreal blend of simulation, horror, and psychological depth, wrapped in a noir atmosphere.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Police DLC
description: The Police DLC for Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 adds 6 police cars inspired by real models, unique liveries – no new missions or glowing police lights.

title: Otherside: Untamed Words
description: OTHERSIDE is a 2D, hand-drawn Metroidvania adventure featuring 'Cat Face' - a hunter awakened from slumber. Wield a sword and brush to explore a beast kingdom, encounter tribes, and uncover secrets.

title: Shallow Pond
description: Play as cute diver Ripples, swim like a penguin or bounce your way through the vivid landscapes of this 3D platformer. Defeat weird foes while collecting shells, water spirits and other secrets hidden in the levels. Enjoy the cozy vibes!

title: What Happened Here?
description: What Happened Here is a short adventure horror game: around 30-45 minutes, exploring the classic horror trope of being locked inside a house and exploring it in order to go out.

title: Letters of War
description: Letters of War is an adventure war drama inspired by real events and a spiritual successor to the legendary Valiant Hearts: The Great War. Help a simple British carpenter not lose touch with his little daughter during World War II. Connect their destinies with the help of letters.

title: Outlive 25
description: Old school RTS is back! Outlive 25 is the remastered version of the game originally released in 2000, that will be featuring enhanced graphics and sound, an updated Campaign Editor, Steam multiplayer support, and much more. Get ready for a battle of unprecedented proportions, fought to achieve supremacy—and above all—to ensure humanity’s survival.

title: SpellCutter
description: Armed with a magical pizza cutter, venture through the depths of a spooky castle. Fight zany dust bunnies, living radios, and sock-wearing monsters. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Edenwound
description: A brutally difficult dungeon crawler rpg with roguelike elements. Face the horrors of Eden and uncover the truth, one expedition at a time.

title: Tankenstein
description: Control a dishevelled tank in a post apocalyptic wasteland. Look for new parts to survive and upgrade yourself. All of the other tanks in the scrapyard have the same goal, which makes them hostile in this survival of the fittest arena.

title: The Heart of Anathema
description: Card-driven RTS Roguelike in which you lead your forces into the depths of the mysterious forest and claim its lost relics for your kingdom. To do so, use cards to build your settlement, discover powerful synergies with cards from rival factions, then take command of your army in real-time battles.

title: Sunset Suckerpunch
description: Meet K8E: a talking, transforming motorcycle-sword-gauntlet. Drive her to meet your enemies, and wield her to crater them into the asphalt. Don't let them take her voice, too.

title: Perfect Diamond
description: Perfect Diamond is a fast-paced puzzle game made for the NES. ROM included! Slide puzzle blocks into the grid to fill lines. Try to survive as the pieces move faster and faster. 3 single-player modes, local multiplayer battle, battle vs CPU.

title: Elven Rivers V: The UnderSea
description: Explore the boundless ocean, uncover hidden treasures, and befriend two powerful princes of the underwater kingdom.

title: Chess of Mana
description: Now Celts and Orcs face off in a chess battle where fallen warriors can be revived by the Mana of the Kings! Choose your side of the battlefield—uh, we mean the board—plot the best strategy, use your mana, and defeat the enemy to claim glory!

title: Drone District
description: Drone District is an adrenaline-charged FPV arcade experience that mashes up the flow of Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater with the freedom of Burnout Paradise—but with drones. Master flight tricks, grind power lines, launch off rooftops, chain mid-air stunts, and explore an open world.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4: Echoes from Episode 3
description: You can play three remade stages from The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 3.

title: Epoch Spire
description: Epoch Spire is a first-person shooter roguelike, where players improve by discovering and understanding the secrets of a spire on an alien planet.

title: Marshals of Yore
description: This game is a hybrid of three genres: RTS, tower defense, and RPG. Engage the enemy on 100+ stages. Pick your perks as you level up and win. As you complete stages, you will unlock new and powerful items. Upgrade your units, unlock new marshals, and more.

title: Malgwa Naui Iyagi, Alicia
description:
Malgwa Naui Iyagi, Alicia was a 3D online racing game released in South Korea, where players race each other in magical worlds across various race types and tracks, riding a wide range of horses. It was first unveiled by its South Korean developers, Ntreev Soft, under the codename Project Alice in 2007.

On January 13, 2014, it was announced that the game would be shut down a month later, on February 13, 2014.

title: Avali Race Mod
description: The cutest predators this side of the universe rift

title: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Light of Xaryxis
description: This update added a new campaign based on the adventure Light of Xaryxis from Spelljammer. Champions try to solve a galactic-level problem that affects the entire world of Toril. They visit Wildspace as well as multiple worlds connected throughout the Astral Plane.

title: ESG Football
description: Co-founded by two professional gamers, ESG Football is the first ever online multiplayer 11v11 and 7v7 American football video game for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and PC.

title: Black Vultures: Prey of Greed
description: Black Vultures is a tactical first-person shooter set in a fractured warzone where trust is scarce, resources are limited, and every mission begins with a choice. Navigate ruined infrastructure and contested zones. Intercept transmissions, track movements, and recover intel to locate your objective before rival squads close in. Engage only when necessary. Retreat when survival demands it. The deeper you push, the higher the risk, but greater the reward.

title: Recolorize
description: In RECOLORIZE you play as Colorina, a teenager with schizophrenia. Your decisions and actions affect her mental state, which can lead to healing or insanity. Hallucinations will haunt you. Choose your words and actions carefully to save Colorina from herself

title: Alice's Wonderland 3: Shackles of Time - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 4: Festive Craze - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland: Cast in Shadow - Collector's Edition
Going Viral
description: An infection has struck the body! As the mighty T-Cell, it's your duty to eradicate the invading pathogens! Consume pathogens to earn mito energy, and use it to purchase upgrades and summon allies in your battle to protect the body. If all your body cells die, it's game over for you.

title: Incen(diary)
description: A sci-fi psychological-horror sound novel. Wake up the old system AI, !Rue, and have her unlock the archive logs. Find out what happened to our subjects of interest; girl named Kui and her companion, designation C-06.

title: The Last Chance
description: Journalist David, whose career is not going well, takes on the most dangerous assignment he can after receiving a warning from his editor. As time passes, it becomes clear that what is happening is far from simple.

title: Silent Still II
description: Silent Still 2 is a first-person psychological horror that traps you in the paralyzing nightmare of sleep paralysis. Helpless and unable to escape, you’ll face unspeakable entities that watch, whisper, and move when you can’t. Blurring the line between waking and something far worse

title: Alicia Quatermain: Secret of the Lost Treasures - Collector's Edition
Aloha Solitaire
description: Relax with a mix of classic card games and mahjong on the golden sands of Hawaii. Aloha Solitaire can be played at a normal or hard level of difficulty. Power-up cards will help you get to the next level, but use them wisely, as they are limited. Each of the 72 levels have a different challenge and a different look.

title: Elemental: Reforged
description: Create a character and lead your civilization in this epic, turn-based fantasy strategy game. Design units, research technology, learn magical spells, send adventurers on quests, craft magical items, trade or battle other civilizations for dominion of worlds of your imagination.

title: Doppelpartment
description:
You're the building manager of an apartment complex. Your tasks are simple: taking care of the building, collecting rent, making sure your tenants are okay, etc. However, one night a soldier knocks on your door and gives you some disturbing news: some of your tenants have been replaced by doppelgangers.
Your mission? To identify these doppelgangers and report them to the soldier. However, things won't be easy for this poor old man...

Get ready for a week full of madness, body horror and knocks on your door.

title: Amy's Greenmart: Collector's Edition
description: Help your friend Amy and her cat Napoleon run stores in this time management game. Open your first shop in quiet Suburbia, and expand your chain store across the town, using your wits and skills. Grow and sell your Eco-Friendly food to the customers, manage the shop, and help it to expand. The collectors edition features 3 more locations.

title: Runaway Mole
description: A simple platformer in which you navigate underground tunnels as a mole to reach the garden above. Along the way you'll have to dodge pesticide pools, stalagmites, and stalactites. Jump on bouncy mushrooms to help you reach new heights, and eat some bugs, just for fun.

title: Get Out of the Woods
description: Life is easier when you're a small creature on a farm. Everything is decided for you, and your fate is written out until the very end. Sounds like a fairy tale... or maybe a nightmare? Enjoy the peaceful times. You'll never leave it, because you're safe here... Or are you?

title: Moon Carrier
description: Do cargo missions between bases and cities founded on the future moon. You can drive to anywhere you want, however, you are limited with the capabilities of your vehicle. Drive fast and you take risk of a sudden death, drive slower and you take risk of failing your missions for not delivering on time.

title: The Trials: Chapter One
description: A classic choose your own adventure story. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings and secrets to unlock. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

title: Run4Ever
description: Four endless runner levels in one game! Run and see how high of a score you can get!

title: Overwords
description: Overlap words. Grow the board.

title: MustScream
description: MustScream is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players that uses mic input. Scream into your mic to run! Push your voice to the limit and make it to the end!

title: Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love With You
description: Set in a small town where reality and daydreams softly blur, this visual novel invites you on a quiet, emotional journey. As the scenery slowly changes, you embark on a journey to face the feelings you once forgot— searching for something that surely existed, somewhere in the past.

title: Escape House
description: 'Escape House' is a short (around 30 minutes), walking simulator game wherein the player is paid to partake in an experimental, real-world video game which is currently in development and not yet accessible to the public. Will you partake, and at what cost?

title: Kibus Moon Rock
description: Build your dream moon city in Kibus Moon Rock! A Cozy City Builder with simple mechanics, an interactive world and new biomes to discover. Create colourful forests, influence Kibus behaviour, unlock new buildings, collect pets and build seamlessly in a fantasy space world.

title: Lightcore Guardians
description: A compact but content-rich roguelike strategy game where every turn matters — all under 50MB.

title: Rune Dungeon
description: Rune Dungeon is a strategy game blending auto-battler and roguelike elements. Recruit heroes, collect equipment, and activate runes to build powerful synergies. Face new challenges each run—form your team wisely and battle to the dungeon’s depths.

title: Parcel Frenzy: Get To Work!
description: Run the warehouse while your boss relaxes on a beach. Sort packages by weight, stack pallets under 60kg, label them, manage power, and deal with failing machines. Everything costs money. Mess up and you’re fined. Keep it running, or the company goes under.

title: Yindy
description: A non-linear horror game: carry items, solve puzzles, enjoy the music, explore unique atmospheres in each map, and savor your time walking through a mysterious, dark, and intriguing world...

title: Ispell
description: Ispell is a shoot'em up & bullet hell game where you take on the role of a nameless android who wanders through the dying worlds. Use various weapons and dodge enemy bullets, as well as challenge powerful creatures.

title: Hotdog Hazards
description: Hotdog Hazards puts you in Tony's shoes, a highly trained grill master and undercover agent for the Galactic Tasteforce. Save the world by serving hot dogs to alien tourists, or fight for survival one hot dog at a time in challenge mode. Wishlist now to prepare for the grill of a lifetime.

title: Fast: Casters of Chaos
description: FAST: Casters of Chaos is an indie, top down, party game where you fight as time travellers. Everyone has different powers connected with time or space. Join the tournament and fight for glory and blessings of titans!

title: Diorama Builder: The Museum
description: Build an epic Museum of Natural History, Science, and Technology! Assemble a giant T-Rex skeleton, the Apollo 11 capsule, a panoramic elevator, and more in this highly detailed diorama.

title: Reflections of Life: Slipping Hope - Collector's Edition
description: Return the Guardians to slumber to keep evil from the universe. The collector's edition features a bonus gameplay chapter and other goodies.

title: Diorama Builder: Secret Bunker
description: This expansion of DIORAMA BUILDER brings the "SECRET BUNKER" diorama, allowing you to build an underground super bunker.

title: Diorama Builder: Mars Colony
description: This expansion of DIORAMA BUILDER brings the "MARS COLONY" diorama, which will allow you to build a real exploration colony on Mars. In it, you can build, for example, a workshop for vehicles, a greenhouse for growing plants, a rocket with its launch tower, and much more!

title: Kowakunai Celebration
description: "KOWAKUNAI CELEBRATION" is a horror Jokes 3D action game. The mantion looks scary, but don't worry. There are no monsters in this game.

title: Clan Duramont
description: Join the Clan Duramont.and journey into an adventure of family, courage, betrayal and redemption in this classic 2D RPG worth about 15-20 hours of playtime.

title: Robo Rhythm
description: Slash to the beat in this stylish pixel rhythm game! Battle unique bots across 6 different songs! Climb the corrupt megacorp’s tower and reclaim your stolen volcano! Find out who you're unhinged nemesis is and bring justice.

title: Wires and Whiskers
description: Wires and Whiskers is a local co-op action-puzzle game where two players control a lab-engineered gerbil and its magnetic exosuit. Work together to fight mutated enemies, solve magnetic puzzles, and survive in a ruined, post-apocalyptic trench world.

title: The Inconvenient Platformer
description: Are you ready for the most inconvenient platforming experience of your life? Traverse through exciting colorful environments as you accidentally slip up and fall 3 sections backwards. Try and make your way to the top of the mountain or create your own levels and send them to your friends!

title: Ronald Rump: Fake Assassin Simulator: Save America Again
description: It's early July, and you're a crook named Thommatt One Mangi. You've been employed by an anonymous contractor to go to President Rump's rally, and fake an assassination. You're promised a lifetime amount of eggs!

title: Twin Trials
description: Dive into Twin Trials, a dynamic arcade FPS featuring an innovative system where you wield up to two weapons simultaneously to interact with physics and the environment. With varied challenges and explosive gameplay, will you manage to dominate the global leaderboards?

title: Ko Ima ni Ari
description: Ko ima ni ari is an interactive story-driven game about the past, present and future of someone loosing slowly their sight.

title: Brickoid
description:
Control four paddles at once around your ship for full 360° defense

Battle through 30 handcrafted levels with diverse brick layouts and mechanics

title: LinkShift
description: A abstract arcade-style puzzle game with roguelite elements in which you place Nodes on a grid to try and form big connection chains. Use Upgrades and Master Nodes to change the rules or break them.

title: I Wanna Try
description:
A High Difficulty Platformer you need to Try!
Complete Levels, Defeat Bosses, Find Secrets and more!
Do you have what it takes to try?

title: Project Epoch
description:
Project Epoch is a Classic+ server in active development for over a year, built with a singular goal: to bring you back to the world you love—enhanced with high-quality, thematic, and immersive content carefully woven into a Blizzlike foundation. Running on the Wrath of the Lich King 3.3.5 client, Project Epoch has been extensively modified to recapture the feel of Classic WoW, all while opening the door to new possibilities grounded in rich Warcraft lore.

On September 9, developers announced on Discord that Blizzard sent a cease-and-desist letter. The team complied immediately.

title: Japan Stigmatized Property
description: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes

title: Delivered on Time
description: Delivered on Time is a first-person horror game themed around food delivery. As an elite delivery pro, nothing—not ghosts, hauntings, or even supernatural battles—will stop you from getting the food to the customer's door… on time!

title: Baldur's Gate III: The Black Hound
description:
Baldur's Gate III: The Black Hound was a cancelled role-playing video game developed by Black Isle Studios and to be published by Interplay Entertainment for the Microsoft Windows platform. Announced in 2002 under the codenames FR6 and Project Jefferson, it was planned to be the third main entry in the Baldur's Gate series, utilizing the Dungeons & Dragons 3rd Edition ruleset.

The development of the game was halted in 2003 due to Interplay Entertainment's loss of rights to create more Dungeons & Dragons games for the PC platform.

title: Infinity Nikki: Danqing Season
description:
Version 1.8 of Infinity Nikki "Danqing Season" officially launches on July 29 (UTC-7)!

Get ready for new events, a new area, a new ability outfit, new collectibles... and so much more! Stylists, don't miss out on the excitement—dive in and explore!

title: Hypixel
description: Hypixel is a server with Custom Minigames using Minecraft Engine, noted for being the one of the Most famous Minecraft servers

title: ParaLegends
description: Para Legends is a fast-paced third-person hero shooter featuring unique characters, tactical teamplay, and explosive abilities. Choose your legend and join the fight in competitive online matches.

title: Quadcubes
description: Quadcubes is a minimalist puzzle game where you move, rotate, and stack falling blocks across all three axes to fill and clear layers. Play at your own pace or take on an increasing challenge as the speed rises and try to reach the highest score you can.

title: 10hit
description: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

title: GeneBreak
description: A brutal first-person survival horror set in a Soviet apartment complex after a secret lab explosion. Minimal inventory, no pause — just survive what should not exist.

title: Halloween 2: Asylum
description: Dani is the cook at Haddonfield Psychiatric Hospital, where Michael Myers has been locked up for the last 30 years. But this rainy Halloween night won't be as expected: things will get out of control and Dani may end up fighting for his life in a relentless battle against Myers itself.

title: Second Coat
description: Second Coat is a fast-paced multiplayer paintball game where players compete against each other by using strategy and skill to outmaneuver opponents, rack up eliminations, and achieve victory.

title: Opus Castle: Chapter III
description:
In Chapter 3 of Opus Castle, the mystery surrounding the tragic events on Apa Street deepens. The shadows grow denser, and the line between reality and illusion begins to blur. As you venture into previously unseen areas of the castle, you'll discover disturbing memories hidden within its walls.

The paranormal phenomena become increasingly intense, and each decision you make brings you closer to one of several story paths—will you find the truth or be swallowed by the castle's darkness?

title: Dungeon Squire
description: It's a direct descendant of Dragonsweeper, which in turn is a spin of Mamono Sweeper. The game focuses on Android gameplay (touch, small screen size) and uses Kenneys tiny-dungeon assets and sounds from freesound.org.

title: Ghost Jukebox
description:
Take a seat, relax, and boo-gie your way into a happy afterlife in this cozy rhythm game! You're a ghost in purgatory helping lost souls move onto the afterlife with the power of music therapy!

All of your clients have a story. Some are good, some are bad, but all of them are packed with emotion. It’s up to you to use the power of music to help these lost souls move forward!

To help your patients, you’ll have to play some music on your trusty jukebox! Point, click, and hold the left mouse button to play the right notes.

After you’re done…why not explore your room a little? Sometimes, it’s good to unwind and take a breather after such an emotional session.

title: Opus Castle: Chapter IV
description: Chapter 4 invites you into the heart of the castle's darkest secrets. Time begins to distort, showing the past as if it were the present. Visions of those who lived—and died—there become inescapable. The castle begins to reveal its own consciousness, reacting to your presence. Your investigation into the tragedy becomes personal, and each ghost you encounter has a story to tell—or a warning to deliver.

title: Opus Castle: Chapter V
description: In Chapter 5, the weight of the truth begins to sink in. The boundary between the living and the dead crumbles, and the castle becomes a labyrinth of emotions, memories, and dangers. You are no longer just a visitor—you are part of the story. At every step, you are forced to make choices that could bring salvation or doom. Can you handle the consequences of your curiosity?

title: Liquid Sugar
description:
Somewhere on this universe, a completely new form was suddenly born. It's just a floating fistful of sugar, with no clear sense of self, lying on some room in an abandoned laboratory.

After a little stroll in the surroundings, the tiny living mass transforms! Out of nowhere, their body turns slimy, inconsistent and gluey.

Stepping outside, an entirely artificial planet, with a never ending sweet rain. A weird tower can be seen on the inaccessible distance, and a journey to make sense of anything begins!

title: Opus Castle: Chapter VI
description: The final chapter of Opus Castle brings all stories to a close. In this haunting finale, all paths converge, and the castle forces you to confront everything you've discovered—and everything you've done. The spirits are restless, and the truth is no longer just a mystery to be solved, but a reckoning. The fate of the castle—and your own—depends on the decisions you make. Will you escape, or will you become another whisper in its haunted halls?

title: Day Trading Simulator
description: Experience a realistic stock market simulator! Buy and sell virtual stocks, respond to dynamic market news, and manage your assets wisely to become a successful investor.

title: Someone Creepy
description: Someone Creepy is a horror game about a women who is being stalked by someone and that stalker is going to take big steps to disrupt her life.

title: Velocity One
description: Velocity One is a Futuristic Track Challenge game that resembles your favorite mid-to-late 90s futuristic racing games, but with stunning, modern atmospheric environments and a truly terrifying amount of loops and inversions. And this time... you are not magnetized to the track.

title: Retro Fears
description: You've just got a new job at a haunted house but something isn't right. Check the security cameras, Survive the animatronics and make it through the night until 6:00 AM

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Orange
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful orange mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Stars and Stripes
description: GTA: Stars and Stripes (GTA:S&S) is an ambitious collaborative modification for GTA San Andreas. Not only it is a total conversion, we also convert the impossible into the possible. The main focus of a project is to bring the entire USA map into the game, while keeping the artistic style of the original San Andreas map as accurate and authentic as possible. We indeed put the emphasis on a map addition aspect of this modification, however this is not the end of it, we of course bring you new exciting vehicles, weapons, properties to buy, interiors, side missions.... and perhaps even a storyline.

title: Parsector
description: In Parsector, you play the role of a starship captain at the outer rim of the galaxy. Begin the game in your own fighter ship, accept missions, mine space metal, and build your way up to a capital flagship while you dodge Imperial blockade drones & avoid the Starshadow Guild's harvester crews.

title: Hypercore
description: Hypercore is a Party Platformer made both with and without multiplayer in mind. Over 1 Billion runs possible with up to 4 players locally. Use Numerous Items against dangerous enemies, scale Golden Cliffs and Barren Landscapes and do what is considered impossible.

title: Conchiglia
description: Conchiglia is a hidden object game, where you have to find shells on the beach

title: Kassei: Road Cycling 2025
description: Kassei 25 is a summer sports simulation game. Become a road cycling manager and master every aspect of the discipline - from training plans to team selection to race tactics! Are you ready for a new season?

title: The Rotting Man
description: The Rotting Man is a psychological horror game that depicts a protagonist working as a clerk in a Japanese internet café.

title: Pinball Hero
description: Defeat the rising enemies by launching pinballs! Aim for a higher score by mastering the unique traits of your pinballs and enemies, and strategically planning their upgrades and combinations to secure an easy victory.

title: Get It Up!
description: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

title: Wood for Nobody Else
description: Wood for Nobody Else is a physics-based wood chopping experience reflecting on hating your job and the dread of tomorrow. You have one week. Good luck.

title: Ultimate Mythic Ski Jumping League
description: "Ultimate Mythic Ski Jumping League" is a mixture of a ski jump game but with lots of RPG elements. You can play alone or up to 75 players in one season. Currently only for multiplayer only local multiplayer is possible.

title: Chess of Fortune
description: A unique and casual chess experience with new rules and luck-based mechanics which requires fresh strategies, tactics, and ingenuity to conquer.

title: Laser Harp VR
description: You too can be a stealth major You will be the organizer and make the live show a success! Please note that the instrument to be handled is the “Laser Harp”.

title: Omashu: Snail Racing
description: An insect sized time trial with online highscores!

title: The Best Investor
description: THE BEST INVESTOR is a strategic board game where you start with 5 million dollars, then face your opponents by making investments of all kinds in order to increase this financial wealth as much as possible in order to become the best investor of the game!

title: Teaparty in Candyworld
description: Read the story from beginning to end, solve all the puzzles and unravel the creepy history of Candyworld. Accept the invitation to the tea party and make a choice - escape forever or stop the destruction of the magical world.

title: Pikabuu: Stop!
description: Beni, a loving husband to Nadia and father to Kaila, always ensured his family's needs were met with simple contentment. However, one day, an unwitting decision dragged his small family into a spiral that threatens everything.

title: The Inescapable Nightmare
description: There Is No Escape.

title: Izurana's Walk
description: No mercy, no help, no safety in the comfort of save/load systems! Izurana's Walk drags you into an adventure you must finish in one sitting! Trapped corridors, puzzles, and boss fights await you on this journey. Will you accompany Izurana on this perilous path?

title: Numenclature
description: Numenclature is a vibrant idle game where you harness the power of numbers and words to conquer challenges, unlock upgrades, and grow your mastery. Simple to learn, endlessly rewarding to play.

title: We Interns
description: Top-down office themed roguelite. Fight off your annoying coworkers as one of many young interns and unlock different playable characters, permanent items and office spaces to fight in.

title: Dice of Kalma
description: A deckbuilding roguelike where you play dice against Kalma, the grim guardian of the Underworld. Build a deck of powerful skulls, find synergies, and turn the dice to your favor to escape back to the world of the living.

title: Xeno's Adventure
description: Xeno's Adventure is a run and gun action game with focus on boss fights and harder difficulty. You will explore different worlds, battle mind controlled monsters and bosses, all in a drawn 2D Pixel Art style.

title: Toll Booth Simulator
description: You tried to escape prison but got caught. Instead of prison, they gave you a debt. Manage a toll booth on a desert highway. Check passports, take payments, and decide who passes. Grow fruit, mix cocktails, sell drinks, and dodge the cops. The only way to earn freedom is by paying off your debt.

title: Rat's Contracts
description: Slip into the silence of the suburbs - break into houses, outsmart wary residents, and find unconventional paths to your objectives.

title: Hyperspace Hub Manager
description: Master hyperspace trade in this sci-fi sim! Manage tariffs on 5 exotic resources, grow your Ecumenopolis, and outwit smugglers. Strategic fun for all!

title: Street Defenders
description: A fast-paced tower defense game where you protect your city from relentless zombie waves. Build, upgrade, and survive!

title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Street Grave
description: Become the gunslinger and mow down your enemies in style with the Street Grave costume.

title: Frieda is Changing
description: Frieda’s fourteen, furious, and sick of secrets. Uncover the real reason for your sister’s disappearance: Snoop through an isolated village, crack puzzles and stir up trouble. But hurry - monsters are lurking where you least expect them.

title: Smash Sector
description: Switch the walls to keep your ball in the sector, TO SMASH ALL THE INSECTS!!

title: Hello Anxiety
description: Hello Anxiety is a pixel art narrative puzzle RPG set in a surreal world shaped by mental health struggles. Navigate eerie bookstores, silent streets, and haunting memories as you explore the layers of anxiety and self-doubt in this emotional, story-driven experience.

title: Robot with a Ram Cannon
description: Command a robot armed with a physics-based rammer weapon. Slam enemies into walls and hazards, ram hazards into enemies, and use obstacles as weapons!

title: Train Simulator Classic: DB BR218 + 761
description: If you need some diesel power for your Regional Express services, look no further! This pack recreates Regional Express services on the Frankfurt - Karlsruhe route, and features the classic BR218 diesel loco, double-decker coaches and DBbzf driving trailer.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Western Maryland I-2 Class
description: With Machine Rail’s powerful Western Maryland I-2 Decapod for Train Simulator Classic, you’ll climb aboard an extraordinary behemoth of a locomotive to experience steam-era railroading at its memorable best!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Ostbahn - Wien Hbf - Hegyeshalom - Bratislava-Petrzalka Route Add-On
description: One route, three flags! This fascinating route takes you across three international borders, with destinations in Austria, Hungary and Slovakia. The Ostbahn dates back to the 19th Century and the early spread of European railway infrastructure.

title: Train Simulator Classic: DB BR633
description: The DB633 as recreated for Train Simulator Classic by RSSLO captures the efficient, modern design and operation of this up-to-date passenger train, with operable PZB and SIFA, as well as station name displays which can be customised if you create your own scenarios.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Pipestone Pass - Three Forks: Butte
description: From expert developer Milepost Simulations, the Pipestone Pass: Three Forks – Butte route for Train Simulator Classic brings to life the Milwaukee Road’s mountain railroading featuring the use of unique General Electric-built heavy boxcab electric motors.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Bozeman Pass - Livingston: Three Forks & Trident
description: Journey to the “Big Sky Country” of Montana and climb aboard Northern Pacific and Burlington Northern locomotives to challenge rugged and historic Bozeman Pass.

title: Fatal Train
description: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

title: Teeny Tiny Trains: The Enchanted Attic
description: Tucked away in the family home, dusty and forgotten, the attic hatch finally opens… revealing a realm of fantasy. Discover new ways to guide your trains through this world of magic and whimsy.

title: Logiart Grimoire: Emil's Magic Training, Part 2
description: Emil has begun training to create Logiart puzzles, just in case! Feel free to try out the records of his hard work.

title: Logiart Grimoire: Emil's Magic Training, Part 3
description: Emil has begun training to create Logiart puzzles, just in case! Feel free to try out the records of his hard work.

title: Train Simulator Classic: BR285 Diesel Loco Add-On
description: Bring some diesel power to the Mosel Valley! This freight loco from developers RSSLO introduces an up-to-date diesel-powered version of the Traxx locomotive platform to Train Simulator.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Santa Fe Super Fleet GP60M
description: From accomplished developer Reppo, the remarkable EMD GP60M – and its cabless sister, the GP60B – comes to Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Burlington Northern U25
description: The locomotive that helped change the face and history of North American railroading - the remarkable General Electric U25B “U-Boat” (along with its six-axle sister, the U25C) - is now available for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: E412 Electric Locomotive
description: Take the controls of the E.412 ‘Brennerlok', a powerful multi-system electric locomotive from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Norfolk Southern Saluda Grade Route Add-On
description: Answer the call and accept one of North America's greatest and most memorable railroading challenges - with the Saluda Grade: Asheville - Spartanburg route for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: U-Bahn Hamburg U1 - Norderstedt Mitte - Ohlstedt & Großhansdorf Route Add-On
description: Explore the U-Bahn Hamburg U1 from Just Trains, a bustling rapid transit line set in the heart of Germany's vibrant city.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Passau - Regensburg Route Add-On
description: Take in breathtaking views of quaint villages, medieval cities, lush forests and rolling hills as you head into Bavaria with Passau - Regensburg for Train Simulator Classic from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Regensburg – Ingolstadt Route Add-On
description: Discover scenic Bavarian countryside with Regensburg - Ingolstadt for Train Simulator Classic from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Tokyo Commuter - Keihin–Tohoku & Utsunomiya Lines Route Add-On
description: Return to Japan and embark on bustling and world-leading commuter operations in the heart of Tokyo - be right on time and master modern EMUs on local and rapid duty. The ultimate capital city service awaits with Union Workshop's Tokyo Commuter: Keihin-Tōhoku & Utsunomiya Lines.

title: Gobo & Spike
description: Local co-op escape room. After a conflict with the shopkeeper, two goblins end up trapped. Together, they must explore, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape.

title: Sherlock: Hidden Object & Match-3 Mystery
description: Explore familiar stories with Sherlock Holmes! Solve mysteries, find hidden objects, and play match-3 puzzles to restore classic tales. Join clans, take part in events, and uncover secrets across hundreds of detailed levels — the magnifying glass is in your hands!

title: Star Tracer
description: Welcome to an intense racing experience. Get ready to feel the G-Force while pulling hairpin turns and setting the fastest times in this Competitive First-Person Space Racing game.

title: Radial Fusion
description: 2D retro style orbital space arcade shooter game. In this multilevel game, use your ship's beam and plasma weapon to fend off enemy ships and mines. Prevent the star from exploding and destroying the solar system.

title: Daydream Mosaics: Juliette's Collection
description: A beautiful collection of six-color nonogram puzzles from the Daydream Mosaics series. Play in classic picross style or the enhanced Mosaic mode with power-ups and mistake tracking. Packed with vibrant logic challenges—perfect for puzzle fans of all kinds.

title: Neo: The Rainbow Sorcerer
description: A 2D bullet hell plane shooter game with a creative twist in gameplay—instead of shooting down enemies, pick a matching color and swipe them.

title: Mechanical Chess: Real-time
description: "Who wins: a chess grandmaster's strategy or a pro-gamer's reflexes?" In Mechanical Chess, you need both. Shattering the old rules, we've removed turns for pure real-time battles. Your mind is the strategist, your hands are the weapon. Enter the arena and prove your mastery!

title: Pachiko
description: You've been trapped in a looping space by Pachiko's mischief! Find the anomaly, choose the right path, and aim for the goal!

title: Fortune
description: An RPG science fiction game. Collect clues and evidence to break a murder case. Options for the task will lead to different story-lines and endings. Searching mysterious debris to unlock the history of the world and discover their relationship with human race.

title: Aquanima
description: Build your fantasy aquarium, discover rare fish, and manage your underwater world!

title: StarBooze Reborn
description: Various amounts of alcohol to brew, including already in-game drinks!​

title: I Want to Drive That Van
description: Have you ever looked at that broken down camper van in some of the human settlements and thought "it'd be cool if I could drive this"? No? Well I did, and now this is here.

title: Shellguard: Starbound Expansion Remastered
description: A full expansion to Starbound, focused around a new faction called Shellguard.

title: Starsuits! (Remastered+ Edition)
description: Remastered version of Rage/Apple Kid's Starsuits mod - All Starsuits have been visually redone, as well as been made dyeable!

title: Broken Pact
description: In a valley forgotten by time, 4 survivors struggle to complete dark rituals while fleeing a brutal killer, all trapped in a cycle of terror and secrets from the past.

title: Argonauts Agency: Captive of Circe - Collectors Edition
Argonauts Agency: Chair of Hephaestus - Collector's Edition
Argonauts Agency: Glove of Midas - Collector's Edition
description:
One morning, Pelias the collector asked his old friends Jason and Medea to deliver him a package. The package was the legendary glove of Midas. Rumor has it that it bestows magical powers on the wearer. Pelias decided to upgrade it a little and performed an experiment...

The collector's edition includes a bonus campaign.

title: Mega Man DOS Remake
description:
"Break the death-grip of the ultimate computer! Legions of once peaceful robots have been mysteriously transformed into a horde of humanity-hating berserk droids! Nobody is safe - least of all Mega Man. Armed with every android-annihilator ever invented, they're determined to reduce the super-powered cyborg into a heap of radioactive waste!

Can our hero outfight, outwit and "out-robot" the robots? Will Mega Man pulverize the powerful robot-maniacs? Or will he melt down?"

Originally presented by Rozner Labs in 1990 and 1992 as Megaman and Megaman3 for dos. These games have since gone down in Megaman history as some of the worst entries in the series. With many not even knowing of their existence. The few who received a floppy disk instead of a cartridge for Christmas many years ago were greeted with unfair levels, plain bosses, and silent gameplay! Be it from lack of care, or maybe lack of ability. These games were bad, but every game can have a second chance right?

Two years of work have culminated in a full remake of these two games into one large project. A full remake of every stage in classic series nes gameplay! All 9 robot masters! Megaman X style level changes with alternate paths based on bosses defeated! Hidden bosses and secrets! A fully built fortress featuring new challenges instead of retreading the known hazards of the robot master stages! And finally, a fully built level editor. with built in time attack and challenge mode, and custom boss AI planner. Allowing you to make your own Megaman stages and bosses come to life to challenge your friends and community!

title: Dr. Mario Mania
description: Dr. Mario Mania is an unofficial fan-game based of the Dr. Mario series, bringing new features and improvements to the classic formula!

title: O.M.N.I.S.: Overnight Train
description:
O.M.N.I.S. – Overnight Train is a short, atmospheric walking simulator with psychological undertones.Inspired by late-night train rides, liminal spaces, and the sense of being caught in an endless loop.

A game about repetition, perception, and losing control.

title: Pokémon Stadium Club
description: PSC acts as a "hub" to select the minigame to play. All the minigames were made from scratch in Unity Engine supporting PvP (1 vs 1, 2, or 3 players), PvE (player against AI) and EvE (AI vs AI). There are 4 difficulties available: Easy, Normal, Hard and Hyper Hard. Every playthrough ends winning either 1 coin if the player loses, or 1 * difficulty coins if the player wins. These coins can be spent in the Gachapon machine to obtain a Pokémon-toy. There are +700 collectible Pokémon toys available in PSC in regular and shiny forms, so filling the Toy-Dex won't be easy. There are more than 1500 collectibles! If you are only interest in throwing to the gacha machine, you can use the code "I WANT GACHA" to gain 2 throws for free. In addition, you get 10 coins every day!

title: Méli-Mélo: L'Odyssée de la Crème de Marrons
description: Bigflo, Oli, and McFly & Carlito must find a mysterious jar of chestnut cream in a crazy 2D platform game! Switch heroes at each level, face mini-bosses, and embark on a speedrun!

title: Monsterium
description: Monsterium is a 2D pixel platformer where you play as a witch. Jump between platforms and cast magic to raise them and destroy the monster hanging from the ropes.

title: FPV Worldwide
description: Dive into our FPV drone simulator on Steam, featuring stunning global visuals with Unreal Engine 5. Share and discover spots, control the weather, use real drone controllers, and teleport anywhere. Perfect for drone enthusiasts.

title: Particle Accelerator
description: A simple, short, and beautiful arcade game about gaining enough momentum and ripping through dimensions!

title: SuperDucks
description: Welcome to SuperDucks – a dynamic 2D platformer-puzzle game! Choose one of seven unique ducks with special abilities and embark on an exciting journey through dark and vibrant levels. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and enjoy the unique style of each tour!

title: Detective Mane
description: When items go missing and mysterious occurrences disrupt every day life, Detective Leonardo Mane is on the scene. Investigate, interrogate, accuse and solve the case.

title: Sleepy Heroes
description: A great Deck-Building Rogue-Like with Lo-Fi heroes awaits you! With Sleepy Heroes, where each round is a completely different puzzle, you can make great card combos, build your deck and win victories against sleepy creatures.

title: Northstar Courier
description: In Northstar Courier, you take the role of a 20-year-old delivery worker as she becomes accustomed to her new life in a small town. With the help of a rusty scooter, you make your way around town as you talk to the local residents, enjoy photography and fulfil your company's mysterious requests regarding odd sightings. With over 10+ cryptids to track down, will you find them all before the clock strikes midnight. Who knows what lurks in your dreams...

title: Stock the Shelves
description: A Frantic Store Management Sim. Create the best shop you can imagine, then make it better! Manage, Upgrade, Keep Customers Happy, but most importantly STOCK THOSE SHELVES!

title: Warcana: Dog DLC
description: Warcana's Dog DLC introduces dog-themed content, including a Dog of War unit, Warrior's Rest barracks, two new campaign missions, five profile titles, and a redesigned advisor.

title: Warcana: Cat DLC
description: Cat DLC introduces cat-themed content, featuring a Silent Prowler unit, Shinobi's Abode barracks, two new campaign missions, five profile titles, and a redesigned advisor.

title: Hamster Playground: Cute Pets
description: Hamster Playground's new Cute Pets DLC introduces farm-themed content, including new home decorations, animal costumes, unique quests, and jobs for hamsters. The pack allows players to explore a farm-inspired setting and dress up their hamsters as various adorable animals.

title: Grumpy Gaffer
description: Join Mr. Gaffer on his mission to protect the peace of his home in this dynamic strategy game. Test your wits and reflexes as you face intense waves of enemies, and compete in thrilling mini-games against other players.

title: Perlin Festival
description: Perlin Festival is an experimental fever-dream inspired by many of the surreal classics, with an emphasis on random events and interactions with the denizens within The Noise. You'll join the newest denizen, Pluto, uncovering only what you need to.

title: World of Warcraft: The War Within - Ghosts of K’aresh
description:
In The Ghosts of K’aresh, the campaign continues as more pieces to a troubling puzzle fall into place. Players immerse themselves in The War Within story as it leads up to the next chapter of the Worldsoul Saga—Midnight.

There’s some unfinished business to be had on K’aresh and the specter of an old enemy looms large. Forces with ill-intent are determined to bring forth Dimensius, the All-Devouring once more to finish off the ethereals. Should he arise, Azeroth will also be in peril from this dangerous Void Lord.

title: Teknokrat
description:
In the futuristic techno-metropolis of Nu-Vika, you are but a number in the system.

You have been branded as unemployed, and rely on the state to survive. Until you are assigned a temporary position at a cyborg repair workshop, giving you a shot at gaining freedom.

But when strange glitches start happening to your eye implants, you find yourself thrust into a plan far beyond your comprehension, tying your fate to one of three patients in your care.

TEKNOKRAT is a gay, y2k-fuelled sci-fi thriller/romance about the danger of enforced stagnation in the face of unstoppable change.

Explore a city where might makes right, and technology is absolute. Choose a partner in crime, and face the consequences of your actions with them.

title: Dave Gnukem
description: Parody of Duke nukem 1

title: Blind Trust: The City
description: Blind Trust: The City is a co-op game for 2 to 5 players, where only one player can see while the others are completely “blind.” The seeing player must guide their teammates verbally through traps and obstacles. Each round demands precise communication and high trust, as any mistake restarts the team. The game is fun, intense, and relies more on teamwork and communication than visual skill.

title: Farm Vet
description:
You're in charge of dozens of barnyard critters. Diagnose and treat their ailments using more than 30 realistic vet tools. It's your job to take care of and nurture all the animals!

Ride around the farm while treating 60 medical problems. Play 5 different minigames on your way to becoming the Head Vet.

Treat, feed and pamper horses, calves, bunnies, ducks, sheep, chickens and more!

With 3 levels of difficulty, Farm Vet is perfect for animal lovers and budding vets of all ages!

title: Sylox
description: Sylox is a short, minimalist base-building game with a touch of worker placement and strategic expansion. Assign limited workers to key tasks, unlock new buildings, and defend your growing base against increasing enemy attacks.

title: Logiart Grimoire: Emil's Magic Training, Part 4
description: Emil has begun training to create Logiart puzzles, just in case! Feel free to try out the records of his hard work.

title: Train Simulator Classic: SW1 Switcher
description: The SW1 for Train Simulator Classic is a superb re-creation of the 600-horsepower Electro-Motive diesel, with carefully crafted details, authentic cab and controls, and realistic sounds. The SW1 is provided in both “running” and “cold and dark” versions.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Linz - Passau Route Add-On
description: Embark on more services throughout Austria, through towns, countryside, and right to the German border with another expansive stretch from RSSLO for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Boston & Albany - Boston - Springfield Route Add-On
description: The Boston & Albany and New York Central stood among America's greatest and most remarkable of railroads, and now the experience of the B&A can be yours - with the superlative and bustling Boston & Albany: Boston - Springfield Route for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Rio Grande Southern - Placerville - Rico & Telluride Route Add-On
description: Experience the extraordinary - and the magic of legendary Colorado narrow-gauge railroading - with the Rio Grande Southern: Placerville - Rico & Telluride route for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Raven II
description: Born in Blood. Built for War. The Brutal Dark Fantasy MMORPG RAVEN2

title: Star Conflict: Dyrnwyn
description: This bundle includesImperial rank 17 ECM interceptor DyrnwynEM Weapon “Plasma Discharger”Active module “Infobarrier”CPU modifier “Heir Algorithm”Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

description: a turn-based RPG where four children try to protect their neighborhood’s last tree from being cut down. instead of just protesting in the real world, they dive into a surreal fantasy where city developers become monsters, bureaucracy turns into magic, and childhood memories become the battlefield.

title: Abyss Rebel
description: ABYSS REBEL is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG combining grid strategy, intense combat, and loot progression. Set sail for a frozen archipelago at the universe’s edge, lead a four-member squad on a skiff, equipping skills, relics, tackling bosses and summoning mechs to shatter encroaching darkness!

title: Ghost Castle: Gengar's Love Quest
description: Ghost Castle: Gengar's Love Quest is a BL visual novel with three separate routes, over 50 unique CGs, and a fully functioning sprite and CG gallery. Explore the castle through the eyes of Gengar, a charming ghost who is eager to learn all about the residents (especially the cute ones!).

title: Argonauts Agency: Missing Daughter - Collector's Edition
Argonauts Agency: Pandora's Box - Collector's Edition
Around the World 2 with the Johnson Family
description: Explore with the Johnsons. Play ten casual mini-games in different places around the world.

title: Hero in an All-forgiving Fantasy World RPG
description: Players will take on the role of a brave hero, embarking on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord, fighting thrilling battles alongside three companions! No matter what you do, you'll be met with warmth and acceptance—so immerse yourself in this hero-friendly fantasy world to your heart's content!

title: Pc Building Empire
description: Build your own computer store and turn it into an empire in PC Building Empire. Hire employees, assemble PCs, manage sales and ensure the success of your business. Grow your company, expand your operations and conquer an empire of PC gamers.

title: Ghostmoons: Arcade
description: Ghostmoons - Arcade, is a vehicle based first person shooter, focusing on rapid movements or strafing, to avoid projectiles and attacks. Your goal is to remove the unknown military's portals from the moons of the Ghostmoons system, while avoiding collateral damage of the native life forms.

title: Maru Expedition: We Can Fly
description: Catch falling allies and dominate the battlefield! Control your flying platform to catch characters and auto-attack enemies. Build your team, link skills, and shape your own strategy in this evolving arcade action game.

title: Godproof
description: GODPROOF is a story-rich tactical RPG laden with thought-provoking dark fantasy content. Play as Raiden, a gifted young warrior who has immunity to the direct supernatural interaction and influence of godly entities. Recruit companions, overcome chaos, and discover the sinister truth.

title: Kind () Station
description: Lost in the colossal labyrinth of Kind () Station, the protagonist uses scattered wayfinding signs to reach the transfer to the Rinkama Line. Decode the increasingly bizarre signage as you progress, and unravel the mysteries of Kind () Station.

title: Zompell
description:
Zompell is a fast-paced single-player FPS zombie game featuring a story-driven campaign and an intense survival mode. Use advanced spell-tech and tactical weapons to fight the undead across diverse maps and scenarios.
In Campaign Mode, you follow a gripping storyline as a soldier tasked with investigating and containing a zombie outbreak. Travel through a variety of environments—including military bases, rural village maps, and abandoned facilities—as you uncover the truth behind the infection. Encounter mission briefings, in-game dialogues, and scripted events that bring the story to life.

In Survival Mode, the mission is simple: stay alive. Select from multiple unique maps, each with its own layout and hazards. Customize your experience with a wide range of gameplay settings—choose the types of zombies you'll face, enable options like infinite health or ammo, and select your starting weapons. Defend your zone using modern firearms and experimental spell-tech. Equip one spell from each category—Fire, Cold, Blood, and Shadow—and upgrade them by earning spell points from kills. A tactical drone assists you with targeting and support, adding a strategic edge to the chaos.

With two distinct modes, deep customization, upgrade systems, and fast-paced zombie combat, Zompell offers an exciting and replayable FPS experience for players who enjoy action and survival challenges.

title: Dead Exhale
description: Make a sound on your mic, and something will hear you. This isn’t your typical monster. He won’t just hunt you, he’ll toy with you. And as you get better, he adapts, evolving to match your skill in this tentacle-infested nightmare.

title: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend
description: You take your roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary. Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and getting closer to Robin. Will you make the most of this special weekend?

title: Intravenous Collection
description:
Experience the full saga with the Intravenous Collection.

Immerse yourself in the tactical gameplay of Intravenous 2, now including the Intravenous: Remastered DLC - a modernized version of the original game with improved visuals and mechanics.

title: Monster Tutor
description: In "Monster Tutor" you step into the shoes of a professor unexpectedly sent to teach at Netherworld Academy, a school for monster girls. Right from the start, your job is anything but normal. On day one, you meet Azazel, a troublemaker demon; Phanta, a shy ghost; and Josa, a vampire who's not too thrilled about having a human teacher. The game kicks off with you trying to make the best of this weird situation, figuring out how to connect with your students and manage their unique personalities. Do you have what it takes to tutor these girls and form a connection with them, despite being the only human in the Netherworld?

description: "Stellar Witch" is a grid-dodge action game with inventory management. Become a star-powered witch on a journey to become the Grand Mage. Collect gold in battle, buy and place constellations, and use their powers and synergies to fight ever-stronger enemies.

title: Deckstination
description: Deckstination is a real-time combat and deck-building hybrid. In this action roguelike, players use customized skill decks to overcome enemies in battles. Combine randomly drawn skills to survive intense encounters and take control of the battlefield with your own actions and strategy.

title: Confidentiality Agreement
description: Become a counselor in Confidentiality Agreement and engage in conversations with your clients. Listen to their thoughts, observe their expressions, and choose your words carefully. A few words from you could save a client's life... or destroy it.

description: You just joined Melody School, but like in most schools, bullies are everywhere. Luckily, you can fight back with music! Match the falling arrows with your arrow keys to stand your ground, defeat bullies, and make it to the next class.

Collect stars to raise your score, catch origami dragonflies to open portals, explore infinite, procedurally generated dreamscapes and use seeds to create new maps and save your favorites.

The update introduces a story centered around a mysterious woman who transforms into a revered figure within a decaying city. It also includes UI improvements, bug fixes, co-op sync updates, and performance optimizations.

description: Willer's Dominion is a TPS rogue-lite action game where you unlock and upgrade weapons, master new skills, shape your build through powerful perks, and face the growing risk of corrupted items as you grow stronger with each run. Reclaim your will before the Eye’s curse consumes what’s left of you.

title: Touch Grass

title: Hunter's Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure
description: A Victorian Steampunk Roguelike Deckbuilder. Choose from four characters with unique cards and abilities. Customize your deck and character as you investigate a mysterious plague. Battle corrupted beasts and bosses in turn-based combat to unlock powerful relics and enchanted tarot cards.

title: Bound City
description: An action-packed and bittersweet adventure in a city of endless night. Explore the dying city and try to find your way to the tower that seems to be at the heart of it all. Nothing is quite as it appears to be, and only by facing death can you hope to understand the mysteries of Bound City.

title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria - Durin's Folk Expansion
description:
Your story doesn’t end here, oh no…

The Dimrill Gate is open but what’s next for you, Dwarf? As Lord of Moria, it is now your responsibility to bring Khazad-dûm back to its former glory and repopulate it. That means only one thing - Durin’s folk are coming back to Moria!

In this expansion, NPCs join you and your Company to establish trade and help you rebuild Moria, while you embark on Expeditions to uncover even greater treasures and long-buried secrets…

title: The Freak Circus
description:
The Circus of Horrors has arrived in town.

Uncover its secrets and face the terror it hides, all while being led by Pierrot, the silent yandere, or Harlequin, his seductive rival.

Don’t be fooled by their smiles, they’re not what they seem.

You work at a café, and one day, on your way to work, fate leads you to cross paths with Pierrot. That’s when his obsession begins. But he’s not alone, his stage rival decides to join the game, turning this twisted dance into a dangerous competition… all for you.

title: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition – Platinum Edition
description:
The Witcher: Enhanced Edition – Platinum Edition is an upgraded physical release of The Witcher: Enhanced Edition, distributed on 2 DVDs and fully patched to version 1.5. What sets this edition apart is its wealth of bonus content and additional scenarios, making it the most complete version of the game available.

In addition to the two official adventures from the Enhanced Edition (The Price of Neutrality and Side Effects), this release includes five fan-made scenarios: Blight of Bogs, Deceits, Wraiths of the Quiet Hamlet, The Wedding, and Merry Witchmas. These extra modules, available in English and Polish (subtitles only), add several hours of new gameplay.

The Platinum Edition removes all DRM, allowing the game and the D’jinni Adventure Editor to run without the disc. It also includes voiceovers and subtitles in nine languages, with the option to mix audio and subtitle languages independently.

A second DVD contains rich bonus content: a 204-page artbook in PDF format, multiple official game guides and manuals in several languages, exclusive artwork and wallpapers, character avatars, walkthroughs for the fan-made adventures, and four music collections including the full official soundtrack. It also includes fun extras like a behind-the-scenes video and April Fools bonus material.

This edition is ideal for collectors and fans seeking the most extensive and DRM-free version of the original Witcher experience.

title: Sekai de Ichiban Kanashii Egao
description: The protagonist, Gaku Serizawa, is a pachinko addict who goes to a pachinko parlor every day. One day, he happens to stop by a park on his way home from pachinko and meets a mysterious girl who wants sweets. His world starts to change little by little as he comes to know her.

Investigate with up to 8 friends to explore, survive, and defend yourself from monstrosities guarding this deformed dimension. Will you let hunger consume you before the monsters do?

description: Between Dimensions Stands A Haunted Cathedral, Night‑Vision Flickers, Ghosts Lurk & A Monster Awaits Beyond The Portal To Shatter Your Sanity.

title: Survive the Descent
description: A very casual approach to the survivor-like genre. Trudge through the onslaught of foes with your own customized builds of automatically firing weapons, self-activated abilities, and scaling up with powerful synergies, all the while garnering lost souls to empower yourself for the next run.

title: Polytopia
description: Survive, craft, and thrive in Polytopia, an open-world sandbox adventure where exploration and resourcefulness are the keys to survival.

title: Trapped at Home
description: Trapped At Home is a horror game focused on hiding and avoiding a serial killer who has broken into your house and is looking for his next victim.

title: Red Core Division
description: Red Core Division is a co-op survival horror game for 1–4 players. Enter a classified containment facility, where something has gone horribly wrong. Your mission: find evidence of paranormal activity, complete high-risk objectives, and escape alive. But, something is down there—something that hunts.

title: Realm Runner
description: Realm Runner is a 3D fast paced action platformer starring Astro Eskii Dawdle, a competitor in the multiversal game show titled the Microcosm Marathon. Run through beautiful and branching levels as you take full advantage of Astro's speed and squid-like powers!

title: Zone-0
description: Zone-0 is a psychological horror experience built using one of our free game frameworks, offering a chilling glimpse into what you can create with it.

title: Dinoslap
description: Slap your way to victory over your friends in this multiplayer brawler. Use items strategically to edge out the competition. Customize your dinosaur and accessorize your victory in style.

title: Hotdog Hustler
description: Fry meat, stack buns, and serve sketchy customers fast.  Set prices, upsell extras, or pocket shady bribes. ️ Handle weirdos who want ketchup… or chaos.  A gritty, lo-fi PS2-style hotdog sim with janky charm.

title: The Memological Dungeon
description: The Memological Dungeon is a voxel-based 3D adventure. Forget about robes and swords — shoot magic at monsters with your bare hands (well, almost)! A fun journey filled with traps, meme treasures, and quirky enemies

title: Ferb
description: Descend into darkness in FERB, a horror adventure where you explore a foreboding cave, uncover secrets, and face a half-robotic beast that thrives on fear. Solve puzzles, survive five intense chapters, and outsmart FERB in solo or co-op play. Will you uncover the truth—or be hunted?

title: Cat's Showdown
description: A casual card battle game where mischievous cat brothers fight using poker-based rules. Designed for quick and fun singleplayer matches.

title: Fukiage
description: Based on real-life haunted tunnels, this is a first-person horror game. Can you escape the tunnel filled with fear and tension and make it back home safely?

title: Mushroom Survivors
description: Mushroom Survivors is a roguelike survivor game where you must endure endless waves of deadly mushroom monsters! Harness magical powers, fight automatically, upgrade your abilities, and rescue fellow survivors in a cursed world overrun by fungal creatures.

title: GladiArena
description: It's very inadequate. Please take care of it.

title: Hundred Doors
description: A psychological horror experience where reality twists behind every corner. Explore disturbing rooms, uncover buried memories, and descend into madness. Can you make it through all one hundred doors?

title: Sketchy Driver
description: An arcade, roguelike endless racer where you dodge traffic, jump ramps, perform tricks, earn points, and level up to make the run more entertaining, aiming for the best score. No story. No brakes. No problem.

title: Deepest Well
description: Deepest Well is a game where you fight off waves of enemies in a descending well with destructible terrain. Get upgrades after each wave and make insane builds to break the game!

title: Odyssey RPG
description: A JRPG where you play as Ulysses. After the victory in Troy, you must face the arduous journey home. This will make your commute sound like child's play

title: Vexcell
description: Vexcell is an elegant, minimalist puzzle game. Embrace the satisfaction of everything falling into place.

title: Rogue Paper Scissors
description: What if Rock-Paper-Scissors became a roguelite extraction deckbuilder? You'll build a deck of deadly choices, master bizarre traits, and craft powerful hybrid cards. Extract your loot, or risk everything for the next floor. Sometimes, the best strategy is knowing when to run.

title: Hear The Bell Toll
description: A roguelike city-building game focused on short satisfying runs. Buy unique buildings from a shop, place them strategically and manage class synergies and statuses carefully to meet the tribute requirements and survive for 25 years!

title: Gravity Force
description: Gravity Force puts you into the seat of a drone pilot. Steer your spaceship through narrow caves (2.5D) to fulfill your job: locate and retrieve cargo crates without wrecking the ship. The minimalistic controls and realistic physics are easy to learn, but hard to master.

title: The Way Down
description: Absurdist Interactive fiction. Talk to the beings that inhabitant the world at its end. We forgot how to die.

title: Calice
description: Calice is a card strategy deck building game. It's a game in which Alice who falls into a strange country escapes from a strange country with the help of various people. It is a game that uses various cards to defeat enemies and experience various events in the process of escaping.

title: Wizard Fight!
description: Wizard Fight is a bullet hell game where you play as the blue wizard and battle various types of monsters. Enjoy dodging curtains of bullets with a retro aesthetic. Collect keys to venture deeper into the dungeon to claim the holy grail and secure epic victory!

title: Schizophrenia: R.E.M. Protocol
description: Schizophrenia is a game where you have to not go crazy and get out of the bunker. Use all the items you can find to survive. Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

title: Dungeon Run
description: Race through 100 floors of massive dungeons, collect all the keys, and compete for glory!

title: Rotten Crop
description: Rotten Crop is an atmospheric horror game based on the lost game "That Evil Farming Game". Can you hide what you've done from your neighbors and the police? More importantly... can you live with it?

title: 3D Puzzle Dark Fantasy
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: Epicross
description: EPICROSS is a relaxing, colorful 2D picross puzzle game where players use numerical clues to fill in grids and reveal vibrant images. Solve increasingly challenging puzzles in a calm, no-time-pressure environment—perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages.
