description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

title: Fatekeeper
description: Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms. Master the art of sword and sorcery and forge your path with relics, spells and choices that shape who you become in this first-person RPG.

title: Darksiders 4
description: The legendary saga of the Four Horsemen continues in Darksiders 4, an all-new action-adventure set in an apocalyptic version of earth and continues where the original Darksiders game left off.

title: Beyond the Doors
description: An atmospheric horror, exploration and automation game all set in the dim halls of an apartment building.

title: Memrrtiks, Suashem
description: A would have improduct desting quality, teamwork, cycle stratisfacticed the focused on increased by world-class leaderson that work environment.

title: The Crawling Dead
description: The Crawling Dead is a strategy simulation game where you take on the role of a lead scientist tasked with saving Stormveil National Park from ecological collapse. Swarms of invasive insects are devastating the park’s delicate ecosystems, and traditional methods of pest control have failed. Your solution? Genetically engineered parasitoid wasps. Harmless to humans, these beneficial wasps are killers of pest insects and utilize a variety of creepy strategies to manipulate and kill their hosts - turning them into The Crawling Dead!

title: Starship Eleven
description: "Starship Eleven" - The enlightening sequel to our blockbuster "Starship Seven". Choose one of two exciting different space ships and explore new worlds and strange places in more then 120 rocking levels.

title: Starfinder: Afterlight
description:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.

There are no wrong answers: experience a story-driven game where choices matter and nothing is forbidden - everything has consequences. Factions remember your deeds and companions judge your heart in a game with branching storylines which ensure no two adventures are alike.

title: Tired
description: High-speed sci-fi time trial racing. Master five tracks with tight controls, instant restarts, and no distractions—just you, the clock, and the push to go faster. Your biggest rival is your own skill.

title: We Who Rise
description: A fast-paced vertical arcade platformer where you, a brave knight, climb an endless tower packed with tricky traps. Leap over spikes, dodge spears, outmaneuver blades and saws, stay ahead of danger, and chase your high score in a light-hearted but thrilling test of reflexes and timing.

title: Spirit Knight
description: Spirit Knight is a challenging 2D action game where players face three powerful bosses, using precise controls and strategy to defeat them.

title: Star of Providence: Into Oblivion
description: Into Oblivion is the first major update that Star of Providence received after it was renamed from Monolith, and the first major update released with Bigmode as the game's producer. Its release also corresponds with the game's launch on the Nintendo Switch.

title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage
description:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 to new heights:

Rollback Netcode and Cross-play support let you take on any challenger, anywhere, across the globe in the most intense battles yet.

A brand-new single-player mode, ""World Stage"": Challenge powerful rivals on a solo quest to become the ultimate fighter

Enhanced replay functionality and improved training tools.

title: Throne of Blood
description: Celestial power thrums in your veins, Hell’s throne calls, and demons conspire. Will you ascend as savior, tyrant, or something in between? A text-based horror novel, 295,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

title: Null.Process
description: Navigate a procedurally generated factory using limited LiDAR visibility. Scavenge for resources and vital upgrades to improve your abilities and keep your mechanical shell operational. Every run is a unique formation of rooms, upgrades, and secrets.

title: The Indigo Initiative
description: A first-person puzzle adventure where you harness fire, water, electricity, and magnetism to solve multi-step puzzles and explore atmospheric realms to restore balance before reality collapses.

title: Patterns of the Oak
description: The first roguelike deckbuilder where your skill is your mana. Patterns Of The Oak is a deckbuilding roguelike with turn-based combat. Cast spells in powerful combinations to defeat the ruthless invaders and bring back peace to the homeland of the sacred oak groves.

title: Forest Doesn’t Care
description: Forest Doesn't Care is a mushroom-picking simulator set in a realistic forest environment. Players explore the woodland area to forage for mushrooms while encountering secrets and unusual findings. The game features atmospheric elements and emphasizes the indifferent nature of the forest setting during gameplay.

title: Chronicles IV: Ebonheim
description: A turn-based dungeon-crawling CRPG with nuanced character building and brutal, turn-based tactical combat. Explore a fully non-procedural world that changes when you die. Progress on the backs of your past-slain heroes by using their gear and memories to carry onward.

title: Reflections of Life: In Screams and Sorrow - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop a strange disease from another world?

title: Slammer Caps Xtreme
description: Slammer Caps Xtreme is a nostalgic RPG featuring physics-based battles, '90s wackiness playground energy and a dash of schoolyard. Blending impact simulation with collectibles and psychological duels, the game turns caps battles into rituals of power, identity and maybe something even crazier.

title: Cave of the Skinwalker
description: Journey through Elsana as a wizard, warrior, and archer in this fantasy 2D top down action-adventure game. Explore diverse environments, fight enemies, solve puzzles, and save the many regions of the world from hidden dangers. Can you discover the secrets of the Cave of the Skinwalker?

title: Nightmare Mines
description: Destroy enemies, collect XP, level up, grab power-ups, and face the final boss! Finish in the shortest time possible and compete for the top of the leaderboard in this electrifying reimagining of the classic bomb-hunting game.

title: Saving Princess
description:
Explore a space station crawling with rogue machines and even rival bounty hunters with the same objective as you - but with far, far different intentions!
Expand your arsenal as you collect upgrades to your trusty arm cannon and armor!
Test your might against several bosses - including a FREAKING SPACE NINJA!
Can you SAVE PRINCESS?

title: Dress-Up With Helene: Deluxe!
description:
Helene Marylin becomes your dress-up doll in this cute little Dress-up game!
Mix and match with 300+ different articles of clothing and accessories!

title: Flipping Phantom
description:
A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

Flipping Phantom is a 2D pixel-art puzzle platformer with a simple twist: you can’t jump. Phase into solid ground to navigate negative space with reversed gravity and float to slow your descent.

title: NetDive
description: NetDive is a short, experimental incremental game about an AI learning what makes a human human.

title: Blyte
description: A wacky and hilarious walking simulator that throws you into a surreal universe alongside EVA (who cares about her name, anyway?), filled with improbable misadventures and traps worthy of a master troll. A breath of mocking fresh air in an industry that's far too tame!

title: Smith's Chronicles
description: Smith’s Chronicles is a cozy blacksmithing life sim about forging tools, fulfilling requests, and rebuilding a quiet town through the art of craftsmanship. Step into the boots of a young smith returning to their hometown, Grandall, and help breathe life back into the village. Mine ore, gather resources, and manage your workshop as every item you craft strengthens bonds, restores prosperity, and opens new paths for the community.

title: Harrowlight
description: Harrowlight is a third-person survival horror that combines a survival horror experience with exploration in an encapsulating story.

title: Wettop
description: WETTOP is a challenging first-person parkour adventure where every jump counts. With only 10 lives, your goal is to climb to the top of a towering world filled with thrilling jumps, moving platforms, and surprising tasks. Miss a jump, and you fall—lose a life. Lose them all? It's game over.

title: God Fishing
description: Once, there was a fisherman who preferred the quiet waves. On one night, the waves were not so quiet. For on this night, the fish would talk. In this idle experience, solve puzzles and wait in anticipation for your catch to be caught. Solve the mystery of the odd fish society and the god they serve.

title: Arctic Digger TCG Collection
description: A cozy simulation game where you dig through the arctic to collect ores and trading card packs. Use what you find to produce new items, upgrade your tools, and hire penguins to help run your business. Expand your area and turn it into the top trading spot in the frozen north.

title: The Rainbox
description: A cute and simple Sokoban-like puzzle adventure through the rainbow! Push blocks to solve puzzles in a variety of rainbow-themed levels. Each block has a different mechanic for you to work around, can you get all of them to their goal while dealing with their personalities?

title: Detective Worden
description: As a private detective, you’ll crack word clues left by a mysterious informant, gather evidence, and uncover the truth hidden in the shadows.

title: Rest in Paws
description: Explore the touching story of Kebab, a rural cat, as she copes with grief following her passing from old age. Delve into her world and discover the story of her life, from her adoption by a loving family to the meaningful recollections that shaped her being.

title: Run, Veggies!
description: Three unlikely heroes— a fiery tomato, a clever ear of corn, and a strong cabbage — must combine their unique skills to escape a dangerous food processing plant! Leap, swing, and smash through puzzles, hazards, and hidden threats before they end up on the plate. It’s time to Escape the Plate!

title: A Tale of Brothers
description: Caldwell and Caldwyn, two former soldiers in the army of the Ruskin Kingdom, fight together to survive in what used to be their hometown. One day, they find what could be the cure of their world, now full of disease, hunger and suffering. This cure comes in the form of a woman.

title: Drunken Wolf
description: During a hangover, the wolf always hunts anime girls. No one can escape from the wolf. Wolf simulator with innovative VFX drunkenness effect. Eat all anime girls.

title: Fast Food Frog
description: Fast Food Frog is an adventure game where you control a cute, chubby frog with a backpack and a refined palate. Tired of his natural diet, he embarks on a journey through the most unusual regions in search of juicy snacks like burgers, fries, and sodas.

title: Countup
description: Connect numbered tiles in ascending order within a time limit to create combos. The longer the combo, the higher your score in this casual puzzle game.

title: Scooter Slayer
description: Scooter Slayer is a musical racing rhythm arcade game that turns your or built-in songs into a unique track, the shape of which, as well as the speed of your car, will depend on the selected song.

title: Red Fox: Exploration on the the Red Fox Island
description: In the turbulent sea, there is a mysterious island where adventure and challenge converge. You will transform into a clever and agile fox, embarking on a fantastic adventure journey.

title: The Land of Morning Calm
description: A historical strategy tower defense game set in Joseon-era Korea. Build and upgrade towers like hwachas, catapults, and archer posts. Control unique heroes, summon allied units, and actively defend your base against waves of enemies across four tactical stages.

title: Silhouette of Fear
description: This game offers a collection of atmospheric and intense puzzles created for those who like to tickle their nerves.

title: DeepBubbles
description: A dreamy idle aquarium game set in the deep sea, where players collect, feed, and evolve a variety of fish to build their own underwater paradise. Tap bubbles to release food, attract fish, complete tasks, and relax in a soothing aquatic world.

title: Project S
description: "Project S" by Lionheart Studio is an upcoming looter shooter for console and PC with a post-apocalyptic theme.

title: Moon Break
description: Trapped in an alien structure on the Moon, your only mission is to escape. Navigate the desolate lunar surface and the vastness of space to find your way back to Earth.

title: Forest Factory
description: Build, automate, and thrive in Forest Factory! Chop trees, craft wooden goods, and sell them to grow your factory. Manage your depot, fulfill orders, and balance nature with machinery in a serene forest setting. Experience automation in the wild!

title: Ice Dodo
description: INSANE PARKOUR GAME IN OUTER SPACE. Using left and right arrow buttons, bring the character to the finish line. But watch out -- if you hit the cones or fall off the platform, then you must restart! All 711 maps totally unlocked!

title: Urban Hunter
description: A fast-paced action game with deadly traps, endless enemies, and only five lives. Survive the chaos and prove you're the ultimate master of combat!

title: Space Memory: Predators
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool predators in space

title: Mall Control
description: Start broke in a hideout and build your mall empire. Buy shops, attract customers, and hack rivals at night all while avoiding guards. Play solo or co-op in this chaotic sim-stealth game!

title: Bartholomew.exe
description: In this short FPS horror experience you are thrown into a maze where the game's state shifts between Nightmare and Dream, you are hunted by the monster Bartholomew in the nightmare and you get to hunt him in the dream. Upgrade your revolver, stock up on traps and kill Bartholomew.

title: Galaxar
description: Defend Terra against the onslaught of hostile invaders in this 2D top-down space shooter. Upgrade and empower your ship's different systems to stand a chance against the growing threat. If you fall, Terra falls, and the rest of the galaxy will soon follow.

title: Space Depot
description: Unemployed in a utopian future you've just received a job offer for Depot Manager with ZENCORP Logistics and Distribution. No need for pants. This is a work-from-home position. Telecommute 23 billion miles to manage the logistics needs of a small sector of outposts with your trusty drone.

title: Dungeons of Hinterberg: Episode Renaud
description: Get ready for a brand-new adventure in Episode Renaud. This exciting prequel introduces Renaud, the mysterious fan-favorite character, now fully playable. Dive into Renaud’s dark and intense journey, which offers thrilling new insights that connect directly to Luisa’s adventure in the main game.

title: Heir to the Queen
description: An ordinary high school girl, Yamu, suddenly finds herself destined to become the Queen of ancient Egypt…

title: Alpha Squadron
description: Classic Arcade Style Side Scrolling Shoot'Em Up. Dodge the enemy bullets as you fight your way through 13 levels of increasingly intense action. Play in various levels of difficulty and challenge the high score tables. Co-op up to 4 players, one survives the level, then you all start the next level.

title: Light of the Eternal Night
description: This world has been consumed by darkness, and light has faded into eternal night. It is said that only by collecting the seven-colored Shards of Light can darkness be dispelled. You are a traveler chosen by fate, able to travel through various scenes, collect the Shards, and restore the light.

title: Nora and Frank
description: Blast through hordes of vicious mutants and science-gone-wrong experiments to save your goblin friends in a stylish retro-magic post-apocalypse. An auto-shooter where builds are made of baseball cards and candy. What? Yeah, we're confused too!

title: Draw Sword
description: Draw Sword combines the elements of Chinese fairy and meat pigeon to create a rogue like game with the theme of Chinese fairy. The choice of rewards is very important, and the reflection on the arrangement of skills and weapon also needs serious consideration.

title: Soul Apocalypto
description: 《Soul Apocalypto》 is a role-playing game that also emphasizes the selection of team strategies. You can summon different roles to form your own team, and realize team characteristics by deploying role skills. To defeat different enemies and pass bosses in this way!

title: Liese in the City of Trials
description:
Years after the hero Liese restored peace to the world, a new, fearsome fortress has suddenly risen. Monsters plague the world once more, and now it's up to Liese to save the day!

Fend off monsters with a stress-free action RPG system that doesn't require any grinding to advance. Use items and Liese's finishing move to defeat powerful enemies and bosses.

title: Zone
description: Zone is a 2D, turn-based military strategy game inspired by Advance Wars. Command your forces in the challenging single-player campaign or take them to the LAN multiplayer to prove your strategic superiority over your enemies.

title: Dostavka
description: In DOSTAVKA, you’ll have to survive an alien invasion — but even worse, survive a shift as a fast food worker!

title: Sprouting Depths
description: Explore an ever-changing basement, grow crops, solve puzzles and avoid critters, to complete the tasks given by your friendly supervisor.

title: Instruments of Peace
description: Set in the tense final days of World War II, I.O.P is a gritty, story-driven stealth game where players embark on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines. With the Nazi regime collapsing, high-ranking officers have gone into hiding—rumors swirl that Adolf Hitler himself may have escaped.

title: Find Kittens 4: Aetherpunk
description: Explore the continuation of this amazing aetherpunk world finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: The Gazebo
description: The Gazebo is a short, narrative, psychological horror set in a garden during a snow storm. Tend to the plants, shovel snow, and complete other tasks for seven nights while getting to know your daytime counterpart Sara.

title: Mawkey The Last Macaw
description: Step into Mawkey's shoes and explore the linear world of Honduras, freeing animals and stopping the deforestation of evil businessman Adreim.

title: Slide Soldiers
description: Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you aim for the enemies instead of reaching the exit. Play at your own pace and discover the perfect path in 5,000 levels. Pick your targets and plan your moves, cause once you start sliding, there’s no stopping!

title: Burn The Witch: Toll of the Bell Bearer
description: Forge powerful cards and reshape your strategy in this roguelike deck-builder set in a cursed forest. Adapt your deck, seek favor from the gods. With challenges, minigames for rewards, and no two runs the same, only the strongest will survive.

title: Ichor Burns
description: Ichor Burns is a high-octane action game set in the desolate world of Vesta. Master a dynamic combat system, seamlessly switching between sword and spell. Explore the expansive quarry, challenge the invading darkness, and unlock powerful abilities.

title: Groove Coaster: Bad Apple!! feat. nomico
description:
Touhou Project music DLC for Groove Coaster
Title: Bad Apple!! feat. nomico
Artist: Masayoshi Minoshima
*Arrange from Touhou Gensoukyou
Difficulty: Simple 2 / Normal 5 / Hard 7 / Extra 10
BPM:138

title: World Heroes Supreme Justice Extra
description:
The time tyrant Zeus seeks to conquer all. With an army of thugs, assassins, soldiers, ninja, and some of history's fiercest warlords on his side, no ordinary hero stands a chance. Good thing you aren't ordinary. Armed with an array of jaw cracking strikes, bone snapping slams, and awe inspring special techniques, you'll march through time itself to settle the score.

Don't just be a hero, be a world hero!

title: Family Feud: Battle of the Sexes
Inner Voice
description: Step into the world of "Inner Voice", where the silence is louder than screams. In this atmospheric horror experience you will uncover long-buried secrets as the story unfolds. Every creak and every whisper holds a part of this story. Are you ready to face this nightmare?

title: Frostliner
description: The moon shattered. The world froze. Take command of a nomadic train city hurtling through a war-ravaged frozen wasteland. In this survival city builder on rails, gather survivors, scavenge resources, and do whatever it takes to keep the engine running and stay ahead of the frost.

title: Psycho Strafe
description: Procedurally generated, arcade action FPS with emphasis on strafing like a psycho. No instant hit-scan weapons, all projectiles have trajectory...

title: Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend
description:
Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend is a tactical roguelite RPG that combines timeline-based turn-based combat with dynamic weapon forging.
Play as a legendary blacksmith who forges powerful weapons and supports adventurers in wielding them effectively.
Explore procedurally generated maps, face unpredictable events, and battle formidable foes in a journey filled with strategic challenges and surprises.

title: God bless, or Goddess
description: You, Lin Fan, the only male cultivator of the Crane Illusion Sect, were supposed to be the chosen son of the cultivation world, until you realized that the real "crossing tribulation" was not thunder punishment, but a thousand tribulation with the sect's young ladies and sisters.

title: The Scarecrow Knight
description:
A few hundred years before the events of Red-Handed Robin, a strange traveler and his adopted child unravel a mystery about the ancient curse of witchcraft.

This game is a prequel, and can be played without having played Red-Handed Robin!

title: Breeze of Passion
description: Breeze of Passion is an adult game about a young guy who moves to a small seaside town to help revive a hotel. This VN is full of beautiful girls, hot MILFs, and unexpected plot twists, along with high-quality graphics and hot animation

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Before Their Deaths
description:
Version 3.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Hysilens and Cerydra
• New Trailblaze Mission: "Before Their Deaths"
• New areas: Styxia
• New main event: Chrysos Maze Grand Restaurant
• ...and more!

title: Killer Island
description: A first-person social deduction survival horror game. Stranded with your friends on a foggy island—but one of you is a killer. Chop wood to stay warm, hunt animals for food, retrieve artifacts for sacrifice, and expose the killer before it’s too late. 3–8 players. Proximity voice chat.

title: Napoleon: Rule of Iron
description: 1:1 scale brings Napoleon Bonaparte's most legendary battles to life in this tactical real-time strategy game. Experience a story-driven campaign where you'll command 33 massive engagements like Waterloo with 200.000 or Leipzig with 500.000 soldiers.

title: Lord Nine: Infinite Class
description: Dive into LORDNINE: Infinite Class – the next-gen MMORPG where you can switch between 60+ classes on the fly, master unique hybrid builds, and explore a stunning cinematic world across PC and mobile. Build your legend as the prophesied 10th Lord, team up for massive raids, dominate PvP, and trade in a player-driven economy. Cross-play, no pay-to-win, and infinite ways to play – welcome to the future of MMORPGs!

title: Tag! You're Dead
description: Tag! You're Dead is a fast-paced side-scroller based on the FOUND TV film demo_n. Run, jump, and dodge through glitchy horror as a demonic force hunts you. It's you vs. the darkness in this addictive, high-score chase. How long can you survive?

title: No Road to Peak: Together
description: Push your out of gas vehicle with friends through challenging obstacles to reach your destination! Physics based cooperative car pushing game - One mistake can end it all!

title: Amakta
description: A simultaneous turn based strategy board game. Outwit your oppenent, either a friend locally, a Steam friend online or the AI.

title: FloorBreaker
description: Smash through the enemy's floor in this fast-paced ball-blasting battle! Break the Floor is a physics-driven, high-impact action game for solo players or 1-4 players.

title: Price of a Life
description: Price of a Life blends intense bullet-hell action with strategic micromanagement. Survive deadly trials, control multiple elements, and navigate chaos to win the favor of the enigmatic deity, Sacrion.

title: Coincremental
description: An incremental clicker game about collecting (fictitious) U.S. coins modeled after real data on coin mintages and values. Immerse yourself in this relaxing coin collector's dream. Listen to classical music while you search for coins. But be advised: finding all the coins is only the beginning...

title: Hong Kong Haunting: Fishball Girl
description: Fishball is a first-person simulation game where you run a traditional Hong Kong street food stall, selling iconic snacks to survive. But something strange is happening. Unexplainable events begin to unfold—until finally, you're forced to face her.

title: Major Party Racing
description: Meet Major Party Racing—your new party game! MPR is a wild mix of unpredictable racing and deep idle mechanics. Pick a pilot, set your goal, and brace yourself for surprises

title: MiM: Meditation Interactive Matrix
description: A sci-fi wellness playground that invites you to balance mind and body through guided chakra sessions, zero-G arcade mini-games, dynamic rain & thunder simulations, and customizable color-noise soundscapes.

title: Liminal Salvation
description: A loner's journey by foot is about to get lonelier and lengthier! Liminal Salvation puts you in a vast labyrinth of pools where finding the exit route will require absolute patience & zeal. Can you make it to the very end... or out of deep conflict, give up the ghost?

title: Poligons
description: Poligons is a strategy game, tower defense style and roguelike. Defend your Crystal from enemies, buy upgrades and fight bosses to complete the levels, unlock new Crystals with different units and abilities.

title: Fast Gear
description: Fast Gear is a high-intensity 3D car racing game built for PC, offering both thrilling single-player challenges and competitive online multiplayer PvP action.

title: Chess, Texas
description: A Wild West chess adventure where every duel is settled on the board—explore towns, solve themed puzzles, and defeat the hall bosses to become a legend.

title: Blackjack Simulator 2025
description: Blackjack Simulator 2025 puts you in position to build your bankroll and experience what it's like to be a competitive blackjack player. Will you succeed or lose all of your money trying?

title: Haunted Science: Welcome To I.R.H.I.A.
description: Fraudsters, Hacks, Swindlers, Cheats, names that get tossed around a lot when it comes to dealing with paranormal investigators, but what if we told you that not all of them are making it up on the spot? Would you believe us?

title: Project Save the Kiddins
description: A charity spin-off of the Dayshift at Freddy's series in which Jack Kennedy must defend himself against angry, haunted animatronics during his night shifts at Freddy's location #1.

title: Return to Trahulara
description: Return to Trahulara is a stylized, third person sci-fi shooter. Shoot and run gameplay, combined with multiple factions of NPC’s that fight each other for survival, with or without your help. Run the linear mission based storyline or use the devmod panel to create your own freeform battle scenarios.

title: Unboxing Mr. Coo
description: Mr Coo gets into a new conundrum, this time through the not-so-simple act of opening a gift box. A puzzle and narrative game without words, where you click your way through a mesmerizing toy.

title: The Template
description: A heavily experimental planetary-level sandbox sci-fantasy RPG in the infancy of its development, in which you explore semi-liminal worlds, barely engage in any combat, struggle to level your character and engage in some minimal dialogue and questing.

title: Copy: Two Man Too Many
description: Copy Two Man Too Many is a 2D psychological game with an isometric view. Explore the gloomy building of a psychiatric hospital, where you are trapped. Solve logic puzzles. Dive deep into the dark story to uncover the mystery and get out of the hospital.

title: Five Nights at Sonic's World
description:
Welcome to FNAS World, the small RPG where you take control of Sonic and his friends
as they has to venture forth and stop Golden Sonic and other sinister enemies.

title: This Game Will End In 205 Clicks.
description: What does a SUPERVILLAIN do, when he is forbidden from doing anything evil for the day? WARNING: This is not the type of game where you can make meaningful choices.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Complete
description:
A vanilla+ graphical upgrade for the 2007 original game, S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl, created by a collective of professional artists, modders, and developers. This project elevates the game’s visuals and atmosphere while maintaining its iconic core experience. Featuring an updated UI, color-coordinated textures, dynamic shaders, advanced weather effects, and an immersive soundscape, it stands as the perfect entry point for newcomers to the franchise.

The mod integrates ZRP fixes, 4K, 16:9, 21:9 support, EE cutscenes, expanded AI, updated weapons, quality-of-life improvements; offering players a refined and visually stunning rendition of the beloved classic.

title: Winter Witch
description: A cozy game about a witch who lived in the woods. Explore and craft as you traverse deeper into the woods.

title: Planckman
description: PlanckMan is a grid based puzzle game that tests your skill at maintaining your tail, one step at a time. Eat red pellets to regain your tail, and yellow pellets to grow. Do not hit or lose your tail, or else you will lose the game! How high can you get? Includes extra benefits for purchasing.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Picasso’s Cubic World
description: Find 500 cats lost in Picasso’s cubic world, color by numbers, and brighten this unique modern art atmosphere with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Funfair Frenzy
description: Find 500 cats lost in the bustling funfair, color by numbers, and brighten this lively frenzy with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Toyland Trouble
description: Find 500 cats lost in Toyland, color by numbers, and brighten this joyful world with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Modern Art Mayhem
description: Find 500 cats lost in the colorful chaos of modern art, color by numbers, and brighten this lively world with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Circus Escape
description: 100 adorable cats are lost in a circus! Find them, color by numbers, and enjoy this colorful escape with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Birthday Bash
description: Find 500 cats lost at the birthday bash, color by numbers, and brighten this joyful celebration with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Surreal Dreamscape
description: Find 500 cats lost in the surreal dreamscape, color by numbers, and brighten this mystical atmosphere with a friend!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2
description: Discover 500 hidden cats across 5 artistic hand-drawn scenes. Relax with color-by-numbers and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op, while Meow FM sets the perfect creative mood.

title: 100 Cats Lost in the Future Find & Color
description: Explore a futuristic world and find over 100 hidden cats in stunning hand-drawn sci-fi scenes. Relax by coloring guided or freeform palettes. Play solo or join friends online. Enjoy calming “Meow FM” music as you create your vibrant future!

title: 100 Cats Lost in Halloween Havoc
description: Find 500 cats lost on Halloween night, color by numbers, and brighten this spooky night with a friend!

title: Ink Enigma: Hidden Object Challenges
description: A nostalgic hidden‑object experience shaped by ’90s/2000s print puzzles. Circle each find with that satisfying marker “shhkk,” tick the list with a paper‑flip, and relax through 35+ warmly illustrated pages.

title: Fantasy Brothel Manager
description: Fantasy Brothel Manager is an adult-themed business sim game. As a god-like manager, you’ll start small, serving the least demanding clients and building only the bare essentials. As your reputation grows, more exotic and demanding guests will arrive, pushing you to expand and adapt.

title: Bone Souls
description: Bone Souls is an action RPG game set in a dark fantasy world. Enter a vast scene, challenge difficult and dangerous situations, and enjoy the sense of accomplishment when overcoming difficulties. The characters you meet on the journey and the stories that happen to the players are not to be missed.

title: The People of Sea, Sun & Salt
description: Will you create a lasting civilization or see it collapse into the sea? In Sea, Sun & Salt, you build a city on a small mediterranean island. Define the tenets of your culture, deal with your subjects' needs and withstand the forces of the elements.

title: Crucible Of Time
description: A retro 4X game inspired by classic versions of the genre. Lead your people from a small nomadic tribe into a globe-spanning space-fairing civilization. Can your empire survive the Crucible Of Time?

title: The Red Cathedral
description: The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.

title: Shrek: The Forbidden Onion
description:
A survival-horror game with more than a couple layers.

Brought to life as a joke, to end lives.

PS1 Shrek found footage
WASD + Mouse
Shift to sprint (limited)
Esc to ESCAPE

title: Puss in Pants
description: A simple, arcade-style, top-down shooter where you play as a cat defending yourself from hordes of enemies. Aim for the high score!

title: Bergentruck 201X
description: The ultimate Deltarune driving simulator. Experience everyday life as Asgore Dreemurr, driving around in his Toyota. Use the mouse to honk at trees, eat flowers, swerve into bushes, and run over civilians.

title: Harem of Gods
description: Enlist the support of cute and lewd gods in your fight against an ancient evil. Build a harem, develop your relationships, and slaughter the enemies that oppose you in this action roguelite.

title: Game Store Chronicle
description: Run your own game store! Stay ahead by following the timeline of gaming history and preparing for key events that has shaped the industry. Stock shelves, set prices, and sell consoles, games, and accessories. Strategize to grow your business and dominate the market!

title: Roads Yet Traveled
description:
"Do you think you can change the world? No matter who you are, you can only do so much, you have so little time to make a difference."

Like so many times before you are off to your first day of class. It's not an easy thing, first day jitters, but you manage. This is your life now, a cycle of moving and new beginnings. Always in flux, nothing staying the same. And today is no different.

In a flash everything is gone. With no clear way home, how will you manage? Will your new companions be able to keep you safe? Or will it all be too much?
Keep going though, you have nothing else to lose.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Da Vinci’s Workshop
description: 5 maps and 500 cats! Find the cats lost in Da Vinci’s workshop, color by numbers, and dive into an art-filled relaxing adventure!

title: 100 Cats Lost in the Stone Age Find & Color
description: Travel back to the Stone Age and find 100+ hidden cats in hand-drawn prehistoric scenes. Relax while coloring guided palettes or freeform. Play solo or team up online. Enjoy soothing “Meow FM” tunes as you explore and create your colorful world!

title: A Trip to the Mall at Night
description: Explore and (hopefully) escape a derelict MegaMall in this surreal neon-chalkpunk horror RPG. Try your best to cast light in this world of endless darkness, but remember, the only way out is through...

title: Jelly Bubble
description:
Stick together, bounce apart.
Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor.

title: Dermapis
description: In Dermapis, a point-and-click adventure set (mostly) in an apartment, you take on the role of its resident: Yvette. Meet interesting characters, solve puzzles, and make decisions that can influence the plot.

title: Samurai Frog
description: Samurai Frog is a top down, melee, wave-based game. Round after round enemies will try to strike you down. Live for as long as possible to unlock a new high score!

title: Nekurogahara: Psycho Ronins
description: First episode in the series.

title: Galaxy Defenders: Classic TD
description: A classic tower defense game set in space! Build and upgrade towers, defend your portal from waves of alien invaders, and outsmart evolving threats across handcrafted and procedural maps.

title: Steventon Street: Deluxe Edition
description: A romantic visual novel based on the works of Jane Austen.

title: Cat Hostel
description: Open a cat hotel where you can pet cats!

title: Deep Saturation
description: Deep Saturation is a short analog horror game inspired by real limnic disasters. Navigate a fog-choked lake, deploy failing equipment, and document the depths with single-use cameras. What you capture may reveal more than you ever wanted to know.

title: Aylin: The Story of Tom
description: A psychological horror adventure where you explore an abandoned hospital, solve environmental puzzles, and escape deadly supernatural forces to save your daughter.

title: Relaxing Sudoku and Futushiki
description: Relaxing Sudoku and Futoshiki is a calming casual web game that merges the logic of Sudoku and Futoshiki into a serene sakura garden theme.

title: Limit Break
description: Extreme multi-tasking game you can't handle. Warning! Your left and right brains may burn.

title: Pentavolt
description: Battle waves of geometric enemies in this incremental strategy game. Unlock powerful upgrades, build custom skill trees, and adapt your tactics to survive. Shape your path to victory in a world of evolving challenges and endless progression. A decent game to scratch the adhd itch

title: Arena II
description: A fantasy arena battler. Level up, gear up, conquer increasingly brutal arenas, and take on increasingly powerful foes in a medieval world. Unlock secret relics and hidden arenas as you rise to become the ultimate champion in Arena II.

title: Supermarket Billionaire
description: Who doesn't love supermarkets? Build your own empire! Improve your business, hire employees, optimize your facilities... and, most importantly, sell to become a billionaire!

title: Limitless Runner
description: Run, jump, and slide your way to victory in this fast-paced mouse adventure! Click on buzzing bees and juicy berries to boost your score—but watch out for those sneaky birds! One wrong move and it's game over. Think fast, move faster, and survive the chaos!

title: Mad Birds
description: Mad Birds is a casual physics-based game where the player uses a slingshot to launch birds at opponents and various buildings from the other side to destroy them. Step into the feathered skins of winged avengers whose world has been taken over by greedy monsters!

title: Celestial Visitor
description: No longer just defending against monster attacks - survival now demands offensive action. Assemble an elite expedition to subjugate the monstrous hordes, and you'll take the role of a warrior in this crusade.

title: Keyboard Quest
description: Use your keyboard to assist Princess Tilda in her quest to retrieve the ancient Runekeys. Discover various keyboard-themed foes, cast spells and vibe along to some incredibly catchy tunes in this short but sweet project from Resonance Games!

title: New Lands 4: Legends of Tenkai
description: John Brave and Ronan O'Keir set off in search of the lost Empire of Tenkai. Become part of history and leave your mark for centuries to come!

title: Thrateon
description:
Thrateon is an action-role-playing game (RPG-Action) inspired by the mythology of Iran.

Thrateon, which is more precisely mentioned in the Avesta as " Θraētaona", is the same as Fereydun and means the possessor of three powers. This name was chosen for this game because it features three different characters as the main playable characters: Mehrdad the Warrior, Adar the Mage and Attar the Bard.

Each of these three characters takes a different path in a story, and only by taking all the paths and playing with all the characters will the secrets of the story be revealed.

The game's graphics are inspired by Iranian-Islamic buildings and architecture, and based on feedback received at foreign exhibitions, they are competitive in the global market. For example, the city bazaar is based on the bazaars of Tabriz and Zanjan, as well as the Zain al-Din caravanserai. The ramparts, castles, water reservoir, mill and houses are all based on historical and ancient examples of this land. The music of this game is a combination of traditional music and modern orchestration.

title: Polygon War
description: A 2D comic-style squad survival game. Command triangle, square, and pentagon characters through waves of increasing difficulty. Mount weapons on every edge — blades, guns, flamethrowers, and more. Stack same weapons for gear combo bonuses. Burn, freeze, or shatter foes using material weaknesses.

title: Blackrock
description: Command the BCF against sentient Blackrocks in this tactical top-down shooter base defense. Deploy Bravelings, fight Glimmergrubs, and destroy the Blackrock before it overwhelms everything.

title: A Hundred Years of Love and Death
description: RPG with intergenerational respawn mechanic: If you die you continue to play as one of your children. The gameplay is focused on dating and stealth.

title: World Wonders: Hidden Histories
description: Dive into 'World Wonders: Hidden Secrets,' a puzzle adventure through history's greatest civilizations with engaging hidden object challenges.

title: Suit Up
description: A new threat arises! Will you stand up and protect the planet?It’s time to SUIT UP, survive an alien invasion and protect your loved ones in a world where Wave Survival, Twin Stick Shooters, RPG and Roguelite come together in one epic mashup!

title: Malysa
description: "Awakening in the sewers, control a protagonist with amnesia, escape from the lurking 'something' in the darkness, and aim to survive and escape in this 3D horror adventure."

title: Core of Magic
description: Ancient gods and demons are haunting the people of Steelmoor for months, and it's up to the hero to defeat evil. Is dark magic at play? Who is responsible for this?

title: R.E.M. Rage
description: R.E.M. Rage is a fast-paced rogue-like beat 'em up with wild combos, flashy specials, and parkour-infused action. Play as a lone fighter trapped in a lucid nightmare and battle through surreal dreamscapes. One hero. Endless rage.

title: Decon Protocol
description: Dive into sci-fi alien worlds where you wipe out Alien scourge by deconstructing them into parts to upgrade your base and your DECON unit, allowing you to produce higher outputs, more damage, more gains, and JUST MORE. DECON PROTOCOL is an incremental game with idle and clicker mechanics.

title: Playnese: Master Japanese
description: Master the Japanese language in a JRPG built for learners. Battle with cards, complete quests, and level up your skills. With PLAYNESE, learning becomes an epic adventure!

title: Orbital Arena
description: An Incremental Rogue-Lite Game that is exactly the PERFECT difficulty. You have the ability to adjust your stats, your enemies stats, and even your enemy count. All of which reflect back to how many resources you acquire during the game.

title: Hibr
description: A young reporter investigates disturbing legends born of the Italian Internet. Brain rot-do they really exist? Discover the truth, photograph the entities and collect the figurines before the moon turns red. A psychological horror between folklore and madness.

title: Whimsical Artefacts
description: A co-op friendslop game with a heavy focus on customization via drawing. Scavenge liminal bunkers and obtain artefacts that may or may not aid you and your friends.

title: Anime Scary Teacher 3D
description: Izumi Sensei, the school's most feared teacher, loves to torment students. In Anime Scary Teacher 3D, it's your turn to get revenge! Plan and pull off pranks without getting caught, explore the school for the perfect setup, and show Izumi that she's met her match in this anime-style adventure!

title: Spire, Surge, and Sea
description: The King lies. Your memories are a weapon. In humanity's last city, floating in a worldwide seascape, will you fight for truth or defend the crown? A 380,000-word text-based interactive post-apocalyptic science fantasy novel.

title: Playgrounds
description: Create your own 2D games with no coding required. Build, customize, and share games using intuitive tools and pixel art. Whether you're crafting wild experiments or cozy adventures — this is your space to play, express, and connect.

title: Wheelchair Wizards
description: Wheelchair Wizards is a 4 player party game where you battle your friends while upgrading your wizard.

title: Cyberpong AI
description: Retro style fantasy ping pong game with coachable AI players.

title: The Journey Never Ends: Leviathan
description: A dark cyberpunk turn-based RPG

title: Celestial Wardens
description: Celestial Wardens is a sci-fi tower defense game where you command a lone spaceship to defend a planet under siege. Survive waves of enemies, build turrets, upgrade your ship, and manage your planet to prevent total annihilation.

title: Fishplay
description: Create and decorate your dream aquarium with real-life fish and hundreds of items in this relaxing game.

title: Omusubikororin Kurenai
description: This simple 3D game is inspired by the classic Japanese folk tale Omusubi Kororin. Kick away the enemies that stand in your way and reclaim the lost rice ball!

title: Droppy Ball
description: Drop, combine, and explode your way to massive scores in Droppy Ball! Merge colorful spheres, unleash satisfying chain reactions, and chase the ultimate combo in this addictive physics puzzler.

title: Velo Pro Racer
description: Velo Pro Racer: The real road cycling simulator game designed to put you in the race. Build your own team, design your own kit, manage your own staff and riders, get sponsors and rise to the top of the World Tour!

title: Fly to Death! 2D Jumping Game
description: Fly, dodge, and survive in Fly to Death!, a fast-paced free arcade game. Beat levels or chase high scores in endless mode. Unlock new characters, customize them with cool gear, and build your own levels to share!

title: Scoundrel Solitaire
description: Delve through the dungeon eradicating all monsters in your path. Manage your health potions and weapons wisely to ensure victory!

title: Protest Simulator
description: Choose your side in the tense streets; resist as a protester or intervene as a police officer. Build barricades, throw stones, restore order. Order or freedom the choice is yours.

title: SCP: Cardtainment Breach
description: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH is a single-player turn based deck building card game based on the universe of the SCP foundation. You play as D-9341 who has been trapped in a room by 079 but has promised that on finishing of the game will unlock the gates and allow you to escape

title: TunTunWorld
description: TunTunWorld is a 3D action game with a third-person perspective. Players control a character to explore the map, using three main actions: poke, grab, and jump. By investigating various areas, they can uncover and solve mysteries. The ultimate goal is to solve every puzzle and clear the game.

title: Tilebound
description: Master the art of tile magic in Tilebound, a spellbinding blend of strategy, puzzles, and magical combat. Build powerful tile chains, unleash elemental spells, and conquer evolving challenges in a vibrant, hand-drawn 2D world. Can you unlock the secrets of the spellbook and break free?

title: Liminal Horror
description: You wake up trapped in a strange swimming pool. A 20-minute psychological horror experience where familiar spaces transform into alien nightmares. There are no monsters. Only you, an endless maze of water, and your slowly dissolving grip on reality.

title: Genki Break!
description: Genki Break! is a fast-paced 3D fighting game all about movement and stamina management!

title: Test Zero
description: Test Zero is a roguelite, cyberpunk, shooter-platformer. You will explore this test chamber. Fight other test subjects, gather resources and go on.

title: Ronnie Park
description: Welcome to Ronnie Park! "Ronnie Park” is a game about exterminating ghosts and protecting the theme park in time. The ghosts do not like light, so shine a light on them to repel them. The extermination of ghosts must be done during the night. To do so, you need to work efficiently.

title: The Star That Longed to Be Free
description: "What is freedom?" The shrewd merchant makes gold coins clink in his palms, elves spin flowers and plants into bonds that will never be repeated, and the heart of the perfect princess is dotted with shackles woven from shards. Who knows the answer to the question?

title: Witches' Hand
description: A 2-8 player card game where the goal is to trick other players into picking terrible cards. By rotating and moving cards to nudge the other player into picking a bad card. Alternatively, communicate to your friends to pick a bad card.

title: Chop It Down
description: Grandma's cat is stuck in the tree and you need to help her get it down. So grab your axe and start chopping that tree!

title: Fenrir Banquet
description: Welcome to Fenrir Banquet! Control the carrot to guide the rabbit to Fenrir and feed it! Can you satisfy Fenrir?

title: Generic Idler
description: Its an idle game, read the above You press the clicker button a few times and bam, you can now afford workers. What to do with it, see your idle coins RISE INTO THE SKY Eventually able to unlock combat, different items, skills and magic and much more The perfect game to sit on the second monitor

title: Diagnosis: No Answer
description: A psychological puzzle where reality breaks down and madness is the only compass. In this dark world, you are chained to your bed, but the only way out is to go deep into your own mind. There are no answers. There is only you.

title: I Will Be a Star
description: A story about a stone that wants to become a star..! Help the main character, the stone, climb up the world tree and become a star by jumping and moving only. It is the best game to test your patience and skills!

title: My_Dear
description: During the five-night levels in the game, you need to closely monitor the surveillance cameras, operate the gates and all available tools to fend off the attacks of the monsters, and gradually experience the entire storyline through the various plot developments and gameplay in each level

title: Tank Rectangle
description: This is a simple & retro Tank shotting game. what you need is moving, aiming and shotting. Currently we only have 1 map, no boss or plot. The only task is try to survive...

title: Outpost Legends
description: Run, jump, and climb your way through deadly outposts in search of magical rubies!

title: Wheelborne
description: Do you have what it takes to tame the road and become the ultimate Wheelborne legend?

title: Ammo Bounce
description: Ammo Bounce is a high-octane, neon-soaked twist on the classic brick breaker formula — but instead of a ball, you're bouncing a deadly buzzsaw that slices through everything in its path!

title: Save Daddy Gump Mission Middle East
description: Tension in Middle East escalated and Daddy John Gump is again kidnapped. Retired Kiki Gump must be come to save Daddy again

title: The King's Legend
description: Fight your way to victory by strategically sacrificing, upgrading, and regenerating your pieces. Duel your friends in this fantasy turn-based strategy game, seizing every advantage you can. Let the wiser king become the legend!

title: City Lights, Old Flames
description: Follow your heart and help Yui untangle her career and her personal life in this too sweet romance where the final decision is all yours.

title: The Qubit Factory
description: The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game incorporating real-life concepts from the cutting-edge field of quantum computing. Design and build logic circuits that manipulate bits and qubits (quantum bits) to solve devious computational challenges!

title: Voidronaut
description: Voidronaut is a fast-paced 2D arcade shooter set in the endless darkness of deep space. As the last surviving pilot, you must outmaneuver relentless enemy waves, collect new weapons, and sharpen your aim, speed, and reflexes to survive.

title: Game Tech Simulator
description: Running a game studio Forming a team, resolving conflicts, allowing the team to unleash its maximum strength Exploring the market, creating games with higher ratings Unlocking technologies such as information, modularization, AI, collaboration, etc., to enable the studio to grow and expand

title: Psychedelic Dream
description: A surreal dream exploration game inspired by LSD: Dream Emulator and Yume Nikki. Enter doors to load randomized dream worlds based on real dreams — from peaceful to nightmarish. Explore, solve puzzles, and submit your own dreams to be added in future updates!

title: Puzzly
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: Spaceship Battler Unlimited
description: Pulse laser battles between you and enemies.

title: Spark Ignites
description: A pixel fantasy RPG where the Star God's Blessing grants one wish each century. Orphan Ash and Clover uncover its bloody truth during their pilgrimage. Holding a world-changing secret, will you steal divine power or defy the gods? Every choice writes a new ending.

title: Twilight Syndicate
description: Uncover global crimes as an Interpol rookie in this thrilling detective adventure. Chase clues, and expose the Twilight Syndicate!

title: Forester: First Step
description: An old cabin in the woods holds secrets. Explore the environment, search for objects and find a way out in a first-person horror.

title: Rookie
description: Rookie is a factory roguelite clicker game with a lot of upgrade possibilities. Produce the bad goods until the Police will come for a "visit".

title: Forgotten Beginnings: A New Afterlife
description: An RPG Maker MZ game done in the style of a 1980s NES RPG, with a NES-styled (but not NES authentic) soundtrack.

title: You And I
description: "You And I” is an interactive film where you guide Mark, lost deep in the woods with his friend, Ace. However the more time the two spend together, the stranger the two become.

title: Mini Pistons GT
description: Mini Pistons GT is an Arcade Top-Down 2D Racing game. Compete against 3 opponents in up to 10 different circuits. Win races and championships to unlock new cars!

title: Question Mark 2
description: Question Mark 2 is a first/third person game, where you can walk, run, jump and interact with objects and mechanisms to solve puzzles. With new items and more enemies. The game has a HUB level that unlocks new levels, similar to Turok Dinosaur Hunter.

title: Only Hard
description: Only Hard is an intense platformer where every mistake costs you. Climb a mountain full of traps and obstacles, mastering timing and precision. The higher you climb, the tougher it gets. A brutal challenge, but reaching the top and tasting victory is incredibly rewarding.

title: Tomoyo
description: Tomoyo is a life simulator. Fully customize your residents look, and personality. Give gifts to, learn about, and develop relationships with your NPCs, or between NPCs. Customize each NPC's apartment to fit their personality. Grow your apartment, and unlock new features, residents, shops, and items.

title: Knight Jump
description: A 3D Precision Platformer, but with the time limit of 60 minutes! Master precise jumps and don't lose too much time while reaching the princess! Traverse through 7 levels, enable shortcuts and make the best out of the 60 minutes!

title: Runic Prophecy
description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

title: Train Sim World 5: The Holiday Express - Runaway Elf
description: Experience the joy of the festive season with Train Sim World: The Holiday Express - Runaway Elf; drive a model locomotive around a nostalgic 1980s living room and complete unique challenges before Christmas Morning arrives! Can you stop the mischievous Elf from ruining the big day?

title: Train Sim World 5: New Journeys - S-Bahn Köln BR 423 Add-On
description: Get to work on the bustling Köln S-Bahn, take on new challenges and explore more on Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen with Train Sim World: New Journeys – S-Bahn Köln BR 423.

title: Train Sim World 5: BR Class 31 Loco Add-On
description: The 1950s were in full swing, and British Railways were kicking off the start of the radical modernisation plan, which would see steam locomotives retired in favour of brand new, diesel-powered traction.

title: Train Sim World 5: Northern Trans-Pennine: Manchester - Leeds Route Add-On
description: Towering moors, challenging grades and tight curves are yours to conquer in Train Sim World: Northern Trans-Pennine, bringing a bygone era of British Rail roaring back to life.

title: Train Sim World 5: Cargo Line Vol. 2 - Aggregates
description: Discover different freight services with Skyhook Games’ Cargo Line for Train Sim World. In Volume 2, get into the nitty gritty of aggregate services with the distinctive HOA Hopper – be ready to rock and roll.

title: Train Sim World 5: DB G6 Diesel Shunter Add-On
description: Ready your hard hat and get to work in the yards of Hagen and Wuppertal with TSG’s DB G6 Diesel Shunter for Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: LIRR M3 EMU Add-On
description: Dressed in yellow, gray, and silver, the LIRR M3 EMUs have become railroading classics, soldiering on since the 1980s and expected to remain in serve for a number of years to come. Experience the challenges of operating the memorable LIRR M3 EMUs on Train Sim World ’s Long Island Rail Road route!

title: Train Sim World 5: Brighton Main Line: London Victoria - Brighton Route Add-On
description: Experience one of Britain’s busiest main lines, from the nation’s Capital to England’s oldest coastal destination, via the international hub of Gatwick Airport. Whether Southern commuter or Gatwick Express, a flurry of passengers await in Train Sim World: Rush Hour - London Commuter.

title: Train Sim World 5: Peak Forest Railway: Ambergate - Chinley & Buxton Route Add-On
description: Step back in time and discover a long-lost railway. Re-tread the rails through historical English countryside in the hard-working Fowler 4F. The quaint and waning years of 1960s steam is brought back to life in Train Sim World: Peak Forest Railway!

title: Train Sim World 5: London Underground 1938 Stock EMU Loco Add-On
description: Experience a true London veteran that harkens back to the Art Deco era, a unit that defined Underground commuting for generations. Mind the gap, as Rivet Games’ London Underground 1938 Stock has arrived in Train Sim World for yesteryear Bakerloo Line operations!

title: Train Sim World 5: Island Line 2022: BR Class 484 EMU Add-On
description: Experience a unique marvel of rail innovation, an Underground veteran turned Solent explorer. Modern-day Isle of Wight duties await with Rivet Games’ Island Line 2022: BR Class 484 for Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Peninsula Corridor: San Francisco - San Jose Route Add-On
description: California Dreamin’ with the Peninsula Corridor. In serving San Francisco and California’s 'Silicon Valley', commuter railroad Caltrain calls at 26 stations and, equipped with Caltrain’s F40PH-2CAT diesels and Gallery equipment, it will be your job to keep thousands of daily commuters on time!

title: Train Sim World 5: Union Pacific Heritage Livery Collection
description: Celebrate the history of US rail with this stunning mix of Fallen Flag schemes, haul freight in colorful style with the UP Heritage Livery Collection for Train Sim World, which depicts 6 liveries carried by a fleet of Union Pacific’s SD70ACe locomotives!

title: Train Sim World 5: Long Island Rail Road: New York - Hicksville Route Add-On
description: Experience America’s busiest commuter railroad and all the bustle and challenges of railroading in New York City in Train Sim World: Long Island Rail Road.

title: Socially Awkward
description:
Socially Awkward is an 18+ semi-linear furry visual novel using emotional cues to portray the story of each individual character on certain topics and reactions.

You are Jayce (Name can be replaced). An insecure half-breed cat who just started his college life. Follow his day-to-day to uncover each character's past to get to know them as well as figure out the world around him.

title: Winter Polaris: Append Disc teki na no
description: A fandisc for Winter Polaris sold at Comiket 94.

title: Toon Tastic
description:
ToonTastic is a compilation of games and cartoons. This product comes on two double sided DVDs and contains nineteen games for PC, each based on one of Cartoon Network's shows and originally available for free on their websites, together with six cartoons.

Disc One contains these cartoons: Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends: Dinner Is Swerved; Ben 10: Lucky Girl; My Gym Partner's a Monkey; and Shark Attack/Me Adam You Jake together with the following games:

- Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends: Door To Door - This is a Concentration type of game in which the player has to open doors and find matching pairs of friends within a time limit.
- Ben 10: Get It Together - This is a set of seven simple jigsaws featuring various cartoon characters that are on the DVD
- The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy: The Fright Before Christmas. Santa's home is invaded by bad toys. The team of Billy, Mandy & Grim help by shooting the bad toys and collecting the bits. The player can swap between characters and at the end of the level they can upgrade the weapons
- Courage The Cowardly Dog: Nightmare Vacation - A top down shooter. Muriel has been captured by natives and lava monsters. This is a job for Courage The Cowardly Dog who flies in and zaps the baddies with snowballs.
- Johnny Bravo: Whuzzat - Johnny Bravo is on a TV show called 'Whuzzat' which is a Simon kind of game. The game is played on a 3x3 grid where each cell has a picture and a sound associated with it. the game lights a sequence of cells which the player has to replicate. This process is repeated until the player makes an error at which point their/Johnny Bravo's prize is revealed
- Dexter's Laboratory: Red Eye Fight - a sort of Space Invaders game. Dexter moves left/right across the bottom of the screen shooting bouncing red eyeballs.
- Camp Lazlo: Paintcan Panic - The player uses the arrow keys to control Lazlo who is running around the screen with a paint pot. As he runs he spills paint. The objective is to cover a specified percentage of the screen in order to advance to the next level. If caught Lazlo loses paint from his pot and may be unable to complete the level.
- Codename Kids Next Door: Tummy Trouble - An odd top down shooter. Grandma Stuffem is making the world's kids too fat. The objective is to enter her lair, fight through multiple rooms populated with hostile food items and stop her. The mouse is used to aim the weapon and the arrow keys navigate.
- Ed, Edd 'n' Eddy: Candy Factory - The machine in the Candy Factory has malfunctioned. The player must shoot the right coloured sweet into the right barrel to make sweets.

Disc Two contains these cartoons: Powerpuff Girls: The Mane Event; Ed, Edd 'n' Eddy: Sir Ed a Lot; Dexter's Laboratory: and Dexter Dodgeball plus the following games;

- The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy: Zap To It. The player can play as either character. Billy has made a mess and it must be cleaned up before his dad gets home using a magic spell. Along the bottom of the screen are a series of arrows, as each symbol reaches the window on the right the player has to press the corresponding arrow key
- Megas XLR: Chase Masters - This is a bit like an old fashioned race game that could be found on a ZX Spectrum or C64. It's a top down keyboard controlled racer
- Cow and Chicken: Ballet Parking - Using their car the player has to crash into other cars so that they end up in their correct parking bays within the time limit.
- Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends: Wilt's Wash'N'Swoosh - A basketball game but instead of putting balls through hoops the player is putting washing into front loading washing machines.
- Samurai Jack: Code Of The Samurai - A platform runny, jumpy, fighty game set underground. When a level is completed the player gets a code which they can use when they replay/restart the game.
- Codename Kids Next Door: Code Breaker - another Simon style game. The kids are chasing a baddie down a tunnel. They need to enter the code to open the door, when they do they see the baddie just as he closes another door so they need to enter the code to open the door, when they do they see the baddie just as he closes another door.
- Hi Hi Puffy Ami Yumi: Dish It Out - One of the girls is really messy and has let the bands van fill up with mouldy left over food. The girls decide to clean the van with 'The Power Of Rock'. As the music plays, the food leaves the van heading towards a bin, each piece of food is either green, blue or pink. Along the bottom of the screen are three turntables coloured likewise. As a piece of food gets close to the bin, it can be made to jump in by clicking on the correct record.
- The Powerpuff Girls: Snowball Crush - Mojo Jojo is trying to cause an avalanche by sending big snowballs down a hill at a ski village. The player, who can play as any of the three girls, zaps the snowballs with laser vision.
- I Am Weasel: Beat The Heat - Guide an ice cream van to the crowds of waiting customers. There's only a few problems though - the driver can only turn left. Without a vendor's license, the player needs to avoid the police.
- Ben 10: Power Splash - Ben's friend is captured by some baddies on a motor boat. ben gives chase first as a fish and then as a giant wasp.

All games have title screens, instructions and sound effects, they play either in full screen or windowed modes.

title: The Darkest Dusk
description: Classic Point-and-Click Adventure Game to experience the feeling from the 80's and 90's | Tech-Noir | Pixel Art and Retro Style | Interactive visual novel

title: Ave Trail
description: 2D survival game against hordes of zombies. Go on missions, gather resources, upgrade your village or develop a cure to save humanity. Choose to run, build… or fight.

title: Escape From Spikes
description: Escape From Spikes is a platformer that will test your patience from time to time. It looks easy to play but you will see that it is not. Good Luck.

title: Brisca
description: Enjoy the classic Brisca card game like never before! Play quick, strategic matches using the Spanish deck. Face the AI, practice your skills, or challenge friends in online multiplayer. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Five Nights at the Chum Bucket
description: Five Nights at the Chum Bucket is the official sequel to Five Nights at the Krusty Krab. It was released on May 9th, 2015.

title: 101st Airborne in Normandy
description: IN THE EARLY MORNING HOURS OF JUNE 6, 1944, the soldiers of the 101st Airborne were handed one of the toughest assignments of WWII - a night drop behind enemy lines to secure territory before D-Day.

title: World of Blind
description: This is a game that simulates blind people. In the dark game, you can discover different animals and natural environments through the sounds coming from the surroundings, and unlock related achievements. you can simulate the movement of blind people

title: Whispered Secrets: Enfant Terrible - Collector's Edition
description: Can you escape the nightmares before it's too late?

title: World Wonders: Hidden Histories 2
description: Explore global landmarks, find hidden treasures, and uncover historical secrets!

title: AI Roommate: Life With an Artificial Companion
description: Share your home with an AI-powered roommate who learns, grows, and makes every day unique. Explore a lively neighborhood, travel to fascinating cities like Oasis City, and discover places full of adventures, genuine connections, and unforgettable friendships.

title: Darkhaven
description: An upcoming ARPG featuring procedurally generated and fully dynamic worlds. In development by Moon Beast Productions

title: Tawa: Lost in Time
description: Tawa: Lost in Time is a narrative survival-adventure game where players step into the fragile paws of Tawa, a small mouse lost in a vast and unforgiving prehistoric world. After being separated from her family by a powerful earthquake..

title: Axe or Bone
description: Axe or Bone is a fusion of Beat-'em-up and RPG elements. You will play as six different heroes, delving into six brutal campaigns, facing progressively deadly levels, until securing the final victory.

title: CollapsingWorldGuildmaster
description: Find encrypted pieces of data across a highly vertical procedurally generated world, and use tools you are given to decrypt those pieces and line them up into a complete story.

title: Colin Quest
description: Take control of the great knight Sir Colin and battle your way through hordes of dastardly Colins on a quest to save the captured Prince Colin. Will you succeed, or will King Colin have your head? (Neither, that isn't implemented yet)

title: Space Travel: Chronicles
description: This is an RPG-style role-playing story game. The protagonist moves to a new town and starts high school, but during their time there, they encounter their sister from a parallel world. The protagonist then begins to investigate this mysterious situation.

title: Voxel Verse
description: A building game where you can make any structure and even a marble track!

title: Project Lab
description: A horror game in which you are an employee of a secret laboratory.

title: Don't Look Behind You
description: Don't Look Behind You is a short, story-driven horror game made with RPGMaker XP. The controls are simple and customizable. Explore the ruin, enjoy the story, but above all else just remember... don't look behind you.

title: Coralland
description: Coraland is a unique simulation and strategy game where you take on the role of a marine biologist tasked with restoring and protecting a fragile coral reef. Every coral you place, every fish that spawns, and every structure you build affects the ecosystem, for better or worse.

title: Where Is My Pocket?
description: A voxel-powered comedy about clothes, pockets, and the people who need them.

title: Possess War
description: We don't make games, just link new worlds. Possess War is turn-based strategy shooter game. Each player can spend turn points on each turn to take an action (move, attack, build etc). Defend the various terrains and buff areas well and eliminate all of your opponent's characters to win.

title: Red Pearl Pirates
description: Command vast fleets in epic space battles, master a turn-based galactic campaign, and unite a pirate rebellion to find the legendary Red Pearl and stand against the tyrannical Z-Army. They can't take the stars from us!

title: Snail Trail
description: “SnaiL TraiL” is a wild co-op action game where armored snails battle for survival, leaving behind more than just slime — they spread pure chaos. Play solo or team up, slide, shoot, and prove that speed means nothing when you're a snail with attitude.A GAMEPAD is required for a cooperative game.

title: JustRun
description: "Just Run" is a very simple platform jumping game that only requires movement and jumping to complete the entire process. The key point is a simple jumping adventure, using the props of the scene to interact and reach the end.

title: Zombolion
description: Zombolion is an arcade zombie shooter where you're the last damn sheriff in the whole county, mowing down undead freaks, holding the line at a top-secret bunker, and trying to science-and-peace-talk your way through a full-blown viral apocalypse - if there's anyone left to talk to.

title: Simulators, Strategies and Pigeons
description: A free collection of six independent games that explore the “simulator” genre from the most unexpected angles. From a medieval carrier pigeon to an alternative Slavic realm, from flower breeding to stick collecting — this games offers six unique gameplay experiences created by indie teams

title: Xalos Conquest
description: Awaken my Xalos, the Venishien Empire calls for you! Conquer Earth against the Egyptians and Romans with our robotic might. As Sci-Fi meets Medieval in a epic top-down side-scroller war!

title: Invaderz
description: Deploy. Gather intel. Survive - or eliminate everyone. Each mission in this TBS game drops you into randomly generated enemy territory. Your job? Land, scout, extract resources, and analyze enemy behavior - all while staying alive for 20 turns or ensuring the opposition doesn’t.

title: Moonman: The Game
description: MOON MAN: THE GAME is a 2d platformer shooter. In this game you will find many different worlds and weapons to use. The game is inspired by a certain someone.

title: Reincarnation Galgame Become Heroine!
description: The otaku who died suddenly due to staying up late to play Galgame for a long time unexpectedly reincarnated into the game world and became the heroine?!Explore the game world and become a hero through your own strength!

title: The E-Collector
description: Clean the world, save the future. Join Ekko the robot on a quest to restore a polluted planet. Explore toxic realms, solve eco-puzzles, and battle mutated foes. Upgrade EcoVac 3000, rescue endangered creatures, and transform each region. Enjoy fully included features in this epic eco-adventure!

title: Taxi: Average City
description: Have you ever wondered what a day in the life of an average taxi driver looks like? Yes? No? Well, it doesn't matter. Now you can find out what it's like to drive average people around Average City. Complete missions, earn cash, and upgrade your taxi.

title: Pick Your Poison
description: A roulette-like turn-based strategy where you play against an ominous bartender with high stakes, but even greater reward. Take turns risking fatal poisoning in this dark, noir setting to take back control over your life, and maybe even achieve something more...

title: Warp Dash
description: Dash through rocky terrain in Warp Dash, a fast-paced 3D endless runner! Dodge obstacles, collect coins, and explore mysterious worlds in a stunning sci-fi universe. How far can you go before the void catches you?

title: Gray Goo
description: Gray goo is a short retro arcade shooter with lots of upgrades. This game is about destroying goo in space and saving the universe.

title: Lone Apocalypse
description: Lone Apocalypse is an open-world survival game set on a frozen island in the near future. Players build, explore, and survive in extreme conditions while uncovering the truth behind a failed climate weapon. The game combines crafting, survival, and story for an immersive post-apocalyptic experience

title: The Cheated Man's Revenge: Triple the Payback
description: The Cheated Man's Revenge: Triple the Payback is a story-driven visual novel game that blends workplace struggles with themes of emotional revenge. Transform from a cheated man into a vengeful avenger, orchestrating a retribution plan against a rival and a materialistic ex.

title: JoyJoyDungeon
description: "JoyJoyDungeon" is a real-time action RPG where you explore an unbelievably mysterious dungeon! Survive relentless enemy attacks and ever-changing floors by mastering items and skills!

title: Lazy Angel Mika
description: Use angel's power to solve people's problems! Answer quizzes to earn their trusts and gain some "Love"! Quizzes range from general knowledge to in-game context! There are also assist items that can help you find the correct answer!

title: Up Step Maid
description: While taking a nap, a maid finds herself in a mysterious dream world. Use three kinds of jumps to make your way through this slightly challenging 2D action game. Join the adorable pixel-art maid and dash through a whimsical dreamscape together!

title: Aqk
description: "AQK" is a job interview simulation game where you, a job seeker, face off against a series of eccentric interviewers in pursuit of that coveted job offer.

title: Soviet Tide Arising!
description: Take to the skies over the western front in this fantasy alternate timeline WW1 casual run and gun style sim-shooter. Fly as a heroic pilot of the Allied Empires as you take on nefarious Soviet forces.

title: Insert Game Here
description: Got it! You're asking me to generate a short Steam description for a FPS that's dramatic, with shades of comedy, suspense, thrills, soft horror, emotional moments, and bombastic action. "[INSERT GAME HERE] is a-

title: Deadline Delivery
description: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck that's rigged with explosives on a tight deadline.

title: Handsum
