- Robots can be useful, but they can't help you navigate like the Strategy Guide can!

title: Pokémon Potassium
description: Pokémon Potassium is a Fan-Made game in RPG Maker XP and Essentials based around Pokémon, where a streamer makes the game. At the same time, the chat does every decision, like what New Fakemon, new items, new moves, etc. This takes place in the Banerica region and joins us in the wacky lore of the lucky Chatters that got picked to be in the game. Every chatter or viewer contributes to the game, whether you are just watching the game grow or helping with Sprites, Art, Music, and such.

title: Tetra Esports
description: Tetra Esports is a block-stacker game made by Tetra Developer Studios as a spiritual sequel to Tetra Online. Compete against yourself in singleplayer modes, climb the leaderboards, or battle against other players in multiplayer modes.

title: Room XIII
description:
ROOM XIII is a first-person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere, exploration, and symbolic narrative.

You play as Father Joseph, an exorcist with a dark past — once known inside the Church for handling cases that were never meant to reach the public. Now, he lives in isolation, tending to a small, forgotten countryside church, trying to live a quiet life far from the shadows that haunt him.

Everything changes when he receives a call from an old friend: a newly acquired hotel, currently under renovation, has become the center of disturbing and unexplained events. Workers speak of voices, apparitions, and an overwhelming sense of dread.

As Joseph investigates, he begins a slow and unsettling descent into a place where reality blurs with hallucination, and every room may hold fragments of something far more personal — and sinister — than he expected.

ROOM XIII is a game about guilt, faith, and the things we bury deep inside. Get ready for symbolic puzzles, shifting environments, and fear that gets under your skin.

title: PostScriptum
description: Follow the steps of the protagonist, a melancholic young adult stricken by unemployment and paralyzed by a chronic care-free and lethargic attitude. His redemption-seeking and guilt-averting efforts are eventually met with a job interview, at none other than the Pokemon Couriers, a prestigious, esteemed, and highly regarded organization. Setting his sights on the future, he attempts for the last time to begin anew.

title: Mystery Case Files: The Riddle of Mrs. Bishop
description: GrandMA Studios presents the first case in a new era for the Master Detective with Mystery Case Files: The Riddle of Mrs. Bishop!

title: Gigantes Ex Machina
description: Fast paced Top-down shooter! Smartly use IRCM to evade the constant barrage of bullets and missiles and destroy everything that stands in your way.

title: Daemon
description: Daemon is an action-packed first-person shooter with expressive and customizable gameplay that can be built for tactical assistance, controlling space, or dealing oppressive damage. Combine a wide variety of weapons and abilities to out-strategize your opponents and claim victory.

title: Mech Fortress
description: A tower defense game where each turret has unique mechanics. You can freely place them on a 5×5 grid, and your goal is to eliminate all enemies.

title: Dancing with Ghosts
description: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

title: Pekku
description: Start your climb in Pekku! Discover colorful islands packed with challenges, collectibles, creatures and much more. Get climbing in an all-new multiplayer Foddian adventure. PEKKU TIME!

title: Hexavale
description: In this cozy strategy puzzle game, you connect tiles to create two unique landscapes at the same time. Will you merge them into one harmonious world – or keep them deliberately separate? Play with your favorite world combinations and let your creativity run free.

title: Cursed Words
description: From letters to lunacy, Cursed Words is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

title: Party Management
description: Party Management exists in a fantasy world of the contemporary age. Mighty warriors and mystical wizards now adorn streetwear and star in movies. Adventuring is a common pass time, but to do it you must be licensed under a party manager. This is where you come in. Select and manage 6 unique party members for each puzzle and use their abilities to guide them on a treacherous adventure into the golden city of Opulence in hopes of striking it rich, quitting their 9-5’s, and following their dreams.

title: Gangs of Asia
description:
Dominate rival gangs by seizing buildings, summoning unique fighters, and unleashing devastating special attacks. Whether you're battling alongside friends in co-op or unleashing chaos in PvP, the game offers shared split-screen, online multiplayer, and free-for-all modes to keep the action fresh.

Experience a fusion of skill-based 1v1 Kung Fu combat and real-time strategy. Command a diverse army—from mighty Sumo and agile Ninjas to legendary Kung Fu Masters—seize territory, manage resources, and unleash special attacks to crush your opponents and claim victory!

title: Like A Normal Fish
description:
A crip game about exclusion and living outside of the ableist norms.

Have you ever tried being a crab in a world tailor made for fishes ? Well, do your best, and may the best fish win !

title: The Rabbit's Shadow
description: A Father who has suffered of grief due to his daughter being missing, got trapped in an unknown location resembling an old arcade, while being locked inside a mascot suit. The Father needs to investigate different things such as lockers and play minigames to progress into further rooms to try to escape. Unknown Creatures are aware of his presence however.

title: Well Dweller
description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

title: Little Kitty, Big City: Picture Purrfect
Laura Lustful Secrets
description: Laura Lustful Secrets is the story of a housewife whose life changes after her husband Samuel decides to host a coworker in their home. Things get worse when a series of crimes takes over the entire city.

title: School Exit Class 8
description: An "Exit 8"-style anomaly-hunting horror game. In a haunted school, if something feels off—turn back. Classrooms, restrooms, the nurse's office—nothing is quite right. The closer you get to the exit, the more your memory—and your self—begin to distort.

title: Haunted Manager
description: “If your fear is half-hearted, I will shut you down―――”My father, the head of the haunted mansion, said this to me on the first day of opening.

title: The Island of Bad Women
description: The Island of Bad Women is home to a powerful and dangerous group of women, each more ruthless than the last. Bound together by a shared vision of destruction, they have cast aside all morality and now stand united in their mission to bring about the end of humanity.

title: Final Frontier Story
description:
Build your very own warm and friendly intergalactic city in the cold vacuum of space!
Expect close encounters of the third, fourth, and maybe even fifth kind!

Aim to become the most desirable city in the galaxy by developing land so you can build shops and bases for your residents to live in comfort.
Build Convenience Stores and Parks to make daily life easier, or Takoyaki Stalls and Cinemas to bring in tourists and keep people.

title: Tou Ikkyoku Gojyuusan Honba
description: This is the first ever Mahjong game in which Mahjong tiles do not appear! Complete the mahjong hand by using the letters on the dice! Add dice, reroll dice, and use special moves and items like in a fighting game to win!

title: Papa Needs a Headshot
description: Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.

title: Spinning Scarecrow
description: A dark arcade puzzle game where a Spinning Scarecrow faces deadly traps, grotesque minigames, and precision challenges in a fully hand-drawn world.

title: Fish Farm 3
description:
Fish Farm 3 is one of the entries in the popular Fish Farm series — buy, breed, cross-breed, sell, and enjoy plenty of freshwater and saltwater fish, including seahorses, whales, dolphins, sharks, starfish, and jellyfish.

Reach higher levels to access more fish, decoration, and aquarium inventory. Breeding and selling your fish wisely earns coins to further advance and refine your aquariums.

Don't forget to feed your fish and to change the water, either by hand or by automation.

Do you want to try out different lights or enjoy the fluorescent inhabitants by switching off the light? Just do it!

title: Deadboot
description: DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

title: Disciples: Domination
description:
Rule through the chaos! Fifteen years after Avyanna freed Nevendaar from the tyrannical grip of the gods, Disciples: Domination returns you to a realm hanging in the balance. In this dark fantasy strategy RPG with turn-based combat, take your place on Queen Avyanna’s throne – and attempt to hold together a crumbling kingdom.

The fire of doubt burns scorching within her, sparked by the crushing weight of the throne in Yllian and stoked by twisted dreams of becoming one of the very monsters she once defied – and destroyed. Paralyzed by fear and haunted by her own power, Avyanna’s rule begins to crack. Allies disappear and abandon her. An unknown force spreads strife and madness through her realm.

The choice is yours – shape the future, for salvation or ruin. As you chase the truths behind the ceaseless conflicts, dark magic and lurking conspiracies infecting your rotting empire, you’ll face betrayal, strife, and shadowy schemes. Uncover the long-lost Mountain Clans, witness the rise of an ancient cult and confront a corrupted seer whose visions have awoken bitter grudges, while old enemies are on the rise.

It will take all your courage to save Nevendaar. Are you brave enough to face – and embrace – its darkest truths?

title: Heretic + Hexen
description: Heretic + Hexen is a remastered version of the games Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders, Hexen: Beyond Heretic and Deathkings of the Dark Citadel. It includes quality of life improvements (native widescreen, engine fixes, interface tweaks...), reworked local and online multiplayer, as well as new episodes - Heretic: Faith Renewed and Hexen: Vestiges of Grandeur.

title: Hell is Us: Secret Code
description: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Secret Code DLC and other bonuses. With the Secret Code DLC, you start the adventure with a mysterious code in your pocket. What does it open?

title: I'll Be Home With You
description: A micro kinetic (no choice) novel about the last things you do and what comes after you're gone. This game was created for the Only One of Any Asset (O2A2) Visual Novel Jam 2024.

title: Trench Rats: The First March
description: A small troop of cryptids find themselves in a struggle to survive after the war has ended. With dwindling options, they march forth from the fields and into the unknown in search of prey.

title: Dragon Assault
description: Take control of a powerful dragon, navigating through dangerous terrains, shooting down monsters, and defeating waves of incoming enemies. Collect energy to enhance the dragon's abilities, challenge increasingly difficult levels, and ultimately conquer all foes to achieve victory.

title: Cats Go!
description: Cats Go! is a defense game blending strategy, cooperation, and direct combat. Grow mutant plants to protect your village! Whether you prefer to play solo as a brave defender or team up with friends online. Not feeling cooperative? Slip into the role of a devil cat and secretly sabotage the village!

title: Recoil Rush
description: Recoil Rush is a fast-paced movement shooter where your weapon’s recoil is your only means of movement. Master the art of propulsion as you blast through over 40 challenging levels in the single-player mission mode and go head to head against other players in multiplayer.

title: Gloomy Clues
description: Immerse yourself in a dark point & click adventure with an anime aesthetic. Solve murders, uncover secrets, and confront the demons of your past as a detective tormented by guilt.

title: Nangong Detective Agency
description: A detective themed game where players transform into the son of a famous detective and freely explore crime scenes and question suspects. The producer challenges players' reasoning ability and encourages them to assist the police in solving cases in the fastest way possible!

title: Sea of Radiation 2
description: Welcome to the perilous nuclear-contaminated waters, where all creatures are mutating. Start as an ordinary small fish, struggling to survive in this toxic sea. Through continuous evolution and adaptation, you will grow into a powerful ocean monster and ultimately become the sole ruler of this ocean

title: Starship Fighters: Galactic Warfare
description: Pilot your starship in Starship Fighters, a realistic space combat simulator. Engage in intense battles, explore vast galaxies, and unleash destruction with an arsenal of powerful weapons in a universe teeming with enemies!

title: Train Sim World 5: San Bernardino Line: Los Angeles - San Bernardino Route Add-On
description: The might of Metrolink takes a turn out of sprawling Los Angeles for an east-west express in Train Sim World 5. Dash between highways, soak in the sun and soar to the industry-laden outskirts of the San Gabriel Mountains along the San Bernardino Line.

title: Train Sim World 5: FlixTrain BR 193 Vectron Loco Add-On
description: Calling all passengers for Frankfurt, as FlixTrain operations arrive in Train Sim World 5! Twinned with bold inter-city stock, the BR 193 Vectron takes on an green appearance and is ready to bolt across Germany on all-new long-distance and rapid services.

title: Train Sim World 5: West Coast Main Line: London Euston - Milton Keynes Route Add-On
description: Commuter action abounds along the bustling 4-track West Coast Main Line in Train Sim World 5. Dash through the complex layout of London Euston aboard the Class 350 and embark across the Northwest corner of the Capital to Milton Keynes.

title: Train Sim World 5: Avanti West Coast BR Class 390 Pendolino EMU Add-On
description: Tilt your way in and out of the capital on the busy West Coast Main Line. The Class 390 Pendolino in Avanti West Coast livery swings into action, racing along this thrilling route with Train Sim World 5. All aboard!

title: Train Sim World 5: Frankfurt - Fulda: Kinzigtalbahn Route Add-On
description: Explore the rails of Frankfurt - Fulda and take control of regional, commuter and inter-city express duties in Train Sim World 5. Lean into the action with the all-new DB BR 411 ICE-T, tilting heavy metal optimised for smooth and faster travel.

title: SM64 Coop DX: Super Mario World in Super Mario 64
description: A mod for SM64 Coop DX which changes Mario to his Super Mario World counterpart, with a specific moveset based on the SNES, like the faster sprint speed, the spin jump, different water mechanics, small Mario, among others.

title: Riddle of the Runes: The Worlds of TSR
description: A puzzle game that's also a screensaver. Riddle of the Runes features over 200 pieces of fantasy artwork across D&D campaign settings. Find hidden clues in the images to discover the location of a stolen treasure.

title: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
description: Four heroes descend into hell in a tactical narrative game blending mythology and surrealism. Recruit your team, choose your path, and overcome the trials of the underworlds. A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

title: Pokémon Coda
description: Pokémon Coda is a short plot-driven game focused on narrative and world-building.

title: Pokémon Beyond DX
description:
On a planet far, far away, lies the galaxy's greatest mystery... a collection of hermetic tombs that seemingly defy all logic.
10 Standard Years ago, the tombs began to open... Unbeknowst to the people of the Pangalactic Empire, the fate of the galaxy was about to change forever.

title: Pokémon Lost World: Echoes of Eternity
Pokémon Ageless
description: A grand adventure set in the diverse Muzon Region! At the heart of the conflict lies the sinister Team Umbra, an ancient organization obsessed with achieving immortality. Their failed attempts to harness the power of the legendary Ho-Oh resulted in the creation of Corrupted Forms—feral Pokémon mutated by experimental exposure to chemicals found in the region’s Flabébé population. Team Seraphs is a resistance group fighting to protect Muzon’s ecosystems and its people, aiming to stop the spread of these dangerous mutations. You’ll take on the role of either Carter or Grace, twin siblings from the wealthy Salone family who receive rare Pokémon from Professor Agerwood and begin a journey across the region’s eight gyms. Along the way, you'll face rivals like Micah, meet allies such as the former Hoenn Champion Raisen, and unravel the truth behind Team Umbra’s century-long legacy.

title: Doki Doki Pokémon Club!
description: "Doki Doki Pokémon Club!" follows Natsuki, Yuri, Monika, Sayori, and the main character as they get sucked into the Pokémon world. They have to work together to try and find their way out of the game. However, the personal problems they keep to themselves always find a way to hurt those around them and stop them in their journey.​

title: Exposed Livestream
description: Stream by day, prank by night, and build your fame in this RPG adventure game! As IRL streamer Laika, create content, earn subscribers, and expand your skills. Explore the city and risk it all to entertain your growing audience. Show them what they actually want to see...

title: Tower of Ashes
description: Tower of Ashes is a roguelite game made for the Eevee Expo Game Jam 10 by Brawligator and PikachuMazzinga.

title: Pokémon: A Star in the Desert
description: A new adventure heats up in the world of Pokémon, with yourself starring as one!

title: Pokémon Decay
description:
Pokémon Decay is supposed to be a best of the first four generations.
It's intended to give the player as much nostalgia as possible by referring to the storylines of the old games.

Due to natural disasters the four regions Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh collided and became one big Region, the Talem Region.
The player wakes up and can't remember what happened. He has to find out what caused those natural disasters.

title: Pokémon Sors 2
description: The International Police has set its foot in Hupest after the events of Pokémon Sors. Siara's staff was arrested and the organization was disbanded, Asher's group wasn't safe from law either. While Asher and Valora did not face any charges, Jackson (Asher's father) and Prof. Ivo were facing charges, however due to a deal between Asher and the IP they were given a pardon, in return of their knowledge of Eclipsing, support in research and Asher's Eclipsing related artifacts. 3 years later in Aclyn (the International Police's main HQ's location), the IP is organizing a new ITP Group after the collapse of the trio from Pokémon Saiph 2. Micah left the police and his location is unknown, and Darlo was laid off due to the Regris incident. Lori is tasked with organizing and leading a new, larger ITP Group. Around the same time Asher decided to break his deal with the IP and raided Aclyn's HQ to steal the artifacts. His reasons and motives are unknown to the police. Due to these turn of events, a young citizen of Aclyn, Rene/Haru decides to become a cadet in Lori's new ITP Group at the International Police, and a year later they become an official cadet. Will they be able to climb the ranks? Will they become part of something bigger than what they ever imagined? Find out in Pokémon Sors 2!

title: Immortal Immanuel
description: A Touhou Fanmade STG with 6 normal stages and an Extra Stage.

title: Tardiness Girl
description: A short game about high school student who's late for class and must overcome a series of ridiculous obstacles to get to school on time. Navigate a gauntlet of familiar anime tropes.

title: Blood Lily: Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship
description: A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game. Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war. "How dare you come between Sally and me!"

title: Survive: The Alien Tracing
description: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.

title: Crayola Amazing Art Adventure
description: A collection of art-related minigames for young children.

title: The King of Tower Defense
description: A real tower defense game set in a medieval fantasy world. This game has high difficulty that focuses on strategy.

title: Lawless: Blood and Dust
description: An intense third-person action-adventure set in rural India. Engage in brutal combat, explore a vibrant and raw open world while navigating a gripping narrative of power, survival, and moral choices.

title: Nutmeg!
description: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

title: Kimochii Classroom
description: Kimochii Classroom is a psychological horror slice-of-life visual novel set within the Radish ASMR alternate reality game. Meet Anabelle, Chiko, Felicia, and Maykua!

title: Hot Stakes Casino: American Roulette
description: Try your luck or manipulate the game in your favor using special powers in a fast-paced gambling experience!

title: Silent Cleaning
description: Move silently. Clean thoroughly. A 3D horror action and cleaning simulation featuring Kao’s real products. Clean the villa, solve hidden puzzles, and escape while your performance affects the home’s appraisal value. A unique blend of suspense and cleaning awaits.

title: Spy Guy Memory Fantasy
description: Discover Spy Guy Fantasy Map!

title: Skyline Bowling: Spooky Style
description:
With this DLC, You'll unlock:
3 powerful balls: Clown, Scarecrow and Reaper!
A Grimshard T-Shirt for better accuracy!
Pyrothread Gloves for extra spin!
Emberwalk Shoes for more speed!
1K gems to buy new gear!
150K coins to upgrade your gear!

title: Skyline Bowling: Sweet Style
description:
With this DLC, You'll unlock:
3 powerful balls: Sting, Wing and Hive!
A Beeheart T-Shirt for better accuracy!
Buzzwrap Gloves for extra spin!
Honeyglide Shoes for more speed!
5K gems to buy new gear!
50K coins to upgrade your gear!

title: Cicada
description: Cicada is a short horror game where you go in the woods to collect cicadas.

title: Frutigeropolis: The Promised City
description: Step into a serene, surreal city of the old future. Explore environments shaped by the soul of Frutiger design. Slow down inside a world built to be remembered.

title: Kimchi: A Stars in the Trash Story
description: Embark on a short and charming puzzle-platformer adventure as Kimchi, the kitten on his journey through the history museum. Travel through stylized dioramas representing ancient Egypt and feudal Japan, all from a feline point of view. Discover fun facts and light challenges designed for a relaxed and family-friendly experience.

title: Ashen Wilds
description: Ashen Wilds is a challenging survival experience set in a ruthless open world. Gather valuable resources, build and expand your base, and face deadly creatures lurking in the shadows. In this world, trust is a luxury – other survivors might be your allies… or your downfall. Every day brings new dangers, every night new horrors. Only those who plan wisely and fight fiercely will survive the Ashen Wilds.

title: Geamana Village
description: A first-person investigative game set in a drowned village. Explore abandoned homes, speak with the last remaining locals, and capture through your lens the destruction left behind by the toxic sludge. Gather evidence, follow every clue, and uncover the truth hidden beneath silence and decay.

title: Hexen: Vestiges of Grandeur
description: Korax lingers between life and death, his shredded corpse left behind with no semblance of life while he clings to a fresh, if fragile, rebirth. His grip on Cronos is once more released, yet the cycle continues, proving another force is at work: an invisible hand puppeteering both Korax and you, weaving a star-crossed destiny that will never die. And if that hand tugs the threads of fate again, what surprises are yet in store for you?

title: Heretic: Faith Renewed
description: Years after the planes were cleansed of D'Sparil's wretched influence, a wandering warrior in search of home arrives at a foreign land to discover the blighted stains of that old time religion seeping through the cracks of society once more. In the fortified city, zealous acolytes stand high atop a decadent cathedral and listen to the lamentations echoing from the streets as non-believers are dragged away for 'correction.' The shadow of D'Sparil lingers after death, his absence attributed to apotheosis. Once revered, now worshipped, deserving of neither. An all-too-familiar scene, and one you simply cannot stomach. Taking up the mantle of Heretic once more, you stride into the city, staff in hand, to silence the echoes of your arch-nemesis.

title: Monomoon
description: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

title: Casualties: Unknown
description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

title: Inzoi: Island Getaway
description: inZOI: Island Getaway is inZOI's first official DLC. Swim and snorkel in Cahaya's crystal-clear waters, where vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and dolphins await. Unwind at a resort with a variety of relaxing and recreational activities.

title: Connect Me
description:
Do your job, and nothing else.

A short horror game by Robin and IODINE for the TFR Gamejam Vol. 2.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 6 - Season 4: Shock 'N Awesome
description: The orders are in, so charge headfirst into the hive! The bugs out there? Vicious, relentless, swarming. The vermin are dug in deep, and drawing out the queen won’t be easy. Neutralize the infestation with the latest and greatest high-tech tools in Fortnite BR Chapter 6 Season 4: Shock ‘N Awesome!

title: Higanbana no Saku Yoru ni Extra Credit
description: Fanmade PC port of the «Higanbana no Saku Yoru ni» booklet stories by Ryukishi07, «The Inhuman Teacher», «Class Meetings At The Old School» and «Marie's Utopia».

title: Leonardo: The Inventor
description: Educational software that includes an arcade game where you pilot the Icarus and a point & click "Flee the Fortress" adventure.

title: Ninja Ordinance
description: Join Momijimaru, an elite ninja on a mission of survival in this Stealth ARPG! Sneak past enemies and strike from the shadows—or confront them head-on with a decisive blow! But beware, one wrong move can lead our agent of shadows into many precarious situations!

title: Balefire: Ashes To Ashes
description: Pyre, Young promise of the Inquisition, must escort the witch Sunniva the day before her execution.

title: Terra Nil: Heatwave
description: In Heatwave, we’ve added the brand new arid region to the game with never before seen flora and fauna in the world of Terra Nil. We have sandy deserts, salt pans, canyons and floodplains. You’ll be populating these landscapes with some of the world’s most famous animals: elephants, lions, giraffes and rhinos to name a few.

title: Not Sure About That
description: Not Sure About That is an exciting trivia quiz set in the middle of the ocean. Test both your brain and agility to conquer all 555 questions.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 9
description: Sabrina’s leaving the door open for the next Fortnite Festival Icon… Bruno Mars! This GRAMMY-winning megastar is expanding his record-breaking world tour with a stop in Fortnite.

title: Yoshima: Hentai Simulator - Horny Summer DLC
description:
What are your plans for the summer? I understand that, as always, there's a ton to do, but in any case, you need to find a free day! You buy a ticket and invite your neighbor (and maybe something more) to head to the beach!

There can be no "buts" or "we'll see." Grab the essentials and hit the road! The sound of the waves, the rustle of the sand, and the oasis of shade under a palm tree will be the backdrop to your one-day, yet endlessly long love story.

title: Against Tribulation
description: "Against Tribulation" is a survivor-like game set in Chinese cultivation culture, featuring auto-battler synergy mechanics. Players must learn and combine divine abilities from different sects to eliminate waves of enemies.

title: Blocate
description: blocate is a 2d puzzle platformer about moving blocks around and solving puzzles.

title: Sonic.Exe The Destiny
description: The game follows Tails, Knuckles, Dr. Eggman and Metal Sonic as they are terrorized by a bloodthirsty monster who's out to kill them for unspecified reasons. However, these motives, and the paths these four take, will define their future and have an impact on their lives forever.

title: Deltarune Yellow
description: This is a fangame derived from the Undertale Yellow universe, reimagined within the context of Deltarune.

title: Loop One: Done
description: Loop One: Done is a mixed reality automation game where you record loops with drones and robots, turning your play space into an efficient automated factory.

title: Homeplanet
description:
Homeplanet is a computer game in the space simulator genre, developed by Revolt Games in 2003. Homeplanet became a prequel to the game Neuro due to the temporary suspension of its development. The game is currently only released on the PC platform.

The FLYM engine is also used for another series of games, Babylon 5: I've Found Her.

Homeplanet is notable for its implementation of a real Newtonian flight model, which allows the player to use the fighter's capabilities more widely. It is advisable to use a joystick, almost all keyboard keys and several combinations are used in the control.

In 2004, an official add-on to Homeplanet was released - Homeplanet: Playing with Fire.

title: Decline's Drops: Shoes & Mirrors
description:
The second major free content update of Decline's Drops is available right now!

It adds:

QUE SERA, the Third Puppet, is now playable! She's a slender, elegant yet fierce fighter! You'll need to find how to unlock her before you can test her moveset.

THE MIROIRS MENSONGERS, A brand new world which adds 4 stages and a unique boss. Unlocked once specific conditions are met.

BONUS STAGES: Race to the finish in this top down racer! Winning the race shall unlock

COLOR ALTS : There are now many alt. colors available for Globule AND Que Sera! I had a lot of fun making these!

title: Menhera Farm
description: You've been chosen for the top-secret DOLL Trainer Initiative. These girls are powerful weapons in disguise. Train them, fight in the arena, and rise to glory. But beware—mistreat them, and they may break. Will you create a savior, or a tragedy?

title: Seal Hunter
description:
Seal Hunter is a freeware 2D shoot ’em up game featuring not only tons of blood and gore, but also the possibility for four players to ensure the future of Norway’s fishing industry together. United we stand, right?

With a large array of weapons at your disposal, you must prevent harmful sea creatures from reaching the ocean in order to ensure a decent catch of fish the next morning. The enemies range everything from seals to fierce polar bears – but they must be downed, regardless.

This is an approved remake of the original The Seal Hunter (2005).

title: Diceville
description: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your HQ, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.

title: Carnaval Marbles
description: A tactical billiards roguelike inspired by French carom. Activate magical balls, tweak the rules by choosing talismans, and chase ever-higher scores. Each round is a challenge of physics and strategy. Find the balance between skill and luck…

title: Tentaphage
description: Tentaphage is an adventure 3D platformer with horror elements. You play as the Tentaphage, an anomalous eldritch creature. Swing, grapple, slingshot and possess humans to save your mother and devour humans!

title: Curse of Argentum
description: Investigate, explore and fight your way through a cursed manse to find the keys to your escape. Cast spells with the power of Argentum; manage limited resources, and navigate with a classic fixed-camera perspective while you solve puzzles and defend against cursed creatures.

title: Temporalysis
description: A quick paced 2D rogue-like shooter. Shoot your way through endless waves of enemies, acquire new abilities and new weapons as you take on more difficult foes. Your adversaries are moving too fast? Slow down time to aim better or make a quick escape.

title: Flaurel's Diaries
description: A visual novel about my OC, Flaurel. Her full name is Flaurel Gerania el Caryana. She’s a character, but also a part of me. I hope you enjoy reading her story as much as I enjoyed writing it. Thank you for playing.

title: Cauldron Chaos
description: Cauldron Chaos is a multiplayer party game where you control a jelly-boned wizard in chaotic deathmatches. Use magic wands, explosive potions, and quick thinking to outlast your opponents and claim the crown as the ultimate wizard!

title: Song of Nanzhao
description: Song of Nanzhao is a music-driven puzzle adventure set in ancient China. As a voiceless court musician, use pentatonic melodies drawn from nature to solve puzzles, uncover hidden stories, and connect with villagers, seeking peace through the power of sound.

title: Grim Tales: Prisoners of the Past - Collector's Edition
description: There's a kind of magic in discovering who we are...

title: Tales of Tonbrook
description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

title: Liminal Exit
description: Step into an uncanny building trapped in endless loops. Use the elevator, uncover unsettling anomalies, and evade the Entity lurking behind you. Liminal Exit, an immersive walking simulator inspired by liminal spaces. Can you escape, or will you remain forever trapped?

title: Eugene Onegin
description: The Russian literature classic "Eugene Onegin" has been turned into a visual novel with colorful hairstyles, eccentric characters, and unexpected plot twists.

title: Train Simulator: WSR Diesels Loco Add-On
description: Two of the West Somerset Railway’s most popular locomotives – the Class 47 and Class 03 – come together in this gathering of preserved diesels for Train Simulator.The Class 47 was one of the first mass produced diesel locomotive after the gradual withdrawal of steam locomotives on the UK railway network in the 1960s.

title: Train Simulator: GP9 Loco Add-On
description: The EMD GP9 is a great road switcher which can find a home on any of your US routes in Train Simulator.

title: Tales From The Under-Realm: Lilith
description: The archwizards are out of control, running a witch hunt all over Aravorn. Will the three heroines put an end to it? Fight evil wizards, find romance and unlock different endings in this dark fantasy yuri visual novel.

title: Poly Plaza Ultimate
description: An open-world entrepreneurial sandbox game. Sell resources, purchase properties, become rich. Includes all the DLC's and new content from Poly Plaza!

title: Hidden Expedition: The Lost Paradise
description: Gather your thoughts and retrace your steps through tropical Costa Rica to remember how you ended up there. A rich man claims a new source of energy is linked to a dead civilization, said to be hidden under the sea. Is it lost forever, or will you be the one to unlock its secrets?

title: Depression
description: Depression is a short narrative driven game, where you play as an artist, who lost himself, who lost colors in his life. He cant draw anymore. Nothing to draw. But one day, a strange opportunity appears.

title: Born to Burn: Ash and Flesh - A Tale from Surrealidade
description: Born to Burn: Ash and Flesh is a surreal, experimental indie game that blends psychological horror, platforming, and exploration as players control an evolving creature through diverse gameplay styles and metaphysical challenges.

title: Bone March
description: In the March between life and afterlife, the spirits are restless and their numbers are endless. Your watch has begun. Bring as many souls to rest, while you can.

title: Island Life With Mayalala
description:
Akitoshi decided to take a vacation on Earth to rest and recover from the drudge of office life. Everything was perfect… Until a sudden storm sank the ship he was on! Now he’s been washed ashore on a random island in the middle of who knows where, attacked by a wild animal, and saved by a mysterious young woman. What will happen to him now?

Get to know your savior, investigate the island… Do whatever you have to in order to survive and escape this tropical nightmare in this island exploration adventure RPG!

title: Eyes of Rain
description: As a humble baker in a quiet medieval town, your life takes a dark turn when a stranger arrives equipped for battle. Thrust into a hidden world of supernatural beings—elves, demons, fae, and more—you must make choices that alter the fate of the world you thought you knew.

title: Sage
description: Sage is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to learn spells and become a friend of the forest.

title: The Jester and the Madman
description: The Jester and the Madman, a sequel to Curse of the Old Gods, is a point-and-click adventure with a 90s-style digitized art aesthetic, steeped in Lovecraftian horror. Solve puzzles, uncover a vast conspiracy, and descend into a world of cults, paranoia, and creeping madness.

title: Wordscoop with Gelato the Otter
description: Classic word-searching returns, cadet!

title: Project Fallback
description: It is a 2D pixel-based shooting game, where you are a robot sent from Earth to capture spaceships and satellites from enemy control and bring them back under our control. You are humanity’s last hope. The story takes place in the far future. Play the game and experience yourself.

title: Realm of Fame
description: A myth-inspired roguelike with intense fast-paced wrestling combat. Explore a cursed Byzantine citadel where dungeons change every run, face legendary heroes twisted by dark winds, and uncover mythological mysteries as you seek redemption.

title: The Concrete Tower
description:
Uh-Oh! Bunny got himself trapped in a tower! Can you help him escape?

A Silent Hill like adventure game starring cute critters and not so cute critters.

title: Project Origin
description: Project Origin is an immersive MMORPG set in a fractured world where players explore, battle, and shape their own journey. Engage in dynamic combat, uncover hidden lore, and traverse a vast, evolving landscape filled with challenges and secrets waiting to be discovered.

title: Moonsteel
description: A solo shitgame where you wander a massive magical forest hunting for a sword, while trolls hunt you. Part horror, part boredom, all pain. Good luck, you'll need it.

title: Grandma, Is That You?
description: “Grandma, Is That You?” is a psychological horror game. As we visit our elderly and ill grandmother to help her, the old mansion reveals buried memories and dark secrets. The line between reality and illusion begins to blur.

title: Echoes of Vasteria
description: Guide (and mostly watch) Caleb—the ever-marching hero—in a pixel-art auto-adventure that fuses idle-incremental depth with side-scrolling action. Complete tasks, harvest loot, and let the game's rich graphs and stats tell the story of your endless run.

title: Crash Bandicoot Retro HiJinx
description: Crash Bandicoot Retro HiJinx is a Crash Bandicoot fangame, infamous for its first demo containing pseudo-malware that deletes Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy and Crash Bandicoot 4: It's About Time off your computer once booted up. The pseudo-malware has been removed since, but please install with caution. The description from GWKTM's website reads: "After countless lack-luster revivals, the true orange island-hopping bandicoot we know and love, is coming back for real, and in condition of his life! Join Crash and Coco, as they dish out some justice once again in their most polygon-perfect crystal hunt in decades!"

title: Marry the Witch
description: You've stumbled upon an invitation letter to MARRY THE WITCH. It's addressed to SATAN, which you are not... but who cares? You've decided to give it a try, and now you found yourself with a crazy girl stuck in some MACHINE. You can't leave, and your only option now is to survive and MARRY her.

title: Bring Me Home
description: A small point and click game about helping a dog to get back home.

title: Görev
description: A story-driven psychological horror game about a man who takes a job to fund his newlywed wife's surgery, only to face terrifying events deep underground. Feel fear, helplessness, and entrapment seep into your bones.

title: Frob
description: The happy life of a whimsical little frog called Frob was turned upside down when his tadpoles were tadnapped by a heron. Now it's his quest to collect them all in this silly 3D platformer!

title: Broken Defense
description: A tower defense and castle builder where you defend your town hall against waves of fury thieves in a procedural world that changes every time you play.

title: Shikiyoku: Teru Yumemi in the Nightmare
description: "There are things better left unknown" — The hidden paranormal horror ADV by ImCyan, creator of "Tsugunohi", is now on Steam. Detective Teru and his sister Luna investigate cases in spirits' dream worlds. Enjoy mystery, comedy, and horror across 9 episodes and 10+ hours of content.

title: Master of Cigkofte
description: Discover the spicy world of çiğköfte, Turkey’s famous bulgur-based street food! Wrap it in lavaş, serve customers, upgrade your food shop, and become a street food legend in this fun, colorful first-person cooking simulator.

title: Remnants of War
description: Remnants of War is a 2D action RPG with souls‑like elements. This is the demo version of my first game project. Choose your character, collect items, brew potions, and personalize your gameplay style as you dive into the adventure. Face challenging enemies and test your skills in a fast‑paced combat experience. The full version will feature more abilities, enemies, and new maps to explore.

title: Ethereal Sunder
description: Play as Eilayda, the Fairy Queen, on a quest to save her people from a deadly sickness. Navigate a human prison district rumored to hold a cure, facing ruthless criminals and tough moral choices. In this RPG, your resilience will be tested—will you uphold integrity or succumb to corruption?

title: Amazing Weekend 3: Search and Relax - Collector's Edition
description: Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and collect souvenirs in stunning outdoor locations. Relax with mini-games, wallpapers, and soothing music. Perfect for a calming break!

title: Skeleton Dungeon
description: Explore the dungeon and defeat the Skeleton King!

title: Excommunication
description: The renegade Angloids and wayward souls forge plans within the artificial realms, let them burn in the surreal 'hack and slash'. Excommunication is an artistic experience in which the heretics dream of uprising. But let steel be your answer. No heretic shall remain.

title: Ravager: Moon-friendly Edition
description: Ravager - Moon-Friendly Edition is a role-playing game where you play a young dragon, determined to reclaim his birthright. To do so, you will need to build your power, ally with dark forces, evade justice, and return to rule.

title: Smokin Potions
description: Chaos reigns as up to 4 friends battle in a magical, explosive local-multiplayer showdown. Create your wizard, choose your magical affinity, mix elements, and craft explosive potion bombs to dominate the arena. Even in defeat, haunt and sabotage rivals as a ghost, seizing a second chance at glory.

title: Treacherous Trials
description:
A short platformer game made in ten days for @LoafeeBuns' birthday, based on her Geometry Dash inspired personifications and lore.

The extreme insane moderately tough (but very handsome) demon Nine Circles is undergoing some intense training! Can you help him master his abilities and survive the countless trials he must face? I dunno, maybe.

title: Egg Finder
description: Find the eggs.

title: Rachel's Journal
description: You wake up in a maintenance room, alone. Your partner's journal is out in the open. You probably shouldn't read it.

title: Here, Flower Picking, Manila North
description: a short hypertext offering to the living amongst the dead, where windows form wastelands and flowers bloom underneath graves. commissioned for indiepocalypse.

title: Hana's Light
description: Hana's Light is a hidden-object game about loss and Tamagotchi.

title: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times
description: Create unique spells by combining magical runes to solve puzzles your way. Transform objects, manipulate time, and discover the mysteries of a world where everyone has vanished, leaving only 12 people behind. Every puzzle has multiple solutions - if you can imagine it, you can probably do it.

title: Mini Bash
description: From the creators of Club Penguin & Battle Bears, Mini Bash is a safe online social world filled with fun games, collectibles & battles with friends!

title: Medicus
description: Step into the role of a medieval medicus! Manage your own medieval potion shop! Craft potions, serve customers, expand your workspace, and grow your reputation in a relaxing isometric simulation with strategic resource management.

title: BurnerSphere
description: BurnerSphere is an immersive social VR experience where players explore VR documentary content filmed at Burning Man. Navigate iconic art installations, engage with interactive workshops, and connect with friends or meet new ones to go on adventures. Experience Burner Culture like never before!

title: Anime Dream Match: Butterflies
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime butterflies.

title: Clean Break
description: Clean Break is a short first-person narrative game about objects, memory, and the quiet violence of letting go.

title: Night Club Simulator: Party King
description: Step into the vibrant world of nightlife! Create, manage & customize your own nightclub, solo or co-op. From hiring staff and organizing events to setting the perfect atmosphere with music & lighting, every choice you make will shape your club. Are you ready to become the ultimate nightclub tycoon?

title: Devose
description: DEVOSE is a cooperative horror game for 1 to 4 players. Explore, survive, and be the hunter or be hunted. Every corridor is a trap. Every noise can betray you. Coordinate or die alone.

title: Podvodsk
description: A game about building an underwater city. Drag & drop building schematics in the top right corner to build them, each schematic costing different number of points. Try to get as deep as possible!

title: VVVVVV: The Depths
description:
Some time after the events of VVVVVV, Viridian and the crew explore the depths of an unknown planet.

But watch out... it might not be what you expect.

This mod was created for the VVVVVV Discord server's 2025 April Fools project. Intended as a bait-and-switch, it's revealed to be an exploration-based fishing simulator, with beautiful art and many different fish to catch.

Created in a week and a half by NyakoFox (Alexandra Fox) and mothbeanie, VVVVVV: The Depths is the first full mod of VVVVVV with a fresh, new campaign. As it does not contain VVVVVV's paid content, it is available for free.

title: Beneath The Six
description: Beneath The Six is a traditional roguelike set in a fractured world long-forgotten by space and time. Collect powerful dice sets, use them to forge valiant adventurers and explore daily randomized dungeons full of trinkets, traps and treasures.

title: Habanero
description: If you find an anomaly, go downstairs. If nothing unusual is found, go upstairs. This game tests your observation skills. Clear the game and escape from the infinite loop. Can you spot the difference?

title: City-Defence
description: Classic Tower Defense Game; Completed development, no Early Access; No Pay to Win; Ad-free

title: Memology: Italian Brainrot
description: You will have a fascinating journey through the amazing world of virtual creatures, each of which has a special character and unique features. Can you accurately distinguish these characters and name each of them correctly? Let's check your knowledge together!

title: Memology 2: Old Times
description: The continuation of the legendary MEMOLOGY series. This time you will have to demonstrate your knowledge of old memes, and prove that you are the based scuf!

title: Medi-Cooker
description: You wake up in a forest with no memories. Gather ingredients, craft special potions, and help the dolls with troubles to uncover hidden secrets. Medi-Cooker is a story-driven 2D platformer adventure where you explore a Storybook-Like World, converse with dolls, and unravel the mysteries within.

title: InCrazyBall
description: InCrazyBall is an unusual arcade and logic game, largely reminiscent of the classic 1984 production of Atari Games called Marble Madness. However, this item is much more modern and uses modern trends in the computer entertainment industry - including colorful, fully three-dimensional graphics and advanced algorithms describing the physics of the world presented. The main theme, however, remained similar - our task is still to manipulate the movement of the big sphere and fulfil a series of tasks characteristic for a given level.

title: BBQ Quest
description: You are Kurt, a guy that was kicked from a BBQ Party. And now, his objective is to get Coca-Cola to the feast (the BBQ sauce is later)!

title: Mycopsychosys: Remastered
description: Emergency Alert! New security protocols have been activated. Remain indoors. Do not open your doors under any circumstance. Isolation is safety. Isolation is truth. Or is it?

title: BunnyBarTalk
description: Bunny Bar Talk is a quick and fun command-input mini-game. Get to know the girls at Bunny Bar!

title: It Goes On
description: It Goes On is a little platformer that attempts to use mechanics as metaphor to explore disability and disempowerment.

title: Orange Life
description: Step into the bittersweet chaos of Orange Life — a narrative-driven game where every choice matters and nothing is quite what it seems

title: Yacht Dice Family
description: Family Yacht Dice on Steam is classic dice-rolling fun with only local multiplayer. Play turn-based or simultaneous, climb weekly leaderboards, and chill to mellow tunes. Perfect for couch battles with friends!

title: Titanic Rescue
description: Command the RMS Carpathia in 1912! Rescue Titanic survivors from icy waters, navigate treacherous icebergs, and deliver them to New York. Prepare for a challenging voyage through four distinct levels, each testing your navigation skills and resolve.

title: Evening
description: A cozy text-based game, for quiet evenings. Approximate playtime 15-30 minutes.

title: Vidalia's Adventure
description: Vidalia's Adventure is a series of interactive vignettes, each with distinct procedurally generated soundscapes.

title: Info Fighter
description: Produced by a IFMA student, Info Fighter is a 2D fight game, with split keybord - Feel the pleasure of attack without being expelled, discovering new brutal combos and attacks of each character.

title: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139...: 4 YoRHa
description:
4 YoRHa is downloadable content for NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139..., made available alongside the game for free on release.

The DLC includes includes a YoRHa Type-S outfit for both the "Boy" and "Adult" versions of the protagonist, Type-B and A outfits for Kainé, as well as four weapons from NieR:Automata, complete with their own weapon stories.

Each of the weapons included can be used during the player's first run. Access to the "Wardrobe" feature will unlock upon downloading the DLC. The wardrobe is only accessible through the main menu under options. While equipped with the DLC outfits, loading screens in the game will be styled after themes from Automata.

title: Elementail
description:
Set off on a magical journey with adorable animal wizards, harnessing the power of Water, Fire, and Lightning elemental cards!

Elementail is a casual roguelike deckbuilder with the feel of a luxurious board game.

It’s easy and intuitive—yes, even a squirrel could play it!—but you'll need clever strategy to overcome quirky enemies and unexpected challenges.

In a world where enchanted animals and elemental spirits coexist,

you play as a rookie wizard setting out to stop the growing elemental corruption.

And yes, the game’s addictive card-drawing is a bit of a problem... but in the most lovable way.

title: I Wanna Play That Picture Puzzle with Numbers All Day!
description:
I want to play that puzzle—where you look at the numbers on the left and top and fill in the intersecting squares—forever!

In a rainy café, you can quietly and endlessly immerse yourself in solving puzzles.

title: Ajgal
description:
Ajgal is a psychological horror game blending surreal environments, symbolic puzzles, and tense encounters.

You play as Paul, a father searching for the last fragile link to his missing daughter, navigating oppressive places like the Temple of Flesh and the Church of Ash.

Buried memories, ancient rituals, and disturbing visions shape a story where every step carries a cost.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Xerxes (The Achaemenid) Persona
description: Play as the leader Xerxes with his Achaemenid Persona in Sid Meier's Civilization VII!

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Friedrich (Baroque) Persona
description: Play as the leader Friedrich with his Baroque Persona in Sid Meier's Civilization VII!

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Himiko (High Shaman) Persona
description: Enjoy an alternate persona for the Civilization VII base game leader Himiko with her High Shaman Persona!* This persona includes a unique outfit and background for Himiko, plus a new Unique Ability and Agenda that reflect a different side of her personality!

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Ashoka (World Conqueror) Persona
description: Enjoy an alternate persona for the Civilization VII base game leader Ashoka with his World Conqueror Persona!* This persona includes a unique outfit and background for Ashoka, plus a new Unique Ability and Agenda that reflect a different side of his personality!

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Right to Rule Collection
description:
Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire in Sid Meier's Civilization VII with the post-launch add-on content of the Right to Rule Collection!

Included:
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Genghis Khan Pack
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Dai Viet Pack
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Right to Rule Collection - Wonder Pack
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Assyria Pack
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Right to Rule Collection - Cosmetic Bonus
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Lakshmibai Pack
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Qajar Pack
Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Silla Pack

title: IdleQuest
description: Click (or just sit back and watch) as your party of heroes battle to earn your gold. You can leave the game on so it plays while you sleep :D Use your gold to unlock new heroes and move to new and more dangerous areas. When you feel you are ready... ascend! Ascending will allow you to unlock new characters, and gives you more power to restart the game with.

title: Ghost Haunting
description: GHOST HAUNTING is a humorous 2D point-and-click adventure in wonderfully low resolution. A loving tribute to the graphic adventures of the 90s - with the best of then and the comfort of today. Grinsemuskelkater guaranteed (no liability for permanent damage)!

title: Ragnarok Online 3
description: Official Sequel to Ragnarok Online, recapturing the original charm of RO in a modernized system. RO, as it was meant to be.

title: Drow Space Shooter
description: You are the new hot shot space Cadet fresh out of the Terran Space Force academy in the year 2247 when the alien invasion of the solar system begins. Fly your spaceship through planetary landscapes firing advanced technology weapons and managing ship subsystems to defeat waves of enemies.

title: Home for Friends: Beloved Pets - Collector's Edition
description: Rescue adorable pets, solve puzzles, and build the perfect sanctuary in this cozy hidden object adventure!

title: DDD: Drone Drop Dash
description: A memory-based drone delivery game where every route counts. Rise to the top pilot.

title: Poker Crush
description: A fast-paced 2D puzzle game where you swap cards horizontally or vertically to form poker hands like pairs, straights, and flushes. Cards clear when matched, new ones fall from above, and you can chain combos for massive points and multipliers.

title: Block Pile
description: This game is a fun and easy casual puzzle game. Stack colorful blocks, throw your ball, and smash same-color blocks to score big! Simple controls, happy colors, and exciting combos.

title: Space Hitchhiker Stop
description: Your store has been kidnapped by the mafia, work for them and upgrade your ship until you're able to hyperjump out of space!

title: Undertale Promise
description:
Undertale Promise is a fan-made prequel to Undertale Yellow, a fan-made prequel to Toby Fox's UNDERTALE.

Follow Harmony through Snowdin to find her lost friend while evading the royal guard.

Meet familiar faces and make new friends in this friendly RPG where somebody has to die.

Can you avert the tragedy waiting to happen?

title: Vasilisa the Beautiful
description: Vasilisa a young beautiful girl, abused by her step-mother and step-sisters is forced to face Baba Yaga the human eating evil witch living in the woods. Could she get back home safely? collect items to solve puzzles you face along the journey and find the solution of textual based puzzles.

title: Mathbits
description: Mathbits is a fast-paced, brain-training game with multiple modes like guessing, memory, equations, graphs, and number series. With 50+ unique ways to play, and addictive progression, it keeps your mind sharp and coming back for more.

title: Changelog
description: In 2016, a group of ambitious students got together to make the best adventure game ever — but they failed. Discover their story by playing through different builds of their game and reading their development logs.

title: Fallen Relics
description: "Fallen Relics" is an ARPG-type adventure-themed game. You and your friends can use characters of different professions to explore, fight, collect, and decrypt in various themed levels; you can develop your character in a variety of ways and then challenge powerful bosses.

title: Wyrd World
description: Open world, multiplayer, survival fantasy setting. Create your custom character, Craft tools, learn spells, loot your enemies. explore through arid deserts, snowy tundras, murky swamps, windy meadows and deep forests. Build a base to stash your rewards or rest from your travels.

title: Female Swordsman
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Keyboard Simulator
description: The game everyone always wanted, but no one could get. And it's changed now! Keyboard Simulator is a clicker game that will help you uncover the true meaning of life. A truly deep and wonderful game with relaxing typing. Type on keyboard, get skins, type more, get more skins – do more!

title: Gnomes Garden: Black Stones
description: Gnomes Garden: Black Stones - adventures await! Help the queen save her friends and herself!

title: Straif
description: Compete with players around the world in a fast-paced 3D platforming shooter. Race through a variety of hand crafted maps, shooting at targets with an arsenal of weapons, all to achieve the fastest time on the global leaderboard!

title: Byte Wars
description: Byte Wars is a strategic top-down rocket shooter where every shot counts. Take control of a spacecraft, rotate to aim, and launch a single rocket at a time, carefully navigating the pull of nearby planets that warp your trajectory in real time.

title: Gold Miner: Classic Edition
description: A classic arcade mining game where you dig for gold, collect treasure, dodge hazards, and upgrade your gear across multiple modes and levels.

title: Super Hard Game
description: An escape like no other! Join the adorable moon rabbit “Dalddo” in this hardcore top-down arcade game. One mistake means instant failure—are you ready to prove your skills?

title: Ruby and the Lost Crystals
description: Ruby and the Lost Crystals is a calm third-person puzzle adventure where you swap between two characters to solve puzzles. Use physical interactions, magical projectiles, and object-swapping to unlock paths, reflect lasers, activate platforms, break obstacles, and explore ancient ruins.

title: Super Shootout
description: Super Shootout is a top-down, roguelike shooter set in a stadium on an alien world. Leave a wake of destruction with powerful pickups sent down by the roaring crowd. Fight, die, and fight again to the top of the online leaderboard.

title: After Work
description: After Work is a short, atmospheric first-person exploration game. The workday is over and it's time to head home. But a familiar way out begins to lead somewhere unfamiliar, gradually taking you further from the ordinary.

title: Cleaning Up!
description: Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of restoring them to order with your super-powered cleaning tools. The quick, cozy joy of tidying up!

title: An Ocean Game
description: Welcome to the island abandoned by the people who once celebrated here. You must find the 8 SCURXS to escape this place before the ocean man takes you to a place you cannot understand...

title: Swords & Bones 5
description: The fifth and final chapter of the saga: embark on an action-platformer fantasy adventure in pixel art and put an end to the demonic threat once and for all!

title: Kimi ga Nozomu Eien: Enhanced Edition - Another Episode Collection+
description:
A jam-packed title containing ten more stories from the world of "Kimi ga Nozomu Eien", including:

Extra episodes featuring characters from "Kimi ga Nozomu Eien".
The Muv-Nozo short story that takes the characters to the wild world of "Muv-Luv EXTRA".
"TRUE LIES," a re-recording of the infamous "Radio Special TRUE LIES"!

Contents Include:

● "The Hill Where Cherry Blossoms Fall" (Part 1 & 2)
Haruka Suzumiya has secret feelings for Takayuki Narumi, but her shy nature stops her from approaching him. One day, Haruka spots Takayuki skipping class and heading to the hill behind the school. She decides to follow him...

A story about Haruka from before the beginning of the game!

● "The Water's Surface Trembles in the Wind"
Mizuki Hayase is a member of the swim team, but she has long hair. Everyone tells her that she needs to cut it off to improve her times, but she always stubbornly refuses. Then, Takayuki Narumi makes a comment that leaves her terribly confused. As she takes an after-practice shower, she starts to wonder...

A story about Mitsuki from before the beginning of the game!

title: Necrotyper
description:
Necrotyper is a typing-based action-adventure game with elements of RPG and strategy. The player controls an undead army indirectly by typing spells to support it. There is no direct unit control; gameplay focuses on typing to influence battles.

Typing speed is important to avoid being overwhelmed by enemies, but accuracy also plays a role—mistake-free typing increases spell effectiveness. Spells can be upgraded over time to help manage the increasing number of enemies.

title: DA-VI-NC1
description: DA-VI-NC1 is a Turing-machine-based coding puzzle game. You must complete the puzzles, pass the Turing test, and discover the philosophical world of DA-VI-NC1 with the Mona Lisa.

title: Paleo Pines: Trick or Treat DLC
description: Welcome to Paleo Pines, a charming island known for its friendly dinosaurs, quirky townsfolk, and mysterious past. Set out with your companion, Lucky, uncover the island’s secrets and befriend new dinos. Then enlist their help to fix up your ranch and farm crops to create your cozy dino sanctuary!

title: Paleo Pines: Spooktacular DLC
description: Welcome to Paleo Pines, a charming island known for its friendly dinosaurs, quirky townsfolk, and mysterious past. Set out with your companion, Lucky, uncover the island’s secrets and befriend new dinos. Then enlist their help to fix up your ranch and farm crops to create your cozy dino sanctuary!

title: Connected Hearts: Hour of the Witch DLC
description: Unlock the secrets hidden within Aradon’s most mysterious locations. Will you have the courage to break the curse and uncover the truth?

title: Kiipluu
description:
Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

title: Starboi
description: The cosmic horrors have kidnapped Starboi's friends! Launch across the galaxy in search of them, avoiding black holes and defeating the tentacled monsters.

title: Half-Life: Cross Product Multiplayer
description: The multiplayer counterpart to Half-Life: Cross Product. Features various gamemodes and maps.

title: Starship Eleven Deluxe
description:
MORE THAN 120 ROCKING LEVELS!!

• Dozens of dangerous monsters, traps and mazes
• Worldwide Highscores List
• Play it offline on your computer
• Advanced controls and Interactive opponents
• Intelligent leveldesign

title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

title: Comfy Girl
description: Need a cozy companion while you plan your day or just zone out? Comfy Girl lets you unlock and collect cute pets, decorate your virtual space, and relax music. Focus while you work or study, and enjoy time with Grandma and Zoe.

title: Kingdom Death: Simulator
description: Kingdom Death: Simulator (KDS) is a digital project in development that aims to recreate the tabletop game Kingdom Death: Monster (KDM) in an online, sandbox environment. It provides players with a virtual dwelling and game room where they can play the core KDM game, including various expansions, either solo or with friends. The simulator offers a way to experience KDM, explore its content, and potentially introduce new players to the game.

title: Wish on this Flower
description:
A short kinetic visual novel at 3,000-4,000 words. Linear narrative, single-ending.
(Approx. 10-15 mins play time).

Made for the Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2025

title: ElfMiner
description: In this mini-metroidvania festive adventure, help discover Elf's calling and learn to follow their dreams. Unlock Christmas decorations an keep nightly visitors entertained. Collect gems, complete time trials and discover friends along the way.

title: Danganronpa Delusion: The Front Line of Despair and Hope Reinterpreted
description: Rei Yukine enters a new world as an ordinary person into a school full of ultimate talent students.

title: Risky Rocket
description: Risky Rocket is a 3D Rocket Jumping platformer. Hone your skills and launch through the climb map and many time trial levels. Using the physics of momentum, and propulsion of rockets to build up speed and become a master of Rocket Jumping.

title: Rebound Rush
description: Duel your friends in a life-sized pinball arena in a high-tension one-on-one sport! Parry a constantly accelerating ball and launch it into your opponent’s goal to win the match. But watch out — the commentator might have a trick or two to spice things up... Good luck!

title: Sam 0
description: SAM0 blends card roguelike combat, resource management, and sci-fi storytelling. Play as humanity's AI legacy: explore planets, craft decks via tech upgrades and randomized packs, battle varied foes, and unravel mysteries of human absence.

title: Nasubi Room
description: Survival in a closed room. Every hour you get $1000. Stay as long as you want. The main thing is not to go crazy. Be careful in the room besides you there is someone else. Maintain your mental health and create items that will help you survive.

title: Panzer Kliker Mk I Yanks
description: Idle tank-building clicker game with retro pixel-art style. Assemble parts, recruit crew, and upgrade your war machine to climb the ranks - even while you're away!

title: Street Errands
description: Hurdle dangerous obstacles in this dystopian 2.5D platformer set at night in a controlled city. Is your duty to collect all the items and advance to other city locations. Bur after, dodge the guards that are patrolling the city.

title: The Love's Ordeal
description: Nengchi, can you hold yourself? On the cusp of immortality, the prodigy from Sect of Pure Retreat is forced to face his trail in "Eden of Yao"- a realm of seductive spirits. As the temptresses unleash their charms, can you hold your Chan mind?

title: Goat Stand and Turtle Guy
description: This is a fictional story. In the game, you need to collect clues and find a way to lift the curse and safely escape from Goat Stand. All content in the game is unrelated to reality, and any similarity is purely coincidental.

title: Real Life Flappy Bird
description: Turn on your webcam and start flapping! This AI-powered Flappy Bird turns your webcam into a game controller.

title: Nirvana: Origin of Fate
description: 3rd person procedural survival 3D Game. The game allows you to simulate the character's survival needs and find meaning in adventure, and create a bond with the other characters in the game, to develop their ability to control the elements of the island.

title: Storm's Wrath
description: A silent narrative driven, fantasy, action-adventure game about a storm that brings an enraged army. A woman longs for her lost husband when the storm's war forces her to flee.

title: Knight's Dungeon
description: Knight's Dungeon is a puzzle game where you must solve word, number, color, push-block, and music puzzles to advance through the dungeon. You use an in-game journal to automatically record information as you find it. Also features a handful of expansive side-games separate from the original campaign, such as a hilltop mansion mystery or an ocean adventure complete with a health and game-over system.

title: Love N Life: Happy Student
description: Love n Life: Happy Student, a unique dating sim, incorporates inventory management for the first time. As a top-scoring third-year student, you are chosen to join the most prestigious college, where you’ll meet gorgeous ladies. Discover intriguing personalities and the school’s mysteries.

title: Paint Rumble
description: Paint Rumble is a fast-paced party game where strategy and reflexes matter! Cover the most area in 2-minute battles, playing solo, in teams, or against friends locally or online. Choose Wolfy, Quacky, Tigro, or Lucky, grab power-ups, and use your agility to dominate the battlefield!

title: Warrior's Dilemma
description: Warrior's Dilemma is a casual strategy chess game where you play as a weak yet intelligent hero, constantly making advantageous choices in battles, unlocking, collecting, and trading to survive and become stronger until you ultimately kill the demon king.

title: Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover hidden secrets in a haunted medieval park! Solve puzzles, find clues, and escape a ghostly knight in this thrilling hidden object adventure.

title: Mighty Kingdom
description: In a mythical realm, six ancient gods, battle for dominion. Strategically claim lands, outmaneuver rivals, and rise as the supreme power in this fast-paced conquest of territories—solo or in asynchronous online multiplayer.

title: Reaper Recon
description: Reaper Recons is a fast-paced zombie arcade shooter that blends classic gameplay with modern enhancements. Eliminate waves of undead enemies, collect powerful weapon drops, and activate five distinct weapon power-ups to dominate the battlefield as difficulty steadily ramps up

title: Louis Charles in the Louvre
description: Explore a museum's spooky attic after hours as the ghost of a little king. In this cozy adventure, you'll paint masterpieces with pixie dust, vacuum dusty bunnies, and collect cute outfits while saving France.

title: Wasteland Horror Radio: Episode 1 - The Radio
description: Wasteland Horror Radio: Ep. 1 - The Radio: A gift, a radio of revelations bound to one man's personal hell, repeatedly showing him all the people he brutally murdered on September 20th, 1991..

title: Echo Protocol: Escape Room
description: You, Hamilton Porter, wake up in an unknown laboratory. A voice guides you trough some tests that you didn't apply to. In this escape room, you will have to discover what is going on on this facilities and find your way out.

title: Hog Heist
description: Don't get caught as you explore large museum exhibits, steal valuable items, evade law enforcement, and race back to your getaway truck in this exciting arcade game.

title: Infinite Canyon
description: An arcade style racing game where you drive on an infinite track, within a dark virtual void, with every turn requiring you to drift!

title: Pawn.OS()
description: Pawn.OS() is a programming puzzle game where you use a custom scripting language to control a pawn on a grid. Solve 30 puzzles, learn logic step-by-step, and optimize your code to climb the leaderboard—even without any prior coding experience.

title: Secret Cats: Ice Cream Day
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Ice Cream Day" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Escape30DayCircle
description: A first person perspective horror game for finding anomalies. This realistic style of 'Escape from 30 Day Cycle' may be suitable for you. You will play the role of a stay at home man. One day, the player is trapped by a mysterious force and needs to explore secrets and find ways to escape

title: Shipwrecked: A Quick Automation
description: A short and sweet escape automation game meant to scratch that factory itch. Crash land from space into a randomly generated world with 4 basic resources and then gather, upgrade, and construct a factory to build your spacecraft back up from rubble and escape. A 2-3 hour experience (no game saves).

title: Hook, Line, and Axe
description: Swing into action in this third-person hack-and-slash parkour set in a sci-fi dystopian America. Strike down corruption with your trusty battle axe. Grapple onto enemies and the environment alike. Chain abilities for the ultimate combo of destruction in Hook, Line, and Axe.

title: I Commissioned Some Snails 4
description: I paid artists to hide snails and lettuce in 15 more artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Delirium: Echoes of the Domino
description: Delirium: Echoes of the Domino is a supernatural roguelike where each placed domino alters a cursed board and unleashes echoes of ancient curses. Confront time-warped entities and break the cycle... or become part of it.

title: Aenigmarch
description: Step into a chilling mystery and peel back the ominous veil shrouding a peaceful southern Russian town.

title: Legend of Wukong
description: The brain teaser game 'Legend of Wukong' is your excellent choice! Download games and instantly have a vast collection of questions covering various fields such as life, humor, logic, etc., stimulating your thinking at any time. Come and become a master of brain teasers!

title: Humanity's Last Hope
description: A roguelike game with upgrades paths inspired by "Vampire Survivors" and "Seraph's Last Stand". Build your own upgrade build, buy new hats and weapons, combine them and break the game!

title: The CodFather
description: A crazy 3D hack and slash game where you fight as a king! A survival snake-like game that combines snake-like action and card skill selection!

title: Citadel Siege
description: Can your strategy hold against the darkness?

title: Just Move Fall Dungeon Endless Abyss
description: Faced with difficult tasks, try to challenge the limits.Sometimes need luck to win.

title: Zereoton Hauntings
