description: Zereoton Hauntings is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

title: Emergency Crew 4: Call of the Ancestors
description: Emergency Crew 4 - an exciting strategy of selfless heroes in the time of a disaster!

title: The Unseen Fears: Outlive - Collector's Edition
description: It's more than your average survival show...

title: Argonauts Agency: Ares Games
description: Argonauts Agency: Ares Games: Explore mythical lands and uncover Ares’ sinister plan!

title: Master of 4 Swords
description: Master of 4 Swords is a fast-paced 2D action slasher where your weapon never leaves your side — literally.

title: Desktop Pasture
description: A Low Poly stylized idle-pasture simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks while caring for your pasture and animals!

title: Amazeballs!
description: Amazeballs! is a calm, top-down 2D maze pathfinding game for people who enjoy relaxing with patterns and movement. Relax and enjoy the soothing mental exercise of finding the patterns in the maze, competing only against yourself.

title: Sound of Summer Thunder
description: Kody, a modern gym rat gets zapped by strange lightning and time-travels to 1898. A BARA, choices matter, alternate history, Visual Novel Musical set in the East Coast of USA. LGBTQ+ with romance options.

title: Ragdoll Boxing Multiplayer
description: Dive into Ragdoll Boxing, the ultimate physics-driven boxing game where every punch counts. Powered entirely by realistic, real-time physics, this game brings you closer to the raw excitement and unpredictability of a genuine boxing match. Control your boxer with intuitive active ragdoll mechanics.

title: Waffle Spin Ball
description: Waffle Spin Ball is a chaotic paddleball/pinball-inspired arcade game with 2 x 5 worlds and 25 levels, 10 playable characters, power-ups, power-downs, cheats, and both local and online high score leaderboards for each game mode. Bounce, blast, and climb the global Top 5!

title: BiColor: Lazy Eye Game Trainer
description: Fun and interactive vision therapy game for amblyopia (lazy eye) and strabismus. Train binocular vision using anaglyph glasses or an occluder through mini-games that improve focus, coordination, and visual perception. Suitable for kids and adults.

title: Warp Commander
description: A top-down 2D arena shooter in the style of a retro arcade game. The player fights against waves of enemy spaceships to defend space as we know it.

title: Veil Stream
description: Play as a livestreamer exploring a snowy forest to capture supernatural events on camera. Manage stamina, hunger, and motivation while risking everything for views. The closer and longer you film, the more you earn. Upload videos, buy gear, and survive in this unique horror survival experience.

title: Cards of Fortune
description: A co-op rogue-like where strategy and chaos meet ! Battle monsters and gods in a magical universe, upgrade your deck, and survive hellish rooms in this tactical multiplayer bullet hell.

title: The Paper Arcade: Pong
description: The Paper Arcade: Pong is a hand-drawn twist on the arcade classic! With soccer-inspired visuals, magnetic chaos, and multiball power-ups, it's pong like you've never seen. Play 1v1 or add up to 6 AI players for frantic free-for-alls and sketchy team battles.

title: Pain 'n Dave: The Maze of Malice
description: Escape the Maze of Malice in this frantic 2D top-down shooter!

title: Fluffy Showdown
description: Chaotic third-person multiplayer shooter where adorable animals battle in TDM, FFA, Capture the Egg, Stack Off, Gun Soccer, and Basketball, or fight off waves of zombies in single-player mode.

title: PASS
description: PASS, People Are Seriously Slow! The endless driving game where the only goal is to overtake every slow driver in your way. How many cars can you PASS? You'll be saying "I can make that gap!" as you just barely swerve back over!

title: PixelRulers
description: PixelRulers is a fun, pixel-styled 2D real-time strategy game with simple yet engaging multiplayer gameplay for up to 96 players. Designed with simplicity as a core principle, PixelRulers focuses on easy-to-understand mechanics without sacrificing depth.

title: Zombie Survivor
description: A fast-paced bullet-hell survival game where you battle endless waves of zombies, upgrade powerful abilities, and deploy tactical support units to stay alive as long as possible.

title: Shi's Summer Battle
description: A raising breakout casual self-movement game, breakout + Roguelike, can allow players to reduce the operation at the same time, can be high degree of freedom to control the actions of the team, tailored for your team to create a set of powerful builds, to defeat all the enemies.

title: Lo-Fi Golf
description: Chill out with a third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music. Explore dreamy, atmospheric maps with the freedom to find your own path. Will you risk a tricky shortcut or play it safe? Every shot counts, complete each course before running out of strokes!

title: Kingdoms of Dice: The Elonia Chronicles
description: Kingdoms of Dice - The Elonia Chronicles is a strategic RPG inspired by dice-based games. Play as 4 factions across 4 scripted campaigns. To succeed in your adventures, upgrade your troop of fighters, purchase bonus cards, and roll your resource dice to activate each warrior’s abilities.

title: The Journey East and West
description: This game was made for my NMU CS120 Winter 2025 semester final project. It is a text-based game where you use number inputs to control the game through the console. Open JDK no longer needs to be installed and added to your systems PATH do not be alarmed when a Command Prompt window opens.

title: Pure Shooter
description: Single-Player / Action, Parkour, Aim-Trainer

title: Twelves: Shadow
description: "Twelve Shadows" is a hardcore Boss Rush action game set in an Eastern dark mythology. Players take on the role as "WuMing," challenging twelve bosses and exploring a unique Chinese-style world inspired by the twelve zodiac signs. Each adventure is a test of courage and wisdom

title: Elemental Rush
description: Elemental Rush is a strategic action game where you build defensive towers, protect your base, and face waves of enemies in stunning 3D graphics. Adapt your tactics, upgrade your towers, and survive the relentless onslaught!

title: Horizon Valley
description: Horizon Valley is an exciting endless runner where you'll encounter different types of scenarios. Your goal is not only to set a new record with every attempt but also to unlock incredible characters and ships that suit your style. You can obtain them through random chests, special spins, and more!

title: Summoner's Automata
description: The king is dead, long live the king!

title: Ark of Trisolar
description: Steam's first AI robot driven Ark Colony simulation shooting game In the era of civilization collapse, the 'Three Body Ark' - the last fortress of hope for humanity, carries three interdependent ecological worlds towards deep space.

title: Kip 2: Beyond Boundaries
description: Kip 2 : Beyond Boundaries - A very difficult precision platformer game about the chicken; Kip.

title: Xeno Rangers
description: In this Coop Platformer Defense game, you must defend your HQ from enemy hordes by building your base and defenses wisely, while you fight using weapons & items acquired and upgraded along the way.

title: Black Pieces Move First
description: Chess, but with a unique twist: you freely control a rebellious black pawn, determined to change the rules of the game. Dozens of chess sokoban puzzles with a touch of action and a tale of revenge.

title: Shiny Stones
description: The game combines platforming and puzzles, encouraging you to use your wits. Explore the dungeon, collect crystals and gold, use the environment to survive and find upgrades to fight the dark forces.

title: Playing With the Big Boys
description: Survive the streets, outsmart the gangs, and uncover what freedom really means in this dark narrative adventure.

title: Doge Storm
description: Doge Storm: Lead the Chaos as Tlon Step into the whirlwind of Doge Storm, an electrifying strategy simulation, where you embody Tlon, a fearless reformer thrust into the heart of a nation teetering on the edge.

title: Math Party Fezgugel
description: Math Party Fezgugel is a local multiplayer game is for 1 or 2 players looking to sharpen their arithmetic skills while having a blast. It's a wacky festival that transforms addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division into an epic competition. Are you ready to play?. Hard mode enabled.

title: Tombs & Trials
description: Battle through waves of orcs in this 2D top-down dungeon crawler. Play as a lone knight fighting to escape a deadly dungeon and reach the outside world.

title: Doorway 2
description: A fast-paced parkour game where you leap, slide, and crawl through intense obstacle courses—solo or online. Beat the clock. Dodge the bosses. Respawn, retry, and keep moving.

title: Baazi
description: To survive the dungeon and escape. You'll need to discard all cards in your dungeon and keep your health above 0.

title: Joy Striker
description: Point, click and score goals as the crowd go wild! Football, Ice Hockey, Target Games-300 Levels In 3D Compete with Multiplayer and Leaderboards.

title: Forest Rites
description: Defeat the forest's masters in this exciting trick-taking card battler!

title: Resist Mutants
description: This is a shooter action game set in a world ravaged by a mysterious virus outbreak. Humans infected by the virus mutate into deadly creatures. Play as humans wielding firearms against mutants, or become the virus-infected mutants themselves and spread the infection.

title: Wahm
description: A psychological Arabic horror short story. You set off toward the Empty Quarter, off-roading deep into the vast desert, a place meant for peace and clarity.

title: WonderLang Japanese
description: Learn Japanese through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Japanese. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey to JP fluency today!

title: Gst Wars
description: You need to select Character DNA to get power and join the battle

title: Voxel Eras
description: Voxel Eras is a game about collecting, crafting, and automating within an infinite 3D voxel world. Taking your humble workshop made with your own two fists through eras of technology. Design, build, and evolve your operations, all in the name of progress.

title: Dungeon Reborn
description: Prepare to descend into the depths of Dungeon Reborn, a thrilling RPG dungeon crawler that will test your courage and cunning. Explore treacherous dungeons, battle hordes of fearsome foes, and uncover powerful loot.

title: Helhigan
description: The world of Helhigan was forever changed by the final war. You are a famous Golem Battler seeking to improve themself beyond the walls, you wont be alone accompanied by Slayers, Artificers and others who seem to survivor outside the world, you won't miss Helhigan thanks to the Touch-Down System.

title: Oracle 5000
description: With deep deck-building mechanics and real-time strategic duels, The game invites you to traverse 5,000 years of history, using the wisdom of the I Ching to unravel the ancient mysteries hidden in the annals of time!

title: Spin Forward
description: Spin Forward is a slot-based Roguelike game! Collect rare symbols, build the strongest combinations, and keep moving forward!

title: Opollo
description: Little Minimalist Arcade High Score Chaser with 200+ Vehicle combinations.

title: Tiny Tots
description: Embark on a fun-filled 2.5D adventure with quirky characters, vibrant worlds, and endless surprises in a journey full of excitement and charm!

title: Shadowland: Rise of the Fallen
description: In a world where the light has died, you are the last spark of hope. Shadowland: Rise of the Fallen is a single-player, cinematic action-strategy experience with tactical combat and a haunting post-apocalyptic setting.

title: Survive the Cards
description: Survive the Cards is a fantasy deckbuilder like game with survival and crafting elements. Your goal is to survive and make it through all the different levels while gathering resources, crafting tools and items, and fighting monsters.

title: Quichotte’s Never-Ending Watch: A Lofi Companion
description: Meet Sir Quichotte, your loyal desktop guardian! Watch this brave knight battle monsters - from skeletons to zombies - while you work, study, or relax. Features Lofi music, Pomodoro timer, to-do lists, memos. It's a cozy idle game that lives anywhere on your desktop.

title: My Fishing Desktop
description: Unwind with this cozy idle fishing game. Cast your line, collect unique fish, and customize your character with fun hats. Add relaxing ambient sounds like rain or jungle vibes to set the mood. Perfect for relaxing in the background while you work or chill.

title: Mission on the Planet
description: Mission on the planet is a 3D platform game. A robot called Martin X arrives to the planet Tellus with his spaceship. He has a mission: aliens have kidnaped doctor Hugo and Martin has to rescue him. Player has to find, where aliens keep doctor Hugo and eliminate obstacles and enemies on the way.

title: The Door You Can Never Open
description: Take care of your ailing father while facing a disturbing presence that distorts reality around you in this short psychological horror experience. Your choices matter, and opening the wrong door might be your last.

title: Red River
description: A simple game about slashing away at ninjas and monsters. Also play as a Gorilla fighting men.

title: Day of the Undead
description: Fight endless waves of zombies across 9 unique maps! Collect powerful, unique guns, unlock game-changing perks, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced arcade shooter. How long can you last against the undead?

title: Cuddle Corner
description: Meet your tiny companions in this adorable desktop pet simulation. Feed them with care, play together, and create a cozy home with colorful decorations. Whether you’re working, gaming, or on a break, spend time with these charming friends.

title: An Empty House
description: It is an empty house. There is nothing here any more.

title: Space Alien Hangar
description: Play as a space alien in a light-hearted third-person 3D sci-fi adventure. Explore a space station hangar, power up the hover jack, transport an aggressive alien pet onto the shuttle, fix the broken shuttle engine, etc. All with the help from your floating AI companion. Gamepad suggested.

title: Soap
description: Built on old-school FPS roots, Soap is a brutal movement platformer where only the sharpest runs survive.

title: Waking Dreams
description: A survival horror game that blends exploration, puzzles, resource management and combat.

title: Fasthand
description: A fast-paced aim trainer for reflex and precision. Shoot balls, improve your skills, and have fun – all for a super low price!

title: Ultimate Dunk Shooter
description: Draw the perfect shot and dunk the ball! In Ultimate Dunk Shooter, you have 3 chances to score as many points as possible. Easy to play, hard to master — a fast-paced arcade basketball challenge awaits!

title: Captain Firat
description: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place, especially if you're stranded on an island full of cursed skeletons. Find ways to escape from this island together with the villagers on the island.

title: Fun
description: Edgy experimental game.

title: Area Zero
description: Area Zero is a gritty, comic book style fighting game. It features continuously scrolling stages, modern style controls and a hold-to-cancel input system.

title: Church Crew
description: An online and local party game of 4-12. Prepare for teamwork, betrayal and lots of penguins!

title: Meow Path 2
description: Welcome to "Meow Path 2" - a charming and challenging 2D adventure puzzle game! Dive into a world filled with adorable cats that will take you on an exciting puzzle-solving experience in every level. Get ready for a journey of endless fun and entertainment with these meow-velous felines!

title: Deodar
description: A short, non-violent, retro-inspired platformer

title: Space Funeral: Of Rubies and Gold
description:
Made in occasion of Space Funeral's 8th anniversary, this is a Space Funeral fangame that takes place during the first game's time, but with different main characters.

This story takes place in the wicked world of the claustrophobic caverns in the outskirts of Space Funeral. Everything has been transformed, and the perfect beauty of the world was lost. As Phillip and Leg Horse sweat and bleed on their quest, other legends are formed.

Follow the tale of Otton, Ghoul from Skull Village, and his adventure inside the Treasure Grotto to find a fix to his insatiable hunger for gold...
Will he be able to achieve what he desires?

title: Space Funeral 2: of Rubies and Gold II - From Shadows We Rise
description: A sequel to Of Rubies and Gold, and an unofficial sequel to Space Funeral 2. The game takes place after Of Rubies and Gold but before Space Funeral 2.

title: When Eyes Close
description: What if your sleep paralysis demon is more inventive than you think? Embrace the sleeper's nightmare. Explore rooms in a random order and find the answers: who are you, what happened to you, and most importantly, in which bed did you fall asleep?

title: Ruby’s Realms
description: Explore hand-built levels packed with puzzles and perils. Leap platforms, blast enemies with magic flames, and discover secrets. Each realm brings fresh challenges. Green swamps ooze with toxic sludge. Orange factories rumble with crushers and blades. Blue depths demand swimming through hidden caves. Pink alien zones twist with bizarre life.

title: Beast Awakening
description:
Beast Awakening is a turn-based, one-vs-many multiplayer game of deadly hide-and-seek, where every move counts.

Inspired by Nordic folklore, it draws you into a dark world where ancient creatures roam and the lines between right and wrong begin to blur.

title: Raccoin: Coin Pusher Roguelike
description: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

title: Buy a Croquette!
description: March 2012, Nagano. The brave and clever high school girl, Chio Aozora, is facing a major crisis: she doesn’t have enough money to buy a croquette! Navigate through the streets and alleys of Nagano, interact with a variety of characters, solve complex puzzles, collect 380 yen, and buy a croquette!

title: Trading Card Inspector
description: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

title: Woochi the Wayfarer
description: Woochi the Wayfarer is a modern reimagining of the story of “Woochi,” a Dosa (The Mage of the Way) and the protagonist of Jeonwoochi-Jeon, a centuries-old Korean folktale. This action-adventure game is set in a fantastical world inspired by the Joseon era, one of the most dramatic periods in Korean history. Players will embark on a journey alongside Woochi, exploring environments that reflect the unique aesthetics and spirit of traditional Korean culture.

title: Wzrds
description: WZRDS is a horde survival roguelite where you play a wizard with powerful spells and abilities. Mix and Match weapons and set bonuses, choose between dozens of items, create unique and powerful builds, and survive against waves of powerful spirits

title: Patagonian Pilgrimage
description: Patagonian Pilgrimage is a sixteen-map Doom II megawad for limit-removing source ports created by the fine folks at Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz. The theme is wintry gothic mountain maps, loosely based on the Patagonia region in South America, to help you cool off during this hot summer. It is the 75th installment in the ongoing Doomer Boards Project series.

title: Team Fortress 2 Classic: Community Edition
description: A mod that brings back the removed Deathmatch mode From Team fortress 2 classic.

title: Slampunks
description: Slam, slice, and roll through an evil corporation in this fast-paced 1-3 player co-op action roguelite. Chain kinetic hero synergies, steamroll over endless swarms of enemies, and stack wild augments until your builds are screen-breakingly huge. Grab a punk-mate and smash the machine!

title: Dunkadillo
description: Finally, a game that answers the age-old question: “What if a basketball was also an armadillo?”

title: Compadrone: Land Wars
description:
Compadrone: Land wars is a family friendly top down roguelite arena shooter with elements of tower defense game play set in the year 2352. In this game you play as a drone sent to fight off aliens on an exoplanet.

The objective of the game is to survive against hordes of invading aliens. Use a controller or mouse to maneuver your drone across an alien landscape while shooting alien warbots, gaining experience and collecting resources and powerups.

Enemies appear in waves and to win the game you must complete a boss fight on the final (20th) wave.

title: Asterfel
description: Asterfel is a third-person Action-RPG. You find yourself shipwrecked on an island nation, where greed and magical mining rouse an old god from it’s slumber. Encounter three factions, discover forgotten history, and shape the island’s future. Will you thrive, survive, or witness the end of an era?

title: I-Dolls
description:
In I-DOLLS, the player takes on the role of a Frenchwoman, a Korean LLCER student, who goes to Seoul for a year as part of her studies. There, she joins a Korean university in the company of her cousin.

While there, she will meet up with Colin, her French-Korean cousin whom she hasn't seen for 15 years, and who is now a member of a K-POP group - 3rd Star.

For our heroine, this will be an opportunity to visit Korea and immerse herself in its culture, but also to follow the group and immerse herself in the world of K-POP. Attending concerts, getting to know the members as men and not just as the stars she admired, and sometimes discovering what goes on behind the scenes.

title: Five Nights at Pikachu's
description:
Old-School themed FNAF Fan game featuring Generation 5 Pokemons!
In an alternative universe someone takes the job in the old Teselia's Pokeball Factory...
What happened on this factory?
What happened to the people that worked in there?
There is only one way to find out...

title: Stellar Cafe
description:
The first VR game built entirely around your voice. No menus, no controllers, just real-time conversations and interactions.

Welcome to Stellar Cafe, a coffee shop at the edge of the galaxy filled with quirky robots with bizarre ambitions and a lot to say. Pull up a seat, order whatever you can imagine, and meet a rotating cast of unforgettable characters. You might end up helping a robot quit their job, be a guest on their podcast, or chase their dreams. Your voice steers the story.

title: Vex Mage
description: Twin elements. Infinite momentum. Danger from every direction. Merge spells, cross dimensions, and dance through deadly arenas in this lightning-fast shooter. Alone or together - Claim your immortality on cross-platform leaderboards. Your name is eternal.

title: I'm Sleep!
description:
A fascinating short story about the dream of a young man Alexander, who cannot wake up and is stuck in his dream. According to the plot, the day before the coma, the main character managed to experience several confessions, about betrayal, treason and farewell.

The main character did not want to finish his school and could not stand it. In his dream, he dreamed that everything. His hell was over and that a new one had begun. Hell - emptiness and indifference. This touched him to the depths of his soul.

title: Nullpoint Protocol
description: The feeling of high-level MMO raids, without the grind. Nullpoint Protocol is a 1-4 player co-op action roguelite where you face harbingers of the apocalypse. Craft your own class from randomized loot, master each boss fight, and save your species from extinction!

title: Hot Wheels Let’s Race: Ultimate Speed
description: Buckle up and race in Hot Wheels Let’s Race: Ultimate Speed! It's the new high-speed racing video game inspired by the hit Netflix animated series! Join Coop and his friends as you race iconic Hot Wheels cars on over-the-top fast-paced tracks. Customize your vehicles with decals and create your own custom tracks. Take down epic bosses and speed toward the finish line!

title: Project Voxel Miami
description: A multiplayer action shooter voxel style game

title: Gran Theft Lure
description: Gran Theft Lure is a top-down arena shooter roguelite in which you play as your lovely gran being attacked by hordes of burglars. They can only be killed by luring or pushing them into your garden’s traps. Choose one of the 4 weapon modes, and make them taste theft lure, or should we say failure!

title: Westview Academy
description: A talented young man joins "Westview Academy", one of the nation's best schools, known for its spectacular sports facilities and its music program. At Westview Academy, he'll make tough decisions and have unique experiences surrounded by many new friends and different environments. Live your dreams as a college athlete or climb your way to the top as a superstar musician! How will your story go?

title: GreenGrass
description: A short, immersive VR experience inspired by sixth-generation console aesthetics. Explore a stylized forest over three surreal days. Walk, watch, and rest. Built for performance and atmosphere, GreenGrass is a compact journey with a long echo.

title: Polyopolis
description: Stamp out a thriving city by fitting shapes into a ever-changing grid to attain the most resources. Chain buildings to boost energy, people and products, gain gold coins, and unlock rare stamps in this zen-meets-strategy city builder.

title: Urbexophobia
description: Urbexophobia is a survival horror game for 1 to 4 players. Urban exploration used to be a thrill. Tonight, it’s a trap. Search, survive, and face your fears alone or with others. Just remember one thing: You control nothing.

title: NectorX
description: NectorX is an arcade rail shooter inspired by games from the 80s and 90s. Control a spaceship and fight against rogue machines.

title: D.E.A.T.H.
description: Abducted by an alien civilization, you are given the chance to prove humanity is ready to join the intergalactic community. All you need to do is escape!

title: Saccharine
description: From the creators of Project Absentia, Saccharine is a tasty FPS throwback of the violent sort to Christmas specials of days gone by. Play as Sanya Vaffelzscki as she kicks terrorist ass and tries to visit her friends out west.

title: Little H.O.P.E.
description: Follow a small cute robot in a puzzle game where nature suffers the consequences of a reckless past! Help H.O.P.E. decipher a strange language and create a new world where, this time, there is a little hope.

title: Trolley Time
description: Cute animals shopping for groceries - what chaos could possibly ensure? Play solo or with up to three friends, engage in frantic action as you try to deliver as many groceries as possible within the time limit!

title: TowerUp: Breakout
description: What do you get when you mix FPS, Roguelike, Parkour, and... robots that want to destroy you? TowerUp!

title: Backyard Defenders
description: Defend your picnic from hungry bugs in this strategic tower defense game! Place unique defenders, upgrade their abilities, and survive increasingly challenging waves of ants, beetles, mosquitoes, and epic boss battles. Can you protect your backyard feast?

title: FNaF 3 Retro Edition
description: This is a complete recreation of FNaF 3 in an 8-bit art style!

title: Lurking In Fear
description: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

title: Office of Interstellar Production
description: Take the reins of the newly founded Office of Interstellar Production, annex newly discovered star systems, mine resources and refine quality components to build mighty warships to deliver to the unceasing needs of the Navy. A chill sandbox resource management game.

title: ReUse
description: Fancy a shoot’em all with a little bit of resource management. Join Theo on his perseverance to kill monsters by crafting deadly weapons using whatever he can scavenge from his surroundings.

title: Before They Catch Us
description: A dark text-based RPG in which the world is consumed by an eternal race for survival. An inexorable mushroom forest corrupted all life on planet. And you are a prophet's disciple leading your clan to survival... or oblivion. Interpret misty visions, make important choices, do everything to survive.

title: Go Ahead
description: A third-person action game that challenges your reflexes and reasoning with deadly traps, puzzles, and precision. Overcome extreme laboratory trials and discover what awaits you beyond the next step.

title: The Last Crawler
description: In The Last Crawler you play as a ventilation repair man named David and you enter the vents of Blackwell Station but everything is not as it seems. The vents are not safe and you must find a new way out before its too late.

title: Ecto Corporations
description: Build your ghost-hunting agency, hire specialists, face possessions, manage resources, defeat spirits and cultists, upgrade your base, and uncover the dark mystery haunting the city. Will you be a hero… or part of the problem?

title: Hardcore Knight!
description: Hardcore Knight! is a 2D-Plattformer where you hopping into the role of a fearless knight, fighting and jumping your way to save the princess, while you´r facing monster and creatures who are trying to stop you!

title: Inside the Flesh Engine
description: An atmospheric first-person horror in retro style, where you awaken on a conveyor among discarded bodies. Explore a living factory, obey or resist, and uncover the secrets of the system that created you... The ending depends on your choices.

title: Midnight at Grimmi's
description: A VTuber-themed Survivor-like.

title: Solitary in the Library
description: A haunting psychological horror set between school life and a cursed library. Relive the same days. Search for answers. Try to wake up.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Crossroads of the World Collection
description: Crossroads of the World Collection, with post-launch content featuring 2 new leaders (Ada Lovelace and Simón Bolívar) , 4 new civilizations (Carthage, Great Britain, Nepal, Bulgaria), 4 new Natural Wonders (Machapuchare, Mount Fuji, Vihren, and Vinicunca), a special cosmetic bonus, and more to be announced.

title: Live Fire Exercise
description: Inspired by classic training missions from your favourite FPS games, Live Fire Exercise is a time trial arcade shooter that challenges you to complete rounds as fast and accurately as possible.

title: Ploink
description: A plinko roguelike where you create crazy setups with random objects then drop balls and watch the chaos unfold. Discover creative interactions, create cross-dimensional setups, break the game, feed cats and ploink it.

title: Luminescent
description: Dash, slide, and lightshift through a gauntlet of perilous memories on the verge of collapse, in this vibrant precision platformer. Conquer hundreds of hand crafted challenges, unlock lightning quick abilities, and save your boyfriend's life from fading to the void.

title: Fantahouse
description: Welcome to Fantahouse! Run through a magical house and overcome a variety of unique obstacles in this 3D platformer game!

title: Tomochi
description: Tomochi is a difficult game about fighting and collecting creatures. Be prepared for a challenge!

title: It's Just A Jump!
description: A reincarnation of the old school high difficult platform.

title: Find Meow in Dwarf Mines
description: Find Meow in Dwarf Mines is a cozy hidden object game where you explore hand-drawn Dwarf Mines to find 100 charming cats, each one carefully hidden and full of personality. Funds raised from selling this game will be spent on saving lifes of our little friends.

title: Archomni
description: Tactical single-player card battler with unique triad combat system and challenging opponents.

title: Principal Panic
description: Principal Panic is a multiplayer school party game filled with chaotic humor. Each round, one player becomes the principal, while the others try to create chaos by completing mischievous tasks, dancing, and managing energy. Distinguish real students from bots and survive.

title: Fractured Dream
description: Uncover your true identity on an alien planet. Run, climb, sneak, hide, and fight to keep yourself alive as you explore the vast world before you; just stay on your toes, you never know what is waiting in the water, trees, ice, or dunes.

title: Push Defense
description: Push Defense is a push puzzle game with tower defense aspects encompassing five different game modes. Solve challenging puzzles while utilizing the tools provided in each game mode to survive.

title: I Am Going for a Beer
description: You're just an ordinary guy, coming home after a long day. Beer in hand, TV on... but suddenly it runs out. Time to leave your cozy apartment, go down the stairs, cross the street, and get to the supermarket to find the best beer in the world. But isn’t this a strange dream? When will it end?

title: Sayonara Okaasan
description: Sayonara Okaasan is an interactive abstract poem about saying goodbye to a mother and exploring life and death.

title: Turret Kingdom
description: Defend the serene Hilu Village against relentless hordes of elemental enemies in this thrilling tower defense game. Utilize magic-powered turrets strategically across diverse environments, facing off against fiery dragons, icy giants, and electrifying storm elementals.

title: Some Jello and a Hard Place
description: Worlds hardest game? You'll just have to find out yourself.

title: Backrooms: New Gate
description: An immersive wandering simulator through the endless Backrooms. Explore empty corridors, listen to their whisper, and lose yourself in the depths of dark spaces. A subtly oppressive atmosphere, meditative strangeness, and the feeling of an alien, silent world.

title: What Should I Eat
description: Not sure what to eat? Download this game and it will decide for you. Now you never have to spend another second trying to figure out what you'll eat today. And this is not a "healthy diet" game, so you also get pizza and hamburger.

title: Skewer of Heroes
description: Bubble Survivor is a hack-and-slash game that combines Roguelike elements with team-based gameplay. You will summon like-minded heroes to conquer challenges and defeat the malevolent slimes, restoring light to the world!

title: Airrade: Air
description: Horizontal shoot-em-up fan-game based on the anime series Air.

title: Catatonic Game
description: Catatonic Game is a hand-drawn, 1930s-inspired puzzle-platformer adventure set in the mysterious New Marilyn City. Developed by a passionate indie team of four cousins from Bahrain under the company Fred Da Dead Productions, the game explores a world of anthropomorphic animals, hidden secrets, and surreal environments. Players will follow Katrina, a lost cat, as she embarks on a pacifist quest to uncover her true identity and return to her reality, solving puzzles and interacting with eccentric characters along the way.

title: Dynastopia
description: What if Monopoly had Guns? Dynastopia invites you into a fully 3D realized city, where you will compete on a board to take all the other players out with weapons, rob banks to make money, and prove yourself the superior strategist as you make a name for yourself both in the city and amongst friends.

title: Dr Voss' Escape Room
description: Dr. Voss' Escape Room is a relaxing multiplayer puzzle game for up to 4 friends. Explore a mysterious lab, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover secrets to create the immortality potion. Perfect for those who love teamwork, creativity, and a chill escape room experience!

title: Wild Space
description: Wild Space is a turn-based strategy game where dice rolls determine your luck, but it's up to you how you use it. Use your dices wisely and be the quickest ship in space. Choose your path carefully and upgrade your ship along the way. Outwit your opponents and master the dice to claim victory!

title: Youhou no Salete
description:
This game combines a survivors-like combat system with elements such as item crafting, deck building, land development, and an RPG-style story.
Craft powerful items through various methods, mow down waves of enemies, and uncover the mystery behind the abnormal phenomenon engulfing Lapis Macheria, the stage of your adventure.

title: Dimensional Fold
description: Solve puzzles in a way you've never seen before. This game challenges you to rotate 4D objects, known as hypercubes, to perfectly match a target image.

title: Paths of the Visionaries
description: Grab your notebook, trust your gut, or throw a punch—whatever works. This love letter to classic 2D JRPGs throws high schoolers, detectives, and street toughs into a tangled web of conspiracies, lurking horrors, and uncertain paths. Every shadow hides a secret—reveal them or be lost to the void.

title: Tonin
description: Slice and kick your enemies away! An open-world Japanese-style × Sci-Fi slash action game!

title: Meco Rocket Simulator
description: Meco Rocket Simulator is a realistic physics game where you play as an underpaid rocket scientist working for Mecodyne to design and test rocket engines without regard for your safety.

title: The First Scene
description: The game is adapted from the incident "Double Secret Room Murder in Grain Deposit". The story sounds abstract and unintroducible? This game will restore the case process and take you to the "first scene"!

title: Wumbrik
description: Use the colored blocks to create bigger colored blocks in Wumbrik

title: Keep Fire
description: Engage in relentless combat across diverse scenarios using an arsenal of weapons to repel wave after wave of zombie assaults, or survive prolonged sieges under time constraints. Strategically manage resources and unleash precise firepower to outlast the undead hordes. Remember: Keep Fire!

title: Bagua Alley
description: You’re trapped in an endless maze of alleys. Carefully observe your surroundings and complete the Bagua to escape the infinite labyrinth!

title: SpiralGo
description: SpiralGo is a turn-based, casino-style twist on Go. Bet against the house, predict spiral stone patterns, and try to outsmart the casino! Risk, reward, and strategy collide in this minimalist board game with a gambling soul. No real money betting involved. Just some wholesome spiral fun!

title: Botanic Bits
description: Work, study, or relax while little robots take care of your farm. Upgrade and customize both the plants and the robots to maximize your production!

title: Qu Zone
description: Lost in the Hoh Rainforest, inside a shifting dead zone akin to the Bermuda Triangle, you have 30 days to find extraction or be trapped forever. Qu Zone is a roguelike extraction game where every run puts your exploration, crafting, and bartering skills to the final test.

title: Gravity's Apple 2
description: Return to Newton once more — The mission to deliver the apple begins again. This time, the game supports online multiplayer for up to 8 players. Work together with friends to reach the goal.

title: Terrarium
description: Cozy fires, books, and tiny glass bottles filled with endless possibilities. In Terrarium, make your vision a reality and craft the cozy dioramas you've always dreamed of. The only question is, what will you build first?

title: Difficult Times 2
description: Monsters have returned to our lands!

title: Curse of Darkness
description: is a tense survival game in a post-apocalyptic world where the player has to collect parts of a crashed car to save himself while avoiding deadly monsters. Four different creatures roam the world, each with their own special abilities

title: Pinsky Protocol
description: Play as Agent 8085, the most advanced mining AI sent to asteroid 8085 Pinsky. Extract resources, upgrade your systems, and complete missions that affect the future of humanity. Your choices matter: promote unity, extinction, remain neutral. A sci-fi strategy game where your decisions have impact.

title: Iron Skies
description: In this thrilling steampunk adventure from Dualbooted, take command of an airship as you fight to protect a series of floating islands from villainous forces.

title: Farm Invader
description: Pilot a UFO to abduct cows and humans in this retro arcade-style game! Boost your score while managing suspicion as humans roam the farm. Collect power-ups like score multipliers and time slowers to enhance your gameplay. Can you balance abductions and suspicion to achieve a high score?

title: Mutant Rage
description: Fight to be the most powerful Kaiju and conquer the world.

title: Mycroft Holmes Simulator
description: Become Sherlock Holmes' more intelligent, more languorous older brother in this short point and click experience from the world of 'The Beekeeper's Picnic'.

title: Walkabout Mini Golf: Tokyo
description: We are honored to welcome you to Tokyo, a vibrant metropolis where traditional and modern Japan meet. Visit the quaint shops of Yanaka Ginza, sample local flavors from the food stands in Omoide Yokocho, and putt through the brightly-lit streets of the Shinjuku district. Arigato gozaimasu!

title: Wima Magicamia: Cute Girls Magic Battle 3DTPS
description: It's 3D-TPS of Magic battle for Single player. This 3D TPS Game is that Cute Girls will versus each other with magic attack. By Drawing Magic Rune By Mouse, you can use magic of kinds which you drew the rune. By magic attacks, If enemy's HP will be zero, you will win.

title: Wake up the House
description: A first-person horror puzzle game where you explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, and evade deadly ghosts.

title: Sector 404
description: Sector 404 is a first-person anomaly horror game set in a crumbling Soviet housing block. After taking your medicine, your world begins to fracture. Climb from floor to floor, uncovering distorted anomalies and your own unraveling mind. Miss too much, and reality resets. Will you ever make it home?

title: God in a Closet
description: God in a Closet is a short adventure game following a hunter's quest in the house of a mysterious witch. Explore and resolve puzzles to uncover its secrets.

title: Friday Night Dustin'
description: Friday Night Dustin' is a Friday Night Funkin' mod primarily based on the Undertale AU Dusttale, as well as smaller separate songs themed around it's variants, other Undertale horror themed content, or the larger universe of AU's for the game.

title: Sanae no Youkai Taiji Shinan
description: Sanae's Youkai Extermination Lesson is a top-down shooter by doujin circle GATLING CAT (the developers of Touhou Katsugeki Kidan), starring Sanae Kochiya and Momiji Inubashiri. Its gameplay is similar to that of Taito's Kiki Kaikai/Pocky & Rocky shooter series.

title: Negitlet
description: 3D bullet hell gauntlet featuring Hatsune Miku.

title: Nothing Between Us...
description: Waking up in an unknown, tiny room, 16 year old Flow is thrown into a bizarre situation unfitting his typical, uneventful life. With only the quirky and eternally-joyful Chinamu as his company, he must do his best to discover the meaning behind the vague instructions given to them and escape.

title: The Killing Game of Thirst
description: Killing Game of the Thirsty is an interactive cinematic game, blending revenge and battle royale genres. 14 people are stranded on a barren land, where the only way to get water is by taking lives. Survive this deadly game: cooperate or betray? Seek redemption or become the killer?

title: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
description: Join Snoopy and the gang in an all-new mystery adventure packed with charm, clever puzzles, and heartwarming friendships! Step into Snoopy’s paws and detective hat as you explore the town, solve challenging cases, and uncover hidden secrets—with help from the lovable Peanuts gang.

title: Narcoleptic Strata
description: Narcoleptic Strata is a fourteen-map Doom II episode for limit-removing source ports created by the fine folks at Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz. The theme was luminescent and dreamy alien landscapes with mushrooms. It is the 73rd installment in the ongoing Doomer Boards Project series.

title: Noble Legacy: Villager - Abigail
description: Start your Legacy with style and skill, Abigail is now available for you to help grow your village and handle the challenges you face. Abigail is currently ONLY available during the Pre-Order period.

title: Phantom Processing
description: Phantom Processing is an eight-map Doom II episode for limit-removing source ports created by the fine folks at Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz. The theme is green and purple techbases. It is the 74th installment in the ongoing Doomer Boards Project series

title: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
description: A haunting Thai horror adventure. Play as Kumarn, a wandering spirit lost in a world of terrifying folklore and vengeful ghosts. With only his courage and loyal spirit steed, he must face his fears and search for a place called home.

title: FLY: Forever Loving You 2
description: A reboot and sequel to FLY: Forever Loving You. It contains, so far, the entire remastered first season, and 11 episodes of the second one.

title: Super Mario Maker: World Engine
description: Super Mario Maker: World Engine is a fangame inspired by Super Mario Maker, including many new features and improvements.

title: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted
description: Your nightmares, now in High Definition! R-Type Delta HD Boosted brings back the dark, iconic shooter with modern enhancements, new music, razor-sharp graphics, and all the intensity you remember.

title: Sport Shooter: The Eight Galleries
description: Take part in the Sport Shooting Rifle event. Navigate a sprawling complex while testing your nerves and your aim. Hit targets under pressure and race against time as you are pursued by a ghostly presence. Try to make it out alive.

title: Fate War
description: Fate war is a 2025's latest epic strategy simulation game! Lead your Tribe in a vast world with dynamic seasons. Survive using your wit and uncover the secrets of a lost god!

title: Terraformental
description: Waking up alone in a derelict terraforming facility on an unknown (and distinctly not terraformed) planet, it's up to you to find a way to survive, learn what happened to the people who lived here and why you were abandoned in this narrative-driven incremental game.

title: Chaos Rocks
description:
Chaos Rocks is a physics-based puzzle game where every level challenges you to bounce a rock into the final bucket using gadgets, angles, and sheer stubbornness. Upgrade your tools, automate your points, and master trick shots in a stylized, cartoony world.

You play as Corbin, a young kid forced to go outside and touch grass; yet he touches a rock instead and now you are forced to throw it in a bucket.

title: The Secret of Weepstone
description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

title: The Holdouts
description: Smash, grab, and grow in this third-person, session-based shooter—playable solo or cooperatively. Bash through small-town locales and cobble together anything deadly to build the most unhinged weapons you’ve ever seen. Lawn equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, vintage 8-track toys—even the brass section of your local band—all become deadly weapons in your hands. Fight back, hold out, and rebuild a home in a warped new reality.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "Powers of Destruction"
description: Try your hand at the official Rhythm Rift for "Powers of Destruction" by Cazok (free song!) This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "Why Oh You Are LOVE"
description: Step into the light with the official Rhythm Rift for "Why Oh You Are LOVE" by Dancefloor is Lava. This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "Feisty Flowers"
description: Get dazzled with the official Rhythm Rift for "Feisty Flowers" by Cazok. This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "Revenge"
description: Don't be afraid with the official Rhythm Rift for "Revenge" by Cazok! This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "The Final Battle"
description: Go all out with the official Rhythm Rift for "The Final Battle" by Cazok. This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

title: My Dear Emma
description: Exploring beautiful landscapes and local wildlife. Become part of Emma’s story, a young biologist and nature photographer who has decided to start a new life far from the big city. A narrative-driven adventure to relax, feel, and slow down.

title: Everslide
description: Everslide turns classic sliding puzzles into an endless, evolving experience. Test your speed, tackle daily puzzles, or unwind with infinite grids in a clean, minimalist design.

title: Cosmolon
description: Cosmolon is a sci-fi spaceship shooter inspired by classic arcade and MS-DOS games. You control a ship that can boost around, level up, and destroy wave upon wave of enemy ships with beautiful pixel art plasma bolts and explosions. Nab fancy power-ups and fend off unique enemies. Can you survive?

title: Red Clover Case Files
description:
A 2D visual novel where the player will be tasked with navigating a murder mystery, investigating crime scenes and other locales, interrogating a collection of bizarre but intriguing characters, and evaluate all you learn to name the real killer.

Or killers.

title: Idle Racing
description: Purchase and upgrade vehicles as they race on the track, gaining trophies. Use those trophies to buy MORE vehicles and MORE upgrades.

title: Escape From Amazonia
description: This game is a survival horror, where the protagonist must escape from the place where he finds himself, with only the plane to save him. Search for resources, turn on equipment, drive vehicles. If it doesn't work, try again with a different strategy. Escape the Amazon!

title: Dreams of a Ghost
description: Follow the story of Mil, a young girl who’s lost touch with her childhood friend, Vin, and meets her in a dream. The story follows her reconnecting with herself and her friends through the dream world, and maybe in real life…?

title: Monmusu Paradise
description: Simulation RPG about living a slow... survival life to make build back the inherited theme park together. Explore, build, fix, and date everyone on the island! Don't forget to give the visitors who come a good time on your island. *You can date or have a fun event with some visitors too.

title: SOS Recordings
description: A lone mountain in northern Japan. Two hikers rescued alive from its silent maw. In their wake, a perfect SOS made of tree trunks, built years before anyone was lost. Based on a real unsolved case. The recordings are waiting.

title: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution Deluxe Edition
description: This deluxe edition includes three special bonus outfits that change Shantae’s appearance and boost her magical abilities: Sizzle Armor Costume (enhanced Fireball Power), Relic Hunter Costume (enhanced Pike Ball Power), and High Voltage Costume (enhanced Storm Puff Power).

title: Wavekin
description: Wavekin is a narrative adventure and underwater exploration game where you dive into the depths to discover an ancient civilization. Observe, listen, and use your song to unravel the ocean’s mysteries and breathe new life into a world on the brink of silence.

title: Towerfolk
description: Build your city and manage your people in a medieval setting. Overcome earthquakes and other challenging natural disasters, complete missions from the kingdom, and defend against waves of enemies. Use strategy and economic management to keep your city thriving

title: Aerosurge
description: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete fast-paced missions. Upgrade and customize your jet to handle any situation and show off your piloting skills in this fast-paced arcade flying game.

title: Dirtzone
description: Experience the ultimate off-road adventure! Drive powerful 4x4 trucks across rugged terrain, deep mud, and harsh weather. Upgrade your vehicles, master challenging trails, and explore untamed lands.

title: Bot-Break!
description: Paddle Pinball Vs a Giant Robot

title: Mech Encounter: Rise of the Blade
description:
Mech Encounter is an action mech combat simulation inspired by Mechwarrior 2 and other classic games of the era.

The Synthonic Blade have invaded corporate space, led by their AI 'princess', they decimate planets and leave only strange towers in their wake.

Your mission: Get to the mechbay, select your weapons carefully, and engage the enemy.

title: Elemechs
description: Mechs combine with the elements in this tactical combat game. How will you defeat your enemies?

title: Walking Tank Warrior
description: Step into a random episode of the hit mech anime,

title: Of Peaks and Tides
description: Step onto this vast ancient land shaped by intuitive physics, and form a new world born of your imagination. Explore solo or team up online with friends. Reforge the mortal realm devastated by divine wrath. Feel the world shift with your every move. Your lands await. Will you answer?

title: Trials of Valor
description: Trials of Valor is a real-time, roguelike fighting game. Gear up and build your character to fight evil monsters of increasing difficulty.

title: King of Kings
description: King of Kings is a Chinese MMORPG first released in 1999 by DigiWin Software, based on a 1996 text MUD from National Tsing Hua University. Featuring large-scale PvP, guild warfare, and a classic fantasy setting. The original version ran until 2004, spawning sequels before shutting down in 2009

title: Map-Center's Quake Traps Jam 1
description: After several Retrojams, this marks our first foray into something new for Quake. Using Arcane Dimensions as a base, we hosted a jam which focused entirely on traps, puzzles and platforming. Our participants came up with some devilish good no combat experiences, but with lots of ways to die! Explore our custom hub to find 5 unique challenges that can only be survived by using your greatest weapon and a lot of skills.

title: Paddle Pop The Pyrata
description: An adaptation on the movie of the same name, given out to people buying Paddle Pop-branded ice creams in Southeast Asia.

title: Ballad of Violence
description: Play as Via Mintz who fights with her trusty Violin-Crossbow. Collect Melodies to change your arrows element to defeat enemies and solve puzzling levels. Fight your way through prisons and concert halls to bring balance between the musical sections of Yuvono City.

title: Carpool: Attack of the Disco Mob
description: Disco-ver an alien mothership from the disco era! Drive your carpool past cops, blast through barriers, and save Earth from evil dancing invaders!

title: Heart of Stone
description: Play as a lost, lonely dwarf who finds himself deep in a serene forest. Delve into the caves to collect resources in order to build a vast array of defences against the dangers of the night. Be as creative as possible to defeat the ever more difficult waves of nightmares.

title: About a Girl
description: Katya has just turned 18, but her life is spiraling out of control. Now, in addition to shaping her own future, she must navigate the challenges of friendship, love, and family. Help her dive into this whirlwind of life without losing what matters most.

title: All At Once
description: Clear all Stages — ALL AT ONCE.

title: Retroid: Cartridge Protocol
description: A roguelike action game against evolving enemies. Wipe out the Legion across shifting battlefields, hack enemy facilities, and grow stronger with every Cartridge. Get ready for intense retro sci-fi combat!

title: My Pet Store
description: Build a cozy pet store and turn it into a favorite spot for pets and their owners! Manage your shop, discover new animals and products, grow at your own pace, and enjoy the process of care and progress!

title: Only Jump On Pogo
description: Master the pogo stick and climb ever higher through a strange, broken world. One missed jump — and you're back at the bottom. Play solo or race up with friends. Only skill will get you to the top.

title: Bion Clash
description: Dive into a chaotic, free-to-play party royale set in a hilarious dystopian future! Compete in absurd minigames, explore a vibrant sci-fi world, and outsmart your friends in this ever-evolving social adventure.

title: Cipheur: Famous People - Quotes 5
description: Decipher 100 more quotes by famous people.

title: Cipheur: Trivia - Physics
description: Test your knowledge with 100 encrypted physics questions.

title: Frostrain 2
description: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.

title: Cipheur: Proverbs 4
description: Can you decrypt these 100 proverbs?

title: Cipheur: Trivia - Astronomy
description: Test your knowledge with 100 encrypted astronomy questions.

title: Cipheur: Trivia - Biology
description: Test your knowledge with 100 free encrypted biology questions.

title: Cipheur: Famous People Quotes 4
description: A pack of 100 quotes by famous people.

title: Cipheur: Famous People Quotes 2
description: A pack of additional 100 quotes to decrypt.

title: Cipheur - Famous People Quotes 3
description: A pack of additional 100 quotes to decrypt.

title: Death Metal Derby
description: Missiles, machine guns, and total vehicular destruction. Welcome to Death Metal Derby, the most brutal car combat tournament ever! Choose from a wild cast of 20+ combatants, each with their own deadly ride and special weapon. Battle through chaotic, destruction-filled madness in over 25 arenas.

title: Crowded: A Crow City Builder
description: Crowded is a crow city builder where you strategically design a nest-city to support and shelter your flock. Engineer, scavenge and explore your way to a self-sustaining society in the sky!

title: Docked
description: Return home to Port Wake and rebuild your family business. Docked is a realistic simulator where you operate heavy machinery, restore and develop the port's infrastructure, and manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive.

title: Rot Together
description: A first-person co-op horror game for up to four players set in a medieval world. Explore a procedurally generated map and fight a mysterious cult. Brew potions, kill monsters, chat with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed!

title: LA: Streets of Sorcery
description: A detective visual novel where magic, sex, and comedy collide: solve cases, duel wizards, and flirt with danger.

title: Bastionfall
description: Bastionfall is a challenging third-person Action RPG featuring skill-based combat and a unique online co-op follower system. Explore a fallen kingdom, master parries and dodges, and command loyal companions in epic boss battles to reclaim a legendary sword.

title: Gamble With Your Friends
description: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

title: Fractala Sandbox
description: Explore the elements of Fractala Sandbox and its large-scale physics-based simulation. A pure sandbox experience featuring everything from wavy water and sticky slime to viscous lava, coiling honey, squishy jelly, compressible snow, piling sand, aerodynamics, solids, rope, fire, and explosives!

title: Birza
description: A desktop birding simulator.Here, you won't need to worry about feeding or raising the birds.Simply leave it running quietly on your desktop, and adorable birds will visit on their own.You can purchase food and feed them.Use the camera to capture their cute moments.Create personalized birding books.

title: Rain and Respite
description: "Rain and Respite" is a relatively short visual novel where you talk to cute and weird girls at a tavern.

title: Nusantara: Bermuda
description: An otome game with intricate dark fantasy/fairytales. Can you solve the mysteries and find love?

title: The Lost Meowgician
description: The Lost Meowgician blends match-3, tower defense, and roguelite strategy. Match tiles to cast spells against waves of enemies. Combine spells and treasures to create unique builds and unleash satisfying combos in a charming, hand-drawn world.

title: Solstrike
description:
Solstrike is a turn based strategy game for 2 to 6 players.

Players enter the arena and then choose from a variety of actions. Will you beam down more units, upgrade your commander, or go for a direct attack? Will you play an offensive or defensive game? Utilize the unique strengths of each of your units to try to defeat the enemy commanders.

The game has a carefully balanced mixture of luck and skill, such that playing the right strategies will great improve your chances, but a new player can still beat a veteran.

The game has a clean, uncluttered aesthetic and is easy to learn, but as you play it more you will discover its hidden complexity, with surprisingly varied units and strategies and hours of content to

title: Kai UnEarthed
description: Explore an afrofuturistic 3D world scavenging and journaling your way to becoming a wildtender: someone who heals the relationship between humans and more-than-human beings. Reflect on the choices you make, the artifacts you leave behind, and the worlds that will grow out of them.

title: DDoD
description: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

title: Lens Of Fear
description: Realistic, hyper-immersive, intense action-adventure horror game. Developed by PlayableGraph as their debut title. This game combines a portable camera perspective with highly detailed environments and immersive sound design to deliver an authentic horror experience.

title: Chumaky
description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

title: Strategic Command: American Civil War - Concert of Europe
description: Lead the giants of 19th-century Europe through five epic campaigns. Unite nations, outwit rivals, and fight the wars that will reshape the continent, from the Crimea to the Balkans, in this grand expansion for Strategic Command: American Civil War.

title: Watching from Afar
description:
After refusing to help someone in need, you’re cursed by a mischievous fairy to see the world only through other people’s eyes. Explore a realm of floating islands — not from your own view, but through the wandering gazes of strangers in this second-person platformer.

Platform through a world of floating islands and caves, with your camera perspective being only the eyes of those nearby. People are scattered across the land, watching from afar—watch them walk, trip, sneeze, or blink, or take matters into your own hands and toss them around. And for an extra challenge, activate hard mode and face it all with no checkpoints.

title: Uncle Sam's Supermarket Simulator
description: Manage your own supermarket, from stocking shelves to handling customers. Build, upgrade, and expand your store while making strategic decisions to keep customers happy and your business booming. Can you become the ultimate supermarket tycoon?

title: The Caretaker’s Lease
description: 083. In the aftermath of the Quiet Collapse, humanity clings to survival in scattered villages. You are the new caretaker for Sage Creek Outfitters’ most remote winter lease — a 900-acre stretch of frozen wilderness with a dark history. Track game, survive brutal weather, and uncover the fate of your predecessor, Jeb, who vanished without a trace. Every hunt is a test of skill, and every night brings whispers of something older… and hungrier.

title: Archlyphion: Migration
description: Archlyphion: Migration tells a story of a lone Beanie who, after a fire broke out in their habitat, must make a run for it. Perhaps the herd is waiting at the other side of The Maze, but not before it stumbles across other eras along the way. Will it have what it takes to survive the odds?

title: Presidential Beatdown
description: The Ultimate Political Party-Crasher! Presidential Beatdown is a silly local/couch 2-D multiplayer fighting game in which super-soldier Presidents battle it out for political dominance.

title: Attuned
description: Attuned is a cooperative Action Roguelike inspired by your favourite MMOs. Play with friends or unlock NPC-companions to form a 4 player party of tank, healer and DPS. Gain spells and items, maneuver enemy groups, kill bosses, chase loot but manage your risk or you might die and lose it all.

title: Rogue Reigns
description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy rogue-like deck-builder that weaves together the haunting narrative depth and corrupted world-building of games like Elden Ring with the strategic card combat of Slay the Spire. Fight, discover, dies and repeat.

title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
description: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

title: Sin Zero
description: Fast-paced, melee action game where the ground beneath you is just as dangerous as the enemies ahead. Armed with a katana—and any other deadly weapon you may find—you’ll slash your way through relentless waves of foes to survive.

title: Xentra Station
description: Xentra Station is a retro-inspired 2D shooting platform set in a futuristic mysterious world.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Argentina Find & Color
description: 100 mischievous cats are hiding. Search every corner, find them, and bring each scene to life with your colors.

title: Space Vomit
description: Survive an alien invasion, wipe out your enemies with powerful weapons, and collect perk cards and upgrades for your character!

title: Find All Things: Christmas
description: Christmas is coming! That means it’s time to dive into the holiday spirit with the new game Find All Things: Christmas. This time, you’ll explore a variety of themed locations filled with Christmas magic and an even wider selection of mini-games.

title: Fetch Re;Quest
description: After successfully leading her friends through a one-shot TTRPG campaign, part-time barista and full-time gamer Flora now faces a new challenge… How can she possibly muster up the courage to tell her DM that she likes him?!

title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Stitched in Style
description: Dress to impress - or intimidate - with the Stitched in Style Expansion! Unlock two patchwork-perfect sets for Aleksandra and Fortune, tailor-made by the Rug Reader herself. Wrap yourself in mystic flair with the Rulemaster's Set or embrace your sinister side with Ludo's Outfit.

title: Fetch Quest Remastered
description: Would-be adventurer Flora accepts a job to retrieve a stolen item for a shady bartender. To retrieve the item, she'll have to infiltrate a group of notorious bandits by posing as a new recruit. This expands the hit game Fetch Quest with more content, upgraded graphics and unlockable extras through different story routes.

title: Rhythmkill
description: Rhythmkill is a super-fast rhythm action game where your every kill strikes on the beat. Wall-run, dash, slide, and chain lightning-fast katana kills through neon-drenched arenas. Master the rhythm, maintain your momentum, and fight your way to the boss who imprisoned you.

title: Castella
description: Castella is a Tower Defense Rogue-like, where you will build a fortress to defend yourself from hordes of monsters besieging your castle. During the game you will unlock and upgrade towers and buildings. You will build walls to block the path and defend your resources and town hall.

title: Robo Miner: Remastered
description: Dig deep, collect ores, and upgrade your robot in this remastered classic mining adventure with improved graphics and smarter gameplay.

title: Before the Silence
description: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

title: Pigeon Guild
description: Pigeon Guild is a non-combat, single-player action RPG where you play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in Cassandria's most prestigious airborne postal service. Navigate your flying cargo boat through a world of floating islands, where every delivery tells a story.

title: Fortune Seller
description: A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.

title: Logic Leap
description: In this unique command-driven puzzle platformer, you don't directly control your character. Instead, you write an "action script" for it, acting like a "programmer." Your character will strictly follow the script to navigate traps, avoid enemies, and unlock mechanisms.

title: Dimenshot
description: An intense, fast-paced FPS that seamlessly blends parkour and shooting. Master fluid movement, engage in dynamic close combat, and unleash devastating firepower across diverse worlds and unique themes, each filled with dangerous enemies and epic battles.

title: The Spirit Weaver
description: The Spirit Weaver is a narrative-driven visual novel where you use the power of Tarot to guide lost spirits through their grief, and maybe figure out your own. Explore a mystical spirit realm, help its denizens, and restore balance in a bittersweet story of love, loss, and empathy.

title: Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol
description: A dark retro-FPS born from a solo AI-creation experiment. Blast your way through a vampire-ruled station, slay twisted enemies, and uncover the secrets of the VɅΔ Protocol

title: Monumentum
description: Take control of a small rolling square and utilize long dormant mechanisms to ascend to the top. Watch your step!

title: Lethal Dungeon
description:
Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.

Using as few cards as possible will earn you more rewards, and if you get stuck on an enemy, you can use money to shuffle and draw.

Upgrade your deck using the money you earn! Defeat stronger enemies to earn more money! Repeat this process until you clear the dungeon!

title: Shimmer's Quest: Way of the Whoop
description: Join Shimmer and waddle around in search for a way to restore the destroyed sacred flower in this silly point and click fantasy adventure.

title: Scav
description: Scav is a low poly looter shooter with survival elements. Gear up in the safezone, drop into quarantine zones, scavenge valuable loot, fight enemies and zombies, and extract before the nuke hits. Survive the raid or lose everything.

title: Udder
description: Reach escape velocity as a cow with no legs in this tiny reflexive one-button endless runner.

title: Holo Hidden: My Lovely Fans Can't Be This Hidden
description: The ultimate Hololive hide-and-seek adventure! Step into a world of coziness and colorful cuteness in Holo Hidden, a charming hidden object game where your are tasked to find hidden fans and missing items! Test your skill across 11+1 beautifully hand-drawn levels.

title: Astrohaulers
description: Astrohaulers is a sci-fi package management game that challenges you to build and expand your delivery network across the galaxy.

title: Nightfall of the Dead
description: Witness the fall of a city ravaged by an unknown viral epidemic that has brought the dead back to life. But the zombies will be the least of your problems in this frantic and terrifying adventure.

title: Monstrous Liberation
description: Sasha is a spunky internet streamer who finds herself transported to a fantasy kingdom where lewd acts are forbidden. Armed with a set of magical, curse-breaking scissors, Sasha must cut away the shackles of repression and lead a sexual revolution to save the world!

title: Crank It!
description:
A cunning computer game where you find yourself in a cave surrounded by various pieces of patented technology.

You are not alone in the cave.

Meet your supervisor and try to make it through the shift.

title: Eminent Domain
description: Eminent Domain is a 2D scrolling shoot 'em up where you pilot a mech on a mission to deliver former human lands from mutating plants that hijacked other mechs.

title: Customer Support
description:
The questions are all the same. Boring. Repetitive.

Until they’re not.

Your shift starts like any other: mop the floors, answer the phone, restock the shelves, clean the windows. But as the night wears on, the calls start getting... strange, more personal, More threatening.

title: Everspace: Ultimate Edition
description: Everspace combines fast-paced combat with roguelike elements, great visuals and a captivating story. It takes you on a challenging journey through an ever-changing, beautifully crafted universe full of surprises. Shoot, craft and loot your way to victory while the odds are stacked against you.

title: Stage 333
description: It's your first day as a courier, and your task is to deliver a package to the 333rd floor. The notorious megastructure Prometheus Plex is inhabited by thugs, cyborgs, cyborg-thugs, femme fatales, cannibal children, nanomachine-infected beings, and all sorts of other nastiness that anyone else would avoid like the plague. But work is work. So you get into the only functioning elevator... and let fate take its course.

title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Gardendless
description: Plants vs Zombies 2 Gardenless is a rewritten PC port of the mobile game Plants vs Zombies 2 that incorporates features from the Chinese version of the game as well as original content.

title: Overdrawn
description: Overdrawn is a roguelike deckbuilder that twists blackjack into a tactical battle. Cards in your hand have hidden values and are revealed when played. Win the hand and deal some damage! This isn’t just luck, your cards have unique abilities which manipulate the game in your favor.

title: Saturn Quest: The Loneliness Of Captain Navigator
description: The loneliest journey in a universe destroyed by a virus. Go where you can go to find what you can find. Solve puzzles, navigate mazes, and prepare for the final battle with the last functioning bio-ship in the universe.

title: Bubsy 3D: ReFurBished
description: Is Bubsy a celebrated icon from the mascot wars of the early 90s or a platforming punchline? Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection explores the franchise's troubled history and enduring popularity. A playable history that includes games, artifacts and interviews. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Haunted Mines
description:
Haunted Mines is a 4-player online co-op horror game set in old abandoned mines. Your goal is to investigate the location and restore the power, but beware—you won’t be alone down there. A lurking threat is waiting for you in the darkness.

Use weapons and gear to investigate and defend yourself. Try to restore the electricity by completing additional objectives to earn money, all while avoiding the deadly threat trapped within these haunted mines.

title: Mesmalie
description: MESMALIE is an occult visual novel/point & click adventure where you attempt to tame your Magickal ability under the guidance of a small Witches' coven in the middle of nowhere. Heed Mesmer's aloof teachings, strengthen your Magick, or just go home,,,

title: Wummsen Village
description:
Wummsen Village is a fast-paced party game for up to 4 players.
Choose your favorite mode, jump into the ring, and start throwing punches!
Combat follows a unique revolver-style system: press the attack button three times in a row to perform three distinct moves. This makes it easy for newcomers to get started, while giving seasoned players the depth to master timing, combos, and high-damage plays.

Whether you’re in it for friendly chaos or competitive glory, Wummsen delivers laughs, action, and unforgettable party moments.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Feast of Shadows
description: The second dungeon pack of 2025, Feast of Shadows, is coming to live servers soon. It brings with it two new dungeons, Naj-Caldeesh and Black Gem Foundry. For now, the forgotten ruin of Naj-Caldeesh remains a mystery—perhaps to be unveiled soon. Instead, journey into the depths of Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm of Coldharbour to witness the perils of the Black Gem Foundry dungeon. Learn how events have unfolded there, what deadly threats it holds, and the precious rewards to claim from it.

title: DreamWoods 2
description: DreamWoods 2 is a puzzle game where you guide a little girl through grid-based levels filled with different blocks. Match blocks to clear obstacles, use bombs to blast your way through, and outsmart a mischievous witch to reach the exit door. Between levels, collect points to decorate your magical garden and progress along a winding path toward the witch’s castle.

title: Delivery Up
description: Delivery Up is a chaotic vertical platformer about a stunt courier who must climb 10,000 meters to deliver every order on time. Lose your footing — but don’t lose your backpack!

title: Panzer Corps 2: Frontlines - Westwall
