Aperture's experiments go awry when the Zero Point Energy Harvester reaches critical instability, threatening to collapse the facility. You have minutes to navigate a crumbling Aperture and stabilize the core before the coming Nullpoint Crisis. Stay focused, time is running out.

title: NotChess
description:
NotChess is a tactical PvP game where chess pieces ditched their crowns and went straight into brawls.
Forget boring matches: here every unit has its own personality, abilities, and quirks. You build your own army and decide how to lead it into battle.

title: RuneScape 2
description: RuneScape 2 was the name of the engine overhaul update RuneScape received in 2004.

title: Yuki's Symphony
description: Yuki's Symphony is a rhythm game where you can play 3 Iconic songs. Can you get the PERFECT Score?

title: Retro Meadow
description: A pixel-art sandbox where you design infinite maps. Build your perfect world with retro designs. No simulation, no action - just cozy construction. What unique worlds will you create with cute pixels? Turn your visions into peaceful creations.

title: Cargo: Co-Op Delivery Simulator in Post Apocalyptic World
description: The world as we know it has ended. In this post-apocalyptic offroad sim, you're the last lifeline between the scattered remains of civilization. Embark on deliveries, brave hostile terrain, fight raiders, and build your own settlement, solo or with friends in co-op. People of Wasteland need you.

title: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
description: A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

title: Ash Survival
description: An open-world survival game set on a remote island—survive dynamic weather, ride vehicles, fight wildlife, build your base, and trade with others in a player-driven world.

title: Faroda
description: Faroda is a challenging 2D platformer game with colorful pixel-art graphics and chiptune soundtrack. Travel across the 5 islands of a remote archipelago, completing over 100 levels, collecting treasure chests and many hidden gems along the way.

title: Wartales: Contract - The Fief
description: Claim the right to rule over scattered ruins and lawless lands! But ruling is no simple task, it demands more than swords and wealth. Grow your domain by constructing buildings, producing goods, trading wisely, and ensuring your subjects are fed, protected, and loyal. Every decision shapes the soul of your fief, and the legacy of those who endure within it. Will you forge a haven of prosperity, or a bastion of control?

title: Wartales: Contract - The Beast Hunt
description: Hunt the Beast through the mist-laden valleys of Brigga! Unravel the truth behind its cursed existence and follow its trail into its den. But beware, if you wish to survive, you must learn to hunt it.

title: Eggson
description: After being captured by EGG CORP for failing to comply with them, it’s now your mission to escape their facility. Run, jump, and fight your way out in this fast-paced 3D platformer heavily inspired by KARLSON

title: Paper Cannon
description: Paper Cannon is an addictive casual shooting game where you destroy balls with simple controls. Face off against bosses at the end of each stage, and power up your cannon to destroy everything raining down from the sky! Wow!

title: The Fourth Anno
description: Build your team, collect equipment, potions, gems, choose upgrade rewards, and withstand wave after wave of enemy attacks.

title: Toy Town Mayhem
description: In Toy Town, a toy has one goal, to be the last one standing, because the last toy is always the best toy. Play online with up to 9 other players and secure your victory!

title: Minimalist Mastery
description: It's the 1950s/1960s and you're an up and coming artist. Although you've gotten praise for your more traditional and classical works, you feel as though you need to make something new, something... bold. Thus, you decide to pursue a minimalistic style in order to make the art that you wish to see.

title: Clean! Those! Kids!
description: Oh no, the kids got dirt on their face! Use your thumb to spit-clean those kids in this short high score chasing game.

title: Glass Masquerade 4: Constellations
description: Get ready for the next Glass Masquerade sequel! Immerse yourself in the beautiful world of stained glass art, split into constellations with various themes on the celestial map

title: Slime Well
description: Slime Well is a Metroidvania-style puzzle game where players take control of a slime, skillfully using its abilities to solve puzzles, explore, and ultimately uncover the truth of this world.

title: Ginga Cantina
description: Ginga Cantina is a casual sci-fi adventure RPG that blends top-down hunting and gathering with cantina management. Hunt exotic creatures on a vibrant alien planet by day, then cook and serve them to a quirky cast of cosmic customers by night to build the galaxy's most renowned cantina.

title: Foolish Earthlings!
description: A side scrolling side-on shooter from the depths of a long-lost arcade cabinet where you take the role of a UFO on the hunt for human prey! Capture them alive with your tractor beam and pull them into your saucer while unleashing your heat ray upon tanks, planes, and all manner of military might!

title: Professor Pemda's Puzzle Pyramid
description: A block-pushing math game. Destroy all antimatter and antiantimatter, then reach the escape pod.

title: Swordfighting for People Who Are Really Bad at Swordfighting
The Tunnel
description: Awakened in a mysterious place, with no memory of how you got there. Your only companions are your trusty lantern and a weapon. Every step you take, you can't shake the feeling that something's watching. Can you find your way out?

title: Screw Dive
description: Turn screws to unravel the mysteries of the underwater ruins! In order to dive deeper you will need to get rid of the octopuses guarding the ruins. But beware, one screw gone might result in a great collapse of the Stage!

title: FNaF World Redacted
description: A fan-made recreation of FNaF World built from the original source code to fix technical issues and restore the game’s intended experience. Based on content through Update 2, it reproduces the original characters and systems without adding new ones, aiming to offer a more stable, faithful version of FNaF World.

title: Tic Tac
description: Cooperate in this two-player action-platformer and pass the bomb to each other to reach the goal before it explodes. Activate mechanisms, avoid traps, and complete dynamic challenges together across cartoony levels.

title: Wastelanders
description: A dystopian turn-based strategy game where your moves are made manifest through a colorful selection of combat cards. Assemble your deck, exploit Clashes to turn the tides in your favour, and survive long enough to learn the secrets of the Wasteland.

title: Toolbox Tycoon
description: Build and manage your own trade business in a dynamic city sim. Hire staff, assign jobs, upgrade your HQ, and compete with rival companies in this fast-paced business management game.

title: Reflections of Life: Call of the Ancestors - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save your world from darkness in time?

title: Claire Darksage and the Accursed Objects: Collector's Edition
description: The veil between worlds has torn, unleashing accursed objects that drain life from the kingdom. As the last Elemental Harmonizer, Claire Darksage must purify them. Battle foes, outwit rivals, and rally allies across magical lands. Can you end the scourge—or will the kingdom fall?

title: Halloween Secrets: The Blood Vow - Collector's Edition
description: A Halloween dare turns into a nightmare when three friends awaken an ancient evil hidden deep within the walls of a haunted castle. Solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and uncover the dark history in this chilling hidden-object adventure.

title: Reflections of Life: Hearts Taken - Collector's Edition
description: Search the Siberian forests for your missing husband.

title: Hidden Paradise: Aloha with Love - Collector's Edition
description: Relax in paradise with fun hidden object scenes, cozy puzzles, and a light island story. Your Hawaiian getaway starts now!

title: Dark City: Barcelona Collector's Edition
description: Something stalks the construction site of Barcelona’s newest high-rise hotel!

title: Reflections of Life: Dream Box - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop a dangerous foe from turning art against the realms?

title: Bridge to Another World Remastered: Burnt Dreams - Collector's Edition
description: Something strange lies beyond the mist.

title: City of Stories: Stephan's Journey - Collector's Edition
description: Help young Stephan navigate the big city and save his family’s farm!

title: Whispered Secrets: In the Cards - Collector's Edition
description: What does your future hold? The answers are in the cards…

title: Whispered Secrets: Morbid Obsession - Collector's Edition
description: A mysterious invitation promises rare treasures but exposes dark secrets!

title: Grim Tales: Light in the Darkness - Collector's Edition
description: Help weigh the life of Richard Gray to determine his fate!

title: City of Stories: The Professor's Secret - Collector's Edition
description: Can you help a young peasant girl chase her scientific dreams?

title: Marie's Patisserie: Sweet Dreams - Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in a world full of delicious treats! Marie is looking for the perfect job. After many failures, one day she finds herself standing in front of Charlotte's small patisserie, which urgently needs a temp. Many challenges now await Marie in this entertaining Match 3 game.

title: Cursed Fables: Before the Clock Strikes - Collector's Edition
description: What if Cinderella’s family wasn’t so evil after all?

title: Reflections of Life: Sleep's Embrace - Collector's Edition
description: There’s a fine line between dreams and reality.

title: Whispered Secrets: Forgotten Sins - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save your friends from the sins of their past?

title: Hunter's Journey: Tears of the Lake - Collector's Edition
description: Descend into watery depths, unravel haunting secrets, and prove your worth as a legendary hunter. Danger lurks beneath every ripple!

title: Book Travelers II: A Royal Story - Collector's Edition
description: An epic literary adventure awaits!

title: Nocturnarya: Collector's Edition
description: Play Match 3 to help a vampire tribe resist a cruel human invasion. The Collector's Edition includes 60 additional matching levels, exclusive village buildings and more.

title: Ms. Holmes: Letter M - Collector's Edition
description: Trust no one. Perhaps not even yourself!

title: Detective Club: Gallery of Shadows - Collector's Edition
description: A forged Renaissance painting leads three young detectives on a thrilling chase to uncover a centuries-old secret. Solve puzzles, crack codes, and unravel the mystery in this exciting hidden-object adventure!

title: Halloween Stories: Inspiration's Spark - Collector's Edition
description: A literature professor is recruited to help a master of horror!

title: Halloween Stories: Written in Blood - Collector's Edition
description: Can you help Catherine rescue her friends in a terrifying new case?

title: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 3: Collector's Edition
description: Warmed by winter's gentle magic, unwrap a cool Solitaire classic, A thousand levels to explore, Klondike, Spider - and much more. Through sparkling snowflakes reach new heights - Freecell and Yukon, such delights. Embrace the season, pure and clear, let Solitaire enchant your year!

title: Holiday in Europe: Netherlands Dreams - Collector's Edition
description: Start your journey to the land of tulips, windmills, and captivating traditions with the Collins family! Ready to explore the Netherlands?

title: Jixo 3: Hidden Horizons - Collector's Edition
description: Enjoy a delightful mix of immersive gameplay, featuring a brand-new logic puzzle, captivating hidden-object puzzles, inventive jigsaw challenges, and a variety of picture games inspired by the sights and spirit of travel.

title: Jixo 2: Summer Dreams - Collector's Edition
description: Enjoy sunny puzzles and relaxing games: hidden objects, creative jigsaws, soothing music, and garden fun. Discover surprises and unwind with Jixo 2: your perfect summer escape.

title: Broke Brodie
description: It's Broke Brodie's birthday! But just where is his family? This is a short platformer with multiple endings.

title: Turkmenchay
description: The game "Turkmenchay" is a historical first-person shooter that tells the story of the historical events of the Qajar period and the battles of Prince Abbas Mirza and his companions with the Tsarist Russian forces. The game has various mechanics such as sailing and controlling heavy weapons such as cannons and machine guns. The game is designed based on real historical events and characters.

title: Metal Antlers
description: Human in a world of machines. This is a rule discovery game. It's up to you to understand how the world and the creatures work. Hold on until winter comes.

title: The Healing of Sisyphus
description:
"i fear i'll be the same forever."

Sisyphus was punished with the task of pushing a boulder to the top of a hill, only for it to roll down before he could finish. In every try, he reminisces about his life and wonders if he could ever change for the better. Follow him as he goes through the highs and lows of his mind, finding a strange, absurd meaning to his own struggles.

title: Apartment Complex
description: You play as a 40 something year old man who is a co-landlord. You begin seeing strange things. These very same things put you onto a path where you change into someone you can love.

title: Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen
description:
Dracula has been resurrected in modern nights Los Angeles. Separated from his home by oceans and time itself, he must come to grips with a new world while his survival hangs in the balance.

Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen is a work of interactive horror fiction offering a quiet descent into the dark. No music stirs, no voices speak, no light intrudes. You are left alone with only the text and the echoes from the dark recesses of your mind.

The New Order of the Dragon has brought Dracula back from his second death with a long-forgotten ritual from the forbidden tomes of Scholomance but things are not all that they seem.

In Hollywood, yet another adaption of Bram Stoker’s novel is being made, and Dracula must come to terms with the unexpected fame that the author has bestowed upon him.

title: Skull8
description: Explore a labyrinth of procedurally generated levels in search of mysterious fragments and eight forgotten relics. Death means starting over, but knowledge is your greatest weapon.

title: Adorate
description: Take the role of an evil god amassing a cult of followers, build their town, and defend them from incoming holy forces!

title: Pulp Action Shotgun
description: A round-based comic FPS. Explore every issue of Chuck Banner's exotic escapades. Destroy endless waves of vicious demons with your Ol' Reliable Shotgun. Lose teeth & upgrade. Propel through the skies with shotgun blasts. Make them cry for mama!

title: Depression Level 50
description: A day in the life of a hardcore gamer with a serious problem.

title: Touhou Lonely Lovely Bonfire
description: A danmaku-style shooting game about an ordinary magician. Upon seeing blazing lights coming from the bamboo forest, a lonely girl rushes off to investigate. A uniquely circular bullet hell.

title: Death Comes Skiing
description: When a retired cross-country ski team meets to celebrate their past victories, the past soon catches up to them. It's up to you to make sense of the slaughter that follows in this comedic point-and-click murder mystery.

title: Sorceress Services
description: Starting anew as a rookie Sorceress, complete magical transactions and requests to build your clientele and grow your business! In this narrative-driven fantasy vendor simulator, follow unique quest lines, use persuasive techniques, and cast enchantments on your goods with gestures.

title: Myosotis
description: Myosotis is a narrative-driven game following Frank Miller, an elderly man living alone after his wife’s passing. As days blur and nights grow darker, familiar places change, memories twist, and reality itself begins to slip away through conversation and story-driven moments.

title: Find My Frogs: Branches
description: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.

title: Allumeria
description: Explore a vast and hazardous cave network and uncover mountains of loot. Build a town and trade with NPCs using advanced building and lighting tools. Fight bosses and raid dungeons to unlock abilities. Play with your friends, and build, fight, thrive, in the fully destructible world of Allumeria!

title: Beyond the Rust
description: Teleport across a world beyond salvation in this sokoban adventure game. Open new pathways to explore a sprawling, ancient city that worshiped the power of teleportation.

title: Cirno's Not So Ice Day
description:
Cirno was invited to a picnic at the top of a mountain, but she accidentally encased her feet in ice. Despite losing her ability to fly, she wants to reach the top, so she'll have to find her way up using her new ice block skates. She cannot stop moving once she starts and can only rely on her jump timing.

This is a rage platformer similar to Jump King and Getting Over it.
Game can take about 45-60 minutes or more on a first playthrough.

title: Shredmill
description:
In the year 30XX, your only shot at glory is on four wheels. Welcome to Shredmill, a televised bloodsport where fame-hungry technopunks skate across an endless, crumbling loop. With every lap, more of the track collapses behind you, turning the loop ahead into a perilous deathtrap.

The stakes are high, the falls are fatal, and the only rule is: skate or die.

title: Archiver
description: Welcome to the sublime library, where we archive human thoughts that ended a long time ago.

title: The Golden Tower
description: The cosmic amulet has risen. Climb the sacred steps. Our monolithic ritual awaits.

title: Ratstronaut
description: Escape the sewer. Become the true ratstronaut.

title: Picross-8
description: Picross game with 12 easy (10x10) puzzles and 15 normal (15x15) puzzles.

title: SkyShard
description:
Build your island kingdom and battle other wizards in a war for the throne! A PvP auto battler taking inspiration from city builders and puzzle games.

Your island starts empty, and as you progress through the game you can spend your Mana resource to travel to distant skyshards for resources. Build up your little kingdom and fight other players with asynchronous PVP matchmaking. Can you figure out which units combine best together, and how to manage the space on your little skyshard?

title: Weather Report
description: A brief RPG Maker horror game. A young researcher burns the midnight oil, with the nightly weather report as his only company. Two endings, some surprises.

title: Hijack Jump
description: Hijack Jump is a tricky parkour game where your success depends on friends… or enemies. Every player can be hijacked by others. Hijackers don’t just watch – they can interfere with your run, blasting you with stuff to knock you down. There’s no limit to how many spectators can join and mess with your game.

title: Guardian of Altai
description: Feel like a true Altai shaman in this simple 3D shooter with magic elements and a fully diegetic interface! Unleash the powers of fire, water, air, and stone. Battle Erlik's golems, free ancient spirits, and restore balance in a mystical world inspired by Altai mythology.

title: Digital Eclipse: Cyberpunk Survivor
description: A rogue-lite co-op bullet hell looter shooter set in a cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through dozens of missions with dynamic layouts, optional challenges, and persistent upgrades. Unlock weapons, skill trees, and stop the rogue AI Synthex Prime from consuming reality.

title: Mad Lab Roulette
description: One day, you wake up strapped to a chair in a strange laboratory. There’s no choice. The only way out is to survive the game. Bet everything on uncertain odds, and fight to be the last one standing.

title: Tales of Vengeance
description: Open world Action RPG. Discover new soundtrack and offers over 40 hours of gameplay with 6 level design exploration. Use your sword for battling enemies, looting for powerful weapons and gear. Shops selling and buying items, craft, weapons, and gear modification. Your "Goal" get the Ultimate Sword.

title: Pau E Pedra
description: A casual battle royale focused on quick matches where players punch, throw rocks, and swing sticks in fast-paced, minimalist combat with friends.

title: Cursed House 2
description: Cursed House 2 is a Match 3 game. Almost all of its mechanics are unique and unlike anything in our other games. The game includes 15 groups of levels. Each group comes with its own unique objective and custom power-ups designed specifically for that objective.

title: Freedom Bomber
description: Bomb your way to freedom! Manage your weapons and upgrade your pilot and repel the invaders of your territory in this side scrolling action game.

title: Arcana Roma
description: Arcana Roma is a third-person/top-down action-adventure strategy game in which you command a Roman officer and his legion with the goal of reclaiming your homeland from barbarian invaders.

title: Agecraft
description: Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building game where players guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the space age. The game combines settlement building, resource management, and technological progression. Players construct cities, manage the economy, provide for their people, and expand across different eras, unlocking new buildings, production chains, and methods of transportation as history advances.

title: Bend-jo
description: A short puzzle game in which you bend space into loops by playing a magic banjo.

title: Midnight Launch: A GameShop Sim
description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Season 3
description: Season Three, stylized as S03, is the third batch of post-launch content for Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 that was released on April 2nd, 2025 and ended on May 29th, 2025.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Season 4
description: Season Four, stylized as S04, is the fourth batch of post-launch content for Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 that was released on May 29th, 2025 and ended on August 7th, 2025.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Season 5
description: Season Five, stylized as S05, is the fifth batch of post-launch content for Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 that was released on August 7th, 2025.

title: Miss Bellevue Never Heard the Whistle
description: Be a part of this classic whodunnit on a train, with its mysterious passengers harboring secrets.

title: Dragon Snack
description: Golden Dragon Trail

title: A Aventura Máxica de Merliño
description:
Edutainment CD-ROM game developed by the SING research group, showcasing seven different Galician locations.

After completing the game the user gains access to Aquelarre, a tool that allows the creation of new, custom stories.

title: So You Wanna Be A Redneck
description: This expansion for Redneck Rampage comprises 75 levels and 15 multiplayer levels and maps, which were chosen from a contest conducted for the game.

title: Polychrome
description: Turn-based RPG on which you have to find the Philosopher's Stone.

title: Gravehearts
description: 'Gravehearts' is a LGBT, cosy, slow-burn, character-driven visual novel where your new duties don't just include taking care of the graveyard but also taking care of the wayward spirits that dwell within its walls.

title: Maze Estate Escape
description: Collect D.O.T.S. across the many maze-like floors of a mysterious estate while finding new items to upgrade your abilities in Maze Estate Escape, a co-op rougelite for 1-3 players!

title: Z Virus: Outbreak
description: Z Virus: Outbreak is an interactive graphic novel. At various points in the story, you will be asked to make a choice, these choices will take you down different paths in the story. Your objective is to escape the city of Redrock during a zombie outbreak. The game features 3 possible story endings.

title: Cabin Escape
description: First person escape room style game with multiple puzzles to solve and a mystery to unravel.

title: Three Six Nine
description: Solve interesting puzzles based on numbers Three, six, and nine. Solve different types of puzzles where you have to make a sequence in 3,6,9 Based on Roman numbers, drag and drop, music sounds, moving blocks, morse code, alphabet, logic, creativity

title: Verismo
description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily.

title: Tip
description: "Tip" is a 2D multiplayer platformer where players chase each other in fast-paced, competitive rounds. With multiple game modes and unique modifiers, each match is packed with excitement. Outsmart and outmaneuver your friends to win in this action-packed party game full of twists and surprises!

title: Chaotic Cats
description: Chaotic Cats is a 2-4 player local multiplayer paw-ty game where players go paw to paw to collect the most fish through a series of fast-paced minigames.

title: Hangul Typing Tale
description: Learning to type Korean 한글 from ZERO!

title: Geisterbahnhof
description: Geisterbahnhof promises to deliver a chilling adventure, where every step into the unknown could be your last. Are you brave enough to face the darkness?

title: Terra Engine
description: Terra Engine is a geopolitical simulator based on real-world data from the early 21st century (2000–2025). It offers both historical and alternate-history modes, autonomous AI-driven leaders, and a range of systems covering politics, diplomacy, natural disasters, and economics. The experience is customizable via mods.

title: Arise
description:
Arise - The Ultimate Action RPG Multiplayer Experience!
Arise and Dominate!

Step into the epic world of Arise, where every battle is a test of your skill and strategy. Choose your character, customize your look with unique skins, and wield powerful weapons, each offering a fresh and thrilling way to play. Whether you’re slashing through enemies or unleashing devastating spells, every fight in Arise is a chance to prove your dominance. Are you ready to rise above the competition?

Conquer the Dungeons

Dive into the heart-pounding dungeons of Arise, where you decide how to play. Race against the clock in Competition Mode or explore at your own pace in Exploration Mode. Each dungeon is packed with deadly enemies, tricky traps, and epic bosses waiting to challenge you. The choices you make inside will determine your rewards and your rank on the global leaderboards. Will you conquer the depths?

Defend or Plunder—The Choice is Yours
In Arise, your fate is in your hands. Will you build an impenetrable fortress to defend your lands or become the feared conqueror, raiding others for their treasures? Every decision you make shapes your destiny in this ever-evolving world. Choose your path, gather your allies, and either defend your legacy or claim the riches of others. The battlefield is waiting—what will you choose?

A World Driven by Players

Arise offers more than just battles—it's a living world where your actions drive the economy. Gather resources, craft powerful weapons, and trade with players from around the globe. Your choices influence the balance of power and the fortunes of others. In Arise, your gameplay isn’t just about winning—it’s about leaving your mark on a world shaped by players like you. Are you ready to rise and take control?

title: Horrher
description: Horrher - a creepy exploration mystery game

title: SpiceX
description: SpiceX is a fast-paced sci-fi arcade adventure where you play as a new employee testing the Inferno 1. Navigate zero-gravity and blast through obstacles on your way to Outer Spice. With precise controls and a neon cyberpunk vibe, action and finesse are key to survival.

title: Blindernoth
description: Jack Cunningham is a partially blind private investigator. Help him escape from rooms reaching the light, rescue little kittens or recover valuable objects. An innovative game where your good memory, skill and patience will be key to completing the rooms. Platforms 2D game. Test your patience.

title: Fatal Pursuit
description: An unrelenting evil spirit stalks you at every turn as you search for ancient totems to complete a ritual of protection. Explore a world shrouded in danger, evade its deadly pursuit, and uncover secrets that draw you deeper into the darkness. Will you restore peace or fall victim to a fatal pursuit?

title: Gaung
description: Experience the spine-chilling horror game where you explore the haunted depths of an ancient cave shrouded in mystery. As Rani, you will navigate cryptic puzzles, eerie spirits, and survive the supernatural to uncover dark secrets and escape with your life.

title: Homelessvania
description: Fight for your rights as a homeless person in this mini Metroidvania SPEEDRUNNER.

title: Cardio
description: Cardio is a roguelike card game that challenges you to push your limits! In this strategic game, each run is a new adventure where you earn powerful cards and valuable currency.

title: Minecraft: The Copper Age
description: The Copper Age drop is an update to Minecraft: Java Edition which adds copper armor and tools, copper nuggets, various copper decorations, copper golems, End flashes, and shelves.

title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - All Aboard!
description:
Pack your bags and prepare for the next step on your productivity journey!

This cozy, travel-inspired DLC transforms the familiar workspace into a charming train ride. Perfect if you're seeking focus, inspiration, and a gentle sense of movement in a brand-new setting. Discover a host of delightful new Spirits while enjoying breathtaking views through the relaxing world of Spirit City. Prepare for an unforgettable adventure at the next stop along your productivity journey!

title: DungeonCrawlers
description: The second original game by Kusanohito Channel!! Form a team of unique characters and conquer a fully randomly generated dungeon! Use the items you find along the way to defeat the powerful boss waiting in the deepest level!

title: Namakorium
description: Namako (Sea cucumbers) will save the Earth—NAMAKORIUM is a chaotic, cooperative multiplayer RTS game for up to four players. Command the “cleaners of the sea” —Namako left behind by humanity and work together to clean up the polluted oceans!

title: Hekaba
description: After a long journey through the scorching sands of the desert, you come across an ancient abandoned temple. To get out alive, there is only one option: unravel the mysteries it holds.

title: Tony the Mole
description: Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface. Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, collect delightful hats, and explore hidden spaces as you uncover the story of Pebblegrove.

title: Expeditions
description: Lead an expedition of self-fighting heroes to gather resources and rebuild a village destroyed by the Abyss. Equip them with gear and skillbooks to unlock their full potential. Explore the continent, help other races, and guide humanity—before the Abyss returns.

title: Yummimons
description: A pet game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Feed, pet, capture new companions, and engage in explosive battles — all without stopping your work, study, or browsing. Welcome to your new invisible addiction.

title: Choco Kiosk Simulator
description: Manage chocolate and cookie kiosks. Restock shelves, handle queues, complete tasks, upgrade your storage, and research new flavors. Fulfill B2B orders — or take the risk of illegal trade and lose everything.

title: Super Haste
description: Super Haste is a 3D first-person platformer featuring 11 levels designed for speedrunning. It includes many platforming challenges, easter eggs and awesome music.

title: Atelier Yumia: Idus Training Grounds
description:
This content focuses on uncovering the unknown history of the Welleks, and features an expansive map to explore with new gimmicks.
Work with your companions to pass the trials of the Training Grounds.

title: Rabbit Rush
description: Rabbit Rush is a fast-paced, intense action game where players control an agile, highly skilled rabbit who must complete each level in just 10 seconds. Grab your katana and sharp carrot and eliminate all enemies.

title: Bianka Lovesick
description: In classic survival horror fashion, in Bianka Lovesick you explore many places looking for items in order to advance. Collect Ammo and heal items to increase your chances of surviving this nightmare. Each decision counts, so think twice on which enemy to kill and with what weapon.

title: Obitus
description: Obitus is a multiplayer survival game where players are thrown into a deadly wilderness. Scavenge for weapons, avoid traps, and eliminate your opponents – only one will survive. Inspired by Hunger Games, it combines strategy, tension, and life-or-death combat.

title: Bounce It
description: Keep the ball bouncing non-stop, earn high scores, level up, and unlock new skins and cosmetics in this addictive arcade challenge.

title: Keyboard Party
description: Master your keyboard in Keyboard Party! Save your kingdom in a thrilling solo adventure with epic bosses and challenging levels, or battle friends in fast-paced multiplayer minigames. Use your entire keyboard to navigate, solve puzzles, and dodge threats. Only the fastest will prevail!

title: Grimm: Quest for the Gatherer's Key
description: Grimm Quest for the Gatherer's Key is a Hack and Slash Fantasy game with some platforming elements that leans heavily on extremely bloody and satisfying gameplay. Players can explore a huge world that often offers several different routes that lead to accomplishment. Almost every part of it is customizable to taste, not only the graphical aspects but also it's gameplay aspects.

title: Atlanten
description:
The year is 2036.

Klara Anker finds herself trapped on an abandoned cruise liner. She discovers a security terminal and manages to connect to the camera network through her brain implant (a common accessory in this near-future setting). But only a few moments later, she is painfully blinded when a power surge explodes the monitor and damages her eyes.

She will need to use the ship's live camera feeds to find a terminal able to send a distress call.

title: Haunted ROM: The Lost Cartridge
description: A cursed collection of 10 retro horror games, each with its own genre and style, from FPS and platformers to turn-based RPGs and arena combat. Play solo or with friends as you uncover the secrets of a forgotten ROM corrupted by time... and something worse.

title: A Spooky Item Game
description: Figure out what type of entity is haunting your object, correctly dispose of it and try not to fall victim to madness. Progress to uncover new hauntings, make it to the end of the week and you might just get yourself a pretty paycheck.

title: What's for Dinner?
description: A surreal psychological horror game where you cook, serve, and slowly descend into madness. Solve puzzles, interact with strange customers, and try to stay sane as your world unravels.

title: Drod RPG 2
description:
DROD RPG 2 is a 2D puzzle adventure dungeon crawl with resource management, RPG, and move optimization elements. This sequel to "DROD RPG" features an all new three-chapter campaign with adjustable difficulty settings, plus new graphics, music, game elements, quality-of-life features, and an upgraded level editor with vastly expanded scripting support.

This is a "Magic Tower" game like Tower of the Sorcerer, Desktop Dungeons, and Tactical Nexus.

DROD RPG 2 combines DROD's puzzle elements, strategy, worldbuilding, and story backdrop with player stats, weapons and armor, one-on-one monster duels, items, custom power-ups and treasure.

As a puzzle/logic game, level layouts, items, enemy encounters, and treasures are all hand-crafted to bring you a series of engaging, well thought-out puzzles that are a joy to solve. Navigate through series of interlocking rooms, looking for the exit on each level. Spend hit points and resources wisely to power up and advance. Decide which pre-placed monsters to fight along the way. Battles resolve deterministically according to a clear set of rules. Get rewards from defeating enemies now or come back later when you're more powerful and can take less damage.

title: Project Kepler: Delivery Included!
description: Project Kepler: Delivery Included! is a roguelike base-defense game where players control a lone cyborg stranded on a hostile planet. The objective is to survive waves of evolving alien creatures while managing resources, constructing automated defenses, and deploying drones for combat and support. Key features include procedurally generated runs, upgradeable drones and turrets, automation systems, daily randomized upgrades, and an ultimate fail-safe: an orbital strike to eradicate the planet.

title: Charon's Obol
description: Play a high stake game of head or tails against a mysterious opponent, trapped under the ocean in a claustrophobic, eldritch & Lovecraftian horror atmosphere.

title: Does The Moon Dream
description: Does The Moon Dream is a survival horror game that combines brutal grid-based combat with chilling first person exploration and a heartfelt narrative. As the world falls apart, fight against a twisted reality. Become a beacon of hope. Hack your way through, end the nightmare.

title: Slime Match Adventure
description: A colorful match-3 roguelite where you collect mana from slimes to cast spells, battle unique bosses, unlock power-ups, and adapt your strategy run after run.

title: Hallway Gunners
description: Run & gun, dash & slide to claim back your hallway from your enemies and set the new highscore on all 3 difficulty levels. Hallway Gunners is an endless runner with guns, upgrades and leaderboards.

title: Cursed Shorts
description: On your way home by subway, your phone keeps pushing you abnormal short videos. Before your phone runs out of battery, you need to identify them and swipe them away, otherwise, the subway will never arrive at the station.

title: Phantasos Now
description: A fast-paced survival roguelite where you dodge endless enemy swarms, auto-fire weapons, and build unstoppable loadouts across brutal Phantastic Lands

title: TileGuesser
description: A fun party game where players try to guess images - with as few tiles revealed as possible. Perfect for groups, featuring hidden effects as playful twists. Who can combine clues cleverly and trust their instincts?

title: Spider Maze
description: You are alone in an abandoned maze. A monstrous, hairy spider hunts you. To escape, survive three deadly trials hidden within the maze. Experience intense scares and spine-tingling thrills. Player discretion advised - not recommended for players with arachnophobia.

title: Ancient TD
description: Ancient TD is a co-op tower defense game inspired by ancient mythology. Build powerful towers, command unique peasants, collect runes, and face mythic foes. Obtain powerful artifacts from challenges and survive with up to 4 players.

title: Human Parking Simulator
description: Are you confident in your driving skills? Then come and take on this challenge. The goal is simple: drive the vehicle and park it in the designated space. That's all there is to it.

title: San Yin
description: Sanyin is a platform action music game. Under the Xuanhuan sky where the star rhythm has collapsed, use rhythm as a blade and dodge as a gap to rebuild the sound of the Heavenly Dao amid the glint of swords and shadows of blades.

title: Mutant Fish Lab
description: Collect, extract, and replicate bizarre genetic combinations to create the strongest—or strangest—creatures imaginable.

title: Croc Royale
description: Croc Royale is a funny battle royale shooter where your goal is to outlast, survive, and have fun!

title: Prehistoric Skater
description: In a 2D Side scrolling adventure, you are a fearless caveman riding through the untamed jungle on your trusty skateboard. As you speed through the wild terrain, be on the lookout for dangerous snakes, venomous spiders, and other hazardous obstacles.

title: ExitApartment
description: You awaken in an elevator. Something is terribly wrong with this apartment building. Find the scattered notes, follow the clues, and escape—before it's too late.

title: Ondine: Prototype
description: Collect souls, level your weapons, and unleash devastation in one of the most mechanically complex 2D shooters ever made.

title: Monster Girl Manor
description: Welcome to the MONSTER GIRL MANOR! Tour around to find your way to meet the characters created by Dream Audio VA, Lacey Audayo, Method Switch, Startlit Audios and Xena Alexander. Find out which girls are your vibe and find out more of their lore!

title: Play a Game With Me
description: As a nameless adventurer, you must go to meet a stranger and accept his terms of the game. You hear a voice from the pitch darkness, inviting you to play a deadly game where your life is at stake. Are you up to the challenge?

title: Specter Inspector
description: Overcome dangerous specters that now risk corrupting your device upon instillation. Specter Inspector is a training simulator that operates as pop up windows on YOUR desktop.

title: Big Theft Valkeala 2: San Piritori
description: Terentius Duval is back in this open world shooter. Mission is again collect money bags and now he can use money to buy weapons and beautiful cars

title: Tele E Mezzo
description: Based on a popular Blackjack-like game, you are trapped with a mysterious figure on a TV and forced to play against it, until the final stage. Call cards and collect coins the more of risk, use the objects to take an advantage on the dealer, you might reach the end.

title: Memasiki Is My 2007th
description: Become part of the legendary era and prove that you are a true expert in meme culture!

title: Clara Wraiths
description: Clara Wraiths is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help out the spirits to move on or find peace.

title: Welcome Home, Sweetie
description: Experience a gruesome adventure in monochrome 4-color pixel art. Exit the castle and figure out what happened by investigating objects and fighting enemies - remember, you only have one life.

title: Silent Watcher
description: You're waiting for your partner at home. But something isn't right. You feel a presence, something watching you... from every window, every shadow. In Silent Watcher, fear isn't what you see—it's what you feel. A psychological horror where the enemy is always there.

title: Games of the Monarch's Eye
description: Steel, strategy, sabotage - or forbidden magic? How far will you go to defeat your greatest rival and win glory in the grandest tournament in the entire realm? A text-based adventure.

title: Supersweep
description: SUPERSWEEP is a satisfying remake of the classic minesweeper, now with updated visuals and gameplay!

title: Holy Carrot Simulator
description: Holy Carrot Simulator is a chill first-person farming game where the Holy Carrot asks for your help to plant vegetables, earn money, and to summon his friends, the three Holy Veggies.

title: Loop//Error
description: A short and unique psychological horror visual novel with an ever-shifting narrative that explores the deepest corners of the protagonist's mind. Meet characters whose dark secrets will leave you questioning reality, all set to a gripping retro soundtrack.

title: Proxima Divide
description: A first-person sci-fi survival game where you explore a mysterious alien planet, manage oxygen and resources, craft tools, and uncover the secrets of a lost research colony.

title: Mirror of the Phantom Maiden
description: To uncover her sister’s disappearance, the protagonist enters a strange school and explores a mirror world where day and night blur, spirits linger, and forgotten truths resurface.

title: Dive and Dine Simulator
description: Dive and Dine Simulator is launching soon in Early Access! Dive for fish, cook delicious seafood dishes, and run your seaside restaurant with friends. Upgrade gear, explore the ocean, and build your culinary empire. Wishlist now and get ready to make a splash!

title: Frog & Blade
description: Killed by the mysterious villain Frogman, the protagonist wakes in bed as if nothing happened. As the master of a kendo dojo, he tries to resume daily life—until strange powers and mysterious foes begin to appear. Battle, choose, and reshape your destiny in this multi-ending visual novel.

title: Sunshine Story
description: Sunshine Story invites you to explore fantastical islands! Freely build your dream homestead, and farm and adventure with friends. Delve into mysterious mines for treasure, enjoy the companionship of adorable animals, and experience the idyllic daily life with its day-night cycle.

title: Crystal Covenant
description: A turn-based RPG, featuring pixel style graphics and 3D animations during battles. Target enemy weaknesses to stun and lower their defenses, and then finish them by using Boost Points to increase the strength or number of attacks a character uses in battle to inflict massive damage!

title: 5 Min Space Battle
description: 5Min Space Battle is a fast-paced third-person space shooter. Pilot different fighters through intense battles, eliminate enemy threats, and level up your fighter to boost its performance. Each fighter has unique combat capabilities, defining your playstyle in thrilling 5-minute skirmishes.

title: Boostrush
description: Fly through challenging floating platforms in BoostRush! Control your jetpack, dodge obstacles, and master your jumps in this fast-paced 3D platformer. Customize your hero and race against gravity across vibrant levels full of excitement and danger.

title: Executioner
description: The Executioner is a 1-4 player online coop shooting survival game. There are a large number of extremely heinous criminals waiting to be executed in the overcrowded prison. In order to survive, they will rush towards you and try to kill you. If you don't kill them, you will be the one killed.

title: Lucid Clowder
description: A fast paced weapon based movement shooter, keep on moving and try to predict your opponents movements. Currently in early access, more wepons, maps and game mode are coming alongside with a story mode.

title: Kayaking
description: At first, even paddling might feel difficult. That's okay. everyone starts out that way. Ride a kayak with your guide cat and travel across the world, collecting hidden items along the way. By the end of your journey, you'll have become the true King of Kayaking.

title: When the Road Darkens
description: A cooperative action game where up to 4 players battle through themed arenas, dodge deadly attacks, upgrade unique abilities, and survive raid-style encounters in fast paced combat.

title: Yaarmi Tycoon
description: Become a Yaarmi 7 YouTuber in this progression-based tycoon. Upload videos, earn money, and upgrade your setup to rise to digital fame. Do you have what it takes to conquer the virtual world?

title: Emoji Random Defence
description: its very hard. You can check the statistics by pressing the ESC key or after the game over. Analyze why you couldn't stop the enemies and try to clear it next time If too difficult, collect coins and purchase permanent upgrades from the shop

title: Save the Flag
description: Save The Flag is an action-packed single-player shooter. Defend the American flag from zombies and monsters using a jetpack, four upgradeable weapons, and tactical perks. Fight through semi-random levels, earn points, and climb the highscore leaderboard!

title: The Secret of Velmora
description: The artifact of light has been stolen. Something stirs beneath the crypt. And you... are the only one left who remembers the way back.

title: University Is Hell
description: A twisted narrative adventure with branching quests and deadly choices. Relive the same cursed day in a darkly comedic university full of violent classes, shady professors, and disturbing secrets.

title: QuickFire
description: QuickFire: This Wild West shootout has no skill cooldowns—your speed decides victory.

title: Platform Hell
description: Platform Hell is a brutally challenging 2D platformer that will test your reflexes, patience, and precision. Navigate through deadly obstacle courses filled with spikes, moving platforms, and timing-based traps in this pixel-perfect jumping experience.

title: Infinity Rage
description: Infinite balls — no limits. Avoid the deadly spike or lose your score. Collect 45 evil badges across multiple themes you can switch anytime. Climb the online leaderboard if you dare. Customize graphics, sounds, and voices. Join the chaos and make it your own!

title: Hidden Cats: Old Amusement Park
description: Explore this mysterious abandoned amusement park in the new game Hidden Cats: Old amusement park, finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: Yeet Up!
description: Yeet Up! is a challenging 2D physics platformer where you control a spherical character using a grappling hook. Swing with precision, dodge tricky obstacles, and climb as high as you can to claim the #1 spot on the global leaderboard!

title: Detecti Meow
description: This game is a cat personification reasoning game. Players will play as "Detective Cat" talking with cats to obtain evidence, unlock new locations and obtain clues and testimonies to solve various mysteries. Including three cases:

title: Skiers Landing
description: With a pair of Skis or a Snowboard, survive the fast trails in Europe, Japan and Australia. Rescue people while you find lost animals to help you carve, jump and race down the mountain to the finish line!

title: Don't Let It Starve
description: A horror roguelike deckbuilder. You're trapped in a kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster that crawls through the vents. Don't let it starve.

title: Trauma Football
description: A football game unlike anything you've ever seen before! Experience the thrill of dealing with a mentally unstable boss, nagging journalists and social climbers, all the while having to keep up with top players from all around the world!

title: Booster
description: Open free boosters every 3 hours and collect unique cards straight into your Steam Inventory. Trade, sell, or flex — the choice is yours.

title: C4 Clicker: First Mint
description: Click through Crypto chaos in this parody clicker-RPG. Farm tokens, slay bag-holding monsters, and mint fake coins with real attitude. Trade what drops — if it even does.

title: A Minor Pest Problem
description: In "A Minor Pest Problem," Pilot a heavily armed truck through environments in this 2D top-down shooter. Prove that no problem is too big for a trucker with enough firepower. Drive, shoot, survive, and show the wilderness what a real pest looks like.

title: Last Journal
description: Last Journal is an interactive graphic novel where you play as John Weston, fighting to survive a deadly pandemic. Your choices shape the story, leading to branching paths, alliances, and multiple endings. Choose wisely—survive or perish.

title: Stinger: Episode 1
description: "StingerEP1" is an omnidirectional shooting game whose aim is to complete missions using the Stinger, the latest fighter in outer space.

title: Neon Shot
description: A neon-themed physics puzzle game where you flick a glowing square through challenging levels. Launch, bounce, and strategize your way through stylish mazes filled with momentum-based mechanics and time-based goals.

title: Tears of Viceroy
description: Tears of Viceroy is a multiplayer strategy game of interstellar conquest, diplomacy and resource control. Form alliances, forge suzerainties, and outmaneuver rivals in a week-long battle of wits and ambition. For the homeworld!

title: Nocturne FX
description: Fast, unforgiving, and endlessly replayable, Nocturne FX turns every run into an arcade showdown for your best score.

title: Memoria Altera
description: Wake up in a dark, futuristic lab with no memories of who you are or why you're there. Explore the lab with your fellow amnesiac Lenny as you complete puzzles to unlock more of the facility and regain more memories of your past. Will you like who you turn out to be?

title: Keep 'em Out!
description: A single-player wave-based zombie survival FPS where you shoot, barricade, and upgrade to survive increasingly intense undead assaults using weapons, perks, and strategic defense.

title: Mobile Buncha
description: Serve customers the best bowls of BBQ pork noodles, at Tom's family restaurant!

title: Pieces to Find
description: Search for anomalies! Use each chapter’s mechanic to solve short stories, uncover the truth, and choose your ending. Co-op mode lets you play together.

title: Elements of Harmony
description: Harness the power of the elements in this captivating puzzle game that challenges both your mind and your mastery of nature's forces.

title: Panic Sell
description: Would you like to feel like a trader? Try to earn crazy capital in this game or lose everything! Buy cheaper and sell more expensive. That's all you need on your way to wealth. Good luck!

title: R.G.B
description: Never forget Red, Green, Blue is the only way to clear

title: Watchstander: Surface Warfare Officer Training Simulator
description: A realistic bridge and COLREGs simulator built by an active-duty Navy officer for junior officers and maritime learners. Practice watchstanding, radar navigation, and CO trust management offline in Early Access.

title: Metabrawl
description: Metabrawl is a new way of action battles combined in platform fights, beat-em-up, open-world adventure to choose your favourite style. Explore the huge and dynamic world of meta-ryft without bounds.

title: ITribe
description: RTS survival in hand paint style. Create your mode you want: quantity enemies, predators, disasters, the need for food or just turn off it for cozy mode

title: Hyperfist
description: A fast-paced, comic-styled, first person melee action game focused on punching, grabbing, and other hand-to-hand combat. Enjoy visuals inspired by comic books and the punk aesthetic while comboing robotic enemies in a fast and fluid combat system.

title: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
description: In November 755, the An Shi Rebellion broke out, with most Tang Empire's cities falling to the rebels. You will be appointed as Military Governor of Shuofang to confront them. Form legions and strengthen your power to completely defeat the rebels.

title: Nettle Slasher
description: Slash, poke, and blast your way through a backyard overrun with stinging nettles. Armed with makeshift stick weapons, reclaim the garden like you're a kid again. Step past the old mysterious gate into a place best left undisturbed – but make sure you're back before dinnertime... in one piece.

title: Cor Draconis
description: In Cor Draconis, players gather a team of magical adventurers, conquering dungeons and collecting enough fossils to revive the dragon that once protected the lands. Grow your settlement into a bustling city, rid the land of monsters, and restore magic and peace to the nation once more!

title: Stellar Routes
description: Stellar Routes is a transportation management game set in space! Draw routes between planets and watch as ships transport aliens across the system. Buy, upgrade, and slingshot ships to ridiculous speeds to get these aliens home before they are cast adrift.

title: Into the Dataswarm
description: Into the Dataswarm is a turn-based puzzle game inspired by Metal Gear Solid and Megaman, featuring simple, yet intricate levels to solve and escape from. Steal access keys from the Corrupters by hacking them, unlock the exit and avoid their attempts to stop you as you investigate a way to stop them.

title: Demon with a Pickaxe
description: A small incremental game with a twisted tale. You are a demon, trapped behind immense layers of ice in an ancient cave. Your only tools? A mysterious pickaxe, a pathetic fire spell, and a magic crystal to upgrade them to absurd power levels. Oh, and you keep finding messages from an old... 'friend'.

title: Daybreak Slam
description: Colorful characters clash in this beginner friendly 2D Fighter. Family friendly themes and aesthetics with simple combat mechanics make Daybreak Slam a welcoming experience for new players to the genre, and allow each character to stand out in their own unique ways that veterans will appreciate.

title: Neon Raiders
description: From the creators of Mutant Year Zero comes a bold new take on turn-based tactics: a fast-paced, 1-4 player co-op heist game where you and your crew act as one. Build your team of raiders, take on high-stakes raids, and experience tactical combat like never before, no waiting, just pure action.

title: Labyris
description: Labyris is a surreal first-person psychological horror and puzzle game set in an underground labyrinth. Players descend into multiple layers of crypts and caves, where they must survive demonic enemies, solve ritual-based puzzles, and uncover the dark origins of Jarduun — a demon born of forbidden sorcery. The game features both single-player and online co-op modes, an immersive inventory system, and atmospheric environments built with Unreal Engine 5.

title: Garzey's Wing
description: Videogame adaptation of the Garzey's Wing anime.

title: Sonic and the Moon Faucility
description:
Sonic and The Moon Facility is a 2D Sonic fangame that follows Sonic and Tails on an adventure to discover the secrets of a mysteriously reactivated research facility.

This build includes all the levels in the game, however only SONIC can complete the main campaign of the game. Debug tools will unlock once you beat the game, or if you know how to access them already.

This game was CANCELLED and this is a release of an unfinished development build of the game. It is released to honor all the hard work from the people who helped me work on it.

title: Children of the Spring
description: Embark on a quest to find your missing family in a world slowly being consumed by disaster. Explore the unknown, fight dangerous enemies in real time, utilizing variety of unique equipment to your advantage. Upgrade your ship and face the dangers of a boundless ocean.

title: Astroneer: Megatech
description: In the ASTRONEER: Megatech DLC, players unlock the ability to build massive Megastructure projects that will test their Basebuilding skills using new and existing technology. Each Megastructure will have its own unique identity and gameplay, unlocking new possibilities and rewards. Harness the power of Megatech to take Basebuilding and Automation to a whole new level! This DLC will be completely compatible with existing saves, and builds off of any progress you’ve already made in game, feel free to start fresh, or load up your existing saves and start building!

title: Grudgeborn
description: Descend deep into goblin infested dungeons in Grudgeborn. A Dwarven themed survivors-like dungeon crawler. Slay hordes of enemies, pick unique passives and attacks, rescue your fellow dwarves and settle your ancient grudges!

title: Antenna Dilemma
description: Antenna Dilemma is a witty point-and-click adventure game in which you follow C432632, a finicky grey cube that loves watching TV and Alfred, a sphere who discovers a new world where, surprisingly, cookies don't exist.

title: Super Firefighter
description: Run into hell and spray it down in this couch coop twin stick shooter. Team up with 1 to 3 friends and save victims, houses and trees from the flames and those who ignite them. Enhance your firepower waterpower with special upgrades designed to beat the heat from the unique fires you'll encounter.

title: Alien Madness
description: Oh no! Humans stole your eggs! As the Alien mama, you're on a mission to make those egg-snatchers regret their dinner choices. You've got the power to control their brains and turn them against each other. We are going to make them do the craziest things, right mama?

title: Around the World 5: Beautiful America - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a virtual journey across the USA. Find hidden objects, solve engaging puzzles, and collect unique souvenirs from different states. The Collector’s Edition enhances your journey with unique bonus locations, exclusive puzzles and mini-games.

title: Touhou Unite Arena
description: "Touhou Unite Arena" is a card Roguelike game based on the theme of the Touhou Project. Build your own team, combine the spell cards in your hand, play explosive attack values, defeat the target enemy step by step, and challenge the final champion!

title: Jacob's Ladder
description: Jacob’s Ladder is a haunting first-person puzzler where YOU are the solution. Swap bodies and stack puzzle pieces to please The Maker. Question the nature of the soul and earn your humanity - before it’s too late.

title: Van Wheel Gone
description: Van Wheel Gone is a quirky adventure platformer where you guide an orange van through nine surreal hellscapes to recover its stolen wheels, using strange powers like scissors, headlights, time control, and even flight in a bizarre underworld.

title: Cats in Pixels by Louisselle
description: Flip through the sketchbook of pixel artist Louisselle and find all the hidden kittens among her beautiful pixel art!

title: Neon Tea
description: Fight Monsters, bake Cookies and cook Tea for the exatraordinary visitors of the Teahouse, and make dubious Trades - do not get cursed, though!

title: Blastermancer
description: Blastermancer is a crunchy, lo-fi platform shooter where you control a robot whose sole purpose is to obliterate space demons. Beginning as a mix of 80s arcade and rogue-like, the game transforms into a cacophonous ballet of lasers and pixel dust.

title: Loopstructor 2: Skyspine
description: Build intricate rail networks, deploy and upgrade unique Battle Trains, and harness Turret Enchantments to forge mobile fortresses. Fend off endless abominations from the deep earth. Every layout is a battle of wits, every adjustment decides survival.

title: Arcabbit
description: Latch on with two hooks and ride the momentum of a pendulum swing. Swap left and right in rhythm to blaze through neon stages in this 2D action game. Stage mechanics sync with the soundtrack for a snappy “one more try” loop.

title: Doomsday Diner
description: Chaos! Cooking! Combat! In a post-apocalyptic world where hot dogs are cheap and life is cheaper, you manage the last functioning hot dog diner. Cook hot dogs, brew coffee and serve bizarre orders. Upgrade your diner and shoot down raiders who want your hard-earned cash.

title: Death Sees Twice: Spot the Difference
description: The world's most evil spot the difference game. When you see the last mistake, you will know the truth of this world.

title: Deck vs. Doom
description: Deck Vs Doom is a deckbuilding tower defense game where you use cards to deploy towers, traps, and spells to stop relentless waves of enemies. Between battles, you visit different shops to expand and upgrade your deck, collect powerful artifacts, and shape unique strategies. The game features wave-based progression, endless build possibilities, and evolving synergies that grow stronger with every run.

title: Pixel Place
description: One giant canvas. Thousands of artists. Every pixel counts - create, defend, or destroy in the ultimate collaborative art game!

title: Tidal Rush
description: Welcome to Tidal Rush, a casual yet adrenaline-charged water racer inspired by the golden era of kart racers. Hop onto your HydroSpeeder and race across exotic planets. Glide across dynamic waters, unleash tactical power-ups, and pull off daring stunts in fast-paced contests against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

title: Archimedes: Eureka! - Collector's Edition
description: The great inventor Archimedes presents his newest and most advanced invention: a large winch powered by the wind. Even Hercules is no match for this mechanism! However, it’s no match against nature as a strong gust of wind destroys the device, which in turn, destroys the entire city of Syracuse. The collector’s edition includes a bonus gameplay episode, strategy guide and more.

title: Aquacade
description: Crawl into your submarine and go pearl-fishing in addictive underwater action-puzzle game. You'll meet exotic marine animals as you try to reveal the secrets of the seabed while making combos out of colorful pearls. Discover mysterious items and use your ship's powers wisely to collect as many pearls as you can.

title: Ancient Tripeaks 2
description: The card game takes you back to the days of mystical Gods and the greatest heroes of Ancient Greece.

title: Ancient Tri-Jong
description: Explore 15 quests and 150 levels in this twist of solitaire and mahjong.

title: Baku
description: BAKU is a single-player spot-the-difference game. Save the troubled animals by eating their nightmares. However, there is a secret to this story.

title: Project Capture
description:
Project Capture is an upcoming mod for Portal 2. This is not simply a reimagining of 'Project Capture: Legacy'. Project Capture is a new story with familiar, yet changed characters, told across 3 acts, with a deeply developed lore where every event has a meaning and consequence that takes you on a new journey into the heart of Aperture Science.

The portal gun is gone. Your only tool is the experimental quantum camera "ASQRA", capable of extracting objects from reality. Master its powers to solve intricate puzzles and uncover the darkest secrets of Aperture.

Explore a decaying facility on the brink of collapse, unravel a story of betrayal, ambition, and the unforeseen consequences of scientific progress, and face the truth behind Cave Johnson's downfall.

title: As Expected of the Demon Lord
description: Become a Demon Lord, who rules over and manages his dungeon. Listen to what creatures have to say to you, then make a yes or no decision. Will you succeed in growing your dungeon, or will you make it fall?

title: Stewards of Nu Juno
description: Shepherd your station through seasons and storms in this Coop Adventure Management Game. Build your Research Station, befriend a quirky cast of characters and unravel the mysteries of Nu Juno.

title: Supreme Ruler 2030: Supreme Ruler 1936 Remastered DLC
description: Return to WWII in the updated Real-Time Strategy Supreme Ruler engine. Engage in global tactical combat. Manage your country's economy, research and diplomacy. Includes more than 100 countries with no fixed end date. Enjoy improved game performance and visuals in this remastered title.

title: Twilight Requiem
description: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.

title: Noctambulo
description: A Game Boy Color platformer adventure where you'll have to explore, solve puzzles and collect different items to learn the story of Bennie: A drunk heartbroken rabbit trying to crash a mysterious night club in the Andes.

title: Perpetual Torment
description: Perpetual Torment is the 27th entry in the Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series, featuring 14 maps built in 6 hours or less using a custom texture set themed after the visuals of Doom 2016, with the D4V gameplay mod built-in.

title: Fynn's Passage
description: Play as "Fynn" as you make your way through an underground labyrinth, fighting against mobs of malicious creatures. Switch between weapons seamlessly for balanced combat. Explore caverns, discover collectible items, trade with friendly NPCs, and solve various puzzles.

title: Yapyap
description: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival’s towers to cause mayhem. Try to fulfill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.

title: ScoutmasterX
description: Spawns Scoutmaster Mayers to chase players every 6.5 minutes for a total of 1.5 minutes. Also introduces a Scoutmaster hunter that MAY spawn and help you out.

title: Confrontation: Battle for Black Gold
description: Confrontation: Battle for Black Gold is a real-time strategy game developed by Russian studio Red Ice software, set in the historical period of the Gulf War.

title: Peak Item Randomizer
description: A mod that completely randomizes all item spawns in PEAK - any item can appear anywhere! This makes every playthrough unique and unpredictable.

title: Necromental
description: An incremental RPG about unholy, untamed, uncontrollable... necromancy.

title: Station Master RPG
description: Play the role of the station master at a railway station in rural Japan and cope with the ever-increasing flow of passengers in this RPG management simulation! Use the station's funds to upgrade the station and design it to your liking!

title: Haggle Battle
description: Haggle, strategize, and win! Read your opponents, time your moves perfectly, and watch your inventory grow. Race against mounting bills, never miss a golden deal, and keep the family legacy alive! Find the right price for the right customer.

title: Looking for Waifu
description: A physics-based meme platformer where a lonely cat risks it all… for love. Are you ready to climb, fall, rage, and laugh your way through the most cursed journey ever? In LOOKING FOR WAIFU, you play as a determined cat with one goal: find his waifu. No map. No checkpoints. No mercy.

title: Pixel Ronin
description: Pixel Ronin is a fast-paced hack-and-slash survival game where you face relentless waves of ghouls and monsters. Tap into powerful abilities and unleash devastating attacks. Outmaneuver your enemies with tactical precision to turn the tide of battle. Hold your ground—this will be a long battle.

title: Sinoda
description: Sinoda is an abstract strategy game in which players attempt to win by taking each other's pieces. Strategize, sacrifice and capture the most points across 5 different modes. Play alone or with up to 6 players!

title: Catolonizer
description: Catolonizer is an online social deduction game for up to 15 players. Complete tasks to earn coins, buy items from the Merchant, and use your secret ability at night. Outsmart the others and fulfill your unique win condition!

title: The Light and the Shadow
description: A magical 2D action-adventure game. Join Fany on a journey through mysterious forests, overcome challenges, face mystical creatures, and uncover forgotten secrets in a charming and magical world.

title: Dino Explore
description: Dino Explore is a fun way to learn more about dinosaurs! Do you want to dig up bones? Or maybe you want to find dinosaurs in a 2d world? Are you interested in a dinosaur quiz, challenging your knowledge about dinosaurs or .... maybe you just want to compare sizes. All of this is in the game!

title: Selanìa
description: Meet a cast of eccentric characters, gain their trust, and help them rewrite their stories. And yours. Lose yourself in Selanìa, where the greenhouse blooms of curious plants, the kitchen is always hungry, and the library whispers tales. Or just sit down, and relax.

title: Build-a-lot: On Vacation
description: Vacation towns are looking to upgrade their local attractions and your skills are needed! Can you get the gondola working at the ski resort? Will the fairgrounds get constructed in time for the festival? Find out in Build-a-lot: On Vacation!

title: NightMare King
description: Survive a nightmare-tainted world in this thrilling roguelike! With dozens of characters, hundreds of weapons/items, and build freedom, challenge limits across maps. Slay monsters, level up, collect gold, upgrade gear—can you endure the Nightmare Tide?

title: Shards of Order
description: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game—but be ready to face the consequences.

title: Leafy Corner
description: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

title: Northern Crossroads
description: Northern Crossroads is a free, text-based multiplayer RPG that’s been live since 1992. It’s classic Diku-style hack-and-slash: explore 400+ areas (~40k rooms), fight thousands of mobs, level and gear up, and team with others. No graphics—just depth, challenge, and a loyal community that loves discovery and progression. Play via modern MUD clients or Grapevine; direct connect: ncmud.net:9000.

title: Magic Brush
description: In "Magic Brush", Players can press and hold the mouse to slide, generating obstacles on the screen to bounce the little rabbit, allowing it to cross numerous barriers and return home safely.The game has six themes, and nearly 100 levels, full of passion and challenge.

title: CheeseCatToe
description: Basically tic-tac-toe games from classic 3x3 three-in-row to challenging 11x11 five-in-row. Designed for kids and adults to develop logical thinking while playing relaxing game.

title: Seamspace: Minesweeper
description: The classic Minesweeper experience launched into a 3D space environment. Strategically reveal cells against a backdrop of stars and nebulae to beat your best times. Play the traditional beginner, intermediate, and expert difficulties or take control and create your own board in the custom mode.

title: Sparkle Pop
description: Master glittery deluges of sparkling colors in Sparkle Pop as you thoughtfully trigger chain reactions to push your score higher and higher.

title: Flower Escape
description: A local 2 player leveler game

title: Cat With Gun
description: A top down 2D game about a cat who kills starfish with a gun.

title: Train Sim World 6
description: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!

title: Santas Little Helper
description: Join Santa's cheerful elf in this heartwarming holiday game where your mission is to catch as many falling gifts as possible!

title: Drunk but Not Wasted Knight
description: A tipsy tale of questionable choices, suspiciously charming strangers, and conversations that unravel faster than your sobriety. What begins as a harmless chat in the alley might end with truffle mushrooms, a missing crown, or waking up in someone else's dungeon. You've been warned.

title: Spirit Whisperer Conversation With Akari
description: Akari was a beloved streamer—until she died live on camera. Now, as a spirit, she's still performing. You've been hired to speak with her, and uncover the truth behind the smile she never took off.

title: Monster Slayer: Motion Edition
description: Monster Slayer: Motion Edition - VR-free motion gaming! Use any webcam (720p+) to control 3 classes (Archer/Ninja/Mage) with real movements. Smash chests for buffs. 12-level campaign & endless mode. AI motion tracking, auto-difficulty, 2m² play area.

title: Fate of Gun
description: Click 「PLAY」 to start. The PLAY button turns into FIRE.​ After clicking FIRE, the button is grayed out. You fire first. If it's a live round, you fail the game and this round ends. If it's a blank round, the pirate will continue to fire.

title: College Baseball: Dynasty Builder
description: Your wait for a college baseball game is over. College Baseball: Dynasty Builder lets you take control of a college program, recruit top talent, manage your roster, and build a powerhouse over multiple seasons.

title: Apoclone
description: In a world ruined by rogue science, you are the Commander of a clone squad fighting to restore order. Summon powerful Titans, build the perfect lineup, and battle through a wasteland teeming with chaos.

title: Pirate Guy
description: 2d platformer where player controls pirate character, mission is to avoid different enemies and traps and find treasuries end of levels and finish levels. Game contains also boss levels

title: Labyrinth Sword Princess
description: An action game using a time mechanism. Actively slow down the flow of time. Within a short period of time, capture a momentary flaw, quickly approach the enemy, interrupt, avoid fatal attacks, and break the deadlock.

title: How Your Package Gets Delivered
description: Perfect For Fans Of: Endless runners Reflex-based games Arcade-style challenges Indie action-platformers

title: WitchSpring R: The Follower’s Fall
description: This update includes post-ending stories of the main characters, tales of new warlords, and a new storyline centered on a mysterious follower.

title: What Is The Ghost
description: Ghosts haunt the living, and only your company can identify them. Search haunted apartments, collect suspicious artifacts, and reveal cursed objects. But beware: the longer you stay, the stronger the ghost’s presence grows - and the deadlier your investigation becomes.

title: BoysQuest Find the Difference
description: They’re not perfect… and that’s exactly what you need!At first glance, the pictures look identical, but differences are hiding somewhere!Your task is to find them across 70 levels featuring charismatic, fun, and stylish guys.

title: Jump Greed
description: A simple arcade platformer where you try and collect as many coins as possible.

title: Brainrot Battle
description: Goofy animals decided to start a battle! Defend your towers with brilliant gold management for sending animal units fight for you. Then collect more units to fill your deck and beat every level on the map!

title: Space Memory: Mushrooms
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool mushrooms in space

title: Bouncing Buds
description: A party minigame like no other. Battle friends and foes while bouncing around the world in fun minigames anyone can learn.

title: Project MT
