description: Survive endless waves in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Upgrade your ship between 20-second battles, adapt to enemy behaviors, and climb the global leaderboard. Strategic, intense, and built for replayability.

title: Where Time Ends
description: Where Time Ends is a psychological puzzle game that follows a grieving protagonist determined to build a time machine to see his deceased mother one last time. As players construct the machine piece by piece, they must solve challenging puzzles while reality slowly begins to fracture. With nine unique endings that explore different interpretations of grief, obsession, and acceptance, the game offers an emotional and introspective experience that blends mystery, logic, and psychological tension.

title: Neuroarena: Black Duel Master
description: Neuroarena is a free online card game featuring unique generated cards that evolve over time. Engage in PvP duels, explore a vast card universe, and enjoy strategic battles in an ever-evolving world. Perfect for fans of collectible card games and epic hero clashes!

title: AbsentedAge 2: Ghostbound
description: Absented Age is a fresh mix of genres: an action RPG outside of combat that becomes a roguelike-style strategy RPG during combat.

title: You Suck at Football
description: A physics-based rage game where you and your friends control a chaotic football through parkour and deadly drops. One wrong bounce and you lose it all. Climb together or fall together — can you reach the top?

title: Galaxy Cocoa
description: Action game character upgrade

title: Bullets Tracks: Son Of
description: this is a legendary story of crime, you fight aganist the crime for go to the liberty, in this epic adventure you shot and move by side of enemy bullets, you go and become action legend

title: Drone Smuggler
description: DRONE SMUGGLER is an old-school, top-down space shooter with ship customization, randomly generated levels & obstacles to navigate/destroy, and thematic sounds that seek to capture some of the magic of classic video game music & effects. Battle shadespace hazards and fight for the HIGH SCORE!

title: Jigzo
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: TileUp
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: Pica
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: White Forest
description: An unnatural forest has even more unnatural secrets hiding within it. Discover what lies beneath the surface while you investigate trails of blood and carnage which will lead you to untold horrors in this atmospheric First-Person Shooter.

title: Protocol Aegirum
description: A turn-based tactical game in the style of chess, with roguelike elements, where you command a fleet in dynamic strategic battles to break humanity's cycle of defeat.

title: Stop Breaking My Castle!
description: A peaceful demon castle is attacked daily by heroes who smash walls and defeat monsters, turning it into a hunting ground. As the Demon Lord, you summon and evolve monsters to defend your home and stop the relentless heroes.

title: Speedway Club Manager 25
description: Take on the role of a speedway club manager and lead your team to championship glory! Sign your dream riders, secure sponsorship deals, upgrade your facilities, and develop young speedway talents!

title: Project Manager: Initiation
description: A strategic game that simulates the work of a Project Manager within a large corporation. From a first-person perspective, you gain the skills and tools essential for PM work during the first stage of a project: Initiation.

title: Gold Defence
description: Only you can stop the hordes of adventurers hungry for wealth, defend the tower with all possible methods!

title: Agu
description: Game with simple mechanics but very fun to play.

title: MinePuzzle5020
description: Let's play MinePuzzle in an area of 50*20. The number of bombs around you will be displayed, so use that as a hint and right-click to mark where you think the bombs are. When all the cells are open, the game is clear!

title: Snaplt
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: Pixelo
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: Fitly
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: Moxie
description: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

title: Claws of the Forest
description: A mysterious and sinister presence stalks you back to your cabin, where you and your brother are all alone.

title: Riftinvaders
description: RIFTINVADERS is a fast-paced arcade game with hard difficulty, focused on aim training and endless action. Compete for top spots on the leaderboard, unlock achievements and get to the highest X-RUN possible. Enjoy also in seated VR!

title: Clean Minesweeper
description: A calm and clean minesweeper with a modern aesthetic. No guessing, just pure logic.

title: Call of Thief
description: An arcade action plateforme game

title: Mindfall: Song of the Echo
description: The mind is at war, and the realms are cracking. Enter a world where the realm of harmony holds secrets and every step echoes into eternity. Dive into a captivating story filled with love, betrayal, and redemption in this epic classic style JRPG.

title: Escape the Beach
description: A surreal first-person narrative experience. Walk along an endless tropical beach, encounter out-of-place artifacts and look for a way to escape while being guided by a soothing yet sarcastic voice who makes you ponder the meaning of your existence.

title: Nuice Industries
description: Become a space baron in the great 22nd-century Nuice rush! Manage your cash flow, discover buried treasures, capitalize on electromagnetic storms and launch attacks at your competitors to maximize your profits in this sci-fi management game.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 10
description:
Gorillaz — the biggest virtual band in the world — has crossed over and crash-landed into a whole new universe! With their colorful backstory and ground-breaking musical ways, they’re ready to put on a show.

Band members Noodle, 2D, Russel Hobbs, and Murdoc Niccals are the Icons of Fortnite Festival Season 10. Watch out for this dream line-up making their Festival debut on August 26!

title: Monkey Jump
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 8 players. Collect what matters, stay silent, and survive as sound and light lure the creatures closer every second.

title: Popeye
description: The official Popeye game in which you play the spinach eating sailor in this modernized adaptation of the classic arcade game. The objective of the game is to get the highest score by completing as many levels as you can by collecting hearts and letters thrown down by Olive all while trying to avoid the dangers of the witch, vulture and Popeye's rival Brutus. Find and eat the spinach and get the special powers needed to punch your enemies into the sea and become faster at collecting the items before they return. Popeye is a simple, pick up and play, fast action, fun game which anyone can play, but be warned winning a high score won't come easy.

title: First-Person Data Explorer
description: In First-Person Data Explorer, datasets become immersive 3D environments where numbers shape color, size, movement, and more. Load, generate, or edit your data during gameplay, and turn raw values into something you can see, experience - and explore.

title: HgmGame-Tiger
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: HgmGame-Snail
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Stack Attack
description: Stack Attack is a trip down nostalgia avenue. Taking the form of a fully Twitch integrated (Required) app, your chat attempts to gain the most caps by taking turns knocking down the stack and seeing which caps they can flip over. Increases chat engagement and, thus, algorithm response!

title: HgmGame-Lion
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Brainrot Animals Fighting
description: Tralalero Tralala vs Bombordiro Crocodilo, who to choose? It's a fighting game based on a famous meme: fight with your friends and win while playing as your favorite characters!

title: Crystals of Power
description: The crystals hold the power to save Elicion—or destroy it. The choice lies in your hands.

title: Geargrid Tile Match
description: Match tiles to keep the gears turning in Geargrid Tile Match, dive into a stunning steampunk world of puzzles, precision, and clockwork strategy. Can you clear the grid before the system jams?

title: The Sacred Six Crystal: A Hero's Journey
description: The Sacred Six Crystal: A Hero's Journey is an epic RPG game that tells the story of the heroes' journey to save the world of Elysia from destruction caused by the return of the dark power of Drakmor, the former Supreme God of Darkness.

title: Blackjack Saloon
description: Saddle up for classic 21 in BlackJack Saloon! Play against the dealer in a stylish Wild West setting with smooth gameplay, crisp visuals, and authentic saloon vibes. Bet smart, hit or stand, and walk away a legend—or busted.

title: The Bigback Room
description: A comedy horror game about falling into the backrooms while trying to head to the store to find something to eat. You will need to find food and solve simple puzzles to survive and hopefully find your way out.

title: Virtual Crime Scene: Apartment 213
description: An explorable 3D reconstruction of Jeffrey L. Dahmer’s apartment, recreated as it was on the night of his arrest. Developed using police reports, FBI files, crime scene photographs, and trial footage, the project serves as a digital preservation of a pivotal moment in American criminal history.

title: Space Rabbit
description: A high-stakes challenge action game where a space rabbit sets out for the moon!Can you overcome countless trials and safely return to the moon? Only the gods know!

title: Tiris
description: Infiltrate in Tiris Cathedral and recover your beloved's soul in this medieval, lowdark fantasy Top-Down Shooter. Deal with hordes of enemies, solve the puzzles that block your path, and free your loved one and the people from the tyranny of the Necromancer and his commanders.

title: Dungeon Survivor
description: Collect food, slay monsters, and stay alive as you explore the canyons, caves, and dungeons.

title: Gloria's House
description: Gloria's House helps you enhance focus during work and study sessions. Collect ​Time Coins to purchase decorative items, personalize Gloria's cozy cottage, and craft a uniquely warm environment that reflects your style.

title: RunPunk: The Parkour Game
description: This is an open-world parkour game with an emphasis on atmosphere. The player can overcome any obstacles he encounters. The game takes place in Tokyo in the future. In the future, as the game develops, it is planned to add other cities and game mechanics.

title: Rebecca and the Sword of Nasty Curses
description: One day, Rebecca's village is attacked by a group of thieves. Most of the villagers are taken, including her crush, Takezo. Swearing to defeat the thieves, Rebecca sets out on a journey. What fate awaits the village's strongest female warrior when she rescues her beloved?

title: Ominigun
description: Ominigun is a fast-paced and challenging bullet hell action game. Use a variety of weapons and buffs to fight enemy hordes, dodge projectiles, and defeat unique bosses. Combine abilities, react quickly, and overcome intense, chaotic battles.

title: Chrono Stranded
description: Chrono Stranded is an adventure action game where you battle through a shattered world where past, present, and future collide. Survive encounters against humans, aliens, beasts, and robots as you uncover the truth behind a cataclysmic temporal collapse.

title: Punk Girl
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Blaster Bunny Chronicles
description: In this adventure, Your siblings are being controlled and calling themselves "The revengers of Millonaire Bunny" approaching with the mission of steal the Blaster Power from Gunner Bunny and the new protagonist Imitator Bunny.

title: ThroneBreaker
description: You play whose family was executed under the orders of a ruthless king Through years of cunning strategy and dangerous alliances, you lead a rebellion and seize the throne for yourself. But the crown is no sanctuary. Years later, just as you begin to rebuild the realm an assassin’s blade finds you.

title: Spirit Whisperer Conversation With Kamiko
description: She died, but no one ever asked her what really happened. Now she speaks—and you're the only one listening. What you say will decide whether she finally moves on… or disappears forever.

title: Hypnosis Knight-Princess
description: As Gina, your mission is to travel across the kingdom of Triss and break the hypnosis curse affecting her people. To do this, you'll need to craft magic fragments and dispelling stones, which will help you perform exorcisms on the citizens. Each exorcism consumes time, so plan accordingly! You'll also face automatic battles with enemies that will take up both time and HP. The more citizens you free, the more regions of the world map you'll unlock, potentially revealing new dungeons and powerful bosses to defeat.

title: Echoes of Time
description: A native PC recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D, with single-screen controls and menus, widescreen support and customizable graphics.

title: Shadowed: The Demon Castle of Ooe
description: With a focus on stealth, combat, and long-term planning, Shadowed offers 6 unique classes, over 200 perks, and a heavy emphasis on level and enemy design. Synergistic and brutal in both style and difficulty, Shadowed is a traditional Roguelike experience like no other.

title: Hanamaru Koumuten
description: Construction-themed simulation game.

title: Project Smile
description: Uncover the dark secrets of The Haven Institution in this psychological horror adventure. Under Dr. Evelyn Vane’s rule, patients endure twisted experiments in pursuit of “perfection.” Escape is uncertain. Compliance is expected. Eventually, you will find your smile too.

title: Tabletop Defense
description: Take out your toy box and shred your enemies to pieces.

title: Ectorider
description: Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ektos evil plan.

title: Noroi E: Nightmares
description: Noroi E: Nightmares is an auditory psychological survival horror game, where the true enemy isn't what you see… but what you hear.

title: Computer Shrilow
description: Computer Shrilow is a clicker game dedicated to being actually playable! you can speak to people, gamble, try on new clothes, mine in the mines, and much more! The game also has Minigames and Events, which trigger every once in awhile, keeps you on your toes! or. paws? Theres something more going on than meets the eye however, and the only way to find out? is to play it for yourself!

title: Darling, Darling... Dead?
description: Yandere x yandere x yandere: one must go. Yandere x yandere, a vampire-themed Visual Novel.

title: The House: A Maple Street Story
description: Explore a cursed house where a family was driven to madness by a dark presence. In The House: A Maple Street Story, uncover a terrifying mystery through enigmatic puzzles, an engaging narrative, and a psychological horror atmosphere that holds your every move captive.

title: Reus 2: Ice Age
description:
Fill the universe with even more life in Reus 2: Ice Age!
Re-create the prehistoric Ice Age with this brand new expansion, filled with biotica that have unique synergies with your worlds ecosystem.

New Biome - Ice Age Tundra

Variation of Aegir, the mighty Frost Giant

40+ new biotica, including apexes and cohorts

New archetypes like Evolve and Extinct, building around early biotica to empower future ones

title: Countryballs Conquest
description: Lead your country through the Victorian age, expand your empire as you go head to head with the great powers of the world.

title: Artificial Fashionista: Winter Collection
description: A set of 35+ new Winter-themed items for Foris to wear!

title: Neon Exploding Bread
description: NEON EXPLODING BREAD is a rhythm game where you sync your mouse to hit every glowing beat flying towards you!

title: Fiora
description: Fiora is a roguelike game in which you will see randomly generated maps, you need to fight shadows, and along the way collect firewood to maintain the flame of Fiora, without which you will not be able to use magic.

title: Kill Ze Bugs
description: Survive for as long as you can while shooting down hundreds of carnivorous insects! Kill ze bugs is a bullet heaven/survivor game in which your success depends on good aim, tactics and - most importantly - synergies between dozens of available augments.

title: Battlefield Pirates
description: Battlefield Pirates is a full conversion mod of Battlefield 1942. The general theme of the game is two rivaling clans, the Skull Clan and the Peglegs. These two pirate clans have been clashing at each other’s throats for years and over the course of time, they have evolved with new weaponry to kill one another. Brace yourself for a fun-filled adventure on the high seas!

title: Battlefield Pirates 2
description: Battlefield Pirates 2 is a full conversion mod for Battlefield 2. The game pits two rivaling crews, the Undead and the Peglegs, in a vicious battle for control of the Caribbean and all its booty. Brace yourself for a fun-filled adventure on the high seas!

title: Artificial Fashionista: Extra Collection
description: A set of 70+ fan-picked items for Foris to wear!

title: Artificial Fashionista: Spring Collection
description: A set of 35+ new Spring-themed items for Foris to wear!

title: Artificial Fashionista: Autumn Collection
description: A set of 35+ new Autumn-themed items for Foris to wear!

title: Stock Exchange Game
description: Stock Market Game Involving Trading on Commodity Exchanges for Beginner Traders

title: No Man's Sky: Voyagers
description: Create your own colossal, fully furnished, completely bespoke Corvette-class starship in No Man's Sky VOYAGERS - and invite your friends on board. Introducing habitable, multi-crew starships assembled from hundreds of ship modules, new multiplayer missions, a stunningly detailed new player suit, a ship-building community expedition - and more!

title: Velgrym
description: Velgrym Play as Chalara, trapped between life and death for past sins. Explore memory worlds where sinful souls wander. Uncover truths and choose: grant peace or send them back. Each choice shapes the story and reveals Chalara's own sin. Do sins come from soul or environment? You decide.

title: Ozawa-Ken
description: Ozawa-Ken is a typing-based fighting game. As you correctly type displayed characters or words, your character delivers attacks to opponents; mistakes or slow inputs leave you exposed to counterattacks. The game features three distinct modes: one-on-one typing battles, “Electric Chopping Kawara” practice for learning key positions, and the faster-paced “Electric Punching Board” with level progression and symbol inputs.

title: P1: Anchor Light
description:
Anchor Light is a first-person anomaly-hunting experience set within a lavish, mysterious lighthouse. In this unique game, light and shadow are your tools and your enemies. You'll need to observe every detail, as each room holds secrets waiting to be uncovered.

A wide spectrum of anomalies will test your perception and sanity. From subtle distortions that question your memory to deeply unsettling scenes, every moment is designed to linger, striking a balance between dread and awe. The finely-tuned gameplay ensures that each run feels fresh and compelling.

Key Features
Tense 'Red Light, Green Light' Mechanic: The music is your guide. When it stops, so should you. Any movement during a music cut can be your last, so freeze, listen, and pray that whatever is hunting you doesn't find you.

Floppy Disk Collectibles: Discover floppy disks scattered throughout the lighthouse to reveal fragments of the past. These memories from previous inhabitants offer crucial clues to the horrors you're facing.

Unlockable Difficulty Modes: Master the game in Normal and Hard modes, then face the ultimate challenge in Nightmare mode, where familiar layouts are twisted into new terrors.

Leaderboards and Endless Mode: Immortalize your fastest times on the leaderboards across all difficulty modes, or test your endurance in Endless mode to see how many floors you can clear without getting caught.

title: The Maverick Hunter Chronicles
description: The Maverick Hunter Chronicles is a short Mega Man X themed Doom Total Conversion made by SirOblivion, featuring a new story taking place alongside the plot of the first game in the X series, and a full set of custom sprites and textures.

title: Rising Odds
description: Participate in the Death Game "Rising Odds", a psychological horror visual novel, with dark and gore themes. Your choices will decide how this story ends!

title: 1Second
description: "1 Second" is a fast-reflex game where each command demands an instant decision. React in 1 second or face Game Over. Simple, insane, and addictive.

title: Reap: We Reap What Crawls
description: Co-op horror dungeon crawling X creature collection & farming! Descend into shifting dungeons, throw physics objects, and trap terrifying monsters! Imprison them in your decaying basement lair, farm and feed them cursed crops, then sell them to crazy buyers. R.E.P.O. meets Slime Rancher!

title: The Mind Snare
description: Unravel a deadly labyrinth, recover lost memories, and shape your convictions in this adventure where every choice matters. Can you face the truth?

title: Secret Paws: Cozy Apartments
description: Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is a game where you need to find all the hidden cats in the apartments. Open furniture, move objects, and uncover all the hiding spots. Are you ready to become the ultimate cat finder?

title: Love Letters
description: Help a shy and hesitant student gather the courage to speak to his crush by circling some fleeting letters.

title: Reaper's Awakening!
description: An RPG Game where you adventure to the underworld. Ascend the levels of The Void, and Defeat Grim Reapers, Demons, Gods, Angels, and More in this Action Packed RPG Video Game!

title: The Grass Reaper
description: Relaxing yet hellish. An active incremental/clicker with action, where almost every tile is destructible. Grab your scythe, command your minions and reap everything.

title: March of Giants
description: March of Giants is a Free-to-play 4v4 MOBA where you lead an army, not just a hero. Play as a towering Giant, rally hundreds of Soldiers, and deploy Battleworks that turn familiar lanes into shifting front lines.

title: Restore Your Island
description: Heal a scarred island, rebuild habitats, play with your dog, design your sanctuary, and relax by the fire. Turn this broken, trash-filled island into a thriving sanctuary — one clean sweep at a time.

title: Obnulenie
description: A dark retro-style Souls-like where defeating bosses brings more than victory — uncover hidden pleasures along the way. Fight deadly foes, explore a crumbling kingdom, and unlock explicit, animated NSFW scenes — all by choice.

title: Rivals in the Skies
description: Launch your Hyper Frame to liberate the sector from the iron grasp of the emperor! But beware: You aren't the only ace mecha pilot in this fight. The emperor's top pilots are holding the conquered zones, and they take their jobs personally.

title: Gerbil Mech Program
description: You're a graduate of the gerbil mech program, and you're stranded on a distant planet. Find the rescue ship. Shoot mushrooms, and collect their raw materials to process into resources for your mech. This was made for the MechaJamIII.

title: Alone in the Machine
description: Stranded, isolated, and running out of air. Can you survive long enough to repair your ship and make it off the island alive?

title: Grobnopolis: Last Days
description: You haven't been outside in quite a while. The sky was enveloped by a strange layer of clouds that's been blocking the sunlight for months. Something’s brewing in the air… and now it has found its way into your apartment.

title: Mecha's Negotiations
description: Hey, Commander, we need to strengthen the southern forefront. Our primary weapon are mechas, which were partialy stolen by our enemy, so we must destroy their outposts, so they can't research them.

title: World of Warcraft: Shadowlands - Chains of Domination
description:
Patch 9.1.0: Chains of Domination is the first content patch of Shadowlands, announced at BlizzConline on February 19, 2021.

It was pushed to the Public Test Realm on April 13, 2021 and went live in the Americas region on June 29, 2021.

title: Stormbroken
description: A Mecha Rescue Story was fully created in two weeks for MechaJam3

title: Frontline Steel
description: Amidst the endless war of 2 evil countries, Cyan and Magenta, you, a Cyan pilot, are given a mission to take over one of Magenta's city.

title: Assigned Mech At Birth
description: You are a prototype robot invented by a company known as Cyan Science INC. Unfortunately for them, you've escaped their facility and your goal is to run as far away as you can.

title: Astromech
description: In Astromech, you'll play as a salvage robot, or astromech, who must meet their salvage quota and still make a profit. Fly around the debris field and find every item on your salvage list, but remember to keep track of your fuel expenditures, space-gas is expensive, so you've gotta move fast!

title: Mech Top-Down Shooter Dating Sim
description: Made for mechjam iii

title: World of Warcraft: Shadowlands - Eternity's End
description: Patch 9.2.0: Eternity's End is the second content patch of Shadowlands, announced on 11 November 2021 and released on 22 February 2022. It introduces the Zereth Mortis zone, Sepulcher of the First Ones raid, and Zovaal's final chapter.

title: The Icarus Effect
description:
A small space adventure visual novel of mystery, horror, mech's and quirkiness.

You are a herald trying to find a candidate to pilot your Gaunt, a vastly advanced organic machine, designed for the sole purpose of bringing the curren war to a complete halt!

In the process you will get to know your pilot better and learn more about funny trivia and weird encounters.

But remember, there is always darkness lurking in the back.

title: World of Warcraft: Dragonflight - Embers of Neltharion
description: Patch 10.1.0: Embers of Neltharion is the first content patch of Dragonflight. It was released on 2 May 2023.

title: Mechtobacillus
description: Control a mecha vehicle in a stealth mission to pick a very important object from a highly secured facility! No weapons, no combat: just sneaky infiltration. Avoid surveillance and get everything done without being noticed!

title: Bactobot
description: Bactobot is a short game where you explore an infected island and clean it up!

title: Mecha Mining Marvelous Martian Minerals
description: It's yet another day mining minerals on Mars. Make sure your mech is ready to go, then open the mech bay door, climb into your mech, and set out collecting your daily requirement of minerals. Explore the martian landscape, locate minerals with your ore scanner and use your excavator to dig minerals out from under the ground. The environment can be treacherous, but you're a skilled mech pilot. After you collect your daily amount, make sure you get a good night's rest...

title: Hiromechia
description: 1st-Person Mech Prototype

title: Kill The Business
description: Kill the business remake puts you in the shoes of a man who must kill a businessman at each level. The levels become harder and harder and you will therefore have to redouble your efforts to beat them. It is possible to adjust your graphics, sound and keys to fully enjoy your gaming experience. Future updates will arrive for events like Halloween. And a speedrun page is open so that you can face other players in this game of speed and skill.

title: Mir
description: In a dying world ruled by ruthless automation, you are a rogue robot racing against time to collect energy and survive. MIR is a high-speed endless runner set in a dystopian sci-fi universe, where every second counts and the environment crumbles around you.

title: Can't Buy Me Love!
description:
November 1963, a turbulent time for the United Kingdom and the world itself. Four Mop Top lads from Liverpool, in their full digital glory, just waiting to make your acquaintance!

Lots of historical fun facts, era accurate sets and sprites, japes, blatant disrespect and MORE! Can YOU get all four endings?

title: Bling Bling Bankruptcy
description: A gambling game where you gamble to try and pay off your debts.

title: Everything Is Crab
description: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

title: Below the Crown
description: Explore the dungeons Below the Crown, in this love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players.

title: Come Out, Cat
description: The hidden cat is waiting for your words.

title: SushiCat: Bento
description: Sushi, cats, and endless combos! Dive into a unique blend of roguelike deckbuilding and strategic tile placement! Fresh, fun, and oh-so-tasty – SushiCat: Bento is here!

title: Vagabones
description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

title: Dungeons of Edera 2
description: Return to the land of Edera, where you play as a sword-for-hire, exploring environments, competing for contracts, and waging guerrilla warfare to become a legendary mercenary, alone or with friends.

title: Chaos Coin
description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Plan your turns to shove, evade, and attack your foes in tactical lane-based combat. Upgrade coins with new faces unique to every character to build complex combos. The forces of Chaos are coming…so use your heads (and tails)!

title: We Need an Army
description: We Need An Army is a fantasy roguelike grid based deck builder about recruiting a powerful army! Recruit units, match patterns, and upgrade your grid in this tactical roguelike slots-based deckbuilder.

title: Turning Manor
description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor.

title: Creature Kitchen
description: Befriend your local wildlife and feed them their favorite snacks in this cozy atmospheric cooking simulator! With a strange house to search and forest to explore, the witching hour has only begun.

title: App Empire Tycoon
description: Live the dream of an ambitious developer in App Empire Tycoon! Start small, crafting simple apps and tackling tricky clients. Grow your skills, attract investors, and expand your portfolio as you chase greatness. Can you build the ultimate tech empire and make history?

title: Couch Racers
description: Race, bet, and cause capybara-fueled chaos! One player streams, up to six join in, picking wacky vehicles, choosing race paces, and playing cards to boost, sabotage, or repair. Win gold, place bets, and chase championship glory in this wild party racing sim!

title: SCP: Experiments
description: EXPERIMENTS is a first person horror game about escaping a research facility while being hunted by a creature

title: Bit Lost
description: Bit Lost is a single-player atmospheric first-person game set inside a broken digital space. Explore fragments of consciousness to uncover what happened and find a way out. +You can now explore Bit Lost in a special split-screen co-op mode.

title: Beyond Silence
description: Beyond Silence is a first-person psychological horror where you play as James, a former surgeon who returns to the house of his past. The dark rooms, creaking floors, and forgotten notes hide the horrors he himself had a hand in. But the past won't let him go and it speaks to him through the silence

title: Mirror Match
description: Slide and match adorable cats across mirrored puzzle boards! Every move reflects on both sides—so think ahead to solve 50 clever levels. With cute animations, relaxing music, and brain-teasing challenges, Mirror Match is purr-fect for puzzle fans!

title: Alertes Spéciales
description:
Manage the French emergency services in a realistic and strategic simulation game.

In Special Alerts, you play as the emergency operations manager. Coordinate firefighters, ambulances, police, gendarmerie, civil security, and many more to respond to all situations: fires, accidents, health crises, natural disasters, etc.

title: Tetr.io: Season 2
description: The second ever season of Tetr.io included a revamp to the back to back system, implementing surge and all-spin mini to Tetra League, alongside multiple improvements to Tetra Channel.

title: Darkwing Duck R
description: Fan remake of Darkwing Duck NES, Black Cloak with Dandy.

title: Sakunaverse
description: An upcoming life simulation game about the VTuber Yuuki Sakuna.

title: How the Leopard Got His Spots
description:
Bring Rudyard Kipling's classic tale to life with animation, sounds, videos, games, and the music of South Africa.

More than a story, it's a engaging learning experience that lets you explore the people, animals, music, and art of Africa --or explore Kipling's life and writings.

Surprises appear just by clicking your mouse. Click the animals and watch them play a game of ring toss! Keep clicking to bring 15 beautifully illustrated pages to life.

Children at all reading levels can build their skills by listening to the story, reading along as Danny Glover narrates, or clicking on any word to hear it pronounced or defined through sound, video, photos, and animation.

Discover more just by clicking words in the story. You'll never know what you'll find!

Play four enriching, challenging games for hours of fun. You can play alone or with P.J. Rabbit. Choose the Traditional African stone game called Mancala, put together a puzzle, paint the animals with crazy camouflage, or match music.

From "Just So Stories" by Rudyard Kipling, author of "The Jungle Book" and winner of the Nobel Prize for Literature.

title: Garten of Banban: Last Ticket to the Abyss
description: Descend into the forgotten depths of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive sinister horrors and unravel dark secrets hidden in every corner. Uncover the truth behind the facility and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

title: Water Horse
description:
You are the Radioman, a crew member of a search and rescue ship dispatched to investigate naval disappearances in international waters. This is the first time you've ever seen a horse hundreds of mile at sea. You are also kind of stupid.

You are also the Viewer occupying the Radioman, psychic cross-examining the scuttling of naval cutter The Breaks in a retrospective scouring for any substantiative information whatsoever before the case is closed. You are kind of stupid as well.

You are both not very smart.

title: Assault on Hartblood Hotel
description:
Three assassins from an underground syndicate raise hell inside the Hartblood Hotel. Their mission: To huntdown the owner. Follow orders as given. Do not question authority.

A timer has been set for you to die over and over. Every 10 seconds, a new curse to bear. Don’t get sloppy now; it’s bad for the skin.

Kill everyone as fast as you can and avoid the burden of The Seal.

And may God have mercy on their souls.

title: Double Knoxels
description: A 1v1 party fighting game where players aim to slay each other by swapping between their two knights. Each knight not currently in use remains still, as a statue.

title: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive - Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition and Preorder Reward
[Deluxe Edition Special Benefits]
1) Game Edition
- Solo Leveling:ARISE OVERDRIVE
2) Deluxe Edition-exclusive Sung Jinwoo costume
- Sung Jinwoo: Overdrive
3) 1 Face Accessory for Sung Jinwoo
4) 2 New Hairstyles for Sung Jinwoo
5) Cha Hae-In Emoji Set (8 total)
- "Hello!", "Let's go!", "You're the best!", "I'm sorry!", "Thanks!", "Help!", "Run!", "Over here!"
6) Yaruru 'Predator Tank'
*A Yaruru is a cute ally character that helps hunters by picking up items and gathering resources for them.
7) 1 New Profile Card
8) 1 New Profile Frame
9) 1 New Icon
10) 1 New Profile Background
[Preorder Reward]
- Enjoy a 3-day head-start with Advanced Access!

title: Japanese Fun: J64
description: Learn Japanese kana & Kanji with fun games, achievements, and writing practice!

title: Stacks: Village!
description: Stacks: Village! is a base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, defend your village from enemies and explore dungeons.

title: Atomfall: The Red Strain
description: Continue the adventure of Atomfall with "The Red Strain” Story Expansion Pack, introducing a new location, enemies, quests, characters, items, weapons, and more.

title: Desktop Fishes
description: A cozy idle aquarium overlay that brings your desktop to life with pixel-art fish you can hatch, breed, and collect in thousands of genetic combinations. Dress them up with accessories, watch them grow from eggs to adults, and unlock playful upgrades through a quirky skill tree.

title: Attention Deficit: A story about ADHD
description: An abstract visual novel about a girl dealing with the challenges of having ADHD while trying to complete a school assignment before the deadline.

title: Backrooms Lost Runners
description: Backrooms: Lost Runners is a co-op survival horror game where teamwork, voice-reactive AI, and immersive puzzles merge. Explore unsettling liminal spaces, outsmart cunning entities, and dive into a deeply interactive story—remember, even your whispers can betray you.

title: Misspell
description: Misspell is a 2D atmospheric Metroidvania about magic and mysteries of the past. Uncover the secrets of an island risen from the ashes of a catastrophe and master a living vine that changes the way you fight and explore. Every step tells a story — every enemy echoes the mistakes of the past.

title: Central Bank
description: Take control of the most fearsome weapon known to mankind: the key interest rate. As head of the central bank, you wield the power to make (or break) nations. Raise it, and watch markets crumble and riots erupt. Lower it, and brace yourself for an economy so hot it could melt steel.

title: The Museum of Opportunity
description:
Learn all about "careers" and make a few friends along the way! This collection of murals will teach you to grab life by the collar and shout "PRODUCTIVITY" in its dirty face!

To view a mural, click outside of the dialogue window.

Created for Archive.org's DiscMaster Game Jam, April 20th-29th- all game assets except for text content were sourced from the DiscMaster CD-ROM archive.

May be buggy, just like life!

title: Dark Return
description: Immerse yourself in a dark journey filled with secrets and horror, as John returns home after receiving a mysterious letter from a family member stating that he must return home after traveling for treatment. Discover terrifying facts and uncover buried secrets in an exciting and fun experience.

title: Ultimate Pain
description: Ultimate Pain (UP) is wild, sock-blasting journey of non-stop jumping madness! We’re not sure if you’ll love it or scream in agony, but it’s packed with epic leaps, chaotic surprises, and gravity-defying pain. Get ready to jump UP, fall down, and laugh the whole way!

title: Plant Therapy: Tropical Dreams
description: Add the tropics to your life! The Plant Therapy Tropical Dreams DLC is bursting with lush tropical atmosphere, adding over 60 new items to the cozy plant collecting game Plant Therapy.

title: Plant Therapy: Park Place
description: Expand your views with Plant Therapy: Park Place, bringing three new apartments to the game, from the Upper West Side to Harlem, all with views of Central Park. Bonus feature: Birds Galore brings enchanted birdbaths that will attract magical birds to your apartment.

title: Planticulture
description: Planticulture: Another Garden Game is about using companion planting to grow your garden, collect plants, unlock decorations, and fill your journal. Play idle or active, chaotic or controlled, and make the space your own.

title: How Much Items: Plants
description: Game genre find hidden objects.

title: Sort Hexa Tiles
description: Sort the hexa tiles. Collect them in stacks of the same color. Use bonuses to help.

title: Sort Tiles
description: Sort a colored tiles. Collect them in stacks of the same color. Use bonuses to help.

title: Sort Items
description: Sort different objects. Put all the objects on the shelves. Clear all the shelves from things.

title: Pixel Dungeons
description: A turn-based pixel dungeon game where every move counts. Drop bombs, unlock doors, and outsmart enemies in short tactical levels. Easy to pick up, challenging to master. Play at your own pace with no time pressure.

title: The Next Stop
description:
The Next Stop is a narrative adventure about a murder full of contradictions, where the clues don't add up and everything hides something darker. It blends point & click mechanics with the depth of a visual novel, all set in a haunting subway filled with secrets.

Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

title: Ragdore
description: RAGDORE is a physics-driven sandbox where limbs fly, bones snap, and movement changes with every injury. Experiment with traps, crushers, trampolines, and more in colorful maps designed for creative destruction and dynamic ragdoll mayhem.

title: Remote Miner Co.
description: Casual low urgency mining platformer. Craft, Sell and Upgrade your way through the soil and defeat the enemies of the deep! But don't forget to relax. Play at your own pace.

title: BBQ Master
description: SIZZLE SIZZLE! CRACKLE! Let's barbecue!

title: Beautiful Defenders
description: Help the beautiful girls to immerse themselves in their memories and remember the wonderful moments of their lives. This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Dungeon Bodega Simulator
description: Dungeon Bodega Simulator is a retro styled fantasy shop game where you can grow crops, brew potions, sell items and raise slimes as pets! Can you build up your bodega into a one stop adventuring shop while solving the mysteries of the dungeon beneath you?

title: Tidy Toys
description: In Tidy Toys, even the mess has its charm. In this casual puzzle with a touch of kitchen creativity, your mission is to organize the ingredients—or rather, toys—into pots styled like gift boxes. The goal is to fit all the pieces onto the board and fulfill the demanding orders of the customers.

title: PolyRoyale
description: Jump, Land, Fight! Immerse yourself in the world of Battle Royale and Endless Deathmatch on diverse PolyRoyale maps. Whether you play solo, as a duo, or in a squad, you have a plethora of weapons at your disposal. However, in the end, only one can emerge as the victor!

title: Echoes of Seasons
description: In order to restore the fertility of your town's land, play the role of a reckless young man who, with Demeter's blessing, can change the seasons. Put your observation and logic skills to good use in this single-player 3D puzzle game!

title: Root: The Marauder Expansion
description:
The Marauder Expansion introduces two new factions to the Woodland: the Lord of the Hundreds and Keepers in Iron!

Two New Factions!
Lord of the Hundreds – Oppress the Woodland and burn it to the ground if need be. You suffer no dissent.
Keepers in Iron – Lead your exiled order of devout knights into battle to recover ancient relics. For glory!

New Tutorials!
Learn the ins-and-outs of our latest arrivals in new Faction Tutorials!

New Challenges!
Six new challenges with both Normal and Heroic modes test your strategic wiles!

New Achievements!
Eight new achievements push you to conquer the Woodland as never before!

title: Goblins With Guns
description: Goblins With Guns is a game where you fight in 4 player free for all battles as goblins who need to win in order to earn their freedom. There are several different maps, guns and perks that change the game and every battle is filled with bullet hell madness.

title: The Little Adventure
description: A brave dog from a distant planet embarks on a perilous journey through a beautiful yet dangerous world in search of an old friend. Face intense battles, explore breathtaking landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets in this action-packed adventure filled with heartwarming moments and deep connections.

title: Frostbite
description: You are being hunted by the Yeti. You must survive the cold of a dark, winter forest and keep the Yeti at bay by gathering wood to keep your fire from dying out.

title: A Ragdoll Rage Game
description: A Ragdoll Rage Game is a physics-based rage platformer where you grab, aim, and fling a ragdoll through challenging obstacles. The game also features secret badges, unlockable cosmetics, a built-in level editor, global leaderboards, and more.

title: Animals Memory: Monkeys
description: Animals Memory: Monkeys is a card game with images of various monkeys that will test your memory. The goal of the game is to find paired cards.

title: Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
description: To save the people of his village, He enters the Hammashan castle from which no one returns alive. But he sparks a war for the power of a civilization which the world believed has been annihilated.

title: Empire Game: Pixel Hero
description: A troop-clash strategy game. Choose your hero, command minions, crush enemy formations! Inspired by Heroes of Might & Magic and Hero's Hour. Multiple races with national styles like Huaxia and France. Random maps = unique fun every game! Endless development & combat!

title: Evil Superhero Simulator
description: You are a god. The only man in the sky. People are your toys. Violence is your religion. Choose from a multitude of SuperVillains, all inspired by your favorite Superheroes. Kill THOUSANDS of NPCs. A supervillain sandbox with endless possibilities.

title: Hexa Harmony
description: Hexa Harmony is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you slide and merge matching tiles on a hexagonal grid. Plan your moves carefully, clear the board, and chase high scores in this colorful, relaxing, and strategic brain teaser!

title: Go Cycling
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Cozycult
description: run a satirical cult from your phone in this cozy idle-roguelite. tap to grow followers, play small minigames, unlock apps, and automate everything. ascend for upgrades and keep the numbers climbing.

title: Laser Battle Cats: Travel & Destroy!
description: Tame kittens, develop your workshop, and experiment in the lab! Build a laser on your battle cat and destroy your enemies!

title: It: Unstoppable
description: A world dominated by slime, as time passes, they will gradually establish their own civilization, but at the same time, they will also face some crises. Different events will occur in different times, and you can intervene in these events and observe the results of all of them.

title: Frame Machina: OcularZero
description: Hardcore arcade survival shooter where you pilot a mech completely blind to the battlefield. Your only sight? The minimap. With relentless waves of enemies closing in, precise movement, and total awareness are your only chances at survival. How long can you survive?

title: Kittenship Care
description: Kittenship Care is a cozy life-sim where you nurture, train, and play with an adorable kitten while preparing it for adoption. Personalize and upgrade your space to create the ideal home in a relaxing sandbox full of warmth, whiskers, and feel-good feline fun.

title: Quiz Kingdom: Elementary Math Kids RPG
description: Learning math has never been this thrilling! Slash monsters while looking your best in stylish, badass outfits. Navigate labyrinths, defeat monsters, conquer mighty bosses — all while tackling 2nd-3rd grade math quizzes right in the heat of battle.

title: Side Hustle City
description: Explore the streets of Side Hustle City, a sandbox life-sim where every hustle counts. Build your wealth by trading assets, investing in businesses, and acquiring properties to create the lifestyle you've always dreamed of — from small beginnings to luxury living.

title: Astro Spider: Between Threads and Stars
description: Help a spider connect stars in this minimalist, relaxing puzzle game. Discover perfect paths through beautiful star patterns across 40 calm and clever levels.

title: BloodBasket
description: a community map jam by the blood discord channel

title: Gal, Geek and Summer
description: A lonely honor student, an outgoing gal, and me... an ordinary guy.More than friends, less than lovers, it's time to leave our youth behind.

title: Make it! Pancakes
description:
Get ready for a delicious pancake-making challenge!
Make tons of pancakes and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Yatzi 2
description: Dice games bring people together!

title: Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni
description: It is a forbidden place that must never be entered. Strange events encountered in the decadent school building. And a Japanese doll that begins to speak. There is something here. ......This is a Japanese horror game that reveals the abominable history hidden in an abandoned school.

title: Aphrodite's Bathhouse
description: Can you conquer the challenges of the maidens?

title: Mate in Eleven
description: Auto-chess. Position your units, and the engine plays for you. Last player standing wins.

title: World Wonders Hidden Histories 3
description: Explore world landmarks, search for hidden artifacts, solve mysteries and uncover forgotten stories of ancient civilizations.

title: The Curry Simulator
description: Mindlessly mixing curry. That's the best time. Curry will burn if you take your eyes off it for even a moment. Give it lots of love and keep stirring it slowly to prevent it from burning.

title: W.A.PU Space Orderty
description: The motto of W.A.PU Space Orderty is — running a business doesn't have to be a hassle or tiring! You've just opened an interstellar freight agency. Your daily task is simple: neatly stack all the packages to be delivered. Pick up your mouse and start with ease

title: Mythic Factor: Leaving the Labyrinth
description: Golf your way out of a monster-infested magical dungeon! Use enchanted powers to launch glowing crystals into portals while dodging traps, monsters, and each other. Up to 7 players can join the chaos—expect wild shots, accidental sabotage, and a lot of yelling.

title: Denrei Survivors
description: This is a survivor-style game. Fight off waves of enemies—middle-aged men turned into Denrei (electric spirits)—while choosing weapons and items to power up your own unique build. Dive into randomly generated dungeons and experience the addictive gameplay set in a one-of-a-kind world!

title: Sixyato
description: Sixyato is an action-puzzle game featuring numerous highly creative levels that put players' mind and skills to the test. Unlock these levels, gather information, help Sixyato to uncover the secrets of the symbol world

title: Operation Dimera
description: Operation Dimera is a co-op game for up to 3 players where you and your friends must save the world. Tackle diverse missions. Work together to solve puzzles that stand in your way and customize your weapons to be ready for anything! The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: Sudoku-Zen
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Triple Miracle
description: Juggle three boards at once in this innovative falling-block matching game. Activate your miracle and go for the high score! With soundtrack by shmup legend YASUSHI KAMINISHI.

title: Novice in the World
description: This game includes RPG content such as exploration, self building teams, battles, and growth, as well as multiplayer gameplay such as interacting with other players, forming guilds, and competing in battles.

title: Chrono Space 7
description: An isometric twin stick shooter where the player has only seven minutes to defeat the entity that is going to destroy the solar system. Level up, unlock new powers and win against the clock... and the cosmic dangers.

title: Mini Rugby: World Tour
description: Arcade style Rugby. Play as the top male and female teams in dynamic seasons complete with drills, friendlies and monthly tournaments. Manage fatigue and increasingly difficult opponents to climb the rankings and reach the coveted world number 1 position!

title: Big Giant Tanghulu: Tanghulu Legend
description: I want more Tanghulu! Stack more Tanghulu and unlock skins for the girl who loves sweets

title: Dubai Chocolate Simulator
description: An Arab man asks you to make Dubai chocolate. Box, race horses, complete obstacle courses, defeat enemies, and gather ingredients to craft the Dubai chocolate!

title: Xetter 2020
description: Collect all the dots to clear each of the 30 action-puzzle scenes. Dodge two types of enemies, drop blocks to crush them, and avoid being crushed yourself. Use limited lives wisely, restart levels when needed, and unlock cleared scenes for replay. Can you beat them all?

title: The Narcotic Operation
description: Step into the role of a shadowed undercover police officer in Dark Eyes, brave an area dominated by vice and crime, where allies and enemies blur. Every smirk, tear, and lie tightens the web of deceit—will you destroy the empire or lose yourself in its shadows?

title: Space Chess
description: Play Capture-the-King Raumschach, invented in 1907 and made more playable by futuristic visuals! Spread out cells and helpful highlighting maximize the player's ability to visualize the board. The game features public and private lobbies.

title: Number Place Cats
description: The number place (Sudoku) puzzle with cute cats that beginners can enjoy. There are total 900 puzzles. 100 puzzles of different difficulty levels. With erase function, undo function and hint function, you can challenge yourself to solve difficult puzzle.

title: Sweet Lyoria: Cozy Homes
description: Sweet Lyoria is a cozy pixel art life sim set in a magical snow-dusted village where you build your dream cottage, form meaningful bonds, and uncover a gentle, heartfelt mystery. Decorate, Work, and collect characters in our cozy game.

title: Vintage Pinball
description: Vintage Pinball is a retro pinball game with great sounds and stunning graphics.

title: Stretcher Together
description: Stretcher Together is a cooperative 3D platformer for two players. You play as medics rescuing a patient after a fall. Jump, balance, and climb your way up—but don’t drop the patient, or you’ll have to go back down to retrieve them!

title: Sudoku-X
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Sea Hotel: Fish Scales
description: Experience the laid‑back joy of fishing in **Sea Hotel: Fish Scales**! Run your very own floating houseboat, explore uniquely themed ocean zones, and fully customize both your vessel and your character. Climb aboard now and embark on a deep‑sea fishing adventure that's as stylish as it is relaxing!

title: Light-Strucked
description: Challenging and humorous fantasy RPG with turn-based battles. Based on the books about Tunuss.

title: Sudoku-9
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash
description: Prepare for a thrilling adventure where every decision counts. Construct your base, gather resources, and train unique troops to outsmart your opponents in tactical combat. Raid enemy villages for loot, forge alliances with other players, and expand your territory in a quest for ultimate dominance.

title: Anime Dream Match: Birds
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime birds.

title: Argonauts Agency: God of the Storm
description: Pelias, the wise mentor, joins forces with Jason and Medea to uncover the deeply hidden causes of divine wrath.

title: Cotton Plicker
description: Make yourself rich by growing a cotton farm in this short incremental game. Expand your farm, upgrade plants, and sell cottons to earn money!

title: Lost Flight: Survival
description: Find yourself stranded on a mysterious, uncharted island after a devastating plane crash. With no signs of rescue, your only goal is to survive

title: TechGuardian: Territory Defense
description: This is a sci-fi strategy game featuring a Defense Mode focused on tower defense and an Attack Mode focused on combat. The game includes over 30 different buildings and units, all of which can be upgraded through entry editing to enhance their performance and firepower.

title: Grow Harvest Repeat
description: Plant, grow, harvest, sell, upgrade tools, and craft. Level up skills to build your farming empire!

title: Walk the Plank
description: Walk the Plank is a next gen VR plank walking simulator set high up in New York City. Bring family and friends together for this intense intro to VR experience!

title: Bay: Zero
description: With many, many bossfights, this FPS PvE is extremely fast paced, and could be a great distraction from reality when you finish it!

title: Majoris Nightmare
description: A dark, story-rich puzzle adventure where every clue matters. Think carefully, read with attention, and make meaningful choices and be ready to act fast when danger strikes to uncover the truth and save your daughter.

title: Car Tuning Garage Simulator
description: Build your dream garage, customize every detail, and tune high-performance machines. Restore classics, fulfill client orders, and race your creations on streets and tracks. Car Tuning Simulator is your ultimate playground for creativity and car culture.

title: Click Adventure
description: Click Adventure is an exciting game where you click to increase your score. You can use the points you earn to buy boosters or unique skins. Compete with your friends and colleagues to see who has the highest score.

title: Hack & Po
description: Hack & Po is a 1v1 strategy card game with a 5-class RPS system. Draft your deck, predict your opponent, and battle using cards and timed consumables. Victory comes by outplaying your rival until their lantern fades or you gain a +10 life advantage.

title: Meaningless Suffering
description: Meaningless Suffering is a 2D platformer where you push a simple circle up an unforgiving mountain. But don't be fooled; the true battle isn't physical. It's psychological. Every fall chips away at your patience. Every restart tests your will. How far will you go in the face of failure?

title: Idle Pixels
description: A complex idle clicker game with infinite possibilities. Prestige, tiers, perks, bosses, different worlds, interest, bets and many more gameplay features are available!

title: Akolyte
description:
Akolyte is an unreleased action game for the Sega Dreamcast developed by Ionos. It was cancelled for unknown reasons and the studio closed.

A PC version is rumoured to have existed at one stage, but this too did not materialise.

title: Taxi Chaos 2
description: Taxi Chaos 2 is an arcade taxi driving game in a city ruled by AI taxi bots. As the last human taxi company, deliver extreme fares, adapt to an unpredictable city, and outdrive rival machines to take back control.

title: Burger Maker
description:
Burger Maker is a puzzle game in which you operate a machine to assemble hamburgers to match each customer's order, one after another.

Ingredients fall randomly onto 10 rotating turntables. Spin them to combine the right pieces in the right order — but it's not just about filling orders as they come in. Preparing stock in advance based on available ingredients is equally important. Use combos and chains wisely to keep your rating climbing.

As your restaurant's reputation grows, new menu items are unlocked, making things increasingly hectic. Can you reach the coveted 5-star rating?

Winner of the Grand Prize in the Indies category at the 8th CESA GAME AWARDS (2004).

title: Honkai: Nexus Anima
description: Honkai: Nexus Anima is a brand-new creature-collector adventure strategy game and the latest installment in the Honkai series. You’ll take on the role of a plane-hopping traveler who has escaped captivity, forging deep bonds with mysterious creatures in a new world, battling through thrilling encounters, and uncovering the truths buried within your past.

title: Untapped
description: "Untapped": A co-op cooking roguelite where every run is a fresh new challenge. Team up with friends to serve impatient customers, using cards to unlock new recipes and upgrades! Adapt and improve your kitchen on the fly as the challenge ramps up.

title: Dora: Rainforest Rescue
description: Are you ready for an interactive adventure with Dora and her amigos? Stop Swiper, fix the Duplicator and restore the Alebrije tree. ¡Vámonos! Let’s go!

title: Mostly Trash Sometimes Treasure
description: You've volunteered to clean a beach but the shore hides more than trash. Recycle the waste, upgrade your tools and discover the treasures.

title: Employee 925
description: Employee 925 is a short psychological horror game about compliance and the quiet erosion of self in the workplace.

title: Shidunzi Parkour
description: Ever looked at a humble street bollard and thought, "I want to be that"? Now you can! Dodge and crash your way through endless streets as a sentient stone bollard in this quirky, stress-relieving arcade game.

title: Astra Protocol Remake
description: Cassette futuristic space simulator

title: Mouse Required
description: Mouse Required is a web-playable puzzle game where you find and free your cursor friends.

title: Evilbane
description: Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

title: Tales of Bloomrise
description: Explore, farm, and fight in Tales of Bloomrise! Enjoy a relaxing village life with fishing and crafting, and test your skills in procedural dungeons. A pixel art world that grows with every update, blending cozy vibes with intense action combat.

title: Sokker
description: Sokker is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players! Kick by flicking the control stick! Play your friends in Versus mode, or try co-op in the World Cup!

title: Gnomeball
description: Gnomeball is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players, set in a charming miniature garden. Become a goal-scoring machine, pass like a maestro, and channel your inner Messi as you gracefully dribble past defenders!

title: Brain School
description: Brain School is chill card-based deduction game. A set of playing cards are shown face down: Solve the code by asking questions such as "What is the sum of the face cards?" or "Where are cards with the same value?" and unlock new items that will help solve increasingly harder rounds.

title: Rat Game
description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

title: Grail
description: In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

title: Orebits
description: Smash through alien rock with oversized mining gear, collect rare ores and uncover strange secrets. Orebits is a gritty sci-fi idle game full of mystery and metal.

title: Cow Online World
description: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

title: Digging Town
description:
Brace yourself, it is finally Digging Day! Every year, Digging Town organizes a big celebration named "Digging Day"!

On this day, all the people are asked to find a given number of objects by digging in the ground of the city.

Ready to take part of it?

title: Forkraith
description: You are trapped in the middle of urban labyrinth, and you have to exit ASAP! Examine the surrounding and find out if there are any anomalies or not. Can you choose the correct route and escape?

title: I am a Princess from Another World
Iftar for Two
description: Iftar for Two is a very short kinetic novel made for Ramadan game Jam 2024. It features two former friends who decide to have iftar together and talk about bits about this and that.

title: Jumping Jean
description:
Play as the blue-collared everyman in this retro-inspired sidescroller!

In Jumping Jean, you play as an everyday hero, a simple worker determined to save the day.

You're no superpowered plumber, and you're certainly not the heroic electrician of the kingdom, Jumping Jean!

You are a humble minion tasked with defending your homeland! You'll move left, right, and... actually, that's about it!

Can you survive an oncoming onslaught of dangerous electricians using nothing but your ability to move sideways?

title: KopiCat
description:
KopiCAT is a cat feeding simulator where stray cats will strut into your shelter as if they own the place. Feed them, and maybe they will leave you with gifts. Discover their quirks, win their favor, and maybe, JUST MAYBE, your shop will be allowed thrive.

The game was made by animal-loving folks at Twilight Foundry Games in a 4-day internal game jam. KopiCAT is a pilot project for the DevCares Initiative.

title: Siegeturtle
description: Upgrade your turtle, recruit cute animals, and blast through waves in an idle roguelite RPG. Swim farther each run, unlock new skills, and edge closer to home with every upgrade.

title: Liminal Skies
description: Welcome to Liminal: Skies, the opening chapter of a new creative universe. More than just town building, here you can design your own characters, bring them to life with dialogue, and craft entire worlds through play. With Liminal, creation is the game.

title: Basalt: The Cursed Vein
description: Basalt is a haunted roguelite match-3 mining adventure. Dig for precious ores, battle unsettling creatures, and rebuild a town of strange, whispering residents. The deeper you reach, the greater the rewards… though the villagers keep warning you - don't dig too deep!

title: RatScum
description: Fallen into the sewer, a lone rat embarks on the long journey of returning home in an estranged, crumbling apartment. Navigate forgotten corners and unfamiliar spaces, befriend unlikely allies, and slip through dangers and shadows in the cracks of a broken world.

title: Nourish
description: Nourish is a retro-styled 3D horror game about survival, responsibility, and the terrifying cost of failure.

title: Dove Days: Time Flies
description: Welcome to "DoveDays"! This is an engaging and compact casual puzzle game. Easy to use, simple to solve puzzles. We have combined the essence elements of various casual puzzle games. Without complicated operations, just open and play. It is both a stress-reliever and a brain-energizer.

title: Sushi Cat: Tower Defense
description: Battle back waves of rogue sushi in this cute-but-chaotic roguelite tower defense! Build, upgrade, and reshape the battlefield each run.

title: Xplorite
description: Xplorite is a hand-drawn 2d action-exploration metroidvania full of enemies and secrets. Get in Sy's shoes and explore the depths of planet Nargal in look for the missing research team. Travel through different biomes full of enemies and hazards and try to uncover what is happening on the planet.

title: Project Freefall
description: Grab your squad and dive into a frantic chase for the lone parachute as you play the ultimate game of tag at 10,000 feet! Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you skydive with your friends and try to survive the fall. Will you go on to victory or go splat? Free to play.

title: Echo Point Nova: Under the Clouds
description: Explore a massive new world with swimming and a day and night cycle.

title: Need for Seat
description: A fun kart(chair) racing game where you can drift in a chair, race through office hallways, and even use random power-ups.

title: Sanctuaries
description: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

title: Phantomware 0
description: It starts like any other late shift—quiet office, dull glow of the monitor, work dragging on. You think you’re alone. But then the screen flickers. A message pops up. Not from your team. Not from anyone you know. Suddenly the silence feels heavier. Something’s here. And it doesn’t want you to leave.

title: CTRacer
description:
The world's first MMO Racing game implemented in Full 3D.
It is a car game designed to make users enjoy it easily and quickly by introducing RPG elements in tuning up, trading, and exchanging vehicles and parts, focusing on free driving, various modes of battle events, and communities against the backdrop of Gangbuk, Gangnam, Busan, Shanghai, and Manhattan maps in Seoul.

title: Plinkidle
description: Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

title: Escape Protocol: Online
description: In this co-op horror game, escape an unknown realm where reality is shattered and dimensions collide. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly entities, and uncover the hidden saboteur.

title: Everspace 2: Galactic Edition
description:
This Bundle Contains:

EVERSPACE 2
Experience a 30 hour adventure in this fast-paced single-player spaceship shooter with exploration in space and on planets, tons of loot, RPG elements, mining, and crafting. Explore an exciting sci-fi story set in a vivid, handcrafted open world full of secrets, puzzles, and perils.

EVERSPACE 2: Titans
The Dreadnought and Leviathan have arrived in Cluster 34. Collect new weapon and gear sets by tackling massive repeatable challenges. Discover two exciting storylines alongside a cast of new and returning characters!

EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients
The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion containing a post-game storyline, exciting side quests, four new star systems, new weapons and gear, and the Wraith starfighter.

EVERSPACE 2: Supporter Pack
The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack opens up new cosmetic options for series megafans to customize ships. Contains more than 50 customizable additions including adjustable ship skins, decals, engine and thruster effects, and cybernetic glow lighting options.

title: Mr Wonder
description: Explore an abandoned creator’s studio in this dark psychological horror experience. Survive lethal traps and twisted challenges. Uncover hidden secrets and the truth behind Mr Wonder.

title: Noctiluca
description:
Noctiluca is the Spanish word in for the dinoflagellate, the luminescent plankton.
Illuminate, absorb and transform cells in 13 sweet and tricky levels.

A submission for the GMTK Jam 2024 with theme "Built to Scale".

title: Hexashell
description: Hexashell is a classic arcade style puzzle game with global high score leaderboards, colorful visuals and fast paced decision making. Progress through 15 levels of Arcade Mode to unlock additional game modes, custom color selections and a full original soundtrack!

title: Hollow Stories: Lockdown
description: A neo-retro survival horror noir game where you explore, solve puzzles, and fight to survive in a city ruled by corruption and cults.

title: Gladiatorum: Sacramentum
description: A deep management strategy sim blending political intrigue and character-driven narrative. Acquire and train gladiators with unique backstories and skills, manage your ludus from resources to staff, and navigate a world of political maneuvering and sabotage. Every choice leads to glory or ruin.

title: Solbrand
description: 2409. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and untangle a pseudo-historical knot of cosmic proportions: Why is the sun so loud?

title: PaperCars Tycoon
description: Papercars Tyccon is a small old school tycoon game about automobile. From a humble garage startup to a global automotive giant, your mission is to design cutting-edge vehicles, manage your factories and your staff in order to avoid bankruptcy.

title: One More Tower
description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

title: Untime
description: After an unfortunate incident, Circe moves from the big city to the small town of Dugo to start fresh. But maybe there are some things she can't change.

title: ChickOut!
description: Chickout is a co-op puzzle platformer for 2-6 players, playable locally or online! Team up as cute chicks, overcome obstacles, and enjoy chaotic fun together.

title: Luzhanqi
description: A modern, digital take on the classic Chinese abstract-strategy game Luzhanqi. Deploy your army, outmaneuver your opponent, and capture their flag in this turn-based war game. The battlefield waits for no one!

title: Junk Rise
description: Build your recycling empire from junk. Collect, process, and craft valuable products in a chill, satisfying simulator where garbage becomes gold.

title: Kill Code
description: Hunt the last remnants of humanity in a world shattered by war. Master brutal melee weapons, unleash powerful relics, and transform ORB your deadly robotic companion into the ultimate weapon of destruction.

title: Crush Point
description: Crush balls, dodge blades, and survive explosive chaos. A fast-paced arcade puzzle where every crush creates more challenges.

title: WordCross
description: Crosswords meet battle royale! Think fast, play smart, be the last one standing!

title: Shā Diāo Zhī Lù
description: A bizarre open-world action RPG by a Chinese independent studio, seemingly abandoned after some time in Early Access.

title: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection: Balloon Story
description: Inflate the balloon but don't blow it up.

title: Pyrotoad
description: Pyrotoad is an action platformer where you leap, shoot, and puzzle your way through 35 challenging stages. Harness flame powers, unlock new moves, and battle through diverse biomes in your quest to reclaim Pyrotoad’s stolen sunglasses!

title: Neuroxus
description: A third-person, mech-powered, fast-paced shooter with roguelite elements—Doom-like intensity in a lifeless machine-ruled world.

title: Der Räuber Hotzenplotz
description: "The Robber Hotzenplotz" is a faithful multimedia implementation of the children's book classic by Otfried Preußler. The game is very closely oriented to the original and transforms the book template into a fun and child-friendly adventure game. Various tricky tasks, puzzles and games are to be tackled.

title: Momo Pop
description: Momo is a bubbly witch who's travelling all around space to visit her emo girlfriend, Kiki. However, her task won't be so simple: Kiki's galaxy is all full of hazards that Momo must avoid.

title: Floramino
description: Floramino is a cozy roguelite puzzle game where you manage an ever-growing garden, hand out flowers to customers, and keep Springtime going.

title: TropicHell
description:
