description: "JustDig" is an incremental mining game. Dig ore through clicks and idle play, and thoroughly upgrade your drill. Combine modules to create your very own ultimate drill. When you complete your own unique build that creates perfect synergy, the ultimate satisfaction awaits you.

title: Louis
description: The Mouth is trying to take over Louis's place. Hold to rise and release to dive. Dodge obstacles, travelling from fruit to fruit, collecting seeds, buying clothes and battling almighty monsters to reclaim your home with style!

title: Boss Up
description: Boss Up is a love letter to videogame bosses, from infuriating RPG final bosses, to kart racing rivals, and even dating sim ex-wives. Fight your way through 18 bullet hell bosses with your powerful dodge roll, and try not to break your keyboard in half in this tough as nails action platformer!

title: Orbital Siege
description: A solo indie-developed pixelated 2D arcade space shoot-'em-up that captures the nostalgia and high-octane fun of beloved 80s and 90s arcade experiences.

title: Fire State
description: Experience hyper-realistic visuals and fluid controls from an unprecedented Bodycam perspective. The world's first shooter with truly playable 3DGS environments. Every pulse-pounding firefight and precise tactical move is captured by your chest-mounted camera for unmatched battlefield immersion.

title: Wonderstries
description: Harvest natural resources and build machines to rebuild society following a terrible war that left the world scarred.

title: Armed Animals RPG
description: Armed Animals RPG is a top down action RPG with an emphasis on highly reactive sandbox style tactical combat and complex health simulation systems. Make friends and enemies in a world of colorful animal characters!

title: Stair Tap
description: Tap your way through never-ending staircases, racing to the top before your time runs out!

title: Boll's Journey
description: Zoom through the landscape as Boll, a mysterious glowing sphere, uncovering a forgotten past and the truth behind the world they've landed in. Gather all sorts of collectibles, evading Shapes and Nature alike. Uncover the mysteries...

title: Curse of Woney
description: A Turn-Based RPG + Roguelike following a Familiar trying to free himself from a witch. Optimize your build, and sling spells until you're free.

title: Animal Smash
description: Animal Smash is a lighthearted game where you fling adorable animals at your own pace. Enjoy colorful farm-themed levels, master your aim, and have fun with charming critters in a playful, easygoing experience!

title: Ruins of The Titan
description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

title: Fly a Kite
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Prison Out
description: Prison Out is a game that uses 3D action and a physics engine to help you escape from a prison. It's up to you to use the powers you gain from the demon to escape from prison and defeat it in order to be restored to your original form, or to just run away.

title: Crap Game, Don’t Play
description: This is a true piece of junk. Every second you spend opening this game is a waste of your precious time. Your time is valuable—open your eyes and stay away from trash games.

title: Lord of Ogre
description: Lord of Ogre is a turn-based strategy game with action combat, where players manage their own attacks and defenses. It also features RPG, board game, and strategy elements for a unique victory quest.

title: Between Adventures Idle
description: An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.

title: As We Unite
description: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

title: Midnight Souls
description: Explore the mysteries of the small town of Camomile Peaks! Date the girl of your dreams, fight your enemies, and make socially acceptable friends in this dark humor-flavored RPG. And keep your cat, Charlie, out of trouble!

title: Paranormal Roulette
description: Descend into a haunted hotel casino where fate is twisted by a magical 8-ball. Shake it, interpret the signs, and place your bets as paranormal events guide your moves. Stack your chips, spin the roulette, and try to outwit the house in a game where intuition meets illusion.

title: Outbreak Zero
description: Outbreak Zero is a third person survival horror game that blends modernized gameplay, a gripping storyline, and AAA quality visuals to deliver a heart pounding, immersive experience. powered by Unreal Engine 5, The brave protagonist, Max, sets out to uncover the truth behind the mysterious story.

title: Roguebound Pirates
description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! In this action roguelike, your inventory IS your ship. Combine weapons to become absurdly powerful, search for epic treasures, and claim your place as a pirate legend!

title: Peggy's Post
description: As the new owner of a lighthouse-based post office, it's your role to sort mail, assign postage, and load parcels onto the correct delivery vehicle for shipping. Manage your earnings to upgrade your tools, purchase stamp packs, charter new ships, and above all else, pay off your loan in time -- or the lender *will* foreclose on your lighthouse.

title: Tiny Shop
description: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

title: Versalis
description: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

title: Dungeon Pizza
description: A cooking game with a fantasy twist! Knead the dough, spread the sauce, and prepare… the rat chunks?! Open your own pizzeria deep inside a dungeon, serving weary adventurers who come to rest and refuel between their quests and bounties.

title: Jumpbound
description: Jump and dash your way to the top in this challenging first-person platformer. Embark on an adventure through a mysterious world, unlock more mechanics as you progress, and make every jump count while enjoying the view and relaxing atmosphere.

title: IterativeCollapse
description: ITERATIVECOLLAPSE is a narrative-driven, surreal psychological game about emotional loops, intrusive thoughts, and the painful persistence of existing inside your own mind.

title: Casino Casualty
description:
Welcome to the Crimson Casino.

You are the owner and manager of the Crimson Casino, a place once popular for its advanced robotic entertainment and high-tech games; now, feared for it, following an incident in which patrons were brutally attacked by the robotic workers. This incident has forever tainted the Crimson Casino's name, and its doors are set to close for good at the end of the day. After seeing the last of your patrons out, you lock the doors, only to be struck in the back of the head.

You wake up around an hour later, surrounded by your robotic employees. You've been locked in, and you're being forced to earn your way out using the games that you rigged.

title: Burger Bots Inc.
description: An online co-op burger flipping game with scary and strange customers that you shouldn't anger. Play either solo or up to group of 8!

title: FNF: Spooky Mix
description:
IT'S SPOOKY MONTH!
Play as the spookiest kids around town, Skid and Pump, in spoOoOoOoOky remixes of ALL 26 songs from base game! Every level has been given a spooky fresh coat of paint in the spirit of Halloween.

title: Memoirium
description: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

title: Calamity: Wrath of the Gods
description: Calamity: Wrath of the Gods is an unofficial addon for the Calamity Mod that adds three interesting new bosses and a story-based character.

title: The Hordes of the Dead
description:
A quiet routine patrol in the middle of the night, becomes your worst living nightmare! Unknown sounds from the darkness start coming for you.

This is Survival Shooter, Horror game.

In the middle of the night, you are awakened by a strange sound. Something is coming...

You will have to face fast zombies that are deadly and agile, as well as slower, stronger zombies that can grab you, and tear your flesh.

title: Fungal Colony Sim 2
description: You awaken deep beneath the soil to the Sporemothers call. Gather Mushrooms and grow The Mycelial Network in this incremental adventure

title: Cube Cube 2
description: "Cube Cube 2" is an immersive 3D Rubik's Cube simulator featuring various popular cube types like the classic 3x3, Pyraminx, Mirror Cube, and Megaminx. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, enjoy fun and challenges tailored to all skill levels.

title: No Forgiveness
description: In this psychological horror, you are a guilt-ridden, drunken father who wakes in his dark room, alone. As you search for your missing family, reality twists, and madness takes hold. Something is watching, guiding you—will you uncover the truth, or become its victim?

title: Space Mantlet
description: Bite size colossal battle! Build an army in minutes as infantry upgrade with orbital drops into war machines! Then combine those machines to form the giant Mantlet mech! All while bullet hell rages! In a transhuman future, command Mantlet One to secure New Terra!

title: Jellyfish Blind Box
description: 【Jellyfish blind box】 is a light-hearted placement game where you can buy jellyfish blind boxes to raise your tiny jellyfish, sell them for a profit as they grow up over time, or leave them in the tank for admission.

title: HardDriverz
description: Burn rubber across futuristic cityscapes on twisting gravity defying tracks with customizable karts in this competitive arcade racer!

title: Ivan
description: Trapped in the middle of Siberia in an isolated laboratory, can you escape from the russian scientist Ivan before it's too late? Collect the keycards and escape before you meet your demise!

title: Deliver This!
description: DELIVER THIS! is a FAST-PACED-ACTION SHOOTER dropping you into a cyberpunk fusion of firepower and parkour-driven package delivery carnage! Dash, wall-run, and obliterate rogue drones to achieve perfect delivery efficiency or run it again. The city demands speed, DELIVER OR DIE!

title: Youmu's Cube Adventure
description: Youmu Konpaku has been turned into a cube! Help her escape by navigating her through 100 levels in this challenging physics-precision game inspired by the Ball Revamped flash game series! Also includes a lower-difficulty option for a less strict experience.

title: Marktopia
description: Run your own supermarket and keep your customers satisfied! Restock shelves, set product prices, and serve a growing crowd. Watch their reactions in real time — happy faces when pleased, angry ones when not. Can you meet demand and run a successful store?

title: Shotgun Science
description: Play as a test subject for a shotgun focused research company, while the tests keep coming the AI that overviews the testing seems to be getting aggressive.

title: Burned One
description: Visual novel «Burned One» - story that tells about a post-apocalyptic world in post-soviet decorations, and about its people. In the center of the story a stalker Voyla, who trying to find his wife, disappeared during the Cataclysm...

title: Matchuie
description: Matchuie is a fun and flexible match-three game with hundreds of levels and unique themes to explore. Play at your own pace, then get creative by turning any image into your own match-three masterpiece. Share your designs and discover what others have made!

title: 101 Cats in Chennai
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Chennai landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Bodyguard: Cellwars
description: Take control of the body’s defense system in this fast-paced action shooter. Step into the role of a powerful immune cell and use precise touch controls to target and eliminate waves of invading bacteria and viruses.

title: Purrrification
description: An innocent-looking platformer. Jump, collect, progress. But something feels off. Levels shift, sounds distort, the screen... reacts. This is more than just a game. How far are you willing to go?

title: Survive the Grid
description: Dodge deadly traps on a dynamic grid. Use power-ups to restore tiles, clone yourself, and survive the escalating chaos. Easy to learn, hard to master. Each run lasts under 5 minutes for quick, pure, high-intensity action

title: Goblin Adventure: Free From Lore
description: A short and absurd goblin RPG about portals, mushrooms, and post-ironic freedom. Challenge a mage obsessed with order, or just dance in the mud. It's your lore now.

title: Topzerah
description: A funny 2D bossfight game. While running, jumping and shooting, defeat 10 unique bosses, progress in the game and make your very own bossfights using the in-game boss creator!

title: Click Me Harder
description:
Click Me Harder is the ultimate anime girl clicker experience you didn’t know you needed — and probably shouldn’t admit to playing. Start with one lonely anime girl and a dream: to click her. Hard. For money.

Every click earns cash. Upgrade your clicks, automate your earnings with idle anime assistants, and snowball your empire into a full-blown waifu industrial complex.

title: Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!
description: A Germaphobe's Life-or-Death Cooking. The sheer terror... of touching raw ingredients. The kitchen— the most dangerous room in the house. And now, you're trapped in it. Forced to cook. Against your will.

title: Chicklet
description: Cute chick falls from the real world into a pixelated, multi-dimensional machine. Pull levers, solve unique puzzles, and guide it to freedom. Challenge your mind as you navigate the pages and help the chick escape!

title: Citadel Siege 2
description: Citadel Siege 2 is a tactical tower defense game where strategy, timing, and adaptation are the keys to survival.

title: OctoCraps
description: OctoCraps — the craps you never asked for! Roll eight-sided dice, place your bets, and try your luck in this fast, unpredictable twist on a casino classic.

title: Childhood's End
description: Childhood's End is a fan-made kriselle (the ship between the characters Kris and Noelle) visual novel based on Deltarune covering stories following the ending of that game's weird route as of Chapter 4. It was originally released in Korean, but has since received an English translation.

title: Fairytale Thief: Snow White
description: Stealing hearts and magic mirrors. Snow White reimagined as a vampire,

title: Cause to Exist
description: Cause to Exist is a Narrative First-person Combat Platformer set in the mindscape of Yuno. Traverse and fight your way through Yuno’s anxieties, fears, and insecurities in this corrupted and organic environment as you uncover her heartbreaking story.

title: Ardor 2
description: Ardor is a fast and lethal turn-based tactical card game. Play cards to dodge danger and kill enemies. Combat is simple but deep, with a high skill ceiling. Win fights to upgrade your deck and take on stronger foes.

title: Crimson Tower
description: A dark fantasy occult-themed puzzle game set in a rich and expansive universe. Featuring open-world exploration and intuition-based puzzles blended into the narrative and world itself. It is centered around a dark narrative of tragedy, love, and redemption.

title: Ichorless
description: Battle mighty gods, earn game-changing Blessings, and shape the fate of Greece through your choices in ICHORLESS — the RPG that lets you forge your own path and play your way!

title: Blackwood: Beneath the Silence
description: Search for a missing student in the long-abandoned Blackwood school. A narrative, exploration-driven psychological horror with environmental puzzles and choices that lead to multiple endings.

title: The Death of the Video Star
description: A visual novel about dealing with the aftermath of killing God, and maybe having to kill Her again.

title: Darn Guy Adventures
description: Darn Guy Adventures (AKA DGA) is a ~ 4 hour RPG adventure based around attempting to find news about a certain videogame

title: Guardian Realms TCG
description: Guardian Realms TCG is a cross-platform, fantasy-themed trading card game set in a realm of shifting alliances, rebellion, and magic. Players command powerful Guardians, along with Equipment, Effect, and Field Cards, to battle across three strategic lanes with the goal of destroying their opponent’s Stronghold. By defeating Outposts, players can disable lanes and control the flow of battle, adding layers of tactical depth.

title: Guardian Realms RPG
description:
Guardian Realms RPG is a story-driven fantasy role-playing game set in a war-torn world divided by rebellion, ancient magic, and shifting alliances. Players step into the role of Artha, a young Imperial captain caught in the collapse of the powerful Rythguard Empire, as the Carrowlands Rebellion rises to challenge its dominance.

The game blends classic turn-based combat with exploration, crafting, and side activities like farming, fishing, and cooking. Players can recruit a diverse cast of companions, each with their own quests and storylines, while customizing their party to face powerful enemies and uncover the truth behind the conflict.

title: FNF: From the Top!
description:
5 ORIGINAL SONGS.
Babybatter, I'm Scary Guye, BeRzErKeR, Soundcheck and the newest song in v5.0: HEIGHTS & FRIGHTS, an original song featuring a beautiful christmas tune with Girlfriend and THE (definitely real) Santa Claus!

Still hungry for more? Good news, there's plenty where that came from.

16 REMIXES.
Full remixes of Tutorial, Week 1, 2, 3, 4 and Week 5, with spicy new events and backdrops that revitalize original concepts and scrapped ideas!

Hopefully they invoke the same feeling of hype you got the first time you played them!

FULL LIP-SYNCING AND UNIQUE RATING-BASED POSES.
All playable characters have 36(!!) total animations that change depending on the note sung in the song, and your rating! Even the ones you don't play as still have a pretty impressive 12 different note sprites. (And don't worry nerds, the animations use animation atlases. ;3)

It'll either stroke your ego or spit in your face depending on your skill level.

title: Links
description: Challenge your Brain with this fun and smart puzzle game

title: Tentacle Wars
description: A 2D vertical-scrolling sci-fi shooter that combines classic arcade combat with adult-themed story progression, where enemy Valkyries are gradually converted into your exclusive co-pilots through resonance.

title: Black Shadow
description: Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game built with UE5. Players take on the role of investigator Eric Stone, who ventures into a dark-matter zone. You must explore warped timelines, sneak through the shadows, and evade unknown threats while gradually uncovering hidden secrets.

title: Calamity Black Dragon and the Princess of Lies
description:
This is the tale of a human princess who teaches a powerful and cold-hearted black dragon the meaning of "love".

In this world of swords and magic, the God of Creation had left behind a prophecy:
"This year, the dragon of darkness will capture the princess of the kingdom and perform a blood sacrifice in three years."

As the king's illegitimate daughter, you were chosen as the scapegoat, forced into the role of princess in this time of crisis.

For three years, the evil dragon and the human criminal live together. Will the princess be able to warm the dragon's heart and bring a ray of hope for herself?

Friendship, affection, important people. Danger, conflict, dragons and humans.

title: Gake-ppuchi Reijou wa Mukiryoku Akuma de Otome wo Sutetai
description:
The heroine, a young lady of a noble count's family, was panicking as she approached the age of marriage with no prospects in sight. To rebuild her family, which was on the verge of bankruptcy, she needed a wealthy partner. Yet, being very particular about looks, she insisted, "If I'm to marry, it must be the most handsome Christopher!" and couldn't bring herself to settle for anyone else.

However, her childhood friend Christopher, who was older and always smiling, never reacted to her advances. Frustrated, the heroine eventually hinted at marriage, only to receive a reply she hadn’t anticipated—

"I'm not fond of virgins. But you’re still one, right?"

A typical lady would have probably stormed off in outrage at such a remark, saying, "How rude!" Yet, the heroine's mind sparked in an unexpected direction.

"If I were to get rid of my virginity, would Christopher marry me!? And if I could get a few tips on lovemaking as well, I might become even more to his taste!"

Resolved, she didn’t ask a friend for help, nor did she hire a professional—instead, she earnestly summoned a demon.

After all, demons supposedly grant two wishes, and he seemed somewhat... experienced.

Thus begins the story of a slightly (?) eccentric desperate noble lady and an utterly unmotivated demon—a tale of painful, yet endearing days together.

title: Freight Manager
description: You are the manager of a rising freight company in this strategy-infused management sim. Choose the best cargo deals, plan your routes, and keep your fleet running smoothly — from fueling and repairs to tugboat rentals or sailing your own ships.

title: Row Away
description: Row your way through various river terrains, enjoy the journey through nature, and hopefully make it to the end of the river.

title: Operation Deadbolt
description:
The UAC's experiments with terraforming, teleportation and energy weapons had long been of interest to various rival companies, but they refused any cooperation offers due to the sensitive nature of their resarch. It was only a matter of time before someone wormed their way into their workforce to see how the UAC ticked.

One such rival is Yoshikatsu Heavy Industries, specializing ﻿in bionics, industrial machinery, aerospace research and pharmaceutics. You've worked for them for a while, and they selected you to try and sneak your way into the UAC by posing as a maintenance technician.

Surprisingly, you were able to get in without much issue - they weren't even fazed by you hanging around board meetings on occasion, nor did they notice you kept tabs on the factory floor whenever you passed by. You're sure they didn't even bother looking into misplaced schematics, because you did as told and shredded sensitive data. Of course, you took a good look at it first thanks to your cyber eyes.

﻿﻿

Things were going quite well until the facility you were at went into lockdown - no briefing, no coordination. Everyone quick enough to leave must have escaped, but everyone else? They're likely dead, given the place looked like a charnel house.

Except no one bothered informing the lowly pawns keeping the place running, which includes you.

With much more at stake than technical data, you retrieve the one weapon you ﻿brought along and decide it's time to bail.

Good luck, agent Ayumu.

title: Lumber and Plunder
description: An exploration-focused game set on a remote island said to hide a long-forgotten treasure. Scavenge resources, sell what you find, upgrade your gear, and carve your way through a mysterious forest. Uncover scattered clues, piece together a legend, and conquer the mountain- at your own pace.

title: Flowershop Master Yuukarin!
description: Yuuka Kazami is running a flower shop?! In [Flowershop Master Yuukarin!], Yuuka tries to run a flowr shop in Gensokyo, which has been suddenly dominated by foodie culture.

title: Gatestriders
description: The Kaijus has took over the galaxy, Join the Gatestriders to exterminate all of them.

title: Party Harvest
description: A farm management game where you grow crops, raise animals, fish, mine, cook, and take care of the townspeople alongside your friends.

title: Gravit
description: Manipulate gravity to reach the end of each stage in this first-person, physics-based, puzzle-platformer. The game includes a variety of hand-crafted levels and increasingly difficult challenges to put your problem-solving and navigational skills to the test.

title: Hidden Cats in Istanbul
description: Find hidden cats in the charming and historic city of Istanbul! Start with an uncolored scene and relax as you color the streets, explore landmarks, and meet special furry friends to collect unique cards. A cozy, family-friendly hidden object adventure full of charm and color!

title: Magnat
description: A classic rags-to-riches story. Seems straight-forward, doesn't it? But why does everything feel so suspicious? And yet so ... familiar?

title: Resident Fear 3: Ascension
description: Resident Fear 3 : Ascension is a thrilling story-driven horror adventure where three survivors fight through a world of infected chaos to stop the man behind it all. Dark secrets, intense action, and emotional twists await in this cinematic journey.

title: Empty World
description: Empty World offers an empty world to be in and the relaxing absence of input that comes with that. It is a minimal experience where you'll find only one thing at a time. See how many days you can survive.

title: Gravitrix
description: Gravitrix is an extreme-pogo-sticking 3D sports-platformer dressed in a comic-book art style meant for misfits and rebels looking to unleash their inner pogo spirit in a chaotic, high-flying world full of stunts.

title: Why Did You Leave Me Like This?
description: A cursed house, five toys, and a restless soul trapped in a lifeless android. Can you find her toys before Natalie finds you?

title: Sonic Rush Rerun
description:
Sonic Rush Rerun is a full fan reimagining of the Nintendo DS game “SONIC RUSH”. The idea behind this remake is to take the greatest strengths of the Sonic Rush trilogy (Rush, Rush Adventure, and Colors DS), crank them up to 11, and combine those strengths into the ultimate remake of Sonic Rush!

Boost through familiar zones with refined, low-poly, 2.5D visuals with newly implemented moves and tricks to really kick things into high gear! With the retuning Advance 2 launcher system and the Stomp and Air Boost from Colors DS, Sonic and Blaze can rush through these revamped stages faster than ever before!

title: Zahmahrel
description: As a YouTuber investigating supernatural events, explore the mysterious and terrifying happenings in an abandoned location. Your camera is your only ally, but can you uncover these dark secrets?

title: Shaolin vs. Wutang Legends
description: The continuation of the Shaolin vs Wutang series, this game is yet another indie love letter to martial arts and classic Kung Fu films. Designed for casual gaming fans, it's not aimed at hardcore fighting game players.

title: The Artifact Protocol
description: A psychological horror game where every artifact traps you in the final moments of someone's life. Face five distinct nightmares, each with its own monster, story, and theme. You're not solving the mystery… you're reliving it.

title: Age of Mechs
description: After Artificial Intelligence began to reproduce themselves and exist with their own will, a war between the humans and the new technology started. Most humans got eradicated and the machines were decimated too. The world itself continued as if nothing ever happened. Suddenly, in an abandoned factory used to produce those ancient machines, one of them awakes.

title: Mech in the City
description: With your little Robot you must destroy the nine Mechs, which occupied your City. But be aware, the Mechs can shoot like you.

title: Mecha Jump
description: A 2D Jump and Run game.

title: Death March
description: You are a prisoner placed into a mech thrown at enemy forces with your legs completely out of your control.

title: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Origins
description:
Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Origins is a free, open source fangame based on the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series, built for desktop computers.

In Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Origins, you control a team of Pokémon, and explore Guildmaster Island. Your goal is to reach the fabled summit, and earning the right to lead a guild yourself. Remeniscient of Sky Peak arc in Explorers of Sky, you will find many other teams with similar goals and stories. Befriend wild Pokémon with apricorns to add them to your team, and build an assembly of Pokémon worthy of reaching the top!

title: Musketeer
description: Psytronik Software are proud to present MUSKETEER, a stunning C64 debut release from the duo Ola Zandelin & Dennis Gustafsson. Taking inspiration from C64 classics like The Goonies, Bruce Lee & Zorro, Musketeer is an action-packed swashbuckling arcade adventure set in 17th century France!

title: Machine Child
description: Machine Child - a nurturing simulation lovingly crafted by renowned illustrator Ooyari Ashito! "Raise a daughter in a charming town! Nurture her through heartwarming moments & adventures. Her future is in your hands – will you guide her to happiness?

title: Chirax's Fortress
description: Play as a hydra in this classic-inspired 16-bit 2D platformer with Super-FX-style 3D visuals!

title: Hit the Fan
description: Following his escape from Down the Pipe, Turdesley had donned his flying goggles and is back in his latest and biggest adventure yet !

title: Crossover Clover
description: Second project of novamicus

title: Academy of Magic: A New Beginning
description: Play the fourth part of the popular match-3 series! Unlock twenty powerful upgrades to help Raymond in his quest! Experience a magical story told across five engaging chapters! Follow the twists and turns of a conflict for the ages!

title: The Final Flame
description:
A 2D Hack-and-Slash Action RPG with rogue-lite elements. Play as Zaf along with a variety of other characters to stop Altemis, a bored goddess from destroying the world.

Inside Altemis' tower are ever changing rooms, all with different enemies and use it to their advantage. Choose between 11 different characters with different abilities along with 2 characters to assist you in your fight to the top. Use your strengths, skills, and wits, equipped with Falucites to enhance your abilities and cast strong magic, to climb up Altemis' ever changing tower.

title: Mucho Texto
description: Corvache has been fired from his job, and now he will have to sort out the platforming challenges of his office through the use of his speech bubbles.

title: Cloak And Coin
description: Cloak And Coin offers 1-4 players the chaotic thrill of being thieves, just not particularly graceful ones. With a limited number of days to plan, finance and execute the greatest heist Marfit has ever seen.

title: Mnemocyne Complex
description: An atmospheric narrative where daily routine shatters and reality starts to twist. Explore mysterious places, make choices that shape the path, and uncover hidden secrets in a cycle of days that is never the same. Every decision pulls you closer to truth—or deeper into doubt.

title: Donkey Ball
description: A high-velocity, “Nanaca-like” where getting hit is the whole point. Launch the Donkey, Avoid obstacles, collect items and coins, perform game changing combos, and try to go as far as you can!

title: Operation Eventide: Dolorosa
description:
In a world where steel monsters called 'Aberrations' are Earth's enemy number one, 'Arbiters,' or as many call 'magical girls' boast strength where even nuclear weaponry fails. Humanity's beacon of hope lies in the center of a military facility where a skeleton crew of mad scientists work around the clock on whatever freak experiments suit their contractor's whims.

In the last resort to isolate and preserve the Arbiters' powers before its too late, secret agent Helena Slater is the only washed-up layabout for the job.

title: KunSpace
description: In an infinite-looping space, find the traces of the modifications made by kun and break them. You can safely leave by reaching the 2.5th level. There is also an endless mode available, allowing you to push beyond your own limits and see how many levels you can reach.

title: Berghotel Heist
description: Co-op horror game that takes place in the Austrian Alps. Your break into a hotel, searching for valuable treasures, but little did you know that Perchten and Krampus are already waiting for you.

title: Shin Era Tensei
description: A text-based Megami Tensei fangame that is part dungeon-crawler, part erotic sim game. Previously called eraMegaten (due to being made using the "eramaker" engine), it was first released in Japan on 2chan. An English translation is available.

title: Movies Tycoon: Dawn of Cinema
description: Relive the birth of Hollywood and redefine the silver screen in Dawn of Cinema, the first major expansion for Movies Tycoon. Take your studio back to where it all began from the roaring 1920s to the revolutionary 1970s and shape the history of cinema, one classic at a time.

title: Astral Planes
description: A rhythm game where you don’t just follow the beat—you create it. Collect sounds, improvise grooves, and evolve the soundtrack in a procedural music-driven world where every move is part of the song.

title: Bloodright
description: 2.5D Survival Horror, painted in four colors. Gather resources, craft what you need, and defend yourself against every shadow in a haunting minimalist world.

title: Ultima Nex
description: Become the master of the galaxy! Battle solo or team up with others in intense multiplayer fights. Conquer the galaxy across diverse modes and maps!

title: The Great Axe
description: The Great Axe is a Beat'em up in the style of medieval fantasy

title: Space Rocks in Space
description: Blast into the chaos of Space Rocks in Space, the ultimate 3D space flight adventure. Pilot customizable ships, explore stunning worlds, and battle through asteroid storms, UFO attacks and endless missiles barrages in this retro arcade odyssey.

title: Infestation on Epsilon 13
description: Collect the data disks, avoid enemies, and go for the high score.

title: Cinema Manager Simulator
description: Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, customize interiors, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience!

title: Digging the Forgotten Cave
description: Dig deep, unearth treasures. Upgrade your tools to uncover the secrets of the mystical caves. This is also an inner journey of relaxation, where your intuition can guide you closer to the mysteries.

title: Four Circles
description: A simple logical game where your goal is to correctly place four circles in their designated positions.

title: Super Serious Golf
description: Test your friendships and become the biggest menace on the course in this chaotic golf brawler. Compete through a series of minigames with 2-8 players and see who is the worst at Golf, and the best at causing mayhem.

title: Tenfold Tales
description: A cozy oldschool adventure where you explore a magical map, one tile at a time. Guide Lapin, a curious bunny girl, through a patchwork world of strange events, tough decisions, and stat-driven surprises.

title: Do Up
description: Do Up is a minimalist, troll-like 3D parkour game. Your goal? Finish in the shortest time possible.

title: Idle Gumball Machine
description: Short, sweet, and addictive incremental game. Shoot gumballs at gears and watch them bounce around.

title: Mariposa
description: Mariposa: Immerse yourself in strategic number management, rebuild civilization, excel in resource management, and shape a thriving society in this unique turn-based game!

title: Echoes of the Core
description: Echoes of the Core is a third person platformer set in the depths of the planet. Explore ancient forgotten civilizations, overcome levels filled with elemental traps, and uncover the secrets buried in the very core of the Earth. The echo of the past is calling... Will you answer?

title: Wyrdbonds
description: Travel across Therris in this MMO Creature Capture Monster Tamer game. Use your Arcaband and Wyrdtome to capture, summon and train Wyrds to use within the world to explore, battle and more all with your friends by your side. Will you rise to the top and become the best summoner in Therris?

title: Primordium: Eclipse
description: “The fate of this world rests on a girl’s decision.” From the mysterious Remnant Room emerges another realm, ruled by the Zaihaku (Glitch)—once human, now twisted into monsters by their sins. Strengthen your power to forge weapons at will, surpass your limits, and fight to reclaim your world.

title: Pinball Dream
description: Pinball Dream is an 80s arcade-style pinball and brick-breaker game. If you want to relax and relieve stress, this game is perfect for you. Get amazing power-ups, break all the blocks, and defeat the boss! Drop everything and play "Pinball Dream".

title: Desomnia
description: You participate in an experiment with your memory lost. You have to determine if you are dreaming or if you are back to reality. The only way to wake up from your dream is to take the given medicine and collapse. Complete the experiment successfully.

title: On Your Notebook
description: "On Your Notebook" is a tantalizing game in which you become one of the animal paintings trapped in a corner paper and survive from the other doodles that flood in.

title: Roxanne The Forgotten Path
description:
Roxanne: The Forgotten Path is a 2D metroidvania that combines exploration, deep narrative, and challenge.

Awaken as Max, a memoryless traveler trapped in a fragmented world. Face hostile creatures, solve ancient puzzles, and survive deadly traps as you recover fragments of your past. On Steam

Every death is a lesson, every victory brings you closer to the truth. Travel through vibrant environments, from deep jungles to forgotten caves and places where reality breaks down.

Will you dare to discover Roxanne's secrets and face what lies beyond the forgotten path?

title: Wall of Insanity 2
description: Wall of Insanity 2 once again plunges us into a grim and perilous world, lurking beyond the veil of dimensions — a world of isolation and decay. It is a nightmare from which there is no waking. In this third-person action game, you will uncover the story of a lost squad while confronting an unspeakable horror

title: Silvanis
description: A psychological thriller, story-driven experience. Venture into the mysterious forest to find your missing daughter; unsolved puzzles, a dark atmosphere filled with whispers, and unsettling sounds await you...

title: Subspace Voyage
description: Travel between bubbles deep in the ocean and gain a fortune.

title: Statecraft
description: Lead your nation, balance the interests of factions, manage the economy and diplomacy, and guide your country through crises to stay in power.

title: Penguino
description: In a world of cold decisions and sharp beaks, where every politician is a walking ideology, the fate of the nation is decided in a circle of the chosen. Welcome to Penguinocracy — a strategic political simulator where pressure isn't just a metaphor, it's a mechanic.

title: Drift Highway: Retro Console Edition
description: Race down an endless retro highway, weaving through traffic to the sound of liquid drum & bass. Breathe in the neon dusk, relax, and let the engine's roar blend with the music.

title: Greatest Angels
description: Take up the sword and escape from your old problems... Survive this abandoned asylum and you will bask in its answers... Confront entities that block your way, solve puzzles, and come to grips with your new reality in this Bite Sized Psychological Horror experience.

title: Dewdrop
description: A physics-based generative music sandbox where droplets collide with hand-drawn vines to create evolving, melodic soundscapes. Create music easily with no prior experience in a calming and ethereal atmosphere.

title: 100 Words
description: 100 Words is a simple puzzle game inspired by the classic hangman. Try to guess as many words in a row as possible before running out of lives!

title: Drive Thru
description: A fast paced time management cooking game where you run a drive thru. Manage your kitchen, be precise and serve your customers fast! Don't drop the food or burn the fries!

title: Mayoi Shopping Street
description: “Mayoi Shoutengai” is a first-person horror game where you must escape from a terrifying shopping district. You are the protagonist. Once you start, there's no turning back.

title: Unextinction
description: Stranded at sea and trapped on a dinosaur-infested island, uncover hidden secrets in a lost sci-fi bio lab while fighting to survive, escape, and outlast natures deadliest era.

title: Where's My Drink...?
description: The Krusty Krab gets a phone call from a customer ordering pizza, the first one to request such a thing in ages. SpongeBob and Squidward leave to deliver the pizza to the customer's house, but the delivery takes a very unexpected turn.

title: Grocery Run
description: Grocery Run is a fast-paced obstacle course game filled with cartoon action and comedy. Test your reflexes as you collect tasty treats and dodge hazardous obstacles. Race through the aisles and discover what lurks inside the mysterious Employees Only section - you know you've always wondered!

title: Good for Nothing
description: Good For Nothing is a cozy scavenger shop game where you explore dumpsters, storage units, and forgotten thrift stores to find hidden gems or total junk. Sell your finds, charm oddball customers, and turn garbage into gold, one questionable item at a time.

title: The Puzzler
description: The Puzzler is a first-person escape room style puzzle game where you must solve challenging puzzles using a unique spell-casting system.

title: Space Way: Echo of the Galaxy
description: In this retro space shooter you will have the opportunity to take control of a space fighter and crush waves of enemies. Show all your agility and reaction!

title: Tictactoe Sets
description: A tic-tac-toe collection game with multiple variants, buy it now and unlock more brain-opening modes!

title: Exo-Card Collector
description: Collect cards, sell extras for profit, and complete your card albums with ease.

title: Five Stars
description: You're on the run. The city is on lockdown. They won't stop until you're dead. Five Stars is a fast-paced PvE shooter set in a procedurally generated, fully destructible city. There's no end — just waves of escalating force. The more you kill, the harder they hit.

title: SingFever: Your Sing Game
description: SingFever: Your Voice, Your Stage! Turn every moment into a karaoke party with SingFever, the ultimate singing game! Featuring a massive song library, dynamic gameplay modes, and real-time scoring. Grab the mic, hit the notes, and let the fever take over! Sing Forever = Sing over 26000 Songs

title: Diamond Painting
description: A relaxing art game where you place colorful dots to complete diamond paintings—just like the real craft.

title: Capital Cities Trivia
description: See if you can name the capital city of every country in the world! Choose from the most popular geographical categories including Europe, North America, The 50 States, and World Capitals.

title: Pirate Chest Chess
description: A pirate themed chess puzzle game where strategically placing a limited number of pieces is key to breaking open all treasure chests and completing each level.

title: Goblin Clicker
description: A small clicker game about killing goblins! Includes various goblin types, mercenaries, upgrades, rebirth system and a secret feature.

title: Sad Virus Town
description: Sad virus is again back in this 3rd person walking simulation. Now virus is in town where he needs find beer bottles

title: Love Starts Again
description: A live-action romance adventure with high-definition images from a first-person perspective. A love drama begins with a friend, a childhood friend, a junior from high school, a senior at a part-time job, an influencer you like, and a student you saved from a delinquent...

title: Baduk Challenge
description: Take on exciting challenges and sharpen your skills by playing Go. Compete in tournaments, win prizes, and customize your own Go board with unique items!

title: Strange Day
description: Nick must solve various challenges within the events of the past. Can you solve these mysteries? Most people probably can't solve it. Play and journey into Nick's memories!

title: Rise of Transport
description: Enjoy the trill of vehicle simulation in this open-world transport RPG game.

title: Memory Showdown
description: Flip number cards to attack and outsmart your opponent in this memory-based turn-based battle! Use hidden item cards to gain the upper hand and secure victory!

title: Matchy Way Tales
description: A retro pixel-art sci-fi match-3 puzzle game where you swap and match tiny aliens to help them explore Earth and find their way back home through relaxing gameplay. It's fun, it's exciting, and it's a challenge!

title: Dungeon Raid: Zero Floor
description: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

title: Our Town Hero
description: Watch the seasons change as you restore a small town to it's former glory & rescue those who have been kidnapped by an ancient vampire, in this cozy retro RPG. Rebuild the town, save the day, and make friends along the way.

title: Whitematter
description: Shift your direction of gravity to the walls and the ceiling to overcome your obstacles in this first-person puzzler. Solve 40+ traversal puzzles that challenge your spatial reasoning skills. Take care, however, for not all is as it seems.

title: On My Way Out
description: On My Way Out is a heartwarming adventure game about a spinning top trying to watch the sunset with his friends. The problem - the front gate won't budge. Play as Culver, who will have to spin, jump and dive through the obstacles the neighborhood contains in order to find a way out.

title: Speedtickers
description:
SPEEDTICKERS is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer where every second counts. Inspired by the breakneck speed of Ultrakill and the tight movement mechanics of Celeste, your goal is simple: complete short, intense levels before the timer hits zero.
Push your reflexes to the limit across 90+ handcrafted levels, featuring original mechanics, tight controls, instant respawns, and a slick neo-futuristic pixel art style. Whether you're a casual player looking for quick challenges or a hardcore speedrunner aiming for hard yet simple games. SPEEDTICKERS delivers a satisfying loop of trial, mastery, and flow

title: Enchanted Valley: Fantasy Slide Puzzle
description: Enchanted Valley: Fantasy Slide Puzzle is a cozy, story-driven puzzle game set in a magical pixel art world. Solve 30 handcrafted sliding puzzles, unlock 3 extra game modes, and follow the journey of Valkyria, a young druid chosen to save her home.

title: Lane Drifter
description: A sci-fi arcade dodger where you pilot a ship through asteroid fields using precision, gravity bombs, and mining tools. With no weapons, survive by drifting, dodging, and scoring based on distance and hazards avoided. What else might be lurking in this galaxy?

title: Hampy's Great Adventure
description: Join Hampy in his quest to explore the Galaxy! Each level trickier than the last, and with each world, lie new mechanics to explore.

title: Parking Garage Anomaly
description: Explore a haunted parking garage in this first-person horror adventure. Uncover mysteries and anomalies as you progress through the floors. Reach the 10th floor to find out who or what has been haunting this place.

title: Rabbat
description: RABBAT is a physics-based, 2.5D platformer. Play as a small robot, using a jetpack and defeating enemies. Collect scrap to customize the robot's parts, listen to radio songs while you explore the diverse environments, meet other robots, defeat enemies, bosses, and two extra minigames to enjoy!

title: Theden
description: Escape to a paper paradise filled with colorful characters and noteworthy enemies! Shift between different classes and shuffle a stack of unique items to ream enemies, keep tabs on your friends, enter dungeons, and explore. Don't die, DYE, as you write your legend and rip The Engineer a new one!

title: Fluffy Party
description: Join the ultimate party game where you and your friends compete as fluffy creatures in wild mini-games! Jump, race, and outsmart your rivals in this chaotic, fun-filled world. Only the fluffiest will rise to the top — are you ready to party?

title: Echo Re:kill
description: You wake in an unfamiliar “Preparation Area”, surrounded by strangers. The system declares: “New mission, commencing immediately.” Mission after mission, where life and death hang in the balance. Only by earning points can you reclaim freedom. An adventure with no retreat—move forward or vanish.

title: Vacation Adventures: Cruise Director 9 - Grand Tour USA 2
description: A family friendly Hidden Object Game set onboard a luxury cruise ship

title: Space Memory: Artiodactyls
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable artiodactyls in space

title: Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats
description: Escape to a World of Tranquility with "Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats"!

title: Hotdangle
description: Hotdangle is a fast-paced hockey training game where real stickhandling meets virtual challenges. Dangle a real puck / ball across the floor, hit interactive targets, score points, and improve your stickhandling skills -- all in a fun, augmented reality-style experience.

title: Sex & Coffee
description: Play as a charming barista, brew magical coffee, and build spicy connections with quirky customers like a bunny cop, a demon writer, and a wild elf. Save your coffee shop and uncover love, secrets, and temptation!

title: Seleri's Lament
description: In the depths of the forest of Lovellia there is a girl, who calls herself a "witch", with a mission to deliver a mysterious letter to a detective "friend", but... it looks like it won't be as easy as she may have thought at first, one hardship after another will show up, thus she will have put forth her utmost effort to deliver the letter and complete her mission.

title: Desert Sky Rider
description: In this heart-pounding adventure, you must overcome ancient ruins, deadly traps and tricky obstacles to find the hidden treasure of Anubis. One wrong step could send you back to the start.

title: Tiny Whiny Island
description: Tiny Whiny Island is a short, cozy, open-world game where you explore scenic routes as the islands postman. Deliver letters, resolve local conflicts, and discover the heart of a tiny coastal community.

title: Consumption Line
description: "Consumption Line" is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.

title: Wild Wizards
description: Get WILD in this fun arena game! Filled with cute animals and arcane magic, choose your wizard and battle your friends to show everyone who the most powerful wizard is! Ranging from fire wands to poison wands, and explosions in between, join in on the fun in this WILD game!

title: Wanech's C.A.N.
description: Wanech's C.A.N. becomes a retro green pub serving brew, burgers, fries, and wings to synthwave beats. In this top-down cooking sim, prep meals by hitting W/A/S/D in sequence as orders rain down. Keep plates moving, customers smiling, and the pub buzzing!

title: No Sheep Left Behind
description: No Sheep Left Behind, is a simple and casual game where you embody a valiant sheepdog on a procedural journey to gather and protect a growing flock of sheep. Enjoy the chill atmosphere and all the sheep bleats while you try to beat your top score.

title: Backrooms Maze 2D
description: Backrooms Maze 2D is a tense survival maze game where you navigate shifting halls, evade relentless enemies, and race to the exit before your sanity drains away. Multiple difficulty levels, pixel art style, and eerie ambience keep you on edge every step of the way.

title: Super Clown Ultimatum
description: Super clown is back. Fight against Sorcerer and virus bosses and their army and try to find hidden stars

title: The Lost Song
description: The Lost Song is a visual novel about how an air force member Marina encounters a singing merman Zeru while cruising the island and how this brings enormous changes to her boring life. Become the heroine Marina and see things through her eyes, listen through her ears and make her own choices.

title: VR Lander: Lunar Edition
description: Take a giant leap as you pilot the iconic lunar module to a precision landing on a miniature moon landscape in this modern reimagining of a classic moon lander game.

title: Isekai Mystic World
description: Your wish has been granted, and now you are in another world. Isekai Mystic World is an action adventure game featuring exploration, farming, fishing, crafting, and building. Come explore solo or with your friends.

title: The Minister
description: A turn-based RPG. Play as a Confucian sage's disciple entering politics in a fictional world, striving to save a collapsing dynasty and its suffering people. Cultivate factions, plot schemes, and vie with rivals. Witness hardships, resist power's corruption, rise to power, and stabilize the realm.

title: Terror Call
description: Tamil gamers, this one's for you—with complete English support included. Terror Call blends horror, puzzles, and mystery into a chilling journey. Every step tests your courage, every clue leads to survival or death.

title: Make Watermelon
description: The game is based on the theme of watermelon. You only need to collide the same fruits to synthesize. Three special props: Hammer: One click, you can crush any kind of fruit; Bomb: You can eliminate two adjacent fruits at the same time; Color ball: can eliminate all fruits of the same color.

title: Hidden Pairs 3: Lovely Birds
description: Ready for a tranquil and engaging puzzle experience? Dive into Hidden Pairs 3: Lovely Birds!

title: A Ball Id
description: A simple game where you just dodge balls and pet cats. (The balls are strong enough to kick you out of the game.)

title: Second Works
description: Second Works is a 2D platform action-adventure game set in a sci-fi fantasy world based on biotechnology. Enjoy the unique atmosphere created by colorful anime-style graphics and the thrilling experience of high-difficulty action.

title: Taking My Dark Knight Girlfriend to the Corner Store
description: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!

title: Dark Slayer
description: You, an ordinary high school student, are suddenly pursued by dragon clans and saved by the dark mage Violet. Violet sees your pendant and believes you to be the reincarnation of the legendary hero Myers, taking you to another world.

title: Mi10
description: Prepare for chaos in MI10, a fast-paced, top-down roguelike shooter where every mission could be over in an instant. Every run is a brutal test of skill. Adapt, dodge, and acquire upgrades as you battle enemies in fast-paced combat. Every mistake is costly, every success is earned.

title: Hockey Legacy Manager 26
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional hockey team!

title: Football Legacy Manager 26
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional American football team!

title: Football Legacy Manager 25
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional American football team!

title: Micromancer
description: Oh no, you accidentally shrunk yourself and got trapped in a terrarium. Use your wizardly powers of SCALING to escape.

title: Crusaderman
description: You are the new crusader amongst the order of the almighty and must uphold the Almighty's teachings and serve out justice in his name! Will you be a paragon of justice, a punisher of the wicked, or will you use the power you wield to strike fear in the eyes of all? Looks like its gonna be quite the adventure for... Crusaderman!

title: Yakouga
description:
It is an orthodox shooter that uses shots and bombs to progress.
Collecting crystals released by enemies will power up your shots. There is no upper limit to the level of your shots, so the more you repeat, the stronger they will become.
You can accumulate bombs by hitting enemy bullets.
When you kill an enemy, it will explode with surrounding enemy bullets, and adjacent enemy bullets will detonate more and more.

title: Yuletide Legends: Frozen Hearts - Collector's Edition
Yakouga 2
description:
A side-scrolling shooter that uses acceleration and deceleration to progress.
It's quite difficult.

title: Sucky Safari
description: You are Gob. Fastest Tuba jockey in Neo New York. You are tasked to clean up an animal mess. Suck up those animals, shoot them into each other to daze them, and then swallow them whole to grow bigger and stronger.

title: Mirrors of Deception: The Poisoned Legacy
description: A quiet estate visit turns into a deadly investigation full of secrets, lies, and hidden clues.

title: Enchanted Solitaire 3: The Magic Web
description: Break the magical web and restore the forest by mastering mystical solitaire challenges.

title: Lonely Rover
description: A very small game about helping a lost lunar rover.

title: Delve Down Under
description: Delve Down Under is a bullet hell rogue-lite set in wartime Australia, 1941. Play as mutated Aussie heroes battling Nazi occult forces and Dreamtime horrors. Dodge, shoot, and slash through chaotic combat, collect powerful relics, and strategize your way through procedurally generated dungeon runs.

title: Intersecta
description: In a nutshell, Intersecta is an intense and intuitive tactical top-down shooter with a distinct arcade feel. It blends fast, twitch-based gameplay with the intelligent use of tactics. The game has a unique audio-visual style, utilising the power of Unreal Engine 5 for a stunning 2.5D experience.

title: Audiomech: Your Music Transformed
description: Your music paints the world, and controls the action. Each of the Mech’s three forms [Bass Knight, Vocal Gunship, and Treble Bomber] react to any audio, including streaming.

title: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Making Music
description: Strike up the band and march to the beat of your own automation. This playful yet powerful DLC introduces a brand-new musical system that lets you turn your factory into a fully orchestrated machine of rhythm and melody.

title: BeatHero
description: BeatHero blends rhythm puzzle, tower defense, and roguelite elements with energetic electronic music. Eliminate elemental tiles on a neon-lit 9x9 grid to unleash dazzling barrages against monster hordes. Randomized builds × pulsating synth tracks deliver an immersive disco-inspired battle experience

title: V-Monsters Forgotten Link
description:
V-Monsters Forgotten Link is a turn-based monster RPG with strategic 3v3 battles and evolutions that occur mid-combat, in a digital world on the brink of collapse.

Immerse yourself in Folklora, a system created to simulate a perfect life—until an experiment went wrong.

title: Astra Bestiary
description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

title: Yami Kids
description: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

title: Legacy of Pandora
description: Legacy of Pandora is a monster-taming roguelike inspired by Greek mythology. Play as Pyrrha, daughter of Pandora, on a journey to recapture the escaped evils, confront legendary heroes, and reshape your cursed family legacy.

title: Samurai Beat Demon
description: A Brotato-inspired roguelike for players short on time, diving straight into combat! Weapon positions unlock 62 unique abilities, each with a buff and debuff. Strategically mix and match based on battle and build for endless playstyles!

title: Beats of Un'sonia
description: Dive into a rhythmic combat game where every move counts! Adapt your playstyle, explore diverse biomes, face epic bosses, and push your score higher. Face the beat... and conquer it!

title: King's Beat
description: Survive obstacles on varying neon space boards that move in rhythm. Battle an onslaught of chess-inspired enemies moving on changing beats. Solve puzzles that make you control the beat. This mix of rhythm, chess, puzzle and endless runner will test your fingers, quick thinking and patience.

title: Cyber Cleaner Simulator
description: Vacuum space junk, polish derelict ships, and clear alien worlds of debris as you upgrade your high-tech cleaning gear.

title: Cyber Siege
description: Cyber Siege is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with pure gameplay. Play solo or in local co-op up to 4 players. Upgrade your character and weapons as you fight 100+ enemy types across 20 levels in 4 distinct worlds.

title: Dino Citadel
description: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

title: WinMon
description: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

title: Yakouga 3
description:
This is the story of Nokundi's childhood before they became a carefree and easy-going personality.
In order to rescue her mother who is held in the "Nightmare Prizon", Nokundi the crybaby ventures through a vast labyrinth filled with scary monsters and vicious traps.

title: Yakouga 4
description:
This is a game for people who like shooting, but can't make it to the end because they're not very good at it......
Sold alongside an "All-Ages Edition".

title: Yakouga 5
description:
In the Lirinalga region, surrounded by rugged mountains, there exists the "Lirinalga Diocese" under the jurisdiction of the Church. The Church and the demon country "Lilimar" have been fighting for a long time.
Each could match the other in strength, until the situation began to change due to the new anti-magic shell developed by the demons.
In the Lirinalga Diocese, in order to counter the new anti-magic armor, the "Resurrection of the Dragon" by the warrior chief Mizune is planned in secret.

The dragon, once sealed by the alchemist Enryone, was treated as something that should not be touched in the Church.
The Western Church sends an inspector to spy on Mizune's movements.
However, the real aim of the Western Church was elsewhere.

title: Kikai Shushi: MachinE SeeD
description:
The mechanical empire attacked from far beyond the universe With
their overwhelming mechanical power, the capitals of each country were reduced to ruins in the blink of an eye. In
just three months, humanity lost 30% of its total population.

Heavy electromagnetic computing device "Thunder Brain" composed of 5 million electromagnetic relays
Probability of mankind's survival in three years
0%
Humanity was
on the verge of extinction
But......
The result of simulating a reckless operation devised by Lieutenant Colonel Goma Degübe......

The probability
of survival of humanity in three years
0.017%
Humanity vs the Machine Empire.
The battle for the survival of the species begins now!

title: Yakouga 6
description: Takes place after Yakouga 5, but with no story relationship. Another gore-filled violent shmup from Akiragoya.

title: Yakouga 7
description:
It is an exploratory ARPG.
Simply collect moves, register them in the [Combo Slot], and hold down the [Combo Button] to perform continuous attacks.
In addition to combo moves, there is also a [Slam Move], where you can use the arrow keys + [Slam button] to attack such as launching and flapping.
After the launch move, you can hold ↑ to make a follow-up jump, make some cool aerial combos.

There aren't many elements like Yakouga 3 where you collect items and pave the way.
It feels like repeating the battle endlessly and increasing the attack rate of each map.

The story is completely independent and can be enjoyed without knowing the past works.

title: Mystery Trackers: Reflections of the Past - Collector's Edition
All Our Broken Parts
description:
Experience a story-driven adventure/VN game as a robot doctor.

In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories.

Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

title: Yakouga 8
description: An ARPG created for Comiket 95. Previously what is now Yakouga 9.

title: Synco Path: Automaton Prison
description: Trapped in a surreal prison cell, Avery Stardust, a rogue automaton, has only 17 days to enter his reset code and accept a new life as determined by the Stagnation Protocol. But when the mystery of the Synco Path program unravels, Avery will question everything he believes to be true.

title: Warped Universe
description:
A co-op meta-driven sci-fi looter shooter where every mission counts for all. Explore the unknown, defend facilities, upgrade your Echo, and empower the galaxy.

Choose your combat style before every mission: real-time action or turn-based tactics. Fight on the ground or in space, solo or with friends. Same mission, completely different experience depending on how you play.

Built by the team behind Jumpgate, Auto Assault, LEGO Universe, and Dragons & Titans.

title: Taisho Romance Theater
description: This is a dark and diverse romance visual novel set in 1920s Taishō-era Japan, where amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma is pulled into long-buried secrets after a friend's mysterious death. As he becomes entangled in magic, conspiracy, and haunting blood ties, his search leads him toward a darker truth.

title: Type Her to Sleep
description: Ever spelled out your thoughts to fall asleep? Well, here, you can! Type Her to Sleep is a lo-fi, cozy typing game about typing out thoughts for a good night's sleep. Experience cute aesthetics, chill music, and an overall comfy vibe.

title: Enfora Star
description: Enfora Star station is being overrun! Pilot your spacecraft and deploy defenses to survive droid swarms - but every purchase costs precious score points. Will you risk everything for maximum points or play it safe? Master the ultimate arcade challenge!

title: Cosmic Tails
description: Become the Cat Bounty Hunter. Blast off through deep space as you decimate hordes of space creatures with bounties on their heads. Upgrade unique cat-themed abilities, unlock pulverizing weapons, and survive until your contract expires -- or join the ranks of fallen bounty hunters before you.

title: Heroic Aegisio: Origins
description: A strategic multiplayer tower defense game where players build synergistic towers, trade resources, and coordinate with teammates to overcome challenging enemy waves.

title: Blackwood's Dilemma
description: Step into detective Brian Storm’s shoes and unravel a grim 17th-century mystery. Interrogate villagers, gather clues, and piece together the evidence in a deduction system where every secret matters.

title: Three Body Problem
description:
Three Body Problem is an arcade game about chase and elusion.

Two opponents will attempt to collide with you. They are inside your head. You will die, until you get inside theirs.

title: No Tithe for Olaf
description: A grimly humorous single-player tower defense roguelite set in 17th-century Norway. Defend your farm from the King’s tax collectors, build bizarre towers, and lead a farmer’s uprising as a goat-riding rebel! Upgrade your farm, manage resources, and weaponize onions in escalating rural chaos.

title: Store Life Simulator
description: Store Life Simulator is a simulation and management game where you start with a small grocery store and must expand it until you create a true business empire! Hire employees, manage your inventory, serve customers, and open new stores while facing the daily challenges of an entrepreneur.

title: Watch the Cornline VR
description: VR game about shooting scarecrows. Stop them before they get out of the field. Earn points, unlock maps and beat records. Try different modifications and break new records.

title: GravityMan
description: A 2.5D side-scrolling action game. Simple controls and gravity gimmicks. Use gravity abilities to overcome various gimmicks and clear stages.

title: Aphasie
description: Aphasie is an open-world immersive sim of action and stealth that puts you in the role of Mastema, the Angel of Cataclysms. Explore the dynamic environment of the city of Babel, use your powers, stealth, or a wide array of weapons and tools to bring down the tower.

title: Locally Sourced Anthology II: The Timeline
description: A collection of 5 experimental games from different indie devs that takes you on a journey through time!

title: Vault Survivors
description: Vault Survivors is a post-apocalyptic top-down roguelike shooter where you must survive 20 minutes against diverse enemies and bosses. Master dozens of weapons across different characters, then return to your vault to chat with your companions and upgrade your character between runs.

title: Blanky
description: Blanky tells the story of a young boy named Jacob, who is thrown into a nightmarish world, filled with his biggest fears. With the help of his Blanket, nicknamed "Blanky" Jacob unlocks new abilities in search of the courage needed to defeat the evils within his own mind.

title: Dacha
description: Immerse yourself in the peaceful atmosphere of a Russian summer cottage: take care of the vegetable garden and flower beds, pick ripe apples, cook fragrant compote, roast kebabs and enjoy nature.

title: Idle Rect
description: Complex idle clicker game with infinite possibilities. Prestige, evolving, limits breaking, perks, bosses, income options, ranking and many more features are available!

title: Orbital Purge
description: A fast-paced space shooter where you blast through waves of Martian invaders, upgrade your ship, dodge bullet hell, and wipe them out with devastating firepower.

title: Truck Parking World
description: Park your truck across 90 levels and 5 unique themes, each with escalating difficulty. Complete every challenge without collisions, unlock all stages, and prove your skills as the ultimate parking master in this realistic truck simulation.

title: Chair Debiti
description: A chairbuilder roguelike where flipping a chair is your only means of paying off your life's debt. Craft lucrative combos with your chair by simultaneously fishing, mining, playing blackjack, casting spells, manipulating stocks, and fighting monsters!

title: Feed the Greed
description: A short active incremental game. Send skeleton villagers with sacrificial offerings to a growing space rift. Feed the rift in exchange for essence, unlock different offerings and their upgrades - all for the sake of more essence.

title: Omega Point
description: A MIXTAPE AT THE END OF THE WORLD. A mech exploration game about listening into the last remaining radio stations of humanity.

title: ChessXpanse
description: ChessXpanse is a game that captures the intensity of chess and pits one player against another in the midst of battle. In ChessXpanse, a player faces varying front lines as the starting positions of each game board differ.

title: The Butterfly
description:
Leila is sick. You should help her.

THE BUTTERFLY is a short narrative-driven psychological horror game about insects and love. About 20-25 minutes of playtime.

title: Elohim Eternal II: Son of Man
description: Start a rebellion in this character-driven, science fantasy RPG. Collect guns with different abilities and perks. Ride a giant mecha in a rebellion against the corrupt Pleroman government. Inspired by Xenogears for the story and Shin Megami Tensei for fast-paced turn-based combat.

title: Champions of the Cosmos
description: Champions of the Cosmos is a retro sci-fi RTS inspired by 80's action figures, comics and movies. Play heroes with the power to reshape the landscape around them and other unique abilities to take over the cosmos and choose whichever side you sympathize with most - light or darkness.

title: Holy Hoop
description: Relax and shoot hoops on a heavenly basketball court. Perfect your aim and power to take full advantage of the point multiplier system. Basketball skins are rewarded every 3 hours. Buy, Sell or Trade all through Steam!

title: The Loop Below
description: Trapped in a looping, claustrophobic bunker, you must detect subtle anomalies before they consume you. Watch every shadow. Memorize every detail. No weapons. No escape. Just your scanner, your instincts — and the creeping dread that something is terribly wrong.

title: The Sacrilege
description: The Sacrilege is a 2D movie-game with interactive minigames to advance the film. The plot follows a newly pastor, starting over in the same town where his past vanished into darkness years ago. But that darkness never went away and... it is about to return.

title: Maze Infinite Puzzle
description: Find your flow in Maze Infinite Puzzle a cozy, endlessly replayable maze puzzle. Navigate procedurally generated levels with a gentle, reset-anytime difficulty, optional hints, and Top-Down/2.5D views. No timers or combat just relaxing play and Steam Achievements.

title: Coin Hoarder
description: Click, collect, and ascend! Coin Hoarder is an addictive idle/incremental game in the spirit of Cookie Clicker and other greats, with endless upgrades, ascensions, and achievements.

title: Ring Toss Water Game
description: Inspired by physical water ring toss games, a simple desktop companion to fidget with.

title: Hydra Heli
description: Hydra Heli is a short, relaxing incremental game about sinking battleships with an overpowered helicopter. Control a swarm of unstoppable torpedoes, annihilate armadas, collect shards, and utilize the Depot to boost damage, increase firepower, and unlock new regions.

title: Begin the Slaughter
description: A momentum based hack 'n slash with roguelike elements. Use wall-bouncing and slithering to pick up enough speed to slaughter your enemies

title: Proxy Project Ouroboros
description: A 3D local splitscreen reimagining of the snake game (can be played single player too), as an infinite wave based score attack where you have to eat different rogue critters who's AI changes depending on the current level event in the chosen map, with deep customization in both looks and gameplay.

title: Knight Brawler
description: Inspired by the masterpieces of the past, Knight Brawler is a nostalgic 2D platformer that combines thrilling action with vintage game play.

title: Slither Link Plus
description: SlitherLink Plus — Train your brain with daily logic puzzles. Use numbers to draw one continuous loop across square, hex, kite, and Cairo grids, each with unique logic. Hundreds of handcrafted levels + endless mode keep your reasoning sharp and your mind engaged.

title: Maniac Mind
description: A psychotic AI rules the land. Explore towns, brave dungeons, and travel to distant worlds in this authentic late-80s style CRPG. Uncover clues, gather strength, and find a way to end the Maniac Mind’s reign.

title: Ghost Code: Escape
description: Collect pets and explore 18 handcrafted levels as you uncover a small part of the world of Ghost Code.

title: Catch Sunlight Museum
description: High-class virtual museum where every piece of art is given the space and respect it deserves.

title: One Day of Romance
description: Based on the traditional "Memory Flip", you need to uncover the secret of the beauty by flipping over the cards and eliminating the same cards! If the two cards have the same pattern, they will be eliminated successfully; otherwise, they will be automatically covered.

title: Find Kittens 5: Magic Tree
description: Explore the amazing magical tree of life, finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: Rise to King Ortler
description: A turn-based game inspired by classic board games - featuring 8 unlockable maps, items, special tiles, a campaign, free play mode, and a name editor for your characters. Supports up to 4 players or AI in local multiplayer. Colorful, fun, and family-friendly.

title: Knight of Justice
description: A fantasy action game featuring real-time combat, party building, exploration, and strategic tower defense as you rise from outsider to hero in a world besieged by demons.

title: Lost in the World of Succubi
description: When the protagonist awakens, he finds himself in the "Succubus World" — a realm inhabited by succubi. Can he avoid their interference and safely escape back to his original world?

title: Delive' R Us
description: Delivery Driver Job simulator, that blends fast-paced gameplay with life management mechanics. Accept or decline jobs through your in-game phone, then hop on your moped to navigate the city streets, collect grocery items, and race to make timely deliveries.

title: The Barber Shop
description: Run your own little barbershop and see if you've got what it takes to keep the customers happy and the chairs full! Hire barbers, cut hair, earn tips, and upgrade your shop from a run-down room to a buzzing hotspot.

title: H.Z.T.
description: You are a Hazmat, built for underground labor and deadly experiments. When your control chip failed, you gained freedom. Now hunted by patrols and mutants, you must navigate decaying tunnels, scavenge to survive, and reach the surface to claim the freedom they swore you'd never have.

title: Paper Soccer
