description: Paper Soccer is an online turn-based strategy game. Take turns kicking the ball towards each others goal, but each kick draws a line which cannot be drawn again.

title: Idle Idle
description: Idle Idle is a soothing idle game focused on comfort, calm, and gentle progression. Earn zen, unlock unique items and relax in a peaceful digital space. No grinding, just presence, reflection, and low-pressure fun

title: Lily's Lil Video Shop!
description: The old Lily Flash Games are being recompiled for modern systems! In Lily's Lil Video help Lily learn to be the best worker at the Happy Video Store! Sort through VHS tapes, stock up the shelves, and pick up after messy customers. Strive for perfection every day so Lily can be the best employee!

title: Big Beautiful Van Derby Racing
description: Take your old van to the derby track and battle against other drivers in exciting and thrilling races. Battle for the win and customize your Big, BEAUTIFUL, Van to your preference with your own custom paint scheme.

title: Space Memory: Monsters
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool monsters in space

title: Path to Tamer Town
description: Travel from city to city collecting badges in these procedurally generated roguelite adventures. Catch and evolve your team of Mokitons, make tough choices, and fight using a unique real-time meets turn-based battle system – all leading up to the ultimate Stadium Showdown!

title: Space Memory: Chinchillas
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cute chinchillas in space

title: Space Memory: Dinosaurs
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool dinosaurs in space

title: Birdhouse
description: A short narrative-driven horror game made in RPGmaker featuring hand-drawn graphics and animated cutscenes. Players navigate the house and its backyard, interacting with the environment and collecting key items to progress the story.

title: Juvenate
description: Juvenate is a 2.5D platformer where players will journey across three distinct levels—each featuring unique environments, enemies, and mechanics.

title: Rogue Pong
description: Just a simple brick-breaker game with some rogue-like elements and a bit of random stuff (totally unrelated to the plot)

title: LootMage
description: LootMage is a bullet-hell action roguelite game set in a medieval fantasy world. As an adventurer in this realm, you must brave ever-changing dungeons, battle fierce enemies, collect treasures, and fight to survive.

title: Try to Drive
description: Become a true team in this unique co-op game for two! Take control of a single bike and overcome the toughest challenges to reach the peak. Jump, maneuver - Are you ready to prove you can conquer any height?

title: Bubbles!
description: Can you and a duck bath toy reach the peak of evolution? In this physics-based combination game featuring cute little sea creatures, merge bubbles together to create new life forms!

title: Honey Trap Escape: Family of Villains and the Cage
description: I found a book in my father's bookshelf......from this day, my life has changed. I was being chased by a bunch of maids and the four woman in charge of the mansion... Let's escape from the mansion!

title: Trigger Land
description: A chaotic third-person shooter where stereotypes come to life. Fight waves of rednecks, Karens, and more in this satirical, round-based shooter packed with dumb weapons, unpredictable AI, and over-the-top action.

title: Seema's Pogo
description: This game is a 3d-platformer, but instead of jumping by yourself you're using pogo, which was inspired by 3D Hopper tech demo for Nintendo 3DS. Select one of your favourite cat characters (including Neco-Arc!), try yourself on 25 levels in 5 different settings, and get ready to die. A lot.

title: Ghlobot Shift
description: Ghlobot Shift is a charming space adventure where glowing little Ghlobots journey across 7 unique universes to reclaim their stolen stars and rescue their queen from the Demon King. Explore 35 handcrafted levels and face off against 7 epic bosses in glowing, otherworldly environments.

title: Pocket Spouse
description: Choose From Eight Unique Spouses. Explore Your New Luxury Homestead And Farmland. Explore Your New Island Home. Complete With Guilds And A Castle. Explore The Deep Woods And Open Beaches. Seek The Hunters Guild And Their Fabled Bestiary. You Never Know What You might Find!

title: Yunhanzhi
description: Become a Three Kingdoms hero and embark on an action-packed adventure! In this top-down ARPG, take on quests, master powerful skills, and explore new lands. Grow through intense combat and carve your own legend. No loot, just pure skill-based gameplay. So lightweight, it runs on any computer!

title: You Picked the Wrong Castle
description: A cursed Goblin by the name of Apollo (you) has snuck into the castle to carry out a personal vendetta against the King of Topaz. In the process, Apollo is cursed and his power is rewinding. Outnumbered, out armed and slowly regressing, it looks like you picked the wrong castle.

title: Escape the Maze
description: Escape The Maze is a single-player escape game set in a mysterious maze. Solve intricate puzzles to find the only way out. With an engaging storyline, challenging puzzles, and a suspenseful atmosphere, it offers a unique gaming experience as you navigate your escape as a test subject.

title: Sinister Outbreak
description: Sinister Outbreak is an action-horror game where you wake up in a zombie-infested lab. With no memory and danger around every corner, fight to survive, uncover the truth, and escape the nightmare.

title: 7 Dice Destroyers
description: 7 Dice Destroyers is a collection of 10+ fast-paced mini-games and 2 game modes (at first version, more games and game-modes planed). Use it as a standalone or as a quirky replacement for dice in tabletop games. Inspired by the charm of classic flash titles.

title: Frontier Combat: Beginnings
description: A fantasy JRPG where you build combo chains in turn-based combat, and defend against your enemy's chains in real time!

title: The Underdog Tycoon
description: Forge your path from underdog to tycoon in this challenging business sim! Master character development, manage diverse businesses, and navigate a realistic market. A world of opportunity, both authentic and fun, awaits you!

title: Frosten: Two Realms
description: Frosten: Two Realms — An immersive story about a young man named Ivan, who possesses the extraordinary ability to freeze objects. His life takes a dramatic turn when he finds himself in a mysterious world brimming with magic and peril.

title: Echoes of the Wind
description: After a fight with her fiancé, Naomi Lee goes camping on her usual trail to clear her mind. But the woods hold more than memories—something sinister is waiting in the dark.

title: Faction Reticent
description: A "whimsical fantasy" action platformer game with an open-ended progression. Utilize the given abilities to you to its fullest potential, and look epic while doing it.

title: Life's a Beach
description: explore a deep and endless ocean instead of fighting your enemies. a 5 mile plus world awaits. have you ever? You know what I've always wondered about porcupine sex. They have all those quills and poison. It just seems dangerous to me and yet ive never heard of any

title: Planetris
description: A challenging Suika-like with no ground and an end

title: AirLoveEngine
description: A liminal, atmospheric game set in a dream emulator known as the AirLoveEngine, where people go to escape reality.

title: Card Artisan
description: Card Artisan is a card battler with RPG and roguelike elements and an emphasis in random generation that allows you to not only create your own deck but also create and use your own custom cards!

title: Defense X
description: Build a defense strategy to protect the peace.

title: Urban Undergrounds
description: A first-person horror game where you explore an abandoned bunker, avoid deadly threats, and search for your missing friend in a chilling story.

title: Psi Masquerade Deadly Wonderland
description: Online PvP action and roguelike multiplayer combat. Battle with random abilities in PSI Masquerade, bring gear and allies into Transrealm Masquerade, or explore the roguelike Deadly Wonderland, playable both online and offline.

title: 250ms2
description: 250ms2 is a platform game that tests the player's reaction speed. The name '250ms' refers to the average human reaction time. Players progress through stages by quickly defeating various enemies.

title: Anime Dream Match: Predators
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool anime predators.

title: Iron Dusk Path of Honor
description: A 2D/3D hybrid medieval action-adventure game where you fight, block, and outwit enemies in real-time combat while navigating arenas, pirate towns, and cult strongholds on a quest to reclaim your honor.

title: Checked Out
description: Checked Out is a casual action game where you race against the clock as a mischievous shopping cart - collect groceries, dodge damage fees, and wreak comedic havoc in physics-based challenges.

title: Dawn After Dusk
description: Asylum simulator. An interactive fiction about schizophrenia and finding meaning after near-death, with Disco Elysium-style mechanics.

title: Đồng CỎ Lau: The Reed Field
description: An exploratory and non-linear adventure game, where each player's experience may differ to some extent and requires careful investigation to reach the best ending (the game's length depends on the ending you fall into). The worst ending will cause the game to end the earliest

title: Mega Fruit
description: Time to combine the fruits! Some say Hell mode is too dangerous and should be avoided. Or will you stay away from the action and become the town's beloved merchant? Choose now!

title: Edevreal's Theater: The Final Show
description: Edevreal's Theater: The Final Show is a survival horror RPG with real-time combat. You must try to survive while exploring the hostile and strange theater of Edevreal to unravel all the dark mysteries it hides.

title: Buscabit: A Treasure Hunter Adventure
description: Find all the treasures waiting for you in the cubic world of Buscabit and become the king of metal detecting.

title: Catto Boi Collection
description: Play as Catto Boi, a small, cute cat who slowly begins to realise that the world he lives in is more sick and twisted than it seems to be on the surface. The choices you make will matter in the end... right?

title: Journey Card
description: The Myth: Wukong - Unfamiliar with or want to revisit the classic tale? Play

title: The First Nightmare
description: John will embark on a dangerous adventure, in search of his mother in the place he once called home and is now a terrifying place with a bloodthirsty enemy, he will have to discover the signs that will lead him to wake up from this nightmare, will he find his mother?

title: Save the Earth or Not
description: A top-down shooter roguelite in space. Defeat enemies to collect six 'Color Stones' and use them as weapons. Use leftovers to buy upgrades from cat merchants and unleash skills to escape crises. Even in death, permanently upgrade your ship to challenge powerful bosses and save the Earth.

title: Awss
description: Immerse yourself in a first-person shooter where Low-poly cartoonish visuals clash with a sinister, gloomy atmosphere. Armed with a massive arsenal of weapons, you'll blast through hordes of Enemies, infiltrate a sinister lab, and fight your way to the escape point.

title: Hot Swap Rave
description:
Hot Swap Rave: a Village Discotheque Simulator is a musical game set in the mid nineties in a post-soviet village of Pupkovka. At his first shift as a DJ at a rusting culture house, our protagonist Pyotr finds himself in an unprecedented situation, which eventually puts the fate of the entire village on his shoulders. Will he survive this ordeal? It is for the player to find out.

Pyotr has to host 4 discotheques at once by switching between cassettes, CDs and vinyls. On this journey his guide is Borysych - an old culture house manager speaking to our protagonist via an intercom. Because all parties happen at once, Pyotr has very little time to switch between discs in order to accommodate all the crowds. That time becomes shorter the longer the night lasts.

title: Anime Dream Match: Cats
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime cats.

title: Anime Dream Match: Girls 2
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime girls.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Patrick
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Patrick is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming St.Patrick Day-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a festive holiday world.

title: Mazzle Halloween
description: Mazzle Halloween is a straightforward yet surprisingly challenging celebration of the simple beauty of mazes and jigsaw puzzles in a Halloween style.

title: Grafi 4
description: GraFi 4 - casual, colorful,minimalist, physical puzzle with traps and changing gravity.

title: The Winter Mind
description: This is a psychological horror in which we play as a girl who has psychological health problems, and her mother has sent her to the store. Our task is to help her buy groceries.

title: Journey to Dawn
description: This game is a classic 2D action-adventure game where you can choose from four unique heroes. The game features five major levels, over 100 different enemies, and RPG elements, with each hero having three independent skills. It offers an immersive combat experience!

title: Rabidja's Revenge
description: In this retro inspired platformer, you play as Rabidja, the famous rabbit ninja. Travel through 20 levels including forests, seashores, underwater depths, gloomy caves, fly in the sky and explores the dark castle of the sinister Professor to get back your 12 golden pieces.

title: S.O.V.A.
description: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history. What happens when the AI finds a way to survive?

title: The Amazing Digital Circus: Lost Demo
description:
Step right into the circus!

This is a small fan experiment inspired by The Amazing Digital Circus. You play as Pomni and step out into the circus halls. Along the way you’ll meet the cast, take on little tasks, and explore a colorful world that feels both playful and unsettling.

title: Roads to the Red Night
description:
“Roads to the Red Night” is the story of Beckett, a jazz singer and sex worker surviving in the North African fictional city of Khandra under European colonialism. Set in the 1950s, the novel is inspired by the writings of the beat generation, a group of mostly gay authors that revolutionized American literature back in the 50s and 60s, particularly the works of William S. Burroughs, who spent years of his life in Tangiers. Like him, Beckett is a junkie, hooked on a terrible drug called Moloch.

The mechanics are simple: the protagonist can use the drug for short term benefits in his rolls, but the long term consequences of its use can bring problems in the future. Beckett is a messed up anti-hero, but deep down he has a good heart, can you balance his addiction with his chances for redemption?

“Roads to the Red Night” is not a dating sim, but it does have some plot relevant NSFW scenes that are completely optional. The plot is driven by political intrigue and sci fi body horror influenced by the works of artists like David Cronenberg or Ken Russell.

title: New Times
description: You are a rebel in the citadel about to become a stalker, until the citadel collapsed. After you broke free, you need to escape the citadel, and then escape City 17!

title: Coastal Postal
description: Soar across the sunlit Archipelago in your trusty delivery seaplane. Explore diverse islands, meet charming locals, and deliver packages by sea and sky in this short cozy adventure.

title: Gallery of Night Order
description: Climb to the top of the spire in 'Gallery of Night Order', a classic 2D action game focused on boss battles. Master a variety of actions like sword attacks, dodging, and parrying to defeat diverse bosses. Dive into mysterious painted worlds with charming pixel art characters.

title: Fluffy Escape: Cryptic Cube
description: Fluffy Escape: Cryptic Cube is an escape room-style game where each room holds clues, puzzles, and strange mechanisms! Doors are already open, spaces overlap, and the cube itself seems to bend in ways it shouldn’t. Strange? Absolutely!

title: Gladston Valley
description:
Two friends reunite amidst a disturbing string of murders in the small town of Gladston Valley. The crime scenes are gruesome, leading many of the townspeople to believe a monster lives in the valley.

Torches and pitchforks are drawn as the bloodshed feeds into a growing unrest. At the precipice of disaster, only Leo knows what is truly going on.

title: Reader Rabbit: I Can Read With Phonics
description: Reader Rabbit: I Can Read With Phonics (stylized as Reader Rabbit: I Can Read! With Phonics) is a 2-in-1 CD compilation released in 2000 by The Learning Company. The compilation features the games Reader Rabbit Reading Adventures Ages 6–9 (titled "Road to Imagination") and Reader Rabbit's Reading 2 (titled "Wordville Station").

title: 3 Nights of Terror
description: 3 Nights of Terror lets you dive into the Nightmare-driven Dreams of Police Officer Scott Harris, who suffers from an extreme form of Parasomnia. Guide him through his horrifying dreams and survive the Nightmares to ensure he wakes up in the morning.

title: JumpStart Study Helpers Math Booster
description: JumpStart Study Helpers Math Booster is a JumpStart game released in 2003. It is geared to 1st - 5th Grades and intended to assist in practicing math problems. It is a sister game to JumpStart Study Helpers Spelling Bee.

title: Cellscape
description: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

title: Yakouga 9
description: Originally Yakouga 8, this game was finished and bundled alongside the demo for Shuuen no Archetype. Split into two playable characters, Miyumi and Nokundhi. A third character is planned.

title: Claim the Forest
description: When Wolves Meet Capybaras

title: Aaero2: Black Razor Edition
description:
Black Razor Edition brings new music, bigger stages, and a sound shaped for late-night energy:
• Exclusive Black Razor Records tracks, including music from Arcade Paradise produced by former The Prodigy drummer Kieron Pepper
• Tracks from Lania Kea, a rising star in the Black Razor family.
• A lineup of Monstercat tracks
• Expanded environments and visuals inspired by Arcade Paradise, Black Razor Records, and more.

title: New Supper Banana!
description: Adventure! Drama! New Supper Banana! is a funny adventure platformer drawn entirely in a notebook!

title: Snack and Quack
description:
Snack and Quack is a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed for casual players.
The goal is to guide all the ducklings to eat the scattered bread in each level. The game focuses on logical challenges and progressive difficulty across two distinct maps to keep players engaged.

title: Frutiger Space
description: Frutiger Space is a social multiplayer game about the future we were promised.

title: Honeycomb Hotel
description: Honeycomb Hotel is a game of logic and deduction. It provides over 65,000 puzzles in each of small, medium, and large sizes. The goal of each puzzle is to determine the placements of images within the honeycomb (up to 37 different cells on the large puzzles) and to determine the exact path that runs through each cell of the honeycomb. You're provided with sufficient clues (presented graphically) to determine all of this, using clear, cold, precise logic. Are you up to the task, or are you too buzzy?

title: Packmates
description: Gear up your animal hero in this 1–3 player co-op survivor roguelite forged on tactical inventory mastery. Arrange loot for devastating combos, obliterate enemies, and battle to dominate the darkness infiltrating your forest!

title: Tomb Boom
description: Help the Illustrious Hatterfax find the treasure in the Well of Wonders! Find the glowing key and bring it back to the grate to continue. Dying is ok! (They'll just send another goblin).

title: Grand Tits Adventure
description: An adult 3D visual novel set in Miami. Complete a secret checklist full of erotic challenges, explore the city, and build steamy relationships in a world of temptation, danger, and sexy opportunities.

title: MILFs in Paris
description: Summer in Paris never tasted this sweet. A sexy visual novel where desserts, desire, and choices mix in one delicious adventure.

title: Lust Company
description: Lust Company is a visual novel where you play as the captain of a space crew trapped by pirates. Gather resources, complete quests, repair your ship, and make choices that shape the story. Will you save your crew or face disaster?

title: Swimpossible!
description: Move each limb separately to swim against the current and avoid difficult obstacles in Swimpossible!

title: Quill > Pistol
description: Thrown into an underground pistol dueling tournament, you'll have to think fast and shoot faster. Quill > Pistol is a turn-based logic dueling game where every shot begins with a puzzle.

title: Sudden Attack Zero Point
description: Sudden Attack has been cherished for 20 years. Now, an endless journey begins. With its signature fast-paced combat and strategic gameplay rooted in classic bomb defusal, we've upgraded the graphics and introduced a gun customization system. Dive into action and discover a new level of excitement!

title: Trip Movie /Mosaic: Shounen Alice Satsujin Jiken
Paddle Together
description: Physics-based chaotic co-op adventure game where communication and teamwork are your only hope and also your biggest threat. Paddle in sync, blame each other at every turn, crash into obstacles and try not to drown (yes, it's optional) while questioning your friendship, together.

title: Patricide
description: Patricide is an adventure RPG about girls who killed their father. It features a story of love and hate, hybrid action and turn-based combat, and cute anime-style heroines. Master the "emotion system" to weaken enemies through empathy, and survive a ruthless, suffocating modern society.

title: Poppy Kart 2
description: Poppy Kart 2 is a galactic racing game in a pixelated world!

title: Taste of the Wind
description: A simulation and RPG game with multiple endings, set in a Chinese restaurant. Play as the owner, and manage the restaurant, form bonds with characters, and explore the lively town. Uncover the secrets behind the restaurant’s mysterious downfall.

title: Melon Bounce
description: Inspired by the Suika Game, this game offers a completely new kind of fun with billiard-style gameplay. Adjust the angle and power to bounce the cute fruits like billiard balls, merge them, and create a melon!

title: Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator
description:
Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator is a cozy cooking game where you serve drinks to our loyal guild members! You might even run into some familiar Vtubers!

Man our drinks bar and learn the ins and outs of each station. Each station has different equipment and drinks to master.

Our state of the art coffee station offers espressos, lattes, and americanos!

We have a wide selection of tea and boba combinations at our boba station!

Make something healthy with fruits and vegetables (or not) at our smoothie station!

title: Fate of the Seventh Scholar
description: Fight against an unyielding horde, explore a handcrafted world, solve puzzles and discover the Fate of the Seventh Scholar.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Black Honey
description: Explore an open-world 100 Aker Woods while outwitting a twisted Winnie-the-Pooh who wants to eat you. Upgrade yourself and craft elaborate traps to stop him using black honey.
An upcoming platformer inspired by NiGHTS into Dreams and Freedom Dive.

title: Buster's Big Score
description: Pull off heists in this jazzy fast-paced 2D platformer as legendary(-ish) thief Buster Speedway! Smoothly combine your acrobatic abilities and novelty gadgets to sneak past guards. Slide into the vault to the jewels and hoist your score before making a quick getaway back to your hideout!

title: 2 in 1 Hidden Object Worlds
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of hidden objects! With lovingly designed scenes and a multitude of objects, each hidden object picture offers endless fun. Ideal for anyone who wants to put their powers of observation and detective skills to the test.

title: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2026
description: Start as a coordinator and rise to head coach in Draft Day Sports: College Football 26! Build playbooks, recruit stars, manage team cohesion, and outsmart adaptive AI. Create your dynasty with unmatched depth and strategy.

title: Bouncy Click
description: Dribble the ball over obstacles and reach the end.

title: Dungeonought
description: Dungeonought, a third-person action co-op multiplayer dungeon-crawler game

title: Digitum
description: A bored old wizard pokes his finger into a tiny portal — and you fall out! In this fast-paced arcade adventure, race through twisted levels, master the physics, and perfect your runs to beat the clock… and your friends on the leaderboard.

title: Garden and a Goat
description: Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!

title: Mayonaka Mayoi Ga
description:
The ultimate goal of this game is to control the protagonist, Tachibana Momoru, and escape from the mansion.
The mansion has various rooms, each containing hidden items.
Players search for these items, use them, and sometimes combine them to progress the story.

title: 7 Days To Think About It
description: A short spot the difference psychological horror game. Your friends invite you to hang out tonight - you have 7 days to think about it.

title: Nonsolar
description: A survival horror game where you must work alongside an 8-bit computer to overcome deadly challenges. Use unique weapons and equipment to explore a dark, hostile exoplanet.

title: Bee Master
description: A fearless bee sets out on a relentless journey to rescue his captured queen. Dodge vehicles across 4 perilous roads, collect 3 hidden keys, and uncover the island's mystery!

title: The Resident
description:
Your friend invited you over.

But when you arrive, it’s clear… he isn’t the one living here anymore.

A very short PSX-style horror walking sim with multiple endings.

Made in 1 day in Unreal Engine 4.

title: Void of Lilly
description: Void of Lilly is an adventure in the world of the near future with JRPG elements and Bullet Hell battles! Help Ann to find her sister and uncover secrets of this world... Void of Lilly is coming on Steam for free!

title: Cutting Grass with Nail Clippers: The Game
description: A walking and exploration simulator for cutting grass with nail clippers. You cut grass with nail clippers, grow the grass, sell the grass, and buy upgrades for your clippers to cut even more grass. Cut grass at your own pace, no rush.

title: Beam Time
description: A logic puzzle game where you redirect and split laser beams to create digital circuits. Through the campaign, you will explore basic logic gates, oscillators, latches, counters, adders, memory, and more.

title: Sorry! I surrounded beauty!
description: "Sorry! I Surrounded By Beauty" is a full-motion live-action interactive video dating simulation game. As the protagonist, Chen Mo, you are a young and promising individual in the early stages of your career. However, you face unexpected professional setbacks and the emotional entanglements that follow. You will encounter beauties with distinct personalities, joining them to uncover the hidden truths behind the story.

title: Sudoku-Edge
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Sudoku-Duo
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: FuSha: Overnight Stay
description: In the text adventure mode, spend a terrifying night of uncertain fate in a perilous hotel. "Fu Sha" has a large number of side options and endings. Any choice may trigger a terrifying situation that is hard to face. In the end, can you make the right choice and escape this curse of death?

title: Hero Secret Realm Survivor Roguelike
description: Exciting and playable free and open hero adventure Roguelike game

title: Tic Cat Dog
description: A Tic-Tac-Toe game made for friends and family! No more draws—every match has a winner. Easy to learn in minutes, yet hides strategic depth. Perfect for parent-child bonding, couples’ playful duels, or fun with friends. Enjoy a fast, no-draw Tic-Tac-Toe match anytime, anywhere!

title: Doodle Defense
description: Doodle: Defense is an exciting roguelite tower defense game in which you play as a mining vessel defending yourself against the planets inhabitants! Use ink to fire bullets and level up to upgrade yourself and add defenses! Extraction will take 20 minutes, good luck!

title: Shards of the Library
description: A simulation puzzle game where everyday life and mystery intertwine on a farm as you uncover secrets beyond the books.

title: Roid Chimp
description: A 2D platformer in the vein of Super Mario World, Megaman, and Sonic, play as Roid Chimp, a personification of our collective rage at a terrible system. Run, climb, and punch your way through a world to explore, filled with books that increase both regular stats and elemental upgrades.

title: Shapeland
description: Addictive gameplay celebrating beauty and physics. Wacky, Quirky, Smart, Intellegent Adventure, 3D Arcade, Explore, Puzzle, Strategy, Tactics. Walk, run, dash, jump and float through this open world adventure. Learn what all the shapes do and how to maximize your score. Play fast or play chill.

title: Sous Raccoon
description: Play as a raccoon sous chef managing restaurants while defending customers from monsters in this action-packed roguelike that blends cooking with combat!

title: The Five Nights at Freddy's Mod
Time Management
description: Travel through a duotone world avoiding obstacles and managing your time to reach the next level. Over 100 levels to conquer and with its simple art style complex puzzles await.

title: Monkey Fruit Fight!
description: Monkey Fruit Fight! mixes PvP retro arcade vibes and modern competitive action! Master precise platforming and throw fruit weapons in intense pixel art duels. Dominate friends to an electrifying synthwave soundtrack! Easy to learn, difficult to master - perfect for all ages!

title: The Heavens
description: Ascend to the Heavens and find out if you're pure enough to be reborn on the Earth.

title: 101 Cats in Indonesia
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Indonesia landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Melancholia Maze
description: Melancholia Maze is a brief atmospheric horror adventure in a twisted version of home. Complete everyday tasks while avoiding lurking demons, collect clues to piece together a lifeline, and find your way out of the darkness. Escape is just a call away.

title: Artifact Seekers
description: Take part in the new adventurous TV show! We designed unique puzzles and locations special for you. “Artifact Seekers” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

title: Dark Place
description: In the darkness, they are approaching. The protagonist is a detective who has come to the location to search for a person who has disappeared at a haunted spot. A horror game played from a first-person perspective. Can you safely escape from the terrifying abandoned house?

title: Strange Pet World
description: Strange Pet World is a fantastical role-playing game where players enter a mesmerizing world filled with wondrous landscapes, including radiant golden trees, fiery red forests, and immaculate white snowfields. In this game, players nurture and evolve their pets, embarking on a unique adventure.

title: Dead Above
description: The world above is filled with countless walking corpses, You can only live in the dark world underground. However, they still want to destroy your only way up——The abandoned mine elevator, protect it, and also protect yourself. Wait for someone to fight alongside you.

title: Project Cobalt
description: ️ Project Cobalt is a survival action game set on a hostile island . Scavenge containers, mine resources, craft tools, hunt animals, and endure storms as you fight hunger, disease, and exhaustion all while uncovering the dark truth behind a failed experiment.

title: Childhood Watermelon
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: The Spring
description: The spring is a Japanese-style first-person horror game that can be completed in about an hour. Set in a silent hot spring inn, players must escape the looming terror and struggle to survive.

title: The Resurrected
description: This is a first-person survival game. There are two different weapons and realistic graphics. This is a high-quality zombie-themed horror game. It features realistic shooting and killing mechanics.

title: Tamako
description: A single or local co-op puzzle platformer with a built-in level editor. Solve creative challenges together or build your own and share them on the Steam Workshop. Tamako is all about relaxed co-op play, clever puzzles, and endless player-made content.

title: Disco Duck
description: A sci fi cat and mouse runner.

title: Sad Virus Land
description: Walking simulation in open world where player controls virus whose mission is to find beer bottles so he can be happy again in big forest land

title: Fusion Skills
description: Fusion Skills is a brand-new classic action puzzle game for all. Use trick shots and strategy to fuse balls into a single chain. With 2,500 procedurally generated levels, each game offers a new challenge. Take pride as you snatch victory from defeat. How fast will you complete all levels?

title: Chrono Port: Heroes of All Time
description: Travel through time, recruit legendary heroes, and battle an ancient evil in this strategic turn-based RPG. Explore 60 unique worlds, unlock 60 heroes, and face off against powerful villains in 3v3 combat. Customize your team and shape the fate of all timelines.

title: Number Crush
description: Flick and combine! Aim for combos with prediction and strategy! Exhilarating billiards puzzle action!

title: All the Mods 10: To the Sky
description: ATM10: To the Sky fuses the massive variety of All the Mods 10 with the classic Skyblock challenge. Begin with just a tree and a single block, and build your sky empire using magic, tech, automation, and exploration.

title: Sudoku-Mini
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Sudoku-Color
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Nations
description: Select an era, a nation and lead it to greatness or decay. Develop the economy and society, or focus on military and territorial expansion. In Nations you can rule your people for centuries from ancient times to the modern day and beyond. You shape your state, history and map of the world.

title: Slice Surge
description: Unleash your slicing skills in Slice Surge! Cut through dragons, fries, treasure, and more in 100+ fun and challenging levels. With colorful cartoon visuals and satisfying slice effects, this one-touch puzzle game is easy to learn but hard to master!

title: Tag League
description: Tag League is an online PvP parkour game where you must use your movement and traversal skills to gain an advantage and beat the other team.

title: Metawork: Antique Shop Simulator
description: Run your own antique shop: buy, restore, and sell rare items. Expand your business, unlock new areas, and protect your store from thieves!

title: Goblin: Mutation
description: This is an open world adventure RPG game Having over 100 types of weapons and 30 sets of collectible armor Simple operations unleash exceptional skills

title: Squares Proximity
description: Master the grid in Squares Proximity! A single-player, turn-based strategy game of precise placements and clever captures. Outsmart the AI by placing numbered squares to boost your tiles and steal theirs. Simple rules, deep decisions. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: The Night Gym
description: The Night Gym is a small retro-style indie horror experience with a VHS aesthetic where a late-night workout turns into a nightmare. You arrive at the gym after hours — just you and the machines. But something feels off. The lights flicker. The silence is heavy. You're not alone...

title: Terra Firma 2
description: Shape breathtaking worlds in Terra Firma 2, a vast simulation where your creations evolve through the forces of nature. Sculpt the land, then watch as weather, erosion, and life itself transform your world into a dynamic, living ecosystem—right down to every plant and creature.

title: Hot and Lovely: Seduction
description: Hot and Lovely: Seduction is a game that combines classic match-3 gameplay with beautiful girls! Players will eliminate colored blocks to unlock beautiful illustrations of several beautiful girls with distinct personalities and experience heart-warming moments with them.

title: Backrooms: The Others
description: Backrooms: The Others is a cooperative horror game for up to 4 players where you will be forced to explore these unknown nooks and crannies, trying to survive in this complex world where death can be waiting for you at every turn!

title: Traveler of Light
description: This game is a third person RPG cartoon game with Zelda style scene design. In the process of fighting against dark forces, you will constantly become stronger, unlock new abilities, and flexibly use multiple skills to defeat enemies in bloody battles.

title: This Ship Goes Brrr
description: Get crystals, get upgrades, get points, get dead. Get a high score, get dead again. Get a higher score. Get flying, get addicted.

title: Spiritstead
description: Spiritstead is a cozy life sim town building game where you care for a growing village full of cute little villagers.

title: Fronteeland
description: Fronteeland is a fast-paced pixel-art hack-and-slash. Battle through perilous levels with weapons you find, survive enemy waves, and unlock more gear for pure, primal combat fun!

title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

title: Echoes of the Court
description: Step into the Supreme Court of Canada in a touching narrative adventure. Explore hidden rooms, hear untold stories that shaped the nation, and craft your own novel inspired by the people whose lives changed here.

title: Timore Avaritia
description: A horror game made by Vidas Games. Your uncle has been making an experiment called health potion, and went missing after that. Your task is to go find out what has happened to your uncle.

title: Hold Me Still
description: "Hold Me Still" is a point-and-click puzzle mystery game where you investigate your friend's disappearance by exploring their house, collecting clues, solving puzzles, and uncovering the truth.

title: Barista Dream
description: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

title: Koalas Deliv & Guy
description: Use the shockwaves from a flying KOALA to carry your buddy, NICEGUY, to the goal! Go off course and it’s game over! But don’t worry—you can try as many times as you want! Now, experience the ultimate physics-based, comical action game!

title: Vade Retro Satana
description: VADE RETRO SATANA is a classicaly retro-inspired RPG with deliberate, turn-based combat. Play as the archangel Saint Michael as he faces Lucifer, Satan, and all of his minions. Will you fight and cast them into the lake of fire?

title: Lazy Train Game
description: Lazy Train Game is a relaxing game about building out your railway, collecting resources, crafting tracks, overcoming obstacles, and unlocking new tracks, scenarios, and engines. Set up your railway in such a way that your trains can do most of the work for you.

title: Bug Bane Survivors
description: Mother Nature has no mercy! Turn bug swarms into fertilizer as a mutated plant. Take root, evolve, and create your garden of death with unique combos. You are the top of the food chain in this chaotic arena!

title: Chain-Em
description: If you like movement shooters, CHAINS, slowmo, speedrunning, parkour... aand getting paralyzed??? ...Well then just buy the game...Chain-em is an FPS movement "boom" shooter where you move at insane speeds, dodge bullets in slowmo and CHAIN your enemies in a retro style setting. CHAINCHAINCHAINCHAIN

title: Piso 6
description: PISO 6 is a first-person psychological horror game with a low-poly aesthetic. After his father's death, Tomás returns to the apartment where he grew up. What seemed like a simple search for a will turns into a nightmare that pulls him back into the past.

title: Starpine
description: You are a pineapple, and as such, your only goal is to reach the stars. Use your platforming skills to jump around unique biomes, from island to island or wall to wall, to reach every star each world has to offer.

title: Defeat the Goblin King
description: Gear up and leave on a Roguelike RPG expedition to the unknown, strategize your way to victory against impossible odds in turn-based combat. It's time for the tyrannical rule of the Goblin King to end!

title: Flask
description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

title: Save Mom
description: A cartoon-inspired co-op action game where you and your siblings must protect Mom as she drives her old motorhome across a bizarre post-apocalyptic America. Gather resources, upgrade the RV, build defenses, and fight off mutants and cultists — all while Mom insists on seeing the good in everyone. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in chaotic family co-op fun.

title: Sports Sports
description: Run, Jump, Swim, Throw and Fire your way to victory with this competitive arcade sports game. Compete solo or against friends, with simple controls which will have you crying for a rematch!

Over the past 11 years, the Seven Knights IP has maintained strong popularity through its robust lineup of titles with diverse gameplay, including Seven Knights, Seven Knights 2, Seven Knights Idle Adventure, and more.

Developed by Netmarble Nexus, the newest entry in the franchise, Seven Knights Re:BIRTH was launched in Korea on May 15, 2025. Just you, your pogo stick, and a long way up.

description: S.P.L.O.S.H is a fast and splashy platformer where you control a pufferfish powered by water! Roll, bounce, and blast through tricky platforms, dangerous machines, and watery boosts in this high-speed adventure.

title: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
description: Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

title: Put One In for Johnny Minn
description:
Stylized physics-soccer arcade puzzle game. Players score using diving headers, volleys, side volleys, and free kicks. Beat levels by discovering the optimal way to solve the level. Timing and precision are needed to make good contact with the ball in order to achieve high contact quality and goal placement scores.

Includes local PvP multiplayer modes: 1v1 (striker vs. keeper) and pass-and-play shot-for-shot party mode for 2-8 local players.

title: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
description:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

title: Banana of Doom
description: A party style deck building and card crafting game where you combine words in hand to win tournaments! ‘Robot Grandma’ vs ‘Moist Goblin’, which is more likely to end the world? A hilarious fast-paced multiplayer party game.

title: Imagine Sisyphus Happy
description:
Sisyphus, king of Corinth, has tricked the Gods and Death. To punish him, the Gods condemned him to push a boulder uphill forever, only for it to roll back each time.
But Sisyphus didn't give up. He decided to livestream it.

Imagine Sisyphus Happy is a Steamer Sim, Clicker and QTE mix game about life, spectacle, and finding meaning in repetition. Roll your boulder, pull off stunts, and try to make the eternal grind worth living.

Push the boulder. Do tricks. Go live.

Progressing from Greek myth to the modern day, the story asks two simple questions:
- Aren’t you a Sisyphus too?
- Can you Imagine Sisyphus Happy?

title: Eclipse of Fate
description: In a world haunted by echoes of ancient magic, young Lioren discovers a connection to reality-warping anomalies: Himself. Join him on a dangerous journey to discover the secrets of his connection to a rapidly destabilizing realm in a classic, story-driven JRPG - and decide the fate of the world!

title: Reclaim
description: Reclaim is a fantasy visual novel following a peculiar elf and a dying god trying to free the world and themselves. Choose wisely and help them study, create, and escape.

title: Piano at 5 am Encore
description: The paid, complete version of Piano at 5 a.m.. It includes additional episodes that depict the characters' pasts and narrated voiceover.

title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer
description: This is a remake of Natsuno-Kanata using the Unity engine. It also features a new character with it's storyline, new CGs, new and updated BGM, full controller support, simplified & traditional Chinese localization and a new insert song by Siika, who also performed the main theme.

title: Dollhouse of Dead
description: In this co-op horror game, your team visits abandoned toy factories. Collect various junk, extract materials from it, create and improve your equipment. And try to survive, because while you are exploring the dark dungeons of factories, bloodthirsty toys are hunting you

title: Ace Attorney: The Final Trials
description:
The Wright Anything Agency is back! Ace Attorney: The Final Trials is a fan game that takes place around half a year after Spirit of Justice.It acts as a sequel to the game, while also wrapping the series into a satisfying conclusion, and showing the rebirth of a new era for Phoenix Wright. Old and new faces alike will make an appearance in the Final Trials, and the Agency must face threats and dilemmas never seen before, including an underground organization scheming something very dubious....
This game will contain spoilers for every previous installment in the franchise, including the Investigations series. I do not own or hold any stake in the series, and this work is fully unofficial.

title: Inspektor
description: Play as the INSPEKTOR, sent to crush a violent uprising on a dark, industrial planet. Blast through rebels and machines in a savage mix of 90s-style shooter action, neon-soaked sci-fi, and nonstop blood-soaked carnage. Retro pixels, brutal combat, zero remorse.

title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - Last Escape
description: Last Escape, the first major DLC for Terminus: Zombie Survivors, continues the story after reaching the Terminus. Secure the station, rescue survivors, and uncover hidden stories. Reclaim the train and make a final, daring escape from the zombie-infested city. Your true survival begins now.

title: Bloodmatch
description: The arena beckons. Sharpen your steel. Slash, stab, and spear your way through the ranks of Rome’s toughest warriors, taking yourself from a lowly pit slave to the land's most glorified gladiator. Your audience awaits…

title: Hexborn
description: An occult-fueled roguelite FPS inspired by Blood and Vampire Survivors — but instead of one arena, explore cursed labyrinths that reshape every run. Draft brutal perks, wield occult firepower, and survive escalating horrors with a retro shooter soul.

title: Brainrot Battle Royale
description: Dive into Brainrot Battle Royale! Fight to the death in Ohio with the greatest brainrot characters in the ultimate Gen Z showdown. Join the fight now, aurafarmer!

title: The Möbius Strip
description:
A scientist, famous for making a sense-enhancing innovation, is recruited to work for the Silver Bed Foundation on a new project: a way to make immortality real.

A short puzzle RPG with three major acts.

title: The Dead House
description: Play as an ambitious YouTuber known for exploring paranormal and creepypasta stories. Your latest video takes you to a hauntingly beautiful, abandoned mansion, rumored to hide dark secrets.

title: Red Vanilla 2
description: Survive and destroy all 33 of your memories. Time had no meaning and I couldn't save her. Something wasn't right in her mind. I focused and fought this as hard as I could but in the end, no matter the result, nothing good would happen. I should've been there and now I ask her to forgive me.

title: Oikizo
description: Oikizo is a city-building game. Start by placing your first building and a few citizens, then make your city prosper. The strength of Oikizo lies in the ability to manage a city cooperatively with your friends.

title: Cook and Play: Animal Friends
description: Cook and Play: Animal Friends is launching in Early Access! It’s a wacky co-op cooking game full of chaos, power-ups, and hilarious kitchen disasters. Team up or face off in fast-paced matches where every second counts. Cook, laugh, and survive the madness — just try not to burn everything!

title: Bananaganza
description: A fast-paced casual arcade game where you peel, slice, and catch flying banana pieces to feed monkeys and rack up high scores.

title: Malevilent
description: A missing envoy. No telegraphs for a month. Something's gone wrong in the mining town of Gunsight, Arizona. As an agent of the newly-formed Federal Secret Service, it's your job to get to the bottom of what's happening in this third-person, open-world RPG.

title: The Population Must Grow
description: Start with just one citizens to build up your city. Grow it more and more and more. There is no limit in size. Just the limit of your own PC.

title: 101 Cats in Macau
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Macau landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Dungeonborne Settlement
description: Defeat monsters in dungeons, gather resources, grow your settlement, and combine and enhance tactics to lead the battle. Use auto-battle and flexible challenges to create and change tactics as you face stronger dungeons.

title: Orbloom
description: Take deckbuilding and replace the cards with ball physics so you can combine abilities in creative ways!

title: Motorcycle Boy
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Presidential Psychologist
description: You're not a real psychologist. He's not a sane president. Welcome to the most unhinged therapy session ever held in office.

title: Static Boy
description: 2D Platformer Action/Adventure Game. Use space bar to jump. Use arrow keys to go left and right. Use mouse/trackpad to navigate menus. Using Xbox controller: Right joystick (up): jump. Left joystick: Left+Right.

title: Pretty Peculiar Lovers
description: Pretty Peculiar Lovers is a visual novel dating sim with a compelling twist, where your decisions impact which romance candidate you engage with, and what secrets you may uncover about them. Come prepared, these seemingly kind and welcoming individuals may not be how they appear.

title: Ludus Manager
description: Found your Ludus. Train your gladiator, set up your camp, and dominate fights across different cities in the Roman Empire. Shape your story based on the character you choose. Make different choices in dialogues to determine your path.

title: Mad Carnival
description: Rogue AI mascots have taken over a once-happy theme park. Blast through deadly attractions, rescue your girlfriend, and survive the chaos in this weirdly fun top-down shooter — now with a playable demo!

title: A Pig Game: A Pee Wee Premiere
description: Join Pee Wee the Polka Dotted Pig - your silent (but determined) ceramic protagonist on a mission to collect toothpicks! Flip, fling, and fly through a kitchen full of cozy characters and curious quests!

title: Bloodquest From Hell
description: Bloodquest From Hell is a first person exploration game made in Unreal Engine. You play as a humble fry cook, who must journey through a mysterious portal in order to keep your job.

title: Adrenaline: May the Sun Return
description: ADRENALINE: May The Sun Return is a first-person parkour game where you try to escape a procedurally generated futuristic district. Master your reflexes as you make your way through this hermetically sealed city.

title: Fling it! Shoe Kicking
description: Fly, shoe, fly! Up into the sky! Swing and kick your shoe as far as you can! Become a shoe-kicking master!

title: Gangsters in Love
description: 24/7 with Dangerous Gangsters?!

title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Beats & Books
description: Join cute cats in festive scenes! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a vibrant music festival and a lively university campus full of discovery and fun.

title: Samurai Academy: Paws of Fury
description: The village of Kakamucho is under attack by the Shogun’s cat armies! Join Hank, a dog samurai in a world of cats, and his friends as they reveal a sinister plot and save the day, samurai-style. Slash, dash, and laugh through this wacky third-person action adventure.

title: Where the Sky Is
description: "Let's create in a mysterious world!"

title: Idle Time Slime
description: A relaxing virtual slime pet that lives at the bottom of your screen while you do other tasks.

title: Space Storm
description: Space Storm is a fast-paced space racing and combat game where players navigate high-speed stellar tracks across distant galaxies. Asteroids, hazards, and unexpected events challenge reflexes and strategy as the starship duels rivals and pushes toward the finish line.

title: Axis Shift
description: Switch between Tank, Spaceship, and Submarine in this third-person sci-fi arcade shooter, battling waves of rabid mechanical beasts to uncover the truth behind Stroth XVI.

title: License to Grill
description: Pick your favorite meat character and cook up to 8 friends using the environment, wacky weapons, or your trusty frying pan in this online 3rd Person Combat PVP game!

title: quilt
description: A Yume Nikki Fangame by rataratata, catcatcat6, nunu and luok.

title: Super Choppy
description: Challenging indie action platformer with beautiful retro pixel art. Play as Choppy and master the platforming gameplay mechanics of using his axe to throw, fly, climb, and chop your way through a silly revenge-fueled adventure.

title: Dragon Ball Sparking Zero: Shallot (Dragon Ball Legends)
description: Shallot from the mobile game DRAGON BALL LEGENDS joins the battle!

title: Puzzle Parasite
description: Puzzle Parasite is a sci-fi puzzle adventure where you wield telekinetic powers and a cricket bat. You send energy cores flying, power alien tech, and avoid deadly lasers, as you go deeper to uncover the hidden secrets. A handcrafted tribute to the classics that made us think in new ways.

title: Meme Wars
description: Skill-based 1v1 3D arena fighter based on memes. Dash, block, and combo through quick 3-minute duels. Climb ranked online PvP or train against bots. Manage Stamina & Mana, stack status effects and outplay with skill. Easy to learn, hard to master

title: Immune Attack
description: Immune Attack was designed, developed and evaluated for learning outcomes by the Learning Technologies Program at the Federation of American Scientists. Funded by a major grant from the National Science Foundation and the National Institutes of Health. All the code, art, sound and voices are by Garry and Melissa Gaber of Escape Hatch Entertainment.

title: Night Shift: 1999
description: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

title: Gravity Was A Mistake
description: Traverse a gravity-inverted world using physics-based movement. Interact with floating structures, unlock new traversal abilities, and climb through a shattered vertical landscape.

title: Backrooms: Reminiscence
description: Backrooms: Reminiscence is a single-player horror game where you experience something unexpected, and now you're left all alone in the cold world of The Backrooms.

title: Train Sim World 5: BR Class 86/2 & Mk2f Coaches
description: Tap into classic British AC traction with the BR Class 86/2 from Just Trains. The Class 86 brings additional challenges to the stunning WCML: Preston - Carlisle route, as well as all-new variety in the form of British Rail's Mk2F coaches!

title: Cora
description: CORA (Counter Offensive Rapidfire Automata) is a singleplayer/multiplayer top-down shooter created by Empty House Games borrowing inspiration from other arcade top-down shooters.

title: Train Sim World 5: Manchester Airport Commuter: Manchester - Alderley Edge
description: From Piccadilly station to the modern airport terminus, multiple lines combine to serve Greater Manchester commuters aboard Northern Trains traction. Experience a variety of services with Alan Thomson Simulation's first route in Train Sim World 5.

title: Rocket League: TriTrim Wheels
description: Blade-sharp and effortlessly brilliant. Roll up to the Arena with the TriTrim Wheels that make a bold statement with every rotation. Grab them for free and get ready for a cutting-edge ride!

title: Astrobarian
description: Astrobarian is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.

title: TrailRail
description: Your path taken is the key. "TrailRail" is a physics-based action puzzle game where the trajectory of your movement becomes a tangible object. Control the girl and aim to escape from the mysterious research facility.

title: Songs of Conquest: Roots
description: Songs of Conquest's second new faction is The Roots, who have spread from deep within the Wyldwoods of the Bleak East. Take command of flora, fungus, and the bones of the repurposed dead to spread the Roots across Aerbor!

title: Medieval Dynasty: Echoes of Nature
description: The Echoes of Nature DLC adds a range of outdoor decoration options, focused on natural elements and seasonal variation. It introduces new types of trees, shrubs, hedges, and stone features that can be placed in the environment.

title: Hell Let Loose: Operation Overlord Units
description:
Fight throughout Normandy with the Operation Overlord Units DLC.

The Operation Overlord Units contains: -

3 New Uniforms:
1x ROA
1x Rangers
1x Field Division

3x New Headgear:
2x New Netted 2nd & 5th Rangers Helmets
1x ROA Cap
1x Field Division
1x Field Division Foliage

3x New Heads:
2x Axis (Friedrich & Nikolai) + Winter Variants
1x US (Gordon) + Winter Variant

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Ragoo
description: The scourge of the waters, the bane of navies, the serpents of the seas - The Ragoo Pirates! Their fleets of ships and lust for plunder are ready to expand their operations from the Kickoo Isles to the rest of the Square!

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Hoodrick
description:
The yellow autumn leaves of the Hoodrick woods are perfect hideouts for its peculiar mushroom stuffing inhabitants.
Hoodrick starts the game with Archery Tech

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Yorthwober
description: Can you hit a BuzzFly with an arrow from 2 tiles away? Then you might be ready for the Hoodrick Yorthwober. These expert sharpshooters have been personally trained in combat and survival by Yorth, the legendary archer, and comprise the most elite force the Hoodrick can muster.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Lirepacci
description: The honor of forging your helmet into a laurel is reserved for the Lirepacci, a group of scholars, philosophers, and magistrates near the top of Imperius society.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Baergøff
description: Bardur who have survived the 5 Tests of Strength are given the rank of Baergøff, meaning “Elite Baerion Hunter”. The sanctified Baerion pelt is thought to let the wearer channel the animal's raw ferocity in battle.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Sha-po
description: The Sha-po are a secretive legion of soldiers, saboteurs, and assassins trained in the ways of warfare and subterfuge from the moment they're hatched.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Anzala
description: The disciples of Anzala eschewed the scientific lifestyle of their Zebasi siblings and followed the calling of art and unrestrained expression! Now they're here, with the Square as their canvas, and no one will hinder their creative conquest!

title: Wibby Buddy
description: Explore a beautiful forest and bond with adorable animals! Build closeness with various creatures, and as your bond grows, gift them cozy homes to live together. Gather resources and craft to create a unique home with your animal friends. Turn a shabby, lonely space into a warm, lively haven!

title: Northgard: Gardariki, Clan of the Hippogriff
description: From Southern Lands, Sindri, eldest of Brok and Eitria, returns clad in fire and steel, his twin hammers echoing both legacy and defiance. A figure of both might and mastery, bringing with him the legacy of the forge and the discipline of distant Kingdoms.

title: Rogue Skies
description: Conquer the skies in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder! In Rogue Skies, you'll assemble your crew, load the cannons and defend your airship from raiding sky pirates as you blow them out of the sky!

title: The Cube, Save Us
description: A post-apocalyptic extraction action game built around brutal, close-quarters combat. Step through the Cube Gate and discover ever-shifting worlds filled with strange landscapes and terrifying enemies. Escape the Cube by fighting your way through twisted mutants and Raiders you once called allies.

title: I'm a Gensokyo Observer 2: Chen's Duty
description: After Thomas finished the observing duty and got sent back home by Yukari, few weeks later, the anomaly starts to haunt few more places within Gensokyo again. Yukari wants Thomas to have a break so someone else need to do an observing job and that's when Chen decided to step in. You'll be playing as Chen and you must observe the haunted locations, report the anomaly and survive until sunrise.

title: Colton Owen: Ace Attorney
description: A group of uni students attend a meeting at an Occult Club on campus, when the unthinkable strikes. A campus rumour comes to life and claims a victim! ...Or does it?

title: Super Farmer
description: "Super Farmer" is a fast-paced game where you compete against pests and farmers in a vibrant orchard. Run, harvest fruits, and use items to outmaneuver rivals. Race through 100 levels, manage energy, and battle farmers to become the ultimate champion!

title: Capoeira Origins
description: Capoeira Origins is an action-adventure experience set in colonial Brazil during the period of slavery. Experience history from the perspective of those who resisted, taking on the role of capoeiristas determined to fight for freedom, justice, and survival.

title: Upload Labs
description: A sci-fi management game where you build and optimize your computer's system from the ground up. Connect and configure interconnected nodes to efficiently download, process, and upload files. Manage your setup, solve system challenges, and become the ultimate system architect

title: Flint
description: A action-adventure game with a top down perspective and a heavy emphasis on story. Become the legendary Knight of Hamarolf and take on a myriad of foes from the Golden Oath to save the world from evil's reign while engaging with memorable characters and a thrilling combat loop.

title: Space Mash
description: Space Mash is a bullet-hell shooter in the retro style of the earliest arcade games. To help beginners, older players and those with a motor impairment, there are five levels of slow-down that can be activated at any time during game play.

title: Bloodless Heart
description: Squeeze the heart, gain elements and eventually synthesize your own blood. In this incremental game, every organ (not only your heart) matters. Use their synergies to achieve your ultimate bloody goal.

title: Put Out the Fire
description: Team up in this chaotic local co-op rescue game! Extinguish fires, save lives, and battle disasters in fast-paced, time-critical missions across stylized environments.

title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
description: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is a modern remake of DRAGON QUEST VII, which originally launched on PlayStation in 2000. In this new reimagined version of the game, the core concept of the original title remains, but the battle mechanics, graphics and story have all been updated and improved, providing players with a more streamlined and focused experience. In particular, the graphics in the game were completely overhauled from the original, using real-life doll figures for the characters and monsters that were scanned into the game to create stunning hand-crafted visuals. This definitive version of the game is perfect for fans who want to revisit the beloved story or newcomers who are diving into the world for the first time.

title: Curse of Dominion
description: Crowned for saving the king, you wield the coveted Blessing of Dominion. Command tense tactical battles, deepen companion Loyalty, evade those who would kill for your power, and watch a secret moral scale quietly reshape Elvorith’s fate.

title: Still House
description: A peaceful, cozy home-building sandbox experience where every corner tells a story. Build your space from the ground up, decorate with care, and let your tiny helper bring life to each room.

title: Demand Dial Exorcist
description: In Demand-Dial Exorcist, you play a demon hunter solving eerie puzzles. Investigate clues, place ritual items on the pentagram, and banish demons before they claim you as their next victim.

title: Too Many Bots
description: Too Many Bots is a first-person action arcade. Dive into brutal, retro-PS1 mazes, alternate between prey and hunter, face endless bot swarms, collect temporary power-ups, and adapt to ever-changing rules. Every run ramps up difficulty, testing your reflexes and strategy.

title: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
description: The full remake of FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO II: Crimson Butterfly. This Japanese-style horror adventure game follows twin sisters lost in an abandoned village haunted by evil spirits. Using the Camera Obscura, they fight ghosts as the story unfolds.

title: Suika Game Planet
description:
A new Suika Game is here from a new setting in space! Turn, target, and aim for the watermelon!

Drop the fruits freely from any direction as "Poppy" flies 360° around the planet. Make fruits of the same type collide to make them "evolve" and aim to create watermelons for a high score!
Make a lot of fruits "evolve" to enter the new "Super Evolution Time" mode! Special background music, dramatic effects, and a bonus score bring the excitement to a peak!

The "Suika Game Planet" has evolved in many ways, including with a customization function that allows you to freely decorate the game screen (skin), and a collection function that allows you to collect stickers for completing missions and use them to create your original name tag. Try playing it now!

title: Danganronpa 2x2
description:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

title: Backyard Football '99
description: Backyard Football 1999 is back and now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, scoring TDs with Pablo Sanchez, or enjoying the witty banter between Sunny Day and Chuck Downfield, simple controls let anyone pick up and play football!

title: Mega Man Star Force: Legacy Collection
description: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

title: Dumpster Divers
description: Dumpster Divers is an online co-op scavenging game where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure. Dive into alleys and dumpsters with up to 4 friends, outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

title: Bonehold
description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

title: After Hell Freezes Over
description: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

title: Art Attack
description: Art Attack is an action roguelike with a unique paint based combat system, and a distaste for GenAI.

title: Scamster Kombat
description: Welcome to the world of Scamster Kombat — an exciting clicker where every mouse click brings you closer to your cherished goal! In this game you have to take on the role of a funny guy who hides under a blanket and earns coins by tapping on the screen. But be careful! Your quiet life can be disrupted by uninvited guests!

title: Orangia
description: A yuri visual novel that tells the story of two childhood friends, from their first meeting to falling in love and the everyday moments of their life together with a multi-branching storyline.

title: Orangia DLC
description: The story takes place after the true end of the main game and tells about the couple's life in college and after work.

title: The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
description: A dark fantasy style pixel ARPG. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

title: B-e-e-t-l-e: Be right back!
description: The sequel to b-e-e-t-l-e, b-e-e-t-l-e: be right back! is a short, cozy keyboardventure where you can type casually and take your time. Explore strange lands, solve unique puzzles and discover whimsical new ways to use your keyboard as you embark on a journey to find your lost beetle.

title: Plants vs Zombies Expansion
description: PvZ Expansion is a mod that mostly adds new content and fixes some bugs while also making the game somewhat more challenging, but not extremely so. This mod does not overhaul the entire game significantly, though there are some balancing changes and new features.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Back to Earth in Evernight
description:
Version 3.6 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Evernight and Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
• New Trailblaze Mission: "Back to Earth in Evernight"
• New areas: Grove of Epiphany and Universal Matrix
• New game mode: Anomaly Arbitration
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Courier Bay
description: Courier Bay is a cozy low-poly delivery sim where you play as Leo, a new driver at Bay Express, completing daily deliveries across a vibrant city.

title: Perfume Atelier
description: Blend fragrances in your cozy perfume atelier! Craft unique scents by mixing essences, design beautiful bottles, and try to sell your creations to curious customers. Decorate your workshop, unlock new recipes, and grow your reputation in the art of fragrance.

title: Recycling Shift
description: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

title: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
description: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

title: Treasure Beach
description: Scavenge the beach and run a cozy trinket shop by the sea! Find hidden treasures or trash, clean and repair your finds, put them up for sale, and upgrade your workshop. Dig deeper and faster to make more money and buy back the beach from the greedy hotel.

title: Hunt Grounds
description: Hunt Grounds is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game

title: Grand Crime Miami
description: Choose a gun to your liking and clear the street of bandits!

title: Cat Karting
description: Now you are a catloaf and you are racing along the track.

title: Infinite Loop: Backrooms
description: This is an exploration + puzzle + mildly horror roguelike top-down shooter game where you can customize weapons and escape the backrooms through thousands of rooms!

title: Winter Sadness Simulator
description: An atmospheric walk through a post-Soviet courtyard with depressing music.

title: Potion Permit: Christmas Tree
description:
Customise your room with:
• Christmas Tree

title: Mixed Spirits
description: Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

title: Hive Stampers
description: Fight giant bugs with your mech! Liberate the alien planet for your cause. In this top-down twin stick shooter, fight bugs as you secure the planet for humankind.

title: Corrupted Souls
description: A brutal souls-like through a forgotten realm. Battle relentless monsters, uncover buried truths, and reclaim the soul humanity betrayed.

title: Just Move: Clean City Messy Battle
description: Faced with difficult tasks, try to challenge the limits. Sometimes need luck to win.

title: Market Empire Simulator
description: Market Empire Simulator is a business management game where you build, run, and optimize your own supermarket. Manage inventory, hire employees, stock shelves, and expand your store to create the ultimate shopping experience.

title: Heat Incremental
description:
Your mission is simple: HEAT UP THE PLANET
Start with clean technologies like solar panels that barely produce any heat, but research less clean methods to produce even more heat. This game introduces new features gradually. At first, you’ll see only the basics to help you get started, but as you progress, more advanced technologies and mechanics will unlock. It is a long journey with plenty to explore.

title: Dead Estate: Home Theater
description: Home Theater is the first update in the six part update series for Dead Estate. Featuring brand-new cutscenes available for every single unlockable character, new bosses, new enemies, new items and more.
