description: Enter the Eggspedition - a terrifying survival horror with dinosaurs! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

title: Plato Shoot
description: This is a shooting game, where nobody dies. Use your gun to help enemies find their lover, at the same time, find your own lover.

title: Mass Effect 3: Earth
description: The Mass Effect 3: Earth DLC is a free multiplayer expansion for the game that added new maps, characters, weapons, and a higher difficulty level to the game's co-op multiplayer mode. Players can select from six new human N7 classes, use three new weapons, play on maps located on Earth (Firebase Rio, Vancouver, and London), and face challenges on the new "Platinum" difficulty level.

title: 3D Massage
description: This is a casual game in which you will play a male protagonist and wash the feet of various beauties at the right time in various interior decoration styles.

title: 3 Triplets, 18 Tits
description: It's your first day on the job at the company called Triplets, Triplets, Triplets! Your task is to select beautiful triplet models to be photographed.

title: 69 Megumi Love
description: 69 Megumi Love is a game with novel and puzzle elements. You decided to visit club 69, but lately you are the only visitor there. The owner of the club Megumi will do everything to make the client happy.

title: Quadratic Puzzle 3
description: Dive into the captivating world of Quadratic Puzzle 3, a delightful jigsaw puzzle game where your goal is to piece together beautifully illustrated images. Sharpen your spatial reasoning skills and strategic thinking to arrange the disrupted pieces into perfect harmony. The faster you complete the puzzle, the higher your score!

title: Aeos: The 18 Plus NSFW Adventure Generator
description: Aeos: The 18 Plus NSFW Adventure generator is an open world campaign based adventure and RPG video game featuring two main characters currently, with options to choose from male or a female protagonist.

title: Beauty Shooter
description: New CGs can be used after customs clearance

title: Mass Effect 3: Reckoning
description: Mass Effect 3: Reckoning was the final, free multiplayer DLC for Mass Effect 3, which added new playable character classes, seven new weapons, and two new pieces of gear to the game's co-op multiplayer mode. The expansion introduced a variety of new recruits, such as the Geth Juggernaut, Alliance Infiltration Unit, and Krogan Warlord, along with weapons like the Biotic Hammer and Geth Spitfire Assault Rifle to help fight the Reaper threat.

title: OutRun GB
description: A fanmade homebrew Demake of the original OutRun for the Game Boy Color released on Itch.io. It features the same levels, themes, and branching paths and music as the original.

title: Pokémon Añil: Definitive Edition
description: Is an updated version of the popular fan game Pokémon Indigo created by EricLostie. This enhanced version was created by DPertierra and Skyflyer, and brings numerous improvements to the game.

title: Color by Number: Medieval Portrait
description: Color by Number - Medieval Portrait is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!

title: Magical Gyarus Milk Me for Mana
description: SHINING, SEXY, STARLIGHT GYARUS! Your house has suddenly become a place for gyarus to gather?! But what are these magical energy or power spots they keep talking about? After fighting evil all day, the best way for a magical gyaru to recharge is to milk a horny boy like you for all his Special Mana!

title: VisionaryWings
description:
A bullet-hell shooting game with around 3000 bullets.
Its selling points are its inflated scoring system and beautiful pre-rendered graphics.

title: Hard Truck 2
description:
Hard Truck 2 is the original version of the more well-known upgraded release called Hard Truck 2: King of the Road. Some of the major differences that separate this release are the lack of extended interface at gas and repair stations that allows player to choose how much fuel to fill or which parts of the car to repair, the lack of ability to buy lighter vehicles such as BMW M5 at the beginning of the game or even start playing as one immediately, weaker AI, far better rewards at "The Circuit", the lack of need to stop for refueling/upgrading in the "Simulator" mode, and some other elements.
This original version cannot be upgraded to the Kind of the Road re-release via patching.

It was initially released in US back in 2000 (v4.0), followed by a few updated versions that also saw release in some European countries as well (such as v5.8 being released in Portugal and Lithuania). Original Russian release v6.5 never had an official English translation, yet v6.5-7.4 were localized and released in some European countries (such as Lithuania).
The upgraded version King of the Road 1.0 released in 2002 wasn't compatible with its predecessor and started a completely new version numeration, effectively becoming a separate expanded version of the game.

title: SCP: Containment Breach Ultimate Edition
description: The Ultimate Edition is a global modification for the "SCP - Containment Breach" game. This mod includes new SCPs, new and expanded rooms, increased performance, improved graphics and atmosphere, and a TON of bug fixes!

title: EvilSlayer
description: The world is facing a disease of unknown origin, resulting in a large number of humans going missing or mutating into monsters that only know killing and eating. The survivors have formed various resistance and self-defense organizations to fight against these monsters in order to survive.

title: Misty Judgment
description: This is a suspense reasoning interactive work with real people. You will play the protagonist "Qi Yi", find evidence in a series of murders, piece together the truth, and find the ultimate murderer, all of which will lead you to an unpredictable future.

title: Uruc
description: Navigate the heart of a war-ravaged world, discovering hidden truths about those around you and yourself.

title: Kinky Cats
description: Kinky Cats is a hot merge game in which you can collect cards and cast sexy babes. Help horny girls unlock their potential, and they will make all your dirty dreams come true!

title: Iron Blight
description: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.

title: Eyes of the ElderWood
description: Eyes of the ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

title: Surprising My Neighbors
description: Surprising My Neighbors is a first-person game where you are going to leave “surprises” at the doors of your beloved neighbors.

title: Fokkland
description: Fokkland is a cozy exploration game. Play as Mara, princess of a tiny realm: ride your horse, invite animals to follow, beware traps, goblins and trolls. Choose kindness or a darker path. Beta, evolving with community feedback.

title: Squaser X
description: SQUASER X is a minimalist puzzle game where you control a white square and erase the darkness on each level. Clear your path using logic and memory!

title: Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast Demo
description: The Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast demo was released in 2002, offering players a preview of Raven Software’s sequel to Jedi Knight. It features an exclusive single-player mission set on the Imperial outpost of Kejim, where Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors investigate mysterious Remnant activities. It showcases the game’s blend of first-person shooting and third-person lightsaber combat, along with Force powers that became central to the full game.

title: Fun with Friends and Trampolines
description: A casual game of bouncing where you use the mouse to move the trampoline under your friends, and keep them from dying a horrible death.

title: Duel Timers
description: Duel Timers is a local multiplayer FPS Platformer. Fight against a friend with On-the-Couch Local Multiplayer or through Steam Remote Play (All multiplayer requires a Bluetooth Gamepad). Jump from platform to platform on a vertical arena to avoid enemy players and the impending void!

title: Christmas Sort Puzzle
description: In this captivating puzzle game, your objective is to sort and arrange various Christmas items such as ornaments, gifts, snowflakes, stockings, and more. The objects are scattered on the screen, and it's up to you to slide and swap them to find the perfect arrangement. Your keen eye and logical thinking will be crucial in solving each level.

title: Laundry & Supermarket Simulator
description: "Laundry Simulator" immerses you in the bustling laundry business. Manage a boutique shop, handling everything from everyday clothes to luxury garments, and sell related products. Efficiently manage resources, upgrade equipment, and optimize layout to attract customers with superior service.

title: Daenerys Doesn’t Want Hentai
description: Daenerys does not want Hentai! but John Sand does not agree. Collect chests filled with gold to make war on him! And save Daenerys!

title: Frame Sense Trainer
description: Frame Sense Trainer is a timing-focused training app that helps animators, developers, and Esports athletes build Temporal Frame Estimation—an internal sense of how long animations last in frames at 60 FPS through tutorials, exercises, and quizzes.

title: Pay 2 Win: The World Is Mine
description:
PAY 2 WIN is an incremental strategy game about running a game studio. Customize your progression, find epic rewards, and discover clever ways to go infinite, as you're joined by Annie and May, your cute anime-inspired assistants.

As your repute grows, so do your choices; switch seamlessly between passive idle gameplay and active resource generation to more quickly boost your progress in the game and story. Random rewards keep you guessing what's next, while you invest in your favorite facilities to make the numbers BIGGER.

Your decisions alter your run and affect your story. One thing is certain - to make it in this industry, you'll need strategy, a bit of luck, and resources. Lots and lots of resources.

title: Chamber no. 5
description: Short itch.io puzzle game about the song Mambo no. 5

title: Gecky The Deenosaur Stars In! Adventures In SunnyDoodle Swimmingland!
description: It's Dyme To Start WackyDoodleing Around! Gecky The Deenosaur is Here! And He Needs Your Help To Find His Lost Pebble!

title: Skyguard
description: Hordes of robot marauders have been attacking airships en route to the city. Join the Skyguard and shoot bots, buy guns, and fly your way to victory (and a paycheck) in this action-packed, couch co-op, third-person shooter.

title: Lady's Escape
description: Join a young lady in 'Lady's Escape,' an NSFW visual novel. Help a young noblewoman flee her confines and pursue freedom. Make choices, avoid the butler's watch, and seduce your way out of the mansion. Can you help her succeed?

title: Sad Virus Foodland
description: Walking simulation and adventure game where player controls virus character in foodland. Mission to avoid obstacles and find beer bottle

title: Project Mercenaria
description: Project Mercenaria is a third-person shooter game featuring beautiful girls. You will play as a mercenary girl, engaging in thrilling gun battles with a mysterious and evil organization on a distant island, experiencing the ups and downs of the mercenary life.

title: Demonborg Mining Co
description: Demonborg Mining Co is a unique rogue-lite about mining the insides of giant demon cyborgs with your auto-firing turret loaded drill drone.

title: Ark Re:Code
description: The end is here and it’s horny… Dive into a wild post-apocalyptic RPG packed with sexy girls, mutants, and more H-scenes than you can handle. Build your harem and fuck these hotties like the fate of humanity depends on it!

title: RaceXXL Space
description:
This game is a racing game that passes in space. Includes 14 challenging space paths and a great race with classic cars ..

Get ready to race in space with 14 classic cars !.

Collect points using the car that is open for you. Buy Level and Buggies with these scores.

Avoid missiles and obstacles in the Arena with your real opponents.
Get the highest prize money in case you win.

title: Sans & Papyrus: Salsa Lesson
description: papyrus teaches sans how to salsa like a proper individual. isn't that nice? that's so nice. very nice. so nice.

title: Morse Shingou de Ai wo Tsutae yo.
description: Morse Shingou de Ai wo Tsutae yo. is a PC game designed to teach players Japanese Morse code.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Warpath
description:
UNSC cadets are taught to imitate—and thereby venerate—the martial actions of humanity’s time-honored heroes.
Operation: Warpath ennobles their legend with myth-made armor sets, the epic resurgence of Invasion mode, and a return to hallowed tradition in the Ranked Legacy rotational playlist.
Harken ye to the drums of war. Operation: Warpath sallies forth!

title: Ultimate Theater Simulator
description: Ultimate Theater Simulator is a first-person cinema management game where you screen movies, serve snacks, hire staff, handle chaos, and grow your dream theater from the ground up.

title: Lǐ Shì Qírén Yì Wén Lù
description: A Arknights fan game featuring the original character ‘Old Li’ as the protagonist, set in Lungmen twenty years ago, where a series of mystery-solving and detective stories unfold.

title: Cry of Monster
description: Everything fell apart. People started getting sick… not in a normal way. Now the city is desolate, and the only thing that matters is finding out if your best friend is still alive. You'll have to explore, run, hide, and face the contamination.

title: Melody before the Dawn
description: Celica, a young girl living in the far north, finds herself every night stepping into another world through her dreams—one filled with sights she has never seen, vibrant companions, and a miraculous encounter. Yet as tender feelings begin to awaken, she is reminded that it is nothing more than an illusion… What is the connection between dream and reality, and how will their destinies change? Shrouded in mist, she spreads the wings of her dream and sings for the coming dawn.

title: Jiǔzhōu Jiàn Gē
description: Jiuzhou Jian Ge is a 3D Wuxia MMORPG, crafted with cutting-edge next-generation technology to bring the most authentic fantasy martial arts world to life. Experience a vast Jianghu of vendettas and brotherhood, explore meticulously designed immersive maps, master elegant and powerful Qinggong, and face countless rare beasts. Engage in thrilling duels at Huashan, fight for supremacy on Songshan, and forge a one-of-a-kind martial world that belongs only to you!

title: Road to Fame
description:
Road to Fame is a street racing game. It is set in "Old Steel City" where the mayor, unable to put an end to illegal street racing, decided to start entirely legal street races for professionals. The player is an amateur driver who is trying to earn his position in the racing world.

The game offers a training mode, where the player can choose any track and practice driving around it, and an arcade mode, which consists of a series of time trials (where the track must be completed within a limited time) and races against other players. Completing the races grants the player money, which can be used to purchase better cars. The game also contains a workshop where the player can repaint his car, or buy decorations.

There are 10 tracks to choose from and 27 cars, based on actual car brands but with false names; each car has slightly different capabilities.

title: Alias Underground Episode 1: SD-6 Agent Training
description: Your first step into espionage: go through training drills at SD-6 to master stealth, movement, and combat before heading into real missions.

title: Alias Underground Episode 2: Mission - Turkish Embassy
description: Infiltrate the Turkish Embassy, steal a sensitive document from the Ambassador’s office, and sneak out without blowing your cover.

title: Alias Underground Episode 3: Mission - Raid On SD-6
description: Raid the SD-6 headquarters: rescue hostages, disable security systems, and escape under pressure.

title: Alias Underground Episode 4: The Circumference
description: In a Taipei laboratory, locate and destroy the Rambaldi device known as “The Circumference” before escaping the facility alive.

title: Alias Underground Episode 5: Turkish Embassy — CIA Countermission
description: Returning to the Turkish Embassy but with a twist: now the CIA counters your infiltration, so expect more patrols, tighter security, and tricky disguise requirements.

title: Alias Underground Episode 6: CIA Mission – Return To SD-6
description: Sydney teams up with Vaughn to steal critical intelligence from within an SD-6 facility. Tension rises: can Vaughn avoid detection while Sydney walks the tightrope of deception?

title: Alias Underground Episode 7: Phase One
description: Sydney finally gets her chance to take down SD-6 and the Alliance. Can she deliver the intel and survive?

title: Alias Underground Episode 8: Breakout
description: Sloane has assembled a dangerous Rambaldi microwave weapon and captured Vaughn and Caplan. It's up to Sydney to infiltrate the compound, rescue them, and stop the device from being activated.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 4 - Heart of the Dragon
description:
The Timestream Entanglement has drawn the Seven Capitals together, forming the Heart of Heaven. After Knull’s fall, Hela is imprisoned in the An'Hay-Zhidi, where Dizang—Devil of the Eighth City—dares her to atone for her sins. But Angela will not forgive her betrayal. She arrives in the Heart of Heaven demanding Hela be handed over, yet its guardian refuses to surrender someone under his protection. Justice will be served and a debt will be paid.

But while they fight, an even greater danger stirs. Doctor Doom seeks to steal the Chronal Chi of the slumbering dragon Shou-Lao, threatening to unravel the fate of the Heavens themselves.

Can Iron Fist protect the Immortal Dragon… or will Doom claim its power?

title: Alias Underground Episode 9: Countdown
description: To prevent a doomsday prophecy, Sydney must acquire the Rambaldi Heart on a heavily guarded ship docked in Cartagena. Can she do it before the NSA is forced to destroy the ship and the Heart?

title: Alias Underground Episode 10: Endgame
description: The finale: Sydney must break into Sloane’s heavily guarded compound, confront the mastermind, and secure the final Rambaldi artifact before disaster strikes.

title: Dragon Age II: The Black Emporium
description: The Black Emporium includes a magic item store which will be restocked as the story progresses, a mabari hound, a "Mirror of Transformation" which allows you to change Hawke's appearance, and a crafting store which sells unique recipes.

title: Yì Shìjiè Wúlítóu Shēnghuó 2
description: This is a text otherworld adventure game that allows you to advance the game's plot with different choices.

title: Dragon Age: Inquisition - The Black Emporium
description:
The Black Emporium expansion adds four high-level stores that sell epic weapons, powerful accessories, new crafting materials and schematics, and other hard-to-find items. Change your facial appearance with the Mirror of Transformation. Accessible from the war table, The Black Emporium provides even more ways to customize your Inquisition.

NOTE: Despite being available very early in the game, the description of the associated war table mission spoils an important plot detail that happens later in the game. Therefore, it is advisable to access this DLC (or at least read its war table description) only after completing the "In Your Heart Shall Burn" main quest.

title: Dragon Age: Inquisition - Spoils of the Avvar
description: The Spoils of the Avvar content pack adds new personalization elements to your Inquisition, including the Avvar Mount Pack, which contains five different beasts to ride across Thedas. Charge into battle atop a war-painted mount! Bring the unfettered spirit of the Avvar to Skyhold with several options to customize your base. The Spoils of the Avvar content pack also includes two sets of unique armor as loot and schematics to give your party the advantage against your foes.

title: Dragon Age: Inquisition - Spoils of the Qunari
description: The Spoils of the Qunari content pack adds new items to your Inquisition, inspired by the style of Par Vollen! Bring the Qun to Skyhold with several options that represent your dedication to discipline, from a massive warrior throne to various sculptures honoring the Qunari people. The Spoils of the Qunari content pack also includes two sets of unique armor as loot, including an Arishok armor set, as well as schematics to craft new pieces for your party members. Ride across Thedas atop an armored war mount and vanquish your enemies in the name of the Qun!

title: Dragon Age: Origins - Feastday Gifts
description:
There are ten unique Feastday gifts available - one for each companion - as well as two generic items that can be given to any companion.

This content requires game version 1.03 or newer.

title: Dragon Age: Origins - Feastday Pranks
description:
There are ten unique feastday pranks available - one for each companion - as well as two generic items that can be given to any companion.

This content requires game version 1.03 or newer.

title: Isekai x Isekai: Tsugi ha Dono Sakuhin wo
Quest for Cathay Kingdom Mah Jong
description: Quest for Cathay Kingdom is a solitaire Mah Jong game. It uses combinations of Mah Jong board game with puzzle match-3, bets and wildcards. This gameplay can be enjoyed separately, or within an engaging story with a rich narrative based on historical facts.

title: 3AM on Fish Island
description: Walk the streets of Fish Island and collect food. Become sober. Stay alert. There are ghosts. Made with the Godot Engine.

title: Liàn yǔ wèi xiē zhī yǔ
description:
The story takes place in a world where “belief becomes reality.”
Yang, the male protagonist who has lost part of his memory, meets a girl named Xiaoyu who claims to be his childhood friend and girlfriend.
Together, they embark on a journey to recover their shared memories — and along the way, they uncover the truth behind Yang’s amnesia.

title: Unfair Flips
description: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

title: Smash N' Crash
description: Where'd you get your driver's license? A vending machine? Doesn't matter—just punch it and survive. Build your ultimate death machine and tear through high-speed chases, explosive races, and chaotic deathmatches.

title: Ricochet Abyss
description: Dive into Ricochet Abyss, a unique blend of tactical backpack management, hero-building, and pinball-style combat. Organize your inventory, equip powerful gear, and send your heroes ricocheting through perilous dungeons—every shot and item choice could be your key to survival!

title: The Last Scion
description: Shrug off bullets, smash buildings with your bare hands, and soar through the air as you battle diabolical supervillains! A text-based interactive superhero novel.

title: House Filled With Cats
description: Embark on a heartwarming hide-and-seek adventure in House Filled With Cats! Explore beautifully hand-drawn, whimsical rooms filled with cozy charm as you hunt for adorable, mischievous cats tucked away in every nook and cranny. Can you find them all? Purrhaps!

title: Maze Lovers Memorial
description: ​Guide a marble through 80 physics-based puzzles set in an atmospheric cemetery. Each solved maze brings flowers and a dad joke to the tombstone, viewing death in a lightening and natural way. A meditative game about movement, memory, and a positive view of the acceptance of death.

title: Bell & Hoof: The Silent Journey
description: A short walking simulator about a quiet cow, a forgotten chapel, and golden bells. Less than 10 minutes. No enemies. Just peace and hooves, and walking.

title: Rainbow Crown
description: Rainbow Crown is a classic RPG adventure game. Fight powerful enemies in the game world. Grow stronger step by step by levelling up, getting equipment, and more, and finally reclaim the Colorful Crown!

title: FickleFlame
description: We invite you to experience our immersive, story-driven Platformer about a candle trying to save it's candle world.

title: Stash: A Card Looter
description: Stash: A Card Looter is a roguelite autobattler with asynchronous multiplayer, where players draft from a loot pile of randomized cards to build unique strategies. Inspired by ARPG-style loot, cards appear in endless variations, including uniques, legendaries, and even set items.

title: The Dark Quarter
description: A companion app necessary for playing the The Dark Quarter board game from Lucky Duck Games. The Dark Quarter is a cooperative adventure game that tells a rich, adult, dynamic story, mixing an app with physical components.

title: Practical Pinball
description: This game is a simple pinball game to show off the game development knowlegde this developer possesses at this time. It features simple drawn characters and fun boards with all kinds of different themes for players to enjoy.

title: Room For One!
description: Race your friends to the last available hotel room in this online platforming racing game. Speed and skill are all you need to make sure you're the one coming out on top!

title: A Place Far Away
description: After the catastrophe that almost decimated humanity, Anya and her father Caledon can only rely on each other to survive. Embark on a journey of self-discovery, love, friendship and purpose in A Place Far Away.

title: Tails of the North
description: Explore northern lands and it's inhabitants as a young cat. Begin unraveling the mystery of a spirit's disappearance.

title: Karma Jump
description: After taking his own life, Bobi awakens in a shadow realm ruled by the Angel of Darkness. To escape eternal torment, he must complete twisted trials tied to his past sins. Fight for redemption in this dark narrative adventure.

title: PlayAgain 2: The Golden Legend
description: A few days ago, a bright meteor streak across of the sky, the golden light lit up the whole sky. The color of golden symbolizes wealth, power, strength, sacredness and happiness, has attracted countless adventurers, including you, on the adventurous journey for this reason...

title: Winslow
description: A boy, home alone, wanders into a shadowy underworld of knights and skeletons. Navigate a cunning labyrinth, find keys, solve color puzzles, and dodge foes in this gripping side-scroller. Uncover secrets in a haunting, nonlinear adventure.

title: The Path of Blades
description: A brutal, arcade-style dungeon crawler with modernized combat, Souls-like intensity, and retro-inspired visuals.Classic Dungeon Crawling Reimagined Arcade Souls-Like Gameplay

title: Dìwáng Chāiqiān Bàn
description:
After becoming a wandering soul, even reunions beyond destiny feel weightless and fleeting.
If true feelings are dressed up in clever, flowery words, then don’t listen, don’t speak.
Shh— do you see it?
The flickering light and shadow cast by his revolving lantern.

title: Thank You for Your Time
description: In a surreal audition purgatory, how long will you wait to be chosen?

title: Where's That Clown?!
description: Where's that Clown is a frantic top down arcade game where you must keep impatient kids entertained throughout chaotic birthday party venues. Dash around, dodging toddlers and parents as you try to get the highest score!

title: Cave of Gurg
description: "Dark. Silent. Waiting." This is a text-based, turn-based strategy mini-game that runs on the command line. You play as a hunter exploring a mysterious cave in pursuit of the terrifying, man-eating creature known as the "Gurg."

title: Paper Depths
description: In a retro-futuristic office run by machines, help Florence complete the work across looping tasks. Solve puzzles, navigate bureaucracy, and manage your time wisely in this solo isometric adventure.

title: Baraban: Master of Bargain
description: Baraban: Master of Bargain is a first-person marketplace buyer simulator set in the setting of retroview and Kharkiv of the future!

title: 1999 Christmas Eve
description: A freeware sound novel created in the Kirikiri engine about a couple whose car breaks down on Christmas Eve night after they heard strange voices coming from the radio, forcing them to take refuge in a nearby church.

title: AnderKant
description: Maneuver your way through strange worlds and get to experience soundscapes that transport your mind to new dimensions. Prepare to explore 7 abstract environments, while 7 instrumental sound-tracks inspired by Trance, Techno, Hardcore and other dance related music guide you through your journey.

title: Magic Tiny Lands
description: Magic Tiny Lands is an action-platformer where a small knight travels through a mystical forest to defeat the evil unleashed by a magical monolith.

title: Strawberry Chocolate
description: Strawberry chocolate" is a "Bang Dream" Doujin Game. It's a pixel style RPG, Players will operate Anon and Taki in different game worlds to carry out crazy adventures, and the cute and loving interaction between the two is the game's greatest charm ......

title: Hello Loaf
description: In Hello Loaf, you’re dropped into unique illustrated environments. These aren’t just static text, they’re alive. Each letter you discover triggers a unique animation, sound cue, and sometimes even changes the world – unveiling secrets, triggering mechanisms, or telling a story piece by piece.

title: Study Arcade
description: Study > Play > Repeat

title: Edge of the End
description: A young kid returns to his boyhood home in search of closure amid strong family ties and regrets while uncovering bittersweet memories.

title: Ivan Poe
description: Ivan Poe is a third person find-your-way puzzle adventure following this cuboid character as they keep truckin' on through the Cosmic Soup.

title: Merica Tale
description: This is a female-led alternate history visual novel where all historical figures have their genders reversed. The story begins with General Georgina Washington’s execution, and France falling alongside Merica. A young lady, Napoleon Bonaparte rises to challenge Queen Georgina III of Britain.

title: Is This a Game?
description: Is THIS a game? Well, it has everything you'd expect: buttons, pixels, achievements, a mouse-cursor to point and click sometimes, an axolotl, more than 50 mini-”games”. Is this enough? What even is a game? How much interactivity do you need? Are games art? Are there TOO many axolotls in this game?

title: Yap Wizards Tower Defence
description: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!

title: I Suppose
description: A story of a simple walk home, with a sprinkling of intrusive thoughts. Make a few choices, decide what's best, and please, try not to overthink.

title: 50 Cents Please
description: You are stranded in a subway where everybody has seemingly disappeared. With only a penny to your name, solves puzzles around the map and find your way out. Explores shops, and various rooms--and avoid the train tracks.

title: Pocket Garden
description: Pocket Garden is a super cute little indie game where you can build the coziest gardens and have the best time ever! No worries about resources, fighting, or health. Just sit back, relax, and enjoy!

title: AcroChallenge
description:
Unleash Your Wit in AcroChallenge: The Ultimate Acronym Game!
Dive into the hilarious and engaging world of AcroChallenge, the fast-paced word game where creativity reigns supreme! Compete against friends and strangers alike to craft the wittiest and most memorable phrase for a randomly generated acronym, ranging from 3 to 7 letters (e.g., "XYZ"). Think fast and type faster – the clock is ticking!

Showcase your linguistic prowess and impress your friends with clever and insightful phrases, or simply elicit laughter with silly and absurd interpretations. AcroChallenge is perfect for players of all skill levels looking for a fun and challenging party game experience.

Play Your Way: Bots, Friends, or New Acquaintances
AcroChallenge offers multiple ways to play! Jump into a random game with a single click for instant action. Or, create your own custom game and challenge AI bots, Steam friends (coming soon), or make new connections with players from around the globe. It's your game, your rules! This is a great online multiplayer game to play with friends.

Take the Acronym Challenge to the Next Level
Want an extra layer of difficulty? Introduce round-specific "Topics" to guide your phrases, adding a strategic element to the word association game. Set by the server, game winner, or game creator, these topics will push your creativity to its limits. Enjoy real-time chat with fellow players during the game but fear not, you have the power to mute anyone whose words don't contribute to the fun!

title: Invasive Species
description: Invasive Species is a couch co-op tower defense game where you and your friend plant towers in pots to protect your grandparents greenhouse from the robot invasion! Get scrap from defeating enemies and buy upgrades in the catalogue to fend off against more difficult waves of enemies.

title: Math Attack
description: Math Attack is a mathematical puzzle game about using math operations to reduce expressions to zero. Each level presents a clever numerical riddle hidden behind deceptively simple notation. It’s a game of logic, foresight, and elegant solutions.

title: Hentai Unlimited
description: Dive into the world of Hentai Unlimited, a captivating and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is deceptively simple: rotate pieces to reveal tantalizing, lewd artwork. But beware, it's more addictive than you might think! Each picture is randomly selected, pulled fresh from the web for an infinite supply of hentai puzzles.

title: Call of Hentai Neko
description: Dive into a unique puzzle game where your goal is to match pairs of images to unveil the full picture. Experience the satisfaction of completing each lewd puzzle and unlocking stunning visuals. Call of Hentai Neko offers a leisurely and rewarding match-two game experience.

title: Night Furries
description: Escape into the tranquil world of Night Furries, a beautifully crafted puzzle game designed for pure relaxation. Immerse yourself in the soothing gameplay as you strategically rearrange tiles to reveal stunning images. Night Furries offers a delightful and calming experience for players of all skill levels.

title: Zenith Realms
description: Guide Ninami on a heartfelt journey through the realms of a fractured planet. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and piece together the truth of a shattering past with a mysterious raven.

Imprisoned for five years, Lancelot is tasked with a mission to defeat the world's greatest threat - Cathedral. Take back the Holy Power from hostile enemies, save humanity, and get revenge for your friend. The 'true ending' of the Fallen Knight series will end in this chapter.

title: Creepy Camping
description: Indie Horror. The main character arrives in the forest in a Motorhome. The forest is covered with secrets and mysteries. Exploring the forest, over time, the campsite turns into a real nightmare. The hero understands that he is not alone in the forest...

title: The Googol Clicker
description: Could you reach the googol value which is 1e100? Idle clicker game with simple goals but very addictive gameplay!

title: I Can't Hear Your Words, So I Want To Listen To Your Heart
description: This is a visual novel that tells a story of healing and pure love, with a focus on inner descriptions, set in a school.

title: Let's Learn Korean! Hangul
description: Study Hangul as you explore the Republic of Korea and learn about its culture, cuisine and history. Practice each new Hangul letter by playing fun mini-games.

title: Let's Learn Korean! Vocabulary
description: Learn over 200 Korean words by completing fun challenges. Unlock mini-games, art and music.

title: Chasing the Universe
description: Chasing the Universe is a light fast FPS platformer. Slide and teleport to gather the stars as fast as you can !

title: Landline
description: Prevent murder cases with the telephone.

title: Desktop Pet Project
description: Elevate your PC experience with charming desktop pets. Inspired by such a wonderful invention as Shimeji, Desktop Pet Project has tried to collect the most interesting and curious mechanics. You can summon up to two pets that will have slight personalities in behavior.

title: Blue Shutter
description: Uncover the secrets of the night in a 2.5D pixel art adventure. Explore, unveil mysteries and fight.

title: Hentai Heroes
description: Dive into the captivating world of Hentai Heroes, a unique puzzle game where solving sexy puzzles unlocks the hearts of adorable anime girls! Use your strategic thinking and one-handed gameplay skills to conquer 25 challenging levels filled with engaging and relaxing scenarios.

title: Lines'98
description: Lines'98 is a classic computer logic game. The object is to strategically arrange balls into lines or shapes on a 9x9 game board. Once balls are aligned, they're destroyed and you're awarded a certain amount of points. However, each time you aren't able score, the program throws three additional balls into the mix.

title: World Eater
description: WORLD EATER is a bossfight game about an underpaid astronaut fighting a giant worm in space. Fight your way through varying planets and defeat the colossal worm!

title: Blest
description: In BLEST, you are responsible for defending the sacred statue. You must use all your wits and the goddess's divine power to eliminate all the monsters that enter through the cathedral's main gate. May the goddess be with you!

title: Sporeborne
description: SporeBorne is a top-down, action hack-and-slash game where you play as an estranged mutation of a fungus infesting the planet H311. Embark on a journey, slashing through your enemies, growing more powerful, and uncovering abilities as you traverse this planet's infested land.

title: Gear Combination
description: Gear Combination is a puzzle game where you combine gears of different sizes to reach a target rotation speed. Place gears freely and watch them spin together. Multiple quests can be played in any order and replayed. Simple yet strategic. Perfect for gear lovers.

title: Subspace Reticulum
description: Blow up bots beyond the stars. AI Driven 2D Spaceship Warfare

title: SoulGatherer
description: One world. One soul. Countless fragments.

title: My Putrid Ponies
description: A zombie ponies game where you have to survive with a shotgun.

title: The Chroma: From the Wasteland
description: A western occult FPS game against the unknown on a train speeding through the western wilderness.

title: Shifting Sands
description: Welcome to the Nexus. You died, the sandpit brought you back, and now you have a shift to finish as a scrapper. Scavenge crashed ships, cram your pack with dangerous salvage, meet odd survivors, and make it home each day through a weird desert world before the storm resets the sands and you with it.

title: Boukyaku no Edicius
description:
She wants to “end” happily ever after...

Saku Koshimizu, the protagonist of this story, is a victim of power harassment and has no courage to commit suicide.

On the day he skipped work, he met a girl who calls herself Nagisa, and they went out on a one-day date.

title: After Mankind: TD
description: A sci-fi Tower Defense game where you build your own towers by combining different modules to create unique structures. The damage system and unique enemies will force you to choose weapons for each threat separately. Study the glossary to learn more about each enemy.

title: Ratatata
description: Ratatata is an isometric Tower Defense game where you lead a space rat kingdom fending off a ruthless cat invasion! Fight across diverse environments and adapt your strategies to survive the relentless waves of these fierce felines!

title: Panama Canal Clash
description: Who will become the master of the Panama Canal? Everything will be decided in the game Panama Canal Clash!

title: Sad Virus
description: Walking simulation in open world where player controls virus whose mission is to find beer bottles so he can be happy again

title: Goddess of the Miracle
description: Bereaved by the war, the heroine had been into sleep in the ruins of gods for three hundred years. After awakening, she lost her memory in order to save the life of the man who had awakened her from the miracle. But the new life seems not so smooth as expected...

title: Kitty's Hungry Adventure
description: Kitty's Hungry Adventure is a hardcore cozy platformer about Kitty’s adventures as she tries to cook the most delicious dishes while overcoming dangers and solving puzzles.

title: Make Tracks Great Again
description: This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again: Only by ensuring trains depart the platform fully loaded with correct cargo can you earn more money and restore the station's greatness.

title: Witch & Bun Cats
description: A light ARPG game that integrates backpack management. In the game, players will play the role of a little witch and help the cats take back the cans that were taken away by monsters. But as you explore deeper, you find that things are not as simple as they seem...

title: Mind Rift
description: Mind Rift is a sci-fi visual novel where you follow your guide, Oni, to explore consciousness splitting in a multi-consciousness simulated world. This immersive journey lets you experience your consciousness scattering across different times and spaces through meaningful dialogue and choices that shape the story.

title: Underground: Chapter 1
description: Underground is a first-person horror-puzzle game where you explore a mysterious subway system, solve deadly puzzles, and escape the creatures lurking in the dark. Will the train take you home—or deeper into the nightmare?

title: Deadliest Pigeon
description: Equip weapons against physics-based enemies, swing through chaos with grappling hook and destroy everything in your path to avenge the little chick!

title: My Sticker Zoo
description: My Sticker Zoo is a relaxing strategy and puzzle game where you build your own zoo. Construct impressive habitats for your sticker animals by placing tiles. Manage a variety of wildlife parks as you unlock new scenario's. Collect all the stars, set new high-scores and become an expert ranger!

title: PandaBomber
description: Step into the explosive world of PandaBomber, a modern reimagining of the classic Bomberman experience! Engage in fast-paced, strategic gameplay that challenges you to think on your feet while delivering heart-pounding action.

title: Summer Beach Trip
description: Escape to a sunny getaway with Summer Beach Trip, a captivating puzzle game where you'll spend a memorable summer day at the local beach. Unlike usual, you're not alone! Meet and interact with seven lovely girls, each presenting their own unique puzzle challenge.

title: Magic Frog
description: Control a magic student who, after messing up a spell, turned into a frog. Fly on a broomstick, dodge and shoot obstacles and enemies, collect items, and gain new abilities while trying to survive as long as possible.

title: Deadly Runner
description: Help the Girl to overcome her fears and get out of the world of nightmares. Jump over obstacles, spikes, traps and beware of monsters!

title: Save The Bear Cubs
description: Save the bear cubs is an incredibly challenging 2.5D platform game. In this game, you can die from absolutely everything! If you like challenging platform games, then this game definitely deserves your attention! Playing as a polar bear, you will need to save all the cubs.

title: Shel: The Cure
description: SHEL: The Cure is a Replicant Diagnostics Simulator. Perform alchemy with spinal fluid, analyze brain scans, commune with otherworldly beings and prescribe treatments with the help of the Manual - an objective and unbiased* guide provided by your interstellar corporate employer.

title: The Room Stalker
description: You are trapped in a hotel room. Find the anomaly and break free from the loop.

title: Sweet Beach Holidays
description:
Dive into Sweet Beach Holidays, the ultimate adult puzzle game where relaxation meets romance! Join three unique and stunning 3D girls on a tropical island getaway and experience a vacation filled with sun, sand, and sweet surprises.

As you progress through 18 challenging card levels, unlock tantalizing rewards including 36 real-time, adult CG scenes. Each girl has her own distinct personality and desires, rewarding you for your attention.

title: Dark December
description: Engage in fierce battles against powerful enemies and create your own combat style through unique combinations of weapons and skills Each character comes equipped with distinct abilities and weapons, and by strategically allocating bonus stat points, you can take on even the most formidable monsters

title: Pig
description:
In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.

Though the game is simple... what The Alleyman offers isn’t: more time. Beat him, and attain extra life—lose, and he takes what time you have left.

And you? You’re dying anyway, frail body ravaged by an incurable disease.

A single die. A single choice: Will you take the deal?

title: Dào zhī Zhàn
description: The combat system of this game is roughly divided into three directions - real-time combat system, semi-real-time combat system and delayed combat system, which correspond to the three classes of martial artist (not yet open), fighter and celestial master.

title: Football Manager 26 Console
description:
New foundations set the stage for you to shape your football destiny. Built on the Unity engine, FM26 Console places you at the heart of the beautiful game. This is the legacy, redefined.

Delivering effortless, instinctive console control, a redesigned user interface combines with the most immersive matchday experience in series history to bring you closer to every match-defining moment.

Build your superstar squad with new transfer tools and bring your footballing vision to life through innovations that deliver enhanced tactical realism.

title: Ursid
description: Ursid is a zen puzzle game inspired by the constellations and the beauty of their imaginary pictures. Connect the stars, explore the hidden images, you will gradually reveal an emotional father-son story while counting down to the moment the Ursid Shower appears.

title: Wild Snap
description: Wild Snap is a relaxing short puzzle game about finding creative, strange and logical ways to attract animals and take pictures of them.

title: Beautiful Summer
description:
Dive into Beautiful Summer, a captivating 2D adventure game where you'll navigate the joys and challenges of finding love at a vibrant recreation center. After a sudden breakup, your solo vacation turns into an unexpected opportunity to connect with a variety of captivating characters.

Explore the open world setting, filled with charming locations and intriguing storylines. Your mission? To win the hearts of the girls you meet. Engage in meaningful dialogue, discover their interests, and shower them with thoughtful gifts. Plan unforgettable dates and unlock their gratitude as you build bonds and experience the joys of summer romance.

title: Cardygon
description: Cardygon is a 100% single-player strategic deckbuilder. Collect 80+ cards from the Batpolygon universe crossover. Devise powerful strategies, customize your profile, and build the ultimate deck!

title: Ben's World
description: This game takes you through many open worlds. Explore the worlds through stunning graphics and beautiful views. You have to explore what this game has to offer, this game will truly blow you away.

description: In Oldschool Tennis you can set the settings to emulate every version directly on your computer!

description: Three mini games. "Boat Racer" - high replay ability in that obstacles are spawned randomly each race. No 2 races the same."Knazi Knockout" 3rd person brawler - it's just fun to beat up Nazis, right? "Nazi's in the Mist" FPS that is the crown jewel of this trifecta of minigames

title: Ares Fighter
description: Ares Fighter" is a vertical scrolling flight shooting game. The player controls the protagonist fighter to fight the enemy in the air.

title: Islet Hell

You have to shoot down all enemy planes and sink all enemy ships in order to win at each level. A radar at the bottom right of the screen allows you to locate all enemies as red dots with regard to your position, which is a black dot at the middle of the radar. Navigate the plane with the arrow keys in typical flight-simulator style: Left and Right for roll and Up and Down for pitch motion. Shoot with the space-bar. That is all! You have no bombs so you have to sink ships by simply shooting at them. However, they can fire missiles at you.

title: Love Girls
description: Indulge in a tranquil puzzle game that is sure to uplift your spirits.

title: So I bought a little chainsaw
description: So I bought a little chainsaw is an Interactive Fiction game featuring reviews for a little, cursed chainsaw. Will the small decisions you make change the fate of the world?

title: Covid Quest 2077
description: Earth has fallen to COVID-2077. Your mission: Rescue your fellow survivors throughout the universe.

title: Super Sonday
description: This is a 2D action platformer where you star as Sonday, a young girl who can transform into a powerful tanooki to save the world.

title: Gate Warfare
description: "Gate Warfare" is a medieval fantasy roguelike tower defense game where players take on the role of a kingdom's hero. Fend off endless waves of demonic hordes, recruit companions, upgrade your skills, and defend the last bastion of hope—the great city of Belrak.

title: Let's Play Cards Solitaire
description: Let's Play Cards Solitaire is a classic single-player card game that is perfect for players of all ages.

title: Reformpunk
description: This is a co-op puzzle game centered around time control and object manipulation. Player 1, Sofia, has the ability to control time. Player 2, Thirteen, can alter objects using their energy, and even transforming themselves into energy to access unique abilities.

title: Cold Dead Hands
description: Cold Dead Hands is a "2D Infinite Runner-Shooter" where you, the player, have to survive as long as possible while shooting, crushing, and dodging zombies along the way. Post your score to the leaderboard to see if your score is one of the best around the world!

title: City of Stories: The Hunter's Heart - Collector's Edition
description: This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

description: This cute and bubbly game is everything you ever wanted in a vanilla sexy game. There are no frills or complicated mechanics, just simple and pure vanilla erotic scenes. Girls are cute and welcoming! The gameplay is highly polished and fun match 3 puzzle.

description: Party fantasy RPG. You control a party of characters, moving around the game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

description: Enter the arena in PKWAR, a hardcore PvP MUD where text-based combat meets competitive glory. Choose from 5 unique classes, battle players simultaneously, and rise through military ranks from Private to Captain. No graphics, no distractions - just pure skill-based combat. Death or glory.

title: Kuafu Chases the Sun

description: A fast-paced action roguelike where you fight through cursed circus arenas, unlock powerful abilities mid-run, and build your own combat style with every performance.

title: Sunny Love

Sunny love is a short visual novel where you play as a young photographer who didn’t strike big in the capital. He decides to visit his hometown to get some inspiration and new ideas for a comeback. Lady Luck smiles at him as he meets a certain redhead muse...

How this meeting will change his life? Will this muse allow him to get his dream job or will she become more important than anything else? It’s up to you!

description: Bunny Battle is a competitive first- and third-person shooter in which you have to fight against other players or bots. There are five different levels and seven game modes available to you. Choose your team and start fighting!

description: Do you have nothing to do? Don't want to load up a game where it takes a while to get into it? Well here is the perfect solution for you.

title: Lighthouse Stories: Book One - Part One
description: The Lighthouse universe now is open with this new Point and Click game, highly narrative with psychological horror.

description: we are doing this game for a project at "univercity". we hope you enjoy this game that we made. we have everything you would want, a main character who totally does not look like Pedro Pascal, a dragon, a run for your life and just some good old egg puns. - Ms Maddy of Breakfast Crew

title: GreenIsland
description: You need to survive on this unknown island after your helicopter crashed Powered By Unreal engine 5.1

title: Hatsuka
description: Aria, a cherished companion and lover, lost her life during an adventure. To fulfill her wish, the protagonist sets out to help the villagers and gather Hatsuka flowers. Enjoy enchanting pixel art, strategic battles, and a heartfelt story that captures the nostalgia of classic JRPGs!

title: Drink Stand Tycoon
description: Drink Stand Tycoon is a casual business management tycoon game. Whether you're looking to relax and manage stats or destroy the competition, Drink Stand Tycoon offers an approachable yet detailed experience both new and old tycoon fans will enjoy!

description: The game is a classic puzzle with three levels of difficulty.

description: 2.5 platformer game where player character is skeleton character. 9 different levels where player need solve different puzzles and make accurate jumps to reach star which is end of every level. Falling from a height kills player.

6 x 6 = 36

Locked away in an altogether strange room of sheer white,

Out of nowhere, the speaker declared the being of "another subject" ...

title: The Winter Wedding

This winter is unlike any other.

There are only 10 days left until your wedding.

Your life is about to change forever...

You can already feel the shift, as extraordinary events refuse to leave you in peace while the tension rises.

Walking the fine line between reality and illusion, you find yourself surrounded by darkness and sinister secrets.

Can you survive your wedding?
