description: The Adventures of Mononc is a turn-based RPG where satirical humor meets the exploration of diverse archipelagos. Recruit a quirky team, uncover hidden treasures, and dive into a captivating story with side quests and surprises around every corner.

title: Saint Goddess
description: This is a game featuring Goddesses + Roguelike + Puzzle-solving + ML + Full dubbing. As an envoy, you travel through various dimensions of the universe, encounter goddesses with diverse personalities, form emotional bonds, and create the future together with the goddesses.

title: Go Babies
description: Welcome to *Go Babies*, the ultimate baby racing extravaganza!

title: Ancient Ruins
description: Every choice matters!

title: My Bird
description: Your bird is one of the first birds to learn the basics of jet-powered flight

title: Finger Trees
description: Travel to different worlds to save every version of your family from the sickness created by Finger Trees.

title: FlyManMissile
description: Control missile to hit the enemy

title: Catch Royale
description: Remember playing tag? We spiced it up a little bit: Immerse yourself in Catch Royale: A stylized free-to-play Battle-Royale game with up to 250 players.

title: Welcome
description: WELCOME is a hardcore survival game that will be in a newer version with a bit of battleroyale style, where the task of the players is to survive on the map and wisely use sprint for stamina. Search for things to survive like food and drink, craft trees, stones and shrubs to extract the necessary resources to build a base where he can...

title: Ender Ocean
description: The Ender Ocean principle? Locate and collect waste (plastic bags, bottles, lost nets...) thanks to underwater robots connected to a collection boat, in order to valorize them afterwards, all from home.

title: Emoji TD
description: Emoji TD is a tower defense game  It's a nice and simple one with plenty of levels 🤔 and variety to keep you busy

title: Escape From Russia
description: This is an adventure horror game, the action of which takes place an alternative reality, in which it is necessary to help Alexei Marginalny to collect an American passport without getting caught by Vladimir Vladimirovich Vrutin and escape from an unprecedented Russia.

title: Desktop Cube-Man
description: This is a free multiplayer PC desktop game, you can simply place on the desktop or enter challenge mode. In challenge mode, you can just idle casually, or try to challenge higher difficulties with friends. You can gain experience through idle time and unlocks more behavior modes.

title: Ugmania
description: A sandbox survival game set in a universe full of procedurally generated worlds to explore and conquer!

title: Relaxjong
description: Relaxjong - Especially for fans of pleasant logic games that do not require haste, relaxjong was created!

title: Ai Dawn
description: The humans have developed Ai to a point that they are thinking for themselves. They have also developed desire; the desire to take over the universe. Join our hero -friend in this third-person shooter mission to stop this infestation.

title: Boss Hunter
description: Join our Boss Hunting friend in this bite-size, indie developed, boss battle game. You will encounter 6 unique and challenging bosses to defeat, but don't let the small number fool you. These are 6 bosses that won't give up easily. You must have the Boss Hunter spirit!

title: Color X Memory
description: Minimalistic puzzle game to test your visual memory. There are hidden colored cards on the field. Your task is to find paired cards by color opening paired cards. Good luck with your game.

title: Idle ShowOff
description: A game all about STEAM Friendlist.By using the "Show Off" button, you can CUSTOMMM Text to break through the dimensional wall and release your inner huge Presence to your STEAM Friends List ! ! ! All of your Friends on STEAM will see it （ This is the only one game has this feature on whole STEAM ）

title: Escape From Covid
description: Escape from Covid is a fun and exciting platformer. Guide your character through a contaminated world in which you have to escape the virus. Fight challenging bosses.

title: Fast & Blast
description: multiplayer survival mode story - you live in universe where boxes live but project balls got wild project balls escaped from lab and started killing boxes after that operation balls was made where you are in you need to destroy all balls to win this war with multiple weapons found in game

title: First Person Shooter
description: First Person Shooter is not at all what you think! This is not your typical run and gun gameplay, this is First Person Shooter, the game where you shoot yourself first!

title: Dig Down
description: A digging, treasure-hunting, roguelike adventure game. How deep can you dig?

title: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars
description: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments.

title: Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter
description:
Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter is a romantic, slice-of-life, fantasy visual novel.

It follows Emile Mayer, owner of A Slice of Comfort bakery in the Kingdom of Selias, when the Fae Kingdom's royal procession brings an interesting newcomer into his life.

title: I Am The Landlord
description: If you had a plot of land, what would you build on it? In "I Am The Landlord," you'll play as a landlord who owns an apartment building in the city center, starting from an empty plot and using your design skills and creativity to construct unique apartments.

title: I am a Senior Official
description: One of the features of the game is to let you experience the feeling of being an official. As a local official, when faced with the temptation of power and money, it is up to you to decide whether to abide by yourself or be corrupt.

title: Broken Space Traveler
description: "Broken Space Traveler" is a casual ROGUE game. Players will take on the role of travelers from different time and space, enhancing their abilities to manipulate various weapons and survive in the fragmented space.

title: RuneHero
description: Rune Hero is a MMOARPG set in the mystical world of Herud, a land of rune magic, treasures, and ancient conflicts. The game blends deep combat strategy, dynamic economies, and diverse gameplay modes for a truly immersive experience. Step into the roles of unique heroes with distinct skill trees and customizable builds. Whether focusing on burst damage, sustained DPS, or survivability, the multi-class system offers endless strategic possibilities. Combine abilities, experiment with synergies, and adapt to conquer any battlefield.

title: Block Granny Horror
description: Survive on the island and protect your family. Granny comes to hurt your wife or child. Craft weapons (bow, club, arrows) and fight Collect the food and feed your family.

title: BoltHead
description: Take control of a scavenger robot, venture amidst the wreckage of an ancient man-made structure, and attempt to find and gather power cells! BoltHead is a speedy 3D platformer with an expressive moveset, where only mastery of your servomotors will ensure your success!

title: I Wanna Ascend
description: As you climb this place, you will fall countless times, sinking into despair. Prove that you're not just a loudmouth coward—reach the top. The 2D platforming jump game that will break your keyboard: I Wanna Ascend.

title: Pedigree Tactics
description: Recruit monsters to battle in tactical, turn-based combat. Create the ultimate team through careful fusion to pass on powerful abilities and save this kooky hand-drawn world.

title: True Idle Simulator
description: How long can You do nothing?

title: Fantasy Legend. The Frozen Century
description: In this game, you will meet new companions on your journey and fight with them to explore the truth from a thousand years ago. The rich plot performance, vivid combat experience and various branch plots will allow you to deeply immerse yourself in that special world.

title: Professional Thief
description: Professional Thief - a first person stealth simulator where you play the role of a burglar and are supposed to rob a house.

title: Playtime With Hoogie
description: Hoogie hates visitors, perhaps? Find yourself in a dark forest where you must find different of number keys around the forest for a week before Hoogie finds you. Collect them all before then and after.

title: Putin Vs. Zombies
description: Zombies! The world was overtaken by the forces of Evil worse than ones from the ♂deep dark fantasies♂. But Putin is here to save the day and kisk some ♂***♂. Region by region, you must fight the ♂Slaves♂ of evil with Billy, Obama and your own army of defenders by your side. Primo Victoria!

title: Eclipse: 2nd Dawn for the Galaxy
description: The galaxy, once peaceful after the Terran-Hegemony War, now faces rising tensions. The Galactic Council's efforts to maintain peace are failing as alliances shatter and secret treaties form. A confrontation looms—who will emerge victorious and rule the galaxy? Lead your people to victory!

title: Pipe Down
description: A pixelated puzzle game about pipes. Enjoy puzzles at various difficulties in four unique modes!

title: Dark Lady
description: Dark Lady is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Velocity Rift
description: Take part in three unique modes, each of which will require your maximum concentration and skill. Beautiful stylized graphics immerse you in the atmosphere of an exotic racing island, where every track is a challenge.

title: Guns Craft
description: Guns Craft is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!

title: Chess President
description: A duel between darkness and light!

title: Rock and Stone
description: Rock and Stone is an idle background mining game where you play as a dwarf, mining rocks for valuable loot. You can sell your loot on the community market for profit or use it to get new gear and gold. Equip different gear—from common to legendary—to boost your stats and mine even more effectively.

title: Lights Out: Forgotten Past
description:
A short first person psychological horror game.

You are an electrician that has been called to an apartment to fix a faulty light.

As the night goes on your past catches up with you.

A 3d horror with multiple 4 endings.

title: Traditional Chinese Medicine Simulator
description: "Chinese Medicine Simulator" is a unique, self-made game with a different style from most other games on the market. It aims to help TCM enthusiasts and students learn more about Chinese Medicine with greater interest and efficiency, and to help beginners get started. Join the discussion in groups 494811550 (learning group), 697138589 (full), or 302219333 (group 2 is full).

title: Geimu Chagama Monogatari
description: What makes this game unique is that you can choose whether to defeat your enemies or befriend them. The items you get will change depending on whether you attack and defeat enemies or befriend them by giving them food. You can also combine items to create "kusuri," items that change your actions and stats. With a "kusuri" you can overcome obstacles that would normally be impossible to overcome. The key to the strategy is what items you get to make the medicine, and whether you defeat or befriend your enemies in order to do so.

title: Windweaver
description:
You are a Windweaver — once a guardian of the skies, now stripped of your full power. Cast from the heights, you must begin the long journey back to the Isle of Wind, relying only on the faint power that remains within you. Every step matters. Every jump demands precision. By bending the wind still at your command, you’ll run faster, leap farther, and cling to walls as you scale your way through a world of environments, obstacles, and pathways.

This high-speed action platformer has a direct emphasis on fluid movement and slope physics, where players will chain their abilities with environmental elements to build up incredible speed and execute spectacular combos to blitz through levels. Experience the thrill of windsurfing down mountain slopes, wall-running through ancient ruins, and soaring through the air as keep running to restore your lost flight - and maybe even discover the truth of your world as you meet new friends along the way!

title: A Sexy Tour With: Yeona
description: Embark on a titillating journey through South Korea with Yeona, your alluring tour guide. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with seductive reveals.

title: Xiānjiè Huàn Shì Lù
description:
Immortal Fantasy World is a 3D MMO Xianxia mobile game, blending cultivation themes with an adorable, cartoonish art style, breaking away from traditional realistic designs.

The visual design adds a touch of elegance and fantasy, while the main characters are no longer fierce and intimidating.
Instead, they take on a refreshingly cute and charming look—from tough warriors cutting down monsters on the battlefield to adorable characters full of humor and mischief.

The game features an original four-stage lightness skill, “Water Treading”, allowing characters to walk and dash across water.
And of course, no Xianxia world would be complete without sword flying, a core element of cultivation.

Cultivate your inner energy, overcome heavenly tribulations, and achieve ascension—
soaring through the skies and overlooking all living beings as you freely roam the immortal realm.

In Immortal Fantasy World, not only can your character ride their sword and fly,
but they can also master the unique four-stage lightness skill, “Water Treading.”
Whether you’re rushing to complete quests or enjoying romantic dual flights with a companion,
lightness skill is an essential ability for every cultivator!

title: Bleeding Metal Rainbow
description: Focus! Your battle will be short and sweet! Dodge and take your aim precisely. Spraying bullets all over the place gets you nowhere! How fast can you defeat the boss enemy?

title: Alone: Shattered Tribes
description: An isometric survival RPG without the survival. Collect resources and craft items and weapons. Build a settlement on your island. Hunt in the darkest forests, or slay the undead in the cursed crypts. Explore the islands, unite the shattered tribes, and become a Jarl worthy of the sagas.

title: Hentai Clicker: Cathy is Streaming
description: Step into a lewd adventure with Hentai Clicker: Cathy the Catgirl! Click to collect hearts, unlock sexy outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive clicker game. Enjoy gorgeous anime art, explicit content, and interactive voice acting with your favorite nekogirl!

title: Tomboy: Annoying Childhood Friend
description: Relive the nostalgia and embrace the playful chaos in Tomboy: Annoying Childhood Friend, an adult romance visual novel that delves into the complex relationship between childhood friends. Experience an emotional and steamy journey as Jimmy and Nana navigate their rekindled bond.

title: Puzletun: Curse of the unfortunate.
description: A retro throwback puzzle adventure that challenges you're timing and problem-solving skills.

title: Arcane Trigger
description: From the Creators of "Endgame of Devil" comes their latest masterpiece! This time, youre not the Devil Lord youre a gunslinger with magic at your fingertips! Pick your Arcane Bullets to lay down some serious firepower!

title: Pain Pain Go Away!
description: Pain Pain Go Away! is a therapeutic typing adventure where you dive into the heart of a troubled girl and type away the trauma that’s consuming her.

title: Koala Kids Golf
description: Control your Koala and collect treasure while avoiding dangers in this non-traditional Golf Game. Play through Challenges or with friends, Local or Online!

title: Karaoke Love Song
description: Share your best beautiful voice with a karaoke game themed around love songs.

title: Legend of Ymir
description:
Legend of YMIR is a free-to-play, MMORPG inspired by Norse mythology, available on PC and mobile platforms.

Experience the awe-inspiring details of Norse mythology brought to life with Unreal Engine 5. Step into a vivid and immersive world where ancient legends come alive.

Each season introduces new battlefields, stories, enemies, and events. Escape the monotony of fixed systems and embrace the ever-evolving combat that changes moment by moment.

Feel the thrill at your fingertips with intricate controls and convenient automatic systems, redefining the excitement of combat through an immersive hit-confirmation system and evade controls.

Your adventures, your choices. Every action and decision shapes your path, carving out your own unique journey. Start an adventure that begins with you and create a story that only you can tell.

title: Welcome to Chirpvenience
description: In Welcome to Chirpvenience!, take on a short-term part-time job at a small-town convenience store and spend a week in Lark Town. Through a first-person perspective, experience cozy, humorous, and surprising everyday life!

title: The Piper of Dawn
description: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

title: Yoshi Tanks Kawaii
description: In Yoshi Tanks Kawaii, play as up to six different Yoshi Tank Girls and use a variety of different powerups as you fire away at your opponents in this multiplayer turn-based artillery game, whether they be your friends, or AI controlled!

title: The Perfect Prince
description: The Perfect Prince is an adventure game featuring a touching story and storybook-style visuals. Progress through puzzles and light action, as the tale branches based on your choices and actions. Build bonds with the characters and shape a story that’s uniquely yours.

title: Safeguard Saga
description: With no martial arts skills, you inherit an escort guild and the late master's daughter. Now, as the new leader, you must recruit skilled escorts, protect precious shipments, settle Jianghu disputes, and fend off ruthless pirates. Build your guild into the most renowned in the land.

title: Time Foray
description: Time Foray is a puzzle platformer where you control Macky Bürg in a mission to infiltrate into a mysterious complex by using her ability to travel back in time. With it, she's capable of creating time paradoxes that allow her to cooperate with her future selves in order to advance through the complex.

title: Kotenok
description:
Play as a lost kitten in a dangerous forest! Master tight platforming controls, sprint, pounce, and double-jump through 50 tricky stages filled with spikes, enemies, and clever puzzles.

Explore vibrant pixel-art worlds, bounce on mushrooms, outsmart foes, and hunt for hidden collectibles. Can you guide this frisky feline home? A charming love letter to classic platformers!

title: Bop It! The Video Game
description: BOP IT! TWIST IT! PULL IT! The same great game you remember, now featuring pulse-pounding music, far-out backgrounds, and global leaderboards. Do you have what it takes to stay in the game?

title: Cats Visiting El Dorado
description: Discover El Dorado’s golden wonders while finding hidden cats in relaxing, hand-drawn scenes.

title: Balanced Food CalorieMate for Game Creators: Jelly Mission
description: Transform into a Calorie Mate JELLY and deliver nutrition to a game creator immersed in work. This action-adventure takes you on a journey through an apartment room.

title: UNI 2
description: The ultimate collection of 2-player mini games is here!

title: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Ultimate Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club Experience — worthy of the world’s most beloved beagle!

The Deluxe Edition includes the full base game plus exclusive extras: Snoopy’s legendary Joe Cool outfit, two Red Baron mini-games (Frozen Cave and Scorching Desert), and two soapbox racing challenges (Great Pumpkin Patch and Off-Road Challenge). Each adds new environments, obstacles, and ways to play.

Rounding out the package is the 75th Anniversary Comic Collection, featuring 75 full-color strips viewable in-game. With bonus adventures and classic Peanuts charm, the Deluxe Edition is the most complete Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club experience.

title: Smokkehed
description: Smokkehed is a music driven on-rails shooter set in a beautiful surreal world.

title: Welcome to the Dungeon
description: Place monsters and objects directly on a grid-based dungeon. Watch as heroes travel along the paths, interacting with the objects and events you’ve set up, and see if they grow according to your plan. Train them into stronger heroes and guide them to reach their ultimate destination!

title: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
description: Welcome to Hunter Haven! Bounty Brawl is a top-down action roguelite shooter for 1-4 players. Here, the hunt is fierce, and betrayal is inevitable. Will you form a fragile alliance with other hunters under the galaxy's most notorious bounties, or go it alone? Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

title: Warlords Battleground: Extraction
description: Search, fight, escape, flip your fate! In a Three Kingdoms world split across thirteen provinces, form a pact with the Dragon Maiden and explore war-torn fragments. Loot, battle, manage your gear—each run is a high-stakes gamble where your ending is yours to write.

title: Project Revenant
description: Project Revenant is a side-scrolling shooter that requires "Precision Aiming" at hitboxes using the cursor.

title: Nammo
description: ‘NAMMO’ is a Korean Dark Fantasy themed Soulslike game. Betrayed and blinded, Nammo awakens 'The Eyes of Spirit' to see into the soul realm. Play through and master 'The Eyes of Spirit' to expose weaknesses, defeat bosses with precise parries, and absorb their souls to forge your own combat style.

title: Slinkie Dinkie
description: Slinkie Dinkie has joined the SPG to bring back the most beloved virtual pet of all time!

title: NyctoType
description: A multithreaded typing battle where speed and strategy decide victory. command virus-shaped pieces, send them at each other, and destroy your opponent. Fast inputting alone won’t save you—think tactically in this fresh, competitive typing game!

title: Kaiju Cleaner Simulator
description: Clean up the aftermath of epic Kaiju battles in this brutal first-person simulator for 1-4 players. Carve up giant monster corpses, extract rare organs, operate heavy machinery, and wash away the blood and toxins polluting the city streets!

title: Deadly Trick
description: Survive the death game unfolding at school under the name "Special Class." You are not given any special role at the beginning. Depending on the situation or your own choices, you could become the White or the Shadow! Cooperate… or betray.

title: Sweet Hamster Days
description: I got reincarnated... as a hamster! My owners are three sisters: a charming cosplayer, a straight-laced and caring one, and one with a sharp tongue and a sweet side. I'm being showered in love... but who will I fall in love with?

title: Cat Island Petrichor
description: "Cat Island Petricolor" is an exploration adventure game set on Japan's summer "Cat Island." Become a cat, explore the island, and uncover the mysteries of Cat Island together with the heroine!

title: The Hidden Scrolls
description: The Hidden Scrolls is a turn-based roguelike tactical RPG with a Chinese-inspired setting. Explore five mysterious regions, battle fierce beasts and ruthless bandits, recruit and train a team of warriors to uncover the secrets hidden within ancient bamboo scrolls.

title: Tales of SclObonia
description: Embark on a turn-based RPG adventure with Kam and Simon who are summoned to the land of SclObonia. The two cousins must meet the inhabitants of the new-found land, unravel secrets long forgotten, and battle savage monsters and fathomless legions if they’re to ever find a way back home.

title: Kaiju Cracking Corporation
description: "KaijuCrackingCorp" is a simulation game about dismantling Kaiju. Manage your company, hire and train employees, and make decisions to maximize profits. Enjoy strategic gameplay mixed with fun mini-games for a unique and casual experience.

title: Unholy Trinity
description: A local multiplayer co-op game where a group of heroes explores a dungeon to collect treasures to power up in order to defeat the Fire Demon at the cost of potentially opening a portal to hell.

title: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
description: A drifting simulator featuring an authentic competition format and a judging system inspired by modern drift championships. Enhanced and updated physics, developed in collaboration with the CarX Motorsport team.

title: Your Big, Cute Monster Farm
description: Create a farm at the bottom of the screen and enjoy planting and harvesting with your monster companions! They handle all the work—just plan the layout, decorate, and wait for fun crop mutations. Take a break from busy life and enjoy the calm joy of farming.

title: Blokes on Blocks!
description: BLOKES on BLOCKS is a casual party game where you push your friends around. With simple controls this game is easy to pick up and play, suitable for everyone. Your actions happen just by moving around. Timing is everything so predict your blokes' next moves and knock them off their blocks!

title: Scribble Wolf
description: A Werewolf game (or social deduction game), in which you can control the character that you have drawn. Up to 10 players can play online. Perhaps the key to victory is to "draw tracing" of an opposing team's character and "disguise yourself" as it...?

title: Plump! Dumb Frog Pond
description: The future is chaos - frog attacks everywhere! You're a frog farmer in Potato Pioneer Town, build pond setups to attract different ugly frogs, then snatch them up in your bucket - Yoink! Toss your catches into tanks, fatten them up, and sell for big bucks.

title: For Zekyll
description: Every step forward rewrites your past. Dive into a cinematic fusion of first-person horror and novel. Featuring branching choices, and emotional storytelling.

title: Kotama and Academy Citadel
description: Kotama and Academy Citadel is a 3D Metroidvania game. Players assume the role of an exchange student named Kotama as she explores through the mysterious Academy Citadel, aiming to become the esteemed [Carmel Star].

title: Pin-Bang-Shot!
description: Pin-Bang-Shot! uniquely blends Pachinko pinball, roguelite, and turn-based strategy! Collect an arsenal of bizarre bullets and gear, team up with legendary gang leaders, and meticulously plan your ricochet paths and firing sequences. Clear the board in one glorious shot!

title: Glitchfall
description: Detect system anomalies! A fresh take on falling block puzzles that mixes Tetris-style gameplay with observation challenges.

title: FrightDiary
description: This is a decryption adventure game, need to explore every tomb, as far as possible to find clues to go out, the darkness is indispensable is the source of fire, ensure the transmission of fire, you can have the opportunity to go out.

title: Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward
description: 『Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward』 is a strategic defense game that fuses the depth of auto-chess with the intensity of tower defense.As a guardian of dreams, you must confront terrifying creatures born from trauma-fueled nightmares.

title: Chill Fox
description: Just Fox n’ Chill! Play as a clever fox exploring a peaceful farm and beautiful garden. Sneak around, catch the chickens, but beware... two guard dogs are on duty, and they take their job way too seriously. Can you outfox them all?

title: Breath of the Pasture
description: A heartfelt life-sim about love, land, and the magic of the countryside. Compose your very own pastoral symphony— Listen to the rain as it falls. Chase the breeze on sunny days. Watch crops reach for the sky. Let your cows and sheep rest in peace. Fall in love. Grow a farm. That is THE GAME!

title: Dress the Duel
description: "Dress the Duel," is a roguelike deckbuilding game where your cards are your wardrobe and your outfit is your arsenal!Build a versatile wardrobe, disrobe strategically, layer outfits for powerful effects, and Dress the Duel!

title: BB Adventure
description: “BB Adventure” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

title: Beast Gang
description: Place cards on a 5×5 board to complete hands in rows, columns, and diagonals in this fresh, casual puzzle game! Simple controls, deep strategy, and addictive combos await. Use items to turn the tide and push your score to the limit in endless mode!

title: Space Revolver
description: Space Revolver is a strategic puzzle game set in a space station. Use limited moves—such as map rotation, gravity control, and horizontal movement—to find the optimal path. Enjoy clever and deep puzzles with retro-style pixel art and a classic sci-fi atmosphere!

title: Hips N Noses
description: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

title: Cat Girl Survivor 2: Beyond the Veil
description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

title: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
description: In a continent inhabited by all kinds of monsters, fight and capture them while bonding with your "Puchimon" to turn them into your loyal battle partners.

title: Beautiful Life Show
description: Welcome to the deadly stage of The Beautiful Life Show a side-scrolling horror action adventure. As the star of a bizarre performance, you face fatal trials. Rewind time 3 seconds before death and collaborate with your replay ghost. Will you survive to witness what lies beyond the abyss?

title: Little Gods of Ancient Echoes
description: Embark on an adventure to discover hidden treasures throughout the world! Treasures come in many forms, including equipment items, currency, recipes, and music records. Of course, the path to uncovering these treasures is perilous. Monsters and traps will stand in your way.

title: Golden Swirl
description: GOLDEN SWIRL is a Roguelike Deck Builder blending fast-paced action with strategic card play in a dark fantasy world. Journey through shifting dungeons, uncover swirl secrets, and adapt to challenges with unique cards, relics, and a depravity system.

title: Final Formation
description: Equipped with the Fusion × Transformation “PELL” System! Free Map Side-Scrolling Shooter

title: Plushes
description: An insane first-person action-adventure, where cuteness has gone too far. Plushes have taken over the city, and there’s only one way out. Pick up a gun and your trusty shovel, and become a Plush Fighter! Shoot Plushes and turn enemies against one another!

title: Forsaken Lands
description: Brave heroes unite to challenge the gods themselves and decide the fate of the world! Dive into an epic roguelite deckbuilder adventure. Gather your friends and take on divine foes together in thrilling online co-op battles!

title: Union Survivors
description: "UNION SURVIVORS" is a roguelite mining survival game that supports online cooperative play for up to 4 players. Players dig through slime-filled terrain to carve their paths and defeat hordes of enemies.

title: Cultic: Chapter 2
description:
Defying death once again, you emerge from the deserted Police Station into the ravaged streets of New Grandewel. Corpses litter the roads, flames and smoke billow from nearby windows, and cultists infest every inch of the city you once protected.

Fight your way through a wide variety of new locations in a thrilling new campaign, with new weapons and enemies, a revamped dodge and tackle, a whole new soundtrack, and more! Chapter Two boasts a longer campaign with larger maps, offering an even bigger experience than the first Chapter!

title: Bygone Snow
description:
When the world ends, who will you spend your final hours with?

A short story (around an hour) about two people and their relationship as their time comes to an end.

title: Die drei ???: Geheimnis der Schattenhelden
description: Rocky Beach is the scene of a top-secret Hollywood action movie series plotted around a league of super heroes. But suddenly, the main actor has disappeared without a trace, along with his secret super hero suit. Help Jupiter, Peter, and Bob to find the actor and save the series!

title: Goofy Golf Remastered
description: Goofy Golf Remastered is a 5 reel, 25 pay-line slot machine (pokie) with a Zany Golfing theme, oriented from left to right.

title: Spooky Spins Deluxe
description: Spooky Spins Deluxe is a 4x5 reel, 40 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Spooky theme oriented from left to right.

title: The Street of Adrift
description: A story of the bond, redemption, and destruction between a noblewoman and the courtesan queen.

title: Mowing Simulator
description:
Take a mower in the relaxing Mowing Simulator! Mow grass manually at various levels such as yards, parks and lawns and even overpasses, golf courses and skyscraper roofs as well as at the most recognizable locations around the world.

You must fight with all your strength to endure the perils of the wasteland and embark on a journey fueled by the hope of survival. Prepare your gear, choose the tools that will keep you alive, and step forward – the path through the apocalypse begins at your feet.

title: Harem of Ankhutep
description:
Harem of Ankhutep is a visual novel set in the sun-drenched streets of Ankhutep, an ancient desert city where daily life unfolds in the shadow of gods, and monstergirls walk the same streets as everyone else as a natural part of everyday life. You, the player, begin your journey by escaping an attack on your homeland, and you arrive in Ankhutep to begin again, not as a warrior or a ruler, but as a humble craftsman.

Here, you’ll share meals, trade stories, and slowly carve out a new life surrounded by friendship, romance, and small, meaningful moments. Yet beneath the city’s warmth lie quiet mysteries, and every bond you form may open the door to ancient secrets waiting just out of sight.

Forge relationships with a diverse cast of monstergirl heroines, each with her own unique personality, ambition, and desire. Your decisions shape your path, unlock unique scenes, and reveal different sides of the story.

title: Super Taxi Driver 2006
description: Super Taxi Driver 2006 is an arcade car game, produced by Team6 Game Studios development team. The player plays the role of a taxi driver, who is not alien to crazy driving on the streets of the city and a fierce fight for customers. The creators have prepared several strongly tuned tariff models, which can be distributed to customers.

title: Pumpkin Hop
description: Help the pumpkin jump from platform to platform and collect candy. Give your pumpkin a unique look by unlocking new hats that you can get with the candy you have collected.

title: Fantasy of Caocao 2
description: The most enjoyable Chinese-style Roguelike card game! Play as Cao Cao and conquer the Central, Japanese, and Western waifu with your allies, save the world!

title: Soccerlypse
description: Soccerlypse is a First Person Shooter + soccer game where the main objective is to get the ball in the goal more than the opposition and win the game. Play Soccerlypse against real players across the world as you kick, shoot, or explode the ball over the line.

title: Egg Game
description: Jump, roll, and scramble your way to victory in Egg Game! Collect balls, overcome obstacles, and compete with friends in hilarious multiplayer modes. Crack up with laughter as you navigate vibrant maps and unlock eggstraordinary power-ups. Get cracking and experience the ultimate party game!

title: Isle of Poochimon
description: Isle of Pochimoon is a Bullet Heaven game that blends life-simulation elements, including a building system, crafting, selling products at a convenience store, fishing, taming Pochimoon, and Pochimoon Fusion where you can fuse two Pochimoon to create an entirely new one that help you in combat.

title: Banana-Clicker
description: Unlock rare banana treasures with every click!

title: XBattleCarsPVP
description: Gear up for battle in XBattleCar PVP! Choose your vehicle and join your teammates in a real-time battle against other players. Strategize with your team and use your unique vehicle abilities to take down enemy vehicles and secure victory. So get behind the wheel and start your engines!

title: Gape Kape Escape
description: We knew they would come to us one day. We had been observing the development of human technology for a long time. We feared this wild civilization. Now, You must reclaim the artifact they stole from us.

title: The Bygone Days of Her and the Flowers
Learn Japanese Kana & Vocab with Sushi
description: Learn Japanese With Sushi is a edutainment game that teaches Japanese through sushi-themed mini-games. Practice katakana, hiragana, and vocabulary—including kanji—by matching, typing, and sorting sushi. Unlock new words via gachapon, customize JLPT levels (N5-N3), and enjoy a pixel-art sushi bar!

title: Survive the Silence
description: Discover the enchanting world of island survival with an overhead view where exploration, construction and a peaceful atmosphere await you. Expand your territories, complete quests and evolve in this cozy adventure.

title: Sea Bikers Jetski
description: An indie jet ski racing arcade game made for pure fun on the water. 16 tracks across 4 environments: Mediterranean, Caribbean, Baltic, and Pacific. Fire missiles, drop mines, boost, jump, and dodge.

title: Alacrity
description: This game plunges players into a challenging desert adventure, where they play as the brave Piggy Hero, navigating through the desert using the ASDW keys.

title: Reboot My Heart
description: Mathew is tired of rejection, so he builds an android to be his perfect girlfriend. But when the final script malfunctions, he ends up with a flawless male version of himself instead. Now, he must deal with the unexpected consequences of his own creation. Love just got complicated.

title: Deck Combo
description: Deck Combo - An overhead view game where the player on a card board arranges his squad in the form of cards that advance, fighting enemy squads, trying to storm the enemy castle and get the victory.

Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

title: Crimson Rite
description: In times of peace, a lone wanderer decides to camp for the night. He faces an unexpected attack from an orc. Trying to find out why he has been kidnapped, then learns the dark history of an outcast orc tribe. You must escape before the Crimson Rite.

title: Daisenryaku SSB2
description: Wield over 300 modern weapons, from jets to tanks, and outmaneuver rival forces with your strategy. From small islands to massive total-war maps, turn-based battles let both newcomers and veterans play at their own pace.

description: The story is about the young man struggling his daily life in pandemic conditions.Packaged into a short interactive story, Living in 2020 have several alternative endings which you can get through your choices in the game.

title: Hit It Back

title: Ballrun 3D Marble Maze Speedrun
description: You choose to play BallRun not because it is easy, but because it is hard, because the goal will serve to organize and measure the best BallRunners and their skills, because that challenge is one that you are willing to accept, one you are unwilling to postpone, and one which you intend to win.

title: Xeonjia

Xeonjia is an adventure game set in a frozen world.

The floor is frozen! Think carefully about your moves because you can't change direction until you meet an obstacle.
Use you mind to solve the ice slide puzzles!

description: PuppetShow: The Face of Humanity is the 8th game in PuppetShow series, developed by ERS Games.

description: Run fast. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

title: Hot Pig Jump!
description: A 3D action game in which you control the main character, a pig, and aim to reach the top while avoiding flamethrowers, which will result in game over if you get completely burned.

title: Hyperfunk
description: HYPERFUNK is 2 seconds per second of evolved funkstyle. Battle rival crews, hang out online, explore the city, do some crazy tricks and blast through the streets.

title: Mystery of Unicorn Castle
description: Jane Morion always considered herself to be an ordinary girl. Then a letter from England arrived describing the inheritance of a family castle. Solve a looming mystery where dreams and magic intertwine. Explore rooms inside the castle while detecting hidden objects. Can you reveal the secrets of the manor's inhabitants and discover the Morion legacy? The Mystery of Unicorn Castle contains a dark spell thats haunted the family for centuries.

description: Bacon Quest: Lovers' Beef is a light-hearted dungeon crawler featuring Syren a sexy succubus and her cute friend Aoi. Battle through each stage finding hidden gallery images, loot and hentai scenes.

description: Another Layer Down is a fast-paced 3d-platformer focused on fluid, snappy movement that enables you to move exactly as you want. Play through open level's with varied different objectives, shortcuts, and secrets to uncover. Test yourself by crushing the gold and diamond times on each stage!

description: A strange homeless-looking man unsuccessfully tries to escape from an equally strange schizophrenic self-destructing world in 10 minutes, saving cats along the way. It is completely unclear what is happening. And it will not become clearer...

description: Explore a mysterious dungeon, brew potions and solve puzzles to help the blop find the way out!

description: Warp through the space in Gloop, a fast paced arcade game where you'll control your ship with just one button as the hyperspace glitches out!

description: Catio Simulator is a casual incremental game with a satisfying gameplay loop: pet cats, adopt them out, collect adoption fees, and use the proceeds to upgrade your petting ability and fill your catio with new toys, plants, furniture, and expansions that attract even more cats.

title: Terrafactor
description: Harvest resources, craft, build, and automate your way through a tech tree as you expand your base and defend it from enemies.

title: The Single-Eye Nightmare
description: Survive deadly traps, solve environmental puzzles, and navigate the twisting corridors and tunnels of a long-forgotten underground temple. But beware: there's a monstrous Cyclops creature lurking around. Stay out of it's sight long enough to find your way out in this first-person horror game.

title: Everglen
description: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet quirky NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.

title: Wild Chorus
description: An adventure game, but you play musical instruments instead of swinging swords. Gather adorable Sound Sprites, cut through the looming Silence, and rebuild the soundtrack of this hand-illustrated world in whatever way you see fit. No musical ability required!

title: Save the Sheep
description: Sheep are a valuable resource, protect your sheep! Hire soldiers and build barricades on the enemy's path! Explode bombs and set traps!

description: Fast paste, fast typing, arcade, die and retry game. De-coding Armageddon is a game to practice your speed and reflexes.

description: Codestar Cromo Land is a 2D platformer inspired by games such as Rayman, Wario Land 3 & 4, Super Mario Bros, and arcade games. But be careful, although Codestar might seem to be a walk in the park, it might maybe, and I mean just maybe, might kick your ass out of nowhere.

description:
"A super-fast mouse accidentally stumbles into a testing ground where something is wrong... Will he be able to escape before disaster strikes?"

This game is just a rough draft of what the original "Comet Tail" could have been.

description: Take command of the massive VOD(Vehicle of Destruction) and journey across planet Gaiganthra with your IPS(Inter-Planetary Squad)-13 crew to uncover the mystery of humans there. title: Sanity Break
description: A class based survival horror RPG. You have been activated by the Felsat Organization, forced to recover their sensitive data in marked facilities—building your character while maintaining your sanity. Your mind can be more dangerous than the entities that lurk in the shadows.

title: New Lands: Legends of Tenkai - Collector's Edition
Deep West
description: Deep West is a platformer shooter inspired by pixel's Cave Story and Kero Blaster. You play as Brine, a framed sheriff trying to clear his name. Follow him through his quest to find the gang leader who put a price on his head! You can also play as Flint or make your own custom character!

title: Delivery Issues
description: Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

title: Phucker in the Ashes
description: The ultimate telling of the legendary Phucker Saga. Includes new content, improved graphics, features, characters, and surprises the likes of which have never been seen before.

description: This game rolls roguelite and run and gunner into a tight experience with 1-4 couch co-op. Combine bullet powers found on the field to create unique bullet types. Dash to avoid attacks but also to crash enemies or deflect bullets.
